coveredGames.name: Football Manager 27
coveredGames.title: The pillar that the series needed. It fixes most of the issues of previous iteration while being able to juggle the fan favorite features of the past and a modern presentation. Well done.

coveredGames.name: Phantom Blade Zero
coveredGames.title: Spectacular combat and bosses, cinematic aesthetic (in the good way) and a Kung Fu vibe that will keep every action RPG enthusiast glued to their seat.

coveredGames.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
coveredGames.title: Great Castlevania experience with modern graphics and classic 2D nod as well. Great music, and a feeling that you're always achieving something new, although some might not enjoy the heavy platforming

coveredGames.name: CONTROL Resonant
coveredGames.title: STILL delightfully weird. Fight your way through a bizarre paranormal Manhattan and enjoy amazing aesthetics, level design and character movement. Includes MFG, DLSS 4.5 and RT.

coveredGames.name: DEATH STRANDING 2: ON THE BEACH
coveredGames.title: Classic Kojami. Fun, beautiful, exciting, weird, sad. All in equal amounts.

coveredGames.name: Schrödinger's Call
coveredGames.title: A lovely visual novel. Beautifully presented and emotional. It can be repetitive, and a bit linear, but for the right person, it's a great experience. Has a demo for you to find out if that's you.

coveredGames.name: Forza Horizon 6
coveredGames.title: More Forza, for Forza fans. If you're already into Forza/enjoy arcade racing games, you can't really go wrong with it, and will play it plenty, otherwise, skip it. The Japan map is beautiful.

coveredGames.name: Mixtape
coveredGames.title: An interactive art project (more so than a game) that captures a moment in time in the 90's if you are a middle class teenager living in Suburbia. Has great music, nice visuals, but no gameplay.

coveredGames.name: PRAGMATA
coveredGames.title: Battle rogue AI with your adorable sidekick in this single-player adventure that combines action and puzzles (not too hard) at the same time, but does so without interrupting the flow of the game.

coveredGames.name: Crimson Desert Enhanced
coveredGames.title: If you're looking for a crafted narrative with tight controls, look elsewhere. Looking for a massive action-adventure sandbox to play around and get lost in for 100+ hours? You are in the right spot.

coveredGames.name: Resident Evil Requiem
coveredGames.title: Grace and Leon have different play styles, which is a theme of the game, since it pulls various things in previous entries, throws everything at a wall, and it all sticks. Has path Tracing&DLSS4 MFG.

coveredGames.name: ARC Raiders
coveredGames.title: Established itself as THE extraction shooter to play in 2025. Action packed and addictive with friends (and even alone). A great multiplayer experience. It features DLSS 4 w/ Multi Frame Gen & Reflex.

coveredGames.name: Dispatch
coveredGames.title: In the style of classics like Wolf Among Us and Walking Dead, Manage and dispatch the right heroes for the job on a mission to become one again yourself. A great story with a fun cast of characters.

coveredGames.name: Borderlands 4
coveredGames.title: Despite the launch pains, what Borderlands fans love is back: the self aware humor, paired with very fun combat, gunplay and looting. It features DLSS 4 w/ Multi Frame Gen (particularly handy here).

coveredGames.name: The Outer Worlds 2
coveredGames.title: Obsidian's RPG chops shine again. Good writing and choice-based mechanics that meet improved gunplay, abilities, perks, and traits/flaws. This is the game that Outer Worlds 1 should have been.

coveredGames.name: BALL x PIT
coveredGames.title: An addictive and well-priced roguelike. It has elements of Arkanoid mixed with light base building, and it makes you want to do just another run for treasure in the pit that used to be Ballbylon.

coveredGames.name: Megabonk
coveredGames.title: Cheap, fast, rewarding, and runs on a potato PC. The kind of game you play to have some mindless fun for 30 minutes, then move on, then do it again the next day. It would be even better with co-op.

coveredGames.name: Battlefield™ 6
coveredGames.title: A return to form for one of the great multiplayer shooters. Has NVIDIA DLSS 4, Multi Frame Gen & Reflex, feels hectic, chaotic, explosive, and fun, at a scale that only Battlefield seems to get right.

coveredGames.name: ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN
coveredGames.title: A standalone Elden Ring DLC. Many have tried to emulate the genre, but no one does it quite like FromSoftware. An unapologetic, excruciatingly hard, beautiful piece of art, just like the main game.

coveredGames.name: SILENT HILL 2
coveredGames.title: The remake of one of the great horror games of all time is a masterpiece in its own right. If you're even remotely interested in the genre and have never played this, make sure you do so.

coveredGames.name: No, I'm not a Human
coveredGames.title: Has an interesting, psychological horror premise and great ambiance, but fails to remain engaging for more than a few hours. For the right price, it's good fun. Make sure you feed the kitty!

coveredGames.name: Hades II
coveredGames.title: Figh. Die. Become stronger. Get further. Start over. It uses the same basics as its brilliant predecessor and seems to improve on it in most fronts. A beautiful, frantic, addictive, and fun roguelike.

coveredGames.name: Together in Battle

coveredGames.name: Mewgenics
coveredGames.title: Wonderful. Probably the biggest and craziest roguelite on the market

coveredGames.name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE

coveredGames.name: Phantom Blade Zero

coveredGames.name: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4
coveredGames.title: The best Call of Duty Modern Warfare in 10 years. Extremely good campaign.

coveredGames.name: CONTROL Resonant

coveredGames.title: Definitely no masterpiece, but not all bad either. It misses its target audience in places, with odd backstories and an MP horde mode that needs work. Still, far from a complete disaster. 7/10

coveredGames.name: Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii
coveredGames.title: The Yakuza series stands for quality, dark humor, and long playtime—and that’s exactly what you get in one of the best and craziest entries in the series. 9/10

coveredGames.name: STAR WARS Zero Company™
coveredGames.title: Who would’ve thought? But it’s one of the best turn-based tactical RPGs with XCOM-style mechanics out there. Absolutely recommend buying it. Must-have 9/10

coveredGames.name: How to Fish
coveredGames.title: Behind the cozy aesthetic lies a brilliant masterclass in pacing. How to Fish seamlessly bridges relaxing cozy mechanics with a deeply rewarding collection system

coveredGames.name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds

coveredGames.name: Adaptory
coveredGames.title: Oxygen Not Included copycat where the player manages a squad of survivors stranded on an asteroid in space.

coveredGames.name: WARDOGS

coveredGames.name: The Blood of Dawnwalker
coveredGames.title: A completely new gaming experience, featuring an innovative system that changes the way you can play and complete the game. Nothing like this has ever been done before.

coveredGames.name: Windbound
coveredGames.title: Windbound combines detailed sailing-crafting mechanics with an ambitious fantasy framework that gives the modern survival-adventure genre a refreshing layer of visual and mechanical identity

coveredGames.name: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy
coveredGames.title: Not some generic, run-of-the-mill crap like the failed multiplayer game Marvel’s Avengers. Pure single-player gaming at its finest, and rarely have I seen so much love and attention to detail. Top!

coveredGames.name: Medieval Dynasty
coveredGames.title: Blending first-person action, village automation, hunting mechanics, and dynasty planning, it delivers impressive long-term value for dedicated simulation enthusiasts.

coveredGames.name: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced
coveredGames.title: The best Assassin’s Creed game of all time is back as a high-quality remake — highly recommended.

coveredGames.name: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy

coveredGames.name: The Referee Committee

coveredGames.name: Bodycam

coveredGames.name: Once Human

coveredGames.name: PatriotMemoirs
coveredGames.title: A really well-made FMV set during World War II. Very exciting, with great 4K quality.

coveredGames.name: Servant of the Lake

coveredGames.name: IRON NEST: Heavy Turret Simulator

coveredGames.name: Crusaders Quest : Hero Town
coveredGames.title: Clear, visually engaging, and packed with content for a desktop companion—offering pleasant company while you work.

coveredGames.name: Mistfall Hunter
coveredGames.title: A fantastic game with innovative gameplay and fresh ideas that bring something new to the genre. Soulslike and extraction mechanics work incredibly well together. Highly recommended.

coveredGames.name: DragonSword : Awakening
coveredGames.title: Visually magnificent and mechanically exhilarating premium game and not some F2P Gacha, DragonSword: Awakening sets an impressive benchmark for fast-paced character action games. 9/10

coveredGames.name: Stellar Blade™
coveredGames.title: A gorgeous, fast-paced action RPG with satisfying, rhythmic combat, spectacular boss fights, and a stunning world. A must-play for fans of uncensored and stylish hack-and-slash games!

coveredGames.name: Pay 2 Win: The World is Mine

coveredGames.name: Total War: WARHAMMER III

coveredGames.name: Windrose

coveredGames.name: Sudden Strike 5

coveredGames.name: Gothic 1 Remake

coveredGames.name: DAVY x JONES

coveredGames.name: Medic: Pacific War

coveredGames.name: Forza Horizon 6

coveredGames.name: 楽園追放 -The Stellar Angel-
coveredGames.title: Japanese voice acting, familiar faces and a detailed TIPS glossary make this a warm return to Expelled from Paradise. Its classic visual-novel format keeps the focus firmly on story and choices.

coveredGames.name: Vice: Magic City Mayhem
coveredGames.title: An odd Zelda-meets-Vice City romp, mixing top-down exploration, dungeon puzzles and weapon-led combat. Raptor-packed yachts and neon clubs give Dutch's rescue mission a wicked sense of humor.

coveredGames.name: Lifeguard Simulator
coveredGames.title: A shift means more than pulling swimmers from the water: prepare safety zones, maintain the beach and handle emergencies as weather changes. The concept works, but some tasks need clearer guidance.

coveredGames.name: Psycho-Sleuth
coveredGames.title: Thirteen players, warped perceptions and murders that defy the evidence make every case a fresh puzzle. Its sharp character writing and escalating twists carry a gripping, Danganronpa-like mystery.

coveredGames.name: Slotbound
coveredGames.title: A slot machine as the heart of a roguelite defense sounds absurd, yet unit fusion, class upgrades and carefully stacked synergies give every spin tactical weight. Luck is only half the battle!

coveredGames.name: Quarantine Lab Sort
coveredGames.title: Sorting thousands of lab objects has a strangely soothing rhythm, while centrifuges, escaped animals and radioactive waste keep the cleanup from feeling routine. A messy but satisfying follow-up.

coveredGames.name: Warota: I Live Next to The Demon King's Castle LOL
coveredGames.title: Between crafting, exploration and hack-and-slash skirmishes, there's always another little task to tackle. The Demon King's idol concert gives this village builder a gloriously absurd fantasy streak.

coveredGames.name: Hope in the City
coveredGames.title: A missing-family mystery with an artist's eye: Hope turns everyday details into sketches, then connects them into clues. Neon-lit Shenyang gives this investigative adventure a quietly haunting soul.

coveredGames.name: Moomin: Midsummer Madness
coveredGames.title: Summer mischief sweeps the Moomins into a floating theatre, where curious friends, gentle puzzles and little surprises await. Hand-painted scenes lend this journey the warmth of a storybook hug.

coveredGames.name: HEART ABYSS
coveredGames.title: A half-fox warrior tears through a folklore-soaked empire where katana work and supernatural Qi go hand in hand. Relentless combat rewards aggression, while striking pixel art gives each clash bite.

coveredGames.name: Space Savory
coveredGames.title: Part kitchen sim, part cosmic oddity, this adventure serves up eccentric customers, shady side hustles and plenty of questionable ethics. Its hand-drawn world makes the whole interstellar mess sing.

coveredGames.name: Potion-making: Path of the Alchemist
coveredGames.title: Brewing is only half the game: recipes, spells and talismans feed a clever race across shifting boards. A thoughtful digital take on a tabletop classic, best enjoyed with rival alchemists.

coveredGames.name: Shipping Store Simulator 2037
coveredGames.title: Sorting boxes is only the start: robots, drones, rival firms and shady VIP jobs gradually transform this warehouse sim into a moreish little business sandbox with plenty of amusing detours.

coveredGames.name: Dominus Gladiatus
coveredGames.title: Managing a gladiator school has a strong hook, and the hand-drawn arena fights look gruesome, but shallow progression, repetitive routines and a very short campaign blunt the appeal.

coveredGames.name: Eternal Palace Sakura
coveredGames.title: Procedural floors and branching rewards give each ascent a tactical edge, while Arts and elemental builds offer room to experiment. Combat has flair, but stiff transitions blunt its momentum.

coveredGames.name: Dungeon Munchies 2
coveredGames.title: Cooking is the key to survival in this bizarre space-colony adventure. Hunt strange creatures, turn them into recipes and stack food-based abilities before facing the next wave of foes.

coveredGames.name: Neo Junk City
coveredGames.title: Robots, road patrols and a city slowly claimed by the sea set the scene for a strange investigation. Its mix of branching encounters, quick-draw shoot-outs and retro racing feels refreshingly offbeat.

coveredGames.name: Frontier: Path of Shadows
coveredGames.title: Think XCOM on the fringes of deep space, with a stronger focus on crew dynamics and narrative choices. Procedural battlefields and squad upgrades keep each mission engaging.

coveredGames.name: President Simulator
coveredGames.title: A satirical presidency where every decree has consequences. Balance the economy, military and public opinion, handle awkward interviews and decide whether that big red button is worth pressing.

coveredGames.name: ANOMALITH
coveredGames.title: Showa-era malls and liminal corridors give the horror a distinct identity. Limited ammo, strange anomalies and the need to extract with useful loot make every dive tense without feeling sluggish.

coveredGames.name: Phantom Blade Zero
coveredGames.title: A fever dream of steel and ancient mysticism, where razor-sharp combat meets breathtaking scenery. Memorable duels and secrets along branching paths make the journey as rewarding as the spectacle.

coveredGames.name: ASPIS
coveredGames.title: ASPIS makes reality itself feel deliciously unreliable. Its bizarre sci-fi mystery keeps curiosity running wild, turning every revelation into another reason to dig deeper. A wonderfully strange ride!

coveredGames.name: Nicotine Merchant Simulator™
coveredGames.title: Every empire starts somewhere, and this one begins with improvised production gear. Craft, pack, stock shelves, and automate your way to success in a business sim where inventory management is king.

coveredGames.name: WE ARE FOOTBALL 2027
coveredGames.title: A football management sandbox with room for every kind of ambition: rescue a struggling side, create a club from scratch or follow a team. The extensive editor makes the world truly yours.

coveredGames.name: Order: The New Dawn
coveredGames.title: The appeal lies in scaling up: a humble outpost becomes a colony, then a transport network, then a foothold among the stars. The mix of exploration and infrastructure rewards long-term planning.

coveredGames.name: Japanese Ramen Simulator
coveredGames.title: From prepping broth to plating toppings, every order keeps the kitchen moving. Team up to split the work, invent your own bowls, and turn a humble ramen counter into a bustling little business.

coveredGames.name: Police Chief Simulator
coveredGames.title: Balancing station upgrades, staff assignments, and street patrols creates a steady loop of goals. Traffic stops and car chases bring the liveliest moments, even if investigations stay simple.

coveredGames.name: HAM: The Game
coveredGames.title: Managing the factory is only half the fun; the real joy is watching a simple delivery turn into total chaos. Throw things, shout instructions, and somehow meet the quota before everything breaks.

coveredGames.name: No Such Place
coveredGames.title: Exploring eerie zones is only half the job: medicine, artifacts, and intel must make it back to extraction. Weapon crafting, character growth, and a customizable safehouse give each run purpose.

coveredGames.name: Colorbound
coveredGames.title: Color becomes more than a visual flourish as painted objects reshape the path ahead. Clever physics puzzles, expressive pixel art and a heartfelt musical journey give this platformer a distinct identi

coveredGames.name: Thunder Hoop Collection (QUByte Classics)
coveredGames.title: A delightfully odd slice of arcade history, pairing nimble run-and-gun platforming with grotesque sci-fi creatures. CRT filters, instant saves and rewind make these tough relics easier to revisit.

coveredGames.name: Maid Cafe Simulator
coveredGames.title: Between frantic orders, café upgrades and late-night chats, this anime-infused sim finds a sweet rhythm. Five distinct maids bring personality to the grind, with romance adding a teasing spark.

coveredGames.name: Duelist: Idle Expedition
coveredGames.title: Hand-drawn pixel art gives this idle RPG a distinct JRPG charm, while 90+ roles and deep gear customization make squad building surprisingly rewarding. Your guild keeps growing even when you're away.

coveredGames.name: Golden Swirl
coveredGames.title: The fusion of deckbuilding and active evasion gives this roguelite a distinctive cadence. Every card demands timing, every dodge matters, and clever builds can turn chaos into elegant control.

coveredGames.name: Blades & Battles
coveredGames.title: A handsome revival of classic arcade brawling, where swords, sorcery, and Arthurian legend collide. The straightforward combat is easy to grasp, while local co-op brings plenty of camaraderie.

coveredGames.name: Transport Fever 3
coveredGames.title: A wonderfully absorbing tycoon where roads, rails, ships, and aircraft become pieces of one enormous machine. Balancing growth, congestion, costs, and demand makes every improvement feel meaningful.

coveredGames.name: Knuckle Jet
coveredGames.title: The joy here comes from keeping your momentum alive. Jet-powered punches send you flying between enemies and obstacles, while hidden collectibles and gear give every level another reason to replay.

coveredGames.name: Monster Alchemy
coveredGames.title: Forget catching monsters: here, you invent them. Experimenting with recipes and fusions is half the fun, while turning your creations into a capable team makes every new discovery feel useful.

coveredGames.name: It's Fine
coveredGames.title: An inventive idle game that turns game development into a wonderfully chaotic progression loop. Upgrading stations, chasing secrets, and resetting for stronger runs makes it easy to lose an evening.

coveredGames.name: Mystery Egg Shop Simulator
coveredGames.title: Running a mystery egg shop sounds simple until every unopened egg becomes a tempting gamble. Balancing sales, collecting rare figures, and building themed dioramas gives the routine plenty of charm.

coveredGames.name: Fakin It XL
coveredGames.title: Fakin' It XL is a great social deduction game where no one needs to run the adventure. At it's best it's playing a game with friends, not with the TV.

coveredGames.name: Warhammer Survivors
coveredGames.title: Warhammer Survivors sticks close to its roots and feels like an expansion to Vampire Survivors, but it also has a few twists of its own to distinguish itself.

coveredGames.name: Theos: Cities Of Myth
coveredGames.title: While not all changes hit home, with some missing mechanics sorely impacting the title, the additions breathe new life to the genre. It's well worth the time to play for fans of the genre.

coveredGames.name: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School
coveredGames.title: Escape Academy 2 lands the sequel spectacularly, bringing back everything that made the original so great, while enhancing it with more to do and an open world to explore.

coveredGames.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
coveredGames.title: Go into Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered with the expectation that this is merely a remaster, so it can feel antiquated or even a bit clunky in some areas.

coveredGames.name: The Killing Stone
coveredGames.title: The Killing Stone weaves an intriguing tale of family curses and folk horror as you build a deck to take on a devil at his own game.

coveredGames.name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE
coveredGames.title: Final Fantasy Resonance is a spectacular RPG that captures the Final Fantasy experience of old. Equipped with a modern vision, it offers a compelling story, and hours of exciting battles.

coveredGames.name: Stupid Never Dies
coveredGames.title: Stupid Never Dies has fantastic style and the mindless hack-and-slash gameplay of a PS2 classic, but with all the modern QoL changes we expect in 2026.

coveredGames.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 12
coveredGames.title: These games all being so different does make me less likely to play them as a pack, but it doesn't change the fact that these are going to be games I'm very much going to want to return to playing.

coveredGames.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
coveredGames.title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 improves upon the original with tighter level design and outstanding visuals.

coveredGames.name: Disney•Pixar Toy Story: Retro Roundup!
coveredGames.title: While there are some games in the pack that don't have much to offer, the good stuff is really good. A must-own for any fans of Disney-Pixar 3D platformers.

coveredGames.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
coveredGames.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse unfurls like a tapestry of mysteries. There are so many secrets to discover, and it'll constantly tug at your curiosity, however, the difficulty is a little inconsistent,

coveredGames.name: Deep Dish Dungeon
coveredGames.title: Deep Dish Dungeon attempts to blend dungeon crawling with survival crafting, but never truly manages to make this combination work. It's still an interesting time full of exploration and puzzles.

coveredGames.name: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival
coveredGames.title: Hellraiser: Revival gets the themes and look absolutely nailed down, but with a 'constantly on' story it betrays itself as players will find themselves quickly desensitized.

coveredGames.name: Forever Ago
coveredGames.title: Forever Ago is a wonderfully meditative narrative experience. It expresses the profound in the mundane parts of life beautifully.

coveredGames.name: Order of the Sinking Star
coveredGames.title: Order of the Sinking Star takes a gaming mechanic that has been around as long as gaming and hasn't stopped iterating upon it. A must have for puzzle gamers.

coveredGames.name: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™
coveredGames.title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer provides excellent, exhilarating racing gameplay, a cheesy but enjoyable underdog story, and some clunky roguelike trappings.

coveredGames.name: Gears of War: E-Day
coveredGames.title: Gears of War: E-Day is the best game in the series. The story gives us an up close and personal look at the events of E-Day, providing a horror-filled and harrowing experience.

coveredGames.name: ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE
coveredGames.title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve has a lot going for it. It's full to the brim with plane customization, a bucket load of missions, and a lengthy story.

coveredGames.name: SiN Reloaded
coveredGames.title: From a gameplay perspective, SiN Reloaded is a decent shooter bursting with personality, but it has a problem standing out among the pack.

coveredGames.name: SILENT HILL: Townfall
coveredGames.title: Silent Hill: Townfall is a terrifying and incredibly immersive experience, putting heavy emphasis on hide-and-seek horror.

coveredGames.name: CONTROL Resonant
coveredGames.title: Control Resonant delivers on Remedy's signature weirdness, with psychedelic views, and intriguing mysteries around every corner. Unfortunately, the combat that connects every great moment is lacking.

coveredGames.name: SPRAWL zero
coveredGames.title: Sprawl zero might take inspiration from a few of the 2000s best shooters, with a huge amount of guns that somehow all work and feel distinct.

coveredGames.name: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault
coveredGames.title: The sequel is a well-polished release that strengthens the best aspects of the game, from its overall story, roguelike mechanics and combat, engaging shopkeeping features, and worldbuilding.

coveredGames.name: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
coveredGames.title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy is a mystery from step one, filled with entertaining but not particularly difficult puzzles. It's a story worth experiencing.

coveredGames.name: STAR WARS Zero Company™
coveredGames.title: Star Wars Zero Company is an excellent tactics game, with strong core mechanics and plenty of customization on offer. The story is exciting, and the cast of characters feels complex and real.

coveredGames.name: Lou's Lagoon
coveredGames.title: Lou's Lagoon feels and plays like the ideal island-hopping adventure that meets what cozy game enthusiasts may like and enjoy.

coveredGames.name: Blood Dungeon
coveredGames.title: It's wacky and a bit outrageous, but if you're able to relish in the chaos, you'll be rewarded with an addicting experience with plenty of new things to constantly throw your way.

coveredGames.name: EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 27
coveredGames.title: Madden NFL 27 has a lot going for it, but it still needs some work. Bugs and long loading really take away from what should be a beefy experience.

coveredGames.name: Creepshow
coveredGames.title: Creepshow has some strong writing and two very enjoyable comic-style horror vignettes. However, the overarching plot fails to go anywhere meaningful during the runtime, leaving a sour note by the end.

coveredGames.name: Memoirium
coveredGames.title: Memoirium is a valiant Soulslike effort from a tiny team, and if you can get past a couple of pretty big flaws, it's worth a try, especially if you're a genre fan.

coveredGames.name: Agent 64: Spies Never Die
coveredGames.title: There are some rough edges that detract from the experience, including boring story objectives and poor multiplayer map design.

coveredGames.name: ReStory: Chill Electronics Repairs
coveredGames.title: Restory: Chill Electronics Repair is a pleasant experience with satisfying electronic repair gameplay with a serviceable, though at times distant, number of narrative strings.

coveredGames.name: RUNT
coveredGames.title: Runt is a heart pounding whodunit visual novel that keeps you on the edge of your seat through multiple playthroughs.

coveredGames.name: Beast of Reincarnation
coveredGames.title: Alright combat and the occasional pretty maps aren't enough to make up for wooden characters and a lack of variety.

coveredGames.name: Halo: Campaign Evolved
coveredGames.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved looks great and runs well taking the story we've loved for 25 years and giving it some modern gameplay upgrades.

coveredGames.name: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game
coveredGames.title: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game is not just a good, well, fighting game, it's the best Avatar game to be released.

coveredGames.name: The Incident at Galley House
coveredGames.title: The Incident At Galley House is a fantastic murder mystery wrapped up in a unique storytelling style.

coveredGames.name: Moss: The Forgotten Relic
coveredGames.title: The first half of the release might drag it down a bit, but with things picking up after a couple of hours, this is a tale well-worth your time.

coveredGames.name: EA SPORTS™ College Football 27
coveredGames.title: College Football 27 adds a whole lot of customization for the new year. From Road to Glory, to Dynasty mode, and even regular Play Now matches, there's something new for everyone despite a few hitches

coveredGames.name: Neo Junk City
coveredGames.title: Dive into a Point and Click action-RPG with fast-paced shoot-outs and retro arcade racing. Artist Jhano has shared so much great pixel art on NG, it's exciting to see Neo Junk City out in the wild!

coveredGames.name: Neon Rhythm Plus
coveredGames.title: Every song is a boss fight in this hand-drawn dual-screen rhythm game. Time your moves to the beat of the music, or make your own custom tracks. Made by Figburn on NG!

coveredGames.name: Signy & Mino: Against All Gods
coveredGames.title: A Tag-Team Battle RPG where every move combos together! Created by Afro-Ninja, creator of An Escape Series, Territory War and Soda Dungeon!

coveredGames.name: Endacopia
coveredGames.title: A Point-and-Click Puzzle Adventure that is visually reminiscent of early computer edutainment games... with underlying horrors. By Andyl4nd on NG!

coveredGames.name: Mewgenics
coveredGames.title: A massive triumph by Edmund McMillen and Tyler Glaiel! Create the ultimate cat army through tactical breeding and send them into deep, challenging turn-based adventures.

coveredGames.name: FUN HOME
coveredGames.title: Originally made for Flash Forward 2025. You are a little boy trapped in a house with an axe wielding maniac clown. Can you figure out the mysteries of the house and escape with your life?

coveredGames.name: Contract Rush DX
coveredGames.title: Contract Rush DX is a hand-animated 2D Shoot 'Em Up, with multiple playable characters. Explore the world, collect powerful upgrades throughout levels, and unleash them to defeat difficult boss battle

coveredGames.name: ODDCORE
coveredGames.title: ODDCORE is a first person, retro-inspired boomer shooter with roguelike ingredients that is packed with endless, brain-rotting visuals of your bullets exploding everything they touch.

coveredGames.name: Master Of Pottery
coveredGames.title: Master Of Pottery is a true virtual sanctuary. Molding pottery is smooth, glazing looks realistic and curating your personal museum gives wonderful direction to your art.

coveredGames.name: Farmer's Diary
coveredGames.title: Managing orchards and vineyards alongside seasonal field crops gives longterm planning real weight.

coveredGames.name: Iron Blight
coveredGames.title: Iron Blight is one of the most interesting indie horrors released in 2026. While the visuals are simple, they provide great retro charm and gameplay is extremely smooth.

coveredGames.name: 7 Millimeters
coveredGames.title: Woodcrafting mechanics are tactile and realistic. You cannot just rush through cuts, precision matters.

coveredGames.name: Car Park Capital
coveredGames.title: Car Park Capital embraces that kind of imagination while giving players practical construction and management decisions to consider along the way.

coveredGames.name: THANKS, LIGHT.
coveredGames.title: THANKS, LIGHT takes a familiar visual phenomenon and turns it into an imaginative puzzle system.

coveredGames.name: Coal Duty
coveredGames.title: Mining quotas, proximity communication and cooperative horror form an appealing combination for anyone interested in an fun extraction game.

coveredGames.name: Realm of Taiwu
coveredGames.title: Realm of Taiwu has a promising cooperative adventure. Friends can join expeditions, explore character choices, and pursue stronger equipment together.

coveredGames.name: Make the Empire Great Again
coveredGames.title: Peaceful construction and turn-based combat creates a refreshing rhythm. Managing the city feels fun, while quests and battles provide exciting interruptions from routine.

coveredGames.name: FIRE AND ASHES
coveredGames.title: FIRE AND ASHES concept pairs naturally with vulnerable exploration, threatening pursuers, and the uncertainty of a psychological nightmare.

coveredGames.name: The Horde of Gorak
coveredGames.title: Gathering resources, recruiting warriors, researching technologies and smashing fortified castles combine into a delightfully focused experience.

coveredGames.name: DUAL PROTOCOL: The Case of Eva & Miles
coveredGames.title: This is a great choice for friends who enjoy puzzle games but want something more conversational. Every solved obstacle comes from combining two viewpoints, so progressing is fun.

coveredGames.name: Rock Hunter
coveredGames.title: The straightforward relationship between shooting and earning is a strong selling point for Rock Hunter. The opportunity to develop both personal firepower and a hired workforce is fun.

coveredGames.name: ROCK CORE
coveredGames.title: ROCK CORE brings together an appealing collection of ideas: peaceful surroundings, straightforward mining, practical upgrades and helpful workers.

coveredGames.name: Ranch Farm and Store Simulator
coveredGames.title: Collecting eggs and milk, harvesting vegetables and fruit, then selling everything in my own shop creates a complete gameplay loop.

coveredGames.name: Architecture & Design
coveredGames.title: Architecture & Design offers more than a blank canvas for decorating. Its connected structural tools create a solidl foundation, allowing furnishings and materials to complement an architectural plan.

coveredGames.name: CHAMBER 13
coveredGames.title: CHAMBER 13 delivers a surprisingly satisfying progression loop. Smashing rocks starts simple, but the steady stream of upgrades, automation, and rising profits makes every session feel fun.

coveredGames.name: Barfender: CO-OP Bar Simulator
coveredGames.title: Hands-on drink preparation, lively customers, humorous accidents and physical interaction keep management energetic and interesting.

coveredGames.name: Factory Default: Build, Trade, Repeat
coveredGames.title: The dynamic economy, where prices react to events and trading volume, adds welcome unpredictability. The explorable 3D Earth is a cool foundation for a management game.

coveredGames.name: Chromascape
coveredGames.title: Chromascape offers a charming blend of gentle exploration, clever color-based puzzles, and expressive hand-drawn scenery.

coveredGames.name: even if TEMPEST
coveredGames.title: The contrast between beautiful presentation and brutal circumstances gives even if TEMPEST a striking atmosphere.

coveredGames.name: Mineral Mining Simulator
coveredGames.title: Filters, splitters, mergers, storage systems, and vertical routing provide plenty of freedom for designing efficient production lines.

coveredGames.name: Sword & Siege Age of Longbow: Volume I
coveredGames.title: The 90+ scenarios offer incredible variety, and the tactical depth of the battles is simply unmatched. A fun-to-play strategy title.

coveredGames.name: Cloudbreaker
coveredGames.title: Breaking through a cloud layer after defeating a boss feels like genuine progress, while the promise of greater danger and richer discoveries encourages continued exploration.

coveredGames.name: Great Northern War
coveredGames.title: Enjoy methodical turn-based strategy with morale, command, supply, fatigue, attrition, formation, and weather interactions, creating battles where planning matters just as much as raw numbers.

coveredGames.name: MONOWAVE
coveredGames.title: The blend of empathy, puzzle solving, and platforming gives quest both entertainment value and genuine purpose.

coveredGames.name: Breathedge 2
coveredGames.title: Better tools and suit improvements gradually unlock previously inaccessible areas, making exploration feel connected to meaningful character and equipment development.

coveredGames.name: Arcaneering: Beyond Automation
coveredGames.title: Arcaneering: Beyond Automation blends factory planning with magical discovery in a wonderfully approachable way.

coveredGames.name: Lady Death Demonicron
coveredGames.title: Fighting through waves of demonic creatures remains exciting, and the dramatic environments provide a fitting backdrop for Lady Death’s destructive supernatural abilities.

coveredGames.name: DoDonPachi Resurrection Reignite
coveredGames.title: DoDonPachi Resurrection Reignite isn't a perfect port, but as far as shmup genre goes, the gameplay is great.

coveredGames.name: TFC2: The Fertile Crescent 2 - Collapse of The Bronze Age
coveredGames.title: Journey-based structure is a welcome change from traditional RTS conquest. Guiding survivors through a changing world gives each scenario context, momentum, and a strong sense of purpose.

coveredGames.name: Better Than Dead
coveredGames.title: The protagonist’s shift from hunted survivor to relentless avenger gives the action emotional momentum & Hong Kong’s dense urban spaces are an excellent match for the close-range action.

coveredGames.name: Strategos
coveredGames.title: Strategos offers deep strategic combat, rich historical flavor, and impressive scale. Pretty cool one to try.

coveredGames.name: Internet Survivor Survivors
coveredGames.title: The pixel art is adorable, the action is satisfyingly chaotic, and the internet-inspired humor gives everything a distinctive identity.

coveredGames.name: Parking World: Build & Manage
coveredGames.title: Constructing at a comfortable pace while gradually optimizing every part of the operation makes it easy to enjoy long sessions.

coveredGames.name: Military Logistics Simulator
coveredGames.title: Coordinating resources, avoiding bottlenecks, and improving reliability produces an enjoyable management experience with plenty of satisfying problem-solving.

coveredGames.name: The Dream Office
coveredGames.title: The Dream Office focus on an ideal office environment which creates plenty of space for creative and satisfying play.

coveredGames.name: Nerd Simulator
coveredGames.title: Mervin’s absurd jobs are a hilarious experience, turning his attempts at independence into memorable comedic challenges.

coveredGames.name: Lugal: Bronze Age Survival Game
coveredGames.title: Collecting materials supports bigger plans, bigger plans improve survival, and each success opens another exciting goal.

coveredGames.name: Echoes of Mystralia
coveredGames.title: Experimenting with spell structures, improving your approach, and adapting between runs keeps the action engaging.

coveredGames.name: 楽園追放 -The Stellar Angel-
coveredGames.title: A fantastic VN & official sequel to the sci-fi anime Expelled from Paradise! Join Angela and Dingo on Earth in a choice-driven story where balancing bonds and resolve shapes your ending.

coveredGames.name: Thank You Bus Driver
coveredGames.title: Thank You Bus Driver is a very creative title with beautiful art direction and some insane gameplay. Get to your destinations on time and decide who stays and who gets thrown out. Highly recommended!

coveredGames.name: Dragon Dinner
coveredGames.title: Dragon Dinner is a very cute management game with an addicting gameplay loop. Play as an adorable dragon and build your own successful restaurant business!

coveredGames.name: TFC2: The Fertile Crescent 2 - Collapse of The Bronze Age
coveredGames.title: 🏺 TFC2: The Fertile Crescent 2 - Collapse of The Bronze Age - Deep strategy satisfying city building and epic Bronze Age warfare create a rewarding experience for every strategy fan ⚔️🌾

coveredGames.name: Drone Sector
coveredGames.title: 🤖 Drone Sector - Building and upgrading powerful drones while exploring dangerous zones feels exciting and rewarding. The action and progression kept me hooked 🚁⚡

coveredGames.name: Liquidation RTS
coveredGames.title: ⚔️ Liquidation RTS - Intense real-time strategy battles smart unit tactics and satisfying base management make every match exciting. Great variety keeps each victory feeling earned 🚀🎯

coveredGames.name: Nedi Cloud Simulator
coveredGames.title: ☁️ Nedi Cloud Simulator - Building and managing your own cloud business is surprisingly fun and satisfying. The progression feels rewarding and every upgrade keeps you coming back 💻🚀

coveredGames.name: Cupid Parasite
coveredGames.title: A beautiful otome visual novel, Cupid Parasite has you playing as a female matchmaker, finding love for a variety of unique bachelors, and maybe even finding it for yourself.

coveredGames.name: False Hero
coveredGames.title: An excellent indie souls-like adventure game, False Hero is a strong indie title that understands what makes the genre work so well and puts a fresh take on it.

coveredGames.name: PROHIBEAST
coveredGames.title: A cool tactical stealth game with a unique premise and fun gameplay, PROHIBEAST is set in the 1930s and features a whole bunch of interesting ideas and fun worldbuilding.

coveredGames.name: Evil School
coveredGames.title: Evil School is an FMV story that really was quite surprising with how deep the story goes. There are plenty of twists and turns and it offers great replay value. A treat for story lovers out there!

coveredGames.name: Sort Them Ducks
coveredGames.title: An enjoyable sorting game involving tons and tons of ducks! It can be quite engaging and when you blink, suddenly a few hours have passed! A really enjoyable game and it offers good replay value also!

coveredGames.name: DragonSword : Awakening
coveredGames.title: DragonSword: Awakening is a highly enjoyable open-world RPG with colorful environments and a rich land to explore. Meet different characters and embark on a great adventure!

coveredGames.name: Nightfall Empress
coveredGames.title: 🌙 Nightfall Empress - Gorgeous pixel art fast-paced combat and rewarding exploration create a fantastic dark fantasy adventure. Every boss fight feels challenging and satisfying 🦇⚔️

coveredGames.name: Shikhondo: Blue Pieta
coveredGames.title: A gorgeous Bullet hell inspired by Korean mythology where every screen becomes pure chaos. Gorgeous patterns, brutal bosses, and zero room for mistakes.

coveredGames.name: Drive Together
coveredGames.title: 🚗 Drive Together - Hilarious teamwork chaotic driving and crazy obstacle courses make every match a nonstop laugh fest. Coordinating the car with friends is pure fun 😂🎮

coveredGames.name: CaseCracker 3
coveredGames.title: 🕵️ CaseCracker3 - Smart investigations intense interrogations and deep deduction mechanics make every case feel rewarding. Piecing together the truth is seriously addictive 🔎📂

coveredGames.name: Panic Delivery
coveredGames.title: 📦 Panic Delivery - Chaotic co-op deliveries creepy monsters and hilarious clone mechanics make every mission pure madness. Dying with friends has never been this fun 😂👾

coveredGames.name: What'Sub

coveredGames.name: Creepy Tale: Snow Child
coveredGames.title: ❄️ Creepy Tale: Snow Child - A beautifully creepy adventure packed with clever puzzles spooky fairy tale vibes and amazing animation. The dark atmosphere feels magical 👁️🕯️

coveredGames.name: Virtual Driving School

coveredGames.name: Nekopedia: Find Her Tail

coveredGames.name: Hotel Architect

coveredGames.name: WITHOUT A HITCH
coveredGames.title: 🚚 WITHOUT A HITCH - Hilarious co-op chaos crazy crane mechanics and nonstop teamwork disasters make every delivery unforgettable. Yelling at friends has never been this fun 😂👻

coveredGames.name: Bangkok Story: A Stray Dog
coveredGames.title: 🐕 Bangkok Story: A Stray Dog - An emotional and heartfelt adventure with touching storytelling and powerful moments. The bond between the man and the dog feels unforgettable 💔🌆

coveredGames.name: Game Saloon Simulator
coveredGames.title: 🕹️ Game Saloon Simulator - Running an arcade hall serving customers and playing classic machines is super cozy and fun! Building the ultimate gaming saloon feels awesome 🎮🍹

coveredGames.name: Twin Shot Deluxe
coveredGames.title: 🏹 Twin Shot Deluxe - Charming retro visuals chaotic co-op fun and addictive arcade gameplay make this remaster feel fantastic! The new hats and modes are hilarious 😺✨

coveredGames.name: Crimson Oath
coveredGames.title: ⚔️ Crimson Oath - Challenging souls-like combat epic boss fights and a dark fantasy world make every battle feel rewarding. The parry and counter mechanics are super satisfying 🔥🛡️

coveredGames.name: Racer Overdrive
coveredGames.title: 🏎️ Racer Overdrive - Fast drifting explosive races and awesome nitro boosts make every track feel intense and exciting! The arcade driving style is pure adrenaline 🔥🚗

coveredGames.name: Ariana and the Elder Codex
coveredGames.title: 📚 Ariana and the Elder Codex - Fun magic combat creative spell combinations and charming exploration make this adventure feel magical from start to finish ✨🪄

coveredGames.name: Mini Tank Mayhem
coveredGames.title: 🚀 Mini Tank Mayhem - Addictive deckbuilding crazy combos and nonstop alien battles make every run super exciting! Mixing roguelike strategy with tower defense feels awesome 🎮💥

coveredGames.name: Above the Snow
coveredGames.title: 🏔️ Above the Snow - Cozy mountain management charming characters and relaxing snowy vibes make this adventure feel warm and unforgettable. Building the perfect Alpine resort is so fun ❄️☕

coveredGames.name: SimplePlanes 2
coveredGames.title: ✈️ SimplePlanes 2 - Building crazy aircraft exploring huge maps and causing multiplayer chaos is insanely fun! The creative freedom and physics make every creation feel awesome 🚀🌍

coveredGames.name: Pebble Knights
coveredGames.title: 🪨 Pebble Knights - Chaotic co-op battles funny mechanics and nonstop action make every run super exciting! Reviving teammates by eating graves is wild and hilarious 😂⚔️

coveredGames.name: Lugh World
coveredGames.title: 🌍 Lugh World - Capturing adorable Lughs exploring huge regions and battling with friends feels magical and exciting! The MMO world is full of charm adventure and mystery ✨🐾

coveredGames.name: Origament: A Paper Adventure
coveredGames.title: 📜 Origament: A Paper Adventure - A charming and relaxing journey with beautiful worlds clever puzzles and creative paper transformations. Every level feels magical and heartwarming ✈️🌙

coveredGames.name: SPARK IGNITES
coveredGames.title: ⚔️ SPARK IGNITES - Gorgeous pixel art deep tactical battles and meaningful choices create an epic fantasy adventure. Every fight feels strategic and every decision matters 🔥👑

coveredGames.name: The Crust
coveredGames.title: 🌕 The Crust - Building a lunar colony automating production and exploring the Moon feels super immersive and rewarding. The sci-fi atmosphere and management systems are fantastic 🚀⚙️

coveredGames.name: No Vacation for an Executioner
coveredGames.title: 🩸 No Vacation for an Executioner - Dark PS2-style horror with creepy atmosphere brutal combat and unique art direction. Feels like a nostalgic nightmare in the best possible way 🎮🕯️

coveredGames.name: Corner Shop: NightShift
coveredGames.title: 🌙 Corner Shop: NightShift - Creepy customers tense night shifts and a dark emotional story create an amazing horror atmosphere. Managing the store while losing sanity feels intense 😨🛒

coveredGames.name: MOUSE: P.I. For Hire
coveredGames.title: Unleash cartoon chaos in this charming and quite well designed old-school FPS with hand drawn black and white rubber hose visuals and a noir-fueled detective story.

coveredGames.name: Tactical Breach Wizards
coveredGames.title: Lead a team of 4 wizards through a campaign of turn-based battles. Sounds strange, but is actually quite enjoyable. You can try out crazy combos - and rewind if they fail.

coveredGames.name: Palworld
coveredGames.title: Strange Japanese open world mix of survival, creature collector, base building and monster hunter game, alone or in multiplayer.

coveredGames.name: Well Dweller
coveredGames.title: Play a tiny bird armed with a matchstick, explore the wretched kingdom and burn the wicked witch to save your family in this challenging dark fairy-tale metroidvania.

coveredGames.name: Crimson Desert Enhanced
coveredGames.title: In this spectacular action RPG, embark on a long journey of revenge through a vast open world and rebuild your scattered clan. Be prepared to spend a long time in this Korean game.

coveredGames.name: Dispatch
coveredGames.title: Hilarious narrative adventure (with skippable QTEs) in Telltale-style. Manage a company of superheroes, your romantic (and not so romantic) relationships and regain your own hero status.

coveredGames.name: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival
coveredGames.title: A disturbing, grotesque, gory and extremely violent first-person action-horror survival game. Pleasure, pain, suffering – for adults only. Fight, sneak, run, solve puzzles. Absolutely stunning.

coveredGames.name: Gothic 1 Remake

coveredGames.name: Phantom Blade Zero

coveredGames.name: ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE
coveredGames.title: Pilot your carrier-based fighter jet through an extensive campaign. Easy to fly, hard to really master. Enjoy a separate online mode. This is the king of action flight simulators.

coveredGames.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
coveredGames.title: Cleanse Kyoto from the demonic Genma in this fantastic hack and slash masterpiece. Not too difficult and with quite high production values.

coveredGames.name: STAR WARS Zero Company™
coveredGames.title: Lead your team of mercenaries through a thrilling new Star Wars story and stop an evil cult in turn-based battles in one of the best XCOM clones available.

coveredGames.name: Forza Horizon 6
coveredGames.title: With over 550 cars, a massive map, stunning graphics, and countless events against the computer or human opponents, this open-world action-racer is one of the best available.

coveredGames.name: R.U.S.E.™

coveredGames.name: Hades II
coveredGames.title: Play as the witch Melinoë and defeat the titan Cronos in this fantastic sequel to the groundbreaking action roguelike. Fight, die, upgrade, and try again in this incredibly polished masterpiece.

coveredGames.name: Timberborn

coveredGames.name: Fallen Leaf
coveredGames.title: A charming little NES-style platformer inspired by Mega Man, featuring a variety of (short) levels, dozens of characters to switch between, and a manageable difficulty level.

coveredGames.name: Find Matt's Cats

coveredGames.name: BALL x PIT
coveredGames.title: Defeat attacking monsters in a roguelite bullet-hell breakout style action game while building a base to harvest resources. Quite unique and super addictive.

coveredGames.name: Lunacid

coveredGames.name: Marathon

coveredGames.name: ARC Raiders
coveredGames.title: Search for loot in a destroyed world. Improve your gear in your underground base - and return to collect more loot on the surface. One of the best multiplayer extraction shooters available.

coveredGames.name: Resident Evil Requiem
coveredGames.title: This is the new benchmark for survival horror games. Looks amazing, plays amazing. Just don't get a heat attack while playing.

coveredGames.name: Where Winds Meet
coveredGames.title: Looks like an AAA open-world ARPG, and is completely free. Quite cool actually - but be aware that it is still a F2P-title with daily quests and a few annoying limitations.

coveredGames.name: Mewgenics

coveredGames.name: Kingdom of Night

coveredGames.name: Foolish Mortals
coveredGames.title: Best classic point and click adventure of 2025, despite serious competitors. The story of an auditor looking for a lost treasure beats them all. Graphic, speech, story, puzzles - all perfect.

coveredGames.name: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon

coveredGames.name: Potions: A Curious Tale

coveredGames.name: Netherworld Covenant

coveredGames.name: NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound
coveredGames.title: Slash through your enemies in this fast-paced 2D hack n slash platformer that plays like an old arcade machine.

coveredGames.name: Tormented Souls 2
coveredGames.title: If you need your fix of classic Resident Evil gameplay - try this one!

coveredGames.name: Anno 117: Pax Romana

coveredGames.name: The Crew Motorfest

coveredGames.name: Songs of Conquest

coveredGames.name: Necesse

coveredGames.name: Dying Light: The Beast

coveredGames.name: The Drifter

coveredGames.name: ARMORED CORE™ VI FIRES OF RUBICON™

coveredGames.name: The Tower Must Fall

coveredGames.name: Splatchinko

coveredGames.name: Theropods
coveredGames.title: It proves you don't need actual words for a good time. A real gem.

coveredGames.name: Bullet Banshee
coveredGames.title: This might actually be one of the best reinventions of classic shoot 'em up styled games I've played in some time.

coveredGames.name: Combolands: Roguelike Citybuilder

coveredGames.name: Cloudbreaker
coveredGames.title: It really ends up giving that delicious feeling of needing just one more run to see how far you can get, and to see how crazy you can make your ship.

coveredGames.name: Orc Incremental

coveredGames.name: Denshattack!

coveredGames.name: LIFTED

coveredGames.name: Typomagical

coveredGames.name: Pathogenic

coveredGames.name: Pight

coveredGames.name: 868-BACK

coveredGames.name: HYPERWIRED

coveredGames.name: Mina the Hollower

coveredGames.name: Enter the Chronosphere

coveredGames.name: Oaken Tower

coveredGames.name: Moonsigil Atlas

coveredGames.name: Fracture Field
coveredGames.title: Smashing.

coveredGames.name: STICKER/BALL
coveredGames.title: Love a bit of chaos and watching numbers go up? This is one for you.

coveredGames.name: Forza Horizon 6
coveredGames.title: With a few tweaks it can run well enough on Steam Deck and Desktop Linux, and overall a fun racing game.

coveredGames.name: Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes
coveredGames.title: A worthy companion for BSG fans to pick up.

coveredGames.name: Everything is Crab: The Animal Evolution Roguelite

coveredGames.name: Cropdeck

coveredGames.name: shapez 2 - Factory

coveredGames.name: Steam Controller

coveredGames.name: Dungeon Clawler

coveredGames.name: Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors

coveredGames.name: Sektori

coveredGames.name: Forestrike

coveredGames.name: PAO PAO

coveredGames.name: A Sector Darkly

coveredGames.name: System Arrival
