coveredGames.name: Neo Junk City
coveredGames.title: Neo Junk City got a pretty charming indie pixel art and the atmosphere is really awesome.

coveredGames.name: Hypnostasis
coveredGames.title: Hypnostasis plays extremely smooth and for an indie horror the experience feels great.

coveredGames.name: ASPIS
coveredGames.title: ASPIS is a pretty cool indie FPS horror experience, tho the animations aren't perfect, but the game is really engaging.

coveredGames.name: Breathedge 2
coveredGames.title: Side quests provide enjoyable content and complement the main storyline while adding useful objectives and variety to everyday survival activities.

coveredGames.name: Under Canopies
coveredGames.title: Searching for unusual animals, documenting them and filling the journal gives every walk through the forest a sense of purpose without creating pressure.

coveredGames.name: Car Park Capital
coveredGames.title: Managing vehicles, expanding facilities and watching a growing parking business develop creates an entertaining foundation for a tycoon game.

coveredGames.name: Coal Duty
coveredGames.title: Threats with different behaviors encourage attention to the environment and give teams more to consider than simply following a route.

coveredGames.name: Space Savory
coveredGames.title: Stranded astronaut running a dubious diner is a hilarious setup. Space Savory connects its restaurant activities to earning fuel money, making every bizarre customer part of a larger adventure.

coveredGames.name: Cowboy Life Simulator
coveredGames.title: Starting in Cowboy Life Simulator with basic resources and gradually unlocking better possibilities gives each improvement a clear purpose and a satisfying payoff.

coveredGames.name: Malignant Survivors 2
coveredGames.title: Malignant Survivors 2 makes uncertainty part of its charm. A difficult attempt can still hold a valuable discovery, encouraging players to stay alert and adapt to whatever equipment becomes available.

coveredGames.name: Nivalis Nights
coveredGames.title: Nivalis Nights is really fun if you enjoy freedom of choice/exploration and dig the cyberpunk-kinda setting. Check it out~

coveredGames.name: Mineral Mining Simulator
coveredGames.title: There is a strong sense of ownership in building every route and production area yourself. By the time the mine runs smoothly, the whole facility feels personally designed.

coveredGames.name: Cupid Parasite
coveredGames.title: Otome visual novel are pretty rare these days, but "Cupid Parasite" is pretty fun if this genre is to your liking. Love the character design too.

coveredGames.name: WE ARE FOOTBALL 2027
coveredGames.title: WE ARE FOOTBALL 2027’s blend of accessible navigation and substantial depth is its biggest attraction. There is plenty to manage, but the emphasis on smooth controls keeps the experience fun.

coveredGames.name: PawMart Tiny Market
coveredGames.title: Designing an attractive shop is enjoyable, but improving workflows and automating tasks gives every decorative decision a useful management purpose as well.

coveredGames.name: Rooster
coveredGames.title: Gentle but substantial adventure. It is easy to pick up, yet the variety of puzzles moments provides enough depth to keep the complete journey engaging.

coveredGames.name: Frontier: Path of Shadows
coveredGames.title: Frontier: Path of Shadows is an appealing tactical RPG for players who value story and decision-making.

coveredGames.name: Arcaneering: Beyond Automation
coveredGames.title: Layout choices, mana routing, and crafting priorities leave room for personal expression while still rewarding careful planning and refinement.

coveredGames.name: Dungeon Settlers
coveredGames.title: Dungeon Settlers is a good one to try if this combination of genres is to your liking. Pretty chill, but sometimes pretty challenging too.

coveredGames.name: Deadlock Station
coveredGames.title: Deadlock Station got pretty great replayability and the game itself feels very unique too.

coveredGames.name: Lady Death Demonicron
coveredGames.title: Lady Death Demonicron delivers fast, stylish action with a cool dark fantasy-like atmosphere.

coveredGames.name: The Economy Bros
coveredGames.title: This sandbox supports both relaxed and ambitious playstyles. You can slowly decorate a comfortable home or aggressively pursue businesses, and city development.

coveredGames.name: TFC2: The Fertile Crescent 2 - Collapse of The Bronze Age
coveredGames.title: Managing population, armies, and progress through vital resources gives the strategy in "TFC2: The Fertile Crescent 2 - Collapse of The Bronze Age" a clear, compelling identity.

coveredGames.name: Liquidation RTS
coveredGames.title: Thoughtful army composition, clever map control, and well-timed abilities create moments of pure strategic satisfaction that seasoned RTS players will savor long after the skirmishes end.

coveredGames.name: Drone Sector
coveredGames.title: Presentation is clean, the action is easy to read, and the gameplay loop is satisfying. Drone Sector is a great pick for players who enjoy tactical combat from above.

coveredGames.name: Wild Ice
coveredGames.title: Wild Ice genre is extremely unique and interesting, ableit could be not for everyone. But the animations are great, gameplay is engaging, so if you love TD genre, feel free to try.

coveredGames.name: VOIDFACE
coveredGames.title: VOIDFACE is hella amazing and pretty challenging too. Indie games just built different, definitely check it out.

coveredGames.name: Moo Who?
coveredGames.title: Moo Who? is pretty chill and relaxing, can help you unwind after a hard day.

coveredGames.name: AI is Home - Survival Thriller
coveredGames.title: Every system in the game supports the central fantasy of becoming a hidden, distributed intelligence.

coveredGames.name: The Dream Office
coveredGames.title: The Dream Office appears built around that appealing mixture of structure and creativity.

coveredGames.name: Nerd Simulator
coveredGames.title: Nerd Simulator has a cute visual style and an enjoyably ridiculous concept. Pretty fun and casual.

coveredGames.name: Last Drop
coveredGames.title: Interactive systems, narrative ambition, physical combat, and open-ended exploration provide plenty of substance beneath the 1990s style.

coveredGames.name: Photomaly
coveredGames.title: Fun PSX horror, just wish it was a little longer.

coveredGames.name: For Sale
coveredGames.title: One of the better walking simulator horror games on Steam.

coveredGames.name: Stackmon
coveredGames.title: Five word preview: It's like Pokémon meets Stacklands!

coveredGames.name: Denshattack!
coveredGames.title: When it comes to gameplay, there has never been a title quite like Denshattack. Fusing parkour, speed, and a complicated tricktionary make for an experience wholly its own.

coveredGames.name: Dark Scrolls
coveredGames.title: Dark Scrolls takes everything you love from retro shmups and cleans it up with all the bells and whistles of a modern-day roguelite. Pick it up, but know you’ll never want to put it back down.

coveredGames.name: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales
coveredGames.title: The Adventures of Elliot comes close to nailing it when it lets you loose and explore a world across eras at your own pace. It falls short without likeable characters and having a story to care about.

coveredGames.name: LumenTale: Memories of Trey
coveredGames.title: Minor flaws aside, LumenTale: Memories of Trey is very fun and feels like the real deal. Its combat is sharper, deeper, and more satisfying than most of what Pokémon has offered in years.

coveredGames.name: Solarpunk™
coveredGames.title: Solarpunk is a game that primarily caters to the needs of a specific audience, while dissuading others from booking an extended stay.

coveredGames.name: STARDUST: Wish of Witch
coveredGames.title: When Stardust: Wish of Witch gets something right, it absolutely nails it. For the price, this game is a total steal and a true hidden gem. Any RPG fan skipping it is only cheating themselves.

coveredGames.name: and Roger
coveredGames.title: Emotion drives the story in every moment, and this visual novel’s ability to place you within the perspective of the protagonist drives home every story beat, memory, and haunting realization.

coveredGames.name: Gothic 1 Remake
coveredGames.title: Gothic Remake proves it is still possible to build a RPG without a soulslike label, without hand-holding disguised as inclusion, and without ever once doubting whether the player can handle it.

coveredGames.name: Moses & Plato - Last Train to Clawville
coveredGames.title: While Moses & Plato – Last Train to Clawville was mostly fun to play, it didn’t feel like the game had enough depth.

coveredGames.name: Joey The Duck
coveredGames.title: It kind of feels like playing a janky bootleg game that’s unintentionally hilarious because of the translation rather than in spite of it.

coveredGames.name: Calamity Angels: Special Delivery
coveredGames.title: There’s definitely fun here, especially for fans of Compile Heart’s signature cozy chaos, but the game never fully leans into its most compelling ideas.

coveredGames.name: STARBITES
coveredGames.title: Starbites is a charming surprise of a turn-based RPG, packed with standout characters, a combat system that keeps you hooked, and the nostalgic heart of a long-lost PlayStation 2 classic.

coveredGames.name: Mina the Hollower
coveredGames.title: Mina the Hollower is nothing short of a true Mouse-terpiece, and this is one of the best retro-inspired adventures I’ve played in a very long time.

coveredGames.name: Schrödinger's Call
coveredGames.title: Ultimately, Schrödinger’s Call is a definitive visual novel, it takes the multimedia nature of the format and blends everything seamlessly.

coveredGames.name: ZERO PARADES: Director's Cut
coveredGames.title: Zero Parades: For Dead Spies is a pretty good and gripping experience, but there is no doubt that it fails to escape the long shadow of Disco Elysium.

coveredGames.name: NITRO GEN OMEGA
coveredGames.title: Nitro Gen Omega was a delightful surprise in 2026, especially since the year’s midpoint hadn’t offered much for fans of this genre to celebrate.

coveredGames.name: Directive 8020
coveredGames.title: At the end of the day, Directive 8020 is just the first game in the second season of the Dark Pictures games. It's okay but nothing too memorable or exciting.

coveredGames.name: PRAGMATA
coveredGames.title: Pragmata is a nearly flawless achievement. It is a game built on a bold mechanical concept, executed with precision, and elevated by a central relationship w/ extraordinary emotional intelligence.

coveredGames.name: Wardrum
coveredGames.title: There is enough originality here to make it stand out. For newcomers to the genre, though, it is a much harder recommendation because the game demands patience and tolerance for repetition.

coveredGames.name: Aether & Iron
coveredGames.title: The story in Aether & Iron is enjoyable, but it can take too long to get moving. Despite some minor issues, if you need a stylish and new tactical RPG to play, then you should pick up Aether & Iron.

coveredGames.name: MOTORSLICE
coveredGames.title: While MOTORSLICE starts out great, it can get unwieldy the longer you play it. Despite this, MOTORSLICE can be quite fun with its clear, singular vision and brutalist style.

coveredGames.name: Galaxy Highways
coveredGames.title: The game clocks at just a couple of hours and I couldn’t put it down. Thank you for tickling my nostalgic bone. Easily recommended to fans of twin stick shooters.

coveredGames.name: Bobo Bay
coveredGames.title: It’s a love letter to the Chao Garden that many of us grew up with and remember fondly; but it also stands on its own as a fresh title for the cozy games crowd who maybe never played SA2.

coveredGames.name: Ground Zero
coveredGames.title: Ground Zero is one of the best resi-likes out there. In many ways, it’s superior to the games that it inspired, with deeper gameplay and jam-packed with content.

coveredGames.name: FAITH: The Unholy Trinity
coveredGames.title: For a crude-looking and sounding game, Faith: The Unholy Trinity is shockingly effective. It demonstrates how minimalistic game mechanics can be made deep through creativity w/ simple imagery.

coveredGames.name: Manafinder
coveredGames.title: Manafinder isn’t going to impress any RPG veteran or anyone looking for an original idea. There are better games made with RPG Maker out there, like Jimmy and the Pulsating Mass.

coveredGames.name: MOUSE: P.I. For Hire
coveredGames.title: If you like noir-style games and wacky boomer shooters, then you’ll enjoy MOUSE: P.I. For Hire. It's a lot of fun, even if it's full of cheesy one-liners.

coveredGames.name: Super Meat Boy 3D
coveredGames.title: Super Meat Boy 3D is exploding with content. There’s so much bang for your buck packed into this game, it’s ridiculous. The only drawback of Super Meat Boy 3D is its heart-stopping difficulty.

coveredGames.name: Ariana and the Elder Codex
coveredGames.title: Ariana and the Elder Codex is a charming game with an adorable lead, supported by a satisfying gameplay loop and just enough flair to be memorable.

coveredGames.name: REPLACED
coveredGames.title: After many hours of playing Replaced won me over. The hypnotic soundtrack and breathtaking visuals make Replaced a must for fans of cyberpunk or dystopian themes.

coveredGames.name: Gunboat God
coveredGames.title: Gunboat God is littered with nuances and satisfying details in the audio and visual department. If you’re not afraid of an old-school arcade challenge, you owe it to yourself to give this pearl a go.

coveredGames.name: RUSHING BEAT X: Return Of Brawl Brothers
coveredGames.title: RUSHING BEAT X: Return of Brawl Brothers is a great beat-em-up that feels good and packs a lot of fun. It’s got style and plenty of heart, but it’s a bit lacking when it comes to substance.

coveredGames.name: Sigma Star Saga DX
coveredGames.title: It’s clear why Sigma Star Saga became a cult game. Combining shoot-em-up action with the epic scale of a sci-fi RPG is very appealing. The art and visuals hold up exceptionally well.

coveredGames.name: John Carpenter's Toxic Commando
coveredGames.title: John Carpenter’s Toxic Commando isn’t a bad game, but you need to play with friends for a fun co-op shooter experience, and its main story remains a bit short.

coveredGames.name: Dread Delusion
coveredGames.title: The unique story, immersive setting, and creative designs that complement the lo-fi graphics are what make Dread Delusion so cool. It may not be much of a challenge, but it’s righteous and immersive.

coveredGames.name: Darwin's Paradox!
coveredGames.title: If you enjoy the 2D Oddworld games, Inside, Lunark, Another World, Heart of Darkness, or even the Little Nightmares series, you will likely find Darwin’s Paradox! appealing.

coveredGames.name: DAMON and BABY
coveredGames.title: The repetitive combat, weak weapon feedback, limited storage, and a barebones co-op mode stop short of being a standout. Come for the characters; keep your expectations in check for the rest.

coveredGames.name: The Midnight Walk
coveredGames.title: The Midnight Walk is a beautiful work of art, but it would be better as a full-blown movie instead of a game. Gameplay is as barebones as it gets for first-person adventure games. Great for kids.

coveredGames.name: Super Lucky's Tale
coveredGames.title: The skill ceiling for high-level play isn’t very high, and Lucky himself is kind of bland, but the sincerity of both the character and the gameplay shines through and kept me engaged.

coveredGames.name: WWE 2K26
coveredGames.title: In spite of a 400+ character roster, WWE 2K26 doesn't reinvent the wheel. The physics engine provides comical moments, but also results in some WTF moments. Unless you're a hardcore, wait for a sale.

coveredGames.name: Dark Light: Survivor
coveredGames.title: Dark Light: Survivor rewards careful planning and daring experimentation in almost equal measure.

coveredGames.name: Car Flipper
coveredGames.title: Bidding blindly on locked vehicles and hoping you did not buy a rusted lemon keeps you right on the edge of your seat.

coveredGames.name: Caramel Creek
coveredGames.title: Furniture craft adds great stylistic variety, letting you build anything from rustic to modern diner aesthetics. Caramel Creek is pure comfort.

coveredGames.name: HANDS OVER
coveredGames.title: The influence cards add fantastic strategic depth to the deadly tabletop challenges. Plus, ArtDock nailed the dark, stylized atmosphere.

coveredGames.name: Voxel Playground
coveredGames.title: Breaking through fences and taking down watchtowers piece by piece is peak destruction gameplay.

coveredGames.name: Re2 I Rise Alone
coveredGames.title: Whether you aim to build a sprawling corporate empire or pursue genuine romance, the game accommodates multiple experiences.

coveredGames.name: Delve Survivors
coveredGames.title: Delve Survivors captures that elusive balance where one mistake can be fatal, yet your build feels totally overpowered when played right.

coveredGames.name: Drawquarium
coveredGames.title: Drawquarium strikes the ideal balance between an artistic sandbox and a functional idle desk buddy.

coveredGames.name: ASTERIS
coveredGames.title: From the varied stages to the epic final confrontation against Azhdarak, ASTERIS keeps the excitement high.

coveredGames.name: Aviator: Airline Empire
coveredGames.title: Even in Early Access, the core gameplay loop is exceptionally solid. Each decade introduces fresh operational dilemmas that keep your airline on its toes, preventing the game from getting boring.

coveredGames.name: Fablery
coveredGames.title: The developers have laid a brilliant foundation and the gameplay loop is already remarkably tight and polished.

coveredGames.name: ArcheAge Chronicles
coveredGames.title: Auroria looks breathtaking and the seamless exploration makes wandering around a treat. Combat has weight and precision, and the raid encounters require real teamwork.

coveredGames.name: Farm & Feast
coveredGames.title: Harvesting fresh wheat, baking warm bread, and handing drinks to cheerful guests makes for an incredibly cozy experience.

coveredGames.name: Icy Tower
coveredGames.title: Chasing that next combo tier keeps you on the edge of your seat. The pacing ramps up smoothly, challenging your instincts and reflexes.

coveredGames.name: The Nugget
coveredGames.title: Exploring claims with a friend in co-op mode makes finding big nuggets ten times more exciting.

coveredGames.name: Slotbound
coveredGames.title: Slotbound turns ordinary tower defense into an fun gamble where player intellect always triumphs over random numbers.

coveredGames.name: Salt and Soil: A Frontier Family Sim
coveredGames.title: Refreshing departure from typical high-speed colony builders. Salt and Soil allows you to ponder each decision, savoring the slow, deliberate crafting of an enduring family heritage.

coveredGames.name: Da Capo 3 R
coveredGames.title: Da Capo 3 R welcomes visual novel fans with polished presentation, lovable heroines and an extensive narrative. Lighthearted scenes and dramatic developments keeps the journey fun.

coveredGames.name: Frontier: Path of Shadows
coveredGames.title: Building a capable crew, exploring distant planets and making difficult choices creates an engaging science-fiction adventure with plenty of strategic depth.

coveredGames.name: False Myth 2
coveredGames.title: False Myth 2 got a huge amount of content and the pixel art quality and animations is really good.

coveredGames.name: GloveUp!
coveredGames.title: GloveUp! is hilarious and actually pretty fun as a casual boxing experience with cute anime characters.

coveredGames.name: Apoc Tank: Rush Forward
coveredGames.title: Apoc Tank: Rush Forward nails the power fantasy of driving an unstoppable mobile fortress.

coveredGames.name: ATMOSFAR
coveredGames.title: ATMOSFAR’s crafting has a satisfying connection to its environment. Gathering organic materials, processing minerals, and recovering scrap all support the larger goal of surviving and exploring.

coveredGames.name: Cozy~Fishing Kitten
coveredGames.title: Cozy~ Fishing Kitten proves that idle games can be deeply comforting. It never pesters you for attention, yet it always welcomes you back with cute catches and warm smiles.

coveredGames.name: The Little Land
coveredGames.title: The Little Land pairs a cute presentation with meaningful resource management. Its energy system makes protection more thoughtful than simply using abilities whenever an enemy appears.

coveredGames.name: Princess Ilyana: Night of Falling Grace
coveredGames.title: The character art is expressive, the twelve endings offer huge replay value and guiding Ilyana through danger feels engaging.

coveredGames.name: Breathedge 2
coveredGames.title: The scattered survivors, abandoned facilities and unusual technology make Breathedge 2 consistently fascinating.

coveredGames.name: Coal Duty
coveredGames.title: The deeper exploration concept gives Coal Duty an enticing sense of risk and reward.

coveredGames.name: Lost Liminal
coveredGames.title: Lost Liminal’s mysterious story and visuals are particularly inviting for fans of atmospheric horror adventures.

coveredGames.name: Space Savory
coveredGames.title: Unique ingredients and unusual conversations make the restaurant concept feel distinctive, with plenty of opportunities for original comedy.

coveredGames.name: Car Park Capital
coveredGames.title: Car Park Capital brings a fun sense of scale to an overlooked business. Starting with land and parking spaces, then expanding facilities and production chains, gives its premise an ambitious direction

coveredGames.name: GROUND BRANCH
coveredGames.title: The first person adds more than visual atmosphere. GROUND BRANCH connects what players see with their character’s physical presence, making awareness of cover and positioning an important part.

coveredGames.name: Himawari - The Sunflower -
coveredGames.title: A story that starts with familiar daily life and gradually reveals a larger world has real appeal. Himawari deliver satisfying combination of discovery and growing character depth.

coveredGames.name: Cauldron Chaos: Brew Potions & Tidy Up
coveredGames.title: Cauldron Chaos: Brew Potions & Tidy Up feels like a cheerful blend of puzzle solving, resource management, and lighthearted simulation.

coveredGames.name: Mortal Shell II
coveredGames.title: Mortal Shell II is a peak experience for Souls-like fans, with even better gameplay and visuals (compared to the first game)

coveredGames.name: OZARK
coveredGames.title: The contrast between a routine recovery mission and the horrors lurking beneath a derelict facility gives OZARK a strong identity.

coveredGames.name: even if TEMPEST
coveredGames.title: The witch trial premise provides an excellent backdrop for suspense, betrayal and difficult choices.

coveredGames.name: Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era
coveredGames.title: The tactical battles shine with thoughtful unit interactions and terrain advantages. The different factions offer unique playstyles, ensuring varied strategies each session.

coveredGames.name: Barfender: CO-OP Bar Simulator
coveredGames.title: The cooperative premise is simple, but the number of simultaneous problems adds cool variety. A quiet drink order can quickly become a cleanup emergency, a theft, or a full brawl.

coveredGames.name: Trinoline Genesis
coveredGames.title: Trinoline Genesis expands the original game in exactly the right areas. Familiar heroines gain satisfying continuations, supporting characters receive better routes and the story is just better.

coveredGames.name: No Asteroids
coveredGames.title: Fox plays No Asteroids and is thrilled to try out amazing arsenal of tools helping me deconstruct that space rock. It offers variety of gameplay parts from mining by hand to hiring spaceships!

coveredGames.name: Sudokiller
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Sudokiller and loves the idea behind it combining sudoku with a detective clue finding and puzzle solving work is brilliant! Cozy and casual yet it offers some training for your logic.

coveredGames.name: Wielders of the Essence
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Wielders of the Essence and loves combination of troops and spells they unlock making it not just another survivor but a tactical challenge. It's wieldersday, my dudes!

coveredGames.name: Pool of Madness
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Pool of Madness and loves chaos and weirdness inserted into a pretty serious game of pool so you can try to implement base knowledge about it but it is better to just submit to the darkness!

coveredGames.name: Gildoria - Organize a Dragon's Hoard
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Gildoria - Organize a Dragon's Hoard and likes to be a perfectionist erasing the mess and making everything sit on a dedicated place. Being a little bit of a dragon myself also helps!

coveredGames.name: Cozy~Fishing Kitten
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Cozy~Fishing Kitten and its warmth keeps your day bright and smile up! It is chill and comfortable to play with any level of attention you can give the game which is perfect for idler genre.

coveredGames.name: Slotbound
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Slotbound and tests my luck but it is not enough and you still need to think carefully calculating chances and the odds. It is very fun, engaging and addictive which we crave for!

coveredGames.name: Salt and Soil: A Frontier Family Sim
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Salt and Soil: A Frontier Family Sim and is surprised by detalization and variety of decisions you need to make in order to form a path for a family throughout the ages.

coveredGames.name: Echo Mates
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Echo Mates and loves how the sonar mechanic works! It brings new and rather unusual representation of surroundings and it is your survival tool too. Fun, fresh and engaging!

coveredGames.name: GloveUp!
coveredGames.title: Fox plays GloveUp! and is pleasantly surprised how you can have boxing bring so much fun and be pretty casual to play yet such addictive so you end up playing the whole night.

coveredGames.name: Eternal Palace Sakura
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Eternal Palace Sakura and is amazed by thrilling and fast paced combat allowing you to show your muscle memory of the moves and combos alongside with smart build decisions.

coveredGames.name: Frontier: Path of Shadows
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Frontier: Path of Shadows and loves that your decisions shape not only result of battles but a whole story. With well made combat game is balanced in story-gameplay proportions.

coveredGames.name: ATMOSFAR
coveredGames.title: Fox plays ATMOSFAR and loves having both long term goals like building flying fortress of your own and smaller ones you reach by exploring and gathering, crafting and upgrading your scouting vessels.

coveredGames.name: Breathedge 2
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Breathedge 2 and deems it worthy successor full of humor and meaningful exploration. Well cooked project with ambitious roadmap we have no doubt will be done.

coveredGames.name: The Second Reality Room: Unspoken Truths
coveredGames.title: Fox plays The Second Reality Room: Unspoken Truths and enjoys its distinct art style, sprinkle of humor and fun to explore game mechanics. Looks pretty and plays amazingly!

coveredGames.name: Coal Duty
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Coal Duty and loves both exploring part of it where each mission contains new dangers you need to adapt to and fun time like bug race betting and snowball fight to chill out with friends.

coveredGames.name: No Such Place
coveredGames.title: Fox plays No Such Place and believes in the future of this one as even during EA state game shows strong foundations and passionate developers behind it working hard to refine and perfect their child.

coveredGames.name: Escape from Vlogger: Runaway
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Escape from Vlogger: Runaway and finds it pretty fun with all the humorous and weird situations you are put to solve. Not without a flaws but definitely a joyful experience.

coveredGames.name: ARC Raiders
coveredGames.title: Fox plays ARC Raiders and is in awe of its visuals, gunplay and even ability to roleplay during raids. Fun actually allowed in this one be that helping and cooperating or trying some cheeky strat.

coveredGames.name: Good Heavens!
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Good Heavens! and is amazed by amount of things to do! Wrapped into a beautiful and distinct visuals exploring becomes even more fun and engaging.

coveredGames.name: Barfender: CO-OP Bar Simulator
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Barfender: CO-OP Bar Simulator and wrecks chaos everywhere inside and outside. I call friends to do even more destruction and eventually serve some drunkards but fun is priority here.

coveredGames.name: Duelist: Idle Expedition
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Duelist: Idle Expedition and likes how lightweight it is on the attention requirement while maintaining reasonable depth of gameplay and quality of content.

coveredGames.name: Power Network Tycoon
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Power Network Tycoon and enjoys even most complicated mechanics as with time you master the game and challenges become more fun rather than tiring.

coveredGames.name: Transport Fever 3
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Transport Fever 3 and enjoys having heavy weight of bringing delicate balance to the town veins via careful management and tough choices throughout the game.

coveredGames.name: Tidy Up the Flower Shop
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Tidy Up the Flower Shop and smells good game from afar. It is exactly what you'd expect - chill, casual and relaxing but at the same time beautiful and full of bright colors.

coveredGames.name: Mineral Mining Simulator
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Mineral Mining Simulator and swipes tail joyfully as I progress through engaging management part along with need to survey and move onto new locations creates perfect gameplay loop.

coveredGames.name: Purr-fect Chef: Kitchen Chaos
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Purr-fect Chef: Kitchen Chaos and likes its style, coziness and gameplay featuring time management mechanics all wrapped into cute visuals making you want to stay a little longer.

coveredGames.name: Creator Chronicles
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Creator Chronicles and likes the idea of managing literally everything and that loop feels very addictive and engaging. It looks nice, plays amazingly and gets our heartly recommendation.

coveredGames.name: Blades & Battles
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Blades & Battles and wields its blade to relive glory of Golden Axe and Streets of Rage with crisp controls and amazing combat flow.

coveredGames.name: Love All My Girls
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Love All My Girls and falls in love with silky and warm interaction with the ladies making your day better with every section you play.

coveredGames.name: WE ARE FOOTBALL 2027
coveredGames.title: Fox plays WE ARE FOOTBALL 2027 and dives deep into a detailed and meaningful management systems enjoying them as much as results on the field after giving correct instructions to the team.

coveredGames.name: Land of Glarefall
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Land of Glarefall and is amazed by combination of precise and engaging ARPG gameplay, tower defence and squad management taking They Are Billions formula and cooking it to perfection.

coveredGames.name: 33 Days till Extraction
coveredGames.title: Fox plays 33 Days till Extraction and enjoys thrill of the raid time and excitement grasping you in the preparation phase. Dynamic, engaging and risky but rewarding both in loot and emotions.

coveredGames.name: Police Chief Simulator
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Police Chief Simulator and checks out all the details of this wonderful sim. Expand and renovate, help citizens and get crime out of the shadow to become beacon of pure light and justice.

coveredGames.name: Deck & Conn
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Deck & Conn and taps all the buttons in this retro flavoured TBT game with engaged campaign to dive into or some singular battles to perfect your controls and tactics.

coveredGames.name: Magical Blush
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Magical Blush and likes pixely stylish visuals, elemental based combat requiring pretty fast reflexes and deadly world to explore.

coveredGames.name: Lady Death Demonicron
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Lady Death Demonicron and loves fast paced combat that fits perfectly within cruel dark fantasy world with strong atmosphere.

coveredGames.name: Echoes of Mystralia
coveredGames.title: Fox plays Echoes of Mystralia and falls in love with spell combination system creating an impecable gaming experience you will never forget.

coveredGames.name: Great Northern War

coveredGames.name: Gas N Cars
coveredGames.title: The gas station jobs are simple but really fun. Filling tanks to the exact amount, cleaning dirty cars, and fixing broken parts give each customer a different task and keep every shift interesting.

coveredGames.name: I Know a Spot
coveredGames.title: Choosing a car, changing its colors and wheels, and finding a scenic place to park is a fun little routine. Setting up a camp beside a lake or in the forest makes each location feel personal.

coveredGames.name: Boku Boku
coveredGames.title: The little details make this sandbox enjoyable. Animals can be ridden, instruments can be played, and toys have working minigames. There is always something fun to try between building projects.

coveredGames.name: Eternal Palace Sakura
coveredGames.title: Retla is a charming main character, with great animations and fun voice lines. The anime style looks good in motion, and the quick arena battles make this an enjoyable game for short sessions.

coveredGames.name: Beyond The Evil
coveredGames.title: A village that changes its layout while being explored is an unsettling detour. Familiar streets suddenly stop making sense, creating a memorable moment of psychological unease without combat.

coveredGames.name: WE ARE FOOTBALL 2027
coveredGames.title: Designing the stadium, club grounds and even seating patterns gives long careers a strong sense of ownership. Watching those facilities grow alongside the team makes success feel wonderfully tangible.

coveredGames.name: THANKS, LIGHT.
coveredGames.title: Light becomes more than illumination here: it gives weight, shape and gravity to shadows. Watching a flat outline become a staircase or pillar makes every solved room feel like a small act of magic.

coveredGames.name: Potion-making: Path of the Alchemist
coveredGames.title: Watching ingredients swirl into a glowing vessel gives card combinations a touch of magic. Animated spells and opening portals make this digital tabletop adventure feel wonderfully alive and colorful.

coveredGames.name: Space Savory
coveredGames.title: Mechanical salads and glowing energy drinks give the menu a wonderfully bizarre personality. The hands-on preparation makes each strange order feel like a tiny arcade challenge instead of busywork

coveredGames.name: Golf 5 MAX
coveredGames.title: This is the kind of sports game that makes sense within minutes. Pick a character, enjoy the bright scenery and try to beat the last score. The playful arcade atmosphere keeps things light and fun.

coveredGames.name: Under Canopies
coveredGames.title: There is charm in watching a bare patch of woodland become a comfortable retreat through patient work. Handmade decorations and carefully chosen details make the space feel like it belongs to you.

coveredGames.name: Blades & Battles
coveredGames.title: Quick dashes and attack mix-ups make fighting more expressive than its simple controls suggest. Learning when to dodge, punish and unleash a special turns frantic enemy waves into a rewarding dance.

coveredGames.name: Thunder Hoop Collection (QUByte Classics)
coveredGames.title: Fireballs, lasers and spectacular phoenix attacks bring that glorious 1990s excess to life. The sequel fills its detailed sci-fi backdrops with enough chaos to keep reflexes working overtime.

coveredGames.name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
coveredGames.title: Classic Rush is a fantastic nostalgia hit, while Hero Party and Blitz completely change the rhythm of familiar stages. Five modes per map give the campaign far more replay value than expected.

coveredGames.name: Realm of Taiwu
coveredGames.title: Common loot can quickly become legendary gear, and the steady power curve makes each run feel rewarding. Elixirs, equipment bonuses and varied builds give the monster-slaying grind plenty of momentum.

coveredGames.name: 4 Penny Coffins
coveredGames.title: Different investigator roles give teamwork real purpose instead of turning every round into pure guessing. Police track fingerprints, doctors study blood, and every clue can expose a convincing liar.

coveredGames.name: Rooster
coveredGames.title: An apology basket for Rat is a wonderfully gentle way to begin, mixing hidden-object searching with humor and cultural detail. The hand-painted scenes make even small acts of kindness feel memorable.

coveredGames.name: Love All My Girls
coveredGames.title: Six romances, time rewinds and fatal mistakes give this FMV more bite than a standard dating sim. Strong acting, polished 4K scenes and an emotional final stretch make the journey memorable.

coveredGames.name: Police Chief Simulator
coveredGames.title: Starting with paperwork and case files, then growing into patrols and dispatch work, gives the station a rewarding sense of progress. Each upgrade makes the job feel broader, busier and more alive.

coveredGames.name: Museologist: Tidy Up the Museum!
coveredGames.title: Restoring a shattered museum piece by piece is deeply satisfying as empty halls come back to life. Searching, matching fragments and unlocking tools keeps the whole cleanup relaxing and rewarding.

coveredGames.name: Scavland
coveredGames.title: Scavland makes survival feel wonderfully deliberate. Limited ammunition, dangerous expeditions, faction politics, and customizable weapons turn every journey into a balance between greed and caution.

coveredGames.name: Tormentum II
coveredGames.title: Beautifully disturbing artwork, excellent music, and a fascinating simulation mystery create a gripping experience. The puzzles flow naturally, and multiple endings make each choice feel important.

coveredGames.name: Chop Chop Together
coveredGames.title: Warehouse duty has a knack for turning one misplaced parcel into a full-blown team emergency. Sorting, packing and shipping under pressure makes the smallest successful delivery feel triumphant.

coveredGames.name: Dark Farts: Parody Smell Edition
coveredGames.title: Managing the gas meter gives all the nonsense a mischievous twist, with choices leading toward multiple endings. This cheeky, compact spoof commits to its ridiculous premise from start to finish.

coveredGames.name: Tattoo Shop Simulator
coveredGames.title: A handmade design on display, a new tattoo machine and another satisfied customer make progress easy to see. Staff and studio upgrades turn a modest shop into a cheerful little business empire.

coveredGames.name: Mineral Mining Simulator
coveredGames.title: From dusty extraction points to sparkling gemstones, the production chain feels rewarding to build. Better machines, cleaner workflows and higher throughput create a wonderfully addictive rhythm.

coveredGames.name: Gravebound
coveredGames.title: Gravebound turns post-apocalyptic survival into wonderfully absurd co-op chaos. Fighting weaponized appliances, combining powerful upgrades, and escaping with your loot gives every run real momentum.

coveredGames.name: Brave New Wonders
coveredGames.title: The factory-building loop feels refreshingly different when robots follow your instructions. Optimizing production, linking systems, and watching the world come to life makes progress compelling.

coveredGames.name: Breathedge 2
coveredGames.title: Harsh space survival is softened by absurd humor, junk and an immortal chicken. Exploring dangerous ruins, upgrading gear and solving problems with duct tape gives the adventure plenty of charm.

coveredGames.name: Hot Rod Mayhem
coveredGames.title: Each championship mixes races with skill trials, so the campaign rarely feels repetitive. Boosters, hazards and power-ups keep the pace high, while varied cars make every cup feel a little different.

coveredGames.name: Frontier: Path of Shadows
coveredGames.title: Combat rewards careful planning without drowning everything in random chance. Gear, squad roles and environmental tricks create satisfying battles, while branching decisions give the campaign weight.

coveredGames.name: Dread Admiral
coveredGames.title: Every lost vessel leaves a scar on the campaign, making cautious advances and desperate retreats equally meaningful. Distinct admirals and shifting missions keep each voyage tense and fresh.

coveredGames.name: Magical Blush
coveredGames.title: Fast spellcasting, lovely pixel art and mystical music give the adventure an easy charm. Secrets, talismans and new abilities make old areas worth revisiting long after the first journey through.

coveredGames.name: System Arrival
coveredGames.title: Ruined-city raids feed a layered bunker sim: bring back supplies, recruit survivors, research monster DNA and turn a fragile shelter into a defended home. Psychic powers spice up the fights.

coveredGames.name: Me and You
coveredGames.title: Turning words into rules gives this co-op puzzler its clever hook: move scraps, rocks and walls to reshape each level. The best moments come when a partner spots a rule you both missed.

coveredGames.name: Etranger In the City of Doom
coveredGames.title: Grid-based dungeons turn every key, item and enemy into a resource puzzle, rewarding careful planning over quick reflexes. Tio's journey adds a darker fantasy story and a close-knit cast.

coveredGames.name: Mystery of the Mysterious Futayuri Mystery Dungeon
coveredGames.title: A quirky trio of adventurers makes this dungeon crawl more than a routine loot hunt. Explore winding rooms, battle monsters, appraise ancient relics and turn each expedition into steady progress.

coveredGames.name: Cat Squeeze
coveredGames.title: An explosive kitten, cramped pipes and carefully placed boxes turn each maze into a neat spatial puzzle. Hand-drawn worlds keep the journey charming, while new mechanics refresh each region.

coveredGames.name: Car Flipper
coveredGames.title: From dusty auction finds to late-night pink-slip races, there's more here than flipping cars for cash. Early Access still has rough edges, but inspecting, repairing and selling feels rewarding.

coveredGames.name: Clandestined: Fade to Gray
coveredGames.title: Physical, mental and emotional checks add a welcome layer to this visual novel, making character choices matter beyond dialogue. The mystery of the missing brother gives the lab a darker edge.

coveredGames.name: Boss in Diapers
coveredGames.title: Bluffing, risky offers and quick-fire party modes give this daycare brawl a lively social hook. The baby-mafia costumes add charm, though its small player count makes a full lobby essential.

coveredGames.name: Pre-Warp Age
coveredGames.title: Building a spacefaring civilization feels wonderfully methodical here. Chart unknown worlds, nurture distant colonies and research new technologies, all in pursuit of that first leap between stars.

coveredGames.name: Monkeys!¡
coveredGames.title: High-tempo school comedy thrives on the clash between Saruyoshi's rough edges and the refined world he's trying to infiltrate. The cast's eccentric chemistry keeps every awkward encounter lively.

coveredGames.name: Net Worthless
coveredGames.title: A sharp little economy of choices, where forgotten subscriptions sting and the stock market tempts with easy riches. Planning each month becomes a wry battle against bills, inflation and yourself.

coveredGames.name: Moomin: Midsummer Madness
coveredGames.title: Floodwaters turn Moominvalley into a storybook voyage, with hand-painted scenes, familiar faces and gentle point-and-click puzzles. Switching between Moomintroll and Little My adds a playful spark.

coveredGames.name: The Maker Way
coveredGames.title: Designing machines from parts, 3D-printing creations and commanding a fleet makes engineering hands-on. Exploration, outposts and robot encounters give this sandbox a satisfying sense of purpose.

coveredGames.name: Supermarket Organizer
coveredGames.title: There’s a quiet pleasure in turning bare konbinis into welcoming little shops. Unboxing treats, fitting out shelves and finding a place for every item make this a soothing exercise in order.

coveredGames.name: Under Canopies
coveredGames.title: A peaceful wilderness retreat swaps harsh survival for cabin building, home-grown meals and wildlife photography. Its unhurried loop celebrates small wins and makes outdoor time restorative.

coveredGames.name: Cozy~Fishing Kitten
coveredGames.title: A desktop fishing retreat pairs gentle collecting with adorable cats, custom outfits and unlockable scenery. Its idle pace invites quick visits, while shared fishing and trading add a social touch.

coveredGames.name: Escape from Vlogger: Runaway
coveredGames.title: A runaway escape through a vlogger's world sets the stage for tense pursuits, quick decisions and unexpected turns. Its contemporary premise adds personality, while the chase keeps momentum high.

coveredGames.name: Blades & Battles
coveredGames.title: Sharp timing and decisive encounters put combat at the heart of this action adventure. Learning enemy patterns makes hard-won victories satisfying, while the brisk pace keeps every clash engaging.

coveredGames.name: Truth Beneath the Shadows
coveredGames.title: Clues and uneasy discoveries draw players into a shadowy mystery. The gradual unravelling of hidden truths gives the story an intriguing pull, while its atmosphere keeps curiosity alive throughout.

coveredGames.name: ROLLA
coveredGames.title: A grotesque rolling menace turns the city into an arcade playground of destruction, survival and score chasing. Its bizarre premise and punchy action give every run a wonderfully chaotic edge.

coveredGames.name: BloomTale
coveredGames.title: Arranging flowers, tending a shop and fulfilling customers' ideas create a gentle creative loop. A magical setting and relaxed pace turn everyday business into a colourful ritual worth returning to.

coveredGames.name: You Are Empty: Absolute Edition
coveredGames.title: An alternate-history Kyiv, grotesque foes and retrofuturist weapons give this shooter a striking identity. Modern fixes smooth its rough edges without losing the eerie appeal of a cult classic.

coveredGames.name: Breathedge 2
coveredGames.title: Space survival gains a comic voice through scavenging, tool crafting and cosmic trouble. Exploring, building and improvising alongside an immortal chicken give this adventure a distinctive spark.

coveredGames.name: Hypernet Explorer
coveredGames.title: A post-Y2K European setting blends roguelike structure with an offbeat immersive-sim sensibility. Its unusual atmosphere and genre-mixing ambition promise a distinctive journey for curious players.

coveredGames.name: Good Job : Night Hustle Simulator
coveredGames.title: A shady night business becomes a playground for absurd decisions, demanding customers and dark comedy. Staff, appointments, deliveries and expansion give the outrageous premise a strategic backbone.

coveredGames.name: THE DEAD WE KNEW: Open World Survival
coveredGames.title: Abandoned sites, scarce supplies and danger set the stage for open-world survival. Scavenging, shelter building and co-op play offer a compelling way to face the infected and hostile survivors.

coveredGames.name: Anonymous Hacker Simulator
coveredGames.title: Digital clues, complex systems and careful plans give this hacking adventure a satisfying rhythm. Its investigative tasks should delight fans of technological thrillers and methodical problem-solving.

coveredGames.name: Potion-making: Path of the Alchemist
coveredGames.title: Alchemy is a race of clever recipes and sharper tactics. Gather ingredients, chain potions, cast spells and outmaneuver rivals on shifting boards in this richly layered tabletop strategy game.

coveredGames.name: WE ARE FOOTBALL 2027
coveredGames.title: A deep managerial sandbox where tactics, club growth and long-term planning shape each season. Many playable nations and creative tools make building a football world absorbing and personal.

coveredGames.name: Would You Love Me If I Was a Snake?
coveredGames.title: An unusual premise balances absurd humour with a surprisingly tender question. Its quirky spirit and heartfelt undertone give this playful adventure a charm that lingers long after the final moment.

coveredGames.name: Love All My Girls
coveredGames.title: A warm romance of distinct personalities and delicate turns of affection. Thoughtful conversations and meaningful choices let each connection unfold naturally, making the cast easy to cherish.

coveredGames.name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
coveredGames.title: Varied lanes, memorable enemy waves and a rich mix of towers, heroes and spells keep battles engaging. Careful timing, smart upgrades and creative defenses make each hard-won victory satisfying.

coveredGames.name: Rise of the Merchants
coveredGames.title: More than a town builder, this medieval economy sim ties production and caravan logistics to diplomacy, politics and optional PvP. Its online world gives every growing city wider stakes.

coveredGames.name: Cash is King! Business Simulator
coveredGames.title: Building an empire here starts with pocket change and a lemonade stand, then branches into vending machines, side hustles and home upgrades. Casual minigames keep the sunny grind varied.

coveredGames.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Oaths & Ashes
coveredGames.title: Two vampires, five rival factions and a city balanced on the edge of a knife. Shape Berlin's underworld through political gambits, branching dialogue and forbidden blood alchemy at night.

coveredGames.name: THANKS, LIGHT.
coveredGames.title: Part Portal-like brainteaser, part surreal mystery, this puzzle adventure makes light your main tool. Rotate, merge and resize objects across intricate stages while an odd administrator watches.

coveredGames.name: UBAI Ending
coveredGames.title: Corporate secrets surface when a mysterious executive confronts Ryousuke with an ultimatum. A character-driven visual novel focused on difficult decisions, hidden motives and emotional fallout.

coveredGames.name: False Myth 2
coveredGames.title: Stealth strikes, spectacular magic and coordinated partner attacks give this sequel a livelier combat rhythm. Between dungeon crawls and mini-games, a sprawling romance-driven story unfolds.

coveredGames.name: Space Savory
coveredGames.title: Forget farm-to-table: this intergalactic kitchen takes its ingredients directly from the customers. A darkly comic blend of cooking challenges, inventory juggling and shady space-side business.

coveredGames.name: CRACK
coveredGames.title: One giant egg, a mysterious lab and an absurdly satisfying work shift. Team up, smash through layers, upgrade your tools and uncover what lies beneath the shell. Weirdly addictive co-op fun!

coveredGames.name: Orion Blue
coveredGames.title: A peaceful alien fishing trip grows into a cozy life sim, with fish to collect, materials to craft and villagers whose stories unfold as friendship deepens. Idle mode keeps it low-pressure.

coveredGames.name: Mirrorbane
coveredGames.title: Drafting heroes in a tavern auction before a duel is a neat PvP twist. Co-op expeditions test party synergies, while the shared-deck system keeps every choice connected from the first bid.

coveredGames.name: Internet Cafe 98
coveredGames.title: The nostalgia goes beyond the CRT look: install licensed games, clean hard drives, stock the coffee machine and expand into new rooms. Progress can stall when research becomes a lengthy wait.

coveredGames.name: Delicious - Festival of Dreams
coveredGames.title: Power cuts, harsh weather and 60 timed stages push multitasking beyond the usual restaurant rush. Bonus challenges and a custom festival booth add extra goals to this colorful management story.

coveredGames.name: Shorted
coveredGames.title: Your deck becomes a 9×9 board, where tracing same-color packets into twisting shapes turns each move into a scoring puzzle. Smart patch combos and rising multipliers make big clears feel earned.

coveredGames.name: Ridiculous Space Battles
coveredGames.title: A welcome return to space warfare, with ship parts to unlock and fleets to refine between skirmishes. Early Access has a solid sandbox, but its campaign and online challenges are still missing.

coveredGames.name: Car Flipper
coveredGames.title: Paint tests, engine checks and careful haggling turn every used-car deal into a detective job. The repair loop is satisfying, while co-op lets friends share the risks and split the profits.

coveredGames.name: Clandestined: Fade to Gray
coveredGames.title: A post-apocalyptic lab mystery built around a long-awaited awakening, a missing brother and suspicious sponsors. Its enclosed setting and personal stakes give the sci-fi premise an intriguing pull.

coveredGames.name: Moomin: Midsummer Madness
coveredGames.title: A lovely little voyage through a world of warm colours, oddball friends and theatrical wonders. Swapping between Moomintroll and Little My brings a playful rhythm to puzzles made for curious hearts.

coveredGames.name: Hope in the City
coveredGames.title: More than a search for two missing parents, this is a portrait of a city full of guarded voices. Drawing-based deductions, expressive performances and moody streets make each lead feel personal.

coveredGames.name: Warota: I Live Next to The Demon King's Castle LOL
coveredGames.title: Between crafting, exploration and hack-and-slash skirmishes, there's always another little task to tackle. The Demon King's idol concert gives this village builder a gloriously absurd fantasy streak.

coveredGames.name: Lumbrix
coveredGames.title: Every new segment adds firepower, but losing one means scrambling to recover it. The push and pull between building a living arsenal and guarding its vulnerable head gives each run a sharp hook.

coveredGames.name: That Damn Grass
coveredGames.title: A tiny robot, a colossal lawn and nail cutters for starters: this oddly charming chore sim turns grass duty into a co-op adventure, with better tools and a missing wedding ring to track down.

coveredGames.name: Doomed Otaku
coveredGames.title: A messy, anxious protagonist makes a refreshing change from a flawless heroine. Quirky side characters, consequential choices and over 20 endings give this internet-age dramedy real bite.

coveredGames.name: Morphing Blocks
coveredGames.title: Forty-two bite-sized games turn this blocky collection into a pocket arcade. From Sokoban and Sudoku to tower defense and pinball, its central Hub makes switching between distractions effortless.

coveredGames.name: Slotbound
coveredGames.title: A slot machine becomes an unlikely battlefield commander, turning each wave into a puzzle of probability. Merge lucky pulls, tune your build with Cores and Items, and watch a scrappy army take shape.

coveredGames.name: Mosaique Neko Waifus 6
coveredGames.title: More than a gallery of cute neko girls, this sequel builds a cozy loop around clever rotating puzzles, useful upgrades and choice-driven rewards. A relaxed pace makes each session easy to enjoy.

coveredGames.name: Dungeon Munchies 2
coveredGames.title: A necromancer's restaurant dream sends you into a labyrinth of cosmic monsters. Hack through new threats, loot useful gear and cook your catches into upgrades for the battles ahead.

coveredGames.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Oaths & Ashes
coveredGames.title: Play a ruthless Ventrue and a rebellious Thinblood in a richly layered Berlin chronicle. Manipulate factions, brew alchemical formulas and decide whether uneasy allies deserve your trust.

coveredGames.name: False Myth 2
coveredGames.title: A mysterious girl with an unreadable heart draws Rouge into a new adventure of danger and devotion. Five romance routes, voiced characters and a deep fantasy quest give this JRPG plenty to explore.

coveredGames.name: Amnea28: Two Eternities
coveredGames.title: An old hotel, five routes, and a week of lectures create a slow-burning psychological mystery; stress-sensitive choices, hidden motives, and multiple endings give revelations lasting weight.

coveredGames.name: Distributrains
coveredGames.title: Rail lines, factories, and tight contracts turn resource distribution into a brisk strategic puzzle; procedural maps, flexible train orders, and co-op play make every network a fresh balancing act.

coveredGames.name: Dark Eyes - Super Soldier 2
coveredGames.title: Alien battles bring real momentum, while stealth routes, platforming hazards, and a broad arsenal keep missions varied; suit upgrades let combat evolve around distinct tactics on a chaotic front.

coveredGames.name: Potion-making: Path of the Alchemist
coveredGames.title: Ingredient chains, spell cards, and races across fantasy boards give this alchemy game a clever rhythm; crafting complex recipes makes every turn a satisfying calculation for aspiring masters.

coveredGames.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
coveredGames.title: Burning medieval Paris, whip-swinging traversal, and fierce boss encounters give this adventure a striking identity; weapon classes, relics, and tarot powers make combat and exploration rewarding.

coveredGames.name: Gennady
coveredGames.title: Shifting corridors, chthonic foes, and death that strengthens the next attempt give this roguelike platformer a chaotic pulse; its offbeat cartoon spirit makes every dangerous run unpredictable.

coveredGames.name: Bruisers 2D Boxing
coveredGames.title: From amateur scraps to professional glory, this boxing career mixes training, diet, risky choices, and hard-fought bouts; its progression makes every win feel earned and shortcuts feel costly.

coveredGames.name: Space Savory
coveredGames.title: A grimy roadside diner at the edge of space invites strange customers and darker jokes; its cosmic setting and irreverent tone give this narrative adventure a flavorful personality all its own.

coveredGames.name: Great Northern War
coveredGames.title: An expansive chronicle of the Baltic wars, with five campaigns and 89 scenarios, offers rival armies, winter operations, and shifting alliances for players who relish careful military planning.

coveredGames.name: Ghost hunter
coveredGames.title: Taoist rituals and Chinese supernatural folklore give this co-op ghost hunt an eerie atmosphere, while up to five players can make each investigation a tense exercise in teamwork and eerie discovery.

coveredGames.name: Boarding Denied
coveredGames.title: With a meteor only days away, checking documents becomes a harrowing moral puzzle; shifting rules and scarce seats turn each stamp into a human decision, making bureaucracy feel apocalyptic.

coveredGames.name: Hoosegow: Prison Survival
coveredGames.title: A darkly comic prison roguelite where random charges and sentences shape each run; branching choices and grim humor make survival feel like a story written one bad decision at a time, run after run.

coveredGames.name: Swarmslam
coveredGames.title: A swarm of tiny workers chewing through planets and feeding the void makes resource growth feel hypnotic; each cycle expands the swarm, turning simple repetition into a satisfying incremental loop.

coveredGames.name: Cat's Wars
coveredGames.title: Cute feline fighters bring an explosive edge to co-op combat, pairing oversized weapons with chaotic third-person skirmishes; every firefight becomes a lively mix of teamwork and mayhem with friends.

coveredGames.name: SUMOO
coveredGames.title: A minimalist grid becomes a playground for exact arithmetic, with pits, portals, and multipliers turning each move into a brainteaser; clean rules make success feel earned and wonderfully precise.

coveredGames.name: Nightmare Conquest
coveredGames.title: Building a monster team and combining skills makes every run a chance to discover a gloriously broken strategy; this auto-battler rewards experimentation, synergy, and delightfully absurd builds.

coveredGames.name: Realm of Taiwu
coveredGames.title: An alternate timeline steeped in martial-arts mythology opens a darker path through a richly imagined world; branching lore and dramatic stakes give this tale a fresh, intriguing sense of tragedy.

coveredGames.name: Hypernet Explorer
coveredGames.title: An offbeat post-Y2K Europe gives this roguelike immersive sim a strange identity, blending sci-fi, alternate history, and occult undertones into a world that invites experimentation and detours.

coveredGames.name: Golf 5 MAX
coveredGames.title: Careful shots, course reading, and the pursuit of a cleaner score give this golf experience a satisfying rhythm; its focus on precision makes every well-judged swing feel like a personal triumph.

coveredGames.name: Escape from Vlogger: Runaway
coveredGames.title: Breaking into a vlogger's home becomes a tense escape full of hiding, puzzles, and uneasy discoveries; the familiar setting grows sinister fast, giving each locked door a welcome edge of suspense.

coveredGames.name: GROUND BRANCH
coveredGames.title: Every mission demands patience, then rewards it with heart-pounding tension. Planning feels meaningful, mistakes feel real. A deeply immersive shooter that respects your intelligence.

coveredGames.name: Get Out ! A "Very Bad Dreams" Story
coveredGames.title: Locked in a straitjacket, hooded, and terrified - every escape earns real progress. Each small victory over the nightmare feels genuinely rewarding, pushing you deeper into this unnerving VR ordeal.

coveredGames.name: Quantum Void
coveredGames.title: Solo explorers who crave mystery will love drifting through derelict wrecks, piecing together an anomaly's secrets in immersive, atmospheric VR-supported action.

coveredGames.name: Creepy Support
coveredGames.title: Answer calls, ask sharp questions, and steer terrifying outcomes through dialogue choices. Branching endings reward careful listening, making every paranormal case genuinely tense and replayable.

coveredGames.name: Clean Up Earth
coveredGames.title: Vacuum waste, restore ecosystems, watch nature return. Solo or with 25 players, the loop stays satisfying. Community play even supports real causes. Interesting concept, solid execution!

coveredGames.name: Abyss Horde
coveredGames.title: Every wave forces fresh tactics - no static builds here. Mouse-only control and adjustable difficulty make this abyssal siege refreshingly accessible yet fierce.

coveredGames.name: SkyChart: Airline Executive
coveredGames.title: Span 90 years of aviation history across 528 real cities! Buy 196 historical aircraft, outmaneuver 35 rivals, and survive the Depression, oil shocks, 9/11, and COVID. A superb strategy sim!

coveredGames.name: Guardian of the Sacred Seal
coveredGames.title: Unravel hidden secrets in Gokurakudō alongside a mysterious yandere companion. Each request pulls you deeper into intrigue. Well-written and endlessly captivating!

coveredGames.name: OxyRail
coveredGames.title: Survival fans who love trains will thrive here. Build, explore, fish, and fight in a fresh open-world experience. Solo or with seven friends, this is a must-play for all railfans!

coveredGames.name: Gacha Capsule Shop Simulator - Akihabara
coveredGames.title: Source, price, and sell your way to otaku legend! The gacha shop loop is genuinely addictive, blending business strategy with Akihabara charm. Highly recommended!

coveredGames.name: Lugh World
coveredGames.title: A living world filled with captivating Lughs awaits. Real-time combat and creature evolution create an immersive, ever-changing MMO adventure worth exploring!

coveredGames.name: HackHub - Ultimate Hacker Simulator
coveredGames.title: Rebel hackers and strategy fans will thrive here. Foil surveillance, challenge authority, and rewrite digital rules. With Workshop support and multiplayer, this sim rewards the bold!

coveredGames.name: CarX Street
coveredGames.title: Tune, race, and dominate city streets, highways, and mountain roads. The deep car customization loop keeps pulling you back. Multiplayer PvP adds serious replay value!

coveredGames.name: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check
coveredGames.title: Every survivor you screen could be infected. Manage scarce resources, hold the undead back, and face brutal choices at your checkpoint. One mistake dooms the city. Incredibly immersive!

coveredGames.name: Life Below
coveredGames.title: Life Below offers a captivating underwater city-builder where you nurture coral reefs and restore ocean ecosystems. The satisfying cycle of growth and renewal keeps you engaged.

coveredGames.name: Cralon
coveredGames.title: Oldschool dungeon crawling meets immersive sim depth. Cralon blends RPG questing, secret hunting, and atmospheric mine exploration into something genuinely distinctive and fun!

coveredGames.name: Dancin' Divas
coveredGames.title: Feel the adrenaline rush as you fight back against robbery in this intense action experience! Four global Divas showcase treasures in a lounge setting gone wrong. Recommended!

coveredGames.name: CarX Drift Racing Online 2
coveredGames.title: Refined physics and an authentic judging system make every drift feel earned. With competitive PvP and co-op modes, CarX Drift Racing Online 2 delivers thrilling, skill-driven racing!

coveredGames.name: Legendary Pilots
coveredGames.title: Unlike typical flight sims, Legendary Pilots combines career management with stylized pixel art aviation. Build your airline empire through strategic route planning and elaborate gameplay options.

coveredGames.name: Midnight Special
coveredGames.title: Atmospheric 16-bit horror that captures 1980s dread perfectly. The labyrinthine manor setting creates genuine unease as you solve puzzles to escape this thunderous Maine night. Thrilling experience!

coveredGames.name: Lost Castle 2
coveredGames.title: Beat'em up action meets rogue-lite treasures in this co-op adventure! Master diverse weapons, collect abundant loot, and battle monsters with friends locally or online. Incredible fun!

coveredGames.name: Cheap Car Repair
coveredGames.title: Building your Polish repair empire from scratch delivers genuine satisfaction as you climb from penny-pinching mechanic to successful shop owner in this engaging 90s adventure.

coveredGames.name: Shikhondo: Blue Pieta
coveredGames.title: This Youkai-hunting shoot 'em up delivers blazing barrage action with a unique blue-burning aesthetic that sets it apart from typical shmups. Solid gameplay with controller support!

coveredGames.name: ARSONATE

coveredGames.name: CarX Drift Racing Online 2

coveredGames.name: Table Battle Simulator

coveredGames.name: Monster Lab Simulator
coveredGames.title: Gorgeous creature variety and smart progression systems. I appreciated the clear tutorials and rewarding synthesis loop. Playing master of a chaotic lab never felt so thrilling!

coveredGames.name: Lords of Ravage

coveredGames.name: Office Simulator

coveredGames.name: Raiders of Blackveil

coveredGames.name: Lost But Found

coveredGames.name: Concubine
