coveredGames.name: Deconstruction Simulator
coveredGames.title: A demolition simulator for all sorts of buildings and structures. It looks really well-made! The graphics and functionality are top-notch. I highly recommend buying the game and playing it!

coveredGames.name: Little Witch in the Woods
coveredGames.title: A very good and meditative game. You run around, collect plants, brew potions, solve puzzles. A cute pixel game. I recommend playing it!

coveredGames.name: Ratatan
coveredGames.title: The bustling island of Lada-Port is home to a group of strange and cheerful creatures. Set to upbeat music, they embark on a thrilling journey! Highly recommended!

coveredGames.name: Car Dealer Simulator
coveredGames.title: From finding deals to selling at the right time, every aspect feels rewarding. The game nails the thrill of the used car market perfectly.

coveredGames.name: Monster Mop Up
coveredGames.title: A fun game for all ages, which you can play with friends. You can also keep pets, everything is done cool here, so I recommend it!

coveredGames.name: Old Market Simulator
coveredGames.title: I've wanted to play a similar cozy store simulator for a long time, the game doesn't rush you anywhere and leaves you with plenty of time for development and learning the mechanics.

coveredGames.name: How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine
coveredGames.title: If you like quests with friends, this game is for you! The second game in the How 2 Escape series! I really liked the new theme of the game, as well as the puzzles that were offered in this game!

coveredGames.name: Let Them Trade
coveredGames.title: Let Them Trade offers a peaceful yet complex experience. Create a thriving kingdom at your own pace, trade wisely, and protect your towns from cheeky bandits. Beautifully crafted visuals.

coveredGames.name: Tiny Aquarium: Social Fishkeeping
coveredGames.title: I enjoyed spending time here! A good game, relaxing. We grow fish, feed them, keep them clean, breed them! There is a lot to do here, I recommend it!

coveredGames.name: Ship, Inc.
coveredGames.title: Not a bad, pleasant, simple game for a couple of hours. Here you can definitely relax and enjoy your work, I recommend! Need to support!

coveredGames.name: Tiny Pasture
coveredGames.title: Simply the cutest farm simulator on your taskbar! In just one day, I collected half of the local zoo! I liked this game because it takes little time and attention.

coveredGames.name: Fuel Harvest Together
coveredGames.title: Interesting game, game to just relax and play. Definitely recommend. I play again and again, and I like everything, so you too support!

coveredGames.name: Rogue: Genesia
coveredGames.title: I'm commenting as someone who finished Vampire Survivors. This game has better graphics, more variety, and a longer playtime than Vampire Survivors. I recommend getting it.

coveredGames.name: Bank Simulator
coveredGames.title: In this game, you will have to design and develop your own bank - from recruiting qualified personnel and issuing loans to investing in bonds.

coveredGames.name: Rooftops & Alleys: The Parkour Game
coveredGames.title: The game is very cool and beautiful stylized nice graphics and cool controls! This is a great game that is nice to play with friends, of course I recommend it!

coveredGames.name: Private Military Manager: Tactical Auto Battler
coveredGames.title: Lead a secret mercenary corporation: analyze intelligence, select squad composition and equipment, make tough decisions in a world where betrayal is commonplace.

coveredGames.name: Silver Pines
coveredGames.title: Survival Horror with Metroidvania elements that draws inspiration from Neo Noir cinema and David Lynch, backed by well written dialogue and voice acting, as well as gorgeous rotoscoped animations.

coveredGames.name: Truckful
coveredGames.title: Isometric trucking game where you make deliveries in a valley cut-off by a supernatural overgrowth, the light inventory management and gentle upgrade path make for a very engrossing experience.

coveredGames.name: Penguin Colony
coveredGames.title: Fascinating game where you play as penguins bearing witness to an unfolding cosmic horror, while a little janky gameplay wise, both the narrative and narration make it a gripping experience.

coveredGames.name: Queen's Domain
coveredGames.title: Queen's Domain is such a gem of an RPG it's positively resplendent! The intricate spiraling level design where the environment itself is a puzzle to be solved with your abilities is immaculate design.

coveredGames.name: Well Dweller
coveredGames.title: A Metroidvania with a distinctly dark fairy tale setting, positively sublime artstyle with nightmarish bosses, and a haunting, melancholic soundtrack, every moment of this game is an absolute joy.

coveredGames.name: Car Park Capital
coveredGames.title: Play as a truly horrible villain and pave over paradise to build parking lots in this satirical strategy, as you maximize the need for cars through use of propaganda and ripping up infrastructure.

coveredGames.name: False Hero
coveredGames.title: False Hero has a real grasp of what makes Souls games tick, the intricate level design and immense boss encounters are impressive, and it adds to this its own unique and engaging combat system.

coveredGames.name: Welcome to Elderfield
coveredGames.title: Immeasurably engrossing Stardew-esque farming sim RPG with wonderfully spooky horror elements, unnerving yet chill music, and gorgeous monster designs featured prominently in the turn-based combat.

coveredGames.name: The Sinking City 2
coveredGames.title: A standalone sequel that is quite an effective Survival Horror game, and while flawed, The Sinking City 2 has some outstanding and memorable level design in some of the elaborate set-piece locations.

coveredGames.name: SPRAWL zero
coveredGames.title: FPS with a gravity manipulation core mechanic, weapons feels monumentally powerful and satisfying, and the bombastic soundtrack brings incredible gravitas to the kind of cyberpunk imagery it invokes.

coveredGames.name: Besmirch
coveredGames.title: A Stardew-esque horror farming game that takes a lot of visual inspiration from Faith, as well as taking elements of Darkwood where you prepare for and barricade your house during days of darkness.

coveredGames.name: Blood Dungeon
coveredGames.title: Blood Dungeon blends the auto-attacking horde survival gameplay of Vampire Survivors with side-scrolling platforming, and sees you run, jump, climb and scrip-scrobble all over to avoid the hordes.

coveredGames.name: Titanium Court
coveredGames.title: And wonderful and baffling roguelike that blends Match-3 and light strategy gameplay styles with delightfully absurd fairy court intrigue, a difficult to describe yet entirely captivating experience.

coveredGames.name: ROUTINE
coveredGames.title: One of the most intense horror games I have ever played, Routine's central sci-fi gadget mechanic makes interacting with the game's world and puzzles fascinating, an immensely well crafted experience.

coveredGames.name: Corsair Cove
coveredGames.title: An extremely inventive pirate themed city builder that utilizes a lot of verticality with its building mechanics, but also has a robust questing system that sees you send pirate ships on expeditions.

coveredGames.name: Jenny the Witch
coveredGames.title: A side-game to Steel Carnelian, Jenny is a bite-size character action game channeling PS2 vibes with its low poly visuals, that offers a surprising amount of enemy variety for its short runtime.

coveredGames.name: The Mermaid Mask
coveredGames.title: The Mermaid Mask is a point & click adventure that offers a tantalizing mystery to solve, filled with delightful puzzles, and interesting characters to question backed by magnificent voice acting.

coveredGames.name: Fogpiercer
coveredGames.title: Fogpiercer is a fascinating roguelike deckbuilder that doesn't particularly innovate, but executes a familiar formula with style and satisfying combat, where repositioning is as important as damage.

coveredGames.name: Hell Maiden
coveredGames.title: A deliciously absurd magical girl take on the Vampire Survivors formula that adds unique deckbuilding mechanics for upgrades and modifiers, and features some truly gorgeous anime inspired visuals.

coveredGames.name: Labyrinth Of The Demon King
coveredGames.title: Fusing King's Field style dungeon crawling with Survival Horror via Japanese mythology. Beautifully grotesque retro visuals, an intensely unpleasant atmosphere, and brutal, deliberately paced combat.

coveredGames.name: Home Safety Hotline
coveredGames.title: An analogue horror game about taking calls from homeowners who may be experiencing supernatural infestations, and diagnose their issues. A delightful creepy, often funny, and entirely engrossing time.

coveredGames.name: PIGFACE
coveredGames.title: With grimy and brutal grindhouse tone, Pigface sees you take on contracts to assassinate, steal, or destroy in expansive open levels where multiple approaches, loadouts, and tactics are viable.

coveredGames.name: Forbidden Solitaire
coveredGames.title: Forbidden Solitaire is a magnificently engrossing title, where the unfolding meta narrative is every bit as gripping as the Solitaire inspired gameplay, backed by some striking 90s inspired visuals.

coveredGames.name: MOTORSLICE
coveredGames.title: Motorslice is a challenging 3rd person parkour platforming through a visually arresting brutalist megastructure that boasts gargantuan boss encounters that are themselves platforming challenges!

coveredGames.name: Creature Kitchen
coveredGames.title: Creature Kitchen is a short but very sweet light cooking sim and puzzle game with an eerie ambience, that has you cook meals for a variety of crunchy low-poly creatures. It's a delightful experience.

coveredGames.name: Demonschool
coveredGames.title: Visually striking isometric turn-based tactics game, featuring a huge cast of vibrant characters each boasting unique and fun skills, with engrossing minigames, and an unfathomably awesome soundtrack.

coveredGames.name: MOUSE: P.I. For Hire
coveredGames.title: More than just the gorgeous animation, Mouse is an incredibly solid Retro FPS at heart with some extremely well crafted levels, adding some inventive weaponry to the mix, and painfully cheesy puns.

coveredGames.name: Subversive Memories
coveredGames.title: Set during the military dictatorship of Brazil, Subversive Memories is a short Survival Horror game where we explore an abandoned military base and confront all too real horrors of torture and abuse.

coveredGames.name: ChainStaff
coveredGames.title: Run'N'Gun action with grappling hook mechanics that visually channels classic Prog Rock and Heavy Metal vinyl album sleeve artwork and oldschool Amiga games, with an incredible soundtrack to match.

coveredGames.name: Resident Evil Requiem
coveredGames.title: RE9 balances the gameplay between supremely creepy horror focused sections and gloriously over the top action, which complement each other shockingly well as rising tension breaks to cathartic gore.

coveredGames.name: ENDLESS Legend™ 2
coveredGames.title: An engrossing turn-based strategy game that incorporates RPG mechanics with its heroes and questlines, wildly different factions, and a fascinating tidefall system where the environment will shift.

coveredGames.name: Crabmeat
coveredGames.title: A short horror game about fishing for crabs where half the fun is navigating the first-person point & click interface, it's remarkably engrossing just interacting with the ship's buttons and levers.

coveredGames.name: Slay the Spire 2
coveredGames.title: Taking everything that works about the original game and refining it, adding a variety of new mechanics, enemy designs, art and animation, Slay the Spire 2 is a masterful, nigh-on impeccable followup.

coveredGames.name: Tearscape
coveredGames.title: Tearscape is essentially a Bloodborne demake in the style of a handheld Zelda game, but the solid gameplay with clever dungeon design and challenging bosses raised it beyond my expectations.

coveredGames.name: The Séance of Blake Manor
coveredGames.title: A positively genius detective game steeped in Irish history and folklore with impeccably weaved narrative threads to pull at that lead you down deductive rabbit holes, and a magnificent artstyle.

coveredGames.name: Captain Wayne - Vacation Desperation
coveredGames.title: Deliciously over the top and ludicrously fast paced retro FPS with a cartoonish artstyle somewhere between Spongebob and One PIece, where you play as a pirate captain with a shotgun for an arm.

coveredGames.name: Verho - Curse of Faces
coveredGames.title: Verho takes huge inspiration from King's Field and Dark Souls, while building its own fascinating mythology, the low-poly visuals and stilted voice acting add greatly to the charming atmosphere.

coveredGames.name: Dispatch
coveredGames.title: Wonderfully well voiced superhero workplace sim with truly memorable characters, where the dispatching and hacking minigames nicely break up the utterly captivating episodic story, highly recommended.

coveredGames.name: Kingdoms of the Dump
coveredGames.title: Thoroughly brilliant RPG with turn-based combat set in a land of garbage, Kingdoms of the Dump's writing is wonderfully clever, great characters and overarching saga, and the pixelart is magnificent!

coveredGames.name: Whiskerwood
coveredGames.title: A survival city-builder in the vein of Timberborn featuring mice, but with some more automation and logistics complexity, and a focus on use of vertical space while building and extracting resources.

coveredGames.name: Pinata Smash: Incremental Circus
coveredGames.title: A nice short incremental game, easy to platine and will take you around 5 hours or your free time. Worth the small price.

coveredGames.name: Golf 5 MAX
coveredGames.title: A simple retro golf game which is easy to pick up and play. Lots of options for solo players including arcade style options and RPG mechanics with upgrades. Online available but quiet.

coveredGames.name: Penguin Colony

coveredGames.name: Dig! Dig! Dino!
coveredGames.title: A cozy, relaxing digging game. Use money to upgrade your tools and there are 3 dig sites to explore. Overall, the game is good, but is on the short side compared to other implemental games.

coveredGames.name: Nomad Drive

coveredGames.name: Pool of Madness

coveredGames.name: Topdeck Automat

coveredGames.name: Dawn of Defense
coveredGames.title: While it doesn't reach the same depth as games dedicated to either the TD or RTS genres, it absolutely nails the engaging and addictive roguelite loop.

coveredGames.name: Sudoku Unlimited

coveredGames.name: Dungeonbound
coveredGames.title: A choose your own adventure dungeon crawler, roguelite and RPG game with loose 'incremental' features, all rolled into one.

coveredGames.name: Trivia Mania
coveredGames.title: There's a lot of trivia games but this one stands out as being an excellent trivia trainer with loads of different games, options to retry wrong answers, and countless stats to benchmark your progress

coveredGames.name: Scramshaw
coveredGames.title: An original and enjoyable roguelite word game based around a pirate theme where progression depends on submitting words to avoid perils and making yourself stronger for the next run.

coveredGames.name: LexiWeave
coveredGames.title: A fun and challenging word game which should cater for all skill levels with a customizable grid and multiple languages. Very relaxing to play and good value for money.

coveredGames.name: Prerolled
coveredGames.title: A cozy dice roguelike that is easy to learn and hard to master. The artwork is cute and menus are easy to understand. Figuring out builds can be challenging, but game sessions are casual.

coveredGames.name: Everybody Loves a Good Hole
coveredGames.title: Everybody Loves a Good Hole is a silly and yet relevant incremental black hole game with a skill tree to increase your hole's effectiveness. Worth a look.

coveredGames.name: RainBook Lite
coveredGames.title: RainBook Lite is a free writing program that saves your writing files to your computer and offers a vibey atmosphere to help you settle into your writing. Worth a look.

coveredGames.name: Wizardry: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord
coveredGames.title: A modern remake of one of the original dungeon crawlers. The game struggles with archaic game design, but is historically important and still a decent enough playing experience. Worth a look.

coveredGames.name: Cake & Bake
coveredGames.title: Bake and create cakes, shop for ingredients and upgrade your baking tools. The best part, no rush and no real life clean up…just cozy, delicious fun.

coveredGames.name: Grim Deck
coveredGames.title: Twisting solitaire into a creepy, challenging rouge-lite experience.

coveredGames.name: Solitaire: Kingdom in Chains
coveredGames.title: An enjoyable and challenging fantasy Solitaire adventure with 17 bosses to fight, and although the Solitaire is quite basic it proves to be addictive and doesn't outstay its welcome.

coveredGames.name: Cat Over Here!
coveredGames.title: Finding the cats is not too stressful since there are some "hints" on their whereabouts, and you can always use catnip to lure them out.

coveredGames.name: No Murders in Grimwick
coveredGames.title: A 45-min cozy mystery with some creepiness sprinkled on top. Investigate the Grimwick harvest festival's “accidents” through cute art & witty lines, but careful not to end up on the village's bad side

coveredGames.name: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School
coveredGames.title: The puzzles are at the right difficulty, and there are plenty to keep you entertained. The new additions of the explorable map make way for collectible and side quest hunting, which was fun to do.

coveredGames.name: Mad King Redemption
coveredGames.title: Side scrolling action and roguelike mechanics work in harmony to create a fun experience. Check out the YouTube video for commentary and game play.

coveredGames.name: Romestead
coveredGames.title: Fun and surprisingly addictive city builder and action survival. Check out our game review on our YouTube Channel.

coveredGames.name: Bolsheviktion 2: Yurovsky's Revenge
coveredGames.title: Enjoyable boomer shooter and a great homage to yesteryear. Check out the gameplay video review on our YouTube Channel.

coveredGames.name: Clean Start
coveredGames.title: The weaving of a wonderful narrative blended with a cozy cleaning sim that is full of heart.

coveredGames.name: Travellin Cats Advent Calendar
coveredGames.title: Grab your hot cocoa and cookies as it is time for some Christmas fun. Join Santa and his elves in 25 amazing hand-crafted scenes.

coveredGames.name: Way Too Many Eggs
coveredGames.title: Way Too Many Eggs is a short pleasant incremental game, will take around 4-5 hours of your free time, but don’t really except more ...

coveredGames.name: Wielders of the Essence
coveredGames.title: A good bullet heaven game with incremental upgrades. I enjoyed the game because there are a variety of playstyles via spells, troops, and wielders. However, the upgrade cost of buildings adds grind.

coveredGames.name: Sticker DECO
coveredGames.title: Relive the nostalgia of collecting stickers and trading with friends along with the excitement of finding that one last rare one to complete your collection.

coveredGames.name: MyDear.exe
coveredGames.title: A fully voiced, adorable love story between two septuagenarians told through an old PC full of mini-games. ~1h30 of gaming references and heartwarming, human moments. Prefect for a cozy evening 🤍

coveredGames.name: Case Solved: The London Files
coveredGames.title: Solid deduction game offering around 65 levels and 6h of content. It's light on story and sometimes awkwardly worded, but a good time for puzzle lovers.

coveredGames.name: Home Safety Hotline
coveredGames.title: Windows 95 meets folklore in this clever, cozy-creepy ~3hr reading comprehension exam. Ideal for lore and art nerds (included artbook is amazing!), BUT no story and gameplay is 99% reading/recall.

coveredGames.name: Slots & Skulls
coveredGames.title: I kept telling myself just one more round. Hours later…

coveredGames.name: Replay Value: Second Hand Games
coveredGames.title: A bright game shop sim full of nerd references and great humor. Perfect to scratch that repetitive, grindy itch, but still in need of a lot of balancing at launch. Keep a close look on future patches.

coveredGames.name: Organize my Shop 2: Pet Shop
coveredGames.title: Organize shelves of pet food, supplies and toys in a relaxing atmosphere with no timers.

coveredGames.name: Lucky Punk: a push your luck Deckbuilder
coveredGames.title: In a post-apocalyptic world it is all or nothing. Playing it safe will only take you so far. You know the odds but will you still take one more card?

coveredGames.name: Cinderwake
coveredGames.title: A simple but efficient & great hack’n’slash, with daily new update, new content planned for next months, and a demo if you want to try it before purchase, full recommended for this quality of work..

coveredGames.name: The Technomancer
coveredGames.title: A choice-driven narrative sci-fi RPG. A unique blend of cyberpunk tech and electric magic creates a very nice lore. Step into the boots of Zachariah, a rookie whose loyalty is constantly tested.

coveredGames.name: Caster Crew
coveredGames.title: A wonderfully unusual roguelike that turns voice chat into part of the gameplay. Your friends might never hear your voice the same way again!

coveredGames.name: Save the Sandcastle
coveredGames.title: Childhood dreams of building the perfect sandcastle, now with the added responsibility of defending it from the ocean. A truly creative puzzle experience.

coveredGames.name: Little St. Files Mayhem
coveredGames.title: They say teamwork makes the dream work. Turns out, getting three friends to agree on where a folder belongs is a whole different story.

coveredGames.name: Boxing Tycoon
coveredGames.title: Behind every legendary boxing night is someone juggling egos, contracts, money and a whole lot of ambition. Now that someone is you.

coveredGames.name: Horror In Neverland
coveredGames.title: A simple little horror shooter to kill some time when you're bored and have nothing better to do. Grab a weapon, shoot some zombies and explore four gloomy levels.

coveredGames.name: Horde Hero
coveredGames.title: A satisfying blend of relentless monster battles and deep character progression. Experiment with different builds, grow stronger and find your own way to survive the hordes.

coveredGames.name: Frank 'n' Stein's Body Shop
coveredGames.title: A wonderfully strange shopkeeping experience where every shift brings new challenges, unusual customers and increasingly demanding orders.

coveredGames.name: Boss in Diapers
coveredGames.title: Who said daycare was peaceful? Gather your friends, unleash your inner baby boss and turn an innocent classroom into a battlefield of wits and mischief.

coveredGames.name: DAEMON
coveredGames.title: A tiny desktop companion who slowly makes himself at home in your daily routine. Be warned, you might get more attached than you planned.

coveredGames.name: Isekai Survivors
coveredGames.title: Cute, quirky and full of personality. A charming fantasy roguelite with an unusually appealing visual style.

coveredGames.name: FINAL CUT
coveredGames.title: The past is buried, the studio is cursed and Vera's return may be the most terrifying performance of her life.

coveredGames.name: Astral Phase
coveredGames.title: What if you could no longer trust your own senses? A surreal psychological horror experience that keeps you questioning everything.

coveredGames.name: Taso Idle
coveredGames.title: Remember those little schoolyard games? Now turn flipping tasos into a whole business. A surprisingly addictive experience.

coveredGames.name: Purrtopia: Desktop Cat
coveredGames.title: Who wouldn't want a tiny pixel cat keeping them company while working or studying? An adorable way to make your desktop feel a little more alive.

coveredGames.name: Widget2000s
coveredGames.title: For everyone who misses the shiny, colorful aesthetics of the 2000s. A charming way to add personality and music-inspired visuals to your desktop.

coveredGames.name: Second Source
coveredGames.title: A unique mix of intelligence analysis, strategic decisions and stealth, where every shift brings new challenges and unexpected dangers.

coveredGames.name: After the Wane
coveredGames.title: A beautifully illustrated story of ambition, love and the supernatural, where every choice matters. Shape Lena's identity and decide which path her life will take.

coveredGames.name: Extracto Proviso
coveredGames.title: An atmospheric sci-fi experience where the satisfaction of building something extraordinary meets the mystery of a world that has secrets of its own.

coveredGames.name: Mystical II: Forgotten Knowledge
coveredGames.title: A thoughtful puzzle experience where every choice matters. Plan your combinations carefully, manage your limited inventory and uncover forgotten knowledge.

coveredGames.name: Terrahold
coveredGames.title: A world that pushes back against every step of your expansion. Build your own mechanical empire, tame the wild terrain and see how long you can hold your ground.

coveredGames.name: Bone Idle
coveredGames.title: A satisfying idle experience with undead workers, expanding islands and plenty of upgrades to keep your operation growing.

coveredGames.name: GENNADIYYY
coveredGames.title: Who knew keeping an eye on your furniture could be so challenging? A quirky puzzle game with a genuinely amusing central mechanic.

coveredGames.name: ABYSS: The Shadows of Elder Cities
coveredGames.title: A wonderfully unusual horror adventure that brings oldschool wireframe visuals back to life with a mysterious cosmic horror atmosphere.

coveredGames.name: Echoes of Dread
coveredGames.title: For those who love exploring eerie locations, piecing together hidden clues and questioning everything they encounter.

coveredGames.name: VALDIS
coveredGames.title: For fans of sci-fi survival, this is a great opportunity to experience a fresh mix of tactical turret placement and intense third person combat, putting both strategy and reflexes to the test.

coveredGames.name: Animal Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats
coveredGames.title: A lovely way to relax your eyes and put your attention to the test. Give this hidden cat adventure a try.

coveredGames.name: Ancient Wars: Sparta HD
coveredGames.title: A classic RTS returns in HD. Relive the legendary battles of the ancient world with enhanced visuals and improved gameplay.

coveredGames.name: ASTERIS
coveredGames.title: Gather your friends, master your roles and unleash divine power together against formidable raid bosses.

coveredGames.name: Old Man's Sushi
coveredGames.title: A cozy little seaside adventure where fishing, making sushi and exploring a charming pixel art cove come together in a relaxing experience.

coveredGames.name: Phantom Blade Zero
coveredGames.title: A dying warrior, a world full of secrets and a blade that never stays silent. Sounds like the beginning of something unforgettable.

coveredGames.name: Aetheris Core
coveredGames.title: A perfect playground for those who love experimenting, discovering synergies and pushing their limits.

coveredGames.name: Big Scoop: Trash Cleaning Simulator
coveredGames.title: Few things feel as rewarding as watching a polluted ocean slowly return to life. A charming idea with a positive purpose.

coveredGames.name: UPSHOT
coveredGames.title: A fresh take on arena shooting where one target quickly becomes a whole lot of trouble. Great fun for anyone who enjoys chaotic action.

coveredGames.name: Crimson Solstice
coveredGames.title: If you enjoy games that mix everyday activities with an unfolding dark mystery, this adventure offers a rather unusual combination of cozy moments and looming danger.

coveredGames.name: Phantom Grind
coveredGames.title: From cursed forests to ruined strongholds, a dark fantasy setting awaits those who enjoy classic RPG aesthetics.

coveredGames.name: Literally
coveredGames.title: A charming collection of clever minigames where familiar sayings turn into delightful little adventures. Full of humor, surprises and creative puzzles.

coveredGames.name: Debtbound
coveredGames.title: An addictive incremental with a fun twist on getting rich. Start buried in debt, build your income and see how far your money making obsession can take you.

coveredGames.name: TOMIDER
coveredGames.title: A psychological horror visual novel set in the 1990s town of Oford. Experience a nostalgic period setting filled with old print media and retro cassette tapes.

coveredGames.name: I Checkmate Thee
coveredGames.title: A twisted chess nightmare where dead pieces become cover, hidden scrolls reveal secrets and every step could lead to death. Think before you move.

coveredGames.name: Real Zombie Survivors
coveredGames.title: Turn every run into a chance to grow with in game upgrades and permanent skill trees for long term progression.

coveredGames.name: Wielders of the Essence
coveredGames.title: The colorful graphics make the busy fights easy to enjoy, and the music fits the action nicely. There are not endless levels, but the steady upgrades and quick rounds make it a pleasant game to play.

coveredGames.name: ZONE L.O.S.T.
coveredGames.title: Having four very different scientists makes cooperation more than just following friends down a hallway. Everyone needs help with something, and those small problems create plenty of funny situations.

coveredGames.name: Zombie Hamsters
coveredGames.title: Playing as tiny zombie hamsters makes exploring the laboratory quite funny. The main goal is to find an exit, but guards, robots, and strange rooms make teamwork important and every attempt different.

coveredGames.name: Hypernet Explorer
coveredGames.title: Traveling across a strange version of Europe is a nice change from dungeon crawling. Trains, towns, and side activities make the world worth exploring, even while some areas remain unfinished.

coveredGames.name: Pool of Madness
coveredGames.title: Each run mixes careful aiming with a bit of luck. Earning points, choosing upgrades, and trying to survive the next ritual makes the simple act of sinking balls much more engaging than expected.

coveredGames.name: Clogwork
coveredGames.title: Logic gates, sensors, and counters add a rewarding layer beyond conveyor management. Solving a stubborn bottleneck with a neat circuit delivers the real deep satisfaction automation fans crave.

coveredGames.name: ArcheAge Chronicles
coveredGames.title: There's a solid mix of solo exploration and group activities, including dungeons and challenging bosses. The buy-to-play approach without paid combat advantages is another welcome feature for an MMO.

coveredGames.name: Boku Boku
coveredGames.title: Creating custom blocks and connecting switches to lights adds a clever layer to the building. Even small projects feel satisfying when decorations can be personalized and rooms can respond to actions.

coveredGames.name: I Know a Spot
coveredGames.title: Rain, crackling fires, and changing daylight give the campsites a wonderfully calm atmosphere. With no timers or survival chores, the experience is all about slowing down and enjoying the outdoors.

coveredGames.name: Potion-making: Path of the Alchemist
coveredGames.title: The recipe system makes this card game surprisingly strategic. Combining simple ingredients into stronger potions is satisfying, and using an opponent's creations adds a fun competitive element.

coveredGames.name: Slotbound
coveredGames.title: The best part is deciding whether another spin is worth the gold. One small adjustment to the reels can change everything, so the slot machine feels more like a tactical gamble than blind luck.

coveredGames.name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
coveredGames.title: Each stage feels handcrafted, with interactable scenery and enemy mixes that reward changing tactics instead of repeating one build. The result is classic tower defense with real strategic bite.

coveredGames.name: Order: The New Dawn
coveredGames.title: Trading adds a welcome layer beyond simply gathering resources. Deciding what to keep, what to sell and where to send a shipment gives the growing settlement a convincing place in a wider universe.

coveredGames.name: Make the Empire Great Again
coveredGames.title: Watching a settlement become a busy kingdom is satisfying, especially when every new building has a purpose. The blend of cozy planning and looming danger gives the whole adventure a lively rhythm.

coveredGames.name: Athanasia
coveredGames.title: Finding a route through the sprawling complex feels like a genuine achievement. Elevators, shortcuts and hidden rooms slowly turn a confusing maze into a place that rewards patience and curiosity.

coveredGames.name: Under Canopies
coveredGames.title: The way small errands grow into an afternoon adventure is oddly addictive. Setting out for supplies, spotting a curious animal and finding a new trail makes the world feel worth exploring slowly.

coveredGames.name: Golf 5 MAX
coveredGames.title: Friendly competition is the real attraction here. Each course offers fresh little obstacles, and improving a score feels surprisingly exciting. It turns a quiet sport into a lively arcade pastime.

coveredGames.name: Mix Universe
coveredGames.title: Mixing ingredients into unexpected creations gives this sandbox its own alchemical charm. The joy comes from stumbling upon surprising results and watching simple ideas spiral into something new.

coveredGames.name: Galvatein : Adventurers' Guild
coveredGames.title: Turning a ragtag band into a renowned adventurers' guild has a satisfying pull, with every recruit shaping the road to glory. The real joy is watching a humble outfit earn its legend.

coveredGames.name: Realm of Taiwu
coveredGames.title: An alternate Taiwu timeline gives the survivor formula real narrative flavor. Hunting ten divine swords across corrupted lands makes each run feel tied to a larger struggle instead of random grinding.

coveredGames.name: THANKS, LIGHT.
coveredGames.title: A clever first-person puzzle game where a flashlight turns flat shadows into real 3D objects. Stairs, cubes and pillars become tools for solving rooms, and later mechanics keep the idea fresh.

coveredGames.name: Carry The Count
coveredGames.title: The best co-op moments come from trying to help and somehow making everything worse. A missed grab, a broken coffin or a badly timed cannon shot can turn a simple crossing into pure co-op comedy.

coveredGames.name: Aquapark Tycoon
coveredGames.title: Co-op works remarkably well for a management game. Dividing tasks, expanding the park together, and solving guest problems as a team makes building ambitious resorts both relaxing and exciting.

coveredGames.name: Museologist: Tidy Up the Museum!
coveredGames.title: Rebuilding a museum from scattered fragments has a wonderfully meditative rhythm. Ancient weapons, fossils and statues turn each room into a quiet puzzle, while visible progress makes it worthwhile.

coveredGames.name: Love All My Girls
coveredGames.title: Each heroine brings a distinct mood, from playful banter to heavier emotional turns. Slick live-action presentation and dozens of endings make the romance feel far richer than its premise suggests.

coveredGames.name: Rooster
coveredGames.title: The twelve-animal structure gives the adventure a lovely rhythm, with each friend bringing a new challenge. From matchmaking to babysitting, the surprises keep coming without losing the cozy tone.

coveredGames.name: Police Chief Simulator
coveredGames.title: Case reports, patrol work and station upgrades form a satisfying climb from small-town paperwork to real command. Hiring staff slowly transforms the empty building into a working department.

coveredGames.name: Hot Rod Mayhem
coveredGames.title: Boost pads, shields and homing attacks turn every race into cheerful chaos. The ten championships and their opening trials give the campaign a fun rhythm beyond simply chasing first place overall.

coveredGames.name: Dread Admiral
coveredGames.title: Building a fleet is satisfying because every vessel has a clear role and every mistake can hurt. Perks, technology and permanent flagship upgrades make setbacks feel useful instead of wasted.

coveredGames.name: Tattoo Shop Simulator
coveredGames.title: Running a tiny studio means more than drawing on skin. Ink supplies, cleanliness, equipment and customer patience all need attention, and watching the business find its feet is quietly rewarding.

coveredGames.name: Jixo 5: Mask Parade Collector’s Edition
coveredGames.title: Collecting ornate masks turns each chapter into a charming souvenir hunt. The Collector's Cabinet and photo album make the gorgeous scenery and theatrical melodies worth revisiting long afterward.

coveredGames.name: SeaColony
coveredGames.title: From a bare platform, a warm little settlement slowly rises above the waves. Fishing, farming and passing traders bring calm, while winter and shortages keep every season quietly tense at sea.

coveredGames.name: Mineral Mining Simulator
coveredGames.title: The real treasure is not buried in the rock, but in a production line that finally runs smoothly. Mining, refining, automation and clever layouts blend into a satisfying management loop.

coveredGames.name: HackHub - Ultimate Hacker Simulator
coveredGames.title: Following clues through fake social media, emails, and network scans makes each job feel like actual detective work. The Linux-style desktop and terminal give the whole experience real character.

coveredGames.name: Breathedge 2
coveredGames.title: Abandoned stations feel rewarding to explore because almost every corner hides scrap, a blueprint or some absurd surprise. Survival pressure and steady upgrades keep the journey lively throughout.

coveredGames.name: Eslabong
coveredGames.title: Smart AI, deep squad building and a lively mercenary market turn every league into a story of risks and comebacks. With so many classes and skills, even a losing season can still feel rewarding.

coveredGames.name: Detective Sherlock: Shadow Stalker
coveredGames.title: Being able to comfort, threaten, deceive, or pressure suspects makes conversations surprisingly flexible. Their changing trust and reactions give clue hunting a sense of unpredictability and depth.

coveredGames.name: Shadow Dungeon
coveredGames.title: The best moments arrive when a modest build suddenly clicks: one weapon changes a skill, another piece multiplies its effect, and a room full of monsters disappears beneath a storm of damage.

coveredGames.name: 日本事故物件監視協会3 -Japan Stigmatized Property-
coveredGames.title: The use of real Japanese locations gives the surveillance setup an extra creepy edge. Subtle object changes, hidden figures and night-vision anomalies make every camera check feel tense and rewarding.

coveredGames.name: Angels Fall First
coveredGames.title: Capital ships you can actually pilot, walk through and board are still a rare sight in games. Add solid gunfights, dogfights, vehicles and good AI, and battles constantly produce memorable moments.

coveredGames.name: The Red Inn
coveredGames.title: 《The Red Inn》是一款PS1复古画风的第一人称恐怖冒险游戏。玩家被困在北海道海边一间大雪封门的温泉旅馆，看不懂告示，手机只能翻译部分文字；入夜后经营旅馆的一家人在走廊游荡，玩家要躲藏并搜寻证据。旅馆宽敞细致、房间各具个性，开场铺陈缓慢而有氛围，画面与音效出色，紧张感十足，还可选择用真实麦克风驱动噪音值。推荐给喜欢复古恐怖与躲藏探索的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Plastic Men: War never changes
coveredGames.title: 《Plastic Men: War never changes》是一款以塑料玩具兵为主角的轻松射击游戏。玩家化身一名塑料小兵，在充满童年气息的场景中完成各种任务、击败敌人。虽然流程偏短，但是玩具兵大战的怀旧氛围很有味道，武器种类多样，还能投掷手雷，射击节奏轻快爽利，上手简单，价格也亲民。推荐给喜欢街机射击与童年玩具兵情怀的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Realm of Iron
coveredGames.title: 《Realm of Iron》是一款黑暗奇幻风格的像素动作RPG，支持单人或最多8人联机合作。玩家探索广阔大陆，攻略地牢、击败首领，打造并精炼装备，还能种田、钓鱼、烹饪、建设城镇，周围的聚落会自行贸易、袭击乃至开战。像素美术与氛围出色，配乐动听，职业与召唤养成丰富，任务和护甲种类繁多，战斗爽快。推荐给喜欢像素动作RPG与联机开放世界冒险的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Office God
coveredGames.title: 《Office God》是一款设定在复古电脑桌面里的讽刺放置增量游戏。玩家从实习生起步，自动化繁琐杂务、雇用员工、收购公司，一路把职场苦差变成宇宙级力量，最终成为现实的管理者。虽然后期可做的事略显单薄，但是复古视窗氛围舒适，配乐轻松，职场幽默犀利，增量循环颇为解压，还藏着小游戏与大量彩蛋。推荐给喜欢放置增量与职场讽刺题材的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Galumb
coveredGames.title: 《Galumb》是一款混乱欢乐的多人派对闯关游戏。玩家在障碍赛道中拳打脚踢、推搡竞速，一路冲向顶端，可以与对手临时结盟，也能随时背刺。虽然难度偏高、部分关卡运气成分较重，优化与稳定性还有提升空间，但是上手后移动手感颇为爽快，关卡类型多样，和好友联机互坑尤其热闹，支持在线合作、对抗与完整手柄操作。推荐给喜欢高难度障碍闯关与多人派对的玩家～

coveredGames.name: 100FRIENDS
coveredGames.title: 《100FRIENDS》是一款以朋友当弹药的打砖块肉鸽游戏。玩家把厨师、老奶奶、吸血鬼等100位朋友发射出去，迎击一波波敌人，搭配构筑，打出夸张的连锁反应。虽然前期流程略显重复，但是增量成长的循环十分上头，朋友种类丰富，构筑深度可观，画面明亮可爱，配乐尤为出彩，还支持手柄与触屏操作。推荐给喜欢打砖块与肉鸽构筑的玩家～

coveredGames.name: MOBU
coveredGames.title: 《MOBU》是一款快节奏的动作肉鸽游戏。玩家化身身怀超能力的武僧，迎战从天而降、四处弹跳的一波波敌人，借助各种升级与不同角色打造强力流派，每局不到30分钟。流派组合丰富，难度由浅入深，短局节奏让人一局接一局，美术可爱、配乐动听，还支持完整手柄、可调难度与云存档，在掌机上运行也很流畅。推荐给喜欢动作肉鸽与清屏生存挑战的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Ayasa: Shadows of Silence
coveredGames.title: 《寂静之国的波斯菊》是一款无对白叙事的黑暗解谜平台游戏。玩家穿越六片超现实国度，借助光芒照亮道路、破解环境谜题，怜悯或冷漠的抉择将左右这个濒临毁灭的世界的命运。虽然流程偏短，部分bug与操作手感还需打磨，但是阴郁奇诡的美术、氛围感十足的画面与配乐令人沉醉，充满象征意味的故事值得细细品味。推荐给喜欢黑暗风格解谜平台与隐喻叙事的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Lighthouse of Madness
coveredGames.title: 《疯狂灯塔》是一款受洛夫克拉夫特启发的克苏鲁风解谜冒险游戏。玩家登上一座神秘小岛四处探索，破解一个个环环相扣、如同连续密室逃脱般的谜题，从散落的笔记与日志中拼凑真相，同时努力守住自己的理智。虽然提示偏少，偶尔容易卡关，但是阴郁诡谲的氛围营造出色，谜题巧妙多样，美术风格颇具辨识度，还支持完整手柄操作。推荐给喜欢克苏鲁题材与烧脑解谜的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Tarnish Online
coveredGames.title: 《Tarnish Online》是一款没有传统等级的动作MMORPG，目前处于抢先体验阶段。玩家不靠自动攻击，而是磨练武器技巧，与忠诚的伙伴并肩作战，在持久世界中走出自己的道路，强调操作技术而非在线时长，也承诺不做付费变强。虽然现阶段内容较少，性能与操作手感还需打磨，但是以技术为核心的设计思路颇具特色。推荐给喜欢硬核动作战斗、愿意陪伴早期MMO成长的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Feed The Vessel
coveredGames.title: 《Feed The Vessel》是一款黑暗科幻题材的短篇主动增量游戏。玩家在飞船上于培养槽中培育克隆体，将其喂给神秘实体，或屠宰焚烧换取血肉与灵液，升级舰上各站点、打造守卫者，最终在航程尽头与实体决战。虽然流程偏短、内容略显单薄，但是诡异猎奇的氛围与独特美术令人印象深刻，碎片化的档案引人拼凑世界观，支持纯鼠标操作与随时存档。推荐给喜欢增量游戏与猎奇黑暗科幻的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Pocket Legend : Inventory Roguelike Deckbuilder
coveredGames.title: 《口袋传奇》是一款融合背包整理的肉鸽卡牌构筑游戏。玩家扮演穿越到传奇武器世界的英雄，在背包格子中巧妙摆放道具与卡牌，应对攻击方式各异的敌人，组合出强力连锁效果，揭开卢门西亚黑暗势力的命运。虽然卡牌说明略显晦涩、部分难度起伏较大，但是摆放触发效果的策略感十足，手绘画风可爱精致，配乐动听，还支持完整手柄操作与云存档。推荐给喜欢卡牌构筑与背包管理玩法的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Eternity Lost: Mystery of Aurum Collector's Edition
coveredGames.title: 《Eternity Lost: Mystery of Aurum Collector's Edition》是一款寻物解谜冒险游戏。玩家跟随一位神秘少女，深入炼金术士秘密教团数百年前建造的地下古城，搜寻线索与道具，破解谜题和小游戏，揭开一场危险阴谋。画面精致，配音出色，剧情引人入胜，谜题难度适中，还支持可调难度、随时存档与纯鼠标操作。推荐给喜欢寻物解谜与奇幻冒险的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Fuck the Ocean
coveredGames.title: 《♥♥♥♥ the Ocean》是一款荒诞幽默的休闲放置增量游戏。只因一只袜子被打湿，主角便决定用沙子、花园小矮人和越来越离谱的机械，把水坑、湖泊乃至整片海洋统统填平。虽然每关重置升级，后期重复感略重，但是无厘头的剧情与俏皮的提示文字令人发笑，画风可爱，音效解压，价格也十分亲民，轻松上手。推荐给喜欢放置挂机与搞怪幽默的玩家～

coveredGames.name: PEGTURE: Peg Solitaire Roguelike
coveredGames.title: 《PEGTURE: Peg Solitaire Roguelike》是一款以孔明棋为主题的肉鸽卡组构筑游戏。玩家构筑卡组、强化棋子，在棋盘上跳子消除，打出连锁组合，击败头目，冲击最高分。经典益智玩法与构筑思路结合得颇为巧妙，棋子协同搭配丰富，每局变化多样，循环十分上头，画风舒适、配乐悦耳，价格也亲民，支持纯鼠标操作与随时存档。推荐给喜欢肉鸽构筑与休闲益智的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Mess in the Toy Shop
coveredGames.title: 《Mess in the Toy Shop》是一款轻松解压的整理模拟游戏。玩家面对一间乱糟糟的玩具店，把散落各处的玩具一件件放回货架，让它们各归其位，并解锁新技能、提升整理效率，把店铺收拾得井井有条。虽然优化还有提升空间，但是玩具种类丰富，画面精致，整理过程顺手又治愈，藏在店里的金色小雕像也颇有寻找乐趣，可按自己的节奏慢慢收拾，价格亲民。推荐给喜欢整理收纳与休闲解压的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Phantom Shapes
coveredGames.title: 《Phantom Shapes》是一款支持2至7人联机的恐怖派对游戏。一名玩家扮演幽灵，把被诅咒的形状伪装成普通物件藏在地图中并加以守护；最多六名工人四处搜寻，争论哪件东西是假的，赶在全员被抓前确认真相。非对称对抗与嘴炮推理相结合，紧张又欢乐，没有内购，辅助功能也很完善。推荐给喜欢和朋友开黑、非对称恐怖与推理派对游戏的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Cricket Club President
coveredGames.title: 《Cricket Club President》是一款板球俱乐部经营模拟游戏。玩家化身地方板球俱乐部主席，安抚队长与委员会，拉赞助、雇员工，协调球员的本职工作与训练，在拮据预算下升级设施，最终在年度大会上赢得会员投票连任。虽然文字量较大，但是队内人事与委员会压力的博弈颇为真实，一个赛季节奏紧凑不拖沓，开发者也很积极。推荐给喜欢体育经营与策略模拟的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Automon Arena
coveredGames.title: 《Automon Arena》是一款节奏明快的肉鸽怪物收集策略游戏。玩家用垃圾袋捕捉各式生物、组建队伍、收集徽章，在自动战斗中挑战其他玩家的阵容，击败玩家冠军夺下王座，还有大逃杀式对战与冒险模式可选。虽然仍处于抢先体验阶段，界面和平衡还在打磨，但是画风可爱，文本幽默搞笑，玩法轻快上手，价格亲民，开发者更新也很积极。推荐给喜欢怪物收集与自动战斗的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Just Kukuruza
coveredGames.title: 《Just Kukuruza》是一款以剥玉米为主题的休闲模拟游戏。玩家面对一座由一百万根玉米堆成的大山，从手工剥玉米起步，雇佣工人、搭建自动化生产线，出售玉米、寻找隐藏收藏品，向排行榜发起冲击。虽然前期略显重复，打磨还有提升空间，但是题材荒诞有趣，物理反馈解压，操作简单易上手，从手工到流水线的成长过程轻松惬意。推荐给喜欢自动化经营与轻松模拟小品的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Airline Legacy
coveredGames.title: 《Airline Legacy》是一款借鉴《足球经理》思路的回合制航空公司经营模拟游戏。玩家受聘出任CEO，向董事会负责，规划通往上千座城市的航线，调配机队与时刻，与对手高管一较高下，也可在历史模式中自由沙盒经营。虽然尚处抢先体验，经济系统还有打磨空间，但是真实机型丰富，界面清爽易上手，按月推进的节奏张弛有度，颇有经典航空经营游戏的味道。推荐给喜欢航空题材与策略经营的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Text Dungeon: The Ring of Life
coveredGames.title: 《Text Dungeon: The Ring of Life》是一款纯文字呈现的复古肉鸽RPG。没有画面与地图，玩家在不断变化的迷宫中探险，从巫师Shingor手中夺回生命之戒，经典的文字提示与叙事场景颇有MUD和游戏书的味道，死亡即永久。虽然操作与菜单略显繁琐，但是地牢冒险紧张硬核，鉴定道具与搜刮战利品充满惊喜，每局都有新发现。推荐给喜欢传统肉鸽与文字冒险的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Axiomatik
coveredGames.title: 《Axiomatik》是一款霓虹风格的VR街机平台跳跃游戏。玩家化身电量不断流失的机器人与时间赛跑，在黑暗中射出发光激光照亮道路，穿越量子传送门，打开薛定谔之箱收集小猫。虽然后期难度上升、偶尔容易迷路，但是独特的霓虹美术与音效出彩，激光弹射的射击手感干脆，对VR空间的运用很用心，短时间游玩也很尽兴。推荐给喜欢VR动作与街机闯关的玩家～

coveredGames.name: DEPTH STRIKE
coveredGames.title: 《DEPTH STRIKE》是一款在经典海战棋基础上加入战术变化的策略游戏。每回合结束后舰船都会重新调整位置，玩家要预判敌舰走向、封锁逃跑路线，再抓准时机发动攻击，还能借助布雷、导弹打击等特殊能力扭转战局。虽然内容量略显单薄，但是熟悉的规则加上移动机制带来了更多推理与博弈的乐趣，上手简单，价格也算亲民。推荐给喜欢海战棋与回合策略的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Space Will
coveredGames.title: 《星际意志》是一款双摇杆射击的生存肉鸽游戏。玩家在科幻星际中探索，从六十种基础核心出发，搭配数百种基站设备与数千枚芯片，自由组装出最强战舰，抵御一波波敌人。虽然数值平衡还有打磨空间，但是构筑组合极其丰富，射击手感爽快，幸存者式的节奏紧凑上头，还支持排行榜与云存档，价格也很亲民。推荐给喜欢幸存者类肉鸽与战舰构筑的玩家～

coveredGames.name: INTERNET4
coveredGames.title: 《インターネット4》是一款多人共享浏览器的休闲社交游戏，目前处于抢先体验阶段。最多8名玩家可以共同操控同一个浏览器，把互联网变成大家的游乐场：一起看视频和直播，分屏各自冲浪，或者合作涂鸦，还能玩基于维基百科的小游戏，累了就去钓钓鱼放松一下。创意新奇，支持联机合作与对战、成就和排行榜。推荐给喜欢和朋友线上一起闲逛、轻松互动的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Mirrorbane
coveredGames.title: 《Mirrorbane》是一款暗黑奇幻题材的战术肉鸽卡组构筑游戏。玩家招募各具特色的英雄，把他们的卡牌合并成同一副卡组，在一次次远征中迎战强敌，回到城镇时还能培养队伍、规划成长。氛围感十足的像素画风与英雄组合带来的流派搭配颇具看点，除单人游玩外还支持线上合作、PvP对战与跨平台联机。推荐给喜欢暗黑奇幻、战术卡牌与肉鸽构筑的玩家～

coveredGames.name: WhoIsHe
coveredGames.title: 《WhoIsHe》是一款超现实风格的点击式密室逃脱解谜游戏。被绑架七年的亨利·格拉奇浑身是血地归来，却失去了全部记忆，玩家要破解晦涩的谜题、搜寻隐藏物品，一步步揭开黑暗的真相。故事诡异而引人入胜，转折不断，氛围浓郁的画风与配乐相得益彰，谜题颇具挑战，解开后成就感满满，还支持可调难度与随时存档。推荐给喜欢悬疑剧情与烧脑解谜的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Draft to Legion
coveredGames.title: 《筑牌成军》是一款回合制卡牌构筑结合实时自动战斗的策略游戏。玩家在营地招募并部署卡牌组建军队，每轮选择不同路线，迎战各异的敌人并收集战利品。虽然战役难度偏高、卡牌随机性较强，但是构筑与自动战斗的循环上手容易，卡牌羁绊搭配颇有酒馆战棋的味道，像素画风讨喜，开发者也积极听取反馈更新，还支持可调难度与随时存档。推荐给喜欢卡牌构筑与自走棋玩法的玩家～

coveredGames.name: VRLF - Virtual Reality Lightgun Framework
coveredGames.title: 《VRLF》是一款让玩家在VR中畅玩光枪游戏的框架工具。它能把经典街机与现代光枪游戏搬进VR，手持控制器精准瞄准，还原特色换弹动作，并支持创意工坊模组与在线合作。虽然初次设置略显复杂，部分游戏还需额外调试，但是射击手感贴近街机，兼容范围广，自定义选项丰富，价格也很亲民。推荐给怀念街机光枪射击、拥有VR设备的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Paint the Town
coveredGames.title: 《Paint the Town》是一款第一人称休闲增量模拟游戏。某天清晨小镇的颜色全部消失，玩家拿起画笔，为房屋、汽车、树木和高塔重新上色，让灰暗的城市再次焕发光彩。从一把小刷子升级到油漆大炮，近五十万平方米的区域等待涂满，节奏舒缓、成就感十足，还支持随时存档、云存档与镜头舒适选项。推荐给喜欢解压涂装与增量升级的玩家～

coveredGames.name: STARCULT Night Twisted Age
coveredGames.title: 《STARCULT Night Twisted Age》是一款以黑暗奇幻为背景的角色扮演模拟游戏。玩家被众人怀疑犯下谋杀，索性化身众人眼中的反派女主，创立或加入邪教，借助“情绪调色盘”操纵人心，享受权力与片刻安宁，直到更大的麻烦接踵而至。故事触及死亡与道德等哲学议题，成人与暴力内容需玩家主动选择才会出现，还支持随时存档与纯鼠标操作。推荐给喜欢黑暗剧情与权谋角色扮演的成年玩家～

coveredGames.name: Iron Dawn
coveredGames.title: 《Iron Dawn》是一款战术机甲射击游戏。玩家化身雇佣兵驾驶毁灭性战争机器，挑选合同、自定义武器配装，投入可完全破坏的战场，完成任务后带着酬劳撤离。赚取报酬升级军火库，挑战愈发危险的任务，成长循环清晰明确，场景破坏颇具爽快感，部分支持手柄。推荐给喜欢机甲题材、战术射击与搜打撤玩法的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Infinite Loop: Incremental
coveredGames.title: 《无限轮回：增量》是一款极简纯文字风格的放置增量游戏。玩家要在严格的时间限制内精心排列行动队列，规划每一步的先后；死亡在所难免，但每次轮回都会让你变得更强，再逐步搭建自动化流程，最终打破无限循环。玩法专注时间管理与策略规划，可按自己的节奏慢慢推进，还支持纯鼠标操作、随时存档与云存档。推荐给喜欢放置增量、文字游戏与策略规划的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Me and You
coveredGames.title: 《Me and You》是一款受《Baba Is You》启发的双人合作解谜游戏。玩家与同伴携手，通过组合文字来创造、改变乃至打破每一关的规则，共同找到通关之路。手绘画风温馨可爱，文字规则谜题巧思不断，豁然开朗的时刻接连出现，难度曲线循序渐进，还支持本地同屏与线上合作、完整手柄操作和成就。推荐给喜欢规则解谜、想和朋友或伴侣一起动脑的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Spinful
coveredGames.title: 《转福传》是一款奇幻题材的肉鸽老虎机构筑游戏。玩家在每次转动之间升级、强化并自定义自己的老虎机，把它打造成强力的战斗机器，在一局局闯关中构筑流派。转轴之间的策略取舍颇有深度，自动旋转适合挂着轻松游玩，画风讨喜，配乐洗脑上头，战斗节奏悠闲，还支持纯鼠标操作、随时存档与成就。推荐给喜欢肉鸽构筑与老虎机玩法的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Monster Girls Survival & Craft 2040
coveredGames.title: 《Monster Girls Survival & Craft 2040》是一款融合沙盒建造与生存的怪物娘收集游戏。2040年，城市被异世界吞噬，玩家可随处挖掘，建起小屋乃至城堡要塞，捕获荒野中的怪物娘，让她们并肩战斗、劳作与生活；每到第七夜敌群来袭，需筑墙设陷阱坚守到天亮。虽然抢先体验阶段打磨还有提升空间，但是建造、生存与收集结合有趣。推荐给喜欢沙盒建造与怪物娘题材的玩家～

coveredGames.name: NARI: Threads of Dawn
coveredGames.title: 《NARI: Threads of Dawn》是一款取材自韩国民间传说的2D动作游戏。玩家要在最后一刻闪避来破解首领的架势，再挥舞飘逸长袖展开反击。六个关卡各以两阶段首领战收尾，三条舞蹈流派可供成长，还有首领连战与无尽仪式模式。以舞入武的设定别具一格，支持纯键盘操作与云存档。推荐给喜欢韩国民俗题材、钻研首领战与精准闪避的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Tiny Ring Defense
coveredGames.title: 《Tiny Ring Defense》是一款可以挂在桌面角落的放置塔防游戏。怪物沿着棋盘外的环形路线绕圈前进，像素英雄会自动迎战，玩家只需召唤、合成并升级英雄，锻造武器，按自己的节奏推进十个世界。虽然后期强化与抽取的养成节奏略显吃力，但是机制简单易懂，像素角色可爱，工作时挂着也不打扰，轻松又有成长感。推荐给喜欢放置挂机与休闲塔防的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Neon Breaker: Endless Arcade
coveredGames.title: 《Neon Breaker: Endless Arcade》是一款双摇杆街机射击游戏。玩家在首尾相连的循环战场中击溃一波波升级的敌舰，灵活闪避、打出连杀，合成强化道具，挑战20位各具特色的头目。经典模式冲击高分，异常模式以肉鸽形式叠加高风险高回报的变异。节奏紧凑爽快，复古感与配乐带劲，操作顺滑，支持单人及本地、在线合作。推荐给喜欢街机射击与刷分挑战的玩家～

coveredGames.name: Rewind 99
coveredGames.title: Rewind 99 is a quirky 90s video store sim where you stock VHS tapes by day and run shady side hustles by night. Fun, chaotic gameplay, though co-op is temporarily disabled

coveredGames.name: Express Rider Simulator
coveredGames.title: An immersive indie delivery sim where you ride a bike, manage rent and fuel, and avoid fines. You can livestream to gain followers and upgrade your motorcycle.

coveredGames.name: BlazBlue Entropy Effect
coveredGames.title: Dynamic 2D cyberpunk roguelite. Features satisfying combat combos, responsive controls, diverse fighters, and deep skill customization. Short, fast, and highly replayable

coveredGames.name: Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos
coveredGames.title: A goofy, co-op simulation game where you use magic and absurd tools to clean massive messes with friends while talking to cats. It is fun, chaotic, and totally weird

coveredGames.name: Flesh Made Fear
coveredGames.title: Pure 90s survival horror! Like classic Resident Evil with fixed cameras, puzzles, and low ammo. Pick Natalie or Jack to survive a creepy lab. Total nostalgia trip for retro fans!

coveredGames.name: Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths
coveredGames.title: Fix trucks and survive the wilderness. A great mix of mechanical simulation and off-road driving. Manage resources, repair parts, and conquer tough paths. A challenging, immersive experience!

coveredGames.name: Beer Manufacture Simulator
coveredGames.title: Feel like you're running a beer empire. Start with a mini brewery and create your own beer using your own unique recipe. Start on your own, then upgrade to automated systems and relax

coveredGames.name: Two Dollar Suits
coveredGames.title: A very dynamic and action-packed top-down game where you have to explore the world, go through challenging levels using various weapons and skills, and use different solutions to the level puzzles

coveredGames.name: Sengodai
coveredGames.title: A tactical roguelike with deck-building, you can play through the campaign or in a randomly generated world. Different gods with their unique playstyles and abilities, various elements, and spells

coveredGames.name: Devil Jam
coveredGames.title: A fun and action-packed vampire survival game. An engaging and flexible build system that requires careful consideration of item placement and synergies. You'll be challenged to defy death itself

coveredGames.name: Capote
coveredGames.title: A fun multiplayer card game.Fun games with friends where you can troll your friends with different cards,and each game is completely unpredictable.The characters are also very colorful and charismatic

coveredGames.name: Roulette Hero
coveredGames.title: A fun and unique roguelike with roulette elements, where you collect animal companions to strengthen your deck and defeat powerful bosses. You can also create your own mods in the Steam Workshop

coveredGames.name: Restaurant Owner: A Restaurant Simulator
coveredGames.title: A great restaurant and business simulator. Become the owner of your own restaurant, serve customers, create your own menu, hire staff, and improve and grow your restaurant business.

coveredGames.name: Candy Shop Simulator: Sweet Start
coveredGames.title: A game in which you will take on the role of a pastry shop manager. Your own pastries, candies, chocolate and much more. Manage stocks and marketing, increase profits and expand your business

coveredGames.name: Lost in Random: The Eternal Die
coveredGames.title: A dynamic roguelike where much depends on the roll of the dice. The game combines dynamic action and tactical battles, has four types of weapons and many powerful abilities

coveredGames.name: SILENT HILL: Townfall
coveredGames.title: Stealth takes priority over fighting, and the pocket CRTV makes tracking monsters feel like solving a risky puzzle. Strong sound design and a layered story carry this unsettling trip!

coveredGames.name: Finding Ruby: Hidden Object Adventure
coveredGames.title: Finding hidden details feels oddly rewarding, with each scene offering another clever little challenge. A cozy treasure hunt that makes sharp eyes feel like a genuine superpower.

coveredGames.name: Frontier: Path of Shadows
coveredGames.title: Uncharted planets and uneasy alliances frame a tactical journey through a fractured galaxy. Squad development, branching dialogue and turn-based combat make every expedition count.

coveredGames.name: Amigo: Kebab Simulator
coveredGames.title: Running a kebab joint becomes a wonderfully scrappy hustle of grilling, serving and keeping customers happy. The charm lies in building a late-night food spot where every shift brings fresh chaos.

coveredGames.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
coveredGames.title: The whip is an absolute joy to wield, turning every fight and leap into a fluid, ferocious dance. Gothic horrors, clever secrets, razor-sharp combat make this a triumphant return for Belmont's legacy.

coveredGames.name: THANKS, LIGHT.
coveredGames.title: Somewhere between Portal and Viewfinder, this mind-bending puzzler reshapes reality with a beam of light. Flatten objects, restore their volume and outwit an increasingly unhinged architect.

coveredGames.name: Fatal Train
coveredGames.title: A murder mystery on rails spirals into absurd chaos as fires, killer birds and freak weather threaten the investigation. A darkly comic co-op romp where solving the case is only half the battle.

coveredGames.name: Duelist: Idle Expedition
coveredGames.title: A pocket-sized JRPG that keeps growing while you work. Recruit pixel-art heroes, forge clever team synergies and turn idle battles into a steady climb toward continental supremacy.

coveredGames.name: Big Walk
coveredGames.title: Somewhere between a walking adventure and a shared playground, this finds a rare multiplayer rhythm. Exploration, puzzles and quiet moments all matter, and none of them need a timer to work.

coveredGames.name: Deadline Savior
coveredGames.title: Deadlines become a strange survival mechanic as every decision burns precious time. Juggling work, money and unexpected problems gives the daily grind enough unpredictability to keep pushing forward.

coveredGames.name: Moo Who?
coveredGames.title: A curious little cow turns a peaceful farm into a playground of mischief, exploration and odd surprises. Its gentle pace and playful interactions make the countryside hard to leave behind.

coveredGames.name: Italian Pizza Simulator
coveredGames.title: From kneading dough to firing the oven, every pizza becomes a small craft project. Balancing orders, ingredients and impatient customers gives the kitchen a lively rhythm without the grind.

coveredGames.name: Vacation Cafe Simulator
coveredGames.title: Running a seaside café feels wonderfully unhurried, from serving guests to decorating the space and enjoying the view. It captures that rare holiday feeling where even routine work feels delightful.

coveredGames.name: Museologist: Tidy Up the Museum!
coveredGames.title: From chaotic rubble to pristine exhibits, every restored artifact visibly transforms the museum. Matching fragments, planning the workspace and uncovering history make for a quietly rewarding loop.

coveredGames.name: Mineral Mining Simulator
coveredGames.title: Watching ore travel from extraction to processing and finally into a sellable product is deeply satisfying. The growing machine network rewards patience, planning and experimentation throughout.

coveredGames.name: Police Chief Simulator
coveredGames.title: Running a shabby precinct into a functioning police force has its own rhythm: investigate cases, recruit staff and expand your reach across Winston Springs.

coveredGames.name: Wild West Miner Simulator
coveredGames.title: Starting with a tent in the middle of nowhere, you dig for riches while turning a forgotten outpost into a thriving frontier town. Mining, oil, trade and railways make every upgrade feel earned.

coveredGames.name: Nicotine Merchant Simulator™
coveredGames.title: Starting with improvised gear makes every early sale feel earned, then the shop gradually turns into a humming nicotine empire. Packing, stocking and automation create a satisfying business rhythm.

coveredGames.name: 日本事故物件監視協会3 -Japan Stigmatized Property-
coveredGames.title: Every shift starts calmly, then a chair moves, a figure appears, or the feed misbehaves. The simple surveillance loop becomes a horror game built on doubt, patience, and careful observation.

coveredGames.name: Life Below
coveredGames.title: Dive into a unique city builder where you revive ocean life instead of cities. Expand coral habitats, guide marine species, and restore balance to a fragile underwater world.

coveredGames.name: Echoes of Elysium
coveredGames.title: Crew up and conquer the skies in a co-op survival RPG. Design your airship, craft gear, and face dangerous enemies across a mysterious world of floating islands.

coveredGames.name: Arctic Shift: Fuel Station
coveredGames.title: Keep a lonely fuel station alive in the harsh Arctic. Manage supplies, fuel vehicles, and explore icy lands while facing blizzards, power failures, and isolation.

coveredGames.name: Layer Land
coveredGames.title: Travel across diverse biomes inspired by real geography. Tame creatures, gather resources, and build your base while surviving and exploring in this multiplayer sandbox RPG.

coveredGames.name: ChromaGun 2: Dye Hard
coveredGames.title: Use a color shooting tool to attract objects and manipulate puzzles in a surreal test facility. Mix hues, outsmart hazards, and explore a humorous sci fi story across mind bending levels.

coveredGames.name: Corner Shop: NightShift
coveredGames.title: A quiet job turns unsettling as strange events disrupt your shift. Manage the store, handle customers, and keep your sanity while paranoia and hidden truths slowly surface.

coveredGames.name: Dark Light: Survivor
coveredGames.title: Swap perspectives and battle endless enemies across deadly biomes. Collect weapons, upgrade skills, and push deeper into chaos in this fast paced sci fi action roguelike.

coveredGames.name: Parking Tycoon 2: Business Simulator
coveredGames.title: Turn an empty plot into a thriving parking business with full control over layout and staff. Install security, optimize profits, and personally stop criminals in this hybrid simulator.

coveredGames.name: Blood Money: Lethal Eden
coveredGames.title: Lured by love and captured in a cruel underworld, you face greed, fear, and temptation. Every decision leads to life, death, or betrayal in this cinematic interactive story.

coveredGames.name: Island of Hearts
coveredGames.title: A first person FMV romance where every decision matters. Build relationships, explore story paths, and experience awkward, heartfelt, and chaotic moments on a sunlit island.

coveredGames.name: Eclipse - 2nd Dawn for the Galaxy
coveredGames.title: Command one of several factions in a galaxy on the brink of war. Build fleets, forge alliances, and outmaneuver rivals in this tactical 4X board game adaptation.

coveredGames.name: Room Craft
coveredGames.title: Create unique interiors by planning layouts and refining every detail. Flexible building tools, free placement, and rich customization let you shape rooms that match your style perfectly.

coveredGames.name: Ultimate Guess Game
coveredGames.title: Challenge a friend in a fast paced guessing duel where every question counts. Ask smart yes or no questions, narrow down clues, and be the first to reveal the mystery image.

coveredGames.name: Drive Together
coveredGames.title: One car, several people fighting for control, and suddenly a simple corner becomes a full team meeting. The shared controls create wonderfully chaotic moments when everyone has a different idea.

coveredGames.name: AI Desktop Pet
coveredGames.title: Turn your desktop into a living space with an AI pet that talks, observes, and evolves. Voice chat, visual novel scenes, and roleplay blend into a dynamic and personal companion.

coveredGames.name: Cornucopia®
coveredGames.title: Farm, explore, and fall in love in a charming world full of secrets. Breed magical animals, grow powerful crops, and dive into dungeons in this cozy yet feature rich RPG.

coveredGames.name: Silver Blade of Gods' End
coveredGames.title: Command your army in a conflict driven world where choices matter. Mix fast tactical combat with strategic planning as relationships and decisions shape multiple story outcomes.

coveredGames.name: Kingdom Loop
coveredGames.title: Build your kingdom with cards while facing ever growing threats. Balance economy, recruit units, and master tactical turn based combat in this challenging roguelike loop.

coveredGames.name: Lunarium
coveredGames.title: Bosses are where the combat truly shines, demanding patience, parries and well-timed dodges without becoming punishing for the sake of it. Lune’s magic adds welcome tactical depth to every clash.

coveredGames.name: Hacker's Journey
coveredGames.title: A puzzle-driven hacking adventure where commands and lateral thinking open the way forward. Each solved challenge feels earned, with the mystery gradually revealing more beneath its digital surface.

coveredGames.name: Dig, Dig, Die
coveredGames.title: Digging deeper reveals a roguelite loop where upgrades, random events and destructible terrain keep reshaping each run. The mix of mining, combat and build tinkering gives every descent a fresh angle.

coveredGames.name: Car Flipper
coveredGames.title: Visual repairs make an enormous difference here. Taking an abandoned wreck covered in dents, swapping bumpers and spraying a glossy finish yields rewarding transformations every single time.

coveredGames.name: Takeover 2
coveredGames.title: Fans of retro beat'm'up titles like streets of rage will surely love and enjoy "Takeover 2".

coveredGames.name: Cozy~Fishing Kitten
coveredGames.title: The soothing sounds, pastel aesthetics and cute character customization options make it an absolute pleasure to keep open while doing daily tasks.

coveredGames.name: Veyora
coveredGames.title: The animal breeding and farming mechanics are fun. Milking cows, collecting eggs and managing field rotations provide a soothing routine.

coveredGames.name: Calvar - The Darkest Gate
coveredGames.title: Calvar - The Darkest Gate keeps the tension while pushing you deeper into the dark history of the asylum and its victims.

coveredGames.name: AMPANIC
coveredGames.title: Everything about this game is tailored for pure engagement. The zero-downtime philosophy means you are active from the first second to the last.

coveredGames.name: The Little Land
coveredGames.title: The Little Land brings personality to survival strategy without losing sight of its protective central role.

coveredGames.name: Escape from Vlogger: Runaway
coveredGames.title: The vlogger themed mystery is an entertaining framework for an adventure built around escaping a dangerous home. For fans of item based puzzles, this is an inviting concept.

coveredGames.name: Coal Duty
coveredGames.title: The combination of a shop, workshop and ongoing progression gives Coal Duty’s a cool appeal.

coveredGames.name: Loop Dungeon - Incremental
coveredGames.title: Gathering resources, upgrading heroes, and progressing through dungeon levels creates an inviting structure for a shorter RPG adventure.

coveredGames.name: CELESTAY Craft & Slowlife
coveredGames.title: CELESTAY Craft&Slowlife provides something pleasant to check throughout the day without constantly demanding attention.

coveredGames.name: Tasty Chef
coveredGames.title: It' cool that management matters without overwhelming the experience. Ordering ingredients, organizing storage, and keeping stations supplied adds meaningful strategy to the cheerful cooking gameplay.

coveredGames.name: Distant Memoraĵo
coveredGames.title: An understated gem that trusts the player to read emotions in faces and pauses. It’s a reflective, humane portrait of how we hold onto one another.

coveredGames.name: Digimon Story Time Stranger
coveredGames.title: A love letter to classic Digimon fans, this title nails the mixture of nostalgia and fresh mechanics. Digimon Story Time Stranger blends time-travel intrigue with tight turn-based battles.

coveredGames.name: Sona-Nyl of the Violet Shadows Refrain
coveredGames.title: The art direction and soundtrack perfectly complement the immersive, dreamlike atmosphere. Great narrative experience with rich dialogue and surprising emotional resonance.

coveredGames.name: WE ARE FOOTBALL 2027
coveredGames.title: WE ARE FOOTBALL 2027 makes the scale of football management exciting without making the basics intimidating.

coveredGames.name: Breathedge 2
coveredGames.title: Survival mechanics remain engaging without overshadowing the adventure. Managing oxygen, temperature, resources, and equipment adds tension to exploration.

coveredGames.name: Bokuten - Why I Became an Angel
coveredGames.title: The consequences of your choices "Bokuten - Why I Became an Angel" are heavy. It’s a beautiful exploration of the human heart and the many different forms love takes.

coveredGames.name: Lady Death Demonicron
coveredGames.title: Lady Death Demonicron offers energetic battles, memorable visual design, and a suitably dramatic journey through its dangerous infernal world.

coveredGames.name: Wanting Wings
coveredGames.title: Welcoming art, gentle humor, and heartfelt conversations make Wanting Wings feel like a comforting, uplifting escape from everyday life.

coveredGames.name: The Dream Office
coveredGames.title: The combination of familiarity and imagination makes it an attractive pick for relaxed, creative simulation fans.

coveredGames.name: Echoes of Mystralia
coveredGames.title: Spellcrafting provides an impressive amount of freedom, letting players shape combat around personal preferences.

coveredGames.name: Da Capo 3 R
coveredGames.title: Its mix of comedy, romance, and fantasy keeps the narrative varied across many hours. Da Capo 3 R consistently finds new ways to develop its central cast and setting.

coveredGames.name: Detective Hayseed - Hollywood
coveredGames.title: Detective Hayseed: Hollywood makes solving clues feel like a fun, breezy cross between a movie parody and a real mystery.

coveredGames.name: Cannon Clicker
coveredGames.title: Combining frontline troops, ranged support, armored vehicles, and aircraft encourages thoughtful and flexible planning.

coveredGames.name: SWAT Commander
coveredGames.title: SWAT Commander creates a strong cinematic atmosphere. The careful room clearing, tense silence, and sudden action moments make missions memorable and genuinely engaging.

coveredGames.name: Mandate Order
coveredGames.title: Mandate Order's Hundred Schools advisor system adds welcome variety and encourages creative approaches to every campaign. I really appreciate how logistics connects every part of the experience.

coveredGames.name: Evil School
coveredGames.title: Evil School delivers a gripping FMV thriller with cinematic performances and a relentlessly tense mystery.

coveredGames.name: Express Rider Simulator
coveredGames.title: Racing against deadlines, locating addresses, managing expenses, and avoiding speed cameras create an engaging daily routine.

coveredGames.name: Dal Segno
coveredGames.title: Dal Segno character designs are charming, and the everlasting summer theme makes for a truly relaxing and heartwarming experience.

coveredGames.name: PatriotMemoirs
coveredGames.title: Effective mix of suspense, emotion, and player agency. The story is easy to become invested in, while its multiple conclusions reward thoughtful experimentation.

coveredGames.name: Dark Light: Survivor
coveredGames.title: Dark Light: Survivor delivers a gripping roguelike experience with tight combat, stylish visuals, and a surprisingly deep progression system that keeps you coming back.

coveredGames.name: Detective Hayseed - The Cloning Madness
coveredGames.title: Detective Hayseed - The Cloning Madness protagonist’s quirks are endearing, and the supporting cast brings energy to every scene.

coveredGames.name: Zoo Protocol
coveredGames.title: Zoo Protocol’s science-fiction setting creates an appealing mixture of isolation and discovery.

coveredGames.name: Laundering Simulator - Clean Cash and Laundry
coveredGames.title: The game never takes itself too seriously, and Eddie’s chaotic operation makes every day feel entertaining.

coveredGames.name: Rose Guns Days -Season 2-
coveredGames.title: Compelling visual novel experience, combining striking artwork, an atmospheric alternate-history setting, memorable characters, and a dramatic mystery that steadily draws readers deeper.

coveredGames.name: Stellar Warfare
coveredGames.title: Stellar Warfare delivers a satisfying blend of classic real-time strategy, base building, and flexible fleet design.

coveredGames.name: Castleborne Survivors
coveredGames.title: This is a promising Early Access game with a strong foundation. The combat is easy to understand, the upgrades are fun, and the replay value is already noticeable.

coveredGames.name: Mistfall Hunter
coveredGames.title: Experimenting with different builds keeps the gameplay fresh, and the third-person combat fits the dangerous fantasy world perfectly.

coveredGames.name: Neko Station
coveredGames.title: This is a delightful desktop companion game. It quietly runs while you work, then rewards you with cute cats, new furniture, and tiny moments of joy.

coveredGames.name: No Asteroids
coveredGames.title: The gameplay loop of managing oxygen, gathering ore, and buying automated ship cannons creates a perfect, relaxing balance of pressure and fun.

coveredGames.name: Gas N Cars
coveredGames.title: Fun and engaging job simulator with a chaotic twist~ Catching wanted drivers, repairing damaged vehicles, and experimenting with weird gadgets makes every shift uniquely thrilling.

coveredGames.name: Veterum
coveredGames.title: A highly polished early-access strategy that already delivers hours of tactical enjoyment.

coveredGames.name: AMPANIC
coveredGames.title: AMPANIC is a great example how a simple gameplay formula can be pretty addictive and engaging.

coveredGames.name: Bruisers 2D Boxing
coveredGames.title: Bruisers 2D Boxing combines charming pixel art with an impressively detailed approach to boxing.

coveredGames.name: Breathedge 2
coveredGames.title: Ruined settlements, abandoned stations, discarded equipment, and unfortunate astronauts suggest events beyond the main narrative, making the surrounding world feel mysterious.

coveredGames.name: Dread Admiral
coveredGames.title: Dread Admiral appears perfect for players who enjoy difficult decisions. Choosing whether to gather more resources, complete objectives, or retreat should make campaign more intense.

coveredGames.name: Silly Suspects
coveredGames.title: The visual concept is expressive. A world full of wandering, dancing, arguing oddballs gives each investigation personality before a single clue is examined or suspect questioned.

coveredGames.name: Ascend
coveredGames.title: The relaxed pacing gives players room to appreciate each puzzle’s design. Rather than rushing forward, Ascend invites scenic exploration and deeper engagement with its mythology.

coveredGames.name: Orbital
coveredGames.title: Orbital offers a direct challenge: endure for as long as possible. That simplicity allows the inventive planetary abilities, dynamic hazards, and satisfying progression systems to shine.

coveredGames.name: The Horde of Gorak
coveredGames.title: The Horde of Gorak has all the ingredients of an addictive incremental strategy game: steady upgrades, permanent progression, resource management, varied units, destructive magic and fun gameplay.

coveredGames.name: Slum Z
coveredGames.title: Slum Z makes the adventure appealing through a combination of weapon variety, persistent improvements, and resource hunting.

coveredGames.name: The Dream Office
coveredGames.title: Office-themed simulations can be deeply satisfying when they emphasize growth, organization, and personal choices.

coveredGames.name: Nerd Simulator
coveredGames.title: Nerd Simulator is an entertaining celebration of chaotic adulthood, unusual responsibilities, and gradual self-improvement.

coveredGames.name: Echoes of Mystralia
coveredGames.title: The evolving world map is a great roguelite feature. Seeing locations change over time creates a welcome sense of progress, even when starting another challenging journey.

coveredGames.name: Vacation Cafe Simulator
coveredGames.title: Vacation Cafe Simulator blends cozy restaurant management with the charm of an Italian holiday.

coveredGames.name: Last Drop
coveredGames.title: Last Drop cinematic presentation, retro style, and unconventional protagonist make this sandbox feel fun and different.

coveredGames.name: Express Rider Simulator
coveredGames.title: The mix of riding, delivery work, and financial management gives every trip real stakes.

coveredGames.name: Laundering Simulator - Clean Cash and Laundry
coveredGames.title: Laundering Simulator is full of charm. From customer interactions to business upgrades, every part feels designed to keep the player busy and amused.

coveredGames.name: SWAT Commander
coveredGames.title: I enjoy the realistic tactical atmosphere in SWAT Commander. The game encourages careful movement, smart loadout choices, and precise teamwork instead of simple run-and-gun action.

coveredGames.name: Stellar Warfare
coveredGames.title: With numerous ship frames, weapons, and modules, Stellar Warfare provides exceptional room for experimentation.

coveredGames.name: Ultra Maze
coveredGames.title: Ultra Maze remains easy to understand while offering enough variables to keep family sessions, friendly tournaments, and solo runs engaging.

coveredGames.name: Neko Odyssey
coveredGames.title: Neko Odyssey is extremely chill and casual, so any kind of gamers, even the most inexperienced one can enjoy the game freely.

coveredGames.name: Ramen Simulator
coveredGames.title: Creating the tallest ramen tower in the Mount Fuji mode is my new favorite hobby. It is quirky, fun, and very polished.

coveredGames.name: Commandos: Origins
coveredGames.title: Commandos: Origins does a great job of introducing new mechanics while respecting the experience of veterans.

coveredGames.name: Not Monday Cafe
coveredGames.title: Not Monday Cafe has become my favorite background game. It sits neatly on the screen, progresses gently, and always gives me something cute and rewarding to check on.

coveredGames.name: Mistfall Hunter
coveredGames.title: Mistfall Hunter delivers a gripping dark fantasy extraction experience with tense third-person combat, rewarding loot runs, and a haunting world wrapped in golden mist.

coveredGames.name: V.A.U.L.T. PROTOCOL
coveredGames.title: V.A.U.L.T. PROTOCOL has a unique flavor: sci-fi horror, dark humor, physics-driven chaos, and cooperative looting.

coveredGames.name: Neko Station
coveredGames.title: Very wholesome experience with beautiful pixel art and a clever theme. The cats are lovable, and the decoration system makes the train feel customizable.

coveredGames.name: Clean Up Earth
coveredGames.title: Clean Up Earth is fun for anyone who enjoys satisfying gameplay loops. Vacuuming up pollution and planting trees is relaxing.

coveredGames.name: Sudden Strike 5
coveredGames.title: One of the best RTS of the last couple of years and a faithful continuation of the series for its fans. Lovely!

coveredGames.name: SubZero
coveredGames.title: Great survival FMV! It bridges the gap between traditional gaming and interactive cinema effortlessly.

coveredGames.name: Life Below
coveredGames.title: Looking for a decent city-builder? Than you're in the right place! Life Below offers a really enjoyable and superb addictive gameplay, completed by an interesting setting. Highly recommended!

coveredGames.name: Starminer
coveredGames.title: Excellent attention to detail in ship customization, resource synthesis, and defense systems makes Starminer pretty fun for casual play.

coveredGames.name: Trader Life Simulator: Together
coveredGames.title: The mechanics are intuitive, and the sense of progression keeps you coming back for more cooperative mischief.

coveredGames.name: Achilles: Legends Untold
coveredGames.title: Everyone can choose their own play style, from aggressive to cautious, making the approach to combat personalised. And i absolutely adore Greek mythology setting.

coveredGames.name: CarX Drift Racing Online 2
coveredGames.title: The virtual cabin and first-person drift modes in CarX Drift Racing Online 2 add strong immersion to the experience.

coveredGames.name: Dark Light: Survivor
coveredGames.title: Exploration across biomes is surprisingly atmospheric, with environmental storytelling that hints at a larger, mysterious lore.

coveredGames.name: Goblin's Die
coveredGames.title: Goblin's Die nails its retro RPG vibe with snappy combat, cozy loot loops, and cooperative chaos.

coveredGames.name: Musical Slime
coveredGames.title: Musical Slime nails the cozy aesthetic while delivering genuine rhythm feedback.

coveredGames.name: OKUREK
coveredGames.title: OKUREK presents a compelling narrative intertwined with simple farming mechanics. The atmosphere is haunting, and the themes of loss resonate deeply throughout the experience.

coveredGames.name: Netherwake
coveredGames.title: Netherwake offers a gripping narrative that kept me engaged throughout. The atmosphere is eerie, and the gameplay mechanics provide a solid challenge while exploring the dark facility.

coveredGames.name: Strike Warfare : Battle Fury
coveredGames.title: Strike Warfare: Battle Fury offers solid gameplay with impressive mission variety, though it has its rough edges. I'm hopeful for future updates to enhance the experience further.

coveredGames.name: Beellionaire Incremental: Bee Simulator
coveredGames.title: I found Beellionaire Incremental to be enjoyable, especially with friends. The gameplay develops satisfying automation mechanics, although initial progression felt slow.

coveredGames.name: Paper Train Rush
coveredGames.title: The single-player mode is addictive. I keep going back for just one more run to beat my high score. The power-ups add a nice twist to the gameplay.

coveredGames.name: Raku
coveredGames.title: The attention to detail in the culinary aspects of Raku is impressive. Preparing kaiseki dishes was both challenging and rewarding, enhancing my connection to Kyoto.

coveredGames.name: Island Idle RPG: Build and Conquer
coveredGames.title: This game strikes a nice balance between being idle and active. I enjoy the calm pace and the rewarding feeling of expanding my kingdom through strategic choices.

coveredGames.name: S.A.M. - Stasis Asset Management
coveredGames.title: S.A.M. successfully captures the tension of night surveillance. The varied anomalies make each shift unpredictable, which is both challenging and rewarding for keen observers.

coveredGames.name: Cosmic Critters Commotion
