coveredGames.title: Cosmic Critters Commotion offers a unique blend of strategy and action. I appreciate how each critter contributes to the larger ecosystem, making management both engaging and rewarding.

coveredGames.name: Round and Round Inc.
coveredGames.title: This game is surprisingly fun. The humor in the crowd's antics adds a nice touch. I've spent hours tweaking my setup and it's always a blast to watch.

coveredGames.name: MISTWAKE
coveredGames.title: MISTWAKE offers a unique twist on survival gameplay with its card mechanics. Planning my resource management has never felt so engaging and strategic.

coveredGames.name: ApocalypseHQ
coveredGames.title: ApocalypseHQ offers a challenging and strategic experience. I appreciate the depth of resource management, but the turn-based mechanics can feel slow at times.

coveredGames.name: Slotbound
coveredGames.title: Slotbound offers a unique blend of strategy and chance that keeps me engaged. The thrill of spinning for units adds an exciting twist to traditional defense mechanics.

coveredGames.name: Vendilooper - original
coveredGames.title: I appreciate the depth Vendilooper provides through automation and statistics. Each upgrade feels impactful, and I enjoy strategizing to maximize my vending efficiency.

coveredGames.name: The Ghost and The Phoenix
coveredGames.title: The combat is fast-paced and engaging. I found the upgrade system rewarding as I salvaged loot from enemies, though some levels felt a bit repetitive.

coveredGames.name: Cake & Bake
coveredGames.title: This game is a fantastic escape from reality. Baking cakes and decorating them at my own pace is just what I needed. The market trips are a fun touch too.

coveredGames.name: Space Savory
coveredGames.title: The vibrant graphics and engaging storyline make Space Savory a standout title. I enjoy the challenge of managing resources while crafting bizarre meals for my customers.

coveredGames.name: ASCENT: MASKLINGS
coveredGames.title: I enjoyed the unique abilities of each character, especially the distinctive combat styles. The progression feels rewarding, and the shifting rift keeps gameplay fresh and challenging.

coveredGames.name: Swinging Pier Clean Simulator
coveredGames.title: Managing my own cleaning company in a bustling city was a fun experience. The upgrade system keeps progression interesting, and driving through traffic adds to the immersion.

coveredGames.name: Amnea28: Two Eternities
coveredGames.title: Amnea 28" offers a gripping narrative with complex characters and an immersive atmosphere. The multiple endings provide great replay value, keeping me engaged throughout my playtime.

coveredGames.name: Jump Team Fire Fight
coveredGames.title: Jump Team Fire Fight offers an impressive open-world experience with captivating environments. The freedom to choose my approach makes each mission feel unique and engaging.

coveredGames.name: Crystal Commanders
coveredGames.title: Multiplayer battles are intense and require quick thinking. I love the challenge of facing other players and adapting my strategy on the fly.

coveredGames.name: HueTrix
coveredGames.title: HueTrix offers a simple yet addictive gameplay loop. I enjoy stacking colors and strategizing with relics, but some rounds can feel repetitive after a while.

coveredGames.name: Grégoire Lefèbvre Investigations : The Vow of Hate
coveredGames.title: The immersive historical setting of Grégoire Lefèbvre Investigations kept me engaged. The voice acting is exceptional and the puzzles are thoughtfully designed.

coveredGames.name: Isles of Arcana
coveredGames.title: I appreciate the game's concept of rebuilding a world, but the pacing can be slow at times. The graphics are decent, and playing with friends adds to the experience.

coveredGames.name: Yukizuki no Seisou
coveredGames.title: Yukizuki no Seisou presents a captivating narrative that intertwines friendship and fate. The visuals may feel dated but the emotional depth makes it a worthwhile experience.

coveredGames.name: ArcheAge Chronicles
coveredGames.title: ArcheAge Chronicles offers an immersive experience with its rich story and engaging combat system. Exploring Auroria has been a thrilling adventure filled with unexpected challenges.

coveredGames.name: Life & Shadow: Celestial Call
coveredGames.title: The observatory setting is intriguing, but the gameplay can feel tedious at times. I enjoy the mysteries, yet some tasks seem repetitive.

coveredGames.name: Tank of the Fittest
coveredGames.title: I find the mechanics fascinating, turning my aquarium into a living experiment. The interactions among the fish create a dynamic environment that keeps me engaged.

coveredGames.name: Rogue Links
coveredGames.title: Rogue Links offers a unique blend of golfing and chaos. The combination of aiming for your ball while fending off monsters creates an exhilarating challenge that keeps me engaged.

coveredGames.name: Inearth
coveredGames.title: The game's art and atmosphere effectively draw me into its mysterious underworld. Every level feels like a new puzzle waiting to be solved through clever spell combinations.

coveredGames.name: Calvar - The Darkest Gate
coveredGames.title: I was impressed by the attention to detail in Calvar. The psychological elements are well-executed, creating a unique horror experience that I can't wait to see evolve.

coveredGames.name: Ashen Legacy
coveredGames.title: Ashen Legacy successfully immerses players in a dark, intriguing world. The character growth system and the variety of weapons kept the gameplay fresh as I advanced through the levels.

coveredGames.name: Golf 5 MAX
coveredGames.title: Golf 5 MAX offers a refreshing take on golf games with engaging mechanics and a variety of courses. The RPG progression system keeps me invested in my golfer's growth.

coveredGames.name: Hypnostasis
coveredGames.title: I really enjoyed the combat mechanics in Hypnostasis. Every fight feels intense and my choices matter. It’s a wild journey through madness that I can't put down.

coveredGames.name: Dimenshot
coveredGames.title: Dimenshot offers a unique blend of melee-centric combat and FPS mechanics. The level design around the Seven Deadly Sins is impressive and keeps the gameplay fresh.

coveredGames.name: BILLIONAIRE'S BUNKER
coveredGames.title: Billionaire's Bunker offers a darkly humorous take on survival management. The mechanics are engaging, though the UI could use significant improvements. Still, it is enjoyable.

coveredGames.name: Riftscourge
coveredGames.title: I love the immersive environments and dynamic music in Riftscourge. It creates an engaging atmosphere that complements the intense action of demon hunting excellently.

coveredGames.name: Cultivation Legend
coveredGames.title: As someone who enjoys roguelikes, I find Cultivation Legend's idle cultivation mechanics intriguing. The vast variety of heroes and classes adds significant replayability and strategic depth.

coveredGames.name: ConEX
coveredGames.title: I appreciate the upgrade system that allows for diverse playstyles. Each run feels fresh as I experiment with different loadouts and strategies to survive the relentless waves.

coveredGames.name: SULFUR
coveredGames.title: Really fun mix of old-school FPS and roguelike elements. The gunplay feels great, the atmosphere is fantastic, and every run keeps things interesting. Definitely had a lot of fun with this one!

coveredGames.name: Phantom Blade Zero
coveredGames.title: I've had a blast with this one. The combat feels incredibly satisfying, the visuals are beautiful, and the boss fights are easily among the highlights. Exactly the kind of action game I love playing!

coveredGames.name: You Are Empty: Absolute Edition
coveredGames.title: Really enjoyed the atmosphere and unusual setting. It has that old-school FPS feel, with plenty of creepy moments and a world that keeps you curious. Definitely worth playing!

coveredGames.name: Valor Mortis
coveredGames.title: Love the dark atmosphere and brutal combat. The mix of fast-paced action, challenging enemies, and creepy environments makes this one easy to get into. Definitely looking forward to more!

coveredGames.name: STAR WARS Zero Company™
coveredGames.title: This feels like a proper Star Wars strategy game. The turn-based combat is fun, the squad system adds some nice depth, and the Clone Wars setting makes it even better. Really enjoyed it.

coveredGames.name: The Blood of Dawnwalker
coveredGames.title: There’s something really cool about the atmosphere here. The whole vampire setting feels dark without going overboard, and I like how the day/night cycle ties into the gameplay.

coveredGames.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
coveredGames.title: Great to see Onimusha back. The combat feels satisfying, the atmosphere is excellent, and it still has that classic Onimusha and DMC vibe while feeling fresh enough for a new game.

coveredGames.name: G-Rebels
coveredGames.title: Really enjoyed this one. The gameplay is fun, the world is interesting to explore, and there’s enough variety to keep things from getting boring. Definitely worth checking out.

coveredGames.name: BLACKWOOD
coveredGames.title: Interesting concept with a mix of action, store management, and cinematic storytelling. Combat can feel rough at times, but the setting and double-life idea are intriguing.

coveredGames.name: CONTROL Resonant
coveredGames.title: A bold evolution of the original. Trading Jesse’s guns for brutal melee combat and the Oldest House for a warped Manhattan makes this sequel feel fresh while keeping the same surreal magic.

coveredGames.name: Mistfall Hunter
coveredGames.title: You hunt, you loot, you pray the extract works. Lively melee and magic, clever mechanics, gear dripping with affixes, and fantastic enemy design — the loop hooks hard.

coveredGames.name: Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era
coveredGames.title: A fantastic return to classic turn-based strategy with modern polish. Addictive gameplay, beautiful visuals, and that "one more turn" feeling never gets old. Highly recommended!

coveredGames.name: Fatekeeper
coveredGames.title: Buy now - think later! It's a Dark Messiah of Might and Magic Remake, currently in EA but if what's shown will develop it'll become a GOTY at three time more price tag.

coveredGames.name: ROUTINE
coveredGames.title: A chilling, atmospheric sci-fi horror set in a haunting lunar base. Minimal UI and immersive design keep tension high, making every moment feel intense, mysterious, and unforgettable.

coveredGames.name: MOUSE: P.I. For Hire
coveredGames.title: A stylish noir adventure bursting with personality. Smooth shooting, clever humor, and a unique vintage aesthetic make it a refreshing, memorable experience.

coveredGames.name: PRAGMATA
coveredGames.title: A mysterious, atmospheric sci-fi adventure with striking visuals and a unique bond at its core. Engaging puzzles and storytelling keep you intrigued from start to finish.

coveredGames.name: Crimson Desert Enhanced
coveredGames.title: A vast, breathtaking world packed with action and freedom. Fluid combat, rich visuals, and an epic sense of adventure make every moment feel alive and worth exploring.

coveredGames.name: DEATH STRANDING 2: ON THE BEACH
coveredGames.title: A haunting, beautiful journey with deeper storytelling, refined gameplay, and stunning visuals. Every step feels meaningful—an unforgettable experience that stays with you.

coveredGames.name: Resident Evil Requiem
coveredGames.title: A true survival horror masterpiece — tense atmosphere, stunning visuals, and relentless action.Leon proves the king is back, delivering heart-pounding moments that keep you hooked from start to finish

coveredGames.name: REANIMAL
coveredGames.title: Reanimal delivers chilling atmosphere, clever puzzles, and hauntingly beautiful visuals. A gripping co-op horror adventure that keeps you tense and hooked from start to finish.

coveredGames.name: The Crew Motorfest
coveredGames.title: After Season 3, The Crew Motorfest shines brighter than ever — stunning visuals, improved physics, and fresh playlists make every drive in Hawaii feel exciting and endlessly replayable.

coveredGames.name: ARC Raiders
coveredGames.title: A breathtaking blend of style and substance — stunning visuals, fluid combat, and a hauntingly beautiful sci-fi world. Every encounter feels cinematic and alive. AR is pure, exhilarating brilliance.

coveredGames.name: RV There Yet?
coveredGames.title: A charming and hilarious co-op road trip adventure! Teamwork, chaos, and creativity blend perfectly as you and your friends navigate the open road. Lighthearted fun and great replay value.

coveredGames.name: Battlefield™ 6
coveredGames.title: Explosive, massive, and endlessly thrilling — this delivers the chaos and scale shooters should have. Stunning visuals, tactical depth, and team-focused gameplay put it leagues ahead of COD.

coveredGames.name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
coveredGames.title: An absolute masterpiece — breathtaking visuals, poetic storytelling, and combat that blends rhythm and strategy flawlessly. Every scene feels like art in motion. A rare, unforgettable experience.

coveredGames.name: Mafia: The Old Country
coveredGames.title: Engaging story, stylish 1930s atmosphere, and strong characters make this a memorable crime drama. Some mechanics feel dated, but the world and narrative more than make up for it. Worth playing.

coveredGames.name: Cronos: The New Dawn
coveredGames.title: A stunning sci-fi adventure with rich storytelling, breathtaking visuals, and deep atmosphere. Every discovery feels meaningful, and the world design pulls you in completely. A true masterpiece.

coveredGames.name: Borderlands 4
coveredGames.title: Fun gunplay and humor stay true to the series, but poor optimization and stuttering ruin the flow. Great style and chaos, yet performance issues make it hard to fully enjoy.

coveredGames.name: Dispatch
coveredGames.title: A tense and immersive thriller that keeps you on edge. Great voice acting, eerie atmosphere, and clever pacing make every call feel real. Short but unforgettable experience.

coveredGames.name: WUCHANG: Fallen Feathers
coveredGames.title: A hauntingly beautiful soulslike with rich lore, atmospheric landscapes, and intense combat. Its eerie world and challenging battles keep you hooked, offering a dark yet rewarding journey.

coveredGames.name: Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks
coveredGames.title: Fast, chaotic, and insanely fun! Explosions, metal mayhem, and wild racing all come together in a brutal multiplayer experience that never slows down. Pure adrenaline from start to finish!

coveredGames.name: Quality Dreams, Reasonably Priced
coveredGames.title: A beautiful cyberpunk setting game in which you act as a modification consultant and your decisions affect the lives of clients. Nice style and interesting story.

coveredGames.name: The Lifeline
coveredGames.title: A survival horror game in which you have to escape from an abandoned hospital full of zombies. It's gloomy and atmospheric, sometimes scary. It's generally playable and sometimes fun.

coveredGames.name: Grandma Left Me A Building
coveredGames.title: A small game dedicated to managing an apartment building. Unusual tenants, sometimes good humor and a lot of tasks to improve the house and solve problems.

coveredGames.name: Military Base Tidy Up
coveredGames.title: A game in the popular genre of restoring order in which you have to dismantle the rubble at a military base. Typical gameplay, but an interesting setting.

coveredGames.name: Gaslamp Cases 12: The Silent Codex
coveredGames.title: A new story in the Gaslamp Cases detective series in which you will uncover the secrets of the mysterious Silent Code and forbidden knowledge. Classic match-3 gameplay with interesting mechanics.

coveredGames.name: Boku Boku
coveredGames.title: A small cozy sandbox with a coop. Nice pixel style, lots of activity options and building blocks, you can also create your own blocks. It will appeal to both children and adult players.

coveredGames.name: Sea Walker Saga
coveredGames.title: A steampunk adventure with an interesting concept - you have to develop and move your floating island. Nice graphics and interesting difficulty in bossfights.

coveredGames.name: Worst Class Ever
coveredGames.title: A fun, asymmetrical game in which one player plays as a teacher, while the others are students who act among the npc's and perform tasks in secret from the teacher. Good for playing with friends.

coveredGames.name: Dead Party
coveredGames.title: A fun zombie action game with co‑op. A pleasant cartoonish style, large crowds of enemies, and many types of weapons and customization options. There’s a split‑screen mode.

coveredGames.name: Northgard Battlegrounds
coveredGames.title: A mix of auto‑battler mechanics and economic strategy with interesting ideas. Balance needs polishing, but the mechanics and ideas are interesting, and the gameplay is addictive.

coveredGames.name: Absolute Sol
coveredGames.title: An interesting sandbox that allows you to both better understand the Solar System and conduct a number of experiments by changing it and observing the consequences of the changes. For curious minds.

coveredGames.name: Cellar Cleanup Simulator
coveredGames.title: Organize the basement, which is cluttered with various bottles. Classic gameplay in this genre, lots of meditative sorting work, and the joy of bringing order.

coveredGames.name: Truth Beneath the Shadows
coveredGames.title: A detective adventure in a world of anthropomorphic animals, featuring fun mini‑games and the search for clues. A good story and a pleasant atmosphere.

coveredGames.name: THANKS, LIGHT.
coveredGames.title: An interesting spatial puzzle, spiritually close to Portal, but with different mechanics that use light and volume changes. Engaging and atmospheric.

coveredGames.name: Thunder Hoop Collection (QUByte Classics)
coveredGames.title: An excellent remaster of two classic platformers. If you like the atmosphere of retro games, you’ll get a full immersion in the 90s aesthetic and plenty of engaging gameplay.

coveredGames.name: Escape from 8-Bit High
coveredGames.title: A point-and-click adventure in the eight‑bit spirit of the 1980s and 1990s. There’s good humour and a variety of puzzles. First and foremost, this is a game for nostalgic players.

coveredGames.name: Tattoo Shop Simulator
coveredGames.title: A tattoo salon management simulator with a wide variety of activities and fun tasks. Interesting mechanics of tattoos and piercings, motorcycle riding, and even fights with bandits.

coveredGames.name: Noctiria
coveredGames.title: A card battler set in a horror theme. A pleasant visual style and plenty of grinding for successful completion. Six characters to choose from and addictive gameplay.

coveredGames.name: Survivor's Notes
coveredGames.title: An impressive AI-FMV game with an engaging storyline in the spirit of Resident Evil. Not perfect, but very appealing, with a good story that’s full of unexpected twists.

coveredGames.name: Black Gold: Oil Drilling Simulator
coveredGames.title: An oil production simulator at the start of the industry. An interesting theme and pleasant graphics. The game doesn’t keep you hooked for long, but it provides a couple of interesting evenings.

coveredGames.name: Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster
coveredGames.title: A stylish metroidvania with hand‑drawn graphics and high difficulty. Hardcore battles and interesting mechanics. Not perfectly polished, but playable and overall good.

coveredGames.name: Remy Thornfield: Royal Dreams
coveredGames.title: A cute match‑3 adventure in a fantasy setting. Interesting mechanics that add variety to the gameplay, pleasant graphics, and a light fairy‑tale plot about the love between a swineherd and a princess.

coveredGames.name: Roots in the Sky - The Hand of Glory 2
coveredGames.title: A classic point-and-click adventure that continues the story of The Hand of Glory. A pleasant game with stylish art and interesting puzzles. For all fans of old-school quests.

coveredGames.name: Returns Outlet Simulator
coveredGames.title: An interesting store simulator in which your task is to evaluate and repair returned goods and then resell them. The gameplay is addictive, and the difficulty constantly increases.

coveredGames.name: Age of Emerald
coveredGames.title: A classic match‑3 adventure with simple yet appealing graphics and various power‑ups. You’ll have to gather 30 resources, build a magical city, and throw a vibrant celebration for the king.

coveredGames.name: Tavern Legends
coveredGames.title: An atmospheric simulator of a medieval tavern. Nice graphics, a cozy town, and many tasks related to managing and expanding your tavern.

coveredGames.name: NODE
coveredGames.title: A platformer adventure in a ruined nuclear complex. Pleasant 2.5D graphics, an atmospheric dark environment, and interesting levels with a variety of puzzles.

coveredGames.name: Italian Pizza Simulator
coveredGames.title: An Italian pizza simulator with detailed process design and the atmosphere of summer Tuscany. Pleasant graphics and relaxing gameplay.

coveredGames.name: RogueCraft
coveredGames.title: Minimalist tower defense in a pixelated retro style. There are roguelike elements and dozens of towers and characters. Addictive and interesting.

coveredGames.name: MoteMancer
coveredGames.title: A production strategy in a fantasy setting based on automation. Hexagonal minimalistic style, addictive gameplay and six different layouts with their own buildings.

coveredGames.name: Chop Chop Inc.
coveredGames.title: A fun carpenter job simulator and furniture production management. Nice graphics, polished gameplay and lots of fun activities and challenges.

coveredGames.name: Turnip Mountain
coveredGames.title: An interesting climbing arcade game in which you control each hand individually. Nice retro graphics and interesting slightly hardcore gameplay.

coveredGames.name: Abyss Kitchen
coveredGames.title: An interesting idea is to play as a chef who supports a team of adventurers and prepares food for them from whatever he finds. All monsters will be eaten, and the dishes depend on the dungeon.

coveredGames.name: Yellowcreek Stories - The Cabin Watcher
coveredGames.title: A short horror story in the spirit of old slashers. The game runs completely in an hour and a half, there are interesting stealth mechanics and a lot of creepy atmosphere.

coveredGames.name: Backyard Baseball
coveredGames.title: An arcade baseball game with lots of modes and a fun character style. A good game for a group of friends, an interesting playable split screen mode. Solo is also fun.

coveredGames.name: Gaslamp Cases 9: The Ghost of Autmaton City
coveredGames.title: Detective adventures with match3 gameplay continue! The game immerses you in the mysteries of the Victorian automaton city and has a lot of enjoyable gameplay with dozens of improvements and mechanics

coveredGames.name: Staffer Retro : A Supernatural Mystery Quest
coveredGames.title: The sequel to Staffer Case is a stylish detective story with elements of a visual novel in an anime setting. You will have to collect evidence and work a lot with documents. An interesting story.

coveredGames.name: Ore Factory Squad ⛏️
coveredGames.title: A cooperative adventure in which you will not only extract minerals, but also automate mining and processing. Lots of activities and fun gameplay. Mines are generated procedurally.

coveredGames.name: Bounty Brawl: Most Wanted
coveredGames.title: A fun isometric roguelike action game that reveals its gameplay in co-op. In the end, each playthrough turns into a royal battle where only one will survive.Eight characters to choose from.

coveredGames.name: Gaslamp Cases 8: Quest for the Relic
coveredGames.title: Continuation of detective match3 adventures, now you have a case waiting for you in India. The plot consists of five chapters, lots of classic match3 levels and improvements, and nice simple graphics.

coveredGames.name: Task Force Admiral - Vol.1: American Carrier Battles
coveredGames.title: Switching seamlessly between first-person cockpit view and the god's eye tactical map is thrilling, letting you command American carriers through intense '42 Pacific battles with real strategic depth.

coveredGames.name: ROMUL
coveredGames.title: Command your AI robot through gravity-shifting space stations, snapping photos and hauling loot while monsters stalk the dark. Tense, cooperative, and genuinely gripping horror.

coveredGames.name: Adore
coveredGames.title: Building your creature team feels genuinely rewarding here. Every battle fuels progression toward resurrecting the God of Creatures, and that steady growth makes each progression satisfying and fun.

coveredGames.name: Dagger Directive
coveredGames.title: Methodical tension gives way to quiet triumph here. Each mission demands patience, rewarding careful planning with genuine satisfaction once your directive succeeds. Large open maps are a great bonus!

coveredGames.name: Stained Roses & Lilies
coveredGames.title: Unlike typical casual RPGs, this title uses a coach's arrival to trigger a slow, unsettling transformation of two innocent flowers, blending quiet dread with delicate symbolism throughout.

coveredGames.name: ZED ZONE
coveredGames.title: Survivalists who crave crafting, base-building, and brutal co-op combat will thrive here. Gather resources, upgrade skills, and battle zombie hordes with friends via LAN or online play.

coveredGames.name: Princess Ilyana: Night of Falling Grace
coveredGames.title: Becoming guardian to a fallen hero's rescued princess sets a gripping stage. This RPG weaves shadowy intrigue and hidden schemes into a tale worth experiencing.

coveredGames.name: Regiments
coveredGames.title: Procedurally-generated Operations keep every campaign fresh and unpredictable, while heliborne infantry from French, Dutch, Canadian, and Czechoslovakian regiments reshapes tactical strategy entirely.

coveredGames.name: ArcheAge Chronicles
coveredGames.title: Auroria stirs something genuine, wonder, camaraderie, triumph. Battling alongside others or against them brings real exhilaration, while the vast world evokes quiet awe. Incredible experience!

coveredGames.name: Top Racer Collection
coveredGames.title: Four full games bundled together, including a brand new entry built just for this collection. Split-screen chaos and online PvP make it a genre standout for racing fans.

coveredGames.name: Raccoo Venture
coveredGames.title: Explore, collect, customize, repeat: Raccoo Venture's loop hooks you with hidden secrets, clever puzzles, and chaos-versus-order abilities that make every corner worth revisiting.

coveredGames.name: Battlefall: State of Conflict
coveredGames.title: Battlefall drips with bleak, old-school charm. Three factions clash across a grim, war-torn world, and the retro RTS visuals give every skirmish a moody, atmospheric weight worth experiencing.

coveredGames.name: Duelist: Idle Expedition
coveredGames.title: A cozy pixel-art world hums quietly on your taskbar, charming JRPG sprites marching through battles while your attention drifts elsewhere. Relaxing, nostalgic, and oddly captivating.

coveredGames.name: Better Than Dead
coveredGames.title: Slide into bullet time and feel every brutal second of this bodycam revenge FPS. Hong Kong's streets become your playground for close-quarters combat and faster, bloodier runs.

coveredGames.name: AMPANIC
coveredGames.title: Every single task is aim-based, turning shopkeeping into a frantic shooting gallery! Three difficulty tiers and online co-op or versus modes make this fast-paced indie gem endlessly replayable.

coveredGames.name: Breakers Collection
coveredGames.title: Pure 90s arcade nostalgia pulses through every match. Breakers Collection delivers thrilling local and online duels that reignite that classic fighting game passion instantly.

coveredGames.name: Cards Everywhere!
coveredGames.title: A soothing, unhurried atmosphere wraps around every scattered card. Sorting thousands of pieces into your album feels calm, cozy, and quietly satisfying from start to finish.

coveredGames.name: Blades & Battles
coveredGames.title: Swinging swords as Arthur or Lancelot stirs pure nostalgic joy, blending retro beat 'em up thrills with cooperative warmth. Each battle feels triumphant, nostalgic, and genuinely satisfying.

coveredGames.name: Drone Sector
coveredGames.title: The weight of command settles on you fast: every troop lost stings, every objective cleared feels earned. Tense, personal, and deeply satisfying gunship warfare.

coveredGames.name: Car Park Capital
coveredGames.title: There's an oddly satisfying mood here: oily propaganda, quiet neighborhoods paved over, asphalt sprawl replacing simple town life. Strangely immersive and worth sinking into.

coveredGames.name: TFC2: The Fertile Crescent 2 - Collapse of The Bronze Age
coveredGames.title: Building your caravan into a thriving settlement feels genuinely earned here. Each milestone in this Bronze Age journey rewards patience, strategy, and care for those who follow you.

coveredGames.name: Philna Fantasy
coveredGames.title: Dungeon crawling feels satisfying here: pick a class, craft gear, tame pets, and battle shadow forces across varied regions. Puzzles and loot hunts keep every session engaging.

coveredGames.name: Gombo
coveredGames.title: Play solo or team up in online co-op as Gombo, an enchanted creature exploring a haunted cartoon world full of magic, crafting, building and infection-driven mystery!

coveredGames.name: Deck & Conn
coveredGames.title: Retro pixels, cold steel dread. This corvette sim nails Cold War tension, humming reactors and flickering readouts. Atmosphere so thick you'll feel the void pressing on the hull.

coveredGames.name: Journey of Realm：Dawn Dew
coveredGames.title: Freely choosing your combat style sets this apart: as Dew explores a clever box-like map, strategy and adventure blend beautifully against the looming beast tide threat.

coveredGames.name: Great Northern War
coveredGames.title: Where many wargames pick one side of a conflict, this spans six nations across 89 scenarios and five campaigns - a genuinely sprawling tactical achievement worth exploring.

coveredGames.name: GROUND BRANCH
coveredGames.title: Deep tactical customization meets deliberate, punishing gunplay. Every loadout choice and cautious step matters here. Solo or co-op, it rewards patience and planning immensely.

coveredGames.name: Liquidation RTS
coveredGames.title: Quenrium's mysterious power drives every battle in Veá, where sci-fi and fantasy collide beautifully. Command armies, wield abilities, and fight solo or PvP in this gripping early access RTS.

coveredGames.name: Repterra
coveredGames.title: Build, breed, and battle - Repterra's loop of fortifying your colony, taming dinos, and unlocking permanent upgrades between horde assaults makes every run feel worth pushing further.

coveredGames.name: American Revolutionary War
coveredGames.title: Mastering all 148 scenarios across four campaigns feels genuinely earned, as tactics learned in small skirmishes build toward commanding entire colonial theaters with real confidence.

coveredGames.name: 3D Escape Room: Detective Story
coveredGames.title: Foggy 1930s London breathes through every richly rendered 3D scene, pulling you into a moody detective tale where each shadowy clue and puzzle feels wonderfully immersive.

coveredGames.name: Abyss Horde
coveredGames.title: Each wave feels like a desperate heartbeat as darkness swallows the world. Building defenses under mounting dread delivers real tension, relief, and triumph when you survive.

coveredGames.name: Creepy Support
coveredGames.title: Perfect for fans of paranormal mysteries who love branching choices. Guide callers through eerie SCP-like dangers, weigh every question, and uncover multiple chilling endings.

coveredGames.name: Get Out ! A "Very Bad Dreams" Story
coveredGames.title: Straitjacket locked, hood on, dread rising - yet escaping this VR nightmare step by step feels genuinely rewarding. Every small victory earns its weight. Tense, satisfying, worth the struggle.

coveredGames.name: Quantum Void
coveredGames.title: Full VR immersion drops you into a derelict corporate fleet, drifting through mystery and dread. Explore, uncover secrets, and chase the good ending among the stars.

coveredGames.name: 3D Escape Room: Cursed Legacy
coveredGames.title: Solve puzzles across different eras to reverse your aging, uncover hidden records, and inherit the manor's true legacy. Each clue pulls you deeper into a mystery worth escaping.

coveredGames.name: Sword & Siege Age of Longbow: Volume I
coveredGames.title: With almost hundred scenarios and a campaign spanning the Hundred Years War, every longbow battle and siege pulls you back for one more tactical decision. A rewarding wargame worth commanding!

coveredGames.name: Mistfall Hunter
coveredGames.title: Fight through the mist, extract with your haul, then risk it all again. This dark fantasy extraction ARPG hooks you with tense combat and gear you must survive to keep, solo or in co-op.

coveredGames.name: War of the Austrian Succession
coveredGames.title: Perfect for grognards who crave depth: 85 scenarios and 3 campaigns of dynastic warfare, cavalry charges, and rebellions across Europe. A tactician's dream - literally a playable history book!

coveredGames.name: Open Wheel Manager 2
coveredGames.title: Manage every aspect of a 90s race team - hire drivers, win sponsors, and research your way to victory. A sharp, rewarding strategy experience for racing fans!

coveredGames.name: Deluge: Raintime
coveredGames.title: This game has great atmosphere, a visual novel with Lovecraftian overtones and cute girls. An immersive game world featuring well-developed characters and a wide variety of locations.

coveredGames.name: Deluge: Sermon for the Dead
coveredGames.title: An interactive visual novel infused with psychological and Lovecraftian themes. Beautiful, hand-drawn artwork.

coveredGames.name: Deluge: Threnody of Crashing Waves
coveredGames.title: It is a beautiful, enthralling experience. A visual novel with psychological overtones. It is a enjoyable experience that fans of the cute anime girls sub genre will enjoy.

coveredGames.name: CLUB BOSS '94
coveredGames.title: A project created with heart by an independent developer and inspired by legendary football management games. A genuinely solid game. A good football manager game.

coveredGames.name: WendyQuest: Legend of the Four Corner Stones
coveredGames.title: A nice gaming experience. An excellent RPG that successfully combines engaging combat with world exploration. An good choice for those looking for a RPG that isn’t too complex, yet is highly engaging.

coveredGames.name: Outcast Tales
coveredGames.title: A turn-based tactical roguelite. Nice art style. Just easy on the eyes and pleasant to look at. Some genuinely funny moments. This is simply a very good game.

coveredGames.name: Evercursed: Act I
coveredGames.title: An atmospheric psychological horror game with RPG and puzzle elements. Good storytelling and oppressive atmosphere. A solid choice for fans of dark, story-driven horror who value emotional depth.

coveredGames.name: Aquarium Party
coveredGames.title: This is a charming underwater-world simulator with collection elements. Taking on the role of an aquarium caretaker, you will manage daily life on an enchanting island inhabited by fish.

coveredGames.name: Eschalon: Book I
coveredGames.title: RPG. An epic adventure, interesting story, nice soundtrack and all in all great atmosphere. Very enjoyable old school single player RPG.

coveredGames.name: Burntime Remastered
coveredGames.title: Survive in the world of Burntime. And it's addictive. Game with toggle: remaster or original graphics. Very decent work, very good post-apocalyptic strategy game.

coveredGames.name: Magic Fruit World
coveredGames.title: An excellent platformer featuring exploration, tactical combat, and epic boss battles. The game offers fourteen heroes, each with their own unique abilities.

coveredGames.name: PixaMixa: Desktop Sandbox
coveredGames.title: Decorate your desktop with stickers. Customize the behavior of stickers, add useful things like notes, counters, alarms. A fun program for decorating your desktop.

coveredGames.name: PyramidValley: Reborn
coveredGames.title: City-building strategy game set in Ancient Egypt. Build pyramids, the Lighthouse of Alexandria, and the Sphinx; manage resources and develop your city’s economy. The game blends simulation, strategy.

coveredGames.name: Atlantis Fantasy: Reborn
coveredGames.title: Atlantis Fantasy offers a city-building experience that is both relaxing and strategically demanding. A slow-paced game where you get to create your own underwater city.

coveredGames.name: Arknights: Endfield
coveredGames.title: Beautiful graphics, locations, interface, and characters. The music is all extremely well done. This is a gacha project that is truly comfortable, visually appealing, and unique in its own way.

coveredGames.name: Solis Chronicles
coveredGames.title: A sci-fi visual novel. The decisions you make influence how the plot unfolds and every scene is animated. The first book is available entirely for free with about two hours of storytelling.

coveredGames.name: 20 Trials to Heaven
coveredGames.title: A minimalist puzzle game with a dark, philosophical atmosphere. Each chamber presents unique puzzles and traps, requiring players to learn from their mistakes. Hard and elegant puzzles.

coveredGames.name: Turing Testimony
coveredGames.title: A narrative mystery game with psychological thriller elements. Tense delivery and clever narrative design. The core mechanics revolve around cross-referencing conflicting accounts.

coveredGames.name: Catson Files: Wizard Town
coveredGames.title: A short hidden object search game. The cats made an escape. Players will have to test their keen eyes and find them among hundreds of static objects.

coveredGames.name: 20 More, Somehow Even Smaller, Mazes
coveredGames.title: A very pleasant puzzle game with an unusual take on mazes. Short but engaging. Very good.

coveredGames.name: REINCARNAGE
coveredGames.title: A solid, brutal game. It’s a straightforward, old-school shooter. The combat system feels great, and the pacing of game is excellent.

coveredGames.name: Millia -The ending-
coveredGames.title: Very nice visual novel with interesting story, multiple endings. Recommend this game to anyone that loves visual novels and anime and would like a good story line with romance.

coveredGames.name: Ignis Universia: Eternal Sisters Saga DX
coveredGames.title: Pretty good game. This is a sweet, polished, small JRPG with visual novel storytelling. The gameplay is kind of addicting. A lot of fun and humor.

coveredGames.name: Sheepy: A Short Adventure
coveredGames.title: A wonderful adventure. This short platformer with nice secrets. A unique combination of calm beauty with dynamic, even epic scenes that are especially enhanced by the brilliant sound design.

coveredGames.name: CAYNE
coveredGames.title: The isometric, point-and-click, sci-fi horror adventure game. Cayne is a prequel to other game, Stasis. The story is awesome and the writing is pretty nice. Excellent horror game.

coveredGames.name: Aniimo
coveredGames.title: A creature-catching RPG. The art is beautiful, the characters are cute. The content is offering a wide variety. A nice open-world adventure.

coveredGames.name: Battle for Wesnoth
coveredGames.title: This game is one of the best free games. Nice lore. The thousands of hours of content. The graphics are the nice pixel art. Great turn based strategy game.

coveredGames.name: Iris Odyssey
coveredGames.title: A nice text-based fantasy adventure game. The game follows a model where a free portion is available, but to continue playing, one must purchase the DLC containing the full version.

coveredGames.name: Pascal's Requiem
coveredGames.title: A nice indie adventure RPG. Character customization, variety of skills. An atmospheric setting. Turn-based combat where every attack is a minigame.

coveredGames.name: Wish Upon a Cat
coveredGames.title: A sweet, light hearted, funny, and simply enjoyable game. The game has a very warm, nice feeling. If you're looking for something cute, check this one out.

coveredGames.name: ANANTA
coveredGames.title: If you enjoy anime-style open-world RPGs with fun combat, memorable characters, and a world that's actually enjoyable to explore, then we recommend Ananta.

coveredGames.name: NTE: Neverness to Everness
coveredGames.title: Game offers a captivating blend of beautifully designed characters, open-world and an intriguing storyline. Your story begins in big city, where you play the role of an anomaly hunter.

coveredGames.name: SURA: Shattered Star
coveredGames.title: A dynamic action platformer. The gameplay is enjoyable. Sura wields a single sword and uses the power of Asterium for rapid attacks. Sharp reflexes and careful planning are the keys to survival.

coveredGames.name: Blue Sign
coveredGames.title: A game about a marine Insurance agent with pleasant atmosphere. A nice experience and good game's mechanics. Work in the insurance field, it'll be fun?

coveredGames.name: Netoo
coveredGames.title: A minimalist puzzle game where you move magnets via rotating widgets to put them in slots and clear levels. If you enjoy puzzles with exciting and engaging gameplay, then give it a try.

coveredGames.name: Dear Magical Girls
coveredGames.title: A nice story-driven defense game. The quieter story moments balance the action well, making players feel more empathy for both the characters and the world they protect.

coveredGames.name: The Grade 5B Case Files
coveredGames.title: A game focused on everyday mysteries from the lives of elementary school students. The game generally moves at a comfortable speed and allows players to appreciate the setting and narrative.

coveredGames.name: Olga Doesn't Die
coveredGames.title: This game is a beautiful work of art. The writing and story are incredibly powerful and emotional. A visual novel with a stunning variety of stories, emotions, branching narratives, endings.

coveredGames.name: TEST TEST TEST
coveredGames.title: A cool puzzle game. A pixel-art point-and-click adventure where you must escape a time loop. Quite challenging, it couldn't be better.

coveredGames.name: Evitania Online - Idle RPG
coveredGames.title: This is a nice idle RPG. A great game to while away the time. The gameplay is auto-farming. Relaxed, simple, and stress-free with satisfying progression.

coveredGames.name: Plague Inc: Evolved
coveredGames.title: While there could be more randomness or more strategy required, Plague Inc. Evolved produces an interesting and unique experience. There's a lot of content in the game and a good challenge.

coveredGames.name: Effie
coveredGames.title: Effie isn't going to blow any minds, but its tried-and-true action and 3D platforming design makes for a delightful callback to yesteryear.

coveredGames.name: Ghost 1.0
coveredGames.title: Ghost 1.0 is a great game with a great visual style and interesting story and characters, that has moments of huge frustration because of the insane difficulty increases.

coveredGames.name: STRIDER™ / ストライダー飛竜®
coveredGames.title: Strider is a liberating, free-form action platformer studded with frustrating callbacks to an arcade era better left behind.

coveredGames.name: Guacamelee! 2
coveredGames.title: Guacamelee 2 builds on the same charm and platforming core as the first game.

coveredGames.name: ECHO
coveredGames.title: Echo is a marvel of A.I. programming bolstered by a compelling sci-fi storytelling, and injects new life into the stealth genre.

coveredGames.name: Final Days
coveredGames.title: Final Days offers players a lot of fun and won’t break the bank. It’s surprisingly rewarding and takes a refreshing amount of planning to survive.

coveredGames.name: Total Tank Simulator
coveredGames.title: Easy to start, but miles deep. THAT’S WAR, BABY!

coveredGames.name: The Talos Principle
coveredGames.title: Games that are this thought provoking and enjoyable are rare. Rarer still are those that imbue this level of pride and honor upon completion.

coveredGames.name: 88 Heroes
coveredGames.title: 88 Heroes is an excellent 2D platformer that makes great use of a unique premise to make it infinitely replayable.

coveredGames.name: Shadowrun: Dragonfall - Director's Cut
coveredGames.title: This expansion is a notable step up in character depth and mission design, and the best reason yet to explore this iteration of the fantastic Shadowrun universe

coveredGames.name: Tower 57
coveredGames.title: A good throwback and tribute to games like Smash TV. The controls could use a little bit of improvement and be prepared to grind for any upgrades.

coveredGames.name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky
coveredGames.title: A slow-paced but charismatic RPG with an incredibly well-crafted world and characters.

coveredGames.name: The Long Journey Home
coveredGames.title: The Long Journey Home is a roguelike sci-fi survival simulator fueled on hope and hopelessness. Bring them home, commander. But be ready to die a hundred deaths before that ever happens.

coveredGames.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 3
coveredGames.title: Jackbox Party Pack 3: Such a great pack of games. Fakin’ it can be really fun, Murder Party is hilarious, Guesspionage is interesting. Really great pack that needs should have 3+ players.

coveredGames.name: Attentat 1942
coveredGames.title: After completing the story, I felt like I had sat down to watch a movie rather than play a game but I got to control the pace if only a little.

coveredGames.name: A City Sleeps™
coveredGames.title: A City Sleeps may tend to favor its least interesting and impressive elements, but while it runs short, in its most accessible state it is also its most ingenious.

coveredGames.name: Wattam
coveredGames.title: Wattam features the best visuals, score, and cast to ever grace a Keita Takahashi game, but its gameplay proves to be a touch too shallow to preserve that childlike wonder beyond its four-hour story.

coveredGames.name: Monster Slayers
coveredGames.title: If you're a fan of deck building or dungeon crawlers then Monster Slayers is a must try. For the $9 price tag there is an insane amount of content and replayability.

coveredGames.name: The Falconers: Moonlight
coveredGames.title: Aotearoa is a perfect setting for a video game, and this game is proof.

coveredGames.name: Hitman GO: Definitive Edition
coveredGames.title: Not particularly difficult, and its mobile roots are showing, but Hitman GO: Definitive Edition is an entertaining puzzle spin-off.

coveredGames.name: MochiMochi
coveredGames.title: MochiMochi's one button setup and sugary sweet presentation hides some serious challenge. Those willing to cut their teeth will enjoy a physics-based platformer that can "hang" with the greats.

coveredGames.name: Mad Max
coveredGames.title: Satisfying car combat and a beautiful wasteland mostly make up for repetitive melee combat and lackluster story.

coveredGames.name: 60 Parsecs!
coveredGames.title: This is definitely a survival game worth playing and in a league of it's own entertainment value that is out of this world!

coveredGames.name: Vaporum
coveredGames.title: Old-school dungeon crawling with a few modern-day touches, Vaporum attention to detail is wrapped around a tale of steampunk mystery and some fresh ideas.

coveredGames.name: Figment
coveredGames.title: From an art style perspective, it's gorgeous work made by very talented people.

coveredGames.name: Wreckfest
coveredGames.title: The scope is ultimately limited, but what a roaring spectacle of broken car bits Wreckfest manages.

coveredGames.name: Yes, Your Grace
coveredGames.title: Eager to do the many issues of medieval life justice, Yes Your Grace can't hit a good balance between challenging and frustrating.

coveredGames.name: Zombie Vikings
coveredGames.title: Zombie Vikings

coveredGames.name: Mother Russia Bleeds
coveredGames.title: When punch, punch, launcher kick, jump, insane piledriver is an option, I tend to get creative whenever possible.

coveredGames.name: Reventure
coveredGames.title: As a connoisseur of platformers, I knew I was going to like Reventure. What I didn’t know, was that I would constantly be thinking about it.

coveredGames.name: Bartlow's Dread Machine
coveredGames.title: Bartlow’s Dread Machine is very much a steampunk style twin stick shooter by Beep Games. This game boasts both a single player and Couch Co-Op modes.

coveredGames.name: Ninja Senki DX
coveredGames.title: [Ninja Senki DX] succeeds to replicating what's already been done, which is fine, but it fails to be a classic in its own right

coveredGames.name: Nidhogg 2
coveredGames.title: Nidhogg 2 is a unique and incredibly intricate game that succeeds in sucking you into its addictive nature, whether you are a newcomer to the series or a veteran looking for a fresh challenge.

coveredGames.name: Cardpocalypse
coveredGames.title: Cute graphics, funny writing, and good gameplay make Cardpocalypse a rousing good time.

coveredGames.name: Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes
coveredGames.title: I have to say this game is definitely worth a buy if you are looking for a fun experience with friends.

coveredGames.name: Road to Ballhalla
coveredGames.title: It is a shame that every level is so well done and all required so much work, in terms of visual and audio presentation, that it means there are so few levels overall

coveredGames.name: Bug Academy
coveredGames.title: There is a good variety between levels and bugs that will keep you engaged until the – very short – end, but you'll be buzzing all about it once you're done.

coveredGames.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 3
coveredGames.title: While Five Nights at Freddy's 3 is still a solid game, it is not on par with the first two entries.

coveredGames.name: Atomik: RunGunJumpGun
coveredGames.title: If you like to be pushed to the absolute limit, the twitch-heavy gameplay and punishing level design will do just that, crushing your spirit along the way.

creators.name: A boy in a strange T-shirt

coveredGames.name: Among Us
coveredGames.title: The ultimate party game for playing with friends! Packed with deception, mystery, and nonstop laughter. Simple to pick up and insanely entertaining.

coveredGames.name: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check
coveredGames.title: The atmosphere at the checkpoint is genuinely tense. You really start second-guessing every single person who walks up to your window.

coveredGames.name: Don't Feed the Zombie
coveredGames.title: A voyeuristic digital simulator where you spy on strangers through hidden cameras. Unsettling, tightly paced, and hard to put down.

coveredGames.name: Blazing Beaks
coveredGames.title: Cute birds with heavy weapons murdering mutants. Picking up cursed items makes the run harder, but the risk-reward loop is super addictive.

coveredGames.name: Shadow Warrior
coveredGames.title: Pure unfiltered katana action mixed with crude humor. Slice through demons, upgrade your moves, and don’t take it too seriously.

coveredGames.name: Vanquish
coveredGames.title: Rocket-sliding across the floor while shooting robot soldiers in slow motion? Third-person action games rarely feel this smooth and over-the-top.

coveredGames.name: Loop Her
coveredGames.title: Such a unique concept. You’re not directly controlling the hero, but planning everything around them. The soundtrack and bleak atmosphere completely hook you.

coveredGames.name: Soulstone Survivors
coveredGames.title: A bit more demanding on the hardware, but the sheer chaos on screen is insane. If you love screen-clearing builds and big damage numbers, you’ll dig it.

coveredGames.name: Killing Floor 3
coveredGames.title: The game evokes only positive emotions

coveredGames.name: MY HERO ULTRA RUMBLE
coveredGames.title: Very good, short, sweet game. Tight controls , pleasant art, fun levels, and great humor

coveredGames.name: Marvel Rivals
coveredGames.title: An excellent game to play, I got it when it was on sale and I don't regret the decision.

coveredGames.name: It Takes Two Friend's Pass
coveredGames.title: Keep a close eye on your daily assignments, interact with others to increase your popularity, not forgetting fans, friends, family and time allocation!

coveredGames.name: DEATH NOTE Killer Within
coveredGames.title: Unexpectedly, I actually got through this game

coveredGames.name: Five Hearts Under One Roof
coveredGames.title: I liked the game so much that I've been playing it for over a week now. The girls are 10 out of 10

coveredGames.name: Rooftops & Alleys: The Parkour Game
coveredGames.title: I liked everything! the game deserves attention

coveredGames.name: The Beginner's Guide
coveredGames.title: Filling your head with questions that have no easy answers, The Beginner's Guide is confusing, thought-provoking, and unlike anything you've ever played.

coveredGames.name: Hand of Fate
coveredGames.title: Aside from some problematic resource balancing and some unavoidable repetition, Hand of Fate is a clever game of risks and rewards that is well worth getting dealt into.

coveredGames.name: Defragmented
coveredGames.title: One miscalculation and you have to start the entire level again. Sometimes, these miscalculations are not even your fault

coveredGames.name: Dandy Ace
coveredGames.title: Dandy Ace may have some problems with its level design and overall variety, but the core gameplay is really polished and the unique card system on top of that sets the game apart from the crowd.

coveredGames.name: Mail Mole + 'Xpress Deliveries
coveredGames.title: Solid based movement platformer that's good with kids, and provides a good laid back experience while still being a challenge at times.

coveredGames.name: Expand
coveredGames.title: Expand's greatest deception is in giving the impression that its stark black and white and red color palette and plain geometric characters were born out of an inability to do anything more.

coveredGames.name: The Fall
coveredGames.title: ARID is a wonderfully interesting character, although she has little opportunity for personality within the space of this game (the first of a trilogy).

coveredGames.name: Violett Remastered
coveredGames.title: Violett channels Salvador Dali and Tim Burton in a surreal and challenging tale.

coveredGames.name: Circa Infinity
coveredGames.title: It's not a perfect game, but Circa Infinity offers an intense challenge that will frustrate even the most ambitious gamers.

coveredGames.name: Runers
coveredGames.title: Runers offers a truly enjoyable experience, with a good marriage of standard roguelike mechanics expanded by the real-time top-down shooter gameplay dynamic and by the spell crafting system.

coveredGames.name: Kalimba
coveredGames.title: While there are some problems with release day DLC and graphical display issues, Press Play has created something truly unique in this indie game and it is well worth the price!

coveredGames.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 3
coveredGames.title: While Five Nights at Freddy's 3 is still a solid game, it is not on par with the first two entries.

coveredGames.name: Dig or Die
coveredGames.title: Dig or Die stands out in most technical ways from other survival crafting games of this style, but it's lackluster visuals leave it looking like a lot of other entries in the genre.

coveredGames.name: Bite the Bullet
coveredGames.title: Appetizing gameplay and hilarious themes make for a tasty meal.

coveredGames.name: Hand of Fate 2
coveredGames.title: While the combat may drag down the highs a bit, the core experience is a fantastic and unique trek through a card-created fantasy world

coveredGames.name: Sky Racket
coveredGames.title: Sky Racket is a wild, playful, delightful tour of a weird, imaginative galaxy that is certainly worth visiting.

coveredGames.name: WRC 9 FIA World Rally Championship
coveredGames.title: Building on the foundation of last year's game, WRC 9 fleshes out the experience with new features and content.

coveredGames.name: Kitty Powers' Love Life
coveredGames.title: Surprisingly deep and often enjoyable. Kitty Powers Matchmaker fans will love the improvements.

coveredGames.name: The Adventure Pals
coveredGames.title: A fun and funny 2D platformer whose infectious sense of humour comes through clearly in the visuals, the script, and the gameplay.

coveredGames.name: Neverwinter
coveredGames.title: If you're a Dungeons & Dragons fan you may be willing to push aside the shortcomings. For everyone else it's a great vacation spot but not the kind of place you'd want to live in.

coveredGames.name: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition
coveredGames.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition is the champion of the RTS genre we deserve.

coveredGames.name: The Talos Principle
coveredGames.title: The Talos Principle builds a giant collection of 3D puzzles, puts you in the middle of it, and then gives you a philosophical puzzle to chew on that's even larger.

coveredGames.name: Titan Souls
coveredGames.title: Titan Souls stretches its simple structure to its breaking point, but before that time comes, it's an intriguing game and a fair but fun challenge.

coveredGames.name: Space Food Truck
coveredGames.title: I thoroughly enjoyed Space Food Truck, and not exactly for the reasons I thought I would.

coveredGames.name: Creaks
coveredGames.title: Familiar puzzle-platform staples are polished to a high sheen in Creaks. It might not break new ground in the genre, but no-one can tell a wordless story quite like Amanita Design.

coveredGames.name: Rifter
coveredGames.title: Rifter is a fantastic neon-synth action platformer with a gorgeous, distinctive style and a rewarding challenge.

coveredGames.name: Blood Rage: Digital Edition
coveredGames.title: Blood Rage: Digital Edition is a strong port of the popular tabletop game that's challenging for both newcomers and veterans alike.

coveredGames.name: Zombie Army Trilogy
coveredGames.title: Zombie Army Trilogy may not do much new in the grand scheme of things, but everything that it does, it does well.

coveredGames.name: Pacer
coveredGames.title: Pacer is an adrenaline-fuelled racer with tons of replayability, and plenty of customisation options to make each win count.

coveredGames.name: Murder by Numbers
coveredGames.title: Overall this is a game no fan of Picross (or nonograms) should miss. It is just as essential as Jupiter’s Picross-e and Picross-s series.

coveredGames.name: The Turing Test
coveredGames.title: The Turing Test can be quite accurately described as Portal meets Soma, exploring similar ideas of AI and selfhood. The trouble is, I suppose, that both those games did each aspect better.

coveredGames.name: One Night Stand
coveredGames.title: A short but sweet visual novel about waking up next to a stranger. A nice art style, solid script, and multiple endings that are fun to try and find. Hard to go wrong for $3.

coveredGames.name: Event[0]
coveredGames.title: When you get down to it, the only major flaw of Event[0] is that there isn’t enough of it.

coveredGames.name: Monster Prom 2: Monster Camp
coveredGames.title: To get straight to the point, Monster Prom 2: Monster Camp is pure fun, plain and simple.

coveredGames.name: The Shattering
coveredGames.title: Thanks to some clever subversions of a troubling dive into the psyche, The Shattering could go down as a new favourite in the narrative thriller genre.

coveredGames.name: Journey of a Roach
coveredGames.title: The short but sweet Journey of a Roach presents a charming postapocalyptic world.

coveredGames.name: Fear Equation
coveredGames.title: Fear Equation is a hard game that can frustrate players but offers a unique mix of management and terror that fans of both strategy and survival genres should try out.

coveredGames.name: One Step From Eden
coveredGames.title: One Step from Eden is enjoyable. It’s also one of the most challenging games I’ve played in a while.

coveredGames.name: Double Kick Heroes
coveredGames.title: A unique rhythm based shoot-em-up game with a killer heavy metal soundtrack, detailed pixel characters and environments with tons of personality.

coveredGames.name: Pony Island
coveredGames.title: A fantastically clever deconstruction of video games and the people that play them, as well as a hugely entertaining action puzzler that's not really about ponies.

coveredGames.name: Bounty Brawl: Most Wanted
coveredGames.title: Bounty Brawl sets itself apart with its Lasso mechanic, letting you zip through chaotic combat in Hunter Haven. Team up for co-op, then betray allies for the final bounty!

coveredGames.name: Princess Ilyana: Night of Falling Grace
coveredGames.title: A shadow-drenched RPG steeped in melancholy beauty. Guarding Ilyana feels intimate and heavy with dread, every scene drenched in atmosphere that lingers long after playing.

coveredGames.name: ZED ZONE
coveredGames.title: Crash, scavenge, upgrade, survive, repeat. ZED ZONE's loop of gathering materials, building shelters, and smashing zombie hordes with friends makes every session addictive and rewarding.

coveredGames.name: Isles of Arcana
coveredGames.title: Arcana's corrupted biomes feel hauntingly alive, each one drenched in moody atmosphere. Exploring solo or with friends, the crumbling world draws you in and never lets go.

coveredGames.name: Cleared Hot
coveredGames.title: Shoot, swoop, snag enemies with your magnet rope, reposition your squad, repeat. Cleared Hot's physics-driven loop makes every chaotic sortie feel freshly tactical.

coveredGames.name: GROUND BRANCH
coveredGames.title: Tense, grounded, and quietly immersive. Every corridor feels heavy with tactical weight, every shadow deliberate. A moody, methodical shooter that rewards patience and sharp instincts alike.

coveredGames.name: ROMUL
coveredGames.title: Shifting gravity turns every corridor into a puzzle, while your voice-controlled AI companion barks orders as monsters close in. Snap photos, grab loot, and flee together through abandoned stations!

coveredGames.name: ArcheAge Chronicles
coveredGames.title: Auroria feels genuinely alive, vast landscapes soaked in lore, shifting light, and layered detail that pull you into its world. A gorgeous, immersive MMO setting worth wandering through for hours.

coveredGames.name: Duelist: Idle Expedition
coveredGames.title: A cozy pixel-art world where charming JRPG sprites march across your taskbar, blending nostalgic visuals with a calm, idle rhythm that makes every battle feel like a peaceful little adventure.

coveredGames.name: Rise of Piracy
coveredGames.title: Command a fleet born from a single humble ship, blending action, adventure and strategy into one voyage. Trade, pillage, recruit and conquer your way to piracy's throne.

coveredGames.name: TFC2: The Fertile Crescent 2 - Collapse of The Bronze Age
coveredGames.title: Build, protect, and keep moving: the loop of gathering resources, defending your caravan, and pushing onward never gets old. A refreshingly human take on strategy.

coveredGames.name: BloomTale
coveredGames.title: Arranging blooms feels genuinely satisfying, and balancing shop tasks with customer requests keeps each session engaging. A relaxing yet rewarding loop that's easy to sink hours into.

coveredGames.name: Factory Default: Build, Trade, Repeat
coveredGames.title: There's quiet satisfaction in watching your first trade route click into place. This globe-spanning builder rewards patience with genuine pride in what you've created.

coveredGames.name: Refund Me TD
coveredGames.title: Fence the meadow, place eight towers, brace for sappers and flocks. Fifty levels against a merciless two-hour clock make every maze a fresh puzzle, tempting one more run.

coveredGames.name: AMPANIC
coveredGames.title: Perfect for aim-focused players who crave chaos and quick thinking. Shopkeeping becomes thrilling when every task relies on precision, speed, and smart planning with friends.

coveredGames.name: The Last Camp : Dawn
