coveredGames.title: Dynamic maps, responsive controls, and constant events keep matches exciting, accessible, and highly replayable.

coveredGames.name: Garry's Mod
coveredGames.title: Server variety, inventive game modes, and a friendly modding community keep experiences fresh and endlessly entertaining.

coveredGames.name: Pacify
coveredGames.title: Pacify delivers a clean, atmospheric fright fest with clever puzzle design and strong multiplayer appeal. It’s easy to pick up, but mastering communication under pressure is rewarding.

coveredGames.name: Enigma of Fear
coveredGames.title: Enigma of Fear and it's non-linear exploration allows players to uncover secrets at their own pace, offering a satisfying sense of discovery.

coveredGames.name: BIGFOOT
coveredGames.title: BIGFOOT is both a fun and terrifying ride, it’s great for a night of gaming with friends. The lore surrounding Bigfoot is fascinating, and the game captures the mythical aspect well.

coveredGames.name: Vietnam War
coveredGames.title: Immersive audio design and cool visuals pull you right into the jungles. The soundscape paints every ambush and retreat vividly, turning ordinary skirmishes into memorable moments.

coveredGames.name: GODBREAKERS
coveredGames.title: Cooperative battles are the heart of GODBREAKERS. The pacing is brutal but rewarding, and the arcane powers create wild, cinematic moments. If you love beatemups with roguelike twists.

coveredGames.name: Beloved Rapture
coveredGames.title: The blend of linear and open-ended gameplay keeps each chapter feeling fresh and engaging, never allowing monotony to creep in.

coveredGames.name: Car Dealer Simulator
coveredGames.title: The visuals are pleasant, and the soundscape sells the dealership ambiance. The car models are detailed enough to feel credible, contributing to the overall immersion and satisfaction.

coveredGames.name: How 2 Escape
coveredGames.title: How 2 Escape has a wonderful balance of tension and fun—an absolute gem for co-op fans. Perfect for casual gamers and the difficulty ramps up at just the right pace.

coveredGames.name: Maid of Salvation
coveredGames.title: Visually striking and relentlessly challenging, Maid of Salvation nails the feeling of perilous, dark fantasy exploration.

coveredGames.name: Lethal Company
coveredGames.title: Coordinating a crew, scanning aliens, and upgrading your ship makes every expedition feel meaningful. It’s a lean, intense co-op horror that sticks with you.

coveredGames.name: Broforce
coveredGames.title: Cooperative gameplay enhances the fun, as players blast through levels with over-the-top destruction.

coveredGames.name: Shovel Knight: Treasure Trove
coveredGames.title: As a love letter to retro gaming, Shovel Knight combines tight controls with charming pixel art and a captivating story. The level design is masterfully crafted, making every challenge rewarding.

coveredGames.name: Black Desert
coveredGames.title: Although primarily an MMORPG, its action combat system allows for exhilarating battles and skill-based gameplay, making every encounter feel dynamic and engaging.

coveredGames.name: RimWorld
coveredGames.title: A colony simulation game that combines strategy with storytelling, allowing players to manage a group of crash-landed survivors and navigate their complex relationships.

coveredGames.name: Factorio
coveredGames.title: Engaging factory-building simulation that tasks players with designing efficient production lines and managing resources in a complex, rewarding environment.

coveredGames.name: Subnautica
coveredGames.title: Fun underwater survival-adventure that blends exploration, mystery, and base-building in a gorgeous, alien ocean.

coveredGames.name: Hollow Knight
coveredGames.title: A beautifully hand-drawn metroidvania adventure with tight platforming, challenging bosses, and a moody, atmospheric world.

coveredGames.name: Cities: Skylines
coveredGames.title: A city-building masterpiece that allows players to design and manage intricate urban environments, balancing resources, traffic, and the well-being of citizens.

coveredGames.name: DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT
coveredGames.title: A visually stunning and narratively complex adventure that challenges players to connect fractured societies in a breathtakingly unique open-world environment.

coveredGames.name: You Shouldn't Be Here
coveredGames.title: A narrative-driven exploration game that challenges players to piece together their reality while interacting with thought-provoking puzzles and landscapes.

coveredGames.name: ASTRONEER
coveredGames.title: The game's vibrant world and creative mechanics foster an incredible sense of discovery.

coveredGames.name: Chicory: A Colorful Tale
coveredGames.title: An art-focused adventure game that allows players to use colors creatively as they explore a whimsical world, blending puzzles with creativity.

coveredGames.name: Beasts of Maravilla Island
coveredGames.title: A delightful adventure that focuses on exploration and creative creatures, allowing players to uncover secrets in a picturesque nature setting.

coveredGames.name: Bounty Brawl: Most Wanted
coveredGames.title: Bounty Brawl: Most Wanted is an enjoyable roguelike whose growing depth and character driven variety make experimenting with builds rewarding, though its story is secondary.

coveredGames.name: Blade Arcus from Shining: Battle Arena
coveredGames.title: I recommend Blade Arcus for its extremely fun combos, tag battles, and well balanced cast. Its story mode is tedious and shallow, so come for the fighting, not the plot.

coveredGames.name: Aria Skies
coveredGames.title: Aria Skies is a fun, free change of pace for casual PvP with friends, but not a deep fighter to commit to long term.

coveredGames.name: Cinderia
coveredGames.title: A fantastic foundation for a roguelike, with deep combat, creative items, and satisfying synergies. With more content and polish, this could become something special.

coveredGames.name: Sort The Bunnies
coveredGames.title: A cozy, quietly addictive organizing game. Watching the clutter turn into tidy shelves is a small, steady pleasure, and the final show is a lovely reward.

coveredGames.name: RoboGAL: Gaga Delta Lady
coveredGames.title: If you love Mega Man, you'll probably enjoy this one. Good weapons, fun bosses, and solid stages. Just be ready for a serious difficulty spike toward the end.

coveredGames.name: Probably Stolen - Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim
coveredGames.title: A brilliant mix of Papers, Please and shop management, with addictive progression, deep item mechanics, memorable NPCs, and enough content to keep you hooked for hours.

coveredGames.name: Well Dweller
coveredGames.title: A fantastic metroidvania with gorgeous visuals, unique bosses, and fun gameplay that makes it well worth your time. However, hardcore fans might find it a bit too easy.

coveredGames.name: One More Brick
coveredGames.title: A fun, addictive brick breaker whose skill and ball variety pair neatly with idle style progression. No controller support or background music, but an easy recommendation at its price.

coveredGames.name: Void Stranger
coveredGames.title: The less you know about Void Stranger, the better. What starts as a simple puzzle game becomes something far bigger, stranger, and impossible to forget.

coveredGames.name: Cats MiaoMiaoMiao~
coveredGames.title: Cats MiaoMiaoMiao~ is a charming, cozy match-3 game filled with adorable cats and relaxing puzzles. Its simple gameplay makes for a delightful casual experience, despite some technical issues.

coveredGames.name: Museologist: Tidy Up the Museum!
coveredGames.title: Museologist turns museum restoration into a cozy, addictive experience, blending satisfying puzzles with interesting art facts. Its relaxing pace is a delight, though the soundtrack lacks variety.

coveredGames.name: GUNFIELD
coveredGames.title: A short but fun shmup with great pixel art and smooth gameplay. A charming experience, though limited replayability leaves you wanting more.

coveredGames.name: Little Ghost
coveredGames.title: A charming chill metroidvania set in a papercraft office. Fun exploration, great indie music to collect, and stunning Tarot card art that steals the show. Weird, cozy, and full of soul!

coveredGames.name: Epistory - Typing Chronicles
coveredGames.title: A charming origami adventure where typing becomes fast, tactical combat. Awkward movement and unclear spell ranges sting, but the clever elemental battles are worth recommending.

coveredGames.name: VOIDRAVE
coveredGames.title: VOIDRAVE é um shoot 'em up (bullet hell) arcade em pixel art 2D. O jogo conta com 100 ondas de inimigos, 20 chefes, elementos roguelite e 4 naves. Modos incluem co-op local, boss rush e daily runs.

coveredGames.name: Cobalt Miner
coveredGames.title: Despite overblown marketing and weak economic balance, Cobalt Miner delivers a charming, relaxing short experience

coveredGames.name: Thunder Hoop Collection (QUByte Classics)
coveredGames.title: This great QUByte port revives two 90s arcade gems, showing a huge evolution in its sequel. Both games are brutally hard, making the newly added rewind feature essential to finally beat them.

coveredGames.name: BULLACATOR -pusher tank battle-
coveredGames.title: BULLACATOR blends deckbuilding and coin-pusher physics into a wildly addictive, challenging combat system. Some mechanics could use polish, but I'm hooked and can't wait for more. Highly recommended

coveredGames.name: NEONFALL
coveredGames.title: A fast-paced twin-stick roguelite set in a flooding neon tower. Grapple, dash and use bullet-time across procedural floors, upgrading your arsenal before challenging multi-phase bosses.

coveredGames.name: Under a Desert Sun: Seekers of the Cursed Vessel
coveredGames.title: A WWII-era Egypt action RPG mixing top-down combat, loot, exploration and undead hordes. It's still very early in development and clearly needs more polish, but the core concept shows potential.

coveredGames.name: Sort Them Ducks
coveredGames.title: Sort Them Ducks is a cozy, intuitive and satisfying way to relax, though its easygoing loop can make urgent tasks easy to postpone.

coveredGames.name: Dicevaders
coveredGames.title: A dangerously addictive roguelike that combines Balatro-inspired scoring with unique characters, deep synergies, and endless build possibilities. Another gem from these developers!

coveredGames.name: StarVaders
coveredGames.title: A brilliant mix of Space Invaders and Mega Man Battle Network, with deep card synergies, strategic combat, and enough variety to make every run feel different.

coveredGames.name: Alex & Arty
coveredGames.title: Alex & Arty is an action-adventure focused on exploration, combat, restoration and Arty’s transformations, but unclear controls, rough combat and progression issues undermine the experience.

coveredGames.name: Dungeon Bomber
coveredGames.title: Dungeon Bomber looked like a simple casual game, then kept adding new layers. Bomb fusion, stacked elements and chain reactions make every turn more interesting than it first appears.

coveredGames.name: Kumatopia
coveredGames.title: Kumatopia instantly hit my 90s Tamagotchi nostalgia. Some minigames need work, but it's charming, full of personality and feels perfect for quick check-ins throughout the day.

coveredGames.name: Dark Avos
coveredGames.title: Brutal, slow and strangely addictive. Dark Avos makes every expedition feel risky, and learning from bad decisions is part of the fun. It still needs clearer explanations.

coveredGames.name: Gunclone Arena
coveredGames.title: A cheesy arena roguelite in the best way, with fantastic announcers and a fun endless mode. Combat feels slow and builds need more depth, but the game show personality kept me smiling.

coveredGames.name: Solitaire: Kingdom in Chains
coveredGames.title: A charming solitaire game with great art, music and surprisingly tense boss fights. Some QoL and RNG balance issues remain, but it’s perfect for short sessions between work breaks.

coveredGames.name: Yellow Taxi Goes Vroom
coveredGames.title: A chaotic platformer mixing Mario 64 and Crazy Taxi, packed with collectibles, creative worlds, movement combos, and enough bizarre humor to get Psychotic!!! stuck in your head.

coveredGames.name: GRID/
coveredGames.title: GRID/ took time to click, but once I switched to the D-pad and understood its rhythm, I got hooked. Tough bosses, distinct weapons and a satisfying learning curve.

coveredGames.name: Rooster
coveredGames.title: Rooster is beautiful, warm and full of heart. Its art, music and story pulled me in completely. Some minigames run long, but Little Dove's journey stayed with me long after the credits rolled.

coveredGames.name: WuLin Showdown
coveredGames.title: A clever roguelike with strategic combat, unique character decks, and plenty of variety. Great mechanics, though it could use more progression and impactful moments.

coveredGames.name: 33 Days till Extraction
coveredGames.title: A satisfying isometric extraction RPG with impactful gunplay, great headshots and layered progression. The UI can overwhelm, but the combat loop and customization make it worth learning.

coveredGames.name: KICKSLAUGHT: Football Idle
coveredGames.title: A quirky football idle RPG with addictive progression and plenty of heart. Still rough around the edges, but fun, charming, and clearly improving with every update.

coveredGames.name: CrossCode
coveredGames.title: A great RPG with deep combat, charming characters, and fun puzzles. The difficulty ramps up nicely, with the DLC taking the puzzles to a very challenging level.

coveredGames.name: Fallen Leaf
coveredGames.title: A fun and varied platformer with multiple characters, secrets, and great movement. Some characters may get overlooked, but the easy achievements make 100% completion enjoyable.

coveredGames.name: Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo
coveredGames.title: A creative roguelike built around a yo-yo, with tons of clever movement, attacks, and puzzle ideas. Fun, inventive, and with no tedious achievements.

coveredGames.name: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault
coveredGames.title: A good roguelike with fun combat and item management, but some systems become obsolete near the end. It has depth, though some limitations hold it back.

coveredGames.name: Mandate Order
coveredGames.title: Taking time to organize supply lines, position buildings and prepare for seasonal disruptions leads to smooth growth and an excellent sense of accomplishment.

coveredGames.name: The Star Named EOS
coveredGames.title: The Star Named EOS - awesome approach to the storytelling and great writing makes this casual visual novel a really cool adventure.

coveredGames.name: Bō: Path of the Teal Lotus
coveredGames.title: This action platformer immerses players in a mythical world inspired by Japanese folklore. Enjoy stunning visuals, acrobatic combat, and a captivating soundtrack that elevates the experience.

coveredGames.name: Blazing Sails
coveredGames.title: The mix of land and sea combat creates dynamic battles, and the loot system adds a satisfying loop between matches.

coveredGames.name: Bendy and the Dark Revival
coveredGames.title: The stealth sections are tight, the Ink Demon scenes unnerving, and the environment oozes personality.

coveredGames.name: The Gold River Project
coveredGames.title: This game captures the feeling of a remote hiking trip perfectly. The visuals are stunning, especially during the fall season.

coveredGames.name: CarX Drift Racing Online 2
coveredGames.title: Starting from the career mode is a great way to learn the ropes. The progression feels natural, taking you from street meets to world-class pro events.

coveredGames.name: PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS
coveredGames.title: Vast maps, evolving loot, and intense close-quarters firefights create unforgettable, high-stakes experiences that keep players coming back for one more round.

coveredGames.name: Team Fortress 2
coveredGames.title: Team Fortress 2 remains a charming, fast-paced shooter with quirky humor and a thriving community.

coveredGames.name: Terraria
coveredGames.title: Terraria’s multiplayer freedom is unmatched - home-building, boss battles and endless exploration shine when teaming up with friends.

coveredGames.name: I Am Cat
coveredGames.title: I Am Cat nails the cozy-cat fantasy in VR. The environment is colorful, the physics are satisfying, and the sense of freedom to explore keeps me returning for more feline escapades.

coveredGames.name: Fursan al-Aqsa: The Knights of the Al-Aqsa Mosque
coveredGames.title: "Fursan al-Aqsa: The Knights of the Al-Aqsa Mosque" offers a unique look at the conflict in the region, combining elements of action and adventure with a deep theme.

coveredGames.name: Super Alloy Ranger
coveredGames.title: Boss battles are the highlight, each presenting unique mechanics and dynamic phases. Defeating them requires patience, pattern recognition, and smart weapon choices.

coveredGames.name: Rooftops & Alleys: The Parkour Game
coveredGames.title: Each challengein Rooftops & Alleys: The Parkour Game feels rewarding, and the sense of achievement after mastering a trick or completing a level is unmatched.

coveredGames.name: Maid of Salvation
coveredGames.title: A polished adventure. The weapon variety keeps combat fresh, and the skill board lets you craft a distinct playstyle. Worthy of any fan of dark fantasy action RPGs.

coveredGames.name: VTOL VR
coveredGames.title: VTOL VR is super old title, but the experience is still amazing and getting it's fair share of updates even up to this day. Absolute indie gem.

coveredGames.name: CarX Street
coveredGames.title: CarX Street - pretty good game that has some small flaws, but seeing it just released you can expect improvements with upcoming patches. What matters is core racing gameplay is done right.

coveredGames.name: Necrobarista
coveredGames.title: Another great novel here today, just this time it's a fairly new one and it's done entirely in 3D. The devs did a great job on storyline and personalities.

coveredGames.name: The Silver Case
coveredGames.title: The Silver Case is a great legacy worth checking out in modern times to see how great writing was back in the day and how bad it's now (hello there, Ubisoft).

coveredGames.name: Looper Tactics
coveredGames.title: We play as a hero who has attempted several times to pass through the dungeon but has never succeeded. We watch his history and attempt to put together the narrative.

coveredGames.name: Vendir: Plague of Lies
coveredGames.title: Vendir: Plague of Lies combat system is quite different from what you would expect when you see the game for first time, but overall it works fine.

coveredGames.name: Phoenotopia: Awakening
coveredGames.title: Phoenotopia: Awakening resembles the traditional 2D action platformer. The game design is flawless, with every pixel well drawn and animated.

coveredGames.name: GNOSIA
coveredGames.title: Imagine a deduction-based game, but not a multiplayer one. For a singleplayer experience this game got great storytelling and interesting characters.

coveredGames.name: BANCHOU TACTICS
coveredGames.title: BANCHOU TACTICS does an excellent job of capturing the essence of anime with a high school feel. The gameplay and music enhance the experience.

coveredGames.name: Swarm Grinder
coveredGames.title: Swarm Grinder - cool horde shooter that got a good amount of grind for you to do in order to get those juicy upgrades and powerups to obliterate the entire map.

coveredGames.name: Cluckmech Oasis
coveredGames.title: Fans of tower defense games should check out Cluckmech Oasis. As a new indie title it's really promising and holds an insane amount of potential. Let's hope the devs will support it for a long time.

coveredGames.name: TASOMACHI: Behind the Twilight
coveredGames.title: TASOMACHI: Behind the Twilight is heartwarming and casual adventure, with gorgeous visuals and level design. If you love this genre - check it out.

coveredGames.name: Nine Sols
coveredGames.title: Nine Sols' combat is unique, relying on parries over movement options. It's initially hard, but mastering deflections turns fights into satisfying combat, testing your timing and reflexes.

coveredGames.name: BOOK OF HOURS
coveredGames.title: BOOK OF HOURS falls in the category of casual entertainment, but this is not that simple as it looks. The gameplay is deep and interesting.

coveredGames.name: Party Animals
coveredGames.title: Party Animals is among the best and most fun family-friendly games. It's pretty easy to learn and enjoy can enjoy the gameplay together.

coveredGames.name: Space Beast Terror Fright
coveredGames.title: Space Beast Terror Fright is a bit of an old title, but the gameplay elements are still one of the best and the replayability is secured in this one. Have fun~

coveredGames.name: Nemesis: Lockdown
coveredGames.title: Nemesis series isn't something new, but this tabletop-to-videogame adaption is pretty cool, even newcomers can enjoy it (aka those who never played the original).

coveredGames.name: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon
coveredGames.title: If you want to try a fun indie open world RPG - Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon is there for you to do that. Pretty solid gameplay core and great visual design go together.

coveredGames.name: DRAINUS
coveredGames.title: DRAINUS is the greatest 2D shooter in years and an outstanding tribute to the genre, with some of the year's best pixel art visuals.

coveredGames.name: Kingdom Rush Vengeance - Tower Defense
coveredGames.title: There are so many heroes and towers to choose from that you won't have time to fully appreciate each one. However, the game is excellent as always.

coveredGames.name: Kingdom Rush Origins - Tower Defense
coveredGames.title: It's motivating and fulfilling to see how much effort and attention the developers put into the Kingdom Rush Origins to make it so much fun to play.

coveredGames.name: DEEEER Simulator: Your Average Everyday Deer Game
coveredGames.title: DEEEER Simulator is another crazy one title for today, where you will be doing an absolute madness and then fight some cool bosses.

coveredGames.name: Zero Caliber VR
coveredGames.title: Zero Caliber VR is among the best zombie shooters for virtual reality and there's also multiplayer options if you desire to try those.

coveredGames.name: Phantom Rose 2 Sapphire
coveredGames.title: The music, gameplay, and mechanics have all improved in Phantom Rose 2 Sapphire as a sequel, the game is still a high standard.

coveredGames.name: The Detective Reaper Invites
coveredGames.title: We had a great time playing The Detective Reaper Invites, which is an excellent way to pass the time. The gameplay is very enjoyable.

coveredGames.name: Breathedge 2
coveredGames.title: Exploring the distant edges of inhabited space in Breathedge 2 creates a strong feeling of isolation and discovery.

coveredGames.name: Tinkerlands
coveredGames.title: Tinkerlands offers a breezy survival adventure with clever crafts and charming NPCs. The world feels alive thanks to dynamic events and shared goals when playing co-op.

coveredGames.name: The Gold River Project
coveredGames.title: If you enjoy survival games with a narrative twist, this is for you. The Gold River Project combines realistic survival mechanics with a sci-fi mystery that keeps you guessing.

coveredGames.name: Mandate Order
coveredGames.title: Whether focusing on efficient production, population growth, or expansive construction, the game supports experimentation and creative ideas.

coveredGames.name: Another Try 2
coveredGames.title: Exploring this vast, desolate world on wheels opens up new strategies for survival and traversal, enhancing the overall game experience.

coveredGames.name: V.A.U.L.T. PROTOCOL
coveredGames.title: This is the kind of game where the best moments happen naturally. The missions feel tense because rewards are always balanced against real danger.

coveredGames.name: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check
coveredGames.title: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check perfectly blends management and survival. The graphics are great, and the UI is very intuitive.

coveredGames.name: CarX Drift Racing Online 2
coveredGames.title: CarX Technologies nailed the feel of the cars. Whether you are on a controller or a full rig, the feedback is intuitive.

coveredGames.name: EcoGnomix
coveredGames.title: EcoGnomix is a powerful reminder of the importance of ecological balance, serving both as a fun and education.

coveredGames.name: Laundry & Supermarket Simulator
coveredGames.title: Enjoy the comedic elements sprinkled throughout the game. It keeps the atmosphere light and fun amidst the chaos of laundry.

coveredGames.name: Best Served Cold
coveredGames.title: The diverse cast of characters is rich and complex, each bringing their own story and secrets to the bar.

coveredGames.name: Use Your Words 2
coveredGames.title: You can expect a dose of laughter and creativity anytime you get together with friends or want to have a fun time with "Use Your Words 2".

coveredGames.name: Automatic Kingdom
coveredGames.title: The game supports thoughtful, deliberate play with meaningful choices. It rewards patience and careful planning, which is exactly what I want from a strategy title.

coveredGames.name: Monster Lab Simulator
coveredGames.title: Monster Lab Simulator delivers a wonderfully relaxing vibe without sacrificing gameplay elements.

coveredGames.name: Table Battle Simulator
coveredGames.title: The core loop of collecting, displaying, and battling is incredibly satisfying. It scratches the itch for resource management and tactical combat in a compact, polished package.

coveredGames.name: Plane Accident
coveredGames.title: The learning curve can be steep at times, but overcoming the challenges feels rewarding. It'll be interesting to watch this genre evolve.

coveredGames.name: Creature Lab
coveredGames.title: Playing as a villainous scientist opens up so many creative avenues. It’s fun to embrace the dark side.

coveredGames.name: I Am Cat
coveredGames.title: The sandbox design encourages curious exploration, and the humor, charming visuals, and playful physics create a cozy, endlessly entertaining adventure.

coveredGames.name: Food Truck Simulator
coveredGames.title: A surprisingly soothing sim where patience pays off. Customizing your truck, crafting recipes, and chasing city-wide food scenes creates a cozy yet strategic culinary sandbox.

coveredGames.name: Heat Death: Survival Train
coveredGames.title: Immersive survival on a moving fortress. Heat Death: Survival Train and it's visuals deliver a moody, unforgettable vibe. Well polished product with good amount of content.

coveredGames.name: Offroad Mechanic Simulator
coveredGames.title: The game blends repair shop duties with adrenaline-pumping off-road trials. Customization options are plentiful, and watching upgrades translate into conquering muddy climbs is incredibly rewarding.

coveredGames.name: Winter Survival
coveredGames.title: Winter Survival exceeded my expectations. The pacing was perfect, the characters felt real, and the survival tactics were smart without being preachy.

coveredGames.name: Beloved Rapture
coveredGames.title: The battle mechanics are smooth and intuitive, allowing newcomers to dive in Beloved Rapture while offering depth for veterans.

coveredGames.name: Vietnam War
coveredGames.title: Vietnam War delivers an immersive experience that drops you right in the chaos of battle. The open-world design really makes you feel the vastness of the conflict.

coveredGames.name: Backyard Football '99
coveredGames.title: A delightful blend of strategy and action. Draft your dream team, weave plays, and enjoy the playful chaos on the field.

coveredGames.name: How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine
coveredGames.title: Perfect for players who love to strategize and work closely with others. With captivating gameplay it’s hard to put this game down.

coveredGames.name: Rooftops & Alleys: The Parkour Game
coveredGames.title: Participating in online competitions has been one of my favorite aspects. It keeps me returning to improve my skills. There’s always something new to challenge myself with.

coveredGames.name: BIGFOOT
coveredGames.title: Playing solo is fun, but teaming up with friends takes it to another level of enjoyment. There’s a great balance of horror and fun, it’s scary without being overwhelmingly terrifying.

coveredGames.name: Gas Station Simulator
coveredGames.title: The campaign and sandbox modes provide solid pacing. I liked how campaigns introduce new systems gradually, preventing overwhelm while preserving long-term goals.

coveredGames.name: GODBREAKERS
coveredGames.title: A kinetic blend of action roguelike and sci-fi fantasy. Gear and archetypes unlock satisfyingly, and the combo system demands precise timing.

coveredGames.name: Maid of Salvation
coveredGames.title: The mix of dodging, parrying, and chain moves creates engaging, rhythmic battles that reward experimentation and perfected timing against relentless foes.

coveredGames.name: Backyard Baseball '01
coveredGames.title: The classic stadiums are a nice nod to baseball history, with a playful twist. Quick plays are a breeze, but the season mode still offers enough depth to keep you engaged.

coveredGames.name: Oxygen Not Included
coveredGames.title: Oxygen Not Included rewards experimentation, patience, and careful foresight, delivering a uniquely satisfying sense of control and accomplishment.

coveredGames.name: Terraformers
coveredGames.title: Crafting interconnected cities across Martian biomes is endlessly rewarding, and the sense of discovery makes each playthrough addictive.

coveredGames.name: The Last Campfire
coveredGames.title: The Last Campfire invites curiosity with its puzzles, then rewards you with a tender, uplifting narrative that lingers in memory.

coveredGames.name: ULTRAKILL
coveredGames.title: ULTRAKILL turns every corridor into a test of reflexes and precision. It’s not just about shooting; it’s about fluid motion, perfect timing, and reading the battlefield like a master.

coveredGames.name: WitchHand
coveredGames.title: Card placement turns complex decisions into crisp, satisfying moments. The peaceful mode option is a nice inclusion for casual play sessions.

coveredGames.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2
coveredGames.title: Take the wheel of a truck, delivering cargo across Europe's beautifully recreated landscapes.

coveredGames.name: Train Sim World® 2
coveredGames.title: Simulate the life of a train conductor with exceptionally detailed trains and routes.

coveredGames.name: Beast Battle Simulator
coveredGames.title: This humorous simulation enables players to mix and match beasts in combat scenarios, yielding unexpected results.

coveredGames.name: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check
coveredGames.title: Realism is the keyword here. Everything in "Quarantine Zone: The Last Check" from the gear to the city streets feels authentic to the setting.

coveredGames.name: Human Host
coveredGames.title: The vast, editable world invites clever trap designs and building achievements that constantly reward patient, strategic play.

coveredGames.name: Cornucopia®
coveredGames.title: Cornucopia shines with delightful characters and varied activities—from farming to cooking to mini-games. Perfect game for casual gamers.

coveredGames.name: Abiotic Factor
coveredGames.title: The game excels at creating tension through restraint. Thoughtful level design, deliberate pacing, and a somber aesthetic make for a memorable, introspective journey.

coveredGames.name: Cafe Business Manager
coveredGames.title: Crafting dishes for different times of day and dietary preferences adds creative flavor to management duties, making me excited to experiment with new ideas.

coveredGames.name: CarX Drift Racing Online 2
coveredGames.title: The car customization is deeper than ever. Being able to fine-tune the ECU and gearbox allows for total control over how the car behaves on the track.

coveredGames.name: Dark Light: Survivor
coveredGames.title: Customization depth is impressive, with diverse classes and artifacts that empower a wide range of strategies.

coveredGames.name: I Am Cat
coveredGames.title: I Am Cat is a refreshing take on VR exploration. The game shines with charm, features clever puzzles, and rewards curiosity with playful surprises and irresistible cat-titude.

coveredGames.name: Concubine
coveredGames.title: The bazaar-like base-building is surprisingly satisfying, and the nudity options are tastefully integrated for those who want them.

coveredGames.name: Neptunia Riders VS Dogoos

coveredGames.name: Breathedge 2

coveredGames.name: The Gold River Project

coveredGames.name: Under Canopies

coveredGames.name: Satelital

coveredGames.name: Springs, Eternal

coveredGames.name: Brimir: Pilgrimage to the Heart

coveredGames.name: CELESTAY Craft & Slowlife

coveredGames.title: A cozy 1h puzzle game where you connect stars. There are 88 constellations to unlock, and no penalty if you connect the wrong stars. Cosmetics for your environment are unlocked as you solve levels.

coveredGames.name: Moonlit Cat Diner
coveredGames.title: I really love Moonlit Cat Diner. It gives you around 400 levels of various solitaire types, Shisen-Sho minigames and other puzzles to solve, all while listening to short lines from your cat customers.

coveredGames.name: Mystical II: Forgotten Knowledge
coveredGames.title: Quite an unique puzzle game with a simple mechanic, yet one difficult to master. Create pairs or trios of the same type by picking up falling tiles and artifacts on the board to meet the targets.

coveredGames.name: The Restoration Studio: Masterpiece Nonograms
coveredGames.title: A really good and relaxing nonogram puzzle where you restore 112 famous artworks bit by bit, each part representing a new level to solve using greyed out hints, mistakes checks and other QoL features.

coveredGames.name: Kitty Needs A Home!
coveredGames.title: A sweet and short (2-3 hours long) incremental game about matching shelter kitties with loving owners. It has a very smooth progression curve, forgiving prestige mechanics, and fits one cozy evening.

coveredGames.name: Hearsay
coveredGames.title: Hearsay offers you a unique challenge by making you sort 724 mystery cassettes across ten cabinets purely by ear without track titles or hints. To play it, you need strong musical recognition skills.

coveredGames.name: Not Another Garbage Simulator
coveredGames.title: A super satisfying and relaxing incremental game where you get to drive various garbage trucks around a litter-filled city and clean it up one sector at a time, while finding some hidden collectibles.

coveredGames.name: KickOff
coveredGames.title: Think of Punch Club, but with a football theme and a more simplistic approach to the mechanics. It's fun and addictive despite it still being quite buggy. At the start, progression is rather slow.

coveredGames.name: Not a Crow
coveredGames.title: Experience the heartwarming and a bit creepy adventure of a little crow through a mysterious world. It's a point and click full of charm, with easy puzzles and a very friendly, guided user experience.

coveredGames.name: TOMIDER
coveredGames.title: A chilling psychological horror adventure where you unravel a 1990s school tragedy. It's an interactive VN with an amazing presentation, a really good story and a super immersive gameplay. Only Ch 1.

coveredGames.name: Cloudy Day
coveredGames.title: A very lovely puzzle platformer that doesn't stress you with difficult-to-overcome obstacles, tight jumps, and enemies that you have to dodge. It's short and sweet, with 40 easy levels to beat.

coveredGames.name: Nomori
coveredGames.title: Nomori is a great game for those that like brain-teasing puzzle-platformers that play on perspective and gravity and don’t mind that its thin story and collectible tracking hold it back slightly.

coveredGames.name: キズツケ kizutsuke
coveredGames.title: Trapped in a room, you must inflict pain to survive. kizutsuke turns this dark premise into a deeply moving story about mutual care and guilt under extreme pressure. The game is free to play.

coveredGames.name: Sushi Day
coveredGames.title: A charming and cozy cooking sim where you run a sushi shop for humans and animals while fishing and tending for chicken. It's a very relaxing and wholesome experience, in the vein of Rogue Duck games.

coveredGames.name: Wands & Whiskers
coveredGames.title: A purr-fectly cozy idle cat collector with a very sweet chore mechanic of waving a wand to play with your adorable cats to level them up. Then find homes for them and decorate your shelters.

coveredGames.name: Puzzles Are Better Together
coveredGames.title: One of the best co-op jigsaw games on Steam due to its atmosphere and snappy mechanics. Building puzzles in a cozy 3D room feels less like a game and more like a warm hangout with distant friends.

coveredGames.name: Aika Was Supposed to Die
coveredGames.title: More episodic anime than VN, the game pairs dialogue with full-length, expressive videos. Decisions lock in permanently and carry real weight. Despite minor visual AI quirks, I really loved reading it

coveredGames.name: Side Quest
coveredGames.title: Side Quest is a hilarious, charming VN parody of RPG tropes. The intentionally crude MS Paint art style and witty dialogue make this a delightful, laugh-out-loud adventure. Chomp steals the show.

coveredGames.name: Big Bad Pharma
coveredGames.title: A cozy yet grindy first-person pharmacy sim where you need to place ~13k items back on their shelves. Satisfying shelf-sorting mechanic powered up by incremental upgrades and nice QoL features.

coveredGames.name: Tidy Up History
coveredGames.title: Tidy Up History is a great addition to the cozy cleaning simulator genre. You’ll get to sort antiquities and restore 16 themed museum rooms, all while learning bite-sized historical facts about them.

coveredGames.name: Harvest Exit Plan
coveredGames.title: If you enjoy games like Leaf it Alone, this game will be down your alley too. It's much more minimalistic (and AI-generated) but it has a great pace and progression. The 6 areas take 1.5h to complete.

coveredGames.name: Mazey Village
coveredGames.title: Mazey Village is a cozy adventure focused on exploration and decoration. Solve simple puzzles inside mazes and restore a broken town at your own pace, with just a slightly limited isometric camera.

coveredGames.name: Tiny Tape Store
coveredGames.title: Tiny Tape Store is a chill and nostalgic idler with lovely pixel art and great synth tunes. Run and decorate your own VHS shop in this adorable, cozy background game. Easy 100% achievements too.

coveredGames.name: Cloudgazer: A Game About Watching Clouds
coveredGames.title: A very chill game about finding hidden shapes among moving clouds. Every few seconds, a new shape appears, and the clouts make way to reveal it. No misclick penalty. Can be completed in around 1.2h

coveredGames.name: Gaslamp Cases 8: Quest for the Relic
coveredGames.title: Another charming addition to this Match 3 series. Morgan and Jack are summoned to investigate a series of calamities allegedly caused by Shiva's sacred relic being stolen. Same fun gameplay as ever.

coveredGames.name: A Short & Simple Pixel Love Story
coveredGames.title: A Short & Simple Pixel Love Story is a cute 2h kinetic romance VN about the ups and downs of modern dating. The protagonist's funny facial expressions and the cozy vibe make it a pleasant and fun read

coveredGames.name: Momento
coveredGames.title: Momento is a wholesome room-decorating puzzle game, full of heart. It blends cozy organizing puzzles with meaningful choices that shape Sam’s life. Sweet hand-drawn visuals and lots of replayability.

coveredGames.name: Swish Ball Clicker
coveredGames.title: Cool sports premise for a clicker, although it can get repetitive. The progression relies heavily on grinding, and tournament matches against AI feel feel weighted in their direction until end game.

coveredGames.name: Halloween Mystery: 100 Hidden Object Fruits
coveredGames.title: Not the best "100 hidden..." game. The unoptimized user experience quite ruins finding the 100 fruits and pumpkins across its 10 levels, but luckily there is an infinite hint that you can use.

coveredGames.name: Go North
coveredGames.title: Go North is a wholesome maze exploration game with a gorgeous atmosphere. Story and UI clunkiness aside, it felt like a calming journey I would recommend to those who love games like A Short Hike.

coveredGames.name: More fish - Idle Clicker
coveredGames.title: Despite its name, it's not an idle game. It's a short and relaxing incremental clicker game with satisfying progression. You hover pools of fish (instead of clicking them) to earn coins and pearls.

coveredGames.name: The Gray-Crowned Reincarnate
coveredGames.title: Short isekai VN made in Ren'Py (<10 mins playtime). Gorgeous AI-generated artwork but poor translation. There are a few choices and in-between them a few lines of text, leading to 4 different endings.

coveredGames.name: 魔法少女甜心3D Magical Girl Sweetheart 3D
coveredGames.title: The 3D sibling to Magical Girl Sweetheart, featuring the same pair-matching gameplay but with 20 new environments having the same yummy sweets aesthetic.

coveredGames.name: 魔法少女甜心 Magical Girl Sweetheart
coveredGames.title: A sweet sequel to PawRebuild games. Sort through mouth-watering pastries across 20 cozy levels to find pairs of the same desserts and transform a barren environment into an appetizing scene.

coveredGames.name: Gods of the Grid
coveredGames.title: A unique blend of match-3, roguelite, and RPG mechanics, wrapped in a rich Greek mythology theme. It’s both casual and tactical, as well as highly addictive and satisfying.

coveredGames.name: Miner Survivor
coveredGames.title: A fast-paced roguelite defense game where you mine ore deposits to build drones and towers against endless hordes of enemies. The UI is clearly designed for mobile phones and not well adapted to PC.

coveredGames.name: Dead Party
coveredGames.title: Up to 4 local (online) players must defend various locations in split-screen from attacking zombies in this sequel of Dead Block from 2011. Build barricades, shoot zombies.

coveredGames.name: iRacing Arcade
coveredGames.title: 3D arcade racer with a ton of tracks and cars, lots of single player options, online mode and races for up to 4 local drivers in split-screen.

coveredGames.name: Educational Family Games
coveredGames.title: Kid-friendly Mario Party clone for up to 4 local players/bots. Play 80 (!) minigames to earn crowns (and win the game). 5 boards, use phones as controllers.

coveredGames.name: Dino Party
coveredGames.title: A collection of 15 unique minigames across 35 maps for 2–4 (customizable) dinos (locally or online). Unlike other collections, these games are actually fun.

coveredGames.name: The Boo Croo
coveredGames.title: Up to 4 local/online ghosts must compete against each other or work together in a dozen mini-games to escape a haunted house (or simply score the most points). Use various items and unlock cosmetics.

coveredGames.name: Blasterbug: Last Bug Standing!
coveredGames.title: Fantastic FREE Bomberman clone for 1-8 local players/bots. 15 characters with different abilities, 15 maps, 5 game modes, additional minigames. Really good.

coveredGames.name: Jelly Bubble
coveredGames.title: Up to 4 local/6 online jellies push each other off the map, eat soap to grow, use special abilities. Map editor, only chinese online players.

coveredGames.name: Grizzy and the Lemmings - Crazy Party
coveredGames.title: Mario Party clone based on the animated series for up to 4 local players/bots. 50 mini-games, party mode with 5 boards and 6 additional game modes, lots of characters.

coveredGames.name: Bounty Brawl: Most Wanted
coveredGames.title: Hunt criminals in co-op in this action roguelike for up to 4 local/online bounty hunters. 8 unique characters, different weapons, special attacks.

coveredGames.name: Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate
coveredGames.title: Decent pixel art beat 'em up for up to 4 local or 8 online players. 38 characters with different moves, arcade/story/co-op/versus game modes.

coveredGames.name: Sky Scramble
coveredGames.title: In this simple arena combat game, up to 4 local players/bots must shoot each other down. Take out your opponents both whilst parachuting and on the ground as well. 3 planes, 5 arenas.

coveredGames.name: Animal Falling
coveredGames.title: 2–4 local/online players (no bots) set up obstacles before the race and then try to be the first to cross the finish line in this nice 3D Ultimate Chicken Horse clone.

coveredGames.name: Heroes of the Triangle: Mask Rush
coveredGames.title: 2 to 4 players on the scene must grab a mask, hold onto it for a certain amount of time, and then try to bring it to the altar to win—while the others try to do the same.

coveredGames.name: SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed
coveredGames.title: Parkour faster than your friends. Up to 4 local/8 online players, short single-player campaign. Quite similar to the first part. 8 maps, 4 characters.

coveredGames.name: Overball
coveredGames.title: Fast team-based Pong clone for up to 6 local players/bots. Various modes, extras, destructible defenses.

coveredGames.name: Alien Strike: Blasting the Intruders
coveredGames.title: Run and Gun in Contra style for up to 3 local players in co-op. One hit kills. Slide, jump and shoot (including direction lock).

coveredGames.name: Racc Game
coveredGames.title: Up to 8 local/online raccoons/bots have to kill each other. Grab a weapon, jump, shoot. 26 maps, 24 weapons. Similar to Duck Game.

coveredGames.name: Hostile Lands
coveredGames.title: Free your crew and build your hub in this roguelike twin-stick shooter for up to 4 local players/no bots. Lots of characters with unique skills to play, lots of weapons to try out.

coveredGames.name: Night Slashers: Remake
coveredGames.title: Beat em up for up to 4 local players. Large sprites, four playable characters with different moves, janky animations, buggy hitboxes, strong bosses. Quite average.

coveredGames.name: Choppy Cuts
coveredGames.title: Hair salon simulation in Overcooked style for up to 4 local/online hairdressers. Cut, wash and dry hair, bring a coffee and sweep the floor in co-op. Campaign, different characters.

coveredGames.name: Nitronauts
coveredGames.title: Low-res Bomberman clone for up to 6 local players/bots. Nine unique stages with some quite brutal environmental dangers, deceased players can continue as ghosts and re-enter when they kill someone.

coveredGames.name: SOS OPS!
coveredGames.title: Up to 4 local (8 online) emergency responders have to fight various emergencies in split-screen in this funny ragdoll game with similar controls to Human Fall Flat.

coveredGames.name: Sunderfolk
coveredGames.title: A turn-based role-playing game for up to 4 local players who use their smartphones as controllers (or online). Play through a campaign, just like a tabletop role-playing game evening. Boring alone.

coveredGames.name: Bang Average Football – Play, Manage, Create
coveredGames.title: Sensible Soccer-like arcade football game for up to 4 local players with vs, co-op and tournament modes. Single player campaign, quite a lot of options. Quite good.

coveredGames.name: SpaceBoots
coveredGames.title: Up to 10+ local players/bots fly around in gravity with thruster boots and kill each other with various weapons. 6 maps, 4 modes, cling to the wall with the magnet in your boots.

coveredGames.name: DreamWorks Trolls Remix Rescue
coveredGames.title: Up to 4 local Trolls have to save the Troll Kingdom and defeat an evil musiscian. Kid-friendly isometric action platformer with mini-games. Bad camera control in multiplayer, rough and buggy.

coveredGames.name: Paddle Paddle Paddle
coveredGames.title: Up to 4 local/online rowers race an inflatable boat through treacherous waters in split screen. If they hit an obstacle even once -> back to the checkpoint. Single, co-op + vs modes.

coveredGames.name: Cursed Blood
coveredGames.title: Up to 4 local (no Steam Remote Play) guardian apes hack and slash their way through a Mafia controlled town in this roguelike action title.

coveredGames.name: Off the Beaten Track
coveredGames.title: Kill your foes in this space arena battler for up to 4 local/online players/bots. Select from 14 characters with different stats, 22 arenas, secondary and ultimate weapons, 2 game modes.

coveredGames.name: Shop Town Dooter
coveredGames.title: Kill your foes in this arena twin-stick shooter for up to 4 local players/bots in 3 game modes - team, FFA or 1 boss against the rest. Throw stuff, buy weapons, randoized maps.

coveredGames.name: Blade Blitz
coveredGames.title: Up to 6 local players/bots in 2 teams have to swing their swords to render the other team members incapacitated and run through the door in 5 levels.

coveredGames.name: Shoresy: Legends of the North
coveredGames.title: Licensed hockey arcade game for up to 4 local players. Defeat the 6 hockey gods in single player story mode or play a pure sports game in local multiplayer. Skate, boost, bodycheck, shoot.

coveredGames.name: Monaco 2
coveredGames.title: Up to 4 local(online) players/no bots in split-screen try to steal valuable stuff from high-security locations in this stealth heist game. Play alone, online or on a large screen to see anything.

coveredGames.name: Wigged Out
coveredGames.title: Early Access sports game for 2 teams and up to 4 local/online players/bots. Different levels, environmental dangers, various weapons and wigs.

coveredGames.name: Roombattle
coveredGames.title: Up to 6 customizable local/online vacuum cleaners/no bots battle in various rooms and compete in a few minigames between the rounds. Powerups, traps - no bad!

coveredGames.name: TactiCats
coveredGames.title: Up to 4 local cats/bots have to fight each other in 4 game modes. 8 power-ups, 16 different maps. Jump, roll, shield, taunt, use powerups.

coveredGames.name: Little Toys
coveredGames.title: Up to 4 local players in split-screen have to race against each other and 8 bots in this (offline, UE5 powered) Fall Guys clone with 16 (unlockable) maps and some pickups.

coveredGames.name: Rotwood
coveredGames.title: Up to 4 local/online heroes/no bots have to explore the forest in this roguelite Hades clone. Bring home loot and improve your hub and your heroes.

coveredGames.name: Zoo Time
coveredGames.title: Up to 4 local players have to take care of their (physic-based) zoo animals... feed and wash them, train with them, avoid their poo in this average Overcooked clone.

coveredGames.name: WIZARD PUNKS!!!
coveredGames.title: Up to 4 local wizards/bots have to combine elements to craft spells and then shoot the other wizards. Use a shield to defend. Simple visuals, but the different spells are fun to use.

coveredGames.name: Kick
coveredGames.title: An interesting runner in which your task is not only to overcome obstacles, but also to guide a soccer ball through them. Stylish, interesting and unusual.

coveredGames.name: No Such Place
coveredGames.title: An isometric extraction shooter with interesting mechanics and lots of points of interest. It's not perfect, but it's exciting and has a lot of potential for development.

coveredGames.name: Gaslamp Cases 12: The Silent Codex
coveredGames.title: Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of mysteries and dark secrets in a new game in the Gaslamp Cases series. Investigate the mysterious death of a professor and complete many puzzling fun match3 levels

coveredGames.name: THANKS, LIGHT.
coveredGames.title: A beautiful first-person puzzle game with impressive and diverse locations and an interesting concept of working with light and shadow. It's playable and interesting.

coveredGames.name: Capy of Gods
coveredGames.title: A vertical roguelike platformer with mechanics from the survivors genre. Retro pixel style, interesting mix of mechanics and addictive gameplay.

coveredGames.name: Sleepytime Village
coveredGames.title: A small point-and-click adventure with an interesting story about a workaholic father who got into children's storybook. Classic mechanics and a touching story.

coveredGames.name: Noctiria
coveredGames.title: An atmospheric roguelike horror game with deck construction and a pleasant dark style. Six different heroes with their own story, fascinating gameplay and an interesting story.

coveredGames.name: Delicious - Recipe for Renewal
coveredGames.title: A casual game in the genre of time management dedicated to fast food restaurants. Classic mechanics, ever-increasing difficulty and pleasant style.

coveredGames.name: Ammossum
coveredGames.title: An engaging roguelike with a large number of crazy mechanic combinations and its own atmosphere. You will have to upgrade your train and develop a special tactic for each enemy.

coveredGames.name: Brave New Wonders
coveredGames.title: A strategy based on automation with pleasant graphics and addictive gameplay. You will need to configure AI automatons and teach them the functions you need. Interesting and engaging.

coveredGames.name: Peacemaker: Bloody Emperor
coveredGames.title: A classic JRPG set in a dark fantasy universe. A pleasant game with a decent story that isn’t groundbreaking but can brighten up a couple of evenings.

coveredGames.name: Volkolak: The Will of Gods
coveredGames.title: A stylish, dark metroidvania with Souls‑like elements, set in a Slavic fantasy atmosphere. Beautiful animation, an interesting branching plot, and challenging, hard combat.

coveredGames.name: Remy Thornfield: Royal Dreams
coveredGames.title: A classic match3 adventure with improved graphics and interesting mechanics that make the gameplay more challenging. Fantasy setting, a simple and cute story, and many interesting, diverse levels.

coveredGames.name: The Merry Fairy
coveredGames.title: A cute game dedicated to keeping a scrapbook journal. Cozy, creative, with pleasant graphics, animation, and atmosphere.

coveredGames.name: Age of Emerald
coveredGames.title: A classic match‑3 game in a fantasy setting. More than two hundred levels, many power‑ups and mechanics, and an interesting story about building a city. A classic visual style and addictive gameplay.

coveredGames.name: Untrusted: hackers at large
coveredGames.title: A hacking adventure involving entering code into the command line. Atmospheric, interesting, and with thrilling cyberattacks. As realistic as possible hacking mechanics.

coveredGames.name: Pivot of Hearts
coveredGames.title: A romantic Brazilian visual novel in an anime style, with its own unique atmosphere and card game elements. A classic plot about growing up and the search for love.

coveredGames.name: OverRider
coveredGames.title: A stylish beat-em-up with the ability to capture enemies and use their abilities. A pleasant cyberpunk style and interesting mechanics.

coveredGames.name: Peckers
coveredGames.title: A clicker in a low-poly style with fascinating and addictive gameplay. An endless adventure with constant development that doesn't get boring for a long time.

coveredGames.name: Lawn Care Simulator
coveredGames.title: Chill simulator of lawn mowing. You will have to develop your company and cut different areas. Nice graphics and relaxing gameplay.

coveredGames.name: Sous Raccoon
coveredGames.title: A cooperative chaotic restaurant simulator with roguelike elements. Very cute style, lots of fun and high difficulty.

coveredGames.name: Gaslamp Cases 9: The Ghost of Autmaton City
coveredGames.title: Match3 adventure in the Automaton city on the edge of magic and technology, which continues the detective series Gaslamp Cases. Nice graphics, interesting story and lots of classic fun match3 levels.

coveredGames.name: The Farm of the Living
coveredGames.title: An interactive adventure set in a zombie apocalypse setting. You will face difficult decisions and forks that affect the history and fate of people.

coveredGames.name: Mini Mini Golf Golf
coveredGames.title: An interesting sci-fi story told in the form of golf puzzles. It's a good idea and the game has a nice style and gameplay.

coveredGames.name: Backyard Baseball
coveredGames.title: A fun arcade baseball game with lots of interactive maps and fun features. It looks great and is interesting to play, there is a split screen mode to play together.

coveredGames.name: Gaslamp Cases 8: Quest for the Relic
coveredGames.title: A trip to India with an interesting plot and a great twist of classic match3 gameplay. A continuation of a series of casual detective games with a pleasant atmosphere and classic fun mechanics.

coveredGames.name: Express Rider Simulator
coveredGames.title: Try yourself as a motorcycle deliveryman. You will have to monitor your rating, improve and repair the motorcycle. Lots of realistic details and an already playable gameplay.

coveredGames.name: The Shadow
coveredGames.title: An interactive thriller with a dark atmosphere and decisions affecting the development of the plot. You will have to confront a dark cult and escape, if possible. Non-linear, replayable, atmospheric.

coveredGames.name: Tormentum II
coveredGames.title: A stylish and dark point-and-click adventure with horror elements, hand-drawn. An interesting story and a lot of impressive dark art.

coveredGames.name: Femme Fatality
coveredGames.title: A slightly crazy and at the same time interesting game in which you have to develop an anime girl who kills only men. Great soundtrack, fun minigames and its own special atmosphere.

coveredGames.name: Delicious - Taste of Truth
coveredGames.title: Classic casual time management with a storyline that takes you through six different restaurants where you have to complete a series of tasks. A consistently strong game in its genre.

coveredGames.name: Trackastrophe!
coveredGames.title: A puzzle based on laying railway rails in a cute casual style. It's easy to learn and addictive at the same time. A little game for relaxation.

coveredGames.name: The Brewline
coveredGames.title: A moonshine magnate simulator in which you have to both develop production and ensure sales by shooting off competitors. Two games in one and lots of fun.

coveredGames.name: Amanda's Magic Book 7: The Way of Belaii
coveredGames.title: Casual match3 adventure with nice simple retro graphics and lots of interesting match3 mechanics. You will have to embark on another magical journey and complete many interesting levels.

coveredGames.name: GAME The Strongest Job Is Apparently Not a Hero or a Sage, but an Appraiser (Provisional)! ~Dungeon and Mystery Girl~
coveredGames.title: A dynamic bullet hell with roguelike elements made from fresh anime and manga. Beautiful art, lots of anime references, plot inserts and dialogues. Overall, it's fun!

coveredGames.name: Bounty Brawl: Most Wanted
coveredGames.title: Cute action game with roguelike elements. 8 different characters with different mechanics and combos, a cooperative with an interesting opportunity to betray after killing the boss, and lots of fun

coveredGames.name: Kamikaze Empire
coveredGames.title: An energetic schmoop who uses kamikaze attack mechanics in addition to the standard ones. Bright fast gameplay, different characters with their own special fighting style and nice retro graphics.

coveredGames.name: Case Files: Internal Affairs
coveredGames.title: FMV is a detective story in which you have to investigate the case and find out the truth. Good acting and an interesting story in which your choice matters.

coveredGames.name: Evil Girls Party!
coveredGames.title: Classic hentai JRPG with a fascinating plot and quite intense battles. Three difficulties to choose from, you can challenge your skills. Lots of hot diverse hentai scenes.

coveredGames.name: Whirlight - No Time To Trip
coveredGames.title: A classic quest in a pleasant visual environment. Charismatic characters, a story about saving the world, not always logical but interesting puzzles and a cozy visual style.

coveredGames.name: Tidy Bakery
coveredGames.title: Very cozy and polished tidying up game with an incredibly adorable cat (helper). The placement / throwing mechanic works fabulously. Speedrun *and* no-skills achievements: at least 2 playthroughs.

coveredGames.name: Museologist: Tidy Up the Museum!
coveredGames.title: No-pressure tidying up game. Reassemble exhibits by placing each piece in its correct place. Both regular ol' dinosaurs and various fantasy creatures are covered. No active skills for 100%: difficult.

coveredGames.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor
coveredGames.title: Not the best survivors-like by any measure, but the one I come back to most often. DLC class adds an entirely new input archetype (tank controls are truly rare in the genre). Lots of cheevos to hunt.

coveredGames.name: Angel Clicker
coveredGames.title: Story-heavy 3–5 hours incremental game with entertaining (& reference-filled) writing, varied artwork, and rather swift linear progression (you won't get stuck or wait too long for resources).

coveredGames.name: Mistpaw Ravine
coveredGames.title: Cute cat-themed city builder/colony sim with a small environmentalist twist (and no fail states). What it lacks in replay value it makes up for with charm and food-themed cat names.

coveredGames.name: Road to Empress I
coveredGames.title: Palace harem intrigue steeped in the history of Tang Dynasty China. High-quality mostly-linear FMV full of kill-or-be-killed situations with a proper English translation. Can't wait for the sequel.

coveredGames.name: Magical Girl ER
coveredGames.title: Strange medical simulation where you examine & treat Magical Girls injured in Kaiju disasters. With limited hospital beds & stamina, decide who to accept, who to refuse, which treatment to choose.

coveredGames.name: Plum Road Tea Dream
coveredGames.title: (Demo Available) Surreal Point & Click Adventure full of unsolved mysteries, abstract puzzles, hostile monsters, and horrors that lurk in the shadows, if tampered with, of course.

coveredGames.name: Venice After Dark
coveredGames.title: (Demo Available) discover a surreal Venice in point& click adventure. Solve a variety of puzzles, chat with quirky characters, uncover the mystery surrounding the Stucky family.

coveredGames.name: Moon River
coveredGames.title: (FREE) Short explorative RPG focusing on music and atmosphere (and perhaps a few secrets). Explore the remains of a strange, quiet, empty world and find the river's end.

coveredGames.name: Dicedus
coveredGames.title: Gather bizarre dice & artifacts to battle in silly contests of wit for the title of Supreme Mage. Each game offers a unique experience, explore all the combinations & forge your own playstyle.

coveredGames.name: Broken Reality 2000
coveredGames.title: Return to the world of NATEM in a quirky new adventure! Explore bizarre realms, solve puzzles with novel tools, and meet eccentric locals in a secret-filled digital universe to find someone special.

coveredGames.name: STICKER/BALL
coveredGames.title: (Demo Available) a pool game roguelike from the future. Fire balls. Hit dice. Earn points. Add stickers. Trigger crazy combos. Battle a gauntlet of weird opponents. Enjoy the chaos, it’s on purpose.

coveredGames.name: Cyberdelia: Micro
coveredGames.title: Psychedelic, retro-inspired RPG where drugs are your best friend. You play as Xaxis, a cyberdelic robot sent to a spiritual land to prevent the end of the world.

coveredGames.name: Be Missed and Remembered: The Letter from Mayoiga
coveredGames.title: Do not enter the mountains: you will be cursed. A Japanese folklore Visual Novel Adventure set in a nostalgic 1970s summer, written by Tomo Kataoka (Narcissu). "We meet again, after 1,827 days."

coveredGames.name: Truck-kun is Supporting Me from Another World?!
coveredGames.title: Drive a magical truck indebted to a buff isekai elf in your head! Hit pedestrians as Truck-kun, make deliveries, and defeat the Skeleton King in a silly, chaotic anime driving game with heart.

coveredGames.name: Nippon Marathon 2: Daijoubu
coveredGames.title: (Demo Available) Cause chaos across Japan as you race through bizarre, physics‑driven obstacle courses. Outsmart your friends in a competitive, silly party racer that tests reflexes & friendships.

coveredGames.name: Blue Wyrm
coveredGames.title: Short (60~ minutes) psychedelic first-person souls-like with a retro aesthetic and skill-heavy combat system. Do you have what it takes to save your wife in the crypt of the Blue Wyrm?

coveredGames.name: The Dreams in the Peacock House
coveredGames.title: Surreal, short narrative game blending text adventures, VNs, and P&C mechanics. Wake from an endless slumber, find mystic eyes to unlock the Sanctum Sanctorum, and uncover lost, blissful dreams.

coveredGames.name: goblinAmerica
