coveredGames.title: В Realm of Taiwu приходится искать способ исправить судьбу мира, где победила тьма. Путешествие духа Хуаньсина связано с поиском десяти древних клинков — необычная основа для мрачного фэнтези.

coveredGames.name: CELESTAY Craft & Slowlife
coveredGames.title: Здесь развитие дома идёт рука об руку с исследованием космоса и открытием созвездий. Крафт задаёт понятную цель, а умиротворённый тон делает игру хорошим вариантом для неспешных вечеров.

coveredGames.name: Space Savory
coveredGames.title: Space Savory подаёт космический быт с чёрным юмором: сомнительная чистота заведения — лишь часть странной атмосферы. За вывеской закусочной скрываются мрачные секреты, а вокруг — безмолвная галактика.

coveredGames.name: Kings of Antikva
coveredGames.title: В Kings of Antikva важно не только расставить бойцов, но и просчитать скрытые намерения соперника. Захват флага превращается в тактическую дуэль; можно играть онлайн по рангу или против ИИ.

coveredGames.name: Bruisers 2D Boxing
coveredGames.title: Пиксельный бокс с ролевым развитием: начинаешь с любительских поединков и постепенно пробиваешься к профессиональным титулам. Нравится идея карьеры снизу вверх, а ретро-подача задаёт игре характер.

coveredGames.name: Calculate It
coveredGames.title: В игре собираешь свою схему вычислений, комбинируя кнопки с пассивными эффектами. Приходится беречь заряды и ходы, а боссы со своими правилами заставляют менять привычный подход к каждому забегу.

coveredGames.name: Spy Drops Gaiden
coveredGames.title: Spy Drops Gaiden напоминает классические 8-битные экшены, но управляется заметно плавнее. Сочетание ретро-стиля с более современным темпом делает знакомую формулу свежей, не теряя старого духа.

coveredGames.name: Architecture & Design
coveredGames.title: В Architecture & Design меняешь планировку и сразу видишь, как перестраивается 3D-модель: стены, крыша и лестницы подстраиваются автоматически. Удобный способ продумывать дом без сложного софта.

coveredGames.name: Hypernet Explorer
coveredGames.title: Hypernet Explorer сочетает исследование огромной башни с необычными занятиями — от гаданий до торговли душами. Альтернативный 2001 год, где магия заменяет технологии, задаёт игре особый характер.

coveredGames.name: Whispers Of The Shadow
coveredGames.title: В Whispers Of The Shadow приходится изучать тревожные локации, искать записи и прятаться от опасности. Свечи и фонарик помогают продержаться, а сюжет и мелкие детали усиливают атмосферу ужаса.

coveredGames.name: Big Market Simulator
coveredGames.title: A new simulator game about managing a modern supermarket! Realist gameplay with plenty of daily tasks, hire employee, order new products..'Big Market Simulator' deserve your attention. Demo available.

coveredGames.name: DinoBones: Tidy Up the Museum
coveredGames.title: Работа здесь сводится к поиску и сборке разбросанных костей в полноценные скелеты динозавров. Около 2000 деталей превращают уборку в масштабный процесс, а собранные экспонаты раскрывают тайны музея.

coveredGames.name: Tunnelborn
coveredGames.title: Копание здесь превращается в постоянную борьбу с самой пещерой: она движется вместе с игроком, поэтому одно неверное движение может закончиться окаменением. Простая идея, но с жёсткой ценой ошибки.

coveredGames.name: Starforge Pirate
coveredGames.title: Аркадный рогалик строится вокруг быстрых космических боёв, где приходится следить за нагревом оружия и одновременно развивать корабль. Создание безумного оружия добавляет простора экспериментам.

coveredGames.name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
coveredGames.title: Основа здесь всё та же защита от волн, но новые башни и герои заметно расширяют варианты тактики. Яркие уровни, боссы и фирменный юмор дополняют привычный формат.

coveredGames.name: Throttle Trace
coveredGames.title: Здесь гонка строится всего на газе и тормозе, поэтому особенно важны сцепление, момент торможения и выбор тактики. Каждый поворот превращается в отдельную борьбу за позицию.

coveredGames.name: DIG Raiders: Anomaly Extraction
coveredGames.title: Кооперативный формат строится на прокладывании пути взрывами и исследовании подземных руин в поисках пришельцев. А найденных существ можно заставить работать в собственном инопланетном квартале.

coveredGames.name: 33 Days till Extraction
coveredGames.title: Здесь привычная стрельба сочетается со способностями, а процедурная генерация зон меняет каждую экспедицию. При этом игра сохраняет собственную яркую подачу, не превращаясь в безликий рогалик.

coveredGames.name: False Hero
coveredGames.title: Бои строятся вокруг атак и смертоносных комбо, поэтому каждое столкновение требует точности. Сложные битвы с боссами дополняются выбором стороны — богов или апостола Смерти.

coveredGames.name: Alexis Almighty: Daughter of Hercules
coveredGames.title: Здесь в центре истории — Геракл, которого злой бог времени превращает в старика. Сюжет строится вокруг спасения героя, а сама завязка с Хроносом задаёт игре необычный конфликт.

coveredGames.name: OZARK
coveredGames.title: Изометрический хоррор - формат хорошо подходит для шутера в загадочном бункере и поиска секретов корпорации. Отдельный плюс — локальный кооператив, где к прохождению может присоединиться друг.

coveredGames.name: Knuckle Jet
coveredGames.title: Ракетный кулак задаёт необычную основу боёв, а настраиваемое снаряжение позволяет менять подход. Скрытые награды и совместный хаос хорошо дополняют этот странный джетпанк-мир.

coveredGames.name: Police Chief Simulator
coveredGames.title: Роль начальника полиции сочетает расследование дел с управлением персоналом и развитием участка. Повседневные задачи по поддержанию порядка создают ощущение полноценной работы. Отличный сим 9/10.

coveredGames.name: World of Tanks
coveredGames.title: A genuinely fun experience. Would recommend giving it a try.

coveredGames.name: Elite Dangerous
coveredGames.title: Glad I tried this one. Fun, enjoyable, and definitely worth the time.

coveredGames.name: Dead by Daylight
coveredGames.title: Really solid game. Kept me entertained and I enjoyed every bit of it.

coveredGames.name: Warhammer: Vermintide 2
coveredGames.title: Had more fun with this than I expected. Definitely a good experience.

coveredGames.name: Back to Bed
coveredGames.title: Easy to enjoy and hard to complain about. Solid game overall.

coveredGames.name: Battlefield™ 6
coveredGames.title: This turned out to be a lot of fun. Definitely worth picking up.

coveredGames.name: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced
coveredGames.title: Nothing but good things to say. Had fun and would happily recommend it.

coveredGames.name: Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector
coveredGames.title: Really enjoyed my time with this one. Worth checking out for sure.

coveredGames.name: Fast Food Simulator
coveredGames.title: Fun game with a nice overall feel. I can easily recommend it.

coveredGames.name: Baldur's Gate 3
coveredGames.title: Had a really good time with this. Definitely glad I gave it a chance.

coveredGames.name: Voxel Playground
coveredGames.title: Sneaking around guards, cracking the vault and blowing holes through walls makes for great and enjoyable gameplay.

coveredGames.name: Farmer's Diary
coveredGames.title: Farmer's Diary strikes a fantastic balance between cozy rural atmosphere and deep management.

coveredGames.name: Iron Blight
coveredGames.title: Opening a stuck door or fumbling with magazine rounds while horrors approach will make your heart skip a beat. The sense of isolation and creeping doom in this setting is great.

coveredGames.name: Barfender: CO-OP Bar Simulator
coveredGames.title: Barfender understands that teamwork becomes funniest when things go crazy. One prepares drinks, another cleans and someone handles brawls, creating fun stories that are easy to laugh about afterwards.

coveredGames.name: Under Canopies
coveredGames.title: This is exactly the kind of relaxing open-world game casual gamers can enjoy. There is plenty to do, but the peaceful atmosphere lets players move at their own pace and enjoy every moment.

coveredGames.name: CELESTAY Craft & Slowlife
coveredGames.title: The steady resource gains and visible construction progress provide motivation while preserving the game’s peaceful, pressure-free atmosphere.

coveredGames.name: Escape from Vlogger: Runaway
coveredGames.title: Moving quietly, choosing hiding places and anticipating danger give the stealth mechanics an appealing layer of strategy.

coveredGames.name: The Merlies
coveredGames.title: There is something magical about climbing electrical cables, bouncing from mushrooms, and exploring abandoned pipes as tiny birds.

coveredGames.name: WE ARE FOOTBALL 2027
coveredGames.title: Building a career beyond familiar leagues is especially appealing when the simulation treats the wider world seriously.

coveredGames.name: 33 Days till Extraction
coveredGames.title: Enemy types, events, rewards, and procedural environments keep changing, while gear, perks, and abilities give players plenty of control over their preferred approach.

coveredGames.name: Breathedge 2
coveredGames.title: The combination of an ordinary protagonist, artificial intelligence, an immortal chicken, and heroic amounts of duct tape captures the game’s eccentric charm brilliantly.

coveredGames.name: Magical Blush
coveredGames.title: Switching elements, chaining attacks and reading enemy behavior turns each encounter into an enjoyable test of skill.

coveredGames.name: Vacation Cafe Simulator
coveredGames.title: Every prepared meal, happy customer, and sensible investment brings the dream restaurant one step closer.

coveredGames.name: SeaColony
coveredGames.title: Limited space encourages thoughtful layouts, while new technologies provide clear goals and satisfying improvements.

coveredGames.name: All Your Wrestling Pro Manager
coveredGames.title: Taking charge of one of thirty companies provides good variety. Each new role feels like another chance to shape a roster, build momentum, and prove yourself as a wrestling executive.

coveredGames.name: Infinitevania
coveredGames.title: With a strong focus on discovery and character growth, Infinitevania captures the appeal of classic exploration-driven adventures while offering enough variety and momentum.

coveredGames.name: Echoes of Mystralia
coveredGames.title: Choosing how to construct spells adds strategic depth without slowing down the energetic pace of each encounter.

coveredGames.name: The Dream Office
coveredGames.title: There is something instantly appealing about transforming an ordinary office into a personal dream workspace.

coveredGames.name: Mandate Order
coveredGames.title: Building an efficient settlement while responding to changing conditions provides a rewarding long-term challenge.

coveredGames.name: Stellar Warfare
coveredGames.title: The combat controls feel smooth and intuitive, making large engagements easy to understand despite their strategic complexity.

coveredGames.name: Laundering Simulator - Clean Cash and Laundry
coveredGames.title: This is a fun indie title with a lot of personality. The gameplay loop is relaxing but still engaging, and the comedy makes it stand out.

coveredGames.name: SWAT Commander
coveredGames.title: AI squad command system adds a lot to the gameplay. Giving orders, managing movement, and keeping the team disciplined makes each operation feel strategic and satisfying.

coveredGames.name: [HERROR] Gas Station Case
coveredGames.title: The concept is immediately gripping: a lonely night shift, missing people nearby, and a mysterious case found by a friend.

coveredGames.name: Arctic Shift: Fuel Station
coveredGames.title: Arctic Shift: Fuel Station has a relaxing rhythm, but it still keeps you alert. Power issues, inventory needs, and weather changes make each day feel different and interesting.

coveredGames.name: Not Monday Cafe
coveredGames.title: A wonderful cozy idle management game with a lot of heart.Staff handle things smoothly, and I can pop in between tasks to harvest, cook, upgrade, and decorate.

coveredGames.name: Manor Lords
coveredGames.title: A medieval city builder with very pretty graphics, that doesn't require a super computer to play, unlike the new cities skylines game, it has some great gameplay and has a very promising future.

coveredGames.name: Neko Station
coveredGames.title: Neko Station feels like a moving cat cafe in pixel form. Feeding, petting, and photographing the cats makes every little visitor feel special.

coveredGames.name: Detective Hayseed - The Cloning Madness
coveredGames.title: The mystery unfolds with satisfying twists, and the pacing never drags. A cozy, entertaining game that feels lovingly crafted.

coveredGames.name: CarX Drift Racing Online 2
coveredGames.title: Career mode is deep and engaging. Earning your way through the ranks feels like a real achievement.

coveredGames.name: Doki Doki Literature Club Plus!
coveredGames.title: Immersive, unsettling, and strangely comforting at times. The Plus edition improves pacing and adds meaningful content without diluting the core atmosphere. A masterclass in VN genre.

coveredGames.name: Touhou Luna Nights
coveredGames.title: Touhou Luna Nights was out before Deedlit, but even with this game you can clearly see that the devs manage to create an amazing metroidvania in the Touhou universe.

coveredGames.name: MEMOLITH: Forsaken by Light
coveredGames.title: You’ll sprint into danger, then calmly execute a well-timed strategy that turns a likely defeat into a hard-fought victory.

coveredGames.name: Do You even Forklift?
coveredGames.title: Do You even Forklift? blends comedy, charm, and clever puzzles into a memorable experience.

coveredGames.name: Trader Life Simulator: Together
coveredGames.title: A genuine comfort title for couch co-op sessions.Traders Life Together nails the feel of running a small business with friends.

coveredGames.name: The Gold River Project
coveredGames.title: Beautiful wilderness, tense survival moments, and smart puzzles make The Gold River Project feel like a living, breathing adventure.

coveredGames.name: Dark Dominion
coveredGames.title: Dark Dominion is great when it comes to mood and craftsmanship. Must-play for fans of souls-likes.

coveredGames.name: Summer’s Heartbeat
coveredGames.title: The game charms from the first scene, weaving warm summer vibes with brisk dialogue and meaningful decisions.

coveredGames.name: Dating 4 Girls
coveredGames.title: Dating 4 Girls emotional arcs are well-written, and the multiple endings give genuine incentive to replay. Highly enjoyable and thoughtfully executed.

coveredGames.name: Real Estate Simulator 2
coveredGames.title: The renovation tools are intuitive, and the market simulation adds meaningful pressure, making every purchase feel like a potential blockbuster profit.

coveredGames.name: Cafe Business Manager
coveredGames.title: As you expand floors and add suppliers, the gameplay opens up with meaningful decisions and clearer long-term goals.

coveredGames.name: ArcheAge Chronicles
coveredGames.title: ArcheAge Chronicles is a solid and fun dark fantasy action-rpg with enjoyable MMO style gameplay: raise your characters and guild, various quests, intense soul-like combat, in EA with more to come. ++

coveredGames.name: Mosaique Neko Waifus 6
coveredGames.title: Уютная встреча с кошками неожиданно затягивает: крутишь плитки, подбираешь бонусы и постепенно открываешь навыки. На сложных пазлах приходится подумать, а выборы и разные сборки дают повод вернуться.

coveredGames.name: Space Savory
coveredGames.title: Space Savory, a weird and fun scifi simulator about cooking foods and aliens..for aliens client! Lovely cartoon animation, fun gameplay with mini-games, hilarious situation and conversation.Must play~

coveredGames.name: Sword & Siege Age of Longbow: Volume I
coveredGames.title: An impressive tabletop strategy wargame, "Sword & Siege Age of Longbow: Volume I" bring the 100 years conflict and all its complexity, from environment, units and placement, management..recommended

coveredGames.name: The Ash Remembers
coveredGames.title: The Ash Remembers is a quality idler/clicker rpg indie game with anenjoyable progression system, a good tutorial and pleasant graphism and UI..fun gameplay loop, plenty of tasks..highly recommended!

coveredGames.name: SkyChart: Airline Executive
coveredGames.title: 'SkyChart: Airline Executive' is a neat airline company management game with rich gameplay mecanism, different eras, historical events and challenge..In Ea with regular update, demo available. 10/10

coveredGames.name: CELESTAY Craft & Slowlife
coveredGames.title: CELESTAY (Craft&Slowlife) is a neat tower builder game with relaxing gameplay..diverse activities to build each floors, trade, fish..cute artstyle and fun to play..a great title on the idle category!

coveredGames.name: Great Northern War
coveredGames.title: "Great Northern War" is a solid tactical wargame about the russian and european conflict: Manage troops, fight harsh environment, army placemment (cavalery, artillery, infantry) and raise your empire!

coveredGames.name: Jarred Defense
coveredGames.title: Jarred Defense is a lovely TD/Puzzler game about building maze and defense to fight waves of enemies and bosses, variety of cosmetic items, towers, achievement, leaderboard, level editor..ton of fun!

coveredGames.name: Kingdoms vs Zombies
coveredGames.title: Kingdoms vs Zombies is a bright, fast-paced and fun Defence strategy game with roguelike mecanism! Build and protect your base against hordes of zombies, manage your soldiers, random upgrade..neat!

coveredGames.name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
coveredGames.title: 'Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD' is probably our favorite TD game: a good story with interesting new challenge, diverse upgrade, new heroes and leveling system, game mode.. active dev team, a must play.

coveredGames.name: American Revolutionary War
coveredGames.title: Replay an important part of America's history with this great tactical wargame "American Revolutionary War" bring rich and complex scenario, skirmishes and campaigns (different scales).. recommended!

coveredGames.name: Police Chief Simulator
coveredGames.title: Take the role of new Police Chief! a life sim with daily activities to maintain order in your city, different tasks, cases to investigate, manage staffs and upgrade your place..realist and fun!

coveredGames.name: The Crust
coveredGames.title: 'The Crust' (in ea) is an excellent SF colony builder management game with solid factory/automation element, exploration and decision making, a good story too..Game in ea with regular update, play it!

coveredGames.name: Gacha Capsule Shop Simulator - Akihabara
coveredGames.title: A truly fun and addictive shop management game! "Gacha Capsule" is a cozy game about preparing your store, collect precious items, help from robot staff, decorate, fun anime culture reference..lovely!

coveredGames.name: Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders
coveredGames.title: Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders is a great investigation adventure with a good plot to unfold, find and combine evidence, interesting characters development..Great adaptation, recommended

coveredGames.name: Italian Pizza Simulator
coveredGames.title: Italian Pizza Simulator offer a good tutorial to learn all the mecanism, prepare ingredients, stir sauce, fulfill specific client request and make perfect pizza, design your box..game is truly great!

coveredGames.name: Imperial Wager: The Shattered Crown of Augustus
coveredGames.title: Imperial Wager (The Shattered Crown of Augustus) is an original civ strategy game: minimal map, efficient UI and complex mecanism with political decision, conquer, some idle element..for connoisseur~

coveredGames.name: STARVAULT VR
coveredGames.title: STARVAULT is a well made 5vs5 MOBA-style hero shooter game build for VR finally on steam, different heroes and playstyle, a good mix of competition and cooperation, great replayability too..a 10!

coveredGames.name: Aksun
coveredGames.title: Aksun (game in ea) is an excellent, brutal and dark hack'n'slash game with roguelite mecanism, satisfying combo and neat combat system, shamanism folklore inspired..more content to come, a must play!

coveredGames.name: Angels Fall First
coveredGames.title: 'Angels Fall First' is a great FPS that offer intense combat (on spaceship, ground, vehicule..) multiplayer and with friends (support bots mode too) fun progression and various upgrade..solid gem~

coveredGames.name: Backyard Baseball
coveredGames.title: 'Backyard Baseball' is a colorful arcade sport game faithful to the original game! polished gameplay with ton of fun and humor, cards to collect, pleasing visual, good voice acting..a great remake!

coveredGames.name: The Pigment
coveredGames.title: 'The Pigment' is a choice-based Visual Novel style adventure game with a well written storyline, different path, tense exploration and progression, different quests..a strange but worthy experience!

coveredGames.name: The Meridian
coveredGames.title: 'The Meridian' is an upcoming text centered rpg-adventure with a simple UI, its well written with multiple choice and progression (relationship, investigation..) A classic.

coveredGames.name: Beauties and the Stranded
coveredGames.title: Latest title from storytaco studio,"Beauties and the Stranded" is a lovely Full Motion Video dating sim adventure that bring romance, different endings and pretty actresses, an original plot too..nice

coveredGames.name: Human Host
coveredGames.title: 'Human Host' is a fun and addictive survival adventure game: wild exploration in a large apocalyptic world to scavenge ressource, use customisable vehicule to go further, some rpg element..a good one~

coveredGames.name: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check
coveredGames.title: 'Quarantine Zone: The Last Check' is a well executed concept: a good campaign or endless mode, test for potential infected survivors, fun mini-games, deadly decision to make and silly humor too..great

coveredGames.name: Life Below
coveredGames.title: A welcome aquatic ecosystem builder strategy game with a good narrative and campaign, "Life Below" offer interesting mecanism, build house for cute wildlife creature, unlock new biomes..peaceful game.

coveredGames.name: Pebble Knights
coveredGames.title: Pebble Knights is a fantastic, chaotic and highly fun couch-party action roguelike game, easy to pickup gameplay, skills and leveling system, great bosses to fight, solo or better with teamate..top!

coveredGames.name: Yandere Maid~Love-Crazed Maid~
coveredGames.title: A good game that combine a strong atmosphere, a fine plot to unfold (different endings) a cute and sometime invasive maid, exploration, puzzle and stealh element.."Yandere Maid" is truly intriguing!

coveredGames.name: Hobby Horse
coveredGames.title: Ride your fake and highly customisable horse, and race acroos plenty of tracks!! (come with a level editor), obstacles and secrets, highscore chasing and items to unlock.."Hobby Horse" is truly fun!

coveredGames.name: Project: Mist
coveredGames.title: After a long developement,"Project: Mist" is close to ea release: An olschool and creepy survival game with strong atmosphere and classic mecanism (upgrade your equipment, loot and craft, quests..) A+

coveredGames.name: Genome Guardian 2
coveredGames.title: Genome Guardian 2, the turret-style twin-stick roguelite shooter is back! A great emphasis on weapons customisation with ton of upgrade, different game mode, pleasing neon-visual..fantastic game!

coveredGames.name: WonderLang Korean
coveredGames.title: WonderLang Korean, a fun way to start learning korean through enjoyable adventure RPG game.. a colorful world and narrative with puzzle, quests to improve vocabulary, grammar, language recognation..

coveredGames.name: Beer Manufacture Simulator
coveredGames.title: Beer maker, this is your game! Adjust each formula and ingredient to create unique beer flavour! Manage your chain production, machinery, timing, earn clients review, entertaining sim game..10/10.

coveredGames.name: BULT: Hunting simulator
coveredGames.title: 'BULT: Hunting simulator' is a quite unique and immersive hunting game: track and hunt small prey, a strong and realistic approach (wind, noise, bird behavior) earn money to unlock new equipment..top!

coveredGames.name: Mosaica: Arboreal
coveredGames.title: 'Mosaica: Arboreal' offer a beautiful art-style, easy to pickup gameplay about combining pieces to solve puzzle, light rpg element (abilities to unlock, items to collect)..demo available, play it~

coveredGames.name: Heroines Through My Lens
coveredGames.title: A light and modern korean FMV/ dating simulator game "Heroines Through My Lens" offer beautiful live scene, each chapter introduce interesting situation, choice-based progression and sexy ladies~

coveredGames.name: Concubine
coveredGames.title: Concubine is an excellent hack'n'slash rpg game with beautiful heroine fighters, enjoyable combat with distant action, magic, and close combat, leveling and equipement system., sexy customisation..++

coveredGames.name: Toy Smash Kaboom!
coveredGames.title: 'Toy Smash Kaboom' is a must play! Manage, build, arrange and combine your tiny toy army, unlock various skills, items and traps, fight in autobattler combat system,lovely cartoony design..ultra-fun!

coveredGames.name: Potion-making: Path of the Alchemist
coveredGames.title: 'Potion-making: Path of the Alchemist' is a lovely tabletop-like adventure game about preparing magical potions! A great sense of liberty to experiment, create recipes, use various ingredients..sweet!

coveredGames.name: ArcheAge Chronicles
coveredGames.title: Здесь приятно чередовать вылазки с ремеслом: после напряжённого боя возвращаешься к торговле и обустройству дома. Прокачка раскрывает новые связки, боссы опасны, а разные занятия удерживают надолго.

coveredGames.name: Space Savory
coveredGames.title: What an odd game! A surreal adventure game about cooking not-so-delicious aliens! Space Savory mix dark comedy, quality hand-draw graphism, easy to pickup gameplay with a fun progression..indie gem!

coveredGames.name: The Ash Remembers
coveredGames.title: 'The Ash Remembers' is an impressive dark RPG idler with engaging gameplay, a certain learning curve to learn all the mechanism, combat and unlock..active dev team and regular update. Recommended.

coveredGames.name: CELESTAY Craft & Slowlife
coveredGames.title: CELESTAY is a clicker/idle game about building pretty towers! Collect ressource, catch fishes, craft materials and build.. beautiful pixelated art style, smooth gameplay..highly recommended.

coveredGames.name: American Revolutionary War
coveredGames.title: ARW is an impressive and dense tactical turn-based wargame about epic and deadly conflict that build the usa.. manage army, placement, ressource,moral.. strong decision making that lead to victory!

coveredGames.name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD

coveredGames.title: A stylish side-scrolling action RPG with weighty combat, striking animations, and a grim atmosphere. Loot and crafting add replay value, but the unclear UI and lack of guidance make progression needly

coveredGames.name: EQUILIBRIUM
coveredGames.title: Typing government orders is a novel, engaging way to manage a country, especially when news creates timely opportunities. Crisis pacing is harsh, and many actions still lack clear, tangible effects.

coveredGames.name: ForgeTax
coveredGames.title: A clever, inexpensive roguelite about forging absurdly valuable swords under pressure. It delivers a fun few hours, though shops, variety, and long-term goals need more depth.

coveredGames.name: Cosmo Cat: A Cozy Desktop Idler
coveredGames.title: A cozy desktop idle companion built around a floating space cat, focus timers, and constellation collecting. Customization and daily records add charm, though active gameplay is minimal.

coveredGames.name: Cordels & Spells
coveredGames.title: A compact action roguelite with striking cordel-inspired art, Brazilian folklore, and satisfying build experimentation. The campaign is short, but weapon and perk variety keep runs engaging.

coveredGames.name: Proyecto Huemul
coveredGames.title: A brief survival horror experience built around stealth, scavenging, and an Argentine conspiracy. The atmosphere is effective, though navigation, combat, and presentation need more polish.

coveredGames.name: Seekers Alliance: Hero's Journey
coveredGames.title: Its three-lane card battles offer a fresh spin on deckbuilding, with hero skills and upgrades creating satisfying turns. Balance issues and limited encounter variety hurt replayability.

coveredGames.name: Void Pachinko
coveredGames.title: A compact pachinko incremental with satisfying peg-and-ball synergies, smart upgrades, and a relaxing audiovisual style. Its five-stage campaign is short, but the progression stays engaging.

coveredGames.name: Princess Maker: Children of Revelation
coveredGames.title: The stat-building loop captures the appeal of classic raising sims, with attractive art and plenty of secrets. Progress can feel slow, while replaying for endings often turns into save reloading.

coveredGames.name: Re:Blade
coveredGames.title: Hover over enemies, shape a build through awakenings, and grind raids for progression. The first runs are enjoyable, but identical weapons and repeated loops weaken the long-term hook.

coveredGames.name: Nientum - Op.ZERO
coveredGames.title: A theatrical rhythm adventure with striking art, expressive music, and a compelling mystery. Its two-button charts are approachable but light, making the story and presentation the real draw.

coveredGames.name: Colorbound
coveredGames.title: A charming puzzle adventure built around coloring the environment to create paths. Clever single-screen challenges, lovely pixel art, and a heartfelt music-focused story make it easy to recommend.

coveredGames.name: Anime Girls: Climb Together
coveredGames.title: A colorful multiplayer climbing racer with traps, power-ups, and a forgiving checkpoint system. The competitive chaos is fun, but imprecise collision and weak landing feedback need work.

coveredGames.name: CELESTAY Craft & Slowlife
coveredGames.title: A cozy incremental game with satisfying visual growth as each new floor expands the sea-bound home. Fishing, collectibles, and a small unfolding story add welcome purpose.

coveredGames.name: Under a Desert Sun: Seekers of the Cursed Vessel
coveredGames.title: Atmospheric top-down action RPG blending WWII Egypt, tomb raiding, and undead hordes. Responsive combat, worthwhile loot, and local co-op stand out, though the UI needs work.

coveredGames.name: Undying Flame
coveredGames.title: A compact fire-defense roguelite with relic-driven builds and an idle option. Its core loop is compelling, but unclear resource rules and rushed upgrade screens hurt accessibility.

coveredGames.name: PEGTURE: Peg Solitaire Roguelike
coveredGames.title: A clever peg solitaire roguelike where special pegs, passive cards, and combo planning turn a simple board game into a satisfying score-chaser.

coveredGames.name: Click & Curate: Idle Photography
coveredGames.title: An approachable blend of idle progression, collecting, and light gallery-building strategy. The photography theme is well used, though the available content runs out quickly.

coveredGames.name: Horizon Ring
coveredGames.title: An incremental tower defense game with satisfying economy-versus-firepower decisions and loadouts that support distinct builds. Early systems take time to grasp, but challenges add strong replay value

coveredGames.name: TRUDGE
coveredGames.title: A slow, cryptic pixel adventure about escaping an empty routine. Its oppressive city atmosphere and deliberate environmental storytelling make patience feel rewarding.

coveredGames.name: EON Survivor
coveredGames.title: A fast, demanding roguelite shooter with meaningful ship progression and a wide range of weapons. Mission hazards and boss fights add welcome tension to the core survival loop.

coveredGames.name: Technically Frogs Can Fly
coveredGames.title: A goofy but well-designed frog platformer with fishing, mining, gambling, and surprising perk combinations. The short loop suits quick sessions, while the art and hidden finds give runs character.

coveredGames.name: Dealer's Dice
coveredGames.title: A dice-driven incremental tower defense game with active placement, rerolls, and satisfying build choices. Runs stay varied through randomness, though early unlocks can be slow.

coveredGames.name: Crazy Pocket
coveredGames.title: A clever roguelike pool game where ball abilities and chalk multipliers create satisfying score-chasing combos. Forgiving physics and a low price make it easy to enjoy.

coveredGames.name: Wobble Ops!
coveredGames.title: A beginner-friendly precision platformer built around timed jumps, movable objects, and frequent checkpoints. Its short length and occasionally awkward grabbing make it best for a casual session.

coveredGames.name: Liminal Heist
coveredGames.title: First-person liminal horror built around sound-based stealth. The shifting mansion and blind monster create real tension, while weapons and wall markings add welcome options.

coveredGames.name: ZPF
coveredGames.title: A colorful Genesis-style horizontal shmup with strong pixel art, great music, responsive controls, and satisfying shop-driven upgrades. The PC release is barebones, but the six-stage campaign is fun.

coveredGames.name: Pragma Twice
coveredGames.title: A demanding JavaScript puzzle game about programming a robot through increasingly flexible challenges. Building a reusable toolkit makes progression especially satisfying.

coveredGames.name: Permafrost
coveredGames.title: Really enjoying Permafrost! Beautiful graphics and I love the relaxed Story Mode. Only tried solo. On Steam Deck OLED, FSR/FG didn't work, but Decky Framegen fixed it with FSR 4.1.1 and FG!

coveredGames.name: SILENT HILL: Townfall
coveredGames.title: Great Silent Hill 2-like atmosphere! Runs well for UE5. Steam Deck OLED: 30–40 FPS with some dips below 30. ROG Xbox Ally X Z2E runs very smoothly. Hopefully updates improve performance!

coveredGames.name: WheelMates
coveredGames.title: It's just like It Takes Two, but then on wheels. Nice game with minigames to play with a friend.

coveredGames.name: Crimson Moon
coveredGames.title: Brutal and fun, with awesome finishers! I played with a controller, so no issues with keybinds. One of the rare new games that runs well on Steam Deck OLED. Highly recommended!

coveredGames.name: METAL GEAR SOLID 4: Guns of the Patriots - Master Collection Version
coveredGames.title: Finally we can play Metal Gear Solid 4 on the Steam Deck with good performance.

coveredGames.name: The Lord of the Rings: War in the North™ - Legacy Edition
coveredGames.title: One of the better classics! War in the North gets a great new life with this polished Legacy Edition. Runs excellently on the Steam Deck OLED. A fantastic way to revisit Middle-earth!

coveredGames.name: Pax Autocratica
coveredGames.title: Pax Autocratica has a great mix of game styles, solid and satisfying gunplay, and runs surprisingly smooth—even on lower-end hardware like the Steam Deck. Definitely worth playing!

coveredGames.name: Big Walk
coveredGames.title: Big Walk is a fun co-op game that's best enjoyed with friends. My only issue is that my friend's mic was too quiet. A mic volume option would make communication much better.

coveredGames.name: Beast of Reincarnation
coveredGames.title: Recommended! Souls-like combat with difficulty options, making it more accessible. Great graphics and solid performance on my handhelds, except Steam Deck OLED. Worth playing!

coveredGames.name: The Ranchers
coveredGames.title: Relaxing solo farming sim with a nice open world that keeps things fresh. Driving feels a bit awkward, and I had a server issue creating my first world. Still a fun game with lots of potential!

coveredGames.name: Halo: Campaign Evolved
coveredGames.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved looks great, had no bugs or crashes, runs decent on all my handhelds, and cloud saves work flawlessly. Highly recommended for Halo fans!

coveredGames.name: Dinoblade
coveredGames.title: Dinoblade is a unique dinosaur Souls-like with a fun concept—who doesn't love dinosaurs? Runs well on Steam Deck with decent FPS, though it can be a bit choppy at times.

coveredGames.name: Shift At Midnight
coveredGames.title: Shift At Midnight is a fun and simple horror game that's easy to pick up and enjoy. The atmosphere keeps you on edge, and I really appreciate that it includes a single-player mode.

coveredGames.name: Tears of Metal
coveredGames.title: Tears of Metal is a fun Scottish hack & slash with a great art style, insane battles, rewarding upgrades, and unlockable characters. A blast for action fans!

coveredGames.name: DIVE or DIE - Children of Rain
coveredGames.title: If DAVE THE DIVER had a very dark cousin who skipped the sushi bar, you'd get DIVE or DIE - Children of Rain. 😄 The atmosphere is fantastic, and danger lurks around every corner.

coveredGames.name: EverRail
coveredGames.title: EverRail feels like Snowpiercer with extraction gameplay. Great train, energy and base-building mechanics. Looting is fun but gets repetitive. Hopefully later areas add more variety.

coveredGames.name: ZeroSpace
coveredGames.title: ZeroSpace is a fantastic RTS with a great campaign and skirmish mode. Even in Early Access it's excellent, and the full release promises to be even better!

coveredGames.name: Cycling Champion
coveredGames.title: Fun little cycling/card game! Enjoyable, but a bit too easy. I'd love a harder difficulty. If you're a cycling fan, it's definitely worth checking out!

coveredGames.name: Denshattack!
coveredGames.title: Feels like Subway Surfers, but faster—you are the train! Great variety, smart checkpoints, fun alternate routes, and even boat surfing keep every run fresh. Highly recommended!

coveredGames.name: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced
coveredGames.title: Ubisoft did a great job with this remake! Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced looks fantastic, plays great, and runs well on different handhelds. A must-play for AC fans!

coveredGames.name: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales
coveredGames.title: Modern Link's Awakening vibes, just like other reviews say—it really is! Great exploration and combat. Lower the assist voice in settings and it's no issue. Highly recommended!

coveredGames.name: Sudden Strike 5
coveredGames.title: Sudden Strike 5 proves why this series has lasted so long. I've played every Sudden Strike and Hidden Stroke game, and they've never disappointed. Another great WWII strategy experience.

coveredGames.name: Dead as Disco
coveredGames.title: Dead as Disco is a great rhythm beat-'em-up with awesome music, satisfying combat, and a fantastic art style. The stylish levels make every stage a joy to play.

coveredGames.name: Fatekeeper
coveredGames.title: Beautiful graphics and strong Dark Messiah vibes. Early Access has 2–3 hours of content, but at this price the full game could be a steal. Skip Steam Deck. Handhelds like Legion GO runs it well.

coveredGames.name: MECCHA CHAMELEON
coveredGames.title: MECCHA CHAMELEON is a unique and fun hide-and-seek game with a creative concept. I'm enjoying it so far and hope the developers add controller support in the future!

coveredGames.name: Voidling Bound: Creature Evolution Shooter
coveredGames.title: Voidling Bound is an interesting game with fun combat, meaningful progression, and cool creatures. Linear levels, wave battles, and bosses keep it engaging. Only 1 hour in, but I'm eager for more!

coveredGames.name: Gothic 1 Remake
coveredGames.title: Gothic 1 Remake nails the original's atmosphere and nostalgia with stunning graphics. Ran well on most handhelds, though the Steam Deck OLED struggled. A fantastic remake for fans and newcomers alike

coveredGames.name: Arms of God
coveredGames.title: Gory Brotato-like action with a great art style. Brutal, fun, and highly addictive.

coveredGames.name: Killer Bean
coveredGames.title: Fun Matrix-style action; a bit buggy, but the solo dev is actively fixing it.

coveredGames.name: Supraworld
coveredGames.title: Fantastic puzzle game! Explore every corner for solutions, sometimes they’re right in front of you. Take breaks if stuck. 7h in, combat is light, focus is puzzles & discovery.

coveredGames.name: World War Z
coveredGames.title: World War Z VR is a solid zombie shooter with huge hordes and smooth High settings on my RTX 4080 Super. No crashes, but sad there’s no multiplaye. Still great for solo action!

coveredGames.name: Whisper Mountain Outbreak
coveredGames.title: Whisper Mountain Outbreak feels like classic survival horror, reminiscent of Resident Evil Outbreak. Great puzzles, but only 1 scenario with 8 levels so far. I hope more are added soon!

coveredGames.name: Mafia: The Old Country
coveredGames.title: Mafia: The Old Country delivers a slow-burn story in a stunning, detailed world. Every scene feels alive, making it a must-play for fans of rich storytelling.

coveredGames.name: Titan Quest II
coveredGames.title: Plays like the original but looks way better. Runs beautifully on RTX 4080 Super, lowest settings on Steam Deck OLED. Best in VR with UEVR. Seeing the world around you is amazing!

coveredGames.name: Recharge: Room Games
coveredGames.title: Recharge is a fun RC racing game with smooth controls, nice tracks, solid online play, and great car customization. Only issue: no car sound in online mode, but it works fine in single-player.

coveredGames.name: WUCHANG: Fallen Feathers
coveredGames.title: WUCHANG runs fine on Steam Deck OLED (30–40 FPS) and great on Legion GO. Combat feels fair, even for Souls-like newbies. Definitely worth a try, even on handhelds or mid-range systems.

coveredGames.name: Killing Floor 3
coveredGames.title: Great gunplay, awesome graphics, and smooth on Steam Deck OLED & Legion GO. Old-school fun!

coveredGames.name: RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business
coveredGames.title: RoboCop: Rogue City – Unfinished Business delivers more of the same solid gameplay, and honestly, that’s exactly what I wanted. If you liked the base game, this is a no-brainer.

coveredGames.name: Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition
coveredGames.title: Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition brings back a game I missed as a kid. Glad it's finally on Steam—beautiful visuals, tons of missions, and more updates planned. Big thanks to the devs!

coveredGames.name: Dungeons & Dragons Neverwinter Nights 2: Enhanced Edition
coveredGames.title: Great to see NWN2 on Steam! Runs smooth on Steam Deck OLED, controller support works great, graphics improved—classic RPG fun with no issues. Happy this gem is back!

coveredGames.name: After the Wane
coveredGames.title: 🩰 Lena comes to Paris to dance and learn about her missing mother 🌙 As a mysterious voice guides her, what path will she choose❓

coveredGames.name: UBAI Ending
coveredGames.title: 💍 As Ryousuke gets involved with Kasumi and Shizune, a man claiming to be Ubai's CEO delivers a shocking ultimatum 🎭 What secrets lie behind Ubai, and what future will Ryousuke choose❓

coveredGames.name: Rose Guns Days -Season 1-
coveredGames.title: 🗾 Leo returns to a Japan under American and Chinese occupation 🌹 Rose helps Japanese people find work and a place to belong 🔫 Can they protect their community without giving in to the gangs❓

coveredGames.name: False Myth 2
coveredGames.title: ⚔️ While accompanying Nagi to Valdia, Rouge rescues Sylphina from attackers 🛡️ Her emotions are sealed away 💔 Who is hunting her, what do they want, and can Rouge protect her❓

coveredGames.name: Princess Ilyana: Night of Falling Grace
coveredGames.title: ⚔️ With the Demon King defeated, the fragile peace is over! 👑 Old rivalries return, and men plot to claim Ilyana and Serina ♨️ Can Edmond stop their schemes before the heroines fall❓

coveredGames.name: Sacrifice Sanctuary: The Ritual Maiden's Life With Monsters
coveredGames.title: 🌸 Sent to Hell to control a dangerous monster population, Yomi is thrilled to be their sacrifice! 🐉 Explore caves, mate with monsters, and raise their offspring 💕 Can she find happiness there❓

coveredGames.name: Sister Compass: Slow Life Loving with My Sisters on a Deserted Island
coveredGames.title: 🏝️ Injured while exploring dungeons, an adventurer retires to a deserted island with his two loving sisters, Al and Miu 💕 But is his recovery their only goal, or do they want him all to themselves❓

coveredGames.name: Five Nights with Maids
coveredGames.title: 🏰 A night guard job promises a fortune for just 5 days 💰 Hired to watch the mansion's maids 📹 you soon face their seductive teasing 💋 What nightmare hides behind their charming looks❓💀

coveredGames.name: Island of Rebirth~NTR and Love~
coveredGames.title: 🏝️ Callum Island returns after 900 years, trapping amnesiac Rick with Sienna and Mila ✨ As love deepens and Netorase tests their bonds, how far will his choices change them❓

coveredGames.name: Lord Liberty Quest II ~Pure White~
coveredGames.title: ⛪ When the knights guarding an ancient seal are massacred, young priestess Konoha is sent to investigate ⚔️ As the Black Devil's resurrection approaches, can she uncover the conspiracy in time❓

coveredGames.name: Do Disciplinary Committee Members Dream of Succubi?
coveredGames.title: 🏫 During a school patrol, Iroha finds Lily, a succubus, and unwittingly forms a pact 💋 She must gain erotic experience to grow stronger ⚔️ Can she win the proxy war without betraying her morals❓

coveredGames.name: Sengoku Rance
coveredGames.title: ⚔️ Rance comes to Nippon for hot springs and ends up leading the Oda clan 🏯 Driven by women, sex, war, and conquest 👹 can this shameless scoundrel really bring peace to Nippon❓

coveredGames.name: Tunnel Escape Fates Entwined
coveredGames.title: 🧟‍♀️ Police officer Olivenia enters an infected city on an escort mission 🔫 but soon finds clues linking survivor Beatrice to a mysterious biological weapon 🧪 What caused the outbreak ❓

coveredGames.name: Trap Yuri Tempest
coveredGames.title: 🌸 A rebellious femboy gyaru is forced into a relationship with the academy’s elegant “Prince” 💢 They clash from the start 💕 but how long can they keep denying their growing feelings ❓

coveredGames.name: Stranded with You
coveredGames.title: 🌊 Shipwrecked with tomboy childhood friend Mitsuki 🏝️ Survive together and deepen your bond 💗 Will you leave the island as friends, lovers, or an openly exhibitionist pair❓

coveredGames.name: Fuyukuru. - Winter winds, adieu? -
coveredGames.title: ❄️ Death is temporary, yet Shihon cannot return 🔪 Yuuhi must find her missing head before it is too late 🧬 Who wanted her permanently dead, and why❓

coveredGames.name: Tentacle Locker 2
coveredGames.title: 🏫 Girls roam the school while tentacles lurk in lockers, pools & hidden traps 🐙 Catch and corrupt your victims without alerting nearby girls 👀 How many can you capture before they flee❓

coveredGames.name: Koikata: How Our Love Grows
coveredGames.title: 🏫 Koikata turns a school merger into 6 personal stories 🔀 Ren helps students protect what matters to them 💞 As those bonds deepen, which heroine will become the one he chooses ❓

coveredGames.name: The Too-Cute Girl Who Moved in Next Door
coveredGames.title: 💔 Yuki targets his abusive former boss’s wife for revenge 🔥 As Keiko grows closer to him, will he choose love and marriage 💍 or send her into prostitution for revenge ❓

coveredGames.name: Strong-Willed Wife
coveredGames.title: 💍 An ordinary husband lets his gorgeous, athletic wife try sex with a powerful, well-endowed man 🖤 Once he takes control, how far will she change under his influence❓

coveredGames.name: Babu Me Baby!
coveredGames.title: 💼 Overwork pushes Haruki to his limit 🌀 Sakura tries hypnosis, but her therapy makes him act like a baby in a grown man’s body 🍼 How far will she go to help him recover❓

coveredGames.name: Alice and the Devil's Prison
coveredGames.title: 🫖 A demon splits Alice, Anya & Lisa after their tea party and traps them in a lethal mansion 🔐 Can their wishes reunite them or seal their fate ❓

coveredGames.name: The Forbidden Tomes of Olipos
coveredGames.title: 📚 Romina, a busty librarian, catalogs books in Fulah, her childhood village 🔮 She accidentally frees daemons Olipos and Zahal, who steal her magic ⚔️ Can she reclaim it and learn the truth❓

coveredGames.name: The Demon King: Harem
coveredGames.title: 👑 An ordinary man dies saving a child and awakens as a Demon King, building a harem to restore his mana, indulge his desires, and defend monsterkind ⚔️ Can lust and loyalty end the war❓

coveredGames.name: B-Prison Unchain
coveredGames.title: 😈 Asmodeus escapes into Chastity Rock and grows stronger by feeding on its inmates ⚔️ Can Misa, the Demon King’s strongest officer, capture him before the prison’s factions corrupt her first ❓

coveredGames.name: The Dungeon of Lulu Farea: Rebirth
coveredGames.title: 👾 Cruellus enters Lulu Farea not for its divine relics, but to win the monster girls’ hearts and build his dream harem without killing a single monster 💚 Will they ever love him back❓

coveredGames.name: World Tree Ranch: Elven Legacy
coveredGames.title: 🌳 You awaken amnesiac in an all-female elf village whose future depends on you 🌱 Farm, earn their love, and help them have children 💞 Can you restore the World Tree and save their home❓

coveredGames.name: Summer Days in the Joyful Countryside
coveredGames.title: 🌻 Aina, Reina, and Yuina return to their manga-artist uncle’s rural home with homework and shameless plans 🔥 Will he finish his manga, or give in to the three sisters❓

coveredGames.name: Poem of the Starherd
coveredGames.title: 🌙 Helios or Selene starts over in Solar with no memories, a Spirit ranch, and a town full of possible partners 🌾 Will they build a family, recover their past, and restore the missing moon❓

coveredGames.name: Summer Sisters
coveredGames.title: 🌻 Yuu returns to his childhood countryside town and stays with Hana, Rina, and Hina for summer break 💕 What new memories will he make with them and the locals❓

coveredGames.name: Karigurashi Ren'ai: Living on Borrowed Love
coveredGames.title: 🏠 Takuma returns to his childhood town, only to find his old home unlivable 💕 As his childhood friends take him in, will this new closeness turn into romance❓

coveredGames.name: Splash Shot Golf Legend
coveredGames.title: ⛳ Forced by his grandfather to inherit Raccoon Country, Hiroshi knows nothing about golf, until its beautiful visitors give him a reason to stay 💦 Will the course become his new playground❓

coveredGames.name: Reverse Dream of the Menasphere
coveredGames.title: ✨ Seleto’s quiet life with his sister Mea changes when Lirili, a succubus, asks for help against a coming demon invasion ⚔️ Can he trust her before the gates open❓

coveredGames.name: Rina's Undercover Train Operation
coveredGames.title: 🚆 Drugged by Kaito and stripped of most psychic powers, Rina returns to the trains as bait 🕵️‍♀️ Can she recover her abilities and arrest every offender before they strike again❓

coveredGames.name: Kunugi's Life is a Mess!
coveredGames.title: 💔 Kunugi, a bat-wielding tomboy, chases the man behind her suffering through mysterious White Doors 🚪 into a chaotic world of power and temptation 😈 will she get her revenge ❓

coveredGames.name: Afternoon Affairs & Helpless Housewives
coveredGames.title: 🏚️ Takumi fails his exams & ends up managing a run-down apartment 💍 Two stunning married MILFs, lonely & starved of affection from absent husbands 🥺 Will he give them what they crave❓💕

coveredGames.name: Raising a Happy NEET
coveredGames.title: 🏠 A shy NEET girl arrives at your door with nowhere to go 💕 Build her trust day by day, unlock intimacy, and shape her future 🌸 Will she find happiness living with you ❓

coveredGames.name: Mogitate: Bearing Fruit
coveredGames.title: 🌅 Start fresh in a lively town 👦 meet a vibrant cast of heroines 💬 shape their stories through your choices 💞 build one love… or a full harem 🤰 which future will you create ❓

coveredGames.name: Succubus Survivors
coveredGames.title: 😈 Three succubus sisters conquer the human world on their Demon Queen's orders 🔥 Drain every man who dares stand in your way 💀 but how far will their thirst for power truly take them ❓

coveredGames.name: SiNiSistar 2
coveredGames.title: ⛪ Lelia enters Arsezon to purge the Cursed Children 💀 Six zones await, where every defeat corrupts her body and soul 🩸 Can she cleanse the blight before darkness consumes her ❓

coveredGames.name: Forza Horizon 6
coveredGames.title: Forza Horizon 6 continues to stay unrivaled on top of the Racing genre. If you have any remote interest in cars and racing games, you cannot afford to ignore FH6, it's a must play franchise.

coveredGames.name: Parking Garage Rally Circuit
coveredGames.title: It feels like a mix between Mario Kart and Trackmania, a lovely little indie time trial racer with really fun physics

coveredGames.name: Need for Speed™ Hot Pursuit Remastered
coveredGames.title: The Remaster offers crossplay Multiplayer and for us PC players finally the DLC expansions we never got. One of the best NFS Games we ever got.

coveredGames.name: Easy Delivery Co.
coveredGames.title: Easy Delivery Co. is an indie gem. As the name implies, you deliver goods in a snowy environment with a pixelated but cute artstyle. It all works surprisingly well, so give it a try.

coveredGames.name: F1® Manager 2024
coveredGames.title: In my opinion the best motorsport manager on the entire market right now, unfortunately discontinued due to poor sales.

coveredGames.name: EA SPORTS™ WRC
coveredGames.title: The successor to DiRT Rally 2 with a WRC license. In my opinion a solid sequel despite its controversies.

coveredGames.name: Le Mans Ultimate
coveredGames.title: LMU is a solid evolution of rF2 with a WEC license as well as several QoL changes that were badly needed for rF2 to take the next step. Keep in mind the priority of this game is the multiplayer.

coveredGames.name: Big Bad Pharma
coveredGames.title: No regrets buying this. Had fun and would easily recommend it.

coveredGames.name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2021
coveredGames.title: Definitely a good game to spend some time with. Really enjoyed it.

coveredGames.name: Woman Simulator
coveredGames.title: This was a pleasant surprise. Ended up enjoying it a lot more than expected.

coveredGames.name: Core Keeper
coveredGames.title: Had a really nice time playing this. Simple, enjoyable, and worth it.

coveredGames.name: DEATH STRANDING 2: ON THE BEACH
coveredGames.title: Fun game with a lot to like. I’d definitely recommend giving it a chance.

coveredGames.name: Cheap Car Repair
coveredGames.title: Very enjoyable from the start. Definitely happy with this purchase.

coveredGames.name: DOOM Eternal
coveredGames.title: Didn’t expect to like it this much, but I had a really good time.

coveredGames.name: Five Nights at Freddy's
coveredGames.title: A solid game that’s easy to enjoy. Would happily recommend it.

coveredGames.name: Victoria 3
coveredGames.title: Had a great time with this one. Definitely worth checking out.

coveredGames.name: Cat Mail Co.
coveredGames.title: Really fun experience overall. Glad I decided to give this game a try.

coveredGames.name: Muri: Wildwoods
coveredGames.title: An eye candy pressure washer adventure, cleansing the nature from corruption in a vast and beautiful world. The game was not very long, but it has various collectathon goals. Very relaxing game.

coveredGames.name: Lavender's The One Stop Potion Shop
coveredGames.title: Free and very goofy shop simulator. If it was any other developer I probably would pass. But hey it's Kira, the Lunacid dev. Enjoyable weird vibes.

coveredGames.name: The Red Inn
coveredGames.title: Stuck in a Japanese Inn with very sus owners, but hey it has nice room service. Decent horror game, the elaborate design of a big location makes it stand out, kidna slow burn, suspense building game.

coveredGames.name: Escape the Baby Alarm
coveredGames.title: Pattern recognition puzzle game about being a parent, and finding your inner strength. I loved the animation, and the music was very calming as well. 1.5~2 hour playthrough, very chill.

coveredGames.name: Astrobarian™
coveredGames.title: It's a third-person King's Field inspired game, very much getting lost in a strange world. Has some bad design choices with stunlock, but it has dozens of hours of exploration, nice modeling too.

coveredGames.name: Nocturne
coveredGames.title: A small enigmatic walking-sim, feeling like a clown in the colorless world. Mostly low to mid difficulty puzzles, takes about 40 minutes or so. Had a nice melancholy vibe to it for $2.

coveredGames.name: Neo Junk City
coveredGames.title: So multigenre game, but mostly P&C adventure with cover shooter mechanics. You can enable click to move in settings. It's pretty great. Fun characters, amazing location design, and a lot to explore.

coveredGames.name: a Dogs Dream
coveredGames.title: Actually a mad game, very dark humor, frequent nudity, and sorta edgy in a fun way. Has 2 parts to it. Some text based puzzles, and some JRPG later in the game when you unlock more things.

coveredGames.name: Manus Sors
coveredGames.title: Horror/Anomaly game that still has a linear narrative progression, most of the gameplay is solving puzzles. I thought the immersion and art were very nice. But maybe a little repetitive overall.

coveredGames.name: Missi
coveredGames.title: Could be a nice visual storytelling adventure, I think the illustrations are very wholesome, but sometimes the feedback on interactions is confusing. The puzzles are hit and miss, so mixed feelings.

coveredGames.name: The House Before
coveredGames.title: Short Garage inspired adventure, playing through a series of dreamlike narrative segments with unique gameplay and unusual world building. 1.5~hours or so.

coveredGames.name: Sticker Mirage
coveredGames.title: Similar to the other 2 visual novels from Yun Seven, seemingly a happy friendship/relationship game, but with lots of gore and traumatized characters. Good content, cheap, nice panels, many outcomes.

coveredGames.name: Snow That Hums
coveredGames.title: Mystery visual novel from the developer of Everlasting Tomorrow, finding a connection with a stranger as something odd is happening with the world, as if everything becoming a routine.

coveredGames.name: Complexia, A Ballet of Blades
coveredGames.title: The idea behind the game is to extend combos that charge powerful moves, and to discourage using the same attacks. Simple parry/follow up game, stylish, but can get repetitive. Has some unlocks.

coveredGames.name: Good Children Say Grace
coveredGames.title: Very evocative walking-sim, using a visual novel format with multiple branching routes. For the price the game has a lot of content and exploration, as well as enjoyable melancholy writing.

coveredGames.name: Silver Valley Screams
coveredGames.title: An open world survival horror focusing on player agency, with many choices and time optimization. I think the trailer makes it look crude, but it's a rather charming game with little hand holding.

coveredGames.name: Yume Tenshi
coveredGames.title: As the name would suggest this is very similar to original Yume Nikki. Even so, the exploration gets very fun, finding new characters to transform into, and honestly feeling very lost in a good way.

coveredGames.name: 囚笼之诗
coveredGames.title: The characters are trapped in a facility with a strange creature, and you have 30 days before only one is chosen to live. Nice art, interesting story, and lots of content. Has some nasty bugs though.

coveredGames.name: Spy Drops Gaiden
coveredGames.title: Such a cool idea, applying modern Metal Gear mechanics/pacing into the original game. It still feels like a NES game, just more smooth with the movement and animations.

coveredGames.name: Valkyrja
coveredGames.title: It reminds me a little of Ghosts 'n Goblins, more fair though. Also you can pick one of 3 characters before the stages. Just a simple NES inspired game, maybe could use more level variety.

coveredGames.name: My Beautiful Faraway, Please Don't Be Cruel To Me
coveredGames.title: An introspective puzzle/walking-sim that seems to be about longing, loss, and acceptance. The game has a few compelling moments, but not every section was interesting, and it was oddly paced IMO.

coveredGames.name: Dark Are The Crypts: The Lost Idea
coveredGames.title: It's hard to articulate the vibes in this game, it's cerebral, and very unsettling. The game has some jank to it, softlocks, and no mouse settings. Uses camera for a few mechanics, I kinda like it.

coveredGames.name: VESSELS: Noiret Mansion
coveredGames.title: RE1 inspired survival horror, except you fighting mannequins instead of zombies. The visuals and the sound design are very good, but the combat feedback and suspense need more work.

coveredGames.name: Baby Lemonade
coveredGames.title: Part dreamcore, and part liminal exploration game from Sad Mask Party. It's a little confusing at first, kinda like a 3D YumeNikki, you just go places, and sometimes you find things.

coveredGames.name: Hyperboard Extreme
coveredGames.title: Surprisingly good racing game like many kart classics, with a nice crash mechanic. Sadly it has one map, so maybe support this free game by playing it, and beg the developer to make more maps.

coveredGames.name: EbiTapes
coveredGames.title: The core mechanic of the game is collecting sounds and arranging them in your mixtape. The hints are color coded so it's nothing complex. Nice exploration game with a fun world to navigate.

coveredGames.name: bonitāka's aquarium of medusae
coveredGames.title: ~25 minute existentialism narrative where you go into the depths to interpret the thoughts of the jellyfish. Has a small fishing mini-game. Just a small life appreciation experience, not a lot to it.

coveredGames.name: Soul Injector Commando
coveredGames.title: Very psychedelic and artistically driven FPS from the creator of ESCAPE FROM LAVENDER ISLAND. Once again, very cool peak visuals, but the gun gameplay is kinda just there, it's very casual game.

coveredGames.name: Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster
coveredGames.title: Neat idea for a metroidvania where you can turn into animals for navigation, it's bigger than it looks, and I really like the backgrounds. That said, they should work on hit-boxes and telegraphing.

coveredGames.name: Deadzoned
coveredGames.title: More of a traditional rogue-like from Mr.Diapers himself. It's more methodic than his previous action rogue-lites, using a combination of melee and ranged weapons in turn-based combat.

coveredGames.name: Chlorine Scales
coveredGames.title: I would say a very original graphic adventure that has a dice mechanic, the art and the vibes are very cool. It's short but very repayable with many endings and unlockable characters.

coveredGames.name: Absolution - The Sequel To Alida
coveredGames.title: It feels like a tribute to the image based adventure games from the 90s, but you can actually walk around. They kept many good and bad nuances of the genre, it's very surreal, but also kinda cryptic.

coveredGames.name: Find My Frogs: Branches
coveredGames.title: The second hidden frogs game from Dorota with a day/night cycle. Reasonably priced with a very personalized art style unique to these games, I think better than many cat games in the genre.

coveredGames.name: Encroacher: Snakes
coveredGames.title: Ape confused. How do I play this game? Yes.

coveredGames.name: Provoron
coveredGames.title: Slightly sinister adventure but in a very whimsical way (controls with keyboard). Amazing visuals, so many pretty and charming art panels, and all kinds of strange characters. Interesting story too.

coveredGames.name: Theropods
coveredGames.title: Even though I like the animation, the game suffers from some pixel hunting, and the puzzles could be better. Surprisingly gory and cute at the same time. At least it has some dinos though.

coveredGames.name: Matchstick: Cosmic Flame
coveredGames.title: Multidimensional horror FPS with a grappling mechanic, better than it looks. Very cool visual effects and the locations, got nice atmosphere to it. Combat is kinda junk though, will need more work.

coveredGames.name: Fantasy Network
coveredGames.title: Large open world collectathon with many interesting features, including some games within a game. The platforming can feel a bit heavy, but the game has great animation and is very fun to explore.

coveredGames.name: Occulto
coveredGames.title: The game has a bit of a surreal diorama vibe going for it, highly detailed backgrounds, kinda similar to a few cult classics on steam. A little expensive for EA, but not bad.

coveredGames.name: Wimple and Habit
coveredGames.title: Very creative adventure game where you navigate 2 versions of the same world. I know it looks very simple, but it makes up for it with original ideas, funny dialogue, and many odd characters.

coveredGames.name: ERLIK
coveredGames.title: Выкашивать нечисть под фолк-хоррорный саундтрек приятно: уклоняешься, собираешь оружие и выбираешь сторону Эрлика или Тенгри. Прокачка помогает, боссы суровы; разные пути зовут снова.

coveredGames.name: HANDS OVER
coveredGames.title: За столом быстро забываешь о дружбе: блефуешь, разыгрываешь карты и подставляешь соперников. Мрачный юмор задаёт тон, раунды становятся жёстче, а новые компании и тактики зовут на реванш.

coveredGames.name: Gangsters Way
coveredGames.title: Уличные разборки держат в напряжении: читаешь замахи, уклоняешься и собираешь комбо. Атмосфера гангстерского боевика работает, соперники крепчают по ходу сюжета, а бои хочется переигрывать.

coveredGames.name: Aetheris Core
coveredGames.title: Космический хаос затягивает: подбираешь способности и реликвии, уворачиваешься от атак боссов. Постоянные улучшения дают рост, сложные варианты проверяют реакцию, а сборки меняют каждый забег.

coveredGames.name: TWIN FLAMES
coveredGames.title: Вдвоём прокладывать путь по гексам неожиданно увлекательно: приходится обсуждать каждый ход. Сказочная атмосфера и новые механики держат интерес; задачки требуют слаженности, демо хочется продолжить.

coveredGames.name: Signs of Life
coveredGames.title: На чужой планете легко пропасть на часы: пробуешь пробиться вглубь, мастеришь экипировку и обживаешь базу. Опасность растёт с глубиной, а новые миры и кооператив каждый раз меняют маршрут.

coveredGames.name: Slotbound
coveredGames.title: Каждый раунд — риск и расчёт: крутишь барабаны, усиливаешь бойцов и ищешь удачные сочетания ядер. Волны становятся жёстче, классы меняют тактику, а случайные сборки манят начать заново.

coveredGames.name: ArcheAge Chronicles
coveredGames.title: Аурория дарит редкое чувство свободы и настоящего приключения. Исследовать её, сражаться плечом к плечу и открывать новые горизонты — одно удовольствие. Путь непрост, но возвращаться хочется снова!

coveredGames.name: Wielders of the Essence
coveredGames.title: Вылазки с магией и отрядом быстро превращаются в хаос, а болотный мир цепляет музыкой и пиксельным стилем. Развитие города ощутимо, боссы опасны; шесть героев и режимы сложности зовут снова.

coveredGames.name: Pure Badminton
coveredGames.title: Розыгрыши требуют тайминга и точного выбора удара: позиция решает не меньше силы. Атмосфера турниров бодрит, карьера закаляет, соперники не дают расслабиться, а рейтинговые матчи манят вернуться.

coveredGames.name: Game Keeper: Somebody Messed Up My Shop!
coveredGames.title: Сортировка коробок затягивает: музыка создаёт уют, а отсылки радуют. Прокачка ускоряет работу, но последние полки требуют терпения. Испытания и достижения дают повод вернуться — попробуйте!

coveredGames.name: AMPANIC
coveredGames.title: Сначала кажется обычной работой в лавке, но вскоре заказы превращаются в хаос! Точный прицел решает всё, темп растёт, навыки помогают выжить. Кооп и рогалик дают повод возвращаться.

coveredGames.name: Wildaria
coveredGames.title: 'Wildaria' (in ea) is a lovely and already enjoyable openworld rpg adventure game, catch and tame creature, a vast world to explore, engaging progression, pleasing pixel-art style..indie gem here.

coveredGames.name: Terrible Lizards
coveredGames.title: Run for your life! "Terrible Lizards" is a fun and engaging plateformer adventure game that mix parkour, great tension and horror element, notes to find, a dino-park, cave and monsters chase..neat!

coveredGames.name: Hypernet Explorer
coveredGames.title: An ambitious sandboxy rpg space adventure game, different gameplay (from economy, ressource, turn based combat, discovery..) explore city, planets, ton of classes, skills, biological attribute..neat!

coveredGames.name: Life & Shadow: Celestial Call
coveredGames.title: Запертая горная обсерватория задаёт мрачную основу: днём приходится продумывать, как продержаться, а ночью — исследовать подвал. Главная цель — остановить ритуал и понять, что скрывает профессор.

coveredGames.name: CELESTAY Craft & Slowlife
coveredGames.title: В CELESTAY приятно чередовать сбор ресурсов с вылазками в неизведанное. Жилище постепенно меняется, а новые созвездия становятся ориентирами для дальнейшего изучения. Всё подано спокойно, без суеты.

coveredGames.name: Space Savory
coveredGames.title: Космическая закусочная выглядит местом, где санитарные нормы давно сдались, а за стойкой явно скрывается нечто неприятное. Мрачный юмор хорошо сочетается с тайнами и пустотой вокруг.

coveredGames.name: Alex & Arty
coveredGames.title: Пытаешься помочь Алексу уберечь мир от гибели, но возникает вопрос: действительно ли угроза реальна? Сюжет строится на сомнениях и собственной трактовке происходящего — не всё стоит принимать на веру.

coveredGames.name: Architecture & Design
coveredGames.title: Architecture & Design даёт простор для экспериментов с формой и устройством дома. Проектировать стало проще, но выбор мебели пока хотелось бы видеть шире — это добавило бы вариантов для обстановки.

coveredGames.name: Nedi Cloud Simulator
coveredGames.title: В Nedi Cloud Simulator восстанавливаешь жизнь на парящих островах, управляя дождевым облаком. Полив возвращает зелень безжизненным местам, а исследование мира помогает раскрыть его древние секреты.

coveredGames.name: Absolute Sol
coveredGames.title: Солнечная система здесь становится объектом экспериментов: можно менять орбиты, сталкивать тела и ускорять время, наблюдая за климатом, поверхностями и последствиями гравитации. Советую.

coveredGames.name: Deadly Contagion
coveredGames.title: Особенность геймплея здесь связана с расширенной системой инвентаря: она заметно влияет на обращение с предметами и перемещение по игре. Атмосфера и персонажи дополняют общий игровой процесс.

coveredGames.name: Starforge Pirate
coveredGames.title: Starforge Pirate, a surprising fun 2d vertical arcade shooter game with minimal aesthetic, enjoyable upgrade progression with rich weapons upgrade, bullet hell element and engaging boss fight..great!

coveredGames.name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
coveredGames.title: Обычный tower defense получает больше разнообразия за счёт новых башен, героев и тактик. Эпичные боссы добавляют сражениям отдельный акцент, а юмор остаётся частью подачи.

coveredGames.name: OpenFront
coveredGames.title: Сотни игроков на одной карте превращают PvP в борьбу не только за территорию, но и за союзы. Богатства и ядерные ракеты добавляют ещё один слой к попытке добиться мирового господства.

coveredGames.name: Police Chief Simulator
coveredGames.title: Реалистичный подход сочетается с глубокой системой и возможностями расширения, хотя на раннем этапе встречаются неудобства. В остальном механики работают хорошо, а игровой процесс остаётся приятным.

coveredGames.name: LONGEYED PROJ
coveredGames.title: LONGEYED PROJ is a dark investigation with horror element: minimal approach and weird illustration, you have to train and find the right or wrong victims, make your choice! minigames-style and creepy~

coveredGames.name: The Crust
coveredGames.title: В этой игре вам предстоит возводить автоматизированные производственные цепочки как на поверхности Луны, так и под её корой, управлять научными экспедициями и принимать ключевые решения. 10 из 10.

coveredGames.name: NONEWORLD
coveredGames.title: NONEWORLD, a minimal and stylish rpg adventure with a great artstyle and storytelling, cute and memorable characters on your journey, engaging turn-based battle with various skills to unlock, gem here

coveredGames.name: Kingdoms vs Zombies
coveredGames.title: Здесь приходится не просто ставить оборону, а менять подход от прохождения к прохождению. Смесь стратегии, tower defense и roguelike хорошо работает против бесконечных орд нежити. Советую.

coveredGames.name: Shadow Dungeon
coveredGames.title: Старошкольная RPG делает ставку на глубокие билды, сложные подземелья и постоянную охоту за добычей. Развитие персонажа хорошо дополняет этот цикл и подойдёт тем, кто любит лут. Отличная игра 10 из 10

coveredGames.name: Educational Family Games
coveredGames.title: Взяли семейную викторину — и тихий вечер быстро превратился в крикливое соревнование. Дети заодно учат географию, а я пытаюсь не сгореть от стыда. 80 игр — хороший запас. Рекомендую для вас.

coveredGames.name: Nerd Simulator
coveredGames.title: Сорокалетний Мервин и абсурдные подработки — уже звучит как хороший повод для point-and-click. За один вечер здесь хватает юмора и нелепых неприятностей, без лишней растянутости.

coveredGames.name: 不心动才有鬼
coveredGames.title: Живой формат с настоящей актрисой заметно выделяет игру: мои слова связаны с выбранным опасным путём, а учительница плетёт интриги прямо на экране. Получается настоящее интерактивное кино.

coveredGames.name: Infinitevania
coveredGames.title: Здесь приятно возвращаться к исследованию мира, находя новые предметы и навыки. Отдельно оценил секреты и ловушки: вместе с врагами и боссами они делают ретро-метроидванию насыщенной.

coveredGames.name: G-Rebels
coveredGames.title: Исследуйте антиутопический открытый мир с боевыми миссиями, но секретная операция меняет восприятие происходящего. Интересно разбираться, действительно ли я обеспечиваю порядок или участвую в заговоре

coveredGames.name: Fearwoods
coveredGames.title: 'Fearwoods' is a new survival horror indie game with a dark and scary atmosphere, collect items, solve puzzle and try to stay quiet.. teamwork oriented (3 players), an hunting monster..wishlist now.

coveredGames.name: Echoes of Mystralia
coveredGames.title: Сборка заклинаний здесь ощущается творческой задачей: соединяю триггеры с модификаторами и проверяю результат в бою. Особенно удачно работают честные телеграфы и боссы. Отличный геймплей.

coveredGames.name: Cannon Clicker
coveredGames.title: Cannon Clicker, a simple incremential/clicker wargame: recruit soldiers, fight on the battlefield, upgrade your army and equipment..till the next round! A good progression loop, a nice little game.
