coveredGames.name: Fishing Inc
coveredGames.title: Short incremental fishing game. Beat the game, then hunt the remaining fish. Come home empty handed once and catch a fish with almost no time left. ~4.5+ hours to 100%, slightly luck-based.

coveredGames.name: Budgie's Bug Shop
coveredGames.title: Short incremental game. Max all upgrades, discover every bug, and let interns do a whole round alone. Keep over 20 Cosmic Scarabs unspent at some point. ~2 hours to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Focus Grove
coveredGames.title: Desktop Companion. All achievements are self-explanatory. Clear obstacles at border to unlock more areas. Lessons are daily. Features cheat codes for easy completion. ~30 minutes to 100%, over 7 days.

coveredGames.name: Dropkick Navvy: First Step
coveredGames.title: Free and fully guided survival game. Always focus on unlocking more areas first. Resource replenishment with firewood is not needed. ~2.5 hours to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Dungeons of Dreadrock
coveredGames.title: Fully guided puzzle game. All achievements should be unmissable with intended solutions. Don't kill the ogre on chapter 6 and lead it down to chapter 8 for 'Trapdoor'. ~4 hours to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Catana
coveredGames.title: Match-3 variant puzzle game. Complete all 110 levels, at least 90 without losing a life. Levels can be replayed anytime for leftover achievements. ~9 hours to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Guilty as Sock!
coveredGames.title: Party game. Requires 9 players for two quick bailiff achievements, 4 players for everything else. Can be boosted in private lobbies. Achievements unlock on close. ~3 hours to 100% per player.

coveredGames.name: Our Brief Eternity
coveredGames.title: Fully guided visual novel. Complete all routes. Credits and post-credits sequences must be watched for routes to count to the completion achievement. ~15 minutes to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Love, Elections, and Chocolate
coveredGames.title: Visual novel. Save the game, load it, and then pick any option at the first three choices to unlock all achievements. ~1 minute to 100%.

coveredGames.name: WITCH ON THE HOLY NIGHT
coveredGames.title: Guided visual novel. Main story and all but one extra stories are kinetic. Get all endings in this non-kinetic extra story (see full review). ~40 minutes to 100% if skipping.

coveredGames.name: Sickly Days and Summer Traces
coveredGames.title: Kinetic novel. Features "jump to next choice" option, which immediately completes the game. Has several misc achievements for using functions in the UI (e.g., save/load). ~1 minute to 100%.

coveredGames.name: AMANATSU ~Perfect Edition~
coveredGames.title: Fully guided visual novel. The ⏭ button in the bottom-left can be used to skip to the next choice. Complete all three routes. ~9 minutes to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Fight of Animals
coveredGames.title: 2D fighting game. Finish 20 versus matches and beat Arcade mode with all 13 characters (can be on very easy). DLC not required. Two characters unlock after beating Arcade mode once. ~4 hours to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Clover Reset
coveredGames.title: Fully guided visual novel. Use the "↪" button in the bottom-right of screen to skip to next choice. Cutscenes can be skipped with Esc, but you have to wait for credits to end. ~10 minutes to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Meteor World Actor: Badge & Dagger
coveredGames.title: Visual novel. Pick all top choices. Dialogue can be skipped with ⏭ button in bottom-right, but there are two unskippable cutscenes. If stuck on a black screen, just wait. ~7 minutes to 100%.

coveredGames.name: SIX SECOND SHADOW
coveredGames.title: Platformer with 100 levels. Complete all levels, collect every item at least once (must reach finish, doesn't need to all be in one run), and do many miscs. ~1.5 hours to 100%, mildly skill-dependent.

coveredGames.name: Birdigo - bird word game
coveredGames.title: Roguelike word game. Use unscrambler tool for easiest completion. Quit to menu to restart/reroll stopovers. Use Feral deck on Swainson's route for "Singularity." Complete 7 dailies. ~15 hours to 100%.

coveredGames.name: 花都之恋
coveredGames.title: Fully guided slow visual novel. Autoclicker recommended, it's faster than the in-game skip option. ~25 minutes to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Please Be Happy
coveredGames.title: Guided visual novel with four distinct routes. Always select locations marked with a "!" before any marked with a book icon. ~20 minutes to 100%.

coveredGames.name: A Tithe in Blood
coveredGames.title: Kinetic novel. Start story, press Shift+O to open console, type "config.fast_skipping = True", then use > to skip story text. Has some self-explanatory misc achievements. ~2 minutes to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Polimines 2
coveredGames.title: Fully guided puzzle game with 60 levels. Complete each level without mistakes by right-clicking the green tiles from the guide, then autoclicking all remaining tiles. ~45 minutes to 100%.

coveredGames.name: 2Dark
coveredGames.title: Fully guided stealth action game. Complete the game noting four missable achievements. The rest can be done in with chapter select. 5-star ratings are not required for achievements. ~7 hours to 100%.

coveredGames.name: The Bunny Graveyard
coveredGames.title: Guided horror adventure game. Chapter select available if needed. Find all clues before moving on to the next area. Quit to menu to get both truth/lie to Ben in the same playthrough. ~3 hours to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Flashback
coveredGames.title: Stat-based visual novel. Type "fxxk" on the main menu, press Q, then relaunch the game. Type "fxxk" again and click "After Story" to unlock all achievements. ~1 minute to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Mareld
coveredGames.title: Card-based RPG. Has console cheese, see full review for details. "Wind-bell" requires making 200 food, not 500. ~15 minutes to 100% with cheese.

coveredGames.name: Choice of Kung Fu
coveredGames.title: Fully guided CYOA game. Requires two full playthroughs. ~7 minutes to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Bottled by Bears
coveredGames.title: Cozy management game with self-explanatory achievements. Use "Bottle Preferences" and "Auto Release" to get specific honey jars and bees missing from the book. ~15+ hours to 100%, based on playstyle.

coveredGames.name: Hokko Spaces
coveredGames.title: Cute sandbox game. Fulfill the requirements of villagers to unlock them. Create 10 spaces, get a grumpy response to pokes 4 times, grow 12 potatos, pull 40 weeds and take 40 photos. ~4 hours to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Cursed Treasure 2 Ultimate Edition - Tower Defense
coveredGames.title: Fully guided tower defense. Focus on 3* in every level, repeat for exp if stuck. Save skulls for the last levels, as most of them can be easily completed with mana/coin refill. ~20 hours to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Sixth Grade Detective
coveredGames.title: Fully guided CYOA game. Requires two runs, but save files can be backed up to make the second run only a single choice. ~8 minutes to 100%, 15 minutes without savescumming.

coveredGames.name: The Cryptkeepers of Hallowford
coveredGames.title: Fully guided CYOA game. Requires four full runs, as well as owning a copy of "The Hero of Kendrickstone" for one achievement. See full review for details. ~25 minutes to 100%.

coveredGames.name: T-Rex Time Machine
coveredGames.title: Fully guided CYOA game. Requires four full playthroughs. ~15 minutes to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Choice of the Petal Throne
coveredGames.title: Fully guided CYOA game. Requires 5 full runs. One route relies on an RNG check and might require additional attempts, see full review for details. ~15 minutes to 100%, depending on luck.

coveredGames.name: Mecha Ace
coveredGames.title: Fully guided CYOA game. Has a limited checkpoint feature instead of full saving capabilities. Requires three full runs and several sub-routes. ~40 minutes to 100%.

coveredGames.name: DiRT Rally 2.0
coveredGames.title: Guided Sim Rally Racer. All achievements related to "My Team" tab are online only (Community/AI Events, Buy/Upgrade car, Credits). GOTY edition required. ~70+ hours to 100%, heavily based on skill.

coveredGames.name: Content Warning
coveredGames.title: Guided Co-op Horror game with Dev console in workshop. Unlock all hats and yard items, film specific monsters and grind 100,000$ (with some other self-explanatory achievements). ~5 hours to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Once Human
coveredGames.title: Free fully guided survival MMO. Play through most of the scenarios and the RaidZone mode. Features events to lower the grind. Strong gears required to beat LEA in Solo. ~100+ hours to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Killing Floor 2
coveredGames.title: FPS Zombie Survival. Has collectibles, PvP, endless waves & level completion achievements with non-stacking difficulty, except for 18 maps. Reach Lvl 25 with every class. ~100h+ to 100%, skill-based.

coveredGames.name: Jacksmith: Weapons and Warriors
coveredGames.title: Blacksmith simulator. Achievements are self-explanatory and none are missable, since the game keeps going after you beat the final boss. ~12 hours to 100%

coveredGames.name: Under The Waves
coveredGames.title: Guided adventure game with collectibles. After getting ’One Last Story’ or ‘A Last Goodbye’ quickly pause and exit to avoid replaying the last day. More in extended. ~10 hours to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Nova Survivors
coveredGames.title: Космические бои радуют динамикой, а разные корабли заметно меняют тактику. Улучшения дают ощутимый рост силы, боссы требуют сноровки. Атмосфера отличная, эксперименты со сборками не дают заскучать.

coveredGames.name: SHRED A BILLION
coveredGames.title: Собирать купюры по одной кажется скучным, но новые инструменты заметно меняют темп. Улучшения ведут глубже в хранилище; сложность невысока, зато ветки прокачки и поиск секретов манят вернуться.

coveredGames.name: Signs of Life
coveredGames.title: Чужой мир хочется изучать самому: добываешь руду, исследуешь пещеры, мастеришь оружие и укрепляешь базу. Чем глубже заходишь, тем опаснее; новые находки и случайные миры зовут снова.

coveredGames.name: Benny's Backrooms
coveredGames.title: Жуткие коридоры то пугают, то смешат: собираешь Тесцил пылесосом и следишь за тварями. Снаряжение открывает новые возможности, вылазки опаснеют, а случайные уровни и кооп зовут снова.

coveredGames.name: ArcheAge Chronicles
coveredGames.title: В Аурории легко свернуть с задания ради далёкой башни — и найти там босса или тайник. Бои требуют выдержки и точных уклонений, оружие меняет сборку, а новые маршруты не дают заскучать.

coveredGames.name: Voxel Playground
coveredGames.title: Крушить стены и устраивать хаос весело, но выживание добавляет цель: собираешь ресурсы, укрепляешь базу и держишь волны зомби. Сложность растёт, физика радует, а карты и моды зовут вернуться.

coveredGames.name: The Ash Remembers
coveredGames.title: Пошаговые бои в мрачном фэнтези требуют продумывать действия, а активные и пассивные механики дополняют друг друга. Новые открытия дают чувство прогресса и повод пробовать разные подходы.

coveredGames.name: SkyChart: Airline Executive
coveredGames.title: Авиакомпания здесь требует продуманного подхода к управлению и стратегическим решениям. Системы дают простор для планирования, хотя интерфейсу не хватает удобства при перемещении по игре.

coveredGames.name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
coveredGames.title: Обширные деревья улучшений делают развитие башен заметной частью тактики. Плюс два героя участвуют в бою одновременно, а Classic Rush добавляет отдельный ностальгический режим.

coveredGames.name: The Crust
coveredGames.title: 'The Crust' is a pretty good factory-style civ builder game on the moon! Great automation mecanism, manage ressource, energy and optimise your production.. a good campaign, great soundtrack too..A+

coveredGames.name: Volkolak: The Will of Gods
coveredGames.title: Volkolak (The Will of Gods) is an excellent 2d metroidvania game with dark and beautiful slavic folklore world to explore, hidden secrets, challenging and rewarding combat, well crafted and fun game.

coveredGames.name: Police Chief Simulator
coveredGames.title: Become the police chief in town! A new and realist job simulator, studies every criminal case, complete variety of quests, hire new staff, fight gang and crime, expand your station.. available soon!

coveredGames.name: Nerd Simulator
coveredGames.title: Мервин пытается заработать на самостоятельную жизнь, но задания быстро выходят из-под контроля. Мне зашёл именно этот абсурдный подход: обычная цель превращается в череду нелепых ситуаций.

coveredGames.name: Fearwoods
coveredGames.title: Fearwoods, an atmospheric horror game with a deadly ghost chasing you and your friends! true jumpscare and dark ambiance, in ea with more maps and content (and cosmetic items!) to come..great so far~

coveredGames.name: Cannon Clicker
coveredGames.title: An enjoyable and straightforward clicker game about sending troops to fight enemies, collect ammo, defend your base, unlock upgrade (skill tree) new classes of soldiers to win each coming battle! ++

coveredGames.name: Imperial Wager: The Shattered Crown of Augustus
coveredGames.title: Управляю раздробленной империей и постепенно разбираюсь в сложном государственном устройстве. Минималистичный подход превращает политику и стратегию в понятную абстрактную систему. Геймплей супер.

coveredGames.name: AstroScaper
coveredGames.title: Здесь приходится думать именно над размещением зданий: удачная комбинация даёт сильные синергии. Путешествие между процедурно сгенерированными мирами добавляет этому процессу приятное разнообразие.

coveredGames.name: Keep Her Safe
coveredGames.title: Keep Her Safe is a good survival game with easy to pickup gameplay: explore to loot ressource, build defense for your base, minigames, fight waves of zombies and monsters..solo or with friends, nice!

coveredGames.name: Yandere Maid~Love-Crazed Maid~
coveredGames.title: Исследование здесь тесно связано с решением головоломок: через них я продвигаюсь и собираю информацию. Необычный образ властной горничной хорошо сочетается с такой структурой приключения.

coveredGames.name: Goo Deer
coveredGames.title: Днём спокойно занимаюсь заправкой, а потом приходится идти в туман за припасами. Именно эта смена привычного управления бизнесом на выживание делает игровой процесс самым запоминающимся. Советую!

coveredGames.name: Cafe Business Manager
coveredGames.title: Своя кофейня постепенно превращается в настоящий проект: я оформляю кафе, собираю меню, нанимаю сотрудников и слежу за клиентами. Управление всеми этими частями делает процесс развития увлекательным.

coveredGames.name: Angels Fall First
coveredGames.title: Здесь ценю то, что сражения не ограничиваются одной ареной. Переключение между боями на кораблях, на земле и в транспорте делает многопользовательские матчи заметно разнообразнее.

coveredGames.name: Rise Again
coveredGames.title: Rise Again понравилась циклом попыток: сражаешься, погибаешь и возвращаешься, чтобы идти дальше по меняющимся подземельям. Атмосфера проклятого мага и постоянное развитие держат интерес.

coveredGames.name: Life Below
coveredGames.title: Life Below понравилась тем, как здесь раскрывается подводный градострой: создаёшь коралловые рифы и постепенно возвращаешь жизнь океану. История добавляет веса каждому действию оп спасению океана.

coveredGames.name: Gacha Capsule Shop Simulator - Akihabara
coveredGames.title: Всегда хотелось открыть магазин для отаку, и здесь это получилось отлично. Ищу фигурки, развиваю лавку и подключаю роботов-помощников. Для любителей японской культуры и менеджмента. Советую.

coveredGames.name: The King Got Too Much Gold
coveredGames.title: The King Got Too Much Gold — лёгкая, но интересная стратегия с необычной завязкой. Королевская жизнь оказывается сложнее, когда богатство начинает приносить новые проблемы и неожиданные ситуации.

coveredGames.name: Aarik And The Ruined Kingdom
coveredGames.title: Aarik And The Ruined Kingdom приятно удивляет своей атмосферой. Мир после катастрофы хочется изучать, а каждая головоломка приносит чувство настоящего открытия и прогресса.

coveredGames.name: Human Host
coveredGames.title: Human Host — напряжённый хоррор, где страх строится на неизвестности и выживании. Исследуешь опасный мир, сталкиваешься с угрозами и пытаешься раскрыть тайну происходящего. Атмосфера тревоги - пугает.

coveredGames.name: Secret Seeker
coveredGames.title: Secret Seeker цепляет ощущением открытия. Каждая найденная деталь приближает к разгадке, а исследование локаций превращается в настоящее расследование с неожиданными моментами.

coveredGames.name: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check
coveredGames.title: Работа на карантинном КПП превращается в настоящий тест на внимательность. Проверяешь людей, ищешь признаки заражения, принимаешь сложные решения и пытаешься защитить поселение от смертельной угрозы.

coveredGames.name: Project: Mist
coveredGames.title: Редкий случай, когда выживание и хоррор работают одинаково хорошо. Исследуешь мир, скрытый в густом тумане, строишь базу, добываешь ресурсы и постоянно оглядываешься в поисках опасности.

coveredGames.name: Black Box - Hacker Day One
coveredGames.title: Black Box даёт почувствовать себя начинающим хакером: от простых задач до сложных операций с данными. Интересная структура заданий и атмосфера цифровых расследований удерживают внимание.

coveredGames.name: Cobalt Miner
coveredGames.title: Если нравятся игры про развитие производства и ресурсы, здесь легко потерять счёт времени. Улучшения открываются постепенно, а глубины постоянно подбрасывают новые задачи.

coveredGames.name: Pebble Knights
coveredGames.title: Милый тактический экшен с маленькими каменными рыцарями. Собираешь отряд, прокачиваешь навыки и сражаешься в динамичных битвах. Простая идея, но затягивает за счёт тактики и стиля.

coveredGames.name: Shikhondo: Blue Pieta
coveredGames.title: Shikhondo: Blue Pieta — хардкорный bullet-hell, где каждый бой как танец смерти. Красиво, но жестко: пули летят стеной, а ты балансируешь на грани, собирая души и выживая на чистых рефлексах.

coveredGames.name: Midnight Special
coveredGames.title: Ретро-хоррор с атмосферой 80-х: исследуйте мрачный особняк, решайте головоломки и раскрывайте жуткие тайны. Пиксельный стиль и напряжённый сюжет создают постоянное чувство тревоги.

coveredGames.name: Trees Inc
coveredGames.title: Спокойный симулятор лесного бизнеса: выращивайте деревья, организуйте заготовку и переработку древесины, развивайте технику и производство. Экономика и медитативный темп делают игру затягивающей.

coveredGames.name: Humans Vs Orcs
coveredGames.title: Фэнтезийная стратегия про войну людей и орков: собирайте армии, улучшайте юнитов, стройте оборону и ведите масштабные сражения. Тактика, развитие базы и динамичные бои держат в напряжении.

coveredGames.name: SWAT Commander
coveredGames.title: SWAT Commander is a good police squad simulator, prepare each missions, plan your action and rely on teamwork to success..great tension and immersive gameplay mecanism, great game to play with friends

coveredGames.name: Laundering Simulator - Clean Cash and Laundry
coveredGames.title: Необычный симулятор прачечной с криминальным оттенком: обслуживайте клиентов, улучшайте оборудование и развивайте бизнес. Менеджмент, апгрейды и баланс риска с прибылью делают игру увлекательной.

coveredGames.title: Grand Theft Auto III → DMA Design / 2001 / Action Adventure

coveredGames.title: Beyond Good and Evil → Ubisoft / 2003 / Action Adventure

coveredGames.name: Dreams on a Pillow
coveredGames.title: As you know by now, Palestine has been wracked by Zionists for the past 70+ years. DoaP is a bold, gorgeous, and suitably harrowing stealth/puzzler set during the Nakba. Crowdfunding, now. ETA: 2027

coveredGames.name: Vampirium: 1997
coveredGames.title: Bithell Games, the studio behind the likes of Thomas Was Alone and Volume, return with a tactile, minimalistic stab at an "immslim". AKA, an immsim with a tiny scope. Interesting setting. ETA: Unknown

coveredGames.name: Steel Carnelian
coveredGames.title: With Catbird Soft having proven their chops with Jenny the Witch, this colorful 3D third-person shooter in the same universe promises breakneck combat and an anime-inspired tale. ETA: Unknown

coveredGames.name: Breaking News Live
coveredGames.title: Remember The Republia Times? Lucas Pope's free moral management predecessor to Papers, Please? Yeah, so this is basically that, but a full, commercial game with more color. ETA: March

coveredGames.name: Meat Lovers
coveredGames.title: Roguelite farming sims are a bit of a thing, but they usually have a cycle of growing crops and using them as weapons. Meat Lovers here is that, but more comedic and in first-person. ETA: Unknown

coveredGames.name: Tapeheads
coveredGames.title: Digging into retrofuturistic aesthetics, Tapeheads is a puzzler where you learn how to operate a fictional computer with its own programming language. Demo available. ETA: Unknown

coveredGames.name: Bad Badger
coveredGames.title: Squish together Little Kitty, Big City with Untitled Goose Game, but with a badger protagonist, and you have a decent idea in your head of Bad Badger. By the Agent A devs. ETA: Unknown

coveredGames.name: Appa
coveredGames.title: Surreality is in short supply in card games, but the story-centric Appa is well suited to filling that gap, with a terrific art style, fresh battle system, and an emotional yarn. ETA: Q1 2027

coveredGames.name: Sonnet
coveredGames.title: A medieval road trip adventure in which you tote a magical flower across its delightful, beautiful world. Looks wonderfully atmospheric. ETA: 2026

coveredGames.name: Breaking News
coveredGames.title: Back in ye olden days, you could smack your CRT TV to get it to stop glitching, which forms the backbone of this first-person comedy adventure where you whack your TV to change channels. ETA: Q1 2027

coveredGames.name: Churrasco: Trying to Cook in Peace
coveredGames.title: It's a goofy backyard barbecue simulator with a bevy of delightful characters and wonderfully vibrant visuals. Also, some random elements to keep things unique between playthroughs. ETA: 2027

coveredGames.name: Very Safe Dino Park 🦖
coveredGames.title: The Frog Sqwad devs have another serving of so-called "friendslop" (read: a party game); this one being a 1-4 player game about running an ersatz Jurassic Park. ETA: Unknown

coveredGames.name: RWR:Renegade
coveredGames.title: Chunky sprite-based boomer shooters are by all means in, and RWR seems like a consummate addition to that vein, with a beat 'em up and motorcycling edge. ETA: 2027

coveredGames.name: Apple Crumble
coveredGames.title: Happy Broccoli are on a hot streak with their zany mystery hoots, between Kraken Academy!! & the Duck Detective series, and this stylish "stop the murder" mystery looks to continue it. ETA: December 2

coveredGames.name: HUNGER
coveredGames.title: The creators of Hell Let Loose return with an extraction FPS/RPG that looks to inject some genuinely fresh ideas and a neat setting into the extraction scene. ETA: December 3

coveredGames.name: Punch Lunch: Foodtruck Fighter
coveredGames.title: Melding top-down beat 'em up battles with managing a food truck, Punch Lunch feels like the all too rare Battle Chef Brigade alternative. Demo available. By the Cave Crave devs. ETA: 2026

coveredGames.name: Painted Kingdoms: Tower Defense & Firefighting
coveredGames.title: With its exquisitely styled art full of gorgeous paint and cardboard cutouts, this mix of strategy and tower defense looks terrific. Demo available. By the Los Pingheros devs. ETA: Unknown

coveredGames.name: Necrowave
coveredGames.title: A thinky action/platformer passion project that's been cooking for a good long while, boasting an art style reminiscent of a Genndy Tartakovsky Cartoon Network cartoon. ETA: Unknown

coveredGames.name: Grave Seasons
coveredGames.title: Horror riffs on Stardew Valley are in, and Grave Seasons posits an interesting twist on the formula: it's a murder mystery where you might romance the killer. Published by Blumhouse. ETA: March 9

coveredGames.name: Kaiju Cleaner Simulator
coveredGames.title: Unbelievably, there's a second kaiju corpse removal simulator that is on the way at the same time as Brightrock's Kaiju Cleanup—and KCS looks neat too. Published by Spaghetti Cat. ETA: Unknown

coveredGames.name: Kaiju Cleanup
coveredGames.title: Have you ever wanted a riff on Viscera Cleanup Detail and Powerwash Simulator where you clean up the remains of a once-rampaging kaiju? By the Galacticare devs. Published by Mythwright. ETA: Unknown

coveredGames.name: Presto!
coveredGames.title: There's always an appetite for N64 style collectathon platformers, and this surreal, physics-based ode to that era is endlessly charming. ETA: Q2 2028

coveredGames.name: Reggie & his Cousin: Two Scientists and Most Likely the End of the World
coveredGames.title: Terrifically hand-drawn, this zany time travel platformer promises a breakneck pace, local co-op, wacky physics, impressive cutscenes, and a sprawling story mode. ETA: 2027

coveredGames.name: Bradley the Badger
coveredGames.title: Hopping across fake games stuck in dev hell probably isn't the sort of leaping a mascot platformer would be accustomed to, but it's a neat premise. Published by Focus. ETA: Unknown

coveredGames.name: PRISON OF HUSKS
coveredGames.title: With the onset of Soulslikes, few can actually be said to hew very closely to Dark Souls 1 and its handcrafted, borderline Metroidvania level design. This does, and with PSX style. ETA: January 27

coveredGames.name: Penguin Colony
coveredGames.title: The Umurangi Generation team return with a reimagining of At the Mountains of Madness by HP Lovecraft, from the POV of a penguin. Weird and macabre. Published by Fellow Traveller. ETA: 2026

coveredGames.name: WARSHIFT 2
coveredGames.title: A decade later, the ambitiously solo developed sci-fi action/RTS/RPG mishmash WARSHIFT receives its sequel, and it is reaching even higher than its predecessor. Demo available.

coveredGames.name: Mortal Shell II
coveredGames.title: The Soulslike that looks like a tech death album artwork returns with speedier combat, open world exploration, and an overhaul on its signature shells system. Published by Playstack. ETA: August 20

coveredGames.name: Bad Magpie
coveredGames.title: Adding to the niche of tiny open worlds, Bad Magpie seeks to offer a narrative adventure running on cartoon logic and puzzles you can solve in multiple ways. Fab art style too. ETA: Unknown

coveredGames.name: Tukoni: Forest Keepers
coveredGames.title: Based on Oksana Bula's children's book series, Forest Keepers is a spectacularly hand-drawn point & click adventure that promises a comfy yarn for an all-ages audience. Demo available. ETA: August 17

coveredGames.name: Sovereign Tower
coveredGames.title: Drawing inspiration from Dispatch + Arthurian legend, this masterfully illustrated management RPG promises a grand tale. One of the prettiest of 2026. Demo available. Published by Curve. ETA: August 6

coveredGames.name: Isle of Reveries
coveredGames.title: Classic Zeldalikes are having a great year thanks to Mina, the Hollower and such, and IoR appears to serve up another dish in that vein, but with co-op. Demo available. ETA: September 4

coveredGames.name: Red Kiss
coveredGames.title: "Vamps in East Berlin" is a pretty damn sick premise for a narrative RPG with a tactics edge from the devs of Herald, and the sheer style in its art helps. Published by Fellow Traveller. ETA: Unknown

coveredGames.name: Pikuniku 2
coveredGames.title: The UNIVERSALLY beloved Pikuniku at last brings us back to its delightful and comedic world, but this time there's a substantial change in visuals and perspective. Published by Devolver. ETA: Unknown

coveredGames.name: HYPERyuki: Snowboard Syndicate
coveredGames.title: Just as the world was in need of more SSX, we're seeing another spiritual successor to the stellar arcadey snowboarding institution that seems to have the sauce. Published by Acclaim. ETA: Unknown

coveredGames.name: Burn-9
coveredGames.title: Have you ever been curious about what a spy thriller like MGS would play like from the liaison's POV? Burn-9 seeks to serve that up. By the Yolk Heroes devs. Published by Fellow Traveller. ETA: 2027

coveredGames.name: KAIJECT
coveredGames.title: This is an inventive FPS in which you hop inside kaijus and kill them internally by shooting around their voxel-based innards & then destroying their organs. By the Cloud Cats' Land devs. ETA: Unknown

coveredGames.name: Glyde The Dragon™
coveredGames.title: Despite Spyro finally notching a new game on the horizon, it's still fantastic to see an honest to god Spyro spiritual successor that looks this damn promising. Demo available. ETA: Unknown

coveredGames.name: ABIDE
coveredGames.title: The Judero creators ply their talents in stop-motion video games to a freaky first-person psychological horror title promising mystery & a neat day/night system. ETA: Unknown

coveredGames.name: Cassette Beasts 2002
coveredGames.title: The best indie monster-catching RPG yet gets a sequel with over 57k fusions, 12 possible partners, a new locale, and the ability to import your CB1 character. Published by Raw Fury. ETA: Unknown

coveredGames.name: Harmony's Odyssey
coveredGames.title: Cute puzzle game. Play it alone, in coop or in versus mode. 100+ dioramic puzzles, 7 types of minigames.

coveredGames.name: Primal Planet
coveredGames.title: Play a caveman ain this puzzle action platformer, while your SO joins you as your pet dino. Both can upgrade their abilities. Craft stuff, fight, solve environmental puzzles, discover secrets.

coveredGames.name: LEGO® Batman™: Legacy of the Dark Knight
coveredGames.title: Play trough Batman's most iconic moments - together with your SO in split-screen. Play the hero of Gotham City, while your SO plays Alfred, Jim Gordon, Catwoman, Robin, Nightwing, Batgirl and others.

coveredGames.name: Stitchlings
coveredGames.title: Play two Stitchlings an save your world in this action-adventure. Defeated foes become parts to stitch onto your characters. Has some rough edges, but it is cool for a FREE students project.

coveredGames.name: Marsupilami 2 - Salsa Palombia
coveredGames.title: Save the land of Palombia in co-op in this cute and highly polished 2.5D platformer featuring 3 marsupilamis with different abilities. Players can revive each other.

coveredGames.name: Dragon Dragon Fire Fire Deluxe
coveredGames.title: Comparatively easy starting Bubble Bobble clone. Defeat all monsters within the time limit to finish the 1-screen levels in co-op with your SO. Has online leaderboards.

coveredGames.name: WHAT THE GOLF?
coveredGames.title: Go to the party room and play through short but crazy tournaments with your SO.

coveredGames.name: Xion Leak
coveredGames.title: One robot can melt ice, the other break wood - both must reach the level exit. Jump, dash, attack. Cooperative puzzle platformer with over 60 levels. Sometimes you need to be fast. Think as a team!

coveredGames.name: Sixth Force
coveredGames.title: Traverse the world with your SO bound to you by an energy bond. Solve puzzles, fight, use whips, swing, pull, freeze obstacles, and levitate your partner to succeed.

coveredGames.name: Forehead Chip
coveredGames.title: Patrol the slums together and capture unchipped residents in this quite challenging run and gun (now with easy mode). Interesting, branching storyline.

coveredGames.name: Gal Guardians: Demon Purge
coveredGames.title: Play two demon hunting siblings on their quest to purge the demon infestation of their school in this backtracking-heavy Metroidvania.

coveredGames.name: StormEdge
coveredGames.title: In this simple roguelite, dodge your enemies until they (often) all meet their end through the dangers in the environment. Play through the five acts endlessly. At least in co-op mode, it is bearable.

coveredGames.name: All Hands on Deck
coveredGames.title: Traverse large levels in this cute co-op puzzler. Grab items, interact with hotspots, jump and solve little puzzles - nice to play with your (not too young) kid. A bit buggy, though.

coveredGames.name: Linebound
coveredGames.title: Reach the exit in this little puzzle platformer. One player steers the character (gamepad), the other draws the way (mouse),

coveredGames.name: Lost Twins 2
coveredGames.title: In this cute puzzle platformer, Ben and Abi have to rearrange the world tiles themselves to reach the exit. Split-screen, wirh single player mode.

coveredGames.name: Paddle Paddle Paddle
coveredGames.title: Work together to steer an inflatable rowboat through treacherous waters. If you hit an obstacle even once, you’ll have to go back to the checkpoint. Only for strong relationships. Single + vs modes.

coveredGames.name: Surmount
coveredGames.title: Climb the world's highest mountain with your partner, belay each other, and help each other up. And please, don't push your partner off a cliff. The physics-based climbing is actually fun.

coveredGames.name: R-Type Dimensions III
coveredGames.title: Remake of R-Type III: The Third Lightning (SNES, 1993). Looks good, but runs quite fast and is even harder than the original. Has a nice 2-player co-op mode, though, if you like being punished.

coveredGames.name: Dome Keeper
coveredGames.title: Dig for ressources and defend your dome together in split-screen in the new local (or online) multiplayer mode.

coveredGames.name: Unless
coveredGames.title: Cool single player speedrun platformer gone FREE. A second player can support the main player by directing a helper bird that generates a bubble that freezes time.

coveredGames.name: Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel
coveredGames.title: You can now summon the Jötunn together with your SO in one of the better Vampire Survivors clones available.

coveredGames.name: Brothers: A Tale of Two Sons Remake
coveredGames.title: Traverse the land on an emotional story to find a cure for your father in this improved version of the original. Great game, but only if you have not played the original.

coveredGames.name: Looters
coveredGames.title: Play two little goblins who are forced to loot a manor of its valuables. Cooperate, feed your living bag, sneak and survive. FREE!

coveredGames.name: REANIMAL
coveredGames.title: Play as brother and sister and traverse together through a grotesque, terrifying land to save your friends. Solve little puzzles in detailled set-pieces. Scary, but a bit short.

coveredGames.name: Boyfiend & Ghoulfriend
coveredGames.title: Collect all keys to open the exit in this 1-screen puzzle platformer to play in co-op with your SO.

coveredGames.name: Big Helmet Heroes
coveredGames.title: Play two knights with big helmets and beat up other knights in co-op. Not as good as Castle Crashers, but quite decent.

coveredGames.name: Hellish Quart
coveredGames.title: Cut open your SO with your sword in this 1-hit, physics-based, 3D sword-fighting game. It requires timing, technique, and speed to defeat your opponent.

coveredGames.name: Thunder Spikes Volleyball
coveredGames.title: Play volleyball vs your SO in this plain looking but rather complex arcade sports game. Perform spikes, tips, blocks, serves, and spectacular diving saves - if you master the controls.

coveredGames.name: Wispy Dreams
coveredGames.title: Cute single-screen arcade game to play in co-op. Not too difficult, with inspiration from games like Bubble Bobble or Rodland.

coveredGames.name: UniDuni
coveredGames.title: Collect all fruits or solve other problems to clear a level in this cute puzzle platformer in co-op with your SO, A nice little braintwister with a bit of action.

coveredGames.name: Tentacle Tango
coveredGames.title: Play the octopuses Ten & Tango and reach the level end by pressing the button at the right time and adjusting the tentacle length while you constantly move. Quite tough, requires coordination.

coveredGames.name: Stick It to the Stickman
coveredGames.title: Beat up your colleagues with your buddy (til promotion time) to climb the corporate ladder in this physics-based roguelite beat 'em up (where you chain your moves) with a strange sense of humor.

coveredGames.name: Perennial Order
coveredGames.title: Play two perennial knights who must cleanse the forest from a corruption in this challenging one-hit-death combat game with twin stick controls. Not bad at all.

coveredGames.name: TOJIBO
coveredGames.title: Solve puzzles together with your robot friend in this little co-op 2-player only puzzle platformer. Throw rocks or even your friend around.

coveredGames.name: The Last Oricru - Final Cut
coveredGames.title: Interesting - but not perfect - Gothic inspired action RPG that can by played by two players in split-screen.

coveredGames.name: SEDAP! A Culinary Adventure
coveredGames.title: Cook asian food together while exploring a cursed island. Catch your ingredients and survive the unfriendly animals and plants. An interesting mix of Overcooked and a bit hack and slash.

coveredGames.name: Arm of Satan: Chapter 1
coveredGames.title: Unique platformer - one players play a girl (move, jump), while a second player plays a living monster arm attached to her who can help her with more advanced moves (fight, climb, double jump...).

coveredGames.name: SHOCKWAVE TRIGGERS
coveredGames.title: Team up to rescue little Norah in this bullet hell shmups with a special shockwave attack - 16bit visuals, graze mechanics, tate mode, online leaderboards, 4 difficulties, boss rush mode.

coveredGames.name: Blanc
coveredGames.title: Play a wolf cub and a fawn searching together for their lost herds in an icy landscape. Jump, run, interact - work together to be able to continue. Simple game mechanics, but quite heartwarming.

coveredGames.name: Shrine's Legacy
coveredGames.title: Play Rio and Reima and find the gems to restore the Sword of the Shrine to defeat the evil demon attacking the peacful land in this great SNES Zelda homage action rpg.

coveredGames.name: Appulse
coveredGames.title: Appulse combines roguelike twin-stick shooting with pinball mechanics for an experience like no other

coveredGames.name: Warhammer Survivors
coveredGames.title: Warhammer Survivors is a decent enough homage to Vampire Survivors, but suffers from balancing issues and a general sense of monotony in its gameplay.

coveredGames.name: DERELIKT
coveredGames.title: DERELIKT captures the heart and soul of the days of early 3D gaming, almost to a fault, delivering a game that can be frustrating and fun in equal measure.

coveredGames.name: Hot Dogs, Horseshoes & Hand Grenades 2
coveredGames.title: Hot Dogs, Horseshoes & Hand Grenades 2 is an immersive and over-the-top VR roguelike and a great sequel to the fan-favourite VR exclusive.

coveredGames.name: Springs, Eternal
coveredGames.title: Springs, Eternal is a compelling and thought-provoking experience abou love, loss and trying to be a good person.

coveredGames.name: Ashes of the Singularity II
coveredGames.title: Ashes of the Singularity II packs a lot of satisfyingly crunchy strategy into its massive matches, aided by some smart asymmetric design. But a middling campaign and general lack of variety hold it back.

coveredGames.name: TANUKI: Pon's Summer
coveredGames.title: Tanuki: Pon’s Summer takes a parcel-delivery game, centers it on a fantastic BMX traversal mechanic, and packs it to the brim with mini-games and side content.

coveredGames.name: SONIC PICO PARK
coveredGames.title: Sonic Pico Park is a charming crossover title that feels faithful to both Sonic the Hedgehog and Pico Park.

coveredGames.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
coveredGames.title: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered feels like a new game with its graphical upgrade, held back slightly by a lack of any other meaningful new additions and a somewhat grindy gameplay loop.

coveredGames.name: Terrible Lizards
coveredGames.title: Terrible Lizards is a terrific parkour-filled trip through 90s nostalgia.

coveredGames.name: Joe & Mac Retro Collection
coveredGames.title: With three great games and tons of goodies, the Joe & Mac: Retro Collection is an excellent assortment of three prehistoric platformers (and I don’t mean that just because they’re retro).

coveredGames.name: Gennady
coveredGames.title: Gennady is a romp through some of the grossest biomes, filled with the ugliest enemies you will see, and it plays well too!

coveredGames.name: The Wolf Among Us Remastered
coveredGames.title: The Wolf Among Us Remastered is the definitive way to experience this episodic adventure cult classic. However, since it deliberately sticks very close to the original, current owners will have little incentive, outside of the promise that the choices will carry over, to double dip.

coveredGames.name: Phantom Blade Zero
coveredGames.title: When I first saw it, I didn’t think Phantom Blade Zero was possible. After playing it, all I can think is that it's hands-down one of the best action games ever made.

coveredGames.name: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4
coveredGames.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is an exceptional finale to an uneven series. Its return to brutal, linear action and resolute storytelling makes it one of the best Call of Duty games since the original Black Ops.

coveredGames.name: Mycopunk
coveredGames.title: Mycopunk combines frantic gameplay with some genuinely unique ideas to make for a seriously fun objective-based shooter experience.

coveredGames.name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE
coveredGames.title: Final Fantasy Resonance wears its inspirations on its sleeves but doesn't use them as a crutch—presenting a worthy story and challenge, and deftly weaving new and old together.

coveredGames.name: Stupid Never Dies
coveredGames.title: Stupid Never Dies is an addictive roguelike action game that mashes together monsters and mayhem in equal measure.

coveredGames.name: Enshrouded
coveredGames.title: More than two years after its Early Access release, Enshrouded 1.0 delivers on everything that was originally promised with flying colours. The result is a survival title which, albeit not quite perfect, rivals other stalwarts of the genre.

coveredGames.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
coveredGames.title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 finds a great mix to please longtime W40K players and newcomers, although veterans will find themselves leaving with a lot more enjoyment. From the new playable character to the amazing Chaos army enemy variety, it's great to see that Auroch Digital took the issues with t

coveredGames.name: Tales of Eternia Remastered
coveredGames.title: Tales of Eternia Remastered brings back a classic 2D Tales adventure, restoring exclusive content cut from prior North American releases, made complete with some choice QoL improvements for modern audiences.

coveredGames.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
coveredGames.title: Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse is a must play title and a return to form for one of video gaming’s most prominent franchises.

coveredGames.name: Ratatan
coveredGames.title: Ratatan takes everything that was good about its spiritual predecessor and applies it to a faster, roguelike experience that really grooves.

coveredGames.name: Valor Mortis
coveredGames.title: Valor Mortis is a well-realised Soulslike FPS with a 19th-century coat of paint that enthusiasts of the genre will surely enjoy.

coveredGames.name: Bluey's Happy Snaps
coveredGames.title: Bluey's Happy Snaps' photography theme justifies another virtual romp through Bluey's world, though it can't quite escape feeling like a tablet game blown up for consoles.

coveredGames.name: Nivalis Nights
coveredGames.title: Nivalis Nights is a decent business management sim, but it fails to really build on its cyberpunk setting and gets a bit boring after a while.

coveredGames.name: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival
coveredGames.title: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival is not without its issues, but looking past its pale and dead exterior reveals one of the best licensed horror games ever made.

coveredGames.name: Order of the Sinking Star
coveredGames.title: Order of the Sinking Star has a lot of interesting mechanics, but its central conceit of block-pushing puzzles makes the game a bit dull after a while.

coveredGames.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered
coveredGames.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered is an amazing remaster of an amazing game. With all the DLC included, great upgrades to the visuals and framerate and even base gameplay. Sure there are some issues on Switch 2 like there are still some muddy visuals, and the bloom is especially bad, but hopeful

coveredGames.name: TOEM 2
coveredGames.title: Toem 2 takes its predecessor’s photo-based gameplay and makes it feel bigger, better and bursting with creativity.

coveredGames.name: Minecraft Dungeons II
coveredGames.title: Minecraft Dungeons II is a great example of how to take ideas from the first game that didn’t work and retool them into something meaningful and enjoyable. With a fleshed-out story, better loot mechanics and an interconnected world, it feels like Dungeons has finally found its groove.

coveredGames.name: ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE
coveredGames.title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve is a great action game and one of the best entries in the franchise so far, with the only major caveat being the incoherent and impenetrable story told in the 30-hour-long campaign mode.

coveredGames.name: Graveyard Keeper 2
coveredGames.title: Graveyard Keeper 2 is everything I wanted in a sequel, and technically, aside from technical issues, is a great grim cozy game sim.

coveredGames.name: Garfield - Escape from Monday
coveredGames.title: Garfield: Escape from Monday is a solid 3D platformer and one of the better outings for the titular fat feline, held back slightly by a lack of overall difficulty that may make you feel like a lazed cat.

coveredGames.name: CONTROL Resonant
coveredGames.title: The story and gameplay of CONTROL Resonant seem at odds with each other—starting strong, then grinding to a halt in the late game. Combined with the rote, repetitive gameplay, underwhelming powers, and a weaker Remedy music moment, this feels like the weakest Remedy game in over a decade.

coveredGames.name: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter
coveredGames.title: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter is a beautiful remake with an amazing story, a great ensemble cast, fun combat, and a killer soundtrack that deserves mainstream attention.

coveredGames.name: NBA 2K27
coveredGames.title: NBA 2K27 is packed with great updates and the crazy amount of gameplay options will not leave you without something to do. In fact, any single mode may be worth the price of admission, all on their own.

coveredGames.name: SPRAWL zero
coveredGames.title: SPRAWL Zero is a very different game from its predecessor, but one that wholeheartedly embraces its mid-2000s mechanics, delivering a fun and accessible prequel that single-player FPS fans will enjoy.

coveredGames.name: HOT WHEELS™ Infinite Rush
coveredGames.title: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush is a feature-rich, open-world arcade racer that anyone can jump into, bringing toys to life without relying on real-world gimmicks or NFC-powered figurines.

coveredGames.name: Crimson Moon
coveredGames.title: Crimson Moon is a great time, and when everything is considered, is a must try for those that can’t get enough roguelike action.

coveredGames.name: Altitude Zero
coveredGames.title: For fans of oldschool horror aesthetics and unsettling adventures. This one has a wonderfully strange atmosphere that's hard to resist.

coveredGames.name: Roomy
coveredGames.title: Your own little virtual world to decorate, customize and make uniquely yours. A great free sandbox for creative minds.

coveredGames.name: Bush League Baseball
coveredGames.title: A charming blend of classic baseball, silly arcade fun and long-term club management, with plenty of hilarious moments in every game.

coveredGames.name: Ringfort
coveredGames.title: Every fort has a weakness, every combination has potential and every victory brings you closer to the crown. The fun is in figuring out what works before your neighbours do.

coveredGames.name: Porchlight
coveredGames.title: A vibrant storybook world brought to life, filled with fantastical creatures, colourful landscapes and wonderfully imaginative encounters. A real treat for fantasy RPG lovers.

coveredGames.name: One Million Gallons
coveredGames.title: Draining an entire ocean with a bucket sounds ridiculous, yet somehow turning this absurd project into an industrial operation is deeply satisfying.

coveredGames.name: ANTARIUM 2
coveredGames.title: Sometimes the smallest creatures have the biggest dreams. Build, discover and leave your mark beneath the earth.

coveredGames.name: I AM MILK
coveredGames.title: A truly unusual experience that turns sound into an entire world. Put on your headphones and let your choices shape the journey.

coveredGames.name: KAREI - ENDLESS DEATH MATCH
coveredGames.title: A simple concept with plenty of room for mastery. Every floor brings a new challenge for those who love thinking before acting.

coveredGames.name: AURORA REQUIEM: The Lullaby of Calvaris
coveredGames.title: An authentic 90s style JRPG set inside the skeleton of a giant sea creature where lighthouses burn human memories for light. Pure retro nostalgia.

coveredGames.name: Frank 'n' Stein's Body Shop
coveredGames.title: Survive absolute basement madness while dealing with goblins, impatient couriers, and Stein himself. Prove to Uncle Frank that you can handle the family trade.

coveredGames.name: SORE CRATEBREAKER
coveredGames.title: An unusual blend of incremental progression and horror, where even the most ordinary task can hide something deeply unsettling.

coveredGames.name: Pinata Smash: Incremental Circus
coveredGames.title: A delightfully chaotic incremental game where the crowd does the smashing, candy keeps pouring and your upgrades make every show bigger.

coveredGames.name: DAEMON
coveredGames.title: Not all companions need adventures and epic quests. Sometimes it's enough to have a tiny friend quietly keeping you company while you do your own thing.

coveredGames.name: Let's Duck!
coveredGames.title: Who knew rubber ducks could be this dangerous? Grab your fanciest hat, gather your feathered squad and prepare to defend your pond.

coveredGames.name: Dome: Become Thyself
coveredGames.title: Not every game wants you to understand it. Some want you to get lost, question everything and slowly piece reality back together.

coveredGames.name: Isekai Survivors
coveredGames.title: Adorable heroines, an unusual visual style and wonderfully engaging gameplay create a fantasy adventure full of personality.

coveredGames.name: Net Worthless
coveredGames.title: Who knew managing everyday finances could be such a nightmare? A painfully relatable life simulator.

coveredGames.name: ColorCraft
coveredGames.title: Finding the perfect palette can completely change the feel of your pixel art. This tool makes experimenting so much easier.

coveredGames.name: Extracto Proviso
coveredGames.title: Build a vast industrial network on an alien world, where every new discovery brings you closer to the secrets hidden beneath its surface.

coveredGames.name: Grandma Left Me A Building
coveredGames.title: Your building needs repairs, your tenants need attention and your patience needs an upgrade. Welcome to property management

coveredGames.name: Apex Armada
coveredGames.title: Build your fleet, experiment with wild combinations and watch your carefully assembled armada tear through enemy ships. Space battles have never been so satisfying.

coveredGames.name: Overspin
coveredGames.title: Work them, feed them, upgrade their equipment and help them dig their way to freedom. Just another day in corporate management.

coveredGames.name: Eugene Onegin vs. the Undead
coveredGames.title: A Russian literary classic has rarely taken such an unexpected detour. Definitely worth a look if you enjoy unconventional adaptations.

coveredGames.name: Terrahold
coveredGames.title: From your first lonely drone to a sprawling industrial network, every step feels like a small victory against an entire living world. A deliciously challenging premise.

coveredGames.name: Hellmate - Chess Deck Builder
coveredGames.title: Who knew chess could be this wicked? Experiment with spells, empower your pieces and discover powerful combinations on your descent through Hell.

coveredGames.name: MARK IT
coveredGames.title: A wonderfully clever twist on jigsaw puzzles where your own marks become the clues. Every level challenges you to think ahead and trust your memory.

coveredGames.name: CrossWords.
coveredGames.title: Create, customize and save your own crossword puzzles, then challenge yourself to achieve better results.

coveredGames.name: Kyle Coral
coveredGames.title: A charming adventure that combines exploration, thoughtful resource management and permanent equipment upgrades.

coveredGames.name: RETRO NIGHT CHASE
coveredGames.title: A fun little arcade game for anyone looking for exciting police chases, retro visuals and straightforward action.

coveredGames.name: Ascension Gamebook
coveredGames.title: Not every adventure has a happy ending. Every dice roll and decision can bring you closer to glory or a gruesome fate.

coveredGames.name: NOSTRA
coveredGames.title: A fascinating blend of turn-based RPG combat and precise timing mechanics, where well-timed parries and carefully chosen equipment can turn the tide of battle.

coveredGames.name: Ragdoll Robotics
coveredGames.title: A hilarious physics-based puzzle game where creative trap combinations lead to spectacular launches, unexpected chaos and satisfying chain reactions.

coveredGames.name: VALDIS
coveredGames.title: If traditional tower defense feels too passive, this one lets you step onto the battlefield and fight alongside your own defenses.

coveredGames.name: Crossroads: Forgotten Paths
coveredGames.title: Sometimes the best adventures come in small packages. A lovely fantasy journey filled with exploration, lore and classic RPG charm.

coveredGames.name: The Cozy Board Game Shop: Tidy Up
coveredGames.title: A perfect choice for relaxing sessions, with no timers or pressure, just a cozy board game shop waiting for your personal touch.

coveredGames.name: Just Keep Defending And Mining
coveredGames.title: Mining and combat come together in a satisfying progression loop where every round gives you another reason to grow stronger.

coveredGames.name: Swift Cultivation
coveredGames.title: Let the queue do the work while you plan your next breakthrough. Just remember that even immortal cultivators need to eat.

coveredGames.name: ASTERIS
coveredGames.title: Experiment with skill combinations, discover powerful synergies and turn your favorite hero into a completely unique fighter.

coveredGames.name: Akgwi Slash
coveredGames.title: A chaotic supernatural battle where the screen fills with enemies, magic and spectacular attacks. A great pick for fans of action packed survival games.

coveredGames.name: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced
coveredGames.title: 𝐑𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐨𝐥𝐢, 𝐑𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐨𝐥𝐢, 𝐂𝐮𝐭𝐬𝐜𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐬 𝐀𝐫𝐞 𝐋𝐢𝐦𝐢𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝟑𝟎 𝐅𝐏𝐒𝐨𝐥𝐢! - 7.5/10

coveredGames.name: SIGILLVM: RESONANCE
coveredGames.title: 3 Romantic interests each with a good & bad ending, go through the story as you investigate your past & why you were targeted also characters are well fleshed out with interesting personalities.

coveredGames.name: Chloé’s Requiem -encore-
coveredGames.title: You play as Michel exploring a old mansion getting the keys/items, sorting puzzles and playing a duet along side Chloe to progress the story and learn how her fate came to be.

coveredGames.name: Hogwarts Legacy
coveredGames.title: Dive into the wizarding world 100 years prior to the popular franchise & explore to see magical creatures, the forbidden forest + more; be sorted into your house and save Hogwarts from disaster.

coveredGames.name: Towards Future
coveredGames.title: Sweet but short story where you play as a blue teddy bear and discover what's happened to your shelter, looking for clues & diary pages to figure out where your young master + family has gone.

coveredGames.name: Dungeon Trail
coveredGames.title: It's like if you take Earthbound's art direction turn it into a dungeon crawler with JRPG tropes and have it be a dice version of Balatro. It's unique and inventive in all the right ways. 8.5/10

coveredGames.name: Memory Girl +
coveredGames.title: Ever wonder what happens to the world after the "MC" finishes the game, the NPCs repeat their days & try to find "him" as the game script changes; is the world truly how you see it or something more?

coveredGames.name: Scarlet Skips
coveredGames.title: A very creative rougelike idea. The animations are super high quality. The core of the game is addictive. Everything feels like it was crafted with love and care. A banger 9/10 time sink of a game.

coveredGames.name: Pre-Odyssey: Love at First Quack
coveredGames.title: Quack-tacular! tons of duck puns in almost every choice, the game takes itself serious enough to not be a complete parody/comedy but it's also very sweet and light-hearted! (3 EDS)

coveredGames.name: WinMon
coveredGames.title: It's like if you take Tamagotchi, Pokemon, and Harvest Moon and mash them into a background game to sink time into. Definitely a game you have rather than actively play. A cute and creative project.

coveredGames.name: Schrödinger's Call
coveredGames.title: Play as Mary as you recover your lost memories and have lost souls confide in you to help them move on, empathise with them as you learn and go through what you have in common to remember.

coveredGames.name: How Much for the Body in the Freezer
coveredGames.title: Filth, a short VN on a street where the street will swallow people whole; money, lies and deception all happen here just to keep yourself afloat till you realise it wasn't even real at all.

coveredGames.name: Super Night Riders S1
coveredGames.title: A fantastic arcade racer. There's a decent amount of unlocks available and the clear plans for new content with this version of SNR is promising. Great fun and exciting for the game's future. 9/10

coveredGames.name: Impostor Factory
coveredGames.title: A short emotional journey that starts as something simple as a murder loop till you really figure out what's going on & accept the "reality" that you're in; Overall enjoyable & worthwhile game to play

coveredGames.name: Baki Hanma: Blood Arena
coveredGames.title: There's something here for fans of Baki and for people just looking for a good arcade game. Graphics are spot on for the franchise and the audio is very crisp. A solid 9/10 Punch Out inspired game.

coveredGames.name: Recall: Empty Wishes
coveredGames.title: Follow Yonny as you go through to uncover the truth of your brother's disappearance; solving minor puzzles and going through old memories and dreams alike as your reality begins to blur together.

coveredGames.name: Re:Turn - One Way Trip
coveredGames.title: Short side scroller horror RPG with a runtime of about 4-5 hours to 100% with a affordable price, Puzzles require a bit more thinking at times but aren't overly complex; characters are very unserious.

coveredGames.name: Starsand Island
coveredGames.title: If you enjoy Animal Crossing/Stardew Valley/Harvest Moon style games, this is a solid competitor. While not amazingly deep story wise, there's plenty of focus on customization and creativity. 8/10.

coveredGames.name: Meiji Tokyo Renka  Full Moon
coveredGames.title: Stuck in the Meiji Era where you end up losing your memories, meeting men & 30 days till you go home, will you stay in the Meiji Era or remember & choose your modern times?(8 Routes, 2 EDs per chara)

coveredGames.name: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined
coveredGames.title: The artstyle doesn't translate nearly as well to 3D as it could have, feeling a little too cutesy, but it's the classic game in all other regards. Feels like a new experience. A solid 8.5/10 remake.

coveredGames.name: SILENT HILL f
coveredGames.title: Another instalment in the SH series, you play as Hinako and navigate through your town & the otherworld solving puzzles, beating bosses & finalising through your resolve for your choices. (5 Endings)

coveredGames.name: Harvest Moon: The Winds of Anthos
coveredGames.title: It's open world so you can explore freely as well as they've updated some mechanics making mining & other skills easier but you do as would in HM games like mining, farming, fishing & marriage.

coveredGames.name: Flowstone Saga
coveredGames.title: If you're a fan of Tetris style games and JRPG storytelling, you'll enjoy Flowstone Saga. Cozy retro inspired graphics, decently written characters, and an enjoyable gameplay loop make this an 8.5/10

coveredGames.name: CABALL: sunset hour
coveredGames.title: Short continuation from the original with 2 EDs where you get to pursue Mael & Gaspar furthering the romantic part of the relationship. Good CGs & befitting BGM that's subtle yet atmospheric

coveredGames.name: BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE
coveredGames.title: As far as Beyblade games go, this is pretty solid. Standard fare tournament arc story with great customization and enjoyable gameplay. Online is dead but the single player is fun. It's an easy 8.5/10.

coveredGames.name: Little Witch in the Woods
coveredGames.title: Fix up the village of Wisteria, 3 visually stunning areas as you collect everything from them; complete your encyclopedia, gain rewards, do quests, befriend cats & villagers & of course make potions!

coveredGames.name: Touhou Dystopian
coveredGames.title: As far as a rogue likes go, this is pretty solid. It retains the Touhou IP staples with bullet hell game play, multiple characters to meet, solid combat, & great visuals. It's a fun game, 8.5/10.

coveredGames.name: Escape from Irene
coveredGames.title: Short horror game with an great visuals, puzzle interaction aren't fully clear and can soft-lock you being as unable to interact with them; 3 Endings and affordable price point.

coveredGames.name: TouHou Makuka Sai ~ Fantastic Danmaku Festival Part III
coveredGames.title: A phenomenal entry into the series. With stunning backgrounds, fun stages, and an amazing OST you'd expect from a Touhou game, this is truely a great title. Very fun for all skill levels. 9.5/10

coveredGames.name: VARLET
coveredGames.title: A good mix of persona & danganronpa with a odd mix of personality tests? Do your SSS chores, get the SSS club stars up & go into glitches; level up and save those being controlled by their own desires

coveredGames.name: Shachibato! President, It's Time for Battle! Maju Wars
coveredGames.title: If you're a fan of tactical turn based RPGs, you'll probably like this game. 2D art and 3D models look good, music is generic but well composed. It's not super deep mechanically, but it's pretty fun.

coveredGames.name: MOOD
coveredGames.title: Short visual novel where there's no right or wrong choices and you just talk/hang out with a demon girl however the choices do affect your environment even if you don't notice it..

coveredGames.name: The Aquarium does not dance Special Edition
coveredGames.title: Short horror puzzle RPGMaker set in a beautiful aquarium where it quickly goes dark/dangerous, play as Suze as you solve puzzles and navigate through the aquarium, find your friends & escape. 5 EDs

coveredGames.name: SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim
coveredGames.title: Incredible graphics with very much in-your-face fetish material and a game play loop that will either suck you in or be a total turn off depending on your feelings on Visual Novels. A solid 8.5/10.

coveredGames.name: Rainbow Sea
coveredGames.title: You spend a year on a boat with 7 gods whilst learning skills, making choices lying/no lies but it will affect your endings with whoever you aim to spend your time & gifts for & Each run takes 1-2Hrs

coveredGames.name: Until Then
coveredGames.title: You're attempting to figure out the mystery of your jumbled up memories/scenes as you face reality slowly over time and learn love, acceptance, loss and eventually letting go of the past.

coveredGames.name: Umamusume: Pretty Derby
coveredGames.title: From the very popular Umamusume IP, the world has finally gotten the game that was exclusive to Japan for so long. Training is a blast and the original story content is great. It's a 9/10 Gacha game.

coveredGames.name: The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters
coveredGames.title: A continuation of the coma as time passes and you once again enter the coma but as the girl however you can explore and use portals to explore beyond the school and now there's more than 1 enemy.

coveredGames.name: Stellar Blade™
coveredGames.title: Beyond the pretty character models, there's an enjoyable plot here. The gameplay is an awesome mix of hack and slash with souls style dodging and parrying. It's one of the best games of it's kind.

coveredGames.name: Garden of Witches
coveredGames.title: Super fun & cute roguelite as you journey in the garden to round up the rest of the witches fighting off enemies and save the garden from being consumed by a black void that can spawn tentacles?

coveredGames.name: Nientum - Op.ZERO
coveredGames.title: 【8.5/10】This rhythm game turns boss fights into musical duets with about 30 songs. Full release adds chapters 6 to 10 totalling 12+ hours for my darlings.

coveredGames.name: ANOMALITH
coveredGames.title: Expensive but fun anime shooter with loot mechanics and surprisingly extensive gun upgrading/customization.

coveredGames.name: Ratatan
coveredGames.title: 【7/10】Early Access. A charming Patapon successor with catchy rhythm commands and 100+ character melees. The loop turns really repetitive, but my darlings who loved Patapon will still adore it.

coveredGames.name: Blood High!
coveredGames.title: 【7/10】Boomer shooter where you shoot blood as ammo and throw your severed head to execute foes and refill HP. Runs are short and some art feels AI-made, but the chaos delights my darlings!

coveredGames.name: Tokyo Xtreme Racer
coveredGames.title: 【8/10】Super fun reboot of the classic highway racer, stacked with lots of real JDM cars you can actually tune. Runs at 60fps on Steam Deck too so my darlings can race the Shuto anywhere they like.

coveredGames.name: PATLABOR the Case Files
coveredGames.title: 【5.5/10】A clunky PS2-style mecha brawler faithful to Patlabor's slow, heavy Labors, fully voiced by the original cast. Really stiff controls but my darlings craving nostalgia may still enjoy it?

coveredGames.name: Love All My Girls
coveredGames.title: 【7.5/10】Full motion video dating sim shot in 4K, you date six girls as a man who resets time whenever he dies. Dozens of endings, one true ending, my darlings, and it's a juicy premise done right!

coveredGames.name: Masquerade Kiss
coveredGames.title: 【8/10】Darlings play as a secret agent seducing the world's worst man in this otome through four well illustrated routes. No bad endings, runs great on steam deck, though there's a couple of typos.

coveredGames.name: A Girl A Rain
coveredGames.title: 【6/10】A short VN of a girl named Xun trapped in an endless rainstorm. About 1.5 hrs with three endings. English is rough with subpar translation and darlings may find the true ending to be confusing.

coveredGames.name: Kernel Hearts
coveredGames.title: 【7/10】Alot of effort was put into the art, music, writing and the magical girl transformation hits pretty hard. Only problem was that the progression is slow, and that the basic mob fights is boring.

coveredGames.name: Trap Yuri Tempest
coveredGames.title: 【8/10】From the Trap Yuri Garden team, this romcom pits proud Prince Reona against rebellious Mahiro in a slow-burn crossdressing romance. Patch available for darlings too.

coveredGames.name: Tormentum II
coveredGames.title: 【7.5/10】Standalone sequel to Tormentum but darlings do not need any prior knowledge. Roughly 8hrs of surreal puzzles and morally ambiguous choices with multiple endings. Runs perfect on Steam Deck.

coveredGames.name: Songtail: Whiskers of Destiny
coveredGames.title: 【8/10】A cozy pixel art rhythm game. Investigate guests, then perform songs that reshape how the moment is remembered. A short yet charming mystery game my darlings really shouldn't miss!

coveredGames.name: Fugitive Free Rider
coveredGames.title: 【6.5/10】Hack and slash musou with generic (?) anime girls and a fun runaway heiress plot. Combos are pretty shallow and the dialogue is rough, but otherwise a neat indie game for darlings to try out.

coveredGames.name: EULA ~2026 Human Creativity Report~
coveredGames.title: 【8/10】A visual novel where pressing Tab swaps organic and AI mode with art, text and music all shifting to match. It's done surprisingly well and overall an interesting concept with branching endings.

coveredGames.name: Cottonville
coveredGames.title: 【7/10】Cozy farming meets dress-up as you grow crops to dye your own fabrics and stitch outfits for the villagers. Map and crafting menus need work but my darlings will enjoy dressing everyone up!

coveredGames.name: Cure for Danmaku Synd
coveredGames.title: 【7/10】Unique top-down bullet hell where darlings parry (instead of shoot) through an infected body to wipe out pathogens. Quite a lot of collision bugs at launch but the devs patched them fast.

coveredGames.name: Dungeon Bomber
coveredGames.title: 【7.5/10】A turn-based roguelite where you drop bombs each round, chain blasts, and fuse them into stronger charges. Simple to learn, tense to master, my darlings will enjoy this cozy dungeon crawl!

coveredGames.name: LumineNight
coveredGames.title: 【8/10】Set in the 1950s, play as Detective Foster and his daughter to solve murders in a corrupt neon city. The point and click investigating is pretty fun and my darlings will love the noir mood.

coveredGames.name: The Demon King: Harem
coveredGames.title: 【7.5/10】A short isekai JRPG about a Demon King rallying a goblin harem to fend off the human invasion. It's fully uncensored and very easy overall, a cozy 4 to 5 hour romp for my darlings.

coveredGames.name: 閃攻機人アスラ - ASURA THE STRIKER -
coveredGames.title: 【8/10】Space Harrier reborn as a 3D rail shooter, punching invaders out of the sky as the mech ASURA. Very creative bosses, and great arcade throwback. It won't disappoint my darlings!

coveredGames.name: Master of Vtuber
coveredGames.title: 【6/10】A roguelite VTuber sim where darlings juggle streams, train and study with a talent tree that carries into your future runs. Lots of potential but kinda buggy with very rough translations.

coveredGames.name: Silver Blade of Gods' End
coveredGames.title: 【7.5/10】A Brigandine style conquest RPG with Fire Emblem combat, Lots of characters and 4 branching routes. Art and sound are somewhat rough but my darlings will find real strategic depth in this one!

coveredGames.name: Fruit Mountain Party
coveredGames.title: 【7/10】Early Access. Suika-like fruit merging gets a fun twist with items and mind games as up to four darlings battle online. Remote Play Together means friends can join without owning it!

coveredGames.name: Immerse Gamepack FINAL FANTASY™ XIV Online Edition
coveredGames.title: 【APP】Official add-on software that scans your ears into an HRTF profile for 360 spatial audio in FFXIV. Footsteps and boss cues get crisper but my darlings need good headphones to really feel it.

coveredGames.name: The seven days i spent with you
coveredGames.title: 【7/10】Confinement horror-romance done right. Darlings have to survive seven days locked in a small room with yandere Shiro. Fully animated sprites. Short at roughly ~4 hrs, pretty unsettling overall.

coveredGames.name: Iris Odyssey
coveredGames.title: 【7.5/10】Free-to-start VN where an orphan girl and a magic investigator chase sorcerers through Shibuya. Fully voiced ~4 hr choice-driven gameplay. Really touching but the full story needs a paid DLC.

coveredGames.name: Crusaders Quest : Hero Town
coveredGames.title: 【APP】Cute pixel heroes defend your town in this desktop idler. Pretty satisfying to leave running in the background. Base game has 42 free six star heroes but darlings can get more with the paid DLCs.

coveredGames.name: Stories from Sol: The Gun-Dog
coveredGames.title: 【9/10】Retro PC-98 visual novel inspired by Gundam and Metal Gear. Tackles PTSD, war and mystery in space. About 6 hours with branching endings worth replaying. My darlings won't see the twists coming!

coveredGames.name: Mon-Yu: Defeat Monsters And Gain Strong Weapons And Armor. You May Be Defeated, But Don’t Give Up. Become Stronger. I Believe There Will Be A Day When The Heroes Defeat The Devil King.
coveredGames.title: 【7/10】Old-school first-person crawling. Build your party and watch weapons and armor grow with them. Recorder-key puzzles can be tedious but it's pretty solid for darlings craving Wizardry nostalgia.

coveredGames.name: Antivirus Girl
coveredGames.title: 【8/10】Tower defense x shooter. Deploy modules, scan incoming files, then blast whatever malware slips past you. Story rich with sexual content and cute heroines. Definitely worth my darling's time!

coveredGames.name: Advent: Dawn
coveredGames.title: 【7.5/10】A cave collapse traps seven strangers in this mystery VN styled after Zero Escape. Voice acting sounds somewhat stiff and the character art takes some getting use to, but the mystery is good.

coveredGames.name: Navigatore of the Ruined World
coveredGames.title: 【7/10】A post-apocalyptic otome, just you and Mika alone amid ruined cities, 17 endings depending on choices. Heavy mood throughout, but my darlings who love slow emotional build-ups should try it!

coveredGames.name: Hypatia
coveredGames.title: 【7/10】A lighthearted and cozy VN about darlings saving a cafe by wooing the four heroines. Total of seven endings. Spine animated CGs are pretty good, but note that there’s no explicit content.

coveredGames.name: Dramatic Road : the origin of wind
coveredGames.title: 【8/10】An SRPG set in modern Kanagawa where students fight with motorcycles and fists. Shift Change lets you reorder your own turns mid-battle, overall a fun puzzle battle system my darlings can enjoy.

coveredGames.name: Be Missed and Remembered: The Letter from Mayoiga
coveredGames.title: 【8/10】An all age mystery novel about a boy chasing a shrine legend and a girl trapped by time. Linear, no choices, but bittersweet. My darlings who loved Narcissu will love this one!

coveredGames.name: Demons' Timeline
coveredGames.title: 【8.5/10】L never leaves his room, he scrolls a fake social network to catch demon killers with partner Nyasuteria. Took Onee-chan 12hrs, it's dense but not punishing. Darlings will love the deduction!

coveredGames.name: Catio Simulator
coveredGames.title: 【7/10】A cozy incremental where you decorate a catio, pet cats til they're adoption ready, and cash in fees for cuter furniture. Rare cats turn grindy near the end but my darlings will adore the vibe!

coveredGames.name: 命运&通胀 -Fate&Inflation-
coveredGames.title: 【7/10】Card building roguelite where runs snowball into absurd exponential numbers, just as the name suggests. Simple tactics with anime female lead. It's a cheap incremental title for my darlings.

coveredGames.name: Nekopedia: Find Her Tail
coveredGames.title: 【6/10】Point and click hidden object game where finding cats unlocks each neko girl's story and an uncensored adult scene. Press Ctrl+F for quick stage clears.

coveredGames.title: It's like Vampire Survivors trying to cosplay Diablo I. Обзор от Evgueni [Linux user].
