coveredGames.title: A million [strike]flies[/strike] players can't be wrong – Megabonk has something for everyone… Обзор от Evgueni [Linux user].

coveredGames.name: DOGWALK
coveredGames.title: A cute dog in a cute game made by a good people. Обзор от Evgueni [Linux user].

coveredGames.name: Divinum
coveredGames.title: Slick graphics, fluid combat & challenging time trials. Enough abilities for players develop their own combat style. Approx. 9 hours for 100% completion.

coveredGames.name: Magical Blush
coveredGames.title: Combination of action RPG & puzzle platforming with non-linear exploration. Plenty of magic spells to learn and upgrade. Beautiful pixel art & "sounds like a Sega" OST. See full review.

coveredGames.name: Dicetris
coveredGames.title: Looks like Tetris but isn't anything like it! Sharpen your on-the-fly arithmetic skills and land satisfying combos by stacking dice. Sleekly designed & easy on the eyes. Journey & Endless modes.

coveredGames.name: Fruitimo! Juicy Night Ride
coveredGames.title: On-rails score attack (cute-em-up adjacent) with 6 short stages. Family friendly - ideal for both younger and older audiences! Local high scores.

coveredGames.name: Prototype Juan: A Tale of Two Mundos
coveredGames.title: Action-packed precision performer that doesn't overstay its welcome. Maneuver your way through carefully crafted levels to help Prototype Juan regain his 16-bit glory. Absolutely worth picking up.

coveredGames.name: Hashire HEBEREKE: EX
coveredGames.title: Even as a fan of the series, this release is pretty disappointing. Both SP & MP modes in the remake are buggy. Not even menus in the OG version were translated into English. Half-baked & lacking love

coveredGames.name: THE GENERAL SAGA
coveredGames.title: The General Saga stands out from other survivors-like games with its unique party building mechanic. Runs are short but lots of grinding is needed to progress. Music is good but could use more tracks.

coveredGames.name: DoDonPachi Resurrection Reignite
coveredGames.title: A fantastic addition to the existing DDP port on Steam! The new multiplayer mode adds variation & has leaderboards. Support this release and show CAVE that we want more of their games on Steam!

coveredGames.name: Ariana and the Elder Codex
coveredGames.title: The combat isn’t particularly challenging or fun and I couldn’t get into the story but the magical storybook aesthetic is quite pleasing. Pick it up on sale if you’re curious.

coveredGames.name: AVILION forever
coveredGames.title: Hats off to Studio Frontier for making this previously mobile-only RPG available on Steam! As expected from a 2004 title, it's full charming graphics & turn-based combat. Decent translation as well.

coveredGames.name: A Love Letter in Snowfall
coveredGames.title: Modern FMV release with plenty of romance. Despite being under 3 hours, it delivers a meaningful "slice-of-life" experience with its captivating performances.

coveredGames.name: PROJECT.98
coveredGames.title: PROJECT.98 is full of nostalgic Windows GFX and Y2K humor, If you know, you know, Watch out for the BSOD!

coveredGames.name: Gacha Capsule Shop Simulator - Akihabara
coveredGames.title: Turns out running a store in Akihabara is pretty fun, Unlock rare figurines, customize your shop and play and mini-games. It already shows much promise in early access & can only get better!

coveredGames.name: Cirno! Lifts a Boulder
coveredGames.title: Short & sweet 3D platformer collectathon set in a charming wintry environment. Ideal for fans of Touhou and N64 enthusiasts alike.

coveredGames.name: Changeable Guardian ESTIQUE
coveredGames.title: Excellent modern-day horizontal shmup developed for retro hardware with online leaderboards. Contains 2 versions of the game (NES/FC) + bonus prototype. Normal/Hard/God of Game difficulties. Love it!

coveredGames.name: Dragon Dragon Fire Fire Deluxe
coveredGames.title: Simple, but addicting arcade action with leaderboards (global & friends). Challenging (but not too difficult) achievements as well. If you like single-screen arcade titles, definitely pick this one up

coveredGames.name: NAMCO LEGENDARY Mountains
coveredGames.title: BeXide have created something special here: A Suika-like with Namco arcade SFX & voxel versions of classic sprites. Together, they elevate the game into something that feels both nostalgic & fresh.

coveredGames.name: Mina the Hollower
coveredGames.title: Yacht Club Games (creators of Shovel Knight), have unsurprisingly nailed it Mina the Hollower. If you love retro-inspired games, pick this up now. The OST (composed by J. Kaufman) is also phenomenal!

coveredGames.name: DAWN ONE
coveredGames.title: It's easy to assume that any action game requiring only a mouse might be gimmicky. However, DAWN ONE has lots of variety and once you learn its techniques is quite rewarding.

coveredGames.name: Fields of Mistria
coveredGames.title: It's safe to say in v1.0 that FoM is not simply a re-skin of Stardew Valley. It has similar mechanics (farming, mining, romancing) but the design, characters & dialogue is simply better. Recommended!

coveredGames.name: STEINS;GATE RE:BOOT
coveredGames.title: Full remake of the classic visual novel from MAGES. If you've never experienced STEINS;GATE before, there's never been a better time with these updated graphics.

coveredGames.name: Future Knight
coveredGames.title: What '90s kids imagined it would be like to play a Tiger handheld: fast action, fluid animation and weirdo sound effects. The Katamari-esque vocals in the OST are icing on the cake. Check it out!

coveredGames.name: Hell Maiden
coveredGames.title: Finally a horde/survivors-like with a strong '90s anime aesthetic AND superb visuals/soundtrack. Although currently in early access, well worth supporting already. Plenty of content coming as well!

coveredGames.name: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales
coveredGames.title: The Adventures of Elliot plays like an action RPG on SNES but feels much more modern with fast travel and unique weapon perks. More dialogue than expected. Takes around 40 hrs to 100% complete!

coveredGames.name: BOXROOM
coveredGames.title: BOXROOM has great potential for showcasing Steam libraries. Sadly an external tool is needed to get it to work properly. Unless you want to support the project, hold off on until the full release,

coveredGames.name: Platypus Reclayed
coveredGames.title: Far from a cheap cash grab on a cult classic, Platypus Reclayed is a beautifully executed & incredibly fun remake. Enjoy fantastic 2-player co-op action backed by a brilliant, fully remixed OST!

coveredGames.name: Forbidden Ground - Lair of Aooni -
coveredGames.title: Despite mixed reviews, Forbidden Ground - Lair of Aooni is worth checking out. The setting in an abandoned school is eerie enough but when mixed with PS1-era graphics it becomes truly unsettling.

coveredGames.name: Fruit Mountain Party
coveredGames.title: Who thought competitively stacking fruit could be so much fun? It can get chaotic at times but it's so satisfying when you can steal fruit from friends. Features online & local multiplayer modes

coveredGames.name: Beholgar 2
coveredGames.title: Beholgar 2 is a massive upgrade over the original, packing even more muscle man madness! It’s a short and to the point metroidvania with excellent 3DO-like graphics and fun boss fights.

coveredGames.name: METRO QUESTER
coveredGames.title: This new Kemco release of 'QUESTER' has all the same dungeon crawling but now includes Steam achievements, updated controls (kbm & controller). Great soundtrack & ambiance!

coveredGames.name: Saint Slayer: Spear of Sacrilege
coveredGames.title: NES-inspired platformer with accessibility modes (no knockback, more lives & passwords). You'll want to memorize stages so you can impress all your friends with your performance. Top-notch soundtrack!

coveredGames.name: Calamity Angels: Special Delivery
coveredGames.title: Unique blend of delivery missions & turn-based board game action. Overall the gameplay loop is not too difficult despite some RNG elements. Loving these bold new creations from Idea Factory!

coveredGames.name: DATE A LIVE: Rio Reincarnation
coveredGames.title: Contains 3 DATE A LIVE visual novels in one package. As expected there are multiple routes/endings. This is the perfect introduction to the series. Once completed, follow it up with 'Ren Dystopia'

coveredGames.name: Neptunia: Sisters VS Sisters
coveredGames.title: Great Neptunia spinoff entry will delight hardcore fans and also entice newcomers. Sisters VS Sisters has plenty of action-filled combat (switch between 3 characters) and go ham in goddess mode!

coveredGames.name: RETRYS
coveredGames.title: Self-reflexive JRPG where you as the protagonist not only exterminate 'bugs' found within the game but also use them to repair environments and help out NPCs. Fun, definitely weird & snappy!

coveredGames.name: Alabaster Dawn
coveredGames.title: Better HD-2D graphics & more fluid animations than Square-Enix. In Alabaster Dawn, Radical Fish has somehow improved on the already stellar foundations laid with CrossCode. Highly recommended!

coveredGames.name: Yaxi Taxi
coveredGames.title: Only one button needed in this simple, yet addicting taxi arcade runner set in space. Not convinced? Test it out yourself on itch.io! No achievements...yet!

coveredGames.name: Summer’s Heartbeat
coveredGames.title: Alluring, immersive & even surreal at times! This is the kind of FMV that's fun to play alone or with a group! Features a memorable cast (Village Chief is my fave) with tons of replayability. Get it!

coveredGames.name: MADO MONOGATARI: Fia and the Wondrous Academy
coveredGames.title: Cute & vibrant PS2-esque graphics, a unique hybrid of action/turn-based dungeon crawling & a catchy OST. Added bonus: Appearances by Sega Sweethearts like Carbuncle & Puyo Puyo!

coveredGames.name: Towerix91
coveredGames.title: Short & sweet TD title with a nostalgic interface & graphics. Upgrades are straightforward & immediately felt - both run-based & permanent ones! Feeling lucky? Give the in-game slot machine a spin!

coveredGames.name: NOSTRA
coveredGames.title: An early alpha of an RPG with interesting turn-based combat.

coveredGames.name: Hayaku! Island of Darkness
coveredGames.title: Great short preview of a 2d pixel-art metroidvania

coveredGames.name: Tormentum II
coveredGames.title: Tormentum II is an omen to the classic point-and-click adventure. Explore a grim world, solve puzzles, make moral choices, and reach one of its multiple endings.

coveredGames.name: The Convergence
coveredGames.title: Build your own squad of five classes, choose the right skills, and lead them to victory against waves of hordes from all eras in this auto battler where every choice matters.

coveredGames.name: R.E.P.O.
coveredGames.title: Haul loot past monsters and try not to break it. R.E.P.O. is co-op horror where your clumsiest friend is the real threat.

coveredGames.name: PlateUp!
coveredGames.title: Redesign your kitchen between days and pray nobody waits too long. PlateUp is roguelite co-op cooking with real challenges.

coveredGames.name: KeyWe
coveredGames.title: Two kiwis, one post office and a typewriter you smash with your butt. KeyWe is a fresh, cute co-op puzzler with brutal gold times.

coveredGames.name: Tormentum - Dark Sorrow
coveredGames.title: Tormentum is a rich, dark world with the best art design to date. Filled with lots of puzzles and moral decisions, find redemption or embrace darkness in this point-and-click adventure.

coveredGames.name: The Farm of the Living
coveredGames.title: A short CYOA game, set in a zombie apocalypse, where your choices will shape the story and its characters. Multiple endings will define the fate of the farm.

coveredGames.name: The Shadow
coveredGames.title: Carve your own path with your shadow in this thrilling CYOA book. Be afraid of your shadow, or learn to control it; every choice will change you.

coveredGames.name: Cornucopia®
coveredGames.title: A cozy, casual, fast-paced farming simulator. From harvesting, meeting villagers, fighting monsters, and plenty more, farm at your own pace with lots of tools and 2.5D graphics.

coveredGames.name: MASUKU
coveredGames.title: Masuku is a simplified version of UNO, where you must play cards filling the dots to get points. Test your wits and luck against the computer or other players.

coveredGames.name: SnekromancY
coveredGames.title: A roguelike, bullet-heaven mashup filled with puns in the form of the classic game Snake.

coveredGames.name: SeizeControl
coveredGames.title: More than a file explorer, SeizeControl turns your desktop into a customizable toolbox for files, workflows and everything in between.⁩⁩

coveredGames.name: DragonSword : Awakening
coveredGames.title: Anime-style RPG in which you follow Lute on his journey to become the Dragon Slayer.

coveredGames.name: Remorses
coveredGames.title: A survival horror where we depend on visual and auditory clues and opening windows to survive. Escape from the manor before the air suffocates you.

coveredGames.name: TSIOQUE
coveredGames.title: A comedic and altogether clever point and click adventure- Tsioque is an enjoyable experience to play. It also has a rather solid narrative that makes good use of foreshadowing.

coveredGames.name: Saint of Chains
coveredGames.title: Saint of Chains follows behind the greatest survival horror shooter cult hits. Descend into darkness, fight against abnormal nightmares, manage your weapons and solve puzzles, and try to stay alive.

coveredGames.name: Frontier Paladin
coveredGames.title: A casual isometric hack-and-slash that also combines tower defense. Protect the empire as a paladin, defeat demons, and safeguard others with your skills and setting up your defenses.

coveredGames.name: Nioh 3
coveredGames.title: Third game of the series and a sequel to the previous entry after a time skip, where you will find yourself fighting new and old enemies, with a massive variety of weapons, playstyles and movesets.

coveredGames.name: CODE VEIN II
coveredGames.title: Open world souls like, seperate from the previous entry, with a nice variety of weapons, interesting story and characters and challange.

coveredGames.name: DEVOUR
coveredGames.title: A co-op horror game where teamwork meets panic. Not the scariest, but definitely unforgettable.

coveredGames.name: Net.Attack() - Code or Die!
coveredGames.title: Hack your way through the terminal against hundreds of robots in Net,Attack(), a roguelike with basic code programming.

coveredGames.name: Table Battle Simulator
coveredGames.title: Set up your own table battle shop, buy, sell, or open and collect champions from four series, and battle with other customers! Complete all the collections in Table Battle Simulator.

coveredGames.name: Monster Lab Simulator
coveredGames.title: In Monster Lab you are a hatcher for cute little pets called Fulus. Hatch elemental eggs and bask in the creation! Sell, merge, and obtain rarer pets to send them into battle.

coveredGames.name: Katana Dragon
coveredGames.title: An adventure that captures the classic RPGs in a land perfectly crafted, with hack-n-slash combat and lots of puzzles that could have been done with a bit more work.

coveredGames.name: Ritualist
coveredGames.title: Choose a plethora of enhancements, make powerful builds, and upgrade your weapons to dominate the ruins of Ritualist. Up to three bosses and biomes are currently available.

coveredGames.name: Eastern Exorcist
coveredGames.title: Explore a mystical world of demons and spirits.

coveredGames.name: 9 Kings
coveredGames.title: The developers dare you to break the game by creating the best build possible to become the king of kings, in this strategy deckbuilder roguelike.

coveredGames.name: Genome Guardian 2
coveredGames.title: Build a crazy nanobot, mix wild DNA guns, and survive neon microbes in this chaotic, bass-pumping microscopic shootout!

coveredGames.name: Reenchant
coveredGames.title: A Kingdom-like strategy game where you protect the forest instead of cutting it down. Manage your spirits, recruit clouds, and prepare your defenses against the woodcutters.

coveredGames.name: Cat President: 3rd-Rate Candidate
coveredGames.title: This game is just pure, adorable political cat silliness - and it leans fully into the fun. I jumped in expecting a light distraction and came out smiling. And honestly? That’s the core strength here.

coveredGames.name: GraviChess
coveredGames.title: Play the classic chess in a different way: platforming! Gravichess has 100 levels packed with a new way to beat the board using the traditional six pieces.

coveredGames.name: AutoBlobber
coveredGames.title: As the name suggests, a blob does all the fighting for you while you upgrade it with better weapons to take on evil blobs in this autobattler roguelike.

coveredGames.name: War and Politics
coveredGames.title: Run the country your way! Rewrite laws, raise taxes, win wars, dodge crises and survive elections in this high-speed political power simulator.

coveredGames.name: Anomalous Adventure
coveredGames.title: Old-school hack-and-slash meets real-time reflexes. Block, cast and loot your way through ever-changing worlds in this bite-sized mini-RPG adventure.

coveredGames.name: Pinhead Adventures
coveredGames.title: Time’s almost up! As Pinhead (and trusty Orbo), battle bizarre alien hordes, crack cosmic puzzles, power up and chase Zortan to the edge of existence.

coveredGames.name: thanks mom
coveredGames.title: A baby’s nap turns into a quiet, dreamlike adventure. Explore memories, find the cow and uncover a different ending in just one peaceful sitting.

coveredGames.name: Darkness Ritual: Impasse
coveredGames.title: You saw the ritual. Now the ritual sees you. Escape a seven-chapter nightmare where the path doesn’t exist and the darkness wants you to stay.

coveredGames.name: Dungeon's Anima
coveredGames.title: Be the last undead standing! Harvest souls, swap classes mid-fight & rebuild your dungeon in this co-op bullet-hell roguelite where the empire is the loot.

coveredGames.name: Zefyr: A Thief's Melody
coveredGames.title: A great Action platformer game that feels like the N64 Zelda games. I don't think that any of the achievements are missable. Great guide available here on Steam. ~18h to complete.

coveredGames.name: Circle Empires 2
coveredGames.title: Cool, beginner-friendly RTS. No missable achievements, and it takes around 20 hours to complete.

coveredGames.name: Shipping Store Simulator 2037
coveredGames.title: Lovely shopkeeper kinda automation game! No missable achievements, but walk and drive as much as you can so you don't have to grind. Always keep repair kits in your car. 13h to 100%

coveredGames.name: Echo Weaver
coveredGames.title: What a unique metroidbrainia game! Your in-game character isn’t the only one learning more and more about the world you wake up in; you, the player, are too.

coveredGames.name: Nivalis Nights
coveredGames.title: Lovely, immersive life sim with so much to do. You can miss some achievements; it's best to save before talking to someone. And get the loan from a loan shark after going broke in the first few days.

coveredGames.name: Woodo
coveredGames.title: A cute puzzle game with no missable achievements. I struggled with the controls quite a bit. Try to find the monk in every level, and if you see a walkie-talkie, click it a few times. ~3 a 4h to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Click&Fix
coveredGames.title: Incremental game in which you clean & repair consoles. No missable achievements; you have to play through normal mode and timed mode, but you’ll earn experience points to make it easier. ~7h to 100%

coveredGames.name: Doggy Don't Care
coveredGames.title: Play as a mischievous dog who was left alone at home and you’ll make a mess of the home. Many achievements are missable; however, you have to play through the game twice, so you can mop them up then.

coveredGames.name: Infiniclick
coveredGames.title: Infiniclick is a fun incremental game where Fun Corp gets you into a scheme where you have to pay them back a lot of money. You need to play all 3 different game modes, and there are a few missables.

coveredGames.name: Pibcremental
coveredGames.title: A fun incremental game that is missing a few quality-of-life features. None of the achievements are missable, and they’ll unlock over time as you progress. Completion takes around 5 to 6 hours.

coveredGames.name: Cards Everywhere!
coveredGames.title: a sorting/cleaning game where you pick up TCG cards and sort them in your album. It has missable achievements. The most important one: filling the album in order. Completion takes around 8h.

coveredGames.name: Cozy Cleaner
coveredGames.title: Cozy Cleaner is a lovely cleaning game where you clean up spaces (mostly houses) by throwing away trash, cleaning floors and walls, and putting things in the washing machine. No missable achievs.

coveredGames.name: Ballionaire
coveredGames.title: Crazy roguelike pachinko that can be very addictive. Gladly it isn't overstaying its welcome, as it can be completed in around 12 hours or so. It doesn't have any missable achievements.

coveredGames.name: Dragon Dinner
coveredGames.title: Dragon Dinner is a cute Overcooked-style game with no missable achievements, and you can complete the levels on the cozy difficulty. Completion takes around 6 hours.

coveredGames.name: Sludgineers
coveredGames.title: Such a fun incremental/cleaning game! None of the achievements are missable; you can enjoy the game without worrying about them. It takes around 5 to 6 hours to complete.

coveredGames.name: Soba's Gunpaw
coveredGames.title: Fun incremental game that takes around 5h to complete. It has no missable achievements.

coveredGames.name: The Last Cat in the Universe
coveredGames.title: Incremental game that takes around 2,5h to complete. No missable achievements.

coveredGames.name: Cauldron
coveredGames.title: Amazing incremental game with mini-games! I enjoyed this game so much, and it is fun to see the mini-games change as you unlock upgrades. No missable achievements.

coveredGames.name: Cozy Caravan
coveredGames.title: Cute game without missable achievements. However, wave a lot to people so they don't have to grind as much at the end for the last few upgrades. There is also a quest with pigment you can repeat daily

coveredGames.name: Blue Fire
coveredGames.title: A challenging platformer without missable achievements. Achievements are mostly for story progression and side quests. You don't need all the orbs in the voids or all the chests for the achievements.

coveredGames.name: Thrifty Business
coveredGames.title: Lovely short shopkeeping game in which you arrange how to display all the different items in your shop. The more items of the same type you place together, the more points you earn. ~6h to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Shard Squad
coveredGames.title: A great Bullet Heaven game in which you make a team of creatures to tackle each new stage. While grinding for resources for meta progression. Completion takes around 25h, no missable achievements.

coveredGames.name: The Greenening
coveredGames.title: A cute incremental game in which you clean ash off the earth. In each level, the ash takes longer to wash away, but you’ll also unlock crazy powers. Completion takes around 3h, no missabables.

coveredGames.name: Agrivore: Incremental Farming
coveredGames.title: A fun incremental game where you harvest crops for a gluttonous King. There are cool combinations between crops, weapons, and skills. No missable achievements, 100% = ~4h.

coveredGames.name: Vending Machine Co.
coveredGames.title: Vendine Machine Co. is a fun and relaxing management sim. Buy vending machines, keep them stocked, and play a bunch of mini games. No missable achievements, 100% in around 12 hours or so.

coveredGames.name: All Hail the Orb
coveredGames.title: A Fun idle game that I couldn't stop playing, as it always felt close to the next upgrade. Be aware, it has missable achievements. You should only have 3 achievements left when finishing the game.

coveredGames.name: Skull Horde
coveredGames.title: What a great dungeon crawler/auto-battle roguelite! It offers various difficulty options, and all achievements can be done on the easier settings. Took me around 30h to 100%, no missable achievements.

coveredGames.name: Cleaning Up!
coveredGames.title: In this wonderful game, you’ll clean houses… and cafes… just normal buildings (I swear, nothing strange is going on over here!). No missable achievements and completion takes around 3.5 hours.

coveredGames.name: More Sushi!
coveredGames.title: In memory of KatherineOfSky <3. Her video is in the link in this review. No missable achievements, 1h to 100%

coveredGames.name: Eternal Strands
coveredGames.title: An amazing game in which you explore an unknown area while also hunting down huge monsters, and you climb onto them to find their weak spot. None of the achievements are missable, 100% = ~40h.

coveredGames.name: Dungeon Tycoon
coveredGames.title: What if a dungeon was like a Theme Park? Build your own dungeon and keep the business afloat. Play on Survival mode to be able to unlock all the achievements, can be played on easy. Around 8h to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Coral Island
coveredGames.title: What an amazing life/farming sim with so much to do! And so many QoL features in the gaming, including a filter to see which items you haven't donated/sold/offered. No missable achievements, ~ 160h.

coveredGames.name: CiniCross
coveredGames.title: A roguelike picross game sounds right up my alley. However, a few things hold this game back. Has very grindy and very challenging achievements. However, no missable achievements.

coveredGames.name: Bear and Breakfast
coveredGames.title: Cute adventure management game, with quests to guide you along the way. None of the achievements are missable. Took me around 30h to complete.

coveredGames.name: Another Crab's Treasure
coveredGames.title: Colorful soulslike with numerous assist abilities. No missable achievements. Make mopping up the last achievements easier by writing down when you find a key; you need 15 of the 16 keys.

coveredGames.name: 9 Years of Shadows
coveredGames.title: An amazing metroidvania with many unique abilities and boss fights! Took me around 20h to 100%. Bestiary achievement is missable.

coveredGames.name: Bit-Cremental: Fishistry
coveredGames.title: An incremental idle game that takes around 8h to 100%. No missable achievements. Achievements unlock when closing the game. I would focus on the value of the fish and the amount of auto-feed.

coveredGames.name: Shelldiver
coveredGames.title: A cute incremental game in which you play as a turtle that dives to catch jellyfish and collect gems. Use those to buy upgrades to dive deeper and reach jellyfish much more! 100% ~4h, no missables.

coveredGames.name: BALL x PIT
coveredGames.title: Roguelite Enginebuilder x Bullet Heaven, I love this game! It is so addictive to play one more round. The last character you unlock reduces some of the active grind. No missables, ~30h to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Rocket Rats
coveredGames.title: A great short bullet Heaven game with a diverse achievement list. Only having this small moon as your playing area is different from other Bullet Heavens. No missables and completion takes around 6h.

coveredGames.name: Fatekeeper
coveredGames.title: Venture into a handcrafted world where ruins whisper of past cataclysms.

coveredGames.name: NITRO GEN OMEGA
coveredGames.title: Assemble your crew, customize your Mech, and lead them in cinematic turn-based battles through a world ruled by rogue AI.

coveredGames.name: Elin
coveredGames.title: In an update blog, they promoted a Steam Workshop mod that uses an A.I. Generated thumbnail.

coveredGames.name: D1AL-ogue
coveredGames.title: The publisher, Jungle Game Lab, has published games made with A.I. Generated material.

coveredGames.name: Taimanin Asagi 2
coveredGames.title: A top tier VN with lots of H-content and great art. Easy to recommend if you enjoyed the previous games. H-content requires a patch.

coveredGames.name: Noa and the Bandits' Den
coveredGames.title: Hentai RPG where your goal is to sneak past the guards strolling around the base. If you get caught... well you know what happens next. Gallery is available and Restoration patch required.

coveredGames.name: The Fame Game II: L.A. Heartbreaker
coveredGames.title: SFW interactive movie with multiple choices, beautiful cast of actresses and somewhat comical & ridiculous storyline. Has achievements and gallery for various events

coveredGames.name: WakuWaku Park
coveredGames.title: Exhibitionism themed game with various character/clothing customization options. Few different locations available with option to choose night/day. Big part of the content is from 3rd party patch.

coveredGames.name: The Demon King: Harem
coveredGames.title: Isekai'd into a body of a demon king, heed the call of your allies, fight off the humans, and build the best harem in the world! Superb NSFW animations, streamlined story, and at an affordable price!

coveredGames.name: The Crimson Maid
coveredGames.title: Lovely exploration & puzzle game with colorful graphics, relaxing gameplay and very good storyline. Has romance and nudity but no explicit scenes. Multiple endings + demo available.

coveredGames.name: Loli Ninja Village
coveredGames.title: As the name suggests, this village only consists of loli's and you're an ogre on a path of revenge. Peep, sneak and then pounce on the girls, to impregnate everyone. Less than an hour of gameplay.

coveredGames.name: Yokai Art 2: Tales of the Nine-Tails
coveredGames.title: Secret Labo has done it again, a sequel to the first Yokai Art and as such it has infinite amount of bugs, impossible to understand mechanics, over half a dozen patches and it is unplayable.

coveredGames.name: Amelie falls over and over again ~ An endless week in Magic Academy
coveredGames.title: Classic JRPG, with a deep mystery, the week resetting, leading to new events, and steamy NSFW scenes. Mainly NTR content, beautiful art, music, voice overs and gallery. Achievements also available!

coveredGames.name: PROCEDURE ZERO
coveredGames.title: Тюремные коридоры давят сильнее монстров: изучаешь маршруты охраны, отвлекаешь её и покупаешь помощь заключённых. Ресурсов мало, ошибки нервируют; новые сектора и тайны зовут на повторный заход.

coveredGames.name: ArcheAge Chronicles
coveredGames.title: Здесь легко потерять счёт времени: ищешь следы древней истории, ныряешь за сокровищами или идёшь в подземелье с друзьями. Оружие развивается, боссы не щадят, а новые вылазки не наскучивают.

coveredGames.name: Crawler 3D
coveredGames.title: 'Crawler 3D' is an awesome dark fantasy first-person dungeon crawling action-rpg with a good combination of exploration, combat and magic, skills and upgrade, a fine story and various quests..its fun!

coveredGames.name: Volkolak: The Will of Gods
coveredGames.title: A beautiful and well made 2d metroidvania plateformer in a dark fantasy slacic world.."Volkolak: The Will of Gods" offer an engaging story, intense and rewarding combat system, skills and upgrade..A+

coveredGames.name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
coveredGames.title: Kingdom Rush 6 (Genesis TD) is back! an excellent Tower defense game with instant fun, slid and enjoyable defense gameplay, graphism and animation are pretty, good replayability too..A great TD game.

coveredGames.name: The Crust
coveredGames.title: Колония и фабрики здесь развиваются параллельно, а добыча ресурсов на Луне становится основой прогресса. Для жанра интересным дополнением выглядит наличие сюжетной составляющей.

coveredGames.name: Nerd Simulator
coveredGames.title: Здесь всё крутится вокруг заработка на переезд, а простые задания умудряются становиться всё более непредсказуемыми. Получился забавный взгляд на взрослую жизнь без лишней серьёзности.

coveredGames.name: Fearwoods
coveredGames.title: Здесь лес ощущается настоящим противником: исследую его с напарником, держусь света и стараюсь не попасться демону. Параллельно раскрываю историю Авалин и пытаюсь довести спасение до конца.

coveredGames.name: Hunters In The Dark
coveredGames.title: Иду на охоту за золотом и стараюсь перехитрить соперников, а непредсказуемые зелья постоянно меняют ситуацию. Частично процедурные уровни и продвинутая логика ботов хорошо дополняют игру.

coveredGames.name: AstroScaper
coveredGames.title: Размещаю здания так, чтобы раскрывать синергии и превращать пустые астероиды в колонии. Отдельно радует процедурная генерация миров: каждый следующий астероид становится новой задачей.

coveredGames.name: Cannon Clicker
coveredGames.title: Здесь кликер не сводится к одному нажатию: я развиваю дерево навыков, слежу за тремя валютами и собираю армию из пехоты, танков и самолётов. Стратегическая часть хорошо дополняет основу.

coveredGames.name: Pebble Knights
coveredGames.title: В этой рогалик-игре мне понравился простой вход и динамичные забеги. Собираю предметы в дневном и ночном цикле, отбиваюсь от волн врагов и могу играть в формате диванной вечеринки.

coveredGames.name: NETBREAK
coveredGames.title: Я работал через терминал, выполняя взломы сетей, сканирование и операции с учетными данными. Интересно, что игра делает акцент не на образе хакера, а на роли оператора с множеством миссий и концовок.

coveredGames.name: Tormentum II
coveredGames.title: Попав в созданный мной кошмар, я исследовал острова и искал решения для загадок. Формат «укажи и щелкни» хорошо сочетается с мрачным фэнтези и атмосферой психологического ужаса. Атмосфера супер.

coveredGames.name: Battlements
coveredGames.title: Строительство стен и установка пушек стали основой моих сражений. Мне понравилось сочетание обороны и атаки: нужно защищать Маринию, бомбардировать врага и использовать улучшения с картами.

coveredGames.name: Angels Fall First
coveredGames.title: Разные варианты действий делают сражения интереснее: особенно запомнились абордажи вражеских кораблей и участие в больших боях. При этом некоторые игровые элементы уже просятся на улучшения.

coveredGames.name: Human Host
coveredGames.title: Human Host — мрачный хоррор на выживание, где каждая встреча с «человеческим носителем» вызывает тревогу. Исследуешь локации, избегая заражённых, и постепенно раскрываешь историю геймплея. 9 из 10.

coveredGames.name: Life Below
coveredGames.title: Life Below — необычный симулятор восстановления океана. Создаёшь подводную экосистему, управляешь ресурсами и наблюдаешь, как жизнь возвращается в глубины. Спокойный, красивый и очень атмосферный опыт

coveredGames.name: The King Got Too Much Gold
coveredGames.title: Игра переворачивает привычную тему богатства: золото здесь не только награда, но и вызов. Планируешь развитие, управляешь ресурсами и ищешь лучший способ удержать власть.

coveredGames.name: Aarik And The Ruined Kingdom
coveredGames.title: Уютная головоломка с необычной механикой вращения мира. Исследуешь локации, восстанавливаешь путь героя и открываешь новые возможности. Отличный вариант для тех, кто любит красивые и умные игры.

coveredGames.name: Secret Seeker
coveredGames.title: Люблю игры, где нужно не спешить, а наблюдать. Здесь поиск секретов, изучение окружения и постепенное раскрытие тайн создают приятную атмосферу любопытства и исследования.

coveredGames.name: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check
coveredGames.title: Чем дальше проходишь игру, тем сложнее становятся проверки. Новые угрозы, ограниченные ресурсы и постоянный поток людей заставляют быстро анализировать ситуацию и действовать уверенно.

coveredGames.name: Concubine
coveredGames.title: Игра Concubine выглядит многообещающе: глубокая настройка персонажей, командные сражения, прокачка навыков и регулярные обновления. Тут всегда есть чем увлечься на десятки часов. Советую всем.

coveredGames.name: Black Box - Hacker Day One
coveredGames.title: Простая, но атмосферная симуляция хакера с акцентом на задания и прогрессию. Каждая новая миссия добавляет глубины, а чувство работы с системами и данными создаёт лёгкое погружение.

coveredGames.name: Cobalt Miner
coveredGames.title: Игра приятно затягивает циклом из разведки месторождений, добычи кобальта и прокачки оборудования. Наблюдать за ростом эффективности особенно приятно после первых часов.

coveredGames.name: Isekai Villain
coveredGames.title: Свежий взгляд на жанр исекай: вместо спасения мира вы оказываетесь в роли злодея. Развивайте персонажа, принимайте судьбоносные решения, влияйте на сюжет и наслаждайтесь юмором и интригами.

coveredGames.name: Midnight Special
coveredGames.title: Midnight Special — это психологический хоррор с упором на исследование и загадки. Ограниченные ресурсы, странные события и давящая атмосфера держат в напряжении до самого финала.

coveredGames.name: Trees Inc
coveredGames.title: Медитативный симулятор лесного бизнеса, где вы выращиваете деревья, организуете заготовку и переработку древесины. Спокойный темп и развитие производства создают приятный экономический цикл.

coveredGames.name: Humans Vs Orcs
coveredGames.title: Фэнтезийная стратегия о противостоянии людей и орков, где каждая битва требует тактики. Собирайте армии, развивайте базу и используйте сильные стороны юнитов в масштабных сражениях.

coveredGames.name: SWAT Commander
coveredGames.title: SWAT Commander is an impressive Tactical shooter about managing your special force intervention, customisable maps and missions, a good tutorial and training mode, more polish and content to come.

coveredGames.name: Laundering Simulator - Clean Cash and Laundry
coveredGames.title: A cozy management game with a twist! Clean money through a front store..diverse activities (wash, dry, fix, repair, counterfait) unlock new tools for your not-so-legal activities..good humor too! A+

coveredGames.name: Alaska Gold Fever
coveredGames.title: Симулятор золотодобычи на Аляске: исследуйте суровые земли, добывайте ресурсы, улучшайте оборудование и управляйте процессом. Атмосфера и прогресс делают игру затягивающей и медитативной. 10 из 10.

coveredGames.name: The Crazy Hyper-Dungeon Chronicles
coveredGames.title: Пиксельный рогалик с процедурными подземельями: исследуйте лабиринт, решайте головоломки и сражайтесь в боях с таймингом. Выбор классов и билдов делает каждое прохождение уникальным и насыщенным.

coveredGames.name: People of Note
coveredGames.title: Музыкальная RPG с пошаговыми боями и ритм-механиками: собирайте группу, комбинируйте жанры и проводите «битвы-выступления». Яркий стиль, юмор и вариативность делают приключение свежим.

coveredGames.name: Slot or Not
coveredGames.title: A refreshing experience in the turn-based deckbuilder genre! "Slot or Not" offer slot-machine combat mecanism, cute character design, great replayability with various items and upgrade to try out,neat

coveredGames.name: Peregrino
coveredGames.title: Путешествуя по просторам Peregrino, игроку приходится быть готовым как к внезапным схваткам, так и к длительным экспедициям в поисках редких материалов или новых территорий. На данный момент игра топ!

coveredGames.name: Decollate Decoration
coveredGames.title: Сюжет игры проникнут эмоциями и размышлениями о потерях, сожалениях и поиске смысла, что делает повествование глубоко личным и затрагивающим. Каждый новый шаг героини раскрывает кусочки её прошлого.

coveredGames.name: Milling machine simulator
coveredGames.title: A niche but well crafted simulator about learning or perfecting your skills on a Milling machine! Close to the real machine, simulate each preparation, improve your technical approach..fantastic app!

coveredGames.name: Workshop Simulator VR
coveredGames.title: Workshop Simulator is just a fun game for VR: spend quality time in your workshop to tinkler and restore diverse objects, dev team continue to push fix and new content, play it..DIY at it's best!

coveredGames.name: Don't FOOL ME, Beauties!
coveredGames.title: Combine dating sim, k-drama and an entertaining story full of magical and fun situation! "Don't FOOL ME, Beauties!" is a great interactive FMV game, interesting characters, high production..top!

coveredGames.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
coveredGames.title: Castlevania Belmont's Curse is an amazing new Metroidvania from developers Evil Empire. Combat is fast and stylish. Puzzles and exploration are a blast. A welcome return to the series.

coveredGames.name: Mina the Hollower
coveredGames.title: Mina The Hollower, the second game from Shovel Knight developers, Yacht Club is a love letter to all 2D top Zelda Games. It has modernized controls, fluid movement, and high difficulty. A must play!

coveredGames.name: Slay the Spire 2
coveredGames.title: The sequel to the breakout hit, Slay The Spire is finally here, featuring improved animations and even more crazy card combinations. Fans of card battlers will sink hours into this roguelike.

coveredGames.name: Mewgenics
coveredGames.title: Mewgenics is an extremely polished turn-based roguelike with hours upon hours of content to uncover. Breed and care for cats at your home base and then send them off to fight in your next adventure.

coveredGames.name: Hollow Knight: Silksong
coveredGames.title: The sequel to the beloved Metroidvania Hollow Knight is here! Featuring a brand new protagonist and world to explore, with tons of power ups and traversal skills to help your journey along.

coveredGames.name: Halo: Campaign Evolved
coveredGames.title: One of DigiPen's Batchelor of Science in Computer Science and Game Design alumnus worked on the tools and UI for the remake of the first Halo game.

coveredGames.name: Creature Kitchen
coveredGames.title: Created by a team of DigiPen alumni inspired by the Pacific Northwest and a nostalgia for late 90s and early 2000s gaming.

coveredGames.name: Dispatch
coveredGames.title: A Batchelor of Science in Computer Science in Real Time Interactive Simulation alumnus was a technical powerhouse on Dispatch.

coveredGames.name: Hades II

coveredGames.name: Call of Duty®: Black Ops 7

coveredGames.name: MARVEL SNAP
coveredGames.title: One of DigiPen's Batchelor of Art in Game Design alumnus helped design and implement new features for this digital collectable card game.

coveredGames.name: DOOM: The Dark Ages

coveredGames.name: Hellblade II: Senua’s Saga
coveredGames.title: Unbelievable photorealistic graphics, immersive binaural audio, brutal motion captured combat, and psychological story.

coveredGames.name: Dragon's Dogma 2
coveredGames.title: Dynamic pawn companions, thrilling large monster climbs, organic world emergent encounters, and physical combat.

coveredGames.name: Persona 3 Reload

coveredGames.name: Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth

coveredGames.name: Space Engineers

coveredGames.name: Deep Rock Galactic

coveredGames.name: Hades

coveredGames.name: FlatOut 2

coveredGames.name: Portal 2

coveredGames.name: Subnautica

coveredGames.name: Celeste

coveredGames.name: Stardew Valley

coveredGames.name: Grim Fandango Remastered
coveredGames.title: Unforgettable Day of the Dead aesthetic, brilliant noir comedy dialog, memorable characters, and inventive story puzzles.

coveredGames.name: DAVE THE DIVER

coveredGames.name: Left 4 Dead 2

coveredGames.name: CONTROL Ultimate Edition

coveredGames.name: Gothic II: Gold Edition
coveredGames.title: Harsh realistic world progression, reactive island wilderness, memorable faction choices, and highly rewarding exploration.

coveredGames.name: Fallout Shelter

coveredGames.name: Shadowrun Returns

coveredGames.name: Cult of the Lamb

coveredGames.name: Return to Castle Wolfenstein

coveredGames.name: Steelrising

coveredGames.name: The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind Soundtrack

coveredGames.name: Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun

coveredGames.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines

coveredGames.name: The Wolf Among Us Remastered

coveredGames.name: Frostpunk

coveredGames.name: Tropico 6
coveredGames.title: Fun island dictator simulation, archipelago management, funny political satire, and rewarding trade route optimization.

coveredGames.name: Darkest Dungeon®

coveredGames.name: Thief II: The Metal Age
coveredGames.title: Pure stealth focus, vast intricate level designs, atmospheric sound design, and clever water arrow gadget mechanics.

coveredGames.name: Alien: Isolation
coveredGames.title: Terrifying unscripted Alien AI, oppressive retro futuristic atmosphere, immersive motion tracker mechanics, and relentless horror tension.

coveredGames.name: Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition
coveredGames.title: Polished historical RTS, unique asymmetrical civilization mechanics, documentary style campaign videos, and slick multiplayer.

coveredGames.name: Sniper Elite 4
coveredGames.title: Satisfying long range shooting physics, visceral X-ray kill camera, expansive open tactical maps, and rewarding stealth choices.

coveredGames.name: Prey

coveredGames.name: STAR WARS™ Battlefront II (Classic, 2005)
coveredGames.title: Legendary galactic conquest mode, epic space battles, classic hero units, and timeless multi-era Star Wars action.

coveredGames.name: Company of Heroes

coveredGames.name: POSTAL 2

coveredGames.name: Command & Conquer™ Generals

coveredGames.name: Dead Cells

coveredGames.name: Commandos 2: Men of Courage

coveredGames.name: The Sinking City 2
coveredGames.title: Pretty fun survival horror title, the value is mostly in it's replayability -Buy-

coveredGames.title: Rough around the edges but a decent experience inspired by stuff like the original fable is buried under the jank -Buy-

coveredGames.title: A great pirate game, an eh assassin game. -Buy-

coveredGames.title: Pretty fun, but pretty expensive too. Worth it when you can find it for a price you like!

coveredGames.name: ZERO PARADES: Director's Cut
coveredGames.title: Not quite Disco Elysium, but still pretty good on it's own.

coveredGames.name: Swordhaven: Iron Conspiracy
coveredGames.title: Combat is a bit wanting but otherwise a fun indie crpg -Buy-

coveredGames.name: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined
coveredGames.title: A streamlined version of the original that will likely appeal to newcomers but might be hit or miss for returning fans due to the cut content -Buy-

coveredGames.name: IGTAP: an Incremental Game That's Also a Platformer
coveredGames.title: A clever merge of platformer and incremental game that manages to be clever and thoughtful on both fronts. Platforming difficulty is advanced level. Great level design and controls. Fun progression.

coveredGames.name: STUNTBOOST
coveredGames.title: Brilliant little time trial game with great controls, fun and clever level design, clean and well executed visuals, fun unlocks and all the QoL features you'd hope for. Very polished and well made!

coveredGames.name: Mina the Hollower
coveredGames.title: I was worried Mina the Hollower might be getting carried by hype, but having played it, nope, it's actually amazing. Brilliant level design, fun combat, tough bosses, great OST. It's really good!

coveredGames.name: Gecko Gods
coveredGames.title: A gorgeous puzzle/platformer about a gecko lost among a series of magical islands. This game absolutely needs to be seen in motion to appreciate that it's like a living watercolor. Recommended.

coveredGames.name: Sort Them Ducks
coveredGames.title: Have you ever wanted to sort over 4000 rubber ducks onto shelves? I didn't either, but actually it ended up quite a fun use of about 9 hours. Lots of fun duck designs as well as some secrets to find.

coveredGames.name: THE CANON OF BALLS
coveredGames.title: A very difficult first-person platformer I happened to really love. Imagine Super Monkey Ball set in Shadow of the Colossus' world. Fantastic level design and atmosphere, can be played solo or co-op.

coveredGames.name: Hole Is Mine
coveredGames.title: Dig deeper and deeper while finding friends to help, upgrading everything you do along the way. An addictive and fairly quick iterative game worth your time if you have a few hours.

coveredGames.name: Void Pachinko
coveredGames.title: Void Pachinko is an incredibly addictive yet simple iterative game. Customize your board with a variety of pegs, unlock tons of upgrades and figure out the best combos possible. I loved it.

coveredGames.name: Project P.I.T.T.
coveredGames.title: Physics powered iterative game about putting rubber ducks (and more) into a hole for cash. Solve problems your own way with a large variety of objects ranging from mundane to strange. Chaotic fun!

coveredGames.name: Cozy Marbles
coveredGames.title: The best marble run creator/game I've found on Steam. Features an easy and intuitive editor, parts to unlock, marbles to customize and a massive XL map to go wild on if you want to. Big recommend.

coveredGames.name: How Many Dudes?
coveredGames.title: A goofy but surprisingly deep auto-battler rogue-lite featuring a variety of special dudes and unlockable items. I didn't think such a simple premise could be so fun but this really got me pulled in.

coveredGames.name: EMUUROM
coveredGames.title: A refreshing and new take on a metroidvania. Traversal through your interactions with wildlife. Great OST, cute critters, solid controls and a sense of wonder and mystery. Highly recommended!

coveredGames.name: One Move Away
coveredGames.title: A delightful physics puzzler around packing and unpacking belongings into various spaces. It's well made and has precise controls. Few things feel better than lining up a gap and item perfectly!

coveredGames.name: STICKER/BALL
coveredGames.title: A really cute and quirky mix of Peggle and Balatro with a great sketchy and fun art style. Create some of the funniest synergies you've ever seen and go for a high score! Recommended.

coveredGames.name: Valkyrie Saga
coveredGames.title: A low-fi 3D platformer with a ton of personality and really fun movement abilities. Build up your character by finding crystals around the island to be able to handle climbing a massive tower.

coveredGames.name: Onirism
coveredGames.title: An homage to a surprising list of games and genres, Onirism feels a bit like Ratchet & Clank through the lens of Serious Sam with a pinch of TimeSplitters. It has a lot going on and deserves a try!

coveredGames.name: Hozy
coveredGames.title: If you like games like Unpacking and House Flipper, you'll have a fantastic time with Hozy. Clean and organize small spaces with highly detailed interactions and gorgeous art design. Huge recommend.

coveredGames.name: RACCOIN: Coin Pusher Roguelike
coveredGames.title: Raccoin is a chill and well made coin pusher roguelike with Balatro style rounds and fun physics interactions. Addictive and feels good to play, there's plenty to do and unlock. Try your luck!

coveredGames.name: Shelldiver
coveredGames.title: A very simple, extremely addictive action/iterative game with a huge skill tree, lots of style and a lovely chill atmosphere. Shelldiver is great value for your money and I highly recommend it.

coveredGames.name: Everdeep Aurora
coveredGames.title: A charming and beautifully stylish narrative driven adventure platformer that was way too often overlooked.

coveredGames.name: Total Chaos
coveredGames.title: A brutally dark survival horror FPS with incredible atmosphere, level design and visual polish. Sound design and general theme are well executed and cohesive, creating a world that sticks with you.

coveredGames.name: Verho - Curse of Faces
coveredGames.title: A strange and wonderful low-fi first person action RPG that consistently hits moments of curiosity and intrigue. Great level design and visual direction make Verho a recommendation from me.

coveredGames.name: Pseudoregalia
coveredGames.title: A modernized "retro" style 3D action platformer/metroidvania with an incredible sense of style, fun movement and a stellar soundtrack. This game honestly deserved more attention than it received.

coveredGames.name: ANIMAL WELL
coveredGames.title: One of the most magical, secret laden platformer/metroidvania games I've ever encountered. Animal Well will keep you guessing for dozens of hours and the layers unfold. An absolutely fantastic game.

coveredGames.name: COCOON
coveredGames.title: One of my favorite puzzle games in recent memory. Cocoon is mind bending but incredibly focused in how it iterates on puzzle design. Visually gorgeous and brilliantly conceived, this is a must play.

coveredGames.name: Mars First Logistics
coveredGames.title: Snap together your perfect vehicle to solve dozens of different transport problems in a stylized Mars environment. Open ended solutions often make you feel clever. I really enjoyed this game!

coveredGames.name: The Tartarus Key
coveredGames.title: A fascinating and surreal horror meets escape room with a big mysterious puzzle mansion and compelling story. This game was FAR too overlooked in my opinion. Give it a try!

coveredGames.name: Planet of Lana II
coveredGames.title: A very worthy and ambitious follow up, Planet of Lana II takes a wider approach while still embracing the best parts of what made the original great. I can't get over how amazing the art direction is!

coveredGames.name: Planet of Lana
coveredGames.title: A gorgeous puzzle/adventure/platformer filled with heart and tons of challenging obstacles to figure out over the course of the suspenseful story playing out. If you like games like Inside, try this.

coveredGames.name: Scritchy Scratchy
coveredGames.title: A very addictive twist on an idle game featuring scratch off lottery cards and an evolving luck mechanic. I ended up loving this and would heartily recommend it if you like the topic.

coveredGames.name: Leaf it Alone
coveredGames.title: A fun and calming "idle" game where you power up while raking leaves around a cute house. Take in the atmosphere and enjoy the process. I really enjoyed this game and would recommend it.

coveredGames.name: Minishoot' Adventures
coveredGames.title: A really unique and fantastic fusion of a top down shooter and adventure game. I can't recommend this game highly enough and finished it in just a few sessions since I didn't want to stop playing.

coveredGames.name: Anger Foot
coveredGames.title: An extremely fast and precise action/FPS game that rewards optimization and learning speedrun techniques. Anger Foot feels a bit like Hotline Miami as an FPS with it's own sense of character.

coveredGames.name: Witchfire
coveredGames.title: The only extraction shooter I'll go to bat for. Dev has put an amazing amount of polish on feel and progression. Punchy FPS action in a PvE only environment. Gorgeous visuals and creepy atmosphere.

coveredGames.name: ROUTINE
coveredGames.title: Routine has some of the best atmosphere I've ever seen in a horror game. The artists who worked on this game deserve every accolade I can think of. Third act stumbles a bit but there are great moments

coveredGames.name: Tinykin
coveredGames.title: One of my favorite 3D platformers! Explore massive, gorgeous levels while using Tinykin (Pikmin like creatures) to solve puzzles and collect items. This game is something quite special!

coveredGames.name: The Invincible
coveredGames.title: An outstanding, deeply touching walking sim filled with extraordinary art direction and presentation. This game is absolutely worth your time if you like sci-fi stories. Highly recommended.

coveredGames.name: The Eternal Cylinder
coveredGames.title: Why is the planet being steamrolled by an enormous, seemingly unending cylinder? Only strange little mutating animals can get to the bottom of this surprisingly compelling mystery/survival/platformer.

coveredGames.name: Night in the Woods
coveredGames.title: Night in the Woods is a bit of an enigma to explain. It's like a very resonant poem filled with character, sweet moments and mystery. I learned things, felt things and didn't want to leave.

coveredGames.name: Dead Cells
coveredGames.title: A fast and exciting action/rogue-lite platformer focused around combat and fun item synergies. Nobody has quite nailed the fusion as nicely as Dead Cells. The DLC is also easily worth the purchase.

coveredGames.name: Return of the Obra Dinn
