coveredGames.title: An atmospheric first-person horror adventure steeped in Japanese urban legend. The eerie village setting and interesting puzzles create genuine tension. However, it's short and leaves you wanting more

coveredGames.name: Cursed Core
coveredGames.title: A brutally hardcore survival sandbox with a randomly generated world that keeps every run fresh. The tension of managing resources while exploring dangerous dungeons is addictive.

coveredGames.name: Demon Street
coveredGames.title: A visually stunning VR shooter with a fantastic neon-drenched atmosphere and catchy synthwave soundtrack. The core loop is simple but satisfying. However, the movement feels overly restrictive

coveredGames.name: Beer Manufacture Simulator
coveredGames.title: A deeply satisfying and educational brewing simulator that lets you craft everything from simple lagers to experimental stouts. The mechanics are rich, though automation comes late.

coveredGames.name: The Dream Office
coveredGames.title: A charming and quirky office management sim that's deeply satisfying to play. The renovation loop is addictive, though early access quirks and occasional chaos keep it from being perfect.

coveredGames.name: Katana Dragon
coveredGames.title: Katana Dragon is a delightful and surprisingly deep action RPG that masterfully blends charming voxel visuals with satisfying exploration and combat.

coveredGames.name: Baston
coveredGames.title: A hilarious and uniquely Russian FPS with deep meme culture and surprisingly good storytelling. It's a rough gem perfect for a few nights of chaotic, patriotic fun.

coveredGames.name: Farm Manager World
coveredGames.title: A deep and rewarding global farm simulator. Manage crops, animals, production lines, and market trends to build a thriving agricultural empire.

coveredGames.name: Dungeon of Erotic Master Reboot
coveredGames.title: A fun, fully-voiced dungeon crawler with a charming story and great monster variety. While the adult content is present, the core RPG adventure is enjoyable and accessible.

coveredGames.name: Forest Construction VR
coveredGames.title: A fantastic and relaxing VR sandbox focused purely on creative building. The physics-based crafting and construction feel intuitive and deeply satisfying for any creative mind.

coveredGames.name: ServiceIT: You can do IT
coveredGames.title: An incredibly immersive and educational IT simulator that's perfect for learning at your own pace. A must-play for tech enthusiasts, despite some progress-breaking bugs that can be frustrating.

coveredGames.name: Avalon Jewels
coveredGames.title: A top-tier match-three game with clever mechanics and satisfying combos. The 250 levels offer great variety, though the stingy in-game economy can feel restrictive.

coveredGames.name: SAVEN
coveredGames.title: A solid short horror game with great atmosphere. While not groundbreaking and a bit light on scares, it's a well-made, enjoyable experience for the price.

coveredGames.name: Maneater
coveredGames.title: Apex predator simulator achieved! Finally got to live the shark life. Chomping on tourists, evolving into a mega-shark, and hearing Chris Parnell narrate my chaos is pure, stupid fun.

coveredGames.name: PEAK
coveredGames.title: Scale wild peaks with friends! Teamwork survival meets daily-changing mountains. A thrilling, beautiful climb. Highly recommended!

coveredGames.name: Cooking Simulator
coveredGames.title: A brilliantly chaotic and hilarious cooking simulator where kitchens explode and food flies. Perfect for pure, uncomplicated fun and a great solo laugh-fest.

coveredGames.name: Neo Junk City
coveredGames.title: Play a female Robocop who was framed for the murder of her creator in this rather good sci-fi pnc with shooting and racing action sequences.

coveredGames.name: Jackie Hart: Headhunter
coveredGames.title: A fully voiced paranormal mystery in which you play as a young woman with supernatural abilities who helps the police solve a brutal ritual murder in Taiwan.

coveredGames.name: Murders on the Yangtze River
coveredGames.title: Search crime scenes for clues and then present your conclusions and evidence to solve the case in this detective game taking place in 1900s China, featuring Chinese voice acting.

coveredGames.name: Tales from Candleforth
coveredGames.title: Move the mouse until you find a hotspot, then solve various puzzles in this first-person point-and-click game featuring a (somewhat) horror-themed story.

coveredGames.name: The Wolf Among Us Remastered
coveredGames.title: A remaster with enhanced graphics of one of Telltale's best games. Play as the sheriff of Fabletown in this thriller packed with QTEs and achievements you can miss.

coveredGames.name: Sleepytime Village
coveredGames.title: Working day and night and neglecting wife and daughter, Rufus gets sucked in a children’s storybook world in this voiced pnc. Can you escape back to your real life?

coveredGames.name: Earth Must Die
coveredGames.title: In this science-fiction comedy, step into the shoes of the spoiled and not-particularly-bright heir to the Kingdom of Tyrythia—along with his nursing bot—in a cinematic pnc with great voice-overs.

coveredGames.name: Allogloom
coveredGames.title: Step into the shoes of a young woman named Nora and uncover the dark secret of a charming little village deep in the forest. Why do the people there worship moths, and why do people keep disappearing?

coveredGames.name: Escape from 8-Bit High
coveredGames.title: Play 3 guys fighting a computer trying to take over the world in this fully voiced pnc adventure. Makes fun of the 80s, includes 4 mini arcade games, music battles and not so easy puzzles.

coveredGames.name: Phonopolis
coveredGames.title: Play Felix and end the Leader's oppressive influence in a resonant dystopian city in this textless pnc in a 3D world made of cardboard.

coveredGames.name: A Case of Fraud
coveredGames.title: A rather good little detective adventure – find a managing director and her pet by sifting through a vast amount of documents. Read carefully – and draw the right conclusions.

coveredGames.name: Chernobyl: Origins
coveredGames.title: Play a young scientist directly after the explosion of the reactor in this first-person pnc. One wrong move and you are dead.

coveredGames.name: College Quest
coveredGames.title: Play a new student and explore the art college campus where you encounter some quite strange students and professors. Discover many causes of death, lots of text, reach multiple endings.

coveredGames.name: Paradise Falls
coveredGames.title: Listen to the voices in your head and do awful things. Keep your anxiety low by cleaning your bloody knife or you will see very disturbing things in this supernatural pnc. Nice.

coveredGames.name: Rendezvous
coveredGames.title: Save your sister in this Indonesian cyberpunk pixel art adventure with action sequences. Shoot, dodge, sprint and sneak - and solve puzzles.

coveredGames.name: Welcome To Mars 9
coveredGames.title: Explore a luxurious space station orbiting Mars in this narrative pnc. You have no idea how you came here, but someone/thing tries to kill you already.

coveredGames.name: The Third Day
coveredGames.title: Play Jesus awakening after his crucifixion in this humorous little pnc fully voiced in Spanish. A bit buggy, though.

coveredGames.name: Occulto
coveredGames.title: Play the young apprentice Eliot searching for his master in this completely textless fantasy pnc. Click everywhere and hope to understand the puzzles he encounters.

coveredGames.name: BACKSPACE
coveredGames.title: Step into the shoes of a new intern and find out what's going on at this strange company in this now FREE adventure. Walk around, interact with your surroundings, solve little puzzles.

coveredGames.name: Slender Threads
coveredGames.title: Play a burnt-out book salesaman/wannabe author discovering strange occurances in a small backward town in this short, fully voiced paranormal pnc mystery adventure.

coveredGames.name: Roots in the Sky - The Hand of Glory 2
coveredGames.title: In this fully voiced point-and-click adventure, take on the role of former detective Lars (and of Alice) as you embark on a journey across several countries to solve a supernatural crime.

coveredGames.name: of pawns & kings
coveredGames.title: Play young Nik discovering dark family secrets on his journey through the Caribbean in this large, Unreal 5-powered, fully voiced pnc using a verb-coin interface.

coveredGames.name: Theropods
coveredGames.title: Play a young woman and a stranded astronaut fighting an evil tribe and outsmarting dinos in this completely wordless prehistoric pixel art pnc adventure. For fans of pure visual storytelling.

coveredGames.name: The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show
coveredGames.title: A FREE short but magical game filled with secrets and unexpected twists in 20 whimsically bizarre acts released to celebrate Rusty Lake's 10th birthday.

coveredGames.name: Cube Escape: Paradox
coveredGames.title: Play detective Dale Vandermeer who finds himself trapped in two different universes and needs to escape and recover his memories. FREE, but chapter 2 is a paid DLC.

coveredGames.name: Underground Blossom
coveredGames.title: Fulfil various tasks at every station to find the metro that will take you through each important event from Laura Vanderboom's life.

coveredGames.name: Cube Escape Collection
coveredGames.title: Updated collection of the old Flash based adventures from Rusty Lake. 9 chapters where follow the path of Dale Vandermeer, a homicide detective.

coveredGames.name: The White Door
coveredGames.title: Explore Robert Hill’s dreams and help him to find his lost memories. Survive the strict daily routine and bring back color to Robert's life.

coveredGames.name: Rusty Lake Paradise
coveredGames.title: Solve all the mysteries of this dark, macabre puzzle adventure which is set on a small remote island cursed by the ten plagues of Egypt.

coveredGames.name: Rusty Lake: Roots
coveredGames.title: Expand your bloodline by unlocking portraits in the tree of life in this follow-up to Rusty Lake Hotel.

coveredGames.name: Rusty Lake Hotel
coveredGames.title: Serve five guests invited to the Rusty Lake hotel in this creepy little first person pnc adventure.

coveredGames.name: Servant of the Lake
coveredGames.title: Survive a weekend as housekeeper for the Vanderboom family conducting strange experiments - now with speech and high-res (background) visuals.

coveredGames.name: Tormentum II
coveredGames.title: Play a mad developer in a dystopian future in this thrilling horror sci-fi pnc. No movement animations, no voice-overs, but a gripping story.

coveredGames.name: The Silver Crow
coveredGames.title: Solve a supernatural murder playing as a medieval executioner/healer plagued by nightmares in this short and easy, but also good looking and well written classic pnc adventure.

coveredGames.name: Obsidian
coveredGames.title: Explore different realms in this weird, surrealistic ScummVM-powered Myst clone with some early FMV sequences and a bunch of rather good puzzles.

coveredGames.name: Normality
coveredGames.title: Bizarre pnc adventure from 1996, completely in 3D and a bit ahead of its time. Explore the vast city of Neutropolis, enjoy motion capture sequences and especially the humour. Actually, not so bad.

coveredGames.name: Ten Dates
coveredGames.title: Speed date to find your true love in this funny rom com FMV adventure.

coveredGames.name: The Isle Tide Hotel
coveredGames.title: Rescue your kidnapped 17 yr old daughter before she gets sacrificed to the cult leader in a strange hotel. Meet deranged ppl. Multiple endings.

coveredGames.name: Dimhaven - The Lost Source
coveredGames.title: Find your missing uncle on a strangely abandoned tourist island in this slightly surreal first person adventure. Quite good, actually.

coveredGames.name: Road to Empress Ⅱ
coveredGames.title: Continue your quest to become empress in this high-quality FMV adventure. Escape from the convent and survive the intrigues of ancient China.

coveredGames.name: Tape to Tape
coveredGames.title: Супер веселый хоккейный рогалик, где надо крушить, уничтожать врагов и иногда забивать шайбы, чтобы выиграть. Но несмотя на очень увлекающий геймплей количества контента хватит на 20-25 часов.

coveredGames.name: Outcast Tales
coveredGames.title: Это точно то, во что необходимо поиграть каждому любителю пошагового боя в играх. Сразу видно вдохновление от других игр жанра, но со своим соусом и стилем. А самое главное - игра бесплатна!

coveredGames.name: Omega Pilot Evolution
coveredGames.title: Осторожно, может закружиться голова! В целом классные казуальные гоночки в VR за не самую большую для VR-игр цену. Большого разнообразия тут нет, но погонять весело. Еще напомнило игру детства.

coveredGames.name: The Last Nordic Tribe
coveredGames.title: Мрачный сурвайвал про ранних викингов: холод, голод, сбор ресурсов и крафт среди погибающей Скандинавии. Пока сыровато и местами простенько, но атмосфера хорошая и играть интересно. Рекомендую!

coveredGames.name: Esports Manager 2026
coveredGames.title: Пока сыро, казуально, но достаточно залипательно и с огромным потенциал стать тем самым менеджером про киберспорт, в который можео возвращаться время от времени. Очень верю в развитие проекта.

coveredGames.name: SharedScreen Wagons 2
coveredGames.title: В общем-то забавная игра, если у вас есть с кем в нее поиграть - совместная игра на раздельном экране в одном и том же месте накладывает некоторые ограничения. Сделана игрушка качественно.

coveredGames.name: HeadHunters
coveredGames.title: Забавный 2D шутер для битвы со своими друзьями. Игра проста в геймплее, при этом играется достаточно бодро и залипательно. Мне понравился и визуальный стиль. Рекомендую.

coveredGames.name: Scritchy Scratchy
coveredGames.title: Стирать, стирать, стирать до смерти. Игра, где надо будет зарабатывать деньги с помощью участия в лотереях, где можно как выиграть, так и проиграть все. Интересная игра на 10 часов.

coveredGames.name: There Is mORE
coveredGames.title: Медленный, но забавный 2D рогалик, где помимо убийства огромного количества врагов нам еще необходимо погружаться в глубины и копать руды. В целом проект интересный, но хотелось ускорить геймпплей.

coveredGames.name: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon
coveredGames.title: Скайримоподобная РПГ, рассказывающая историю короля Артура и падения Авалона. Достаточно занимательная и затягивающая, но имеющая как технические проблемы, так и сюжетные. В целом по скидке хорошо.

coveredGames.name: Saving Princess Of Mars
coveredGames.title: Спасти принцессу хотели? Вот ваш шанс. На самом деле, очень простенький пиксельный платформер, без каких-либо прикрас, но достаточный чтобы скрасить один-два вечера в зимний период.

coveredGames.name: Together in Forgotten Lands
coveredGames.title: Копоперативный 3Д-платформер, где вам с другом предстоит решать головоломки в огромном слишком цветастов мире. Рекомендую к прохожденгию после полного выхода игры.

coveredGames.name: Conquest Dark
coveredGames.title: Очень крутой сурвивор. Из интересного: прокачка некоторых характеристик с помощью прохождения ритуала, прокачка характеристик за прохождение ритуалов конкретным классом, интересный последний босс.

coveredGames.name: Yunashi no Yume
coveredGames.title: Очень интересный проект намечается - неплохая история с элементами RPG с хорошим визуальным стилем. Немного поиграв в нее, я решил, что пройду до конца. Рекомендую.

coveredGames.name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
coveredGames.title: Игра, с которой стоит погрузиться в JRPG, если вы не фанат жанра - европизированные механики, немного духоты и очень хороший увлекающий сюжет. Рекомендую!

coveredGames.name: Secret Seeker
coveredGames.title: Неплохой хоррор на вечер с хорошей атмосферой и приятными головоломками. Немного не понравилась излишняя коридорность геймплея, но в целом пройти и остаться довольным можно. Рекомендую

coveredGames.name: Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel
coveredGames.title: Неплохой сурвайвал, который реально меняется и усложняется по мере прохождения карт - враги становятся более интересными, боссы наносят больше разных атак и так далее. Так что рекомендую

coveredGames.name: HALLOWEEN girls
coveredGames.title: YES

coveredGames.name: One Iced Latte: Milk Song
coveredGames.title: YES

coveredGames.name: Jezebel
coveredGames.title: YES

coveredGames.name: Concubine
coveredGames.title: YES

coveredGames.name: CodeRed: Agent Sarah's Story - Day one
coveredGames.title: YES

coveredGames.name: Secrets of the Heart
coveredGames.title: YES

coveredGames.name: Never Trust a Fox
coveredGames.title: YES

coveredGames.name: 射！就完事了
coveredGames.title: YES

coveredGames.name: 打炮的女孩
coveredGames.title: YES

coveredGames.name: Enshrouded
coveredGames.title: I lost hours to the building and exploration—it quietly eats your weekend. Combat gets messy at times, but the crafting loop is excellent.

coveredGames.name: Double Dealers
coveredGames.title: I love how every auction becomes a battle of bluffs and suspicious promises. Tricking friends into bad deals sounds hilarious, though you'll need a group that enjoys mind games

coveredGames.name: DRAPLINE
coveredGames.title: I got attached to my dragon way faster than expected. Experimenting with training choices and wild skill combinations makes every run feel different, even if unlocking all the endings takes patience

coveredGames.name: The Blood of Dawnwalker
coveredGames.title: I loved how the day/night cycle actually changes the way you play—human by day, vampire by night, with choices constantly eating into your time. Some systems feel uneven, but the atmosphere hooked me.

coveredGames.name: Yet Another Zombie Survivors
coveredGames.title: I really liked the three-character squad setup—it makes each run feel more dynamic. The build choices are a bit straightforward, but the progression loop kept me coming back.

coveredGames.name: VHOLUME
coveredGames.title: I got completely hooked on the movement—sliding, wall-running, and chaining jumps together feels ridiculously smooth. Some levels are brutal, but mastering a route makes every retry worth it.

coveredGames.name: Dig, Dig, Die
coveredGames.title: I had way more fun with this than expected—digging through creepy graveyards while monsters react to every sound creates some genuinely hilarious panic. A little repetitive, but great with friends.

coveredGames.name: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam
coveredGames.title: The jungle setting really sells the tension, and coordinated pushes can feel incredible when everyone works together. The long downtime hurts the pace, but the atmosphere is hard to ignore.

coveredGames.name: Go-Go Town!
coveredGames.title: I meant to build one more shop and somehow lost three hours. Managing the town stays relaxing instead of stressful, though automation takes time to unlock. Totally worth sticking with.

coveredGames.name: Cursed Companions
coveredGames.title: I haven't laughed this hard in co-op horror for a while—trying not to say forbidden words turns every run into chaos. Some voice quirks remain, but the hilarious teamwork is worth it.

coveredGames.name: World of Tanks: HEAT
coveredGames.title: I didn't expect tank battles to feel this fast—hero abilities and tight team fights keep every match exciting. It won't replace classic World of Tanks, but it's a fun new spin.

coveredGames.name: Everything is Crab: The Animal Evolution Roguelite
coveredGames.title: I came for the crab jokes and stayed for the evolution chaos. Unlocking bizarre mutations is a blast, though runs can feel a little repetitive once the surprise starts wearing off.

coveredGames.name: Cafe Crew Simulator: Prologue
coveredGames.title: I didn’t expect making coffee to feel this stressful—in a good way. The rush of keeping orders moving is satisfying, even if the prologue feels a bit limited once you’ve seen everything.

coveredGames.name: NO BACKUP
coveredGames.title: The bodycam perspective genuinely got under my skin—every hallway feels dangerous. A bit rough around the edges, but the tension and co-op panic make for great horror nights.

coveredGames.name: Pratfall
coveredGames.title: Pratfall turns movement into controlled chaos—every jump feels risky, hilarious, and satisfying. Fast retries and unpredictable physics make failure just as fun as success

coveredGames.name: PRAGMATA
coveredGames.title: PRAGMATA mixes shooting with clever hacking mechanics—controlling two characters keeps every fight tense, while its lunar sci-fi setting and story hit harder than expected.

coveredGames.name: Scriptorium: Master of Manuscripts
coveredGames.title: Scriptorium turns medieval art into a cozy sandbox—drag, drop, and create bizarre masterpieces for quirky clients. Chill, creative, and surprisingly deep for such a relaxing sim.

coveredGames.name: REPLACED
coveredGames.title: REPLACED stuns with cinematic pixel art and a moody cyberpunk world—fluid combat and storytelling hit hard, even if the gameplay leans familiar at times

coveredGames.name: Fight Life: Vanguard
coveredGames.title: Fight Life: Vanguard leans into classic tactics—tight turn-based battles, squad building, and steady progression. Simple on the surface, but positioning and upgrades keep it engaging.

coveredGames.name: The Bus
coveredGames.title: The Bus goes deep on realism—1:1 Berlin routes, ticket checks, traffic, and full sim immersion. Slow-paced but satisfying if you enjoy mastering every detail of the daily grind.

coveredGames.name: The Coin Game
coveredGames.title: The Coin Game nails that nostalgic arcade vibe—dozens of machines, goofy physics, and an open island full of distractions make grinding tickets weirdly relaxing and hard to quit.

coveredGames.name: Project Castaway
coveredGames.title: Project Castaway pulled me in with chill island vibes and tense survival—rafting between islands, building, and keeping sanity in check feels immersive and oddly addictive.

coveredGames.name: Everwind
coveredGames.title: Everwind pulled me in with its flying island base and endless sky exploration—building, fighting, and discovering with friends feels magical. A sandbox RPG that’s easy to lose hours in.

coveredGames.name: Over The Top: WWI
coveredGames.title: Massive WWI chaos with up to 200 players, destructible trenches, tanks, artillery, and flamethrowers. Every battle turns the map into a cratered war movie. Pure multiplayer madness.

coveredGames.name: Super Battle Golf
coveredGames.title: Super Battle Golf turns mini-golf into pure chaos. Everyone plays at once, smashing balls, firing lasers, and sabotaging friends in a race to the hole. Silly, fast, and perfect for multiplayer nights.

coveredGames.name: Goblin Sushi
coveredGames.title: Goblin Sushi had me cracking up and obsessively cooking — frantic roguelike kitchen chaos as a goblin sushi chef makes every run hilarious and addictive. Love the wild ingredients and goofy customers!

coveredGames.name: REANIMAL
coveredGames.title: REANIMAL gripped me with its tension and haunting world. Navigating as siblings through grotesque landscape kept me on edge. Atmospheric horror that feels like a fresh evolution from Little Nightmares

coveredGames.name: FrostBound
coveredGames.title: FrostBound throws you into an endless winter: build a base, wield a massive deck of 500+ cards, and hold out against relentless waves. Brutal and addictively deep—cold never felt so intense.

coveredGames.name: Sunken Engine
coveredGames.title: Sunken Engine mixes ship-repair sim gameplay with eerie, Lovecraft-style horror. Fix vessels, unravel dark secrets and struggle to stay sane—all wrapped in a weirdly soothing mechanic loop.

coveredGames.name: Deathground
coveredGames.title: Deathground traps you in pulse-pounding solo or 4-player co-op horror runs as you sneak, fight and scramble to escape marauding dinosaurs. Tense at times, but too short and rough around the edges.

coveredGames.name: Dying Light: The Beast
coveredGames.title: A brutal return to form for the series. Set in the eerie Castor Woods, it delivers intense parkour and visceral combat. While the story is predictable, the gameplay shines with improved mechanics.

coveredGames.name: skate.
coveredGames.title: skate. returns with solid skating mechanics and a massive open world, but the early access release feels unfinished. While the core gameplay shines, missing features and technical issues hold it back.

coveredGames.name: Farming & Supermarket Simulator
coveredGames.title: Farming & Supermarket Simulator blends farming and retail management into a relaxing yet engaging experience. Grow crops, raise animals, and run your own store—perfect for fans of strategy-driven sims

coveredGames.name: LOK Digital
coveredGames.title: LOK Digital is a minimalist puzzle game where you decipher a fictional language to solve challenges. With elegant visuals and daily puzzles, it offers a unique and meditative experience.

coveredGames.name: Deep Dish Dungeon
coveredGames.title: I love how every dungeon expedition feels like solving a mystery with friends—scavenging, cooking, and crafting all feed into the next adventure. Combat is a bit basic, but exploration keeps me hooked

coveredGames.name: CPM 2
coveredGames.title: I love that this is more than just racing—you can fine-tune your car, meet other players, and cruise around an open world. The PC controls still need polish, but the freedom is a big draw.

coveredGames.name: Forsworn
coveredGames.title: I got hooked on stacking ridiculous hero synergies and watching a carefully built party snowball. The difficulty can be unforgiving, but finding a combo that breaks a fight feels fantastic.

coveredGames.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
coveredGames.title: The parries are ridiculously satisfying, and the boss fights had me locked in. The pacing can drag between big encounters, but the swordplay alone makes this comeback easy to recommend.

coveredGames.name: Big Ambitions
coveredGames.title: I got hooked on building my little business empire piece by piece—buying supplies, watching each shop grow feels incredibly rewarding. The grind can get repetitive, but it's hard to stop.

coveredGames.name: Mandate Order
coveredGames.title: I got hooked on shaping a tiny war-state from the ground up—planning logistics, assigning retainers, and watching the city evolve feels rewarding. The learning curve is steep, but worth it.

coveredGames.name: Big Walk
coveredGames.title: I ended up laughing way more than expected—solving weird puzzles with friends and getting hopelessly lost is half the fun. The walking can drag a bit, but the co-op moments are gold.

coveredGames.name: G-Rebels
coveredGames.title: Flying through its massive sci-fi world never got old—the speed and freedom are fantastic. It's still a bit rough in Early Access, but the dogfights kept pulling me back for one more mission.

coveredGames.name: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced
coveredGames.title: I kept getting distracted from the main story just to chase ships and hidden treasures again. A few modern changes won't please everyone, but the pirate adventure is still incredible.

coveredGames.name: Airport Baggage Simulator
coveredGames.title: I got hooked way faster than I expected—sorting bags is oddly satisfying, and watching your messy workflow turn into a slick automated system never gets old. A little grindy, but easy to recommend.

coveredGames.name: Project: Mist
coveredGames.title: The island never felt safe, and that’s exactly why I kept exploring. Giant creatures, co-op survival, and a Gravity Gun turn every expedition into a story worth telling.

coveredGames.name: Phonopolis
coveredGames.title: Every street felt handcrafted, every puzzle had personality. Phonopolis mixes a striking cardboard world with a clever dystopian story that stayed with me long after the credits.

coveredGames.name: LEGO® Batman™: Legacy of the Dark Knight
coveredGames.title: Gotham feels alive, the combat clicks, and LEGO’s humor never misses. I got pulled into every corner of the city. A surprisingly fresh Batman adventure worth building through.

coveredGames.name: Dead as Disco
coveredGames.title: Dead as Disco turns every fight into a rhythm-fueled spectacle—stylish combos, neon visuals, and music-synced combat make it feel like playing through a chaotic music video.

coveredGames.name: Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era
coveredGames.title: Olden Era revives classic Heroes magic—deep turn-based tactics, massive armies, and addictive map control. Nostalgic yet fresh, though Early Access roughness still peeks through.

coveredGames.name: Skull Horde
coveredGames.title: Skull Horde blends auto-battler strategy with roguelike chaos—building undead squads and chasing broken synergies feels addictive, though the pressure never lets you relax.

coveredGames.name: Windrose
coveredGames.title: Windrose blends pirate fantasy with survival depth—sail, build, and battle across a massive world. Ship combat and co-op shine, though Early Access roughness still shows

coveredGames.name: Crystalfall
coveredGames.title: Crystalfall throws you into a loot-heavy ARPG with insane build freedom—procedural skills and endless grinding shine, but rough Early Access edges and balance issues can break the flow.

coveredGames.name: Hozy
coveredGames.title: Hozy is pure cozy therapy—scrub, paint, and decorate at your own pace, with no pressure. Every tiny detail clicks, turning simple chores into a calming, oddly satisfying flow.

coveredGames.name: The Scourge | Tai Ương
coveredGames.title: The Scourge | Tai Ương pulled me into a haunting 90s Saigon nightmare—creepy puzzles, heavy atmosphere, and a story that sticks with you. Feels like playing through a chilling urban legend.

coveredGames.name: DEATH STRANDING 2: ON THE BEACH
coveredGames.title: Death Stranding 2: On the Beach pulled me back into its strange, beautiful world—every delivery feels meaningful, every step meditative. Weird, emotional, and unforgettable.

coveredGames.name: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection
coveredGames.title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection pulled me in with its cozy monster-bonding and deep turn-based battles. Raising your own Rathalos and exploring its world feels magical.

coveredGames.name: Docked

coveredGames.name: The Walking Trade

coveredGames.name: Car Service Together
coveredGames.title: Car Service Together surprised me with chill yet satisfying co-op garage chaos — fixing, tuning and customising cars with friends feels oddly rewarding, and every success run just clicks.

coveredGames.name: Creature Kitchen
coveredGames.title: Creature Kitchen hooked me with its cozy-creepy charm — chopping recipes for raccoons and odd woodland critters in a weird, whispering forest was delightfully strange. It’s indie magic worth your time

coveredGames.name: Constance

coveredGames.title: Like a mash-up of Nu-Marathon and PS1 3D platformer Jumping Flash, and all about speed. Achingly cool, powered by breakbeats and with some deeply ominous prose between races for new leaderboard ranks.

coveredGames.name: Quasimorph
coveredGames.title: Doom: The Roguelike meets Extraction Shooter, and you can join the demons if you want. Long-form roguelike dungeon crawler where your characters are expendable clones, but your costly gear can be lost

coveredGames.name: Frebbventure Alliance
coveredGames.title: Sequel to one of my oddball indie faves. More combat-heavy adventure platforming, this time with 9 playable characters which you tag-team between. Play the original first, though. This is story-heavy.

coveredGames.name: Fuck's Quest II
coveredGames.title: A genuinely good retro Zelda-like adventure that is also the single dumbest piece of media ever created by human hands. But somehow, not offensive? It's just fart jokes and rude words, done with gusto

coveredGames.name: Endacopia
coveredGames.title: Rad point-and-clicker with old-school style but modern ideas (including non-linearity, secrets, combat & minigames) and a chaotic tone. Expect laughs, jump-scares, lovely animation & musical numbers.

coveredGames.name: DEMON DUST
coveredGames.title: A survival horror dungeon, full of knowledge-gated puzzles, navigated through an awkward proxy body with an esoteric CRT monitor UI. Manually load bullets in one at a time and pick off weak-points.

coveredGames.name: Storebound
coveredGames.title: Not a Lethal Company-like, but rather a story-heavy co-op escape room with the occasional monster to run and hide from. Great 'cursed Ikea' setting, crunchy graphics and cute Muppets-Meet-Aardman cast

coveredGames.name: Denshattack!
coveredGames.title: Looks like Tony Hawk on Trains. Plays more like an entire game made out of modern Sonic rail-grinding segments, with music to match. Sometimes, the style is the substance, and this one's SO stylish.

coveredGames.name: Hell Maiden
coveredGames.title: Hades' progression, Vampire Survivors' combat, some extra deckbuilding sauce, shoujo yuri manga aesthetics, an all-girl, all-gay cast and great music. Also it's a sequel to The Divine Comedy. Rad.

coveredGames.name: The Incident at Galley House
coveredGames.title: Fantastic mystery based on free text-adventure Type Help. Piece together the events of a series of murders using a machine that tunes into past conversations, only if you know the who, where and when.

coveredGames.name: Pronoun Palace
coveredGames.title: Whip-smart, bitingly satirical roguelike word game for tired grown-ups. Your pronouns have been confiscated by the state for being disruptive. Beat up modern-day freaks with big words to rad music.

coveredGames.name: Exo One
coveredGames.title: Short (maybe 2.5 hours long) but mesmerizing experience about piloting a strange shapeshifting UFO and impossible speeds through alien landscapes and the void of space. Just incredible to vibe to.

coveredGames.name: Exo Rally Championship
coveredGames.title: Uncompromising, challenging hard sci-fi motorsport sim. Race ATVs cross-country across planets with wildly different environments & gravity, rationing your thruster fuel over multiple stages.

coveredGames.name: CHR$(143)
coveredGames.title: I am not smart enough for this one, but I can tell it's a good puzzler. Complex block-pushing microcomputer-themed puzzles with lots of internal logic and layers of mechanics that unlock and stack up.

coveredGames.name: Marrow Marrow
coveredGames.title: High-speed VR movement shooter. Part Ultrakill, part Devil Daggers, part Pick-3 roguelite. Fast, aggressive, stylish and well optimized, and designed for intense short sessions. Great if you can deal.

coveredGames.name: Berserker's Descent
coveredGames.title: Dev is obviously no artist, but under the jank art lies a surprisingly tight Berserk-inspired platform roguelite. Big heavy sword swings that remain controllable. Makes for snappy, satisfying fights.

coveredGames.name: MeowGun: Hell Denizen
coveredGames.title: Scrappy, messy retro FPS with infectious energy. Finnish trans catgirls battle alien demons. Loves to throw enormous swarms of enemies at you, making swarm-busting explosions the order of the day.

coveredGames.name: Silent Paradise Anthology
coveredGames.title: A bit rough-edged, but the ambition on show here is great. Three short metroidvanias with different heroes & art styles that combine into a final, fourth game that merges all their concepts.

coveredGames.name: nophenia
coveredGames.title: Quiet little dream-diving exploration game. No challenges, no scares, just wandering through low-fi liminal landscapes, some more realistic than others. Gorgeous, great vibes. A virtual evening walk.

coveredGames.name: The Message from Deep Space
coveredGames.title: Smart and surprisingly massive puzzle game about communicating with an extraterrestrial signal. Start with echoing numbers, then sharing math concepts, then build a whole alien linguistic framework.

coveredGames.name: VEX MAGE
coveredGames.title: An excellent, expanded (and slightly less eye-aching) Devil Daggers tribute playable regular style, online co-op, in VR or any mix of the above. Great style, varied arenas and lots of spells to master

coveredGames.name: Besmirch
coveredGames.title: A very compelling Early Access fusion of Faith and Stardew Valley. Farm in a not-at-all-cozy village of paranoid, strange folk, while hiding from/fighting monsters as the shadows grow and fog rolls in

coveredGames.name: Waves 2: Notorious
coveredGames.title: Forever unfinished as its developer passed away, but now free and well worth playing. A solid Geometry Wars-inspired twin-stick shooter, even brighter and flashier than its predecessor. Pour one out.

coveredGames.name: Waves
coveredGames.title: A very solid Geometry Wars-like twin-stick shooter full of neon particle effects and techno jams. Once commercial, now made free after the developer passed away. The Early Access sequel is free too.

coveredGames.name: A Song Of Sunlight
coveredGames.title: Still awaiting its latter episodes, but this is an excellent and highly creative free RPG about a desert village built above a vast brutalist megastructure full of rogue mechanical life. Great art.

coveredGames.name: Creature Kitchen
coveredGames.title: Heartwarming little horror-comedy adventure about being the caretaker of a haunted house in the woods. The forest is hungry... and you need to cook for its inhabitants, who are all adorable lil' guys.

coveredGames.name: Mewgenics
coveredGames.title: The Binding Of Isaac crew do a (similarly gross and weird) grid-based tactical RPG and nail it. Simple basics spiral out into an absolutely massive campaign with relatively bite-sized individual runs.

coveredGames.name: Mama's Sleeping Angels
coveredGames.title: Lethal Company meets queer fever-dream. Delve into fragmented dreams to gather cursed items to feed to Mama, your curse-devouring god. Not everything is hostile. The 'kiss' button is as useful as guns

coveredGames.name: Rhell: Warped Worlds & Troubled Times
coveredGames.title: Fantastically smart Scribblenauts-inspired immersive sim puzzler. Create spells combining dozens of different components to solve puzzles creatively. No wrong answers, especially in Randomizer Mode

coveredGames.name: Super Meat Boy 3D
coveredGames.title: It's Super Meat Boy! In 3D! Almost identical core gameplay but with an additional axis of movement and an air-dash move, which is both a blessing and curse. Otherwise, familiar, tight precision fun.

coveredGames.name: Voidling Bound: Creature Evolution Shooter
coveredGames.title: Very slick third-person shooter take on the Creature Collector. Gather cute alien critters, mutate them to give them new looks and powers, then go hunt to gather more resources to make them better.

coveredGames.name: Luna Abyss
coveredGames.title: The first and last game by Kwalee Labs before they were shut down. An excellent, story-driven bullet hell-ish platform FPS set in an ever-shifting eldritch lunar megastructure. Beautiful and clever.

coveredGames.name: The Remake of the End of the Greatest RPG of All Time
coveredGames.title: A deductive mystery disguised as an RPG. Unravel the truth behind a buggy, unfinished remake of the final dungeon of a fictional JRPG, identifying what changed and using knowledge to go out of bounds.

coveredGames.name: A Kobold Story : Trenchcoat Adventurer
coveredGames.title: A great intro to grid-based dungeon crawls for the intimidated. Instead of a party, you're three funny little lizard-guys in a trenchcoat, eating food for stat boosts and bumbling through silly fights

coveredGames.name: Crushed In Time
coveredGames.title: Fun Sherlock-themed spinoff from point-and-click gem There Is No Game. Elevated and a little limited by its core mechanic - you stretch and flick parts of the environment instead of hoarding inventory

coveredGames.name: Bubsy 4D
coveredGames.title: The best Bubsy game by miles. Also basically a more linear level pack for Demon Tides, by the same developer. Familiar form-switching, wall-scrambling gameplay, but with more traditional structure.

coveredGames.name: Rogue Voltage
coveredGames.title: Grungy one-of-a-kind roguelite where you attack by building modular synth-style devices wired up to each other to maximize signals and boost numbers, collecting more components in deckbuilder format.

coveredGames.name: Mars Gardener
coveredGames.title: Who knew gardening on Mars could be so much fun? Transform barren red landscapes into lush green gardens and create your own little piece of paradise among the stars.

coveredGames.name: Keep It Trolling: Fantasy Edition
coveredGames.title: A fun blend of dice rolling and risk management wrapped in a fantasy theme, where every roll brings a new opportunity and a chance to lose it all.

coveredGames.name: Keep It Rolling
coveredGames.title: Love press your luck games? This one constantly challenges you to decide whether to secure your winnings or risk everything for a bigger reward.

coveredGames.name: SG Racing
coveredGames.title: Colourful pixel art, delightfully unpredictable tracks and plenty of chaotic racing fun to share with friends. Just the way arcade games should be.

coveredGames.name: Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy
coveredGames.title: A charming throwback to classic action adventures, filled with clever puzzles, dungeon exploration and secrets waiting to be discovered.

coveredGames.name: Pump And Dump
coveredGames.title: Retro visuals, shady characters and a wonderfully cynical take on corporate ambition. Sometimes the real challenge isn't making money, but getting away with it.

coveredGames.name: That Damn Grass
coveredGames.title: A charming sandbox where budget robots hunt for a lost wedding ring. Start out trimming an enormous mansion yard using just a tiny nail cutter.

coveredGames.name: Hacker Cats
coveredGames.title: The Internet was never safe, but now the hackers have whiskers. Recruit your feline cybercrime squad and let the paw-some chaos begin.

coveredGames.name: Isekai Survivors
coveredGames.title: A charming roguelite with plenty of character, satisfying progression and an addictive gameplay loop.

coveredGames.name: Disbond
coveredGames.title: Every match feels like a fresh challenge, where quick thinking, teamwork and a little suspicion can make all the difference.

coveredGames.name: Trivia Mania
coveredGames.title: A massive collection of trivia questions with enough variety to keep your brain busy and your competitive side engaged.

coveredGames.name: NOSTRA
coveredGames.title: Experiment with different knight specializations, discover powerful gear combinations and face challenging enemies in this atmospheric RPG.

coveredGames.name: TWIN FLAMES
coveredGames.title: A pleasant choice for fans of co-op adventures who enjoy taking their time, solving puzzles and progressing together.

coveredGames.name: Echoes of Dread
coveredGames.title: If you enjoy horror that builds its atmosphere through unsettling surroundings, paranormal encounters and the fear of being watched, give this one a closer look.

coveredGames.name: FarmWings
coveredGames.title: A refreshing take on the classic shoot 'em up, where the action runs on its own and every upgrade brings you closer to becoming an unstoppable fighter.

coveredGames.name: SLOTDOWN
coveredGames.title: Inheriting a casino sounds like a dream until you realize Grandpa also left you a mountain of debt and some very unhappy visitors.

coveredGames.name: LIMINOID
coveredGames.title: Not every exploration game needs a destination. Sometimes the best part is discovering where a place takes you.

coveredGames.name: Before it Falls
coveredGames.title: Step into a forgotten hospital where every room holds traces of the past. A chilling invitation for fans of atmospheric psychological horror.

coveredGames.name: Out of the Shadows
coveredGames.title: Bring your friends, split up the clues and work together to escape places where every corner could hide something unpleasant.

coveredGames.name: BUBBA CHOP GROVE
coveredGames.title: A delightful blend of idle progression, quirky humor and colorful pixel art. Sometimes simple ideas make the most enjoyable games.

coveredGames.name: Soviet Backrooms
coveredGames.title: A surreal trip through decaying interiors where familiar furniture and empty spaces take on a sinister atmosphere.

coveredGames.name: Literally
coveredGames.title: From tricky mazes to clever logic puzzles, every page brings a new challenge. Collect stars, unlock rewards and master all thirty adventures.

coveredGames.name: A Light in the Gloam
coveredGames.title: For fans of oldschool dungeon crawlers, a journey through winding mazes, tactical turn based battles, and hard earned discoveries awaits.

coveredGames.name: Warside
coveredGames.title: A love letter to classic turn based tactics, with colorful pixel art, clever battlefield decisions and commanders whose special powers can turn the tide of war.

coveredGames.name: Project RedTeam: Contract Offensive
coveredGames.title: A clever mix of roguelite strategy and cybersecurity. With hundreds of cards and items to discover, there's plenty of room to experiment with different tactics and find your own approach.

coveredGames.name: GONE Fishing
coveredGames.title: Explore multiple atmospheric maps filled with legendary creatures like the Loch Ness monster. Drink beer play instruments and try to survive.

coveredGames.name: Heavy in the Hand
coveredGames.title: Every reload is part of the challenge. Master your weapon, manage your ammunition and make every shot count in this dark action horror experience.

coveredGames.name: Real Zombie Survivors
coveredGames.title: Enjoy a darker take on the survivors genre with nighttime battles, flashlight beams and shadows shaped by city buildings.

coveredGames.name: Me and You
coveredGames.title: A promising choice for fans of unconventional puzzle design, where changing the rules can be just as important as solving the puzzle.

coveredGames.name: Potion-making: Path of the Alchemist
coveredGames.title: For those who love finding clever combinations, this game turns ingredients, finished potions and recipe choices into strategic opportunities.

coveredGames.name: Your Judgment, Inquisitor
coveredGames.title: False accusations and difficult verdicts make protecting the innocent part of your work as an Inquisitor.

coveredGames.name: LYSSA: Goddess of Rage
coveredGames.title: Team up with other players, join an alliance and fight together to capture and defend valuable territory.

coveredGames.name: Dune: Awakening
coveredGames.title: The world of Dune comes alive in an open world survival adventure where every journey across Arrakis is a battle against the elements and the unknown.

coveredGames.name: Hack You
coveredGames.title: If you enjoy investigative gameplay, desktop simulations and uncovering stories through files and messages, this one deserves your attention.

coveredGames.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
coveredGames.title: Gothic beauty, legendary monsters and a burning medieval Paris create a memorable setting for a dark journey filled with danger and discovery.

coveredGames.name: Ball Bugz
coveredGames.title: Love watching a clever strategy unfold? Set your angles, position your turrets and let bouncing balls turn incoming bug swarms into a colorful mess.

coveredGames.name: over the hill
coveredGames.title: Some games ask you to conquer the road. This one invites you to slow down, explore the wilderness and stop for a photo when the light is just right.

coveredGames.name: Caribbean Legend: Age of Pirates
coveredGames.title: Forge your own pirate saga through sea battles, political intrigue, treasure hunts and dangerous quests across the Caribbean.

coveredGames.name: Doomlander
coveredGames.title: Find hidden keys to open colored doors and collect stars across six levels. If you enjoy classic retro FPS shooters with limited ammo mechanics, step into this quick action game.

coveredGames.name: Enshrouded
coveredGames.title: Adventure feels better together. Team up with friends to explore forgotten ruins, battle deadly creatures and build a home in a shattered kingdom.

coveredGames.name: Chants of Sennaar
coveredGames.title: Translate ancient languages to unite tower inhabitants, beautiful minimalist architecture, and clever logic puzzles.

coveredGames.name: Palworld
coveredGames.title: Addictive creature capturing, extensive base automation, open world survival crafting loops, and funny firearm combat.

coveredGames.name: Return of the Obra Dinn
coveredGames.title: Ingenious deduction mechanics, striking monochrome visual art style, compelling mystery unraveling, and audio.

coveredGames.name: Sifu
coveredGames.title: Mastering the parry timing makes you feel like an actual kung fu hero as you clear rooms of street brawlers without taking damage.

coveredGames.name: Kingdom Come: Deliverance
coveredGames.title: Hardcore historical realism where sword fighting requires real practice and armor feels authentically heavy.

coveredGames.name: Assetto Corsa
coveredGames.title: Realistic tire grip, brilliant force feedback, and endless community track mods make this a sim gem.

coveredGames.name: Persona 5 Royal
coveredGames.title: Slick UI design, amazing jazz tunes, and a great balance between high school life and dungeon crawling.

coveredGames.name: No Man's Sky
coveredGames.title: Seamlessly flying from outer space down onto vibrant uncharted alien planets remains super impressive.

coveredGames.name: Left 4 Dead 2
coveredGames.title: Surviving relentless zombie swarms with friends across classic campaigns remains the gold standard for co-op shooters.

coveredGames.name: Cuphead
coveredGames.title: Gorgeous hand drawn animation paired with relentless boss battles and an incredible live jazz soundtrack.

coveredGames.name: Phasmophobia
coveredGames.title: Whispering into spirit boxes inside dark haunted houses while fleeing from angry ghost hunts delivers top tier horror.

coveredGames.name: Hotline Miami
coveredGames.title: Blasting through neon rooms, dying instantly, and restarting to an epic synthwave soundtrack feels fantastic.

coveredGames.name: Vampire Survivors
coveredGames.title: Mowing down endless swarms of monsters with automated magic spells feels delightfully brain melting.

coveredGames.name: Sea of Thieves: 2026 Edition
coveredGames.title: Sailing choppy waters with a loyal crew, firing ship cannons at rivals, and digging up hidden chest loot is peak multiplayer fun.

coveredGames.name: Frostpunk
coveredGames.title: Managing heat grids and passing strict survival laws in a frozen apocalyptic wasteland creates immense tactical tension.

coveredGames.name: Slay the Spire
coveredGames.title: Drafting cards and discovering broken relic synergies makes every single dungeon run deeply addicting.

coveredGames.name: RimWorld
coveredGames.title: Managing quirky colony survivors through harsh winters, raider attacks, and sudden mental breakdowns generates hilarious storytelling moments.

coveredGames.name: Terraria
coveredGames.title: Digging deep underground to mine rare ores, building custom towns, and summoning giant floating eye bosses with friends offers endless adventures.

coveredGames.name: Hades
coveredGames.title: Fast combat and divine boons!

coveredGames.name: ELDEN RING
coveredGames.title: Incredible open world freedom. Defeating tough demigods with custom magic builds or heavy swords gives an unmatched sense of accomplishment.

coveredGames.name: Subnautica
coveredGames.title: Diving into alien ocean depths feels amazing until pitch black darkness surrounds you and terrifying leviathan roars echo nearby.

coveredGames.name: Ghost of Tsushima DIRECTOR'S CUT
coveredGames.title: Cutting down Mongols in fluid stance duels while riding across breathtaking fields creates an incredible samurai power fantasy.

coveredGames.name: Monster Hunter: World
coveredGames.title: Tracking giant beasts across vibrant ecosystems and forging heavy armor sets from rare drops keeps you hooked for hundreds of hours.

coveredGames.name: Cyberpunk 2077
coveredGames.title: Night City visually stuns. Exploring neon streets while testing custom cyberware upgrades and fighting street gangs makes every mission memorable.

coveredGames.name: Celeste
coveredGames.title: Pixel perfect jumps, instant respawns, clever air dashes, and an emotional story make reaching the top of the mountain extremely rewarding.

coveredGames.name: Stardew Valley
coveredGames.title: Planting crops, fishing during peaceful sunsets, and restoring the community center offers the most cozy farming experience ever created.

coveredGames.name: Dead Space
coveredGames.title: Terrifying atmosphere!

coveredGames.name: Hollow Knight
coveredGames.title: Exploring the vast underground kingdom of Hallownest feels magical thanks to crisp platforming controls, melancholic music, and challenging boss fights.

coveredGames.name: Risk of Rain 2
coveredGames.title: Pure 3D shooter chaos.

coveredGames.name: Factorio
coveredGames.title: Building intricate conveyor belts to automate resource production creates a deeply satisfying loop that will completely erase your sleep schedule.

coveredGames.name: Scrap Garden - The Day Before
coveredGames.title: Broken servers, empty maps, terrible gunplay, missing features, false promises, and bugged inventory systems created an absolute scam of a game.

coveredGames.name: Frostpunk 2
coveredGames.title: Deep political dilemmas, faction management, brutal icy winds, expanding city districts, heating laws, and tense societal survival make managing the city intensely rewarding.

coveredGames.name: SIGNALIS
coveredGames.title: Classic survival horror mechanics, eerie sci-fi anime aesthetic, cryptic story elements, inventory management, and unsettling atmospheric dread.

coveredGames.name: Lethal Company
coveredGames.title: Terrifying proximity chat screams, collecting brass apparatuses, escaping dark facility monsters, and laughing with friends.

coveredGames.name: Dead Cells
coveredGames.title: Snappy dodge rolling, branching biome paths, procedural weapon drops, fast combat loops, and rewarding skill progression.

coveredGames.name: ULTRAKILL
coveredGames.title: High-speed stylish shooting, coin shooting mechanic, sliding through corridors, painting walls with enemy blood, and fast boss duels.

coveredGames.name: Ghostrunner 2
coveredGames.title: Motorcycle cyber highway races, katana slicing, high speed wall running, shuriken throwing, and intense one-hit action.

coveredGames.name: HELLDIVERS™ 2
coveredGames.title: Explosive co-op shooting, orbital stratagem strikes, friendly fire comedy, alien bug squashing, and democratic galactic war efforts.

coveredGames.name: Lies of P
coveredGames.title: Visceral parrying, custom weapon blades, dark Pinocchio lore, intense boss phases, and incredible Victorian city atmospheric design.

coveredGames.name: WORLD OF HORROR
coveredGames.title: Junji Ito inspired cosmic horror. 1-bit pixel art, turn-based card encounters, creepy mystery investigations, and unsettling chiptune audio.

coveredGames.name: Higurashi When They Cry Hou - Ch.8 Matsuribayashi
coveredGames.title: The conclusion of one of the iconic series—one that will surprise or shock you.

coveredGames.name: Pro Player Life
coveredGames.title: A simulator in the vein of *Game Dev Tycoon* that didn't quite successfully adapt its mechanics to fit its own ideas.

coveredGames.name: Paranormal Stories
coveredGames.title: Mediocre scavenger hunt game with standard mini-games

coveredGames.name: The Coma: Recut
coveredGames.title: A Korean horror film with a sustained atmosphere of the struggle for survival and a solid supernatural plot.

coveredGames.name: The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters
coveredGames.title: A sequel to the first installment that improved the gameplay structure, making the game more challenging and engaging.

coveredGames.name: Hellish Quart
coveredGames.title: A rather interesting and detailed fighting game featuring 17th-century warriors. Each character has their own unique traits and weapons.

coveredGames.name: Size Matters
coveredGames.title: A humorous speed-based game where you must manage to create an antidote by following a formula in the correct sequence.

coveredGames.name: Spinny's Journey
coveredGames.title: A corridor-based puzzle game in which you must control a constantly spinning propeller, which makes the task significantly more difficult.

coveredGames.name: SpellPunk VR
coveredGames.title: An ambitious VR game—a rarity these days. Train to become a true wizard and compete against your friends to find out who the real mage is!

coveredGames.name: Hell of Men : Blood Brothers
coveredGames.title: A well-thought-out RTS that prioritizes gameplay over graphics. Despite having simple—yet decent—visuals, the game features well-implemented operations, economy, and controls.

coveredGames.name: Chang'an: The capital of Tang Dynasty
coveredGames.title: A unique take on city-building games: in this title, you must rebuild the city of Chang'an during the Tang Dynasty. It is up to you to rule the capital!

coveredGames.name: Super Squad
coveredGames.title: An F2P game with interesting gameplay, but a formulaic style lacking creative spark, and a dead player base.

coveredGames.name: Arietta of Spirits
coveredGames.title: An incredibly atmospheric adventure that uses a fantasy story to explore a profound theme: the loss of loved ones.

coveredGames.name: Golden Fall 2
coveredGames.title: A decent game that didn't fully reach its potential due to an unsuccessful combination of dungeon crawler and RPG elements.

coveredGames.name: Wrestledunk Sports
coveredGames.title: A great game for passing the evening when you don't have time for a long gaming session. It allows for 4 players locally and 4 players online-all at the same time!

coveredGames.name: Uninvited Guest
coveredGames.title: A good horror story for a couple of hours that will draw you into its atmosphere and hold you there until the end.

coveredGames.name: Airplane Tycoon
coveredGames.title: This game isn't a "tycoon" game; rather, it's a financial game where you keep track of all the numbers. It doesn't offer anything special.

coveredGames.name: Crawlspace
coveredGames.title: The game attempts to replicate the intentionally terrible style of Vidas Salavejus’s *Timore*, but it overdoes it—to the point where the game leans more toward being bad than good.

coveredGames.name: Alchemist of War
coveredGames.title: This game adopts the mechanics and visual style characteristic of Arnold Rauers, creating the impression that it is his game.

coveredGames.name: Box's Dream
coveredGames.title: A classic Sokoban game with a decent visual style that would be more enjoyable to play on portable devices.

coveredGames.name: ARAIGNEES
coveredGames.title: An atmospheric horror game that skillfully combines various visual styles within a single space, successfully crafting a unique, chilling atmosphere through a chthonic approach!

coveredGames.name: Epic Fantasy Battle Simulator
coveredGames.title: Yet another take on the *Totally Accurate Battle Simulator* concept, which, in terms of optimization, is better than its counterparts.

coveredGames.name: Arcis Ultima
coveredGames.title: A pretty decent attempt at creating an old-school RPG in every sense—both in terms of gameplay and graphics. The only issue is the overly generic plot!

coveredGames.name: Agent 01
coveredGames.title: A reasonably well-made shooter, though it suffers from a critical issue with its AI—which is simultaneously bad in the sense of being both "weak" and "strong."

coveredGames.name: Darkest Dungeon®
coveredGames.title: An incredibly challenging rogue-RPG, teeming with terrifying monsters inspired by legends of the horror genre.

coveredGames.name: Total War: ATTILA
coveredGames.title: Looking for an atmospheric strategy game about the decline of the Roman Empire? Will you be able to repel all the barbarian attacks, or would it be better to join Attila’s hordes?

coveredGames.name: Oasis Defense
coveredGames.title: A defense game where you must evolve as you progress through different eras. It’s a light, relaxing game-just what you need.

coveredGames.name: Quantum Break
coveredGames.title: Cool sci-fi from the developers of Max Payne. A complex plot and spectacular slow-motion shootouts await you! Plus, there’s an entire mini-series included!

coveredGames.name: Zombie Driver HD
coveredGames.title: This game isn't about racing; it’s more of a top-down shooter featuring cars. It includes both a story campaign set in a semi-open world and straightforward races on dedicated tracks against bots !

coveredGames.name: Deadliest Catch: The Game
coveredGames.title: A crab-fishing simulator. Sailing in the northern latitudes off Alaska, we catch crabs on our own. It features an engaging workflow: we personally purchase the bait and set every single trap.

coveredGames.name: Winter Magic Factory
coveredGames.title: A Christmas-themed match-3 game. It features classic match-3 gameplay and 22 mini-games, with the story set in Santa Claus's village.

coveredGames.name: The Cat Lady
coveredGames.title: A cool mystical quest with an incredibly gripping plot and a dark atmosphere. Despite the simple graphics, the game features many shocking scenes of violence.

coveredGames.name: Eagle Island Twist
coveredGames.title: A wonderful platformer featuring pleasant music and pixel art. Rescue your friend on an island with procedurally generated levels, sixteen types of terrain, and a wide selection of abilities.

coveredGames.name: Party Hard
coveredGames.title: If your neighbors are constantly throwing noisy parties until 3 a.m., and their faces are practically begging to be painted with a whole spectrum of colors, then this game is made for you.

coveredGames.name: Apotheon
coveredGames.title: An absolute masterpiece of a game! A game that everyone should play. A golden classic of the adventure genre. Stunning location design, incredibly charming characters, and engaging gameplay!

coveredGames.name: ENSLAVED™: Odyssey to the West™ Premium Edition
coveredGames.title: An absolute masterpiece of a game! A game that everyone should play. A golden classic of the adventure genre. Stunning location design, incredibly charming characters, and engaging gameplay!

coveredGames.name: Dota Underlords
coveredGames.title: Between rounds, you recruit desired fighters from a randomly generated selection to build and upgrade your team for victory in the arena-strategy is everything.

coveredGames.name: Need a packet?
coveredGames.title: A cashier simulator—very monotonous. Surprisingly, the game is engaging due to its realism and its resemblance to those slightly plump, elderly female cashiers.

coveredGames.name: Micronomicon: Heroes
coveredGames.title: An excellent turn-based role-playing game, in the style of the King's Bounty series. A wonderful adventure filled with a sense of nostalgia. Highly recommended!

coveredGames.name: Stellaris
coveredGames.title: Conquer the universe, build an empire of robots, and witness a supernova explosion—all of this is possible in one of the most compelling space strategy games.

coveredGames.name: Encased: A Sci-Fi Post-Apocalyptic RPG
coveredGames.title: Retro-futuristic dome anomaly exploration, distinct corporate wing backgrounds, classic isometric turn-based combat, and quirky humor.

coveredGames.name: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader
