coveredGames.name: Phantasma Hotel
coveredGames.title: Вы оказываетесь в ловушке мрачного и проклятого отеля, который пытается вас убить. В игре доступно несколько уникальных персонажей за которых предстоит исследовать коридоры и комнаты, решать головолом

coveredGames.name: over the hill
coveredGames.title: I got hooked on the mellow off-road exploration—taming old 4x4s with friends feels great, even if the pace is slow.

coveredGames.name: Let's Tidy Up! : Treasure
coveredGames.title: I didn't expect sorting a dwarf's mountain of treasure to be this satisfying. Unlocking upgrades keeps the cleanup rewarding, though the repetitive loop won't suit everyone. Perfect for a chill gaming

coveredGames.name: ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE
coveredGames.title: The cloudscapes look incredible, and weaving through dogfights at full speed is exactly the kind of arcade flight action I wanted. The story can get melodramatic, but the aerial spectacle sells it

coveredGames.name: BOMBANANA!
coveredGames.title: I haven't laughed this hard at a co-op puzzle in a while—trying to communicate with incomplete information creates pure chaos. A few puzzles feel unclear, but the teamwork is fantastic.

coveredGames.name: Next Reign: Kingdom
coveredGames.title: I got hooked watching a tiny settlement snowball into a proper kingdom. The automation makes progression feel great, though the early grind is a little slow. A surprisingly addictive strategy loop.

coveredGames.name: Yet Another Zombie Survivors
coveredGames.title: I got hooked on building a three-person squad and watching their abilities click together. The hordes look fantastic, though runs can get repetitive toward the end. Still, great fun.

coveredGames.name: ReStory: Chill Electronics Repairs
coveredGames.title: I got surprisingly hooked on bringing old gadgets back to life. The repairs feel tactile and relaxing, while the Y2K Tokyo setting adds tons of charm. Some parts are a little repetitive, but it's cozy

coveredGames.name: Leafy Corner
coveredGames.title: I could easily lose an evening growing plants and arranging the shop exactly how I want. It’s deliberately simple, so management fans may want more depth, but the cozy loop is hard to dislike.

coveredGames.name: Dead Weight
coveredGames.title: I didn't expect hauling junk through the skies to be this addictive. Every upgrade feels earned, and the physics keep things exciting, even if the controls can be a little unforgiving.

coveredGames.name: The Message from Deep Space
coveredGames.title: Figuring out an alien language made me feel genuinely clever. Some puzzles really test your patience, but every breakthrough is so satisfying that I couldn't stop chasing the next clue.

coveredGames.name: 007 First Light
coveredGames.title: I loved switching between stealth and all-out action whenever a plan fell apart. The driving feels a bit weaker than the espionage, but the Bond fantasy is absolutely nailed.

coveredGames.name: Outbound
coveredGames.title: I loved turning a tiny van into a rolling home—exploring, crafting, and living off-grid feels incredibly cozy. Progress can be slow, but that's part of its charm.

coveredGames.name: Down with the Ship
coveredGames.title: Loved the constant panic of keeping a sinking ship alive—patching damage, managing chaos, and making desperate calls under pressure turns every run into a great disaster story.

coveredGames.name: Call of the Elder Gods
coveredGames.title: Call of the Elder Gods mixes puzzle-solving with cosmic horror—strange worlds, clever mysteries, and unsettling atmosphere keep pulling you deeper into its Lovecraftian madness.

coveredGames.name: Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors
coveredGames.title: Vampire Crawlers throws Vampire Survivors chaos into full 3D—wild enemy swarms, absurd builds, and nonstop movement turn every run into a flashy, dopamine-fueled mess

coveredGames.name: Above the Snow
coveredGames.title: Above the Snow blends cozy vibes with real pressure—manage a mountain resort, rescue climbers, and survive harsh winters. Chill on the surface, but every decision can spiral fast.

coveredGames.name: Windrose
coveredGames.title: Windrose nails pirate survival—seamless ship-to-land gameplay, co-op chaos, and satisfying naval combat. Rough edges remain, but the sense of adventure is seriously addictive.

coveredGames.name: Oceaneers
coveredGames.title: Oceaneers mixes colony sim and survival with a fresh twist—building floating islands, managing survivors, and exploring a flooded world makes every decision feel meaningful and tense

coveredGames.name: High Above
coveredGames.title: High Above is pure chill—build dreamy rooftop hideouts with zero pressure, just vibes. Watching tiny details come alive turns it into a peaceful, almost meditative sandbox.

coveredGames.name: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection
coveredGames.title: Monster Hunter Stories 3 delivers a deeper Monstie RPG—breed, customize, and battle in strategic turn-based fights. The world feels alive, even if the grind sometimes bites back

coveredGames.name: Retro Rewind - Video Store Simulator
coveredGames.title: Retro Rewind turns mundane retail into a cozy obsession—stock shelves, rewind tapes, and survive busy nights while building your dream 90s video store. Simple, nostalgic, and weirdly addictive.

coveredGames.name: Dragonkin: The Banished
coveredGames.title: Dragonkin: The Banished hooked me with insane build freedom and satisfying loot grind—taming wyrmlings and crafting crazy skill combos makes every run feel powerful and addictive.

coveredGames.name: Tiny Biomes: Cozy Idle
coveredGames.title: Tiny Biomes: Cozy Idle is pure comfort — watching tiny animals grow your world while you chill and upgrade feels oddly addictive. No pressure, just cozy progress and vibes

coveredGames.name: Equinox: Homecoming
coveredGames.title: Ride across a cozy open world, bond with your horse, and uncover a dark mystery on a beautiful island. A chill MMO adventure with exploration, races, and story-driven secrets.

coveredGames.name: Roadside Research
coveredGames.title: Roadside Research is a ridiculous co-op sim where you run a gas station… while secretly being aliens studying humans. Chaotic chores, goofy espionage, and perfect “friends-mess-everything-up” energy.

coveredGames.name: Vampire's Fall 2
coveredGames.title: Vampire’s Fall 2 delivers a dark 2D RPG experience — tactical turn-based combat, meaningful character builds, and an open world where every choice shapes your rise as a vampire.

coveredGames.name: Jackal
coveredGames.title: Jackal blasted me through wild 1970s Vegas hotel raids with relentless carnage and chaotic physics-fuelled combat. Every run feels fresh and feral — perfect if you crave fast-paced action thrill.

coveredGames.name: Cairn
coveredGames.title: Cairn hooked me with tense, limb-by-limb climbing on Mount Kami—every move feels earned, the vistas are stunning, and reaching the top is deeply rewarding. Truly a unique and unforgettable climb.

coveredGames.name: Storage Hunter Simulator
coveredGames.title: Storage Hunter Simulator turns junk auctions into pure fun — bid on abandoned storages, dig up hidden treasures, and build your pawnshop empire. 🎯 Great for chill treasure-hunting and casual sim fans

coveredGames.name: Rue Valley
coveredGames.title: Rue Valley plunges you into a grim, stylish time-loop RPG where every day is your mental battle and every conversation carves your soul. Dark, hypnotic… but the polish still wavers.

coveredGames.name: Seafarer: The Ship Simulator
coveredGames.title: Seafarer: The Ship Sim trades the cockpit for the captain’s helm, letting you steer cargo ships, fight fires and explore vast seas. Realistic waves, detailed vessels make each voyage memorable.

coveredGames.name: Eclipsium
coveredGames.title: Eclipsium drags you into a haunting, dreamlike horror experience. The visuals twist reality, the sound chills your bones, and the light you chase feels both hope and curse. Intense, unforgettable.

coveredGames.name: Goblin Cleanup
coveredGames.title: Goblin Cleanup turns the dungeon clean-up job into chaotic fun: you scrub blood, reset traps, restock loot, and coordinate with friends. Gross, hilarious, oddly satisfying—great in co-op or solo.

coveredGames.name: METAL GEAR SOLID Δ: SNAKE EATER
coveredGames.title: METAL GEAR SOLID Δ: SNAKE EATER feels like the perfect way to relive one of the best stealth adventures ever. The jungle looks stunning, every encounter hits harder thanks to the new visuals and sound

coveredGames.name: POLYGON
coveredGames.title: POLYGON is a tactical, stylized free-to-play FPS with up to 32-player battles, deep weapon customization, and team-based combat on large maps—ideal for fans of low-fi visuals and solid PvP gameplay.

coveredGames.name: Ritual of Raven
coveredGames.title: Ritual of Raven is a cozy farming sim where you enchant magical constructs to tend your garden. Solve puzzles, befriend quirky villagers, and restore balance to a world disrupted by unstable portals

coveredGames.name: The Drifter
coveredGames.title: The Drifter is a dark, fast-paced point-and-click thriller from Powerhoof. Play as Mick Carter, a drifter caught in a time-loop mystery filled with conspiracy, murder, and shadowy science

coveredGames.name: Tiny Bookshop
coveredGames.title: Tiny Bookshop is a cozy bookstore sim where you recommend books, decorate your shop, and meet charming locals. Perfect for fans of relaxing, story-driven management games.

coveredGames.name: FAIRY TAIL 2
coveredGames.title: FAIRY TAIL 2 brings the Alvarez Empire Arc to life with fast-paced, flashy magic battles, a real-time combat system featuring Break Gauges, Link Attacks, and Unison Raids.

coveredGames.name: Doodle Empires
coveredGames.title: Doodle Empires is an alternate-history sandbox where you draw nations, shape cultures, and watch your world evolve. Fun and addicting, though still early access and a bit buggy.Great for strategy fans

coveredGames.name: Boku Boku
coveredGames.title: In the 2D sandbox game Boku Boku, unleash your imagination and build your own world. You can focus on completing quests or simply explore this little world—the choice is yours!

coveredGames.name: Drive UP: Together
coveredGames.title: We are confident that a few small tweaks will boost the game's excitement level. While there are many games in this genre, this is the first one to feature cars. It’s worth checking out.

coveredGames.name: Tormentum II
coveredGames.title: Mysteries are finally revealed in the second Tormentum game. It has practically breathed new life into the point-and-click genre. Its music will draw you in,and you won't be able to tear yourself away

coveredGames.name: Dirty Laundry
coveredGames.title: It’s a bite-sized horror game you can finish in an hour. Unlike other similar titles, the focus on interaction rather than just running away—something fresh to us—raised the tension level a notch.

coveredGames.name: The Legend of Water
coveredGames.title: An obstacle course game where we strive to reach the finish line as a droplet of water. We try to advance across the platform while contending with the sun's impact and the risk of falling.

coveredGames.name: [HERROR] Gas Station Case
coveredGames.title: The price is quite reasonable, even though it's short. There are some jumpscares here and there. The story is quite interesting. Recommended.

coveredGames.name: Luctus
coveredGames.title: While not particularly rich in storyline, it's an engaging role-playing game. Fighting enemies isn't overly challenging, but it's fun. The difficulty level can be adjusted at the beginning if needed.

coveredGames.name: Ultimate Guess Game
coveredGames.title: Try to guess what the picture in their hand is by answering yes or no. Reach a total of 5 points and win the game. Enjoy the fun while sipping your coffee by the fireplace.

coveredGames.name: Trader Life Simulator: Together
coveredGames.title: Welcome to the world of trading simulator. Run your small shop and earn money. As you earn more, expand your business by opening a bigger shop. Play alone or with a friend.

coveredGames.name: SubZero
coveredGames.title: A Chinese game that blends FMV and RPG genres. A pandemic spreads across the world, and those you care about are far away. Can you save them at the cost of your own life?

coveredGames.name: Hitman Classic Trilogy Remastered
coveredGames.title: This version of the HITMAN series—the best stealth-action game of its time—updated for the new generation, will be coming to Steam very soon.

coveredGames.name: Life Below
coveredGames.title: A very fun underwater colony-building game. Keep the pH stable and dominate the mysterious waters of the ocean with the magical creatures of the underwater universe.

coveredGames.name: The Fruit Merchant's Diary
coveredGames.title: This game made by Turkish developers. You have to chance for a playing. It exist for demo too.

coveredGames.name: Dig & Deal
coveredGames.title: Still Early Access, you can think to get after full release.

coveredGames.name: GreedFall
coveredGames.title: This game has truly satisfying and high-quality graphics. If you like RPGs, We'd recommend buying it while it's on sale. Although animation transitions weren't great, the dialogues were quite rich.

coveredGames.name: MR. ELEVATOR
coveredGames.title: This game includes puzzle. Maybe your eyes could be aching cuz of colors. Attention please, if you have epilepsy issue don't play without doctor approval. Welcome to mystery simulation game!

coveredGames.name: DECRYPTO Project
coveredGames.title: It's daily tasks about programming game. Its fun not long game but not short too. You can be feel like hacker or something while playing DECRYPTO game!

coveredGames.name: Paradyce
coveredGames.title: Different indie and lineer puzzle game. At least you have to read all story. After that you can control it. Can you solve this puzzle without harmed?

coveredGames.name: 1899: Secrets of the Maze
coveredGames.title: The game needs to be opened to early access. It is good as a horror game, but it is very dark, more like a puzzle game.

coveredGames.name: Pizza Tower
coveredGames.title: High-speed cartoon platforming, absurd humor, energetic music tracks, and wildly expressive animations.

coveredGames.name: No Man's Sky
coveredGames.title: Infinite procedural universe exploration, smooth planet landings, resource harvesting, and vast base building freedom.

coveredGames.name: Alien: Isolation
coveredGames.title: Unpredictable xenomorph AI!

coveredGames.name: The Magic Circle
coveredGames.title: Hacking game code in real time to alter enemy behaviors, turn monsters into allies, and solve puzzles inside an unfinished video game.

coveredGames.name: Project Highrise
coveredGames.title: Designing skyscraper layouts by balancing utility lines, apartment rents, elevator traffic, and office demands brings great management fun.

coveredGames.name: Mark of the Ninja
coveredGames.title: Visualizing sound waves in darkness, dropping smoke bombs, and dragging guards into vents makes 2D stealth feel brilliant.

coveredGames.name: Alien Swarm: Reactive Drop
coveredGames.title: Top down tactical bug hunting requiring tight squad coordination, sentry gun placements, and welding doors under heavy alien pressure.

coveredGames.name: Vampyr
coveredGames.title: Investigating influenza ridden London districts while choosing whether to drain innocent citizens for power or save them creates real moral weight.

coveredGames.name: State of Decay: YOSE
coveredGames.title: Managing survivor morale, scavenging supply rucksacks, building base facilities, and avoiding permanent character deaths keeps zombie survival tense.

coveredGames.name: EVERSPACE™
coveredGames.title: Roguelite space dogfighting with vibrant cosmic visuals, smooth flight controls, and rewarding cockpit resource management.

coveredGames.name: Kingdom Two Crowns
coveredGames.title: Simple two button controls manage a kingdom, where riding your mount, recruiting archers, and surviving nightly greed attacks feels cozy.

coveredGames.name: Dark Messiah of Might & Magic
coveredGames.title: Kicking enemies onto floor spikes, throwing ice spells on ledges, and using physical momentum makes medieval first person combat unforgettable.

coveredGames.name: Ghostrunner
coveredGames.title: One hit kill sword slicing paired with high speed wall running and dash maneuvers makes dying and instant restarting addictive.

coveredGames.name: Furi
coveredGames.title: Non-stop boss fights requiring frame perfect parrying, bullet hell dodging, and intense sword clashing backed by an incredible synthwave soundtrack.

coveredGames.name: HELENA : Cloud District
coveredGames.title: Massive, beautiful, creative and... free?? What are you waiting for? Download it now!

coveredGames.name: Machine Party
coveredGames.title: A great mixture of games with lots of horrible ways to die!

coveredGames.name: Kusan: City of Wolves
coveredGames.title: Hotline Miami on steroids, with a rocket-propelled fist up its butt and a soundtrack that slays.

coveredGames.name: Below, Rusted Gods
coveredGames.title: A dread-filled horror game that tells its story cleverly and does a great job of making you feel like part of the team, even though you're in the control room and they're down a deep dark ancient hole

coveredGames.name: There's Nothing Down There
coveredGames.title: An excellent little Sci-Fi horror exploration game with great voice acting and environmental design. There's definitely something down there!

coveredGames.name: Midnight Scenes: Among Graves
coveredGames.title: A beautifully told story of one man's battle against a family curse. Another excellent addition to the Midnight Scenes universe!

coveredGames.name: Project Songbird
coveredGames.title: A beautifully crafted narrative driven adventure with survival horror elements. Very cinematic and also feels like a very personal game. t has interesting stuff to say.

coveredGames.name: Crabmeat
coveredGames.title: An excellent crab fishing survival horror game set in the Antarctic. I especially like how the crabs wiggle when you sort them!

coveredGames.name: Jaden Williams' The Stalking Stairs
coveredGames.title: Proof that it's possible to do comedy horror without sacrificing the horror. A fantastic little horror game with superb voice acting and writing that makes every character a joy to meet.

coveredGames.name: Hypogea
coveredGames.title: A beautiful atmospheric megastructure climbing game with well crafted environments, interesting lore and clever pole-vaulting jumping mechanics. Loved spending time in it's decaying mechanical word.

coveredGames.name: CARIMARA: Beneath the forlorn limbs
coveredGames.title: A wonderful little haunted adventure inspired by Normandy folklore. It's got tons of style and a fascinating lore. Be sure to serarch for secrets!

coveredGames.name: Eclipsium
coveredGames.title: Eclipsium - a jaw-dropping surreal dream-like horror trip with stunning sights and creative puzzles.

coveredGames.name: PIGFACE
coveredGames.title: Very cool grungy horror vibes and tactical FPS gameplay that fondly reminded me of Goldeneye and Perfect Dark.

coveredGames.name: AUTO-CRISIS
coveredGames.title: A short and intense horror game with clever monster mechanics, excellent environmental design and a great ending. Automobile horror well worth taking for a ride!

coveredGames.name: The Supper: New Blood
coveredGames.title: A wholesome yet gory story of cannibal cooking vigilante justice. Superb pixel artwork, fun puzzles and lots of devilishly diabolical ways to dispatch and cook your victims!

coveredGames.name: Carnival
coveredGames.title: An excellent folk horror game that's very different from most modern gaming experiences. Confident slow burn storytelling takes its time in immersing you in 1930's Venice and ratcheting up the horror.

coveredGames.name: Ells Tales: Chairbound
coveredGames.title: A very creative concept that has some fun surprises and makes for an incredibly tense experience as you wiggle and swivel your way down a multistory office-block from hell!

coveredGames.name: Luto
coveredGames.title: A very impressive psychological horror game that has elements of Stanley Parable and PT, but also has plenty of interesting ideas of its own.

coveredGames.name: The Drifter
coveredGames.title: The puzzles make sense, the voice work is incredible, the pixel art is gorgeous and the story has more twists than an F1 track. Point and click adventures don't get much better than this.

coveredGames.name: You Shouldn't Be Here
coveredGames.title: A beautifully crafted story that deals with real-life issues in a very creative and intelligent way. The artwork and sound design are superb throughout. Highly recommended.

coveredGames.name: Tape to Tape
coveredGames.title: Tape To Tape stitches together roguelite elements with great hockey gameplay in one of the best sports games released this year.

coveredGames.name: Phantom Blade Zero
coveredGames.title: A quest of 66 days to heal a toxic heart in a world of corruption and dark magic takes us on an incredible journey of beautiful locations and mesmerizing combat.

coveredGames.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
coveredGames.title: When the dust settles, I think there’s a case to be made that Belmont’s Curse might be the best Castlevania game of all time.

coveredGames.name: Valor Mortis
coveredGames.title: A shift to Souls-like set in a nightmarish alternate vision of the Napoleonic Wars might be new ground for One More Level, but it plays well off the Ghostrunner dev's strengths.

coveredGames.name: Gears of War: E-Day
coveredGames.title: From a compelling campaign to blood-soaked multiplayer, The Coalition understands what makes Gears great.

coveredGames.name: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™
coveredGames.title: Even when it was pissing me off, Star Wars: Galactic Racer made me feel alive.

coveredGames.name: Dragon Quest Heroes: Torneko's Mystery Dungeon -Classic HD-
coveredGames.title: If you’re interested in roguelikes and gaming history, here’s a rare opportunity to see one of that space’s entry points.

coveredGames.name: Valheim
coveredGames.title: Valheim is a masterful blend of linear progression with open survival gameplay.

coveredGames.name: Minecraft Dungeons II
coveredGames.title: Minecraft Dungeons 2 is an enjoyable dungeon-crawling romp, especially with friends. And by that, I mean local friends, not online ones.

coveredGames.name: ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE
coveredGames.title: A magnificent campaign full of compelling characters, exciting missions, sleek aircraft, and promising multiplayer make Ace Combat 8 a high-adrenaline delight.

coveredGames.name: CONTROL Resonant
coveredGames.title: Dylan Faden's journey to find his sister, stop the Hiss, and save Manhattan takes some big steps from the original, but not every one of them is sure-footed.

coveredGames.name: SILENT HILL: Townfall
coveredGames.title: Silent Hill: Townfall continues the franchise's modern renaissance with another spooky and inventive entry.

coveredGames.name: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter
coveredGames.title: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter is very much an iterative sequel to the first remake, and that’s all it really needed to be.

coveredGames.name: Graveyard Keeper 2
coveredGames.title: There’s probably an audience for Graveyard Keeper 2, the kinds of people who achieve fulfillment from spreadsheets and min/maxing every ounce of video game they ever lay hands on.

coveredGames.name: NBA 2K27
coveredGames.title: It’s another year of neat additions to NBA 2K, but the game continues to be held back by its aggressive live service elements.

coveredGames.name: Tenebris Somnia
coveredGames.title: Tenebris Somnia is an intriguing game. It takes players back to simpler time, where mechanics were more unforgiving, and while it does suffer in some ways because of it, it manages to be compelling.

coveredGames.name: Stupid Never Dies
coveredGames.title: Stupid Never Dies is an adrenaline rush, something that explodes with colors and silliness and action and pizazz, but doesn’t really aim higher than junk food.

coveredGames.name: Order of the Sinking Star
coveredGames.title: Order of the Sinking Star is a masterpiece. Its immaculate, mind-bending puzzles are perfectly designed to make you feel spectacularly stupid and then phenomenally smart.

coveredGames.name: Blood Dungeon
coveredGames.title: Fun to play, has a cool aesthetic... but its lack of interest in expression and build-crafting really hurts its momentum, and makes playing long-term feel more and more like a chore.

coveredGames.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
coveredGames.title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword’s cast, quest, numerous asides, and the evolution of techniques and combat throughout this adventure have the weight and depth to make you roar in triumph.

coveredGames.name: The Blood of Dawnwalker
coveredGames.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker is an ambitious project that occasionally wears both the best and worst aspects of its inspirations on its sleeve.

coveredGames.name: Agent 64: Spies Never Die
coveredGames.title: Agent 64: Spies Never Die is a fun shooter that goes above and beyond to act as an accurate facsimile of Nintendo 64 shooters, particularly GoldenEye 007.

coveredGames.name: MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls
coveredGames.title: Arc System Works knows what they’re doing, and it shows in every single corner of Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls.

coveredGames.name: EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 27
coveredGames.title: Madden NFL 27 is a good football game. Coming off of Madden NFL 26, the series is trending in a positive direction.

coveredGames.name: The Sinking City 2
coveredGames.title: The Sinking City 2 sits with me now as a game that did a lot of things well, and some things adequately. The missing ingredient is that it didn’t do anything wonderfully.

coveredGames.name: Mortal Shell II
coveredGames.title: Mortal Shell 2 is one of the best follow-up sequels to a game in a long time. It retains the same brutal, unforgiving gameplay Soulslike fanatics have come to masochistically enjoy.

coveredGames.name: STAR WARS Zero Company™
coveredGames.title: I too yearn for the potential of Star Wars’ grittier settings made manifest in RPG form, and that’s what Zero Company showed up to deliver. It just doesn’t have the sauce.

coveredGames.name: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
coveredGames.title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy is a fun time. Its simple combat system makes the game approachable for a variety of players, even if it may get a little repetitive toward the end.

coveredGames.name: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game
coveredGames.title: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game is a rock-solid fighter that manages to honor a beloved IP without compromising any of the sensibilities needed to succeed in this genre.

coveredGames.name: Lunarium
coveredGames.title: Lunarium's pleasant art style, grandiose soundtrack, and deep combat system kept me engaged, but the myriad of bugs and awkwardness in dialogue kept me from fully clicking with the whole package.

coveredGames.name: Truck-kun is Supporting Me from Another World?!
coveredGames.title: I laughed, I smiled, I rammed police, killed some slimes, and did it all again for a few hours until it was time to move on. I call that a good time.

coveredGames.name: BLUE REFLECTION Quartet
coveredGames.title: If you’re jonesing for something new and interesting in the magical girl realm that isn’t just caked in gratuity, Blue Reflection and its sequel are great. Everything else is just an odd bonus.

coveredGames.name: Chop Chop Inc.
coveredGames.title: As far as punching trees goes, Chop Chop Inc. does a commendable job making the impossible possible: making just that part by itself a fun time.

coveredGames.name: Beast of Reincarnation
coveredGames.title: Beast of Reincarnation is a fun action-adventure game, though the exploration elements don’t come together.

coveredGames.name: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales
coveredGames.title: Square Enix and Team Asano have taken a sidestep from turn-based RPGs and put together a fine top-down Zelda-like experience.

coveredGames.name: Beatdown City Survivors
coveredGames.title: It’s worth checking out (especially if you know and like the other games), but it’s not going to ultimately stand out much in its own crowded space. Not for its mechanics, anyway.

coveredGames.name: The 7th Guest Remake
coveredGames.title: Vertigo Games has reworked the rooms, puzzles, and even live-action cutscenes to make this version of 7th Guest a solid reinvention of the classic puzzle thriller.

coveredGames.name: The Remake of the End of the Greatest RPG of All Time
coveredGames.title: Trying to fold RPG design structure into an escape room-like puzzle contraption was an intriguing premise, but frustrating to deal with when these two affectations intersected awkwardly.

coveredGames.name: Mina the Hollower
coveredGames.title: Mina the Hollower is a charming and challenging adventure that never ceased to delight and surprise in music, art, and gameplay.

coveredGames.name: LEGO® Batman™: Legacy of the Dark Knight
coveredGames.title: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight is a great experience overall, and will likely find a passionate audience among those who love this series.

coveredGames.name: Cannon Clicker

coveredGames.name: SWAT Commander

coveredGames.name: Laundering Simulator - Clean Cash and Laundry
coveredGames.title: An unusual small-business management game with a good progression system to decorate and expand your place, buy new machines, the story is fun with colorful characters..chaotic and enjoyable sim game.

coveredGames.name: Alaska Gold Fever

coveredGames.name: The Crazy Hyper-Dungeon Chronicles

coveredGames.name: Peregrino

coveredGames.name: Workshop Simulator VR

coveredGames.name: Car Dealer Simulator

coveredGames.name: Vietnam War

coveredGames.name: CONERU -DIMENSION GIRL-

coveredGames.name: Albert's Ark Idle

coveredGames.name: Ports Of Call Deluxe 3D 2024

coveredGames.name: Crypt Keeper

coveredGames.name: Bank Simulator

coveredGames.name: Broforce

coveredGames.name: Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors
coveredGames.title: Crazy card combos, constant unlocks, escalating chaos. Like Vampire Survivors, it snowballs into pure madness. Main campaign was 12 hours of nonstop addiction for me and I loved it.

coveredGames.name: 2024: Mosaic Retrospective
coveredGames.title: The best free way to test Mark Ffrench’s Mega Mosaic formula: 15 hours of content at no cost. Only gripe is the lack of higher difficulty, which later entries fixed.

coveredGames.name: Die in the Dungeon
coveredGames.title: A dice-driven twist on Slay the Spire with deep and creative gameplay. It looks, sounds and plays great, and the later difficulties push back hard.

coveredGames.name: A Game About Digging A Hole™
coveredGames.title: Satisfying at first, thin by the end. Early digs click, but all upgrades are gone in 2 hours, then it’s just a rush to the end. Fair for the price, but not a game you would need to play.

coveredGames.name: Replicube
coveredGames.title: A puzzly coding playground: write Lua to recreate 3D objects and discover mindblowing math for patterns, shapes and colors. Rewarding, though it offers little guidance and gets pretty difficult later.

coveredGames.name: Hexmaster
coveredGames.title: Polished, brilliant, and smartly designed. Hexmaster nails the Hexcells formula, adds painless cell marking, and saves its best puzzles for after the campaign (master levels). Absolutely loved it!

coveredGames.name: Shogun Showdown
coveredGames.title: Tight, clever turn-based duels with mechanics you won't find elsewhere. Add charming art and a stellar soundtrack, and "one more run" quickly turns into ten. Great game!

coveredGames.name: Bento Blocks
coveredGames.title: Clean, clever block puzzling wrapped in a soundtrack built to slow your pulse. Easy to sink into, much harder to finish than the first hour suggests.

coveredGames.name: Trans Neuronica
coveredGames.title: A smart and difficult twist on line drawing puzzles: your solution decays as the level changes. Superb soundtrack, satisfying friction. Timed boss fights break the flow, but you can disable timers.

coveredGames.name: INDIKA
coveredGames.title: More of a playable movie than a game. Stunning environments, sharp dialogue, cinematic cutscenes, thin puzzles. If you want something memorable, it delivers, just be patient with some of the chores.

coveredGames.name: Tormentum II
coveredGames.title: Beautiful as ever, finally smooth performance-wise. The sci-fi twist lifts the story well past the original. Easy puzzles, no pixel hunting - you come for the atmosphere and nothing gets in the way.

coveredGames.name: Tormentum - Dark Sorrow
coveredGames.title: Plays like a dusty Flash adventure - stuttering framerate, puzzles that solve themselves. But the grotesque dreamscapes, the story and the sound are worth the trip. You come for the atmosphere.

coveredGames.name: Typomagical
coveredGames.title: A tense typing test wearing a bullet-heaven costume. Creative with its spell mods - held back by movement input bleeding into your words. Great if you type fast and precisely, niche if you don't.

coveredGames.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun
coveredGames.title: Stunning 40k environment and combat that rips, held back by a rather thin bestiary and few bosses getting recycled over and over again. Still a comfort food for anyone who misses boomer shooters.

coveredGames.name: Dicefolk
coveredGames.title: Monster collecting meets roguelike, played like a board game - you pick the order of your enemy's moves too. Addictive, generous with unlocks; had really good fun for about 30 hours.

coveredGames.name: Salamander County Public Television
coveredGames.title: What the... fever dream is that. Absolutely bizarre minigames in absurd storyline on a nonsense local TV (which you watch in menu). Very niche, liked that!

coveredGames.name: Bajka
coveredGames.title: A walkable exhibit more than a game, in Afterglitch's vein. Gorgeous, thoughtful world - but the omnipresent starlight shimmer on every texture turned calm into nausea for me.

coveredGames.name: Scarlet Deer Inn
coveredGames.title: Beautiful art and music carry a soft, low-friction adventure. Light platforming, easy puzzles, and after 3 hours I felt it ended way too soon. Enjoyable, but the gameplay could offer way more.

coveredGames.name: Afterglitch
coveredGames.title: Plays like an hour long contemporary art exhibit you can walk through. Gameplay is thin - slow movement, easy puzzles - but striking visuals make it a unique confusing experience.

coveredGames.name: SuperTaxCity
coveredGames.title: Easy to learn, hard to put down. Max the game speed, focus on strategy and optimization, and ride the dopamine of nonstop cha-chings. Just don't expect RNG to cooperate with your perfect plan.

coveredGames.name: WHAT THE GOLF?
coveredGames.title: A pun-stuffed minigame marathon disguised as golf, reminds me of WarioWare. Wildly creative, generously packed with levels. Loved it all!

coveredGames.name: CARRION
coveredGames.title: A short savage joy. CARRION's metroidvania bite, smart puzzles and visceral combat keep you excited. Beautiful and atmospheric. The missing map adds chaos that mostly fits a feral predator.

coveredGames.name: Phonopolis
coveredGames.title: A gorgeous cardboard dystopia told with fairytale innocence. Puzzles charm more than challenge - each one a tiny creative toybox, as Amanita always does those. Short but sweet, enjoyed it!

coveredGames.name: Echo Isle
coveredGames.title: A polished GameBoy Color's The Legend of Zelda love letter with spot-on aesthetics, but little beyond the nostalgia hook. Overall a fine treat for an hour.

coveredGames.name: Pip My Dice
coveredGames.title: Balatro's dice-rolling cousin - same dopamine rush with big scores and loud slot machine sounds. Packed with clever dice and run modifiers. If Balatro hooked you, this will too.

coveredGames.name: Mewseum: Masterpieces
coveredGames.title: Relaxing but rarely surprising. The flat difficulty curve is more a feature than a negative, it pairs well with good art and sound. Fine, not fantastic; enjoyed my 10 hours solving grid puzzles.

coveredGames.name: Nonogram 3D : Mega Puzzle
coveredGames.title: Promising style, poor execution. Difficulty flatlines early, lots of 0-blocks feel like filler, and a progress-wiping bug stings. Pick Voxelgram 2 instead for the same gameplay done way better.

coveredGames.name: Felvidek
coveredGames.title: Stylish art and gorgeous cutscenes carry this RPGMaker gem. Combat is forgettable and a bit tough sometimes, but the local language and humor are unmatched. I want more, Jozef and Vlado!

coveredGames.name: Cat Detective Albert Wilde
coveredGames.title: Mostly style over substance, but the style is great. The puns work well enough, the premise is intriguing, yet the story felt underwhelming and never quite clicked for me.

coveredGames.name: Diorama Builder
coveredGames.title: Really enjoyable and relaxing, especially if you like the feel of assembling a LEGO set. It can get fiddly with tiny parts, and you’ll definitely want DLCs for more content; otherwise it's short.

coveredGames.name: Soda Crisis
coveredGames.title: Short, energetic, and reward-heavy, Soda Crisis delivers quick platforming bursts with a steady stream of upgrades. New stuff is unlocked after almost every tiny level! Enjoyed those few hours.

coveredGames.name: Click Painter
coveredGames.title: Gorgeous visuals and innovative controls (for a Minesweeper), undermined by repetitive line-based level design and harsh fail states. Overall feels cozy but also oddly punishing.

coveredGames.name: Mosaic of the Strange
coveredGames.title: Absolutely brilliant! Great successor to previous mosaics, now with nice story and high difficulty mode that increases puzzle complexity, but keeping it not stressful with mistakes and hints allowed.

coveredGames.name: Astrologaster
coveredGames.title: A wonderful choose-your-own-adventure full of intriguing plots, hilarious moments, and excellent voice acting and songs.

coveredGames.name: Papetura
coveredGames.title: If you’ve played all Amanita Design's adventures, Papetura is a fine follow up. Short, gentle, and stunning in both visuals and sound.

coveredGames.name: The end is nahual: If I may say so
coveredGames.title: A unique and weird game packed with silly puzzles and fourth wall breaks. I enjoyed it for the first 2/3, but later the difficulty spiked and the focus shifted too much on fast dodge-style minigames.

coveredGames.name: Station to Station
coveredGames.title: Don't expect a railroad traffic like in OpenTTD. This is a wonderful puzzle game with beautiful visuals and a great train cam. Mostly easy, but it offers a solid challenge through its niche tasks.

coveredGames.name: Mini City: Mayhem
coveredGames.title: In terms of content to play through, this game is mini, yet also very varied! If you want that Tetris-like time pressure combined with city building (it looks great!), definitely give it a chance.

coveredGames.name: Mosaic of The Pharaohs
coveredGames.title: While it's still good, there's nothing new after Proverbs. If you haven't got enough of huge minesweeper level, here you go again.

coveredGames.name: Jumpbound
coveredGames.title: Short yet very satisfying 3D platformer; good level design, keeping your eyes on the next platform while still being difficult overall. Enjoyed it!

coveredGames.name: Psycho-Sleuth
coveredGames.title: Be part of a killing game to become the new God of a high-tech church in this deduction-based VN where every character has powers based on their disorders. A stylish, deep, and challenging experience.

coveredGames.name: The House Before
coveredGames.title: You wake up as a house, with disturbing beings inhabiting your colossal body and corridorrs as veins. A cryptic, bizarre, and disturbing adventure with word-based puzzles and an insane atmosphere.

coveredGames.name: Particle Hearts
coveredGames.title: Embark on a journey in a wild land made of particles, with deadly wolves and colossal demons. A poetic adventure with exploration, challenging platforming, and some chases, in a game reminding ICO.

coveredGames.name: Village in the Shade
coveredGames.title: Practically Yomawari 4 hidden behind a huge cozy farming simulator with so many things to do. From cursed villages to mountain gods and disturbing Yokai at night, all the elements are there.

coveredGames.name: Silver Valley Screams
coveredGames.title: Complex open-world full of choices in this immersive simulation set in a 1975 desert town. Eat, craft, and survive: you could spend hours in this dangerous land, or die after a few minutes.

coveredGames.name: Anti-anti
coveredGames.title: In this Korean VN, Earth got destroyed by colossal slimes. Now, rich people are looking for a "savior idol." Join a disturbing reality show, and when the hate messages arrive, decide who to cheer.

coveredGames.name: Inky's Sleep
coveredGames.title: Play as a cute cat trapped in surreal nightmares of disturbing beings and cardboard mazes in this adventure with amazing art-style, distinctive atmosphere, and challenging puzzles. A great surprise!

coveredGames.name: SAKIMORI
coveredGames.title: Promising action roguelike in EA where you must venture into haunted schools to retrieve cursed items by using a transforming gun with multiple purposes and shapes, from radar to creating barriers.

coveredGames.name: Otherside Tapes: Favela
coveredGames.title: The feeling of Outlast set in a Brazilian favela, where you need to escape a time-loop by solving puzzles alternating between two realities, while avoiding disturbing "not so immobile" creatures.

coveredGames.name: Last Round at the End of the World
coveredGames.title: An eldritch cult meets a poetic-detective game where you must choose a villager to sacrifice based on a poem from the depths, packed in a puzzle adventure with a disturbing photo-collage aesthetic.

coveredGames.name: Nothing to Report
coveredGames.title: Spot the anomalies in this coop game where only one player sees an anomaly. Talk with your friends, close your eyes to keep sanity, and try to check what is different in every round [AI voice].

coveredGames.name: Shinjuku Anomaly
coveredGames.title: Extremely short VN with a dark aesthetic. Explore a b&w Tokyo while taking photos of disturbing anomalies, learn how to survive each encounter, take the best photo, and aim for one of the 3 endings.

coveredGames.name: Hypnostasis
coveredGames.title: Cryptic and mysterious horror game where Jungian psychology meets Cry of Fear. Explore open nightmares with a very creepy atmosphere, follow the crow psychologist, and fight very disturbing beings.

coveredGames.name: Tenebris Somnia
coveredGames.title: Retro 2D aesthetic and live-action cutscenes (with better effects than many horror movies), merge in this classic survival horror with great enemy design, clever puzzles, and multiple endings.

coveredGames.name: Final Selection
coveredGames.title: Survive 7 days in a dark-fantasy unforgiving world where Hotline Miami meets Fear & Hunger. A very disturbing game where the inventory is inside your flesh, and cutting limbs is necessary to explore.

coveredGames.name: Buitopia DVD
coveredGames.title: It plays like a game inside a DVD menu, and offers unsettling scenes and many hidden secrets. Find the perfect present for a birthday party in a disturbing world where distractions lead to bad ends.

coveredGames.name: Horror Scenarios: The Redwood Estate
coveredGames.title: Homage to Resident Evil 1, with camera and combat inspired by Darkwood. Play as two characters and freely explore a mansion full of puzzles, locked doors, and grotesque mutants.

coveredGames.name: RetroSpace
coveredGames.title: An immersive simulation in a space station with insect hybrids going rogue, inspired by System Shock. Use spray to create puddles and electrocute enemies or use stealth in a game with many approaches.

coveredGames.name: BrokenLore: DON’T LIE
coveredGames.title: Discover the other side of "Don't Watch" in this side-by-side sequel full of minigames, a game inside the game, a fighting combat against cute-but-creepy characters, and many disturbing moments.

coveredGames.name: Deep Sheol
coveredGames.title: FPS set in a cyberpunk open world inspired by Lovecraft. Explore at your pace an island full of dangers, survive hordes of mutants, and solve puzzles in a silent world full of lore and retro vibes.

coveredGames.name: Choice of Life: Floors
coveredGames.title: Play through an ordinary day... broken by anxiety attacks showing demons and eye monsters in this choice-based game with many endings and branches. Will you keep calm or embrace the insanity?

coveredGames.name: Provoron
coveredGames.title: In a peculiar world, crows are infected with demons, while religious dogs teach you how to serve the Gray Crow. An adventure with great art-style and world-building, spiraling into disturbing events.

coveredGames.name: The Skin Stapler
coveredGames.title: Play as both the victims of a serial killer and the detectives investigating the scenes in this cinematic adventure with a nice dub, grotesque humor, and disturbing scenes. Plus, a very creepy killer.

coveredGames.name: Servant of the Lake
coveredGames.title: Rusty Lake returns to its "Roots" playing as a servant in a very peculiar family. Solve clever, surreal, and complex puzzles during the day, and prepare to spot disturbing anomalies by night.

coveredGames.name: Hariti
coveredGames.title: Search for your daughter in a nightmarish Chinese hospital. Use the light to dissolve grotesque fetus-like creatures, and escape from the disturbing red woman while exploring the detailed building.

coveredGames.name: 追曙
coveredGames.title: Two protagonists, 10 years apart, trapped in a twisted Buddhist nightmare in this 2D adventure. Investigate a mysterious suicide, solve surreal puzzles, and be ready to escape from deadly cultists.

coveredGames.name: The Dream Of A Cockspur
coveredGames.title: Sci-fi point-and-click adventure set in a feverish nightmare of surreal and disturbing scenes. Stranded on an island with a research team, you must solve the secret of an alien artifact.

coveredGames.name: Machine Party
coveredGames.title: Insane combination of Mario Party and Saw/The Cube. In a gritty industrial setting, play violent minigames with your friends, including pushing them under the metro, sniping them, or infecting them.

coveredGames.name: Joy Malignant
coveredGames.title: Explore the flesh-town of Visceria as an outcast without a face in this dice-based surreal adventure. Balance your masks in the rolls, and plan every day to advance and evolve your personality.

coveredGames.name: Tormentum II
coveredGames.title: Another incredible journey through cyber-nightmares and hellish dimensions, with amazing art inspired by Giger and Beksiński. Every room is an insane surprise, every character a disturbing being.

coveredGames.name: The Escape to the Afterlife
coveredGames.title: Short black-and-white journey through the early afterlife after 3 Japanese funerals. Escape from a grotesque lady hunting you, find the correct way through mazes, or avoid giant rolling heads.

coveredGames.name: Don't Let It Starve
coveredGames.title: Prepare food for a disturbing mutant chef hidden in a shaft, meet your daily quota... or die. Assemble bentos like it was Tetris, and explore the small room hiding many secrets. Will you escape?

coveredGames.name: BrokenLore: FOLLOW
coveredGames.title: A more focused psychological-horror experience touching heavy topics (bullying and bulimia), featuring clever loop-based puzzles and scares, and including Little Nightmares-like chasing sequences.

coveredGames.name: The Third Shift
coveredGames.title: Game Boy horror game never released. As a guard, wander around a peculiar museum, and survive exhibitions including the Human Body and Cryptids. Brilliant mix of humor and horror, with multiple ends.

coveredGames.name: Besmirch
coveredGames.title: FAITH if it was a farming simulator. Harvest your crops for winter, prepare for bizarre festivals... and be ready for the disturbing beings at night. Full of things to do, from dungeons to bosses.

coveredGames.name: Penance
coveredGames.title: A monk slowly walks through the gothic horror setting of his monastery, ready to discover its secrets. Atmospheric and challenging levels full of threats to overcome in rhythm-based battles.

coveredGames.name: Saint of Chains
coveredGames.title: Inspired by Silent Hill and Cry of Fear, venture inside abandoned apartments in this creepy first-person adventure. Follow the traces of a cult, solve old-school puzzles, and face disturbing creatures

coveredGames.name: Kuentame
coveredGames.title: If Snow White didn't want a kiss? Discover the answer in this psychedelic and surreal platformer/bullet-hell. After avoiding the kiss, venture into a challenging land of masks, hiding many surprises.

coveredGames.name: Kodoku：As the Moon Mourns
coveredGames.title: Peculiar and short horror game with elements from Japanese folklore. Explore the underworld, and survive jar-headed sinners and colossal skeletons dragging a chariot... when your only weapon is a jar.

coveredGames.name: Flesh Made Fear
coveredGames.title: Amazing homage to classic RE with modern twists in a well-packaged survival horror balancing B-movie moments, gore, and action. Choose among 2 characters and carve through hordes of abominations.

coveredGames.name: Grease Trap '99
coveredGames.title: I feel like I can say this with total authority: Grease Trap '99 is the best Gaelic-language Lovecraftian horror chip-shop simulator released in 2026. And it's not even close.

coveredGames.name: Worship
coveredGames.title: Perform rituals, amass followers, and prove your worth to an eldritch god in exchange for untold powers. As somebody with a life-long dream of being a cult leader, this ticks all my boxes.

coveredGames.name: Hot Wax
coveredGames.title: A bit like that other game with the falling blocks, except they're made of wax and their little wicks can be set alight with a well-placed flame. And just like that other game, it's VERY MOREISH.

coveredGames.name: Message From Aliens
coveredGames.title: I think my new favourite genre of game is "Visually Obtuse Translation Games" or VOTGs (gosh I hope that catches on), and Message From Aliens is a wonderful entry into the genre-franchise.

coveredGames.name: A Real Life Party
coveredGames.title: I went to a party once. Like ARLP, it was awkward and exposed my worst fears, but was far less novel, stylish and funny.

coveredGames.name: Judero
coveredGames.title: The kind of game AI could never dream of birthing. Judero is a fever dream of unbridled human craft and creativity.

coveredGames.name: DEPERSON
coveredGames.title: Ooof this is pleasing to me sense. The environments! The music! Those walk animations! Yes, DEPERSON has just shot pretty high up my most anticipated list.

coveredGames.name: MR. RECORDS
coveredGames.title: Mr Records is a very faithful adaptation of what happens in the viewport of my brain whenever I listen to music.

coveredGames.name: Legion Was Here
coveredGames.title: Legion Was Here is conceptually magnificent; clever, satisfying and phwoar what a looker.

coveredGames.name: Virtue and a Sledgehammer
coveredGames.title: I like to take a sledgehammer to things as a form of therapy sometimes, too.

coveredGames.name: Mr Magpie's Harmless Card Game
coveredGames.title: ♥♥♥♥ YOU JERRY.

coveredGames.name: Islands of Insight
coveredGames.title: a bit like having your grey matter massaged by angels

coveredGames.name: It Has My Face
coveredGames.title: If you're a fan of paranoia BOY do I have the game for you....

coveredGames.name: PAGER
coveredGames.title: PAGER combines a few things I find fascinating: surreal takes on corporate life (hello fellow Severance fans), 90's themes, and monochromatic art styles. What an immensely pleasing cocktail of things!

coveredGames.name: The Hollowing
coveredGames.title: Look, I love a flight sim as much as the next guy, but....it can be a bit dry can't it!? The Hollowing though? WELL. Plate me up a dish of those palpably ominous vibes.

coveredGames.name: DONUT PANIC
coveredGames.title: The very cosy, very safe cooking game was long overdue a really messed up re-imagining, and here we are! Cooking Mama this is not.

coveredGames.name: He Who Watches
coveredGames.title: Our pal Newton would bloody hate this; up is down and left is right, gravity is a pathetic joke, and our expectations of spatial logic and how to navigate the space are continually played with.

coveredGames.name: Soul Injector Commando
coveredGames.title: You, a gun, and the ability to inject some much needed soul into the billionaires of a bunker world. And as you do so, the world above starts to heal... It's almost like there's a message here!?

coveredGames.name: Burn With Me
coveredGames.title: As somebody who loves burning things as part of occult rituals this really did it for me. Keen for full game, will update this once it's out!

coveredGames.name: Pigeon: A Love Story
coveredGames.title: Wild how into birds you get as you get older. One day you're all about rollerblades & drinking & staying up until 4am & then BAM. You're all about chaffinches and pigeons. This game scratches an itch.

coveredGames.name: The Old Flesh of Nuraga
coveredGames.title: Treasure hunting for cursed objects with my grandpa was always a cherished hobby of mine growing up so this hits the spot.

coveredGames.name: BREAKOUT BABY
coveredGames.title: The (baby!?) formula is heart-warmingly familiar, but everything else makes me want to take a cold shower after playing. Glorious.

coveredGames.name: The Mermaid Mask
coveredGames.title: LOVE that this series simply refuses to adhere to any sensical naming convention. Unlike the game/it's puzzles, which are a logicians dream <3

coveredGames.name: Desktop Explorer
coveredGames.title: why are bloody uncles always leaving weird/creepy objects for family members to inherit!? fed up of it. (game's dope btw)

coveredGames.name: Helix: Descent N Ascent
coveredGames.title: Doppelgangers! Puzzles! Monochromatic aesthetics! I'm here for it all.

coveredGames.name: The Message from Deep Space
coveredGames.title: I like to think I'm smart and this game makes me feel like a stupid little dumdum and I love it

coveredGames.name: Oh, My Doug!
coveredGames.title: As a connoisseur of crude humour and innuendo, I must say this is doing it for me. Will be back to update this post release.

coveredGames.name: Fear the Spotlight
coveredGames.title: Fear the Spotlight combines three ingredients that should get horror fans all hot under the collar: a derelict school, a séance board, and a strict need for darkness.

coveredGames.name: Interdimensional Vending Machine
coveredGames.title: a lesson to us all: never consume products from vending machines that have no legitimate reason for existing in this reality.

coveredGames.name: Forest of Deceit
coveredGames.title: I played this game with seven of my closest childhood friends, who I've known for literally decades. We now all hate each other. 10/10 [will update this review post launch]

coveredGames.name: Trading Card Inspector
coveredGames.title: Having thoroughly inspected this game, cross referencing marketing materials and developer channels, I can confirm that yes: this is very legit.

coveredGames.name: Vapor Strange
coveredGames.title: I've no idea how much psilocybin has fuelled the development of Vapor Strange so far, but I'd wager it's a lot [will update this review post launch]

coveredGames.name: lily's world XD
coveredGames.title: can't get enough fake OS and fourth-wall-fluckery, and this is top of the anticipation list [will update this review post launch]

coveredGames.name: My Beautiful Faraway, Please Don't Be Cruel To Me
coveredGames.title: The phrase "immaculate vibes" seems relevant when talking about My Beautiful Faraway, Please Don't Be Cruel To Me (what a title) because it has them in spades. Keeping a close eye on this one...

coveredGames.name: NITRO GEN OMEGA
coveredGames.title: Have always wanted to write, direct and act in my own shonen mecha anime, so this seems on point. Good gracious what a striking looking game! Those battle/scene transitions! Phwoooee.

coveredGames.name: A Passing in the Night
coveredGames.title: look I'll be honest I don't really know much about this one (it's a bit walking-simmy?), but GOSH the vibes look on point. I'm in. Will update this review once the game has released.

coveredGames.name: Forbidden Solitaire
coveredGames.title: To be candid for a second: solitaire can be a bit dry, can't it? If there's one thing the classic card game absolutely needed, it was a side of 90s FMV-hellscape. Everybody always said it.

coveredGames.name: Funi Raccoon Game
coveredGames.title: Love garbage. Love raccoons. Love funi things. This ticks all the boxes, honestly.

coveredGames.name: Cursed Words: The Word Game That Isn't
coveredGames.title: Starts out all Scrabbalatro, which is cool enough as a hook, but the game quickly starts messing with its own rule-sets and gets deeper, weirder and more...cursed.

coveredGames.name: I Eat Paintings When Guards Aren't Looking
coveredGames.title: I never miss anything that features a bit of Bosch. If there's a game that references the work of the enigmatic Dutch painter, you can bet your Netherlandish butt I'll play it and rave about it.

coveredGames.name: ArcheAge Chronicles
coveredGames.title: Мир не сводится к боям: исследуешь руины, торгуешь, создаёшь вещи или охотишься. Сильные противники заставляют учиться, а ремёсла, подземелья и PvP дают причины возвращаться.

coveredGames.name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
coveredGames.title: the long awaited new Kingdom rush is here! An amazing and fun Tower Defense strategy with different path and upgrade to try out, cute animation, each mission bring new challenge..nostalgia done right!

coveredGames.name: Cafe Business Manager
coveredGames.title: Симулятор делает акцент именно на управлении: персонал нужно нанимать и мотивировать, меню и кредиты контролировать, а пространство кафе — проектировать. Развитие бизнеса идёт поэтапно...

coveredGames.name: Nerd Simulator
coveredGames.title: Работаешь ради одной понятной цели — накопить на переезд, но почти каждое задание норовит пойти не по плану. Такой хаос хорошо сочетается с юмористическим форматом игры.

coveredGames.name: Fearwoods
coveredGames.title: Вдвоём исследую проклятый лес, где свет и тишина становятся единственными средствами защиты. Приходится избегать демона и одновременно разбираться в истории Авалин — хороший фундамент для кооп-хоррора

coveredGames.name: Cannon Clicker
coveredGames.title: Развитие армии здесь строится не только на кликах: я расширяю дерево навыков, управляю тремя валютами и командую разными войсками. Цель понятная — разгромить вражескую базу и добиться превосходства.

coveredGames.name: AstroScaper
coveredGames.title: Каждое место для здания приходится продумывать, ведь от размещения зависит синергия. Система понятная и забавная, а награда за эффективность в виде новых вариантов строительства добавляет цели.

coveredGames.name: Angels Fall First
coveredGames.title: Разные сборки оружия позволяют по-разному подходить к боям. Мне понравилось сочетание космических сражений с масштабными наземными битвами — ощущается смесь классического и более современного подхода.

coveredGames.name: Workshop Simulator VR
coveredGames.title: Работа в мастерской строится вокруг восстановления предметов и использования специализированных инструментов. Мне понравилось ощущение процесса: постепенно разбираешься с задачами и развиваешь навыки.

coveredGames.name: The Pigment
coveredGames.title: Игра The Pigment не торопит, а постепенно погружает в свою тайну. Балансировать между любопытством происходящего и непонятным ужасом оказалось интереснее, чем я ожидал. Настоятельно рекомендую.

coveredGames.name: The Meridian
coveredGames.title: The Meridian увлекла сочетанием журналистского расследования и разветвлённого сюжета. Постоянно хотелось узнать, к чему приведёт следующий выбор и что изменится дальше. Рисовка просто супер, 9 из 10.

coveredGames.name: Life Below
coveredGames.title: Игра делает упор на экологические механики: размещаешь виды, балансируешь ресурсы и постепенно возвращаешь жизнь в глубины океана, наблюдая, как система становится живой и взаимосвязанной.

coveredGames.name: The King Got Too Much Gold
coveredGames.title: Уютная стратегия с элементами менеджмента и лёгким юмором. Интересно наблюдать, как решения влияют на королевство, а огромное богатство открывает новые возможности и проблемы.

coveredGames.name: Aarik And The Ruined Kingdom
coveredGames.title: Игра берёт не экшеном, а атмосферой и идеями. Каждая локация — это новая загадка, где нужно правильно использовать окружение и помочь маленькому герою пройти дальше.

coveredGames.name: Better Than Dead
coveredGames.title: Better Than Dead (ea), a truly immersive, fast-paced FPS with stylish bodycam presentation and enjoyable gunfight, a dark storytelling and settings, more levels and difficulty to come..play it now!

coveredGames.name: Secret Seeker
coveredGames.title: Необычный опыт для любителей внимательного прохождения. Здесь важны наблюдательность и любопытство: каждая находка открывает новую часть истории и заставляет искать ещё больше секретов.

coveredGames.name: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check
coveredGames.title: Игра отлично передаёт чувство работы на грани. Толпы выживших ждут помощи, но среди них могут скрываться заражённые. Приходится постоянно выбирать между риском и состраданием. Выбор имеет значение!

coveredGames.name: Black Box - Hacker Day One
coveredGames.title: С первых минут погружаешься в роль хакера: взлом систем, поиск данных и цепочка заданий создают ощущение настоящего цифрового расследования с ростом сложности и вовлечённости.

coveredGames.name: Cobalt Miner
coveredGames.title: Копать глубже оказалось интереснее, чем ожидал. Постоянно находишь новые ресурсы, улучшаешь оборудование и открываешь доступ к ещё более богатым залежам. Прогресс ощущается отлично.

coveredGames.name: Trees Inc
coveredGames.title: Trees Inc — это про управление лесной индустрией: сажайте леса, добывайте ресурсы, улучшайте технику и расширяйте производство. Простая, но затягивающая экономическая стратегия.

coveredGames.name: Humans Vs Orcs
coveredGames.title: Любителям стратегий понравятся войны людей и орков с упором на управление армией и тактику. Улучшайте войска, защищайте позиции и участвуйте в зрелищных битвах.

coveredGames.name: SWAT Commander
coveredGames.title: A phenomenal SWAT game that mix intense action, strong teamplay mecanism and tactical decision: manage your squad strategy, realist and various missions to overcome..for veterans and newcomers!

coveredGames.name: The Crazy Hyper-Dungeon Chronicles
coveredGames.title: Crazy Hyper-Dungeon Chronicles send us back to the golden 16 bits RPG area: neat battle, puzzle and minigames, funny storyline and characters..low entry price and ton of fun and replay value.

coveredGames.name: Laundering Simulator - Clean Cash and Laundry
coveredGames.title: A good and funny first person job simulator game about managing the two side of a laundering business! From Laundromat, impatient clients, counterfeit product..and a demanding grandmother! recommend.

coveredGames.name: Alaska Gold Fever
coveredGames.title: Спокойный, но продуманный симулятор: копайте, сортируйте ресурсы и улучшайте производство. Постепенное развитие и внимание к деталям создают приятный игровой ритм. Захватывающий геймплей и атмосфера.

coveredGames.name: Slot or Not
coveredGames.title: A creative slot-style battling roguelike game with adorable characters! enjoyable turn-based gameplay with various enemies and bosses, items and inventory/upgrade, ton of suprise and fun! recommended.

coveredGames.name: Peregrino
coveredGames.title: Игроку необходимо внимательно следить за ресурсами, планировать дальнейший путь и готовиться к столкновениям с опасностями, скрывающимися в темных уголках этого мира. Ошибки могут иметь последствия.

coveredGames.name: Don't FOOL ME, Beauties!
coveredGames.title: A heartwarming interactive game made with love! "Don't FOOL ME" is a good game with well written plot, different situation and choice to make, attractive characters with their own style..play it.

coveredGames.name: Blossom Tales: The Sleeping King
coveredGames.title: Blossom Tales: The Sleeping King милая и хорошая игра в стиле фентазийных приключений с добавление РПГ составляющей. Любители олдскула увидят сходство со старыми игрушками тех времен. Отличная игра!

coveredGames.name: Otherskin
coveredGames.title: A superb scifi third person shooter with metroidvania mecanism, collect ressource and upgrade with alien technology, exploration and plateforming.. "Otherskin" is a new classic for the genre. 10/10

coveredGames.name: CONERU -DIMENSION GIRL-
coveredGames.title: Игра сочетает в себе множество качеств, которые делают её по-настоящему особенной: динамичный геймплей, способный удерживать внимание с первых минут; визуальный стиль, который радует глаз.

coveredGames.name: Vietnam War
coveredGames.title: Планируйте свои операции, разрабатывайте тактики и распределяйте роли в отряде. Управляйте солдатами в напряжённых стычках, ведите скрытные патрули по густым джунглям, устанавливайте засады или атакуй

coveredGames.name: Ascent of Ashes
coveredGames.title: After a bumpy development, Ascent of Ashes is finally out in ea! A great strategy survival game with base management, compelling combat system, develop tech tree and recruit new survivors, raid..++

coveredGames.name: Ports Of Call Deluxe 3D 2024
coveredGames.title: Проект оставляет приятное послевкусие и располагает к многократному прохождению: благодаря гибкой системе торговли, каждый новый старт может развиваться по-своему. Игра отлично подойдёт для ценителей.

coveredGames.name: Photo Studio Simulator
coveredGames.title: Хотите воплотить мечту о собственной фотостудии? В этой игре вы сможете построить её с нуля, развивая бизнес шаг за шагом и превращая его в популярное место для творческих проектов. Советую.

coveredGames.name: Out of Sight
coveredGames.title: First game by Mainframe Games studio "Out of Sight" is a nice stealth-centered action game..well-crafted rooms design that offer diverse challenge and solution, different enemy types and tactics..top!

coveredGames.name: Bank Simulator
coveredGames.title: Игровой процесс радует разнообразием продуманных механик: от найма сотрудников и работы с клиентами до выдачи кредитов, управления рисками и принятия инвестиционных решений. Великолепный симулятор.

coveredGames.name: Eclipse - 2nd Dawn for the Galaxy
coveredGames.title: Политические интриги, межзвёздные сражения и напряжённые кризисы, где каждая фракция ведёт свою игру, скрытую от чужих глаз, эта игра в которой все это имеется с избытком. Настоятельно рекомендую.

coveredGames.title: real-time TD strategy game with balanced gameplay, plenty of enemies, miniboss and good boss fight, diverse abilities, upgrade path..perfect defense game for new comers or veterans of this series.
