coveredGames.title: Управление кафе здесь не ограничивается меню: важны найм и мотивация персонала, кредиты и планировка пространства. Основная особенность — постепенное развитие дает понять структуру управления кафе.

coveredGames.name: Angels Fall First
coveredGames.title: Смешение наземных и космических боёв стало для меня главной особенностью. Механики показались интересными, хотя графика местами выглядит устаревшей. Несмотря на это, игру считаю достойной внимания.

coveredGames.name: The Pigment
coveredGames.title: Очень понравилось, как постепенно нагнетается атмосфера. Чем ближе подбирался к разгадке двенадцатого полотна, тем сильнее хотелось узнать всю историю целиком. The Pigment получилась интригующей.

coveredGames.name: The Meridian
coveredGames.title: Проходить историю интересно именно из-за высокой реиграбельности. Меняешь решения, развиваешь другие характеристики и получаешь новые сцены, диалоги и финалы. Отличный сюжет и его завязка.

coveredGames.name: Life Below
coveredGames.title: Life Below предлагает необычный подводный градострой: формируешь коралловые рифы и восстанавливаешь разрушенные экосистемы. Понравилось ощущение живого океана, чувствуешь ответственность за мир.

coveredGames.name: Human Host
coveredGames.title: Human Host — это напряжённый хоррор-сурвайвл. Выживание строится на подозрительности, поиске заражённых и умении не доверять никому в постоянно растущем чувстве паранойи, поиске и строительстве.

coveredGames.name: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check
coveredGames.title: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check очень затягивает, цикл из проверки, сканирования и принятия решений. Каждая смена ощущается по-разному, а атмосфера постапокалипсиса делает происходящее ещё напряжённее

coveredGames.name: The Crazy Hyper-Dungeon Chronicles
coveredGames.title: A crazy good love letter to the 2d Dungeon crawling genre! Lovely pixelated graphics, enjoyable timed/turn-based battle, exploration and increasing challenge, great humor and reference..good game ^^

coveredGames.name: Peregrino
coveredGames.title: История сосредоточена на группе паломников, решивших пройти через территорию, наполненную древними тайнами, чудовищами и моральными испытаниями, которые ставят под сомнение их силу духа и убеждения.

coveredGames.name: Milling machine simulator
coveredGames.title: A great milling simulator to train yourself to become a machinist, tweak all the parameters, learn to work each tools, blueprints, metals.. a great virtual companion for all makers and enthusiast~

coveredGames.name: Monster Boy and the Cursed Kingdom
coveredGames.title: Метроидвания с удивительным игровым миром, впечатляющая своей красочностью, большим разнообразием локакций, оригинальными персонажами, шикарной музыкой и сбалансированным увлекательным геймплеем.

coveredGames.name: Otherskin
coveredGames.title: 3D metroidvania TPS game with a good narrative, a badass fighter Alex will explore a corrupted plant, unlock skills, combo and new power on the way, exploration and puzzle solving.. Great game here.

coveredGames.name: Vietnam War
coveredGames.title: Здесь вы возьмёте на себя управление солдатами, которым предстоит проходить через густые джунгли, пересекать опасные реки и вести ожесточённые бои на территориях, где все может быть укрытием для врага

coveredGames.name: Car Dealer Simulator
coveredGames.title: An easy choice and fun job sim for all fan of cars: repair and improve old vehicules, unlock new tier to improve your set of possibility, reputation..rewarding and fun gameplay loop, a good simulator.

coveredGames.name: Ports Of Call Deluxe 3D 2024
coveredGames.title: Вас ждёт проработанный мир, в котором каждая сделка и каждая поставка имеет значение, а логистика и экономические решения становятся испытаниями. Управляйте грузами и налаживайте пути поставок.

coveredGames.name: Ascent of Ashes
coveredGames.title: Игровой процесс здесь не прощает ошибок: продуманные боевые механики требуют внимания к деталям, а искусственный интеллект врагов действует умно и непредсказуемо — каждый бой превращается в испытание.

coveredGames.name: Photo Studio Simulator
coveredGames.title: Photo Studio Simulator: start a small business (photos selfies), purchase equipment, daily tasks to develop your studio, interact with people and find model shooting or private session..good game here

coveredGames.name: CONERU -DIMENSION GIRL-
coveredGames.title: CONERU -DIMENSION GIRL- is a fun and classic anime 2d action plateformer with smooth gameplay to smash enemies, collect items, unlock new abilities..lovely japanese soundtrack and design, nice game!

coveredGames.name: Out of Sight
coveredGames.title: After 5 years of development "Out of sight" is finally out! A good stealh indie game about avoiding alien patrol, climb to escape, push different objects..A fine plot with humors, great soundtrack too

coveredGames.name: Bank Simulator
coveredGames.title: Это уютный экономический симулятор, в котором финансы представлены не как хаос цифр, а как спокойная, почти терапевтическая деятельность. В нём нет излишней суеты — лишь вы, задачи и ритм.

coveredGames.name: Eclipse - 2nd Dawn for the Galaxy
coveredGames.title: То, что казалось окончанием эры конфликтов, оказалось лишь временным затишьем перед новой бурей. Под маской стабильности зреет хаос — напряжённость стремительно нарастает. Отличная космо стратегия.

coveredGames.name: ArcheAge Chronicles
coveredGames.title: Сражения требуют экипировки, точных уклонений и парирований. Когда ловишь ритм боя, прогресс радует особенно сильно. Ремесло, подземелья и PvP постоянно подкидывают новые цели.

coveredGames.name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
coveredGames.title: Addictive gameplay with new mecanism, towers upgrade, magic spells, heroes and interesting challenge to overcome..pretty graphism and animation, good humor too..this game is a blast for all TD-fans!

coveredGames.name: CELESTAY Craft & Slowlife
coveredGames.title: CELESTAY Craft&Slowlife подойдёт для спокойных игровых сессий: можно постепенно расширять жилище и исследовать доступное пространство вокруг. Неспешный темп позволяет играть без лишней суеты.

coveredGames.name: Cafe Business Manager
coveredGames.title: В кафе приходится совмещать работу с персоналом, планировку пространства, кредиты и меню. Такой набор управленческих задач делает развитие от маленького стартапа до крупной кофейной империи интересным

coveredGames.name: Angels Fall First
coveredGames.title: В бою понравилось сочетание тактики и большого выбора оружия с техникой. Возможность подниматься на космический корабль и участвовать в сражениях добавляет интереса. Давно не видел таких игр.

coveredGames.name: The Pigment
coveredGames.title: В The Pigment больше всего понравилось ощущение неизвестности. Каждое новое открытие только сильнее разжигало желание добраться до разгадки двенадцатого полотна. Хорошо закрученный сюжет.

coveredGames.name: The Meridian
coveredGames.title: С первых минут втянулся в жизнь редакции. Расследования, сюжетная линия, отношения с коллегами и множество развилок делают каждое прохождение непохожим на предыдущее. Любителям интриг и расследований.

coveredGames.name: Life Below
coveredGames.title: Каждый шаг требует продуманного подхода к строительству рифа. Следишь за балансом экосистемы и видишь, как возвращается морская жизнь — это даёт ощущение, что каждое решение реально влияет на океан.

coveredGames.name: Human Host
coveredGames.title: В Human Host зацепила разрушаемость мира и свобода выживания: копаешь, строишь мобильные базы и крепости с ловушками. Процедурный мир держит в напряжении — каждый заход ощущается по-новому.

coveredGames.name: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check
coveredGames.title: Здесь нет ощущения всемогущества. Ты всего лишь последний фильтр перед безопасной зоной, и каждое неверное решение может привести к катастрофе внутри периметра. Главное тут быть внимательным.

coveredGames.name: Project: Mist
coveredGames.title: Напряжённый survival-хоррор в мире, скрытом туманом: исследуйте заброшенные места, собирайте ресурсы и спасайтесь от неизвестных существ. Атмосфера тревоги и выживание держат в напряжении постоянно.

coveredGames.name: Workshop Simulator VR
coveredGames.title: Симулятор мастерской с полной интерактивностью: ремонтируйте предметы, используйте инструменты и восстанавливайте старые вещи. Реалистичные действия и атмосфера делают процесс расслабляющим. Советую.

coveredGames.name: The Crazy Hyper-Dungeon Chronicles
coveredGames.title: The Crazy Hyper-Dungeon Chronicles is a great indie game: the levels offer various challenge, explore each rooms for secrets, puzzle element, timing-type combat, traps..2D RPG game done right~

coveredGames.name: Blossom Tales: The Sleeping King
coveredGames.title: Blossom Tales: The Sleeping King игра в классическом экшен-приключенческом стиле с пиксельной олдскульной графикой. На самом деле игра интересна как по контенту так и по геймплейной части. Оценка 9.

coveredGames.name: Otherskin
coveredGames.title: A stunning world to explore with your AI-suit companion, fun gunplay and progression system (upgrade, unlock new biological skills) "Otherskin" is a just an excellent indie game. New demo available

coveredGames.name: Vietnam War
coveredGames.title: Это не просто игра, а попытка передать всю напряжённость и хаос боевых действий, где стратегия, внимательность и умение адаптироваться становятся ключом к выживанию. Каждый новый заход принесёт опыт.

coveredGames.name: Car Dealer Simulator
coveredGames.title: Manage a small car business by bying old car, fix and restore, sell with a great profit! Plenty of speciality: mechanical and paint workshop, car wash, sale and negociate with clients..A fun game~!

coveredGames.name: Ports Of Call Deluxe 3D 2024
coveredGames.title: Этот проект сохранил дух и атмосферу старых портовых симуляторов, но при этом добавил современный уровень детализации и удобства управления, что привнесло свежую жизнь в знакомую формулу.

coveredGames.name: Ascent of Ashes
coveredGames.title: В этой игре, действие которой разворачивается в мрачном постапокалиптическом мире, вы начинаете с нуля: строите собственную укреплённую базу, приручаете опасных, но полезных животных и т.д. Советую.

coveredGames.name: CONERU -DIMENSION GIRL-
coveredGames.title: A welcome and vibrant 2d action plateformer! "CONERU -DIMENSION GIRL-" is a just a fun game: collect foods, upgrade, leveling system and combo to take down enemeies, lighthearted dating element..sweet

coveredGames.name: Photo Studio Simulator
coveredGames.title: A creative photography store management game, start from scratch and build an empire! Plenty of activities, manage supplies and budget, build and customise luxious studios.. (workshop on the way)

coveredGames.name: Out of Sight
coveredGames.title: Think and act fast! Out of Sight is a fun stealh puzzler game: Sneak around, slide, use tools and traps, each rooms bring different choice and strategy..cute graphism and animation, good time here.

coveredGames.name: Bank Simulator
coveredGames.title: Здесь вы не просто наблюдатель — вы управляете каждым аспектом работы: от найма сотрудников и обслуживания клиентов до принятия решений по кредитам и инвестициям. Увлекательный симулятор финансиста.

coveredGames.name: Eclipse - 2nd Dawn for the Galaxy
coveredGames.title: Это игра, в которой мышление — ваш главный инструмент, а звезды — поле для реализации амбиций. Постройте империю, которая не просто выживет в галактической борьбе, а станет легендой среди миров.

coveredGames.name: Pathfinder: Kingmaker — Enhanced Plus Edition
coveredGames.title: Sprawling stolen lands exploration, intricate kingdom management decrees, classic tabletop party mechanics, and rich companion quests.

coveredGames.name: RetroArch
coveredGames.title: Universal retro gaming emulation hub, extensive shader custom filters, smooth netplay options, and classic game support.

coveredGames.name: FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves
coveredGames.title: Stylish fighting mechanics, vibrant comic visual aesthetic, dynamic stance shifts, and smooth competitive netcode.

coveredGames.name: Mycelarium
coveredGames.title: Relaxing underground mushroom cultivation, node expansion mechanics, peaceful ambient soundscapes, and cozy discovery.

coveredGames.name: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader

coveredGames.name: Gothic 1 Remake

coveredGames.name: Titan Quest II

coveredGames.name: Wing Commander™ Prophecy: 30th Anniversary Edition

coveredGames.name: Colony Survival

coveredGames.name: Saloon Simulator

coveredGames.name: Satisfactory

coveredGames.name: Portal 2
coveredGames.title: Brilliant physics puzzle design, hilarious voice acting, creative momentum mechanics, and exceptional co-op testing.

coveredGames.name: Grounded

coveredGames.name: Songs of Conquest

coveredGames.name: REMNANT II®
coveredGames.title: Creative procedural worlds, challenging boss mechanics, vast archetype builds, secret loot puzzles, and tight gunplay.

coveredGames.name: Stardew Valley

coveredGames.name: Hollow Knight

coveredGames.name: Dead Cells
coveredGames.title: Fast rogue-lite action, smooth dodge rolling, huge weapon variety, and satisfying fast paced combat flow.

coveredGames.name: Subnautica: Below Zero

coveredGames.name: Valor Mortis
coveredGames.title: Dark Souls meets the Napoleonic Wars in this twisted alternate history. A robust, if linear, experience that marks its place fairly high in the soulslike genre.

coveredGames.name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE
coveredGames.title: A masterclass in job-based, turn-based combat and a story that, while often lackluster on its own, provides an incredible amount of depth for long-running fans of the franchise.

coveredGames.name: HYPER DEMON
coveredGames.title: Beneath an unbelievably hostile appearance lies one of the most flawlessly crafted shooters to date. HYPER DEMON takes perseverance to learn, but those who rise to the challenge are rewarded in kind.

coveredGames.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
coveredGames.title: Castlevania may no longer be the trailblazer it once was, but who said you have to be wildly different to be a very good time?

coveredGames.name: Metro Exodus
coveredGames.title: An intriguing evolution of the Metro formula with excellent gameplay and a well-paced story, undermined by discouraging technical issues.

coveredGames.name: Beyond These Stars
coveredGames.title: A unique citybuilder, Beyond These Stars forces players to consider the consequences of their building as they voyage through the stars.

coveredGames.name: Echo Weaver
coveredGames.title: Echo Weaver's time loop may not offer the strongest puzzles, but it makes for an incredibly unique and addictive metroidvania.

coveredGames.name: Fogpiercer
coveredGames.title: When you've seen as many deckbuilders as I have, they all start to bleed together a bit. Not Fogpiercer, with its many, many ways that make it excellent.

coveredGames.name: Thousand Hells: The Underworld Heists
coveredGames.title: A lush and well-written game, there are nevertheless frustrations amidst these many hells.

coveredGames.name: SiN Reloaded
coveredGames.title: A cult classic remastered, warts and all.

coveredGames.name: Birth
coveredGames.title: A sweet and cosy game with just the right level of puzzling, paired with an excellent art style and wonderful music

coveredGames.name: CONSCRIPT: Director’s Cut
coveredGames.title: A survival horror game set during the First World War where the only monster is mankind's own aptitude for brutality. A brilliant showcase of the cruelty of war and the horrors it creates.

coveredGames.name: False Hero
coveredGames.title: Many a soulslike peddles their own brand of innovative combat and captivating lore, but few have quite a love for the little embellishments and magnificent flourishes.

coveredGames.name: BRAZILIAN DRUG DEALER BEFORE 4: DEMONS FROM THE PORTAL TO HELL I OPENED ARE STILL IN THE FAVELA AND NOW I HAVE TO SAVE MAMADAS FROM RONALDO
coveredGames.title: Growing out of the sheer shock value of its predecessor, Brazilian Drug Dealer Before 4 is a satisfying psychedelic romp that’s difficult to resist, despite its shortcomings.

coveredGames.name: Gothic 1 Remake
coveredGames.title: Yer granpappy's RPG, rebuilt for modern sensibilities, artfully walking the line between the expectations of the modern crowd and the timelessness of strong and unique game design.

coveredGames.name: Kernel Hearts
coveredGames.title: Fantastically fresh, Kernel Hearts combines many tried-and-true features of previously acclaimed roguelikes with strong bullet-hell elements, creating a great but sometimes slightly unfocused title.

coveredGames.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
coveredGames.title: It's a bit long, it's a bit uneven, but the latest Onimusha's defensive swordplay is some of the finest ever made.

coveredGames.name: Best Served Cold
coveredGames.title: While the story itself may move more slowly than I'd like, the story is arguably not the point. The point is the characters and the stories they tell.

coveredGames.name: Cellar Keeper
coveredGames.title: There are 2448 bottles of wine to sort.

coveredGames.name: DREDGE
coveredGames.title: A fun and seemingly-cozy fishing game with a dark underside.

coveredGames.name: Mortal Shell II
coveredGames.title: A considerably better look for Mortal Shell, but one far too bold for its own good.

coveredGames.name: The Outer Worlds 2
coveredGames.title: The writing is by far the best element of Outer Worlds 2, with a wry irreverent style making the game a delight. However, the story as a whole falls flat.

coveredGames.name: PLATONICA SPACE
coveredGames.title: Short and janky, but with a setting and identity to make up for it. PLATONICA SPACE is a fantastic experimental title, if you are willing to chew through a relatively slow and confusing introduction.

coveredGames.name: Rita
coveredGames.title: A delightful little word, Rita is a wonderful way to spend a few hours.

coveredGames.name: 007 First Light
coveredGames.title: IO Interactive’s latest is as good a blockbuster as they come, but rings a bit hollow with where the genre and the developer’s work stand today.

coveredGames.name: Rubinite
coveredGames.title: Rubinite is proof that the only thing you need to make a simple game great is a team of very clever people.

coveredGames.name: METRO Last Light Redux
coveredGames.title: A decent follow-up to the first game, with a handful of persistent problems.

coveredGames.name: Forsaken Realms: Vahrin's Call
coveredGames.title: Imperfect, slightly cheesy and clunky though it might be, Forsaken Realms: Vahrin’s Call is ultimately a competent and rather unique adventure game with RPG elements that stands out from the crowd.

coveredGames.name: Dinoblade
coveredGames.title: There are much, much better soulslikes out there than Dinoblade, but I'd wager few have quite so many cool dinosaurs with cool swords engaging in cool sword/dinosaur-related activities.

coveredGames.name: En Garde!
coveredGames.title: En Garde! features likable characters, a light-hearted, stylistic premise and setting, and gameplay that becomes increasingly frustrating and tedious.

coveredGames.name: Echoes of Aincrad
coveredGames.title: A rough gem of an action RPG that excels at fantastic combat, immersive world design, and progression mechanics, but fails at framing them within interesting boss encounters.

coveredGames.name: RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business
coveredGames.title: A solid standalone expansion that delivers more of the same gameplay that made Rogue City great in a compact format. It’s a little buggier and more unpolished compared to it, but fun nonetheless.

coveredGames.name: HUNTDOWN: OVERTIME
coveredGames.title: A roguelike action game that ain't got time to bleed, even if its early access still has a little ways to go.

coveredGames.name: Survival Machine
coveredGames.title: While held back by a number of questionable design choices, Survival Machine's solid base building and tower defense make for a zombie apocalypse worth experiencing.

coveredGames.name: Into The Depths
coveredGames.title: With a steep initial learning curve and hazy graphics, Into the Depths might be difficult to get into, yet for those who take the plunge, there are deeply rewarding mechanics waiting to be explored.

coveredGames.name: Solo Leveling: ARISE OVERDRIVE
coveredGames.title: SLAO is a solid, well-designed and enjoyable hack and slash RPG that will satisfy both Solo Leveling fans and otherwise. The few issues it has are largely overcome by its qualities.

coveredGames.name: STAR WARS™ Knights of the Old Republic™ II - The Sith Lords™
coveredGames.title: If you can get past its rather obtuse gameplay loop, running on a engine that was outdated even by 2005 standards, you'll find a surprisingly deep, story driven RPG here that still holds up.

coveredGames.name: Don't Let It Starve
coveredGames.title: There is enough of a mystery to make each run feel meaningful, while also providing enough variety for each run to be distinct. It is a fantastic little game.

coveredGames.name: 1997 RELOADED
coveredGames.title: When I look at 1997 Reloaded, its individual elements are all fine. When they’re brought together, though, something incredible happens.

coveredGames.name: DYSPLACED
coveredGames.title: Dysplaced is a cozy, multiverse-hopping, light survival/RPG/crafting game with a solid amount of content for an Early Access release, and a good upgrade on its predecessor, Dysmantle.

coveredGames.name: Oboro no Ichi
coveredGames.title: Create a market for lost spirits in this Japanese-Inspired cozy management game. Welcome wandering spirits by expanding and decorating your market to meet their needs in Oboro no Ichi. 🎬 Gameplay

coveredGames.name: Dressmaker
coveredGames.title: A cute dressmaking game, where you get to design, cut, sew, and sell beautiful garments to ladies of all social standing! There's a fun plot going on here too, but the dressmaking is the main event

coveredGames.name: Puppergeist
coveredGames.title: Play as a witch who heads into the Doggie Underworld in search of her missing puppy! Help the adorable Puppergeists find peace by solving their problems through playful rhythm-based challenges!

coveredGames.name: The Mermaid Mask
coveredGames.title: The captain of the world's strangest submarine has been murdered. But in a classic locked room mystery, there’s no suspects, no murder weapon, and no way anyone could have gotten inside. Or is there?

coveredGames.name: Moss: The Forgotten Relic
coveredGames.title: Play as the Reader, who can manipulate the world around our small and courageous hero-mouse, Quill. Guide, protect, and save Quill as she jumps, puzzles, and battles her way through this mystical land

coveredGames.name: KAMI 2
coveredGames.title: With 100 hand-crafted puzzles, KAMI 2 challenges you to think outside the box in your mission to flood each puzzle with a single colour in as few moves as possible.

coveredGames.name: Cozy Grove: Camp Spirit
coveredGames.title: In this sequel to Cozy Grove, you'll find new spirit bears to meet, new pets to raise, new spooky mysteries to solve, and even multiplayer mode that lets you share gifts with other Spirit Scouts.

coveredGames.name: Neko Station
coveredGames.title: Play as a cat train driver, transporting your feline customers from station to station. Make sure all their preferences are met to attract rare cats, who you can pet, feed and take photos of.

coveredGames.name: Mothkeep
coveredGames.title: Explore a peaceful nature sanctuary and document the lives of moths in your journal as they grow from tiny eggs to fully-fledged adults, all of which are based on real life information!

coveredGames.name: Mythmatch
coveredGames.title: In Mythmatch you play as Artemis who’s trying to rebuild the town of Ithaca in the mortal realm. Work alongside the mortals who collect resources to craft new items, upgrade buildings, and trade.

coveredGames.name: Deer & Boy
coveredGames.title: A moving story about a deer and boy who become unlikely friends and must work together to navigate a dangerous world... The deer is so cute and I love the use of sound > dialogue 🎬 Gameplay Video

coveredGames.name: Fourleaf Fields
coveredGames.title: Everything is bigger than you in this tiny farming sim, including your crops and critters! Explore a giant world, grow your enormous carrots, and get to know the charming villagers. 🎬Gameplay Video

coveredGames.name: Cat Mail Co.
coveredGames.title: Play as a cat postal worker, tidying up your new post office and bringing it back from the brink of collapse one parcel at a time! 🎬 Gameplay Video

coveredGames.name: Fields of Aaru
coveredGames.title: Start your new life in the mystical afterlife of Ancient Egypt in the new cozy lief sim. Farm along the Nile, befriend the locals, and decorate your eternal home.

coveredGames.name: Trackastrophe!
coveredGames.title: Trackastrophe is a puzzle game akin to Railbound where you lay tracks to help your little locomotive cross the level. There are over 100 levels to play through and you can customise your train!

coveredGames.name: Map Map - A Game About Maps
coveredGames.title: Start with a blank coastline and map out uncharted islands in search of treasure: measure distances, plot key landmarks, and create easy to read maps to lead your crew to the hidden treasure!

coveredGames.name: Walk The Frog
coveredGames.title: Walk the Frog tells a heartwarming adventure about a frog trying to find his best friend, but it’s all played across sticky notes. Easily drag and drop each piece around the board to unlock new paths!

coveredGames.name: Caravan Village: Farming Life
coveredGames.title: After being tricked by a scam, you decide to make the best of a bad situation and turn the rundown caravan park you were misled into purchasing into a luxury holiday park!

coveredGames.name: Thrifty Business
coveredGames.title: This is a laid-back management sim about running your very own 90’s-inspired thrift shop! Search through boxes filled with pre-loved gems and use them to create gorgeous displays.

coveredGames.name: Feline Forensics and the Meowseum Mystery
coveredGames.title: This game is about a cat detective, who’s been tasked with unraveling a murder that spirals into a museum heist! A priceless gemstone has disappeared and a guest has died but who is the perpetrator?

coveredGames.name: Greenhearth Necromancer
coveredGames.title: In this magical idle game, you need to take care of your late grandmother’s garden. But you aren’t a very talented gardener and must rely on necromancy to bring plants back to life...

coveredGames.name: Farm to Table
coveredGames.title: Run a farm to table restaurant in this farming/cooking game mashup! Grow fresh ingredients from scratch in your garden, before turning them into delicious meals to sell in your restaurant.

coveredGames.name: Duck Side of the Moon
coveredGames.title: Play as a duck, who has just crash-landed on a mysterious planet and is now on a quest to repair their spaceship and find their home! Explore the galaxy, gather resources, and maybe meet some aliens!

coveredGames.name: Mixtape
coveredGames.title: This next game reminds me a lot of the Life is Strange games! Follow three friends on their way to one final party together, revisiting pivotal moments from their past along the way!

coveredGames.name: Wax Heads
coveredGames.title: This shop sim puts a unique spin on others in the genre! Instead of running a supermarket or similar, you’re running a struggling independent record store!

coveredGames.name: Farming Camp
coveredGames.title: Compete against other farmers to prove you're the best farmer around! Farm, fish, cook, and raise animals to earn points, while trying to get along with the other campers... 🎬Gameplay

coveredGames.name: Flock Around
coveredGames.title: Team up with your friends to explore a nature sanctuary and go bird-hunting in this co-op photography game. Explore the park together, snapping pictures of the birds you find to complete the guidebook

coveredGames.name: Moomintroll: Winter's Warmth
coveredGames.title: When Moomintroll unexpectedly wakes up early from his winter hibernation, he finds himself alone in a world he barely recognises. Explore the wintery Moominvalley, meeting new friends and helping them

coveredGames.name: Cleaning Up!
coveredGames.title: Play as a gig worker in this chaotic cleaning game! Take on a variety of jobs around the city from an apartment FULL of hoarded items, to a coffee shop, ancient temple, or a haunted mansion…

coveredGames.name: High Above
coveredGames.title: High Above is a cozy rooftop-building game about designing the perfect rooftop retreat. At launch you’ll be able to build in four distinct locations: Mediterranean, Japanese, Modern, and Cyberpunk.

coveredGames.name: My Sleeping Girlfriend

coveredGames.name: Clown Is Hungry

coveredGames.name: Overcome Your Fears - Caretaker

coveredGames.name: The Roach Hotel

coveredGames.name: Skinfreak
coveredGames.title: OH HELL YEAH!!! Black Eyed Priest and Puppet Combo are back with another awesome Halloween gift!! Just getting into it and MAN.. this one is much longer with RE like puzzles! Awesome atmosphere!!!

coveredGames.name: CloverPit
coveredGames.title: OH HELL YEAH!!! Ever wanted to experience what its like to experience debilitating gambling addiction?! Well you can!! AND ITS FUN!!! Dont roll a 666. dont roll a 666... dont roll a 666... NOOOO

coveredGames.name: BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH
coveredGames.title: OH HELL YEAH!!! A GREAT Japanese Horror. Well done and unique! It really focuson that body horror at points and all around feels like a short horror movie. Well done!!! Keeping an eye on the dev!

coveredGames.title: Race against the competition in an arcade street championship where the road is fueled with chaos & carnage. Takedown racers in heavy traffic scenarios without crashing yourself across 97 events.

coveredGames.name: Brush Burial: Bruiseland
coveredGames.title: Hunt down your targets in a melee focused stealth immersive sim across the quarry. Steal, profit, kill or chat about the merchants for a hot bowl of chili, plan your routes & snap some necks.

coveredGames.name: Magnavale: Eternal Soul
coveredGames.title: The demons of hell have been unleashed on Castle Lexington as you feast off the souls of your enemies for power. Bend death around your fingertips as you explore deep in this throwback metroidvania.

coveredGames.name: Muri: Wildwoods
coveredGames.title: Explore mysterious ruins, clean away corruption, befriend cute critters, collect sketches, and save the Wildwood’s forest spirit in this cozy cleaning-sim adventure!

coveredGames.name: Toto's Journey
coveredGames.title: Aa cozy adventure inspired by the world of The Wizard of Oz. Play as Toto, a brave dog lost in a magical world after a mysterious cyclone. Explore enchanted lands and meet unusual creatures!

coveredGames.name: Piozila: Escape From Planet Earth
coveredGames.title: Escape rooms with a chameleon! Push and pull furniture with your tongue, manage your energy meter, and escape being flushed down the toilet by your evil human masters.

coveredGames.name: Tama In-Between
coveredGames.title: A 2D puzzle-platformer where slime cat Tama absorbs, splits, and possesses to overcome unique challenges and stage gimmicks.

coveredGames.name: Junebug
coveredGames.title: A cat companion and cozy building game. Create charming little spaces, then experience what you’ve built through the eyes of your cat. Explore, play, relax, survive.

coveredGames.name: DeadRoot
coveredGames.title: You're a small snail. Your foes are bigger, meaner, and out for blood. Flies swarm, rats stalk, and worse things wait deeper down. Delve into a 3D metroidvania world and face colossal bosses.

coveredGames.name: Froggin' Around
coveredGames.title: A two-player co-op game where you play as two mischievous frogs on a magical quest! Use your stretchy, bouncy tongues to swing, grab objects, and help each other hop through puzzles.

coveredGames.name: ATHOLITE
coveredGames.title: A multiplayer adventure built around the freedom of movement, exhilarating creature racing and quiet moments of exploration. Wander through open regions and race as mythical creatures.

coveredGames.name: Maneater 2
coveredGames.title: The splash-hit ShaRkPG returns! Eat, explore, and evolve as you try to escape an invite-only preview event for Neptune’s Kingdom, an ultra-luxury seaside theme park destined for disaster.

coveredGames.name: Rolic
coveredGames.title: A relaxing 3D puzzle-platformer set in a magically mischievous open world. Scoot, scramble, and glide through twisted lands and track down treasure in an enchanted forest.

coveredGames.name: STONEFEATHER
coveredGames.title: An atmospheric adventure where you fly as a stone-born bird across silent ruins. Ride updrafts, build momentum, and restore the wind on a mystical journey through a world that has fallen into silence.

coveredGames.name: Tyto
coveredGames.title: Take flight and glide through a breathtaking world in Tyto, a gliding-based metroidvania, where you play as a lost owlet searching for its family in a vast and perilous world.

coveredGames.name: Rat Game
coveredGames.title: An asymmetrical horror comedy for up to eight players. Play as either a pack of rats trying to sabotage a restaurant, or the chef determined to stop them.

coveredGames.name: Littermates
coveredGames.title: Grab your mates, steal some litter, and help the denizens of Raccoon-opolis as the newest member of The Duke's crew. A physics-driven co-op heist simulator for up to eight raccoons!

coveredGames.name: Cat Mail Co.
coveredGames.title: Run a cozy cat post office. Sort and deliver parcels from the daily boat, organizing everything your way. At night, the moon reveals hidden truths about packages.

coveredGames.name: Empires of the Undergrowth
coveredGames.title: Lead ant colonies against the fearsome threats of the insect world while building intricate nests, developing pheromone-based tactics, and evolving to meet growing dangers in this RTS base-builder.

coveredGames.name: My Penguin Friend
coveredGames.title: Play as Dimdim, a plucky little penguin washed up in a human-sized world. Splash, squawk and peck across a glittering coastal village on Illha Grande and tackle tactile puzzles.

coveredGames.name: Doggy Don't Care
coveredGames.title: What does your dog get up to when you're not home? In this bone-afide adventure, unleash adorable chaos, solve puzzles, and leave your mark (literally!) as a mischievous pup on the loose.

coveredGames.name: The Missing Tail
coveredGames.title: A co-op cat adventure where you play as two cats exploring a lively medieval courtyard and castle. Play with a friend in split-screen, solve co-op puzzles, and platform your way through a rescue!

coveredGames.name: Dumpster Gang
coveredGames.title: A chaotic co-op sandbox game where up to four players can live their best raccoon lives - scavenging dumpsters, stealing junk, raiding snacks, committing tiny crimes, and avoiding an exterminator.

coveredGames.name: Blasterbug: Last Bug Standing!
coveredGames.title: A free bomb-em-up local party game inspired by classic Bomberman! Play as an array of insects, drop bombs, trap enemies, and collect coins to complete your sticker collection.

coveredGames.name: Birds of War
coveredGames.title: Birds of War is a team-based aerial PvP game. Raid nests, steal eggs, fight beak-to-beak in fast, chaotic matches built around flight and combat.

coveredGames.name: GNAW
coveredGames.title: Something’s rotten in New Dino City, and it’s up to you to solve the mystery in GNAW. Explore a pre-apocalyptic saurian civilization hurtling toward self-annihilation.

coveredGames.name: Tumblebee
coveredGames.title: In search of your family, you venture into a hostile cave of silk. A short, bite-sized horror experience with bumblebee physics.

coveredGames.name: Sticky Feet
coveredGames.title: Sticky Feet is a perspective-bending action horror with a rich story about grit, where you play as a lizard trapped in a decaying bayou trailer. Every surface is climbable, but nowhere is safe...

coveredGames.name: Bad Magpie
coveredGames.title: Bad Magpie is a narrative adventure game about a magpie with one wing, a fixation on shiny things, and no interest in connecting the two dots.

coveredGames.name: Dog of Wisdom
coveredGames.title: Traverse the world as Pepper the dachshund as you fly around and bark at nothing! Gain wisdom in search of the galaxy's most dog-friendly foods - but watch out for the toxic ones.

coveredGames.name: OUTCLAW
coveredGames.title: Step into the paws of Comet, a strange, five-eyed cat lost in a strange world. Collect and command chaotic feline shades that morph into ramps, bombs, and more to help you on your journey.

coveredGames.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
coveredGames.title: Step into the paws of your own original cat and experience life among the Clans. Explore a vibrant wilderness filled with hidden paths, dangerous rivals, and spiritual omens inspired by the books.

coveredGames.name: Fuhon
coveredGames.title: Play as a little fox spirit in a decaying world at the brink of extinction. Talk to islanders, solve puzzles, and overcome light platforming challenges as you transform a barren wasteland.

coveredGames.name: Tony The Mole
coveredGames.title: Play as Tony, a curious little mole with a serious digging habit, a taste for worms, and a dream of reaching the surface. Help townsfolk, repair gadgets, and explore hidden places!

coveredGames.name: hilda
coveredGames.title: A soothing idle game with a clock and a cow. Wander a small grassland and listen to calming music, or set a timer for yourself and get some work done in the real world.

coveredGames.name: Prophecy of Vul
coveredGames.title: Enter Inner Taiga, a world full of culture, mystery, and colourful queer animal characters. Wander through a whimsical pixel art world in this simple and engaging 2D platforming adventure.

coveredGames.name: Typomagical
coveredGames.title: Words are power in Typomagical, a spell-building-panic-typing-bullet-heaven-roguelike! As a bear cub mage, combine words to cast dynamic spells and experiment with over 30,000 possible combinations.

coveredGames.name: Spyro™: A Realm Beyond
coveredGames.title: Feel the freedom of flight as you soar above vibrant landscapes, weave between treetops, dive off massive landmarks and wing your way through this new realm in Spyro’s boldest evolution yet.

coveredGames.name: Bruma
coveredGames.title: Explore a mysterious city submerged in a dense mist and utilise the unique stealth and agility of a cat as you search for your elderly friend in this atmospheric adventure.

coveredGames.name: Dodo Duckie
coveredGames.title: Waddle into a reality-bending odyssey where simply being a duck is your greatest superpower. With your magical cap, switch instantly between 2D and 3D platforming to overcome challenges.

coveredGames.name: Little Cheese Works
coveredGames.title: Team up with friends and risk your lives to bring the cheese back your black-hearted boss. Move quietly to avoid the attention of a ferocious cat and complete daring challenges.

coveredGames.name: Herdles
coveredGames.title: An adorable open-world platformer where you play as a magical dog (based upon the creative director's real-life pet!) Em-bark on a highly customizable adventure and save corrupted critters.

coveredGames.name: My Otter Friends
coveredGames.title: After a great flood, the island has grown quiet. Play as a small otter on a cozy adventure to rescue trapped animals and rebuild destroyed homes.

coveredGames.name: Dementium II
coveredGames.title: It's an improvement on its predecessor in nearly every way. Dementium II is a fun, varied, and immensely charming survival horror meets metroidvania game, with a really cool flashlight to boot.

coveredGames.name: You Are Empty: Absolute Edition
coveredGames.title: A slow, brooding and sometimes almost meditative shooter that builds a dense atmosphere of Soviet-era dread, from its meticulously detailed levels to its fever dream cutscenes and enemy designs.

coveredGames.name: BRAZILIAN DRUG DEALER 3: I OPENED A PORTAL TO HELL IN THE FAVELA TRYING TO REVIVE MIT AIA I NEED TO CLOSE IT
coveredGames.title: The most gleeful maelstrom of sound and fury you'll find on the Quake engine, and it's both delirious fun and just plain delirious. A must play!

coveredGames.name: Living Dead Outbreak
coveredGames.title: "You're all going to pay for interrupting my nightly beating FROM MY WIFE!"

coveredGames.name: Instinct
coveredGames.title: Slow and simple FPS gameplay, goofy 2000s physics, and plenty of bleak soviet hallways make this You Are Empty-like a familiar but enjoyable piece of slavjank comfort food.

coveredGames.name: Palpus X Annihilation
coveredGames.title: In every way but name it's Alien Shooter 3, and it's some of the most simple cathartic fun you can have with a twin stick shooter.

coveredGames.name: Dementium: The Ward
coveredGames.title: A charming little horror FPS that uses simple tried-and-true design tools and punches well above its weight when it comes to fun and weirdly comfy horror action
