coveredGames.name: NoSlack Pets: Lo-Fi Paws
coveredGames.title: Adorable desktop productivity buddy with all the usual tools, plus extensive customization/decorating, cleverly implemented co-working, tons of options, and built-in minigames; BUT onboarding is weak.

coveredGames.name: Sudocats
coveredGames.title: Learn how to introduce cats to each other in real life while progressing through (24) Sudoku-style puzzles featuring adorable felines and classical music. Not too difficult and purrfectly wholesome.

coveredGames.name: ShantyTown
coveredGames.title: Strategize item placement to score objectives in this dystopian-cyberpunk diorama builder / casual puzzle. ShantyTown's ~8hr campaign is relaxing, refreshingly unique, and has no timers.

coveredGames.name: Trading Card Inspector
coveredGames.title: Open booster packs, uncover corporate villainy, and do math under ridiculous circumstances in this delightfully quirky work sim. No timers, easy to pick up/put down, ~5-8 hrs to see all 5 endings.

coveredGames.name: Fourleaf Fields
coveredGames.title: [Playtest Review] Whimsical farming sim where your moth-sized farmer axes giant carrots, ranches insects, and gossips with townies. Good start, lovely art, but needs more to do. Still worth watching!

coveredGames.name: Click Painter
coveredGames.title: Cute yet challenging pixel-art logic puzzles similar to Minesweeper, but swap bombs for 1-4 paint colors and make up to 4 mistakes. Tons of content, easy to pick up/put down, BUT unintuitive controls.

coveredGames.name: Hidden Raccoons in Asia
coveredGames.title: The trickiest of the "Hidden Raccoon" trilogy clocks in at ~10min, and features (90) mischievous trash pandas across four gorgeously illustrated levels. Recommend to raccoon and ramen enthusiasts.

coveredGames.name: Hidden Raccoons in Summer
coveredGames.title: Scout out (90) sneaky little bandits across four beautifully illustrated pixel-art scenes in this ~10min hidden object game that delivers all the summer heatwave vibes.

coveredGames.name: The Sorting Bureau
coveredGames.title: [Next Fest Demo] Gaze out at Tokyo while sorting boxes of mismatched and broken items to customer specification. Relaxed, satisfying, and perfect for repetitive organization lovers.

coveredGames.name: Raccoon Packer: A Cozy Puzzle Game
coveredGames.title: A cute, hand-drawn organization puzzle in which you cram oddly shaped items into oddly shaped grids, apply packaging stickers, and bill raccoons. No timers, memorization, or math; ~90min to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Design and Conjure
coveredGames.title: [Next Fest Demo] Unpacking with adorable spirits and recolorable 3D assets. Story follows a young witch tidying her way through town, while Creative Mode is a decorating sandbox. Cute but fiddly.

coveredGames.name: On-Together: Virtual Co-Working
coveredGames.title: A cute, colorful, social world for work-from-homies! The activities, pets, customization, and wholesome chat genuinely improves my workday; BUT no decorating, minimal game, and unstable connections.

coveredGames.name: Thrifty Business
coveredGames.title: Customize a thrift store in this colorful, brain-off, Unpacking-like organizing game and unabashedly queer love letter to the early 2000s. Short (~12+hrs) and sweet, BUT no shop management.

coveredGames.name: Mayor May Knott
coveredGames.title: May Knott restores a ghost town in this super-cozy, Burton-esque ~18hr puzzle adventure featuring 30+ original songs and dad jokes galore. Unhinged, unique, easy to pick up/put down, BUT no decorating

coveredGames.name: Paralives
coveredGames.title: This ambitious indie life sim features awesome building/decorating systems, strong character customization, quests, and a beautiful town, BUT live mode is a work in progress.

coveredGames.name: Phonopolis
coveredGames.title: An artistic masterpiece but okay game: stunning hand-painted cardboard art is offset by unintuitive puzzles and restrained ~5hr story. Recommend to fans of avant-garde art and whimsical point & click

coveredGames.name: The Last Gas Station
coveredGames.title: Restore an isolated gas station in this cozy pixel-art shop sim full of simple minigames and eerie mysteries. Chill vibes, easy to pick up/put down, four endings, BUT story takes a backseat. ~17hrs.

coveredGames.name: The Ratline
coveredGames.title: Saul Perlman, P.I., uses a rolodex to track former Nazis in this uniquely 1970s spin on Roottrees-like document detective games. Lovely 2D art, clever stories, ~8hrs, BUT requires wild logical leaps.

coveredGames.name: CloverPit
coveredGames.title: This slot machine roguelike/allegory about gambling addiction is the unholy retro-horror-style union of Balatro and Luck Be A Landlord. Interesting and fun for ~14hrs, but NOT for completionists.

coveredGames.name: Whisper of the House
coveredGames.title: Discover anomalies, freely decorate homes, and explore dimensions in a beautiful pixel art world. The ~10hr story is lacking, but it plays like Unpacking... if Unpacking were an escape room.

coveredGames.name: Detective Worden
coveredGames.title: Pretty much just Wordle with a side of murder mystery. The ~2hr Story Mode is okay, but Free Mode and Daily Challenges really shine if you love Wordle or configuring words in Scrabble.

coveredGames.name: I Eat Paintings When Guards Aren't Looking
coveredGames.title: A delightfully unhinged, terribly clever, yet strangely educational ~2hr hidden object game in which you decode hints to... well... eat bits of classic oil paintings. (And pet cats.)

coveredGames.name: Frog Holm
coveredGames.title: Filip inherits an island pub in this ~3hr story-driven neo-noir with light platforming, Tetris-y bartending, flawed frogs, dark humor, and twisty plot. Charming and utterly unique, if a bit niche.

coveredGames.name: Lofi Haven
coveredGames.title: Freely decorate city apartments for a customizable cat while chilling to lofi tracks! Includes a pomodoro timer, to-do list, free camera mode, and zero grind, BUT controls and UI are a bit wonky.

coveredGames.name: Lost Wiki: Kozlovka
coveredGames.title: Investigate an Eastern European town's strange history using only a limited database and grainy photos. This ~2hr detective game boasts a twisty story and unique digital Blair Witch-y aesthetic.

coveredGames.name: Project Hospital
coveredGames.title: Build hospitals from the ground up, diagnose and treat patients, and manage every fiddly detail (or don't!) in this deep, complex simulation game informed by real-world medicine. I am OBSESSED.

coveredGames.name: Trinket Bag Maker
coveredGames.title: Created and illustrated by a two-person French studio, this isn't really a game but rather a super cute and nostalgic homage to early 2000s dollmakers and trinket bag obsessions.

coveredGames.name: Mewseum: Film Festival
coveredGames.title: Paint cats into classic film posters by solving grid-based logic puzzles in this relaxing Shikaku game. Between cute pixel-art and smooth jazz, this is perfect for zoning out with a show or podcast.

coveredGames.name: Hidden Raccoons
coveredGames.title: From the studio behind Raccoon Cocoon, this lovely but vanishingly short ~10min hidden object game invites you to sniff out (85) trash pandas across (4) pixel-art levels.

coveredGames.name: Scrub Dudes
coveredGames.title: This ~3hr powerwashing game follows a voxel penguin and his all-in-one cleaning pug as they scour dirt and vacuum trash in whimsical cardboard worlds. Great for fans of repetitive cozies or cleaning.

coveredGames.name: Can I Not Fall for Idols?
coveredGames.title: Short (~1hr) and humorous otome game about managing and *rejecting* love-smitten pop idols. With 8 endings, full Japanese voice acting, plus adult love interests, this was such fun to play!

coveredGames.name: A Tower Full of Cats
coveredGames.title: Packed with details, mischievous felines, and a few minigames, this ~3hr hidden cat game climbs a "tower of time" from prehistory to the middle ages to a distant space-faring future.

coveredGames.name: Creature Kitchen
coveredGames.title: Cozy cottage life meets retro horror vibes in this ~3-6 hr cute-but-creepy puzzle game about photographing and cooking for local wildlife. Unique, heartwarming, and perfect for a rainy afternoon.

coveredGames.name: Dice Gambit
coveredGames.title: Build a dynasty of customizable Inquisitors, engage in fast-paced dice-rolling combat, and curry favor with eccentric NPCs in this quirky, super-stylish BUT repetitive turn-based strategy RPG.

coveredGames.name: TR-49
coveredGames.title: An eerie, mind-bendy sci-fi document detective game in which you reconstruct a corrupted database by parsing known entries for clues. Beautifully designed and voice acted, but requires patience.

coveredGames.name: BUBBA CHOP GROVE
coveredGames.title: Cute incremental with surprisingly a lot of strategic depth. Choose your playstyle and build synergies between your crews! Various layers of progression and prestige, a must for incremental enjoyers!

coveredGames.name: Budgie's Bug Shop
coveredGames.title: Cute art for this refreshing twist on the Nodebuster genre. Gameplay is amazing, as placing your net forces you to understand and anticipate each bug's behavior. Fun and cozy bite-sized experience! <3

coveredGames.name: sys:tan restore
coveredGames.title: Bite-sized, pretty fun while it lasted. Since it's very short (under an hour) for first completion, each run brings something new and feels significant. Character and enemy design is cute and funny.

coveredGames.name: Let It Melt
coveredGames.title: It's utterly charming and brilliantly brings back the feel of playing in the snow as a kid. It also relies on insanely creative, solid and perfectly balanced incremental mechanics. A masterpiece! <3

coveredGames.name: Stick A Fork
coveredGames.title: Absurd concept, cozy atmosphere, insane fun, much dopamine, AND EVEN GACHA MACHINE. And just when I thought I was about to beat the game, there was a brand new second prestige layer waiting for me! <3

coveredGames.name: Wielders of the Essence
coveredGames.title: Amazing horde survival with lots of creative mechanics: troops, essence system, multiple resources... Each hero feels and plays differently, and there's always something to unlock or upgrade! <3

coveredGames.name: Temporal Strike
coveredGames.title: Exactly how I want a free game to be: a showcase for a small dev's skills. A fun and competent short game that makes me want more, so that I might think "Gotta buy their next game!". Good job!

coveredGames.name: Tale Sweeper
coveredGames.title: Not the most exciting "hover to kill monsters" game, but it does the job and introduces many mechanics besides the usual upgrade tree (none is really creative or noteworthy). Very playable, though.

coveredGames.name: Fuck the Ocean
coveredGames.title: Kinda on the fence about this one. On one hand, watching that grumpy old man use the silliest equipment is humorous. On the other hand, "spam click upgrades" "gameplay" is as repetitive as can be.

coveredGames.name: One More Floor
coveredGames.title: Fascinating how a simple idea can make an amazing game! Mixing incremental with a "Stop here or risk it all for a bigger reward" gambling mechanic is great. Click and watch if luck is on your side!

coveredGames.name: DashBreaker
coveredGames.title: Pretty entertaining and dopamine-packed variation on the space shooter. Some design choices are questionnable, but the movement is great and the power creep from upgrading your dash is a blast!

coveredGames.name: Everbastion
coveredGames.title: One of the best incremental TD. Each enemy has a unique behavior, and each tower/ally/construction suits a specific defense strategy. Perfect balance between these and your cursor attacks. Love it!

coveredGames.name: Veinrider
coveredGames.title: Veinrider is a great reminiscence of those Flash games you play with one button, with an incremental layer on top of it. It never becomes trivial, skill vs powercreep maintaining a perfect balance.

coveredGames.name: Black Hole Fishing
coveredGames.title: Think you've seen way too much black hole games? Yup but, it's a fishing one! Absurd premise that delivers a lot of fun and puns, interesting mechanics and never boring progression. Carpe ludum! ><>

coveredGames.name: Astral Archive
coveredGames.title: Creative way to itch the classic space shooter scratch by introducing incremental features. Short arcade-style runs but with upgrades, artifact collecting and long-term progression between runs. Fun!

coveredGames.name: Smashing Bottles
coveredGames.title: Who doesn't like smashing things? Capitalism even invented rage rooms for it, what a wonderful time we live in. Bottles are good material for this, they break and explode: yeah, chain reactions! <3

coveredGames.name: BleepWare Incrementals
coveredGames.title: A compilation of minigames, but incremental ones. Overall quality of games is pretty mid, but getting to switch from one to another when it gets boring is a nice touch for a genre known as repetitive.

coveredGames.name: Slots & Diapers
coveredGames.title: It kinda looked more fun than it really is. The start is slow and the game heavily relies on prestige upgrades: these are original, but I found myself not caring much about what happens on screen.

coveredGames.name: Fish Lab
coveredGames.title: Art and fish movement are fantastic and deliver the most mesmerizing runs I ever played in an incremental game. Sound design (both music and sound FX) is so good I just had to put on my headset. <3

coveredGames.name: Scrap Snap
coveredGames.title: Split screen gameplay (up/active, down/idle) is an enjoyable creative take. A bit slow and obscure at first, but it really becomes interesting afterwards thanks to 3 layers of progression.

coveredGames.name: FEED THE AI
coveredGames.title: One of the all time best! Minimalist art is absolutely gorgeous, sound design is top notch, 3 AI scenarios are both sarcastic and realist, and limited vision gameplay is so good and well implemented.

coveredGames.name: Bookstore Incremental
coveredGames.title: Massive skill tree with creative upgrades : dev never runs out of ideas when it comes to making money with books. New types of workers, customers, things to sell... A great game for all book lovers!

coveredGames.name: Company is watching
coveredGames.title: Amazing horror take on the incremental genre. Creepy atmosphere for this descent into the dark depths of assembly-line production. Two endings, both leaving a part of mystery unexplained. Good stuff!

coveredGames.name: SquareSlicer
coveredGames.title: Very simple concept and pretty much on rails progression (skill tree is more like like a skill line!). But I had fun splitting & slicing for 1h20, and I really felt the way I handled runs mattered.

coveredGames.name: Mouspionage
coveredGames.title: A lot of charm thanks to the old spy movie atmosphere recreated through the music and visuals. Recruiting your animal team and upgrading their abilities is chill and enjoyable. Prestige is well done.

coveredGames.name: Planet Harvester: Incremental Odyssey
coveredGames.title: Fun little timewaster! Quality low-poly art, huge skill tree, carrying capacity management, four planets with their own challenges and resources, exciting weapons and power-ups for max entertainment.

coveredGames.name: Pin Money
coveredGames.title: Actually throwing the ball is decent, but where Pin Money shines is by recreating the atmosphere of a bowling alley with the music, the aesthetic and the funny lines that come with every upgrade.

coveredGames.name: Synthularity
coveredGames.title: The most awesome-looking upgrade tree I've ever seen, PCB-shaped. Nice neon aesthetic, fun runs with "choose 1 of 3" boss rewards, good mix of active and idle gameplay, great (customizable!) music. <3

coveredGames.name: castle idler
coveredGames.title: No waves but a killstreak to achieve for each level make it more relax than your usual TD. Add a great prestige tree with strategic choices to make and you get a pretty unique puzzly incremental TD.

coveredGames.name: I Hate Polygons
coveredGames.title: Game shines by the emphasis on speed and movement during the runs thanks to power-ups, danger avoidment and carrying capacity management. Also does a good job at making you feel the power creep.

coveredGames.name: Peg Champ
coveredGames.title: THIS IS THE ONE, guys! The first one to give me the Peggle vibes, when most of the others are AI slop cashgrabs! Featuring cool incremental upgrades, a crazy expressive monkey and a perfect balance!

coveredGames.name: Pacremental
coveredGames.title: I had a blast with this one! Feels like some crazy bartender blended all the most fun things in gaming into a delicious cocktail : opening packs, customizing your build, fighting waves and mining! <3

coveredGames.name: Crystal Breaker Inc
coveredGames.title: Fun mining game that really shines by its progression mechanics. The usual skill tree, but also lootboxes and a superfun merging system that combines similar weapons or modifiers for insane power.

coveredGames.name: Karma Keepers
coveredGames.title: On one hand, nice art, meaningful upgrades and some of the most original mechanics I've ever seen in an incremental game. On the other hand, a very slow first half and way too much micromanagement.

coveredGames.name: Incremental Fishing
coveredGames.title: Your usual fishing game, following a well-established formula. Fishing games never get old, though, and I enjoyed the somewhat mesmerizing circling of fishes and the elegant minimalist art style.

coveredGames.name: Toll: The Ferryman's Ledger
coveredGames.title: Writing and atmosphere are great. Interactive conversations with daemons are thoughtful, and words from the deads are kinda funny. Incremental part is OK but not great, and prestige needs a rework.

coveredGames.name: Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons
coveredGames.title: Awesome first person idle dungeon crawler! Customization options are just insane and a dream come true for people who like optimizing their party : races, equipment, gods, perks, abilities... Amazing!

coveredGames.name: It's Chopping Time!
coveredGames.title: Enjoyable take on the incremental tree cutting formula, despite the slow pace and repetitive upgrade structure. Art is good, and unleashing forces of nature turns out to be pretty fun. Chop-chop!

coveredGames.name: IGNOBLE
coveredGames.title: Starts a bit slow, but gets insanely addictive after a few runs. Fast-paced gameplay and one of the best skill trees I've ever seen, introducing so many new mechanics, weapons and synergies. Dope!

coveredGames.name: Chef Knight
coveredGames.title: You kinda get two good incremental games for the price of one, here. Runs are fun, visuals and animations are cozy, upgrades are interesting: perfect recipe for a delicious short gaming session. <3

coveredGames.name: JOHN GLEEP
coveredGames.title: You're an alien with a failed casino and a mountain of debt to the mob. The only way to dig yourself out is to abduct gamblers and try to get as much money out of your "patrons" as possible.

coveredGames.name: Dig! Dig! Dino!
coveredGames.title: Join a group o paleontologists setting out on a new dig site. Put your shovel to work and big up dinosaurs bones and other treasures along the way, at your own pace.

coveredGames.name: Mayday: The Survival Island
coveredGames.title: Waking up from a crash, injured and confused about where you are. Work to survive an the unknown and explore across 24 islands. With different environments, resources, and challenges ahead.

coveredGames.name: Double Whammy
coveredGames.title: Play as Gigi, working in a guitar shop by day. Making custom builds, taking on repairing and cleaning job for customers. At night, use our axe to beat down monsters.

coveredGames.name: BOOST VECTOR EX
coveredGames.title: A parkour racing game. Play as a Vector Master, each their own skills, and see what real speed is about. Play against friends, race online, and more.

coveredGames.name: GrimKeep
coveredGames.title: Dice game, deck-builder, rougelike. Explore the world, take on enemies, find items, shop to create a unique build to survived this nightmarish fairy tale world.

coveredGames.name: Defender of Darkness
coveredGames.title: A dark overlord and last protector of an alliance. Fortify your stronghold, cast spells, and manage your resources as you take on 11 waves of assault on your town, in this idle tower defense game.

coveredGames.name: Impersonal
coveredGames.title: You've regained consciousness in a place that doesn't make sense. Completely lost, without a face or memories. Can you regain who you are, how you got here, but most of all, how do you escape?

coveredGames.name: Piece and Quiet: A Stained Glass Restoration
coveredGames.title: Sitting within the walls of a mount side chapel, find, clean, and reassemble works of art. A tidy-up game where you rebuild stained glass. 6 artworks and 2,655 pieces.

coveredGames.name: Winx Club - Moonlight Quest
coveredGames.title: Join the Winx Club in an family friendly open world exploration game! Mysterious happening are going on around the Festival of 100 Moons, what will you wander across?

coveredGames.name: Arkheron
coveredGames.title: 3v3 MOBA Gather items from Eternals to decided your gameplay. Build a whole set and become that Eternal or mix and match your items for unique abilities, as you climb the tower together to ascend.

coveredGames.name: Our Life: Now & Forever
coveredGames.title: A choices matter visual novel about growing up and deciding who you'll become. Relationships with family, friends, and even romance. Experiencing life through four years, across four autumns.

coveredGames.name: The Pogo Witch
coveredGames.title: You've come to a strange place. A tower that rises into the clouds and beyond. Good thing you've got pogo magic. Use your magic to avoid traps and venture into a tower full of secrets.

coveredGames.name: 10 Million Pixels
coveredGames.title: Somewhere in the 10 million pixels, lies the Golden Pixel. Mine pixels, unlock abilities, explore the environment, and never stop searching.

coveredGames.name: Orion Blue
coveredGames.title: Fishing can be relaxing and interesting, especially on an alien planet. Discovery new fish, find resources, customize your boat, build relationships and maybe find romance. Active play or idle mode.

coveredGames.name: The Totemist
coveredGames.title: This town feels slightly off, it's the perfect place for an occult shop. Manage your shop, cleanse materials, craft totems, to help your customers and stay vigilant of the dark forces that linger here

coveredGames.name: MyDear.exe
coveredGames.title: A short but emotional tale of Ellie and Lucien, together for 57 years. Play through their life and love inside mini games found in files and photos inside of an old PC.

coveredGames.name: Ambrosia Sky
coveredGames.title: Sent to investigate a farming colony in Saturn's rings. What you find are bones of old friends and a hostile fungi that's taken over. Put friends to rest as you try to figure out how this happened.

coveredGames.name: The Devil's Due
coveredGames.title: You lost a game of poker against the Devil and now your soul is his. Trapped in hell, do the only thing to know how to, cheat your way out with the tricks and face cards up your sleeve.

coveredGames.name: A Snail's Tale
coveredGames.title: Inspired by classic JRPGS with a twist of ridiculous humor. An immortal snail is hunting your king. Assemble a party of quirky characters, take on odd enemies as you try to save the day.

coveredGames.name: Reshine
coveredGames.title: A game about repairing, restoring, and refreshing long forgotten pieces. Disassemble, clean, and put it back together while listing to the rain in your workshop as you work at your own pace.

coveredGames.name: Arctic Drive
coveredGames.title: Surviving and explore the Arctic. You had a truck, but now it's gone. Good thing your a mechanic, time to get to work and build a car and find supplies. Solo or up 4 player co-op. Made by 2 devs.

coveredGames.name: Chronocracy
coveredGames.title: Where one timeline ends, another begins. Build and expand a civilization across a flat world. Scout, gather resources, expand, and take on what lies ahead or maybe below.

coveredGames.name: Appulse
coveredGames.title: Shooting roguelite that takes place inside of pinball machines. The mission, protect your mothership from invading hostile robots. Master you weapons, buy upgrades, and hold the line.

coveredGames.name: Am I Nima
coveredGames.title: *MATURITY WARNING* A psychological horror experience. Convince your mother you are in fact her daughter in order escape confinement. Take notice of your space, feelings, and use words to become Nima.

coveredGames.name: Light of Atlantis
coveredGames.title: When Atlantis sank, they're tech evolved to adapt to living underwater and controlling water levels. Explore Atlantis as a robot worker and uncover it's mysterious.

coveredGames.name: Cat Cafe Manager 2: Big City Bliss
coveredGames.title: Sequel to game one, welcome to Covestadt! Build a cat cafe, rescues strays, care for them, take your fluffs out and explore the town, gather supplies, become part of the community, and so much more!

coveredGames.name: Dice Hoarder
coveredGames.title: If you've got one dice set, you've got more. Always on the look out for colorful, interesting new sets? You've come to the perfect place. A shop that's... a bit out of a mess. Let's help clean it up!

coveredGames.name: Escape the Baby Alarm
coveredGames.title: A colorful puzzle adventure about the experiences of parenthood and the rebirth of finding yourself again afterward. Love, chaos, pride, worry, and exhausted all mixed together.

coveredGames.name: Me and You
coveredGames.title: A co-op puzzle game inspired by Baba Is You. Work together to change, break, bend rules, and maybe even shape shift across levels in order to solves puzzles.

coveredGames.name: Milki Delivery
coveredGames.title: A short game about reconnecting a community while delivering milk. Care for your cow, collecting milk, and make deliveries across a beautiful country side. Full of characters and random chance events.

coveredGames.name: Dragon's Brew
coveredGames.title: Build and run the board game cafe of your dreams! Start a garden, explore nearby shops for supplies, stock games, try out new recipes, and more.

coveredGames.name: Toto's Journey
coveredGames.title: Inspired by The Wizard of Oz world. We know of Dorothy's journey but what about Toto? Play as Toto, swept up in cyclone landing in a mysterious magical world, now searching for a way home.

coveredGames.name: Dawn of Defense
coveredGames.title: A strategy game that has it all. RTS and tower defense with rougelite progression. The Imperium Aeternum is a shadow upon the world. Seizing everything in it's path and you've had enough.

coveredGames.name: Angel Investor Simulator™
coveredGames.title: Inspired by Silicon Valley's startup culture and TV shows that fund them, become an Angel Investor. Find and invest in quirky ideas to see which will thrive and become profitable

coveredGames.name: Spirit Crossing
coveredGames.title: From the makers of Cozy Grove. A spirit called for you and you answered. Swept away into a fractured world--ready to be put back together with friends, because here in the clouds, we work together!

coveredGames.name: The Attic: A Mystery Puzzle Game
coveredGames.title: With her brother off to uni, Jess has taken claim of his hangout space-the attic! But things are strange, hidden messages, someone named Destiny. Organize the space and the uncover secrets left behind

coveredGames.name: Littlelands
coveredGames.title: Welcome to the world of Littlelands. Full of adventure, exploration, farming, and friends to make. Not every situation will call for a sword, but some definitely will!!

coveredGames.name: Trafficity
coveredGames.title: A city builder, focused on traffic. As the city grows, so does the traffic. It's your job to keep it moving. By expanding, resolving issues and maybe even redesign.

coveredGames.title: A charming puzzle game where you place "tools" like jumps and dashes to guide the character safely though with lovely hand-drawn pixel art and 150 different repayable puzzles in three biomes.

coveredGames.name: Bloom & Dine

coveredGames.name: Meow-Jong

coveredGames.name: cookie planet: cosmic bakery
coveredGames.title: If Cookie Clicker was a first person game... Cookie Planet might not be for everyone, but fan of Cookie Clicker and idle games in general should definitely check it out.

coveredGames.name: Chromascape
coveredGames.title: The puzzles are not too challenging, but paired with the narrative and lovely pastel hand-drawn artwork they create a truly relaxing experience, perfect for a younger audience.

coveredGames.name: Garden Cleanup Simulator
coveredGames.title: A delightful simulation game where you clean and restore 7 different overgrown garden to pristine condition, it's so rewarding to see these garden come back to life.

coveredGames.name: Cat Mirror
coveredGames.title: Cat Mirror is a symmetry type puzzle, your goal is for the two cats to meet. It's deceptively simple, but get challenging in the latter levels, overall a fun little brain teaser.

coveredGames.name: Approved! A Quiet Day of Paperwork
coveredGames.title: Your job is simple; approve and stamp all of the request coming on your desk, Approved! is a cozy simulation/clicker game. It's simple for when you just want something to wind down after a long day.

coveredGames.name: CURSORLOOM
coveredGames.title: A fun way to give your desktop personality, curate your cursor by choosing from the included library divided into themes and collections or use the editor to make your own creation.

coveredGames.name: Greek Kitchen Frenzy: Dionysus
coveredGames.title: Craft dishes to save your people from the wrath of Dionysus in Greek Kitchen Frenzy. It's easy to pick up and perfect for anyone looking to get into time management games.

coveredGames.name: Grandpa's Bee Haven
coveredGames.title: Help grandpa's tend to his beehives in this charming desktop idler with lovely pixel artwork, it's relaxing and so satisfying to see the beekeeping farm grow at the bottom of your screen.

coveredGames.name: Hidden Pets: 101 Cats in Czech Republic
coveredGames.title: Another hand-drawn hidden object game from NaipSoft, one huge level with 101 cats to find hidden in Czechia, a good value for the small asking price.

coveredGames.name: Paperlings
coveredGames.title: A friend that keeps you company at the bottom of your screen until you go through the door and a whole papercraft world unfolds, an intriguing way to blend two genres that look quite promising.

coveredGames.name: Idle Times

coveredGames.name: Hidden Pets: 101 Cats in Budapest

coveredGames.title: One of the most atmospheric games we've played. A really great story, with plenty of hands on, homecooked, detective work. Love the variance in moving throughout the town and searching on the PC.

coveredGames.title: An awesome detective pick, similar to The Roottrees are Dead, except you're solving a corporate tree rather than a family one. Lots of twists and turns, and hunting through information to find answers

coveredGames.title: A hilarious, pun-filled game, about a Duck Detective down on his luck. Continues on from the first game, but can be played standalone too. Great adventure, with plenty of de-duck-tions to be made!

coveredGames.name: The Case of the Worst Day Ever
coveredGames.title: A great detective game about everything that could go wrong. Loved the different cases with the different characters and themes. Each case got more difficult, and was fun to solve!

coveredGames.name: Little Problems: A Cozy Detective Game
coveredGames.title: A super cute cozy detective game about the minor inconveniences in life. Loved the overall story, the graphics are delightful, and the cases are surprisingly complex. Great detective pick!

coveredGames.name: The Roottrees are Dead
coveredGames.title: One of our fave detective games! A story that will hook you, gameplay that has you digging through articles for every nugget of information, and so many twists and turns you won't know what's coming!

coveredGames.name: Confidential Killings - A Detective Game
coveredGames.title: A gritty, dark, and intriguing detective game with plenty of twists and turns. Awesome graphic style and all around aesthetic, with a good story to match!

coveredGames.name: Flotsam
coveredGames.title: A solid city builder with survival aspects that makes it feel similar to a great survival crafter! Huge world to explore, and plenty to do in a really well designed game.

coveredGames.name: Kokoro Kitchen
coveredGames.title: A cute and cozy cooking sim, with a stunning art style! Absolutely love the Japanese theme to the dishes, and it has some really fun mini games too!

coveredGames.name: CloverPit
coveredGames.title: An addictive roguelite similar to games like Balatro and Buckshot Roulette, but with a psychological horror twist. Perfect for casual gamers and roguelite lovers.

coveredGames.name: ALL WILL FALL
coveredGames.title: A survival city-builder where every structure is at risk of collapse. Balance engineering, resources, and leadership to keep your settlement alive.

coveredGames.name: Adaptory
coveredGames.title: Build and adapt with modular survival systems. Every piece you connect changes the way you endure the world.

coveredGames.name: Subnautica
coveredGames.title: An underwater survival masterpiece. Equal parts terrifying and awe-inspiring as you dive deeper into alien seas.

coveredGames.name: Winter Burrow
coveredGames.title: Play as a mouse surviving the cold. Cozy, heartfelt, and all about finding warmth in the smallest things.

coveredGames.name: Solarpunk™
coveredGames.title: Hopeful survival in a bright eco-future. Craft, build, and thrive in harmony with the environment.

coveredGames.name: Len's Island
coveredGames.title: A blend of farming, dungeon crawling, and survival. A little cozy, a little dangerous, and always rewarding.

coveredGames.name: Nightingale
coveredGames.title: Shared-world survival with magical realms to explore. Build, craft, and open portals to fantastical landscapes.

coveredGames.name: Frostpunk 2
coveredGames.title: A survival game where entire cities hang in the balance. It’s about choices, morality, and what you’re willing to sacrifice for humanity.

coveredGames.name: Smalland: Survive the Wilds
coveredGames.title: Survive in a massive insect world. Build gear, ride bugs, and see nature from a whole new perspective.

coveredGames.name: 7 Days to Die
coveredGames.title: Part survival, part tower defense, all about preparing for that next blood moon. If your base holds, you’re a legend.

coveredGames.name: Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days
coveredGames.title: A side-scrolling survival story during a zombie outbreak. Manage survivors, scavenge what you can, and fight to make it another day.

coveredGames.name: Rust
coveredGames.title: Cutthroat multiplayer survival where trust is a rare commodity. Build, raid, betray - and hope you log back in to still have a base.

coveredGames.name: Don't Starve
coveredGames.title: The survival classic with a Tim Burton edge. Quirky, punishing, and endlessly replayable.

coveredGames.name: Pacific Drive
coveredGames.title: A survival road trip where your car is the only thing keeping you alive. Fix it, upgrade it, and keep driving into the weird.

coveredGames.name: The Alters
coveredGames.title: Survival with a twist - you clone alternate versions of yourself to stay alive. Smart, strange, and loaded with moral questions.

coveredGames.name: StarRupture
coveredGames.title: Survive storms, scavenge resources, and fight alien threats on a hostile planet. A sharp blend of sci-fi and survival.

coveredGames.name: Sons Of The Forest
coveredGames.title: A bigger, darker sequel that dials up the horror. The forest isn’t just dangerous - it feels alive.

coveredGames.name: The Forest
coveredGames.title: Creepy, brutal, and unforgettable. You’ll craft, build, and fight for your life while something in the trees is always watching.

coveredGames.name: Oceaneers
coveredGames.title: A colorful, co-op survival game built around teamwork and adventure on the water. Perfect for players who want something lighter and more playful.

coveredGames.name: Voyagers of Nera
coveredGames.title: An oceanic survival game full of exploration and discovery. Sail strange seas, scavenge what you can, and uncover the mysteries of the deep.

coveredGames.name: Enshrouded
coveredGames.title: Part survival, part RPG, all wrapped in a mysterious fog. Build, explore, and fight your way to uncover what’s been lost.

coveredGames.name: Valheim
coveredGames.title: A Viking survival adventure where every tree chopped and boss defeated feels like an epic tale. It’s equal parts cozy building and mythic challenge.

coveredGames.name: Pool of Madness
coveredGames.title: Firmly grab your shaft, polish the tip, and prepare to go balls deep in those corner pockets. All those hours of Miniclip 8 Ball Pool are about to come in handy!

coveredGames.name: Dawn of Defense
coveredGames.title: While it doesn't reach the same depth as games dedicated to either the TD or RTS genres, it absolutely nails the engaging and addictive roguelite loop.

coveredGames.name: Dungeonbound
coveredGames.title: A choose your own adventure dungeon crawler, roguelite and RPG game with loose 'incremental' features, all rolled into one.

coveredGames.name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
coveredGames.title: My kingdom was indeed rushed. TLDR; This may be the Frontiers rival I have been waiting for. The most notable changes were that all towers, heroes, and spells feel much more balanced.

coveredGames.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator
coveredGames.title: The loop is satisfying, progression is smooth, and the balance between busy work and fun is some of the best I've experienced in the genre - This is an easy recommendation.

coveredGames.name: Chop Chop Inc.
coveredGames.title: Finally, an answer to the age-old question ‘How much wood could a woodchuck chuck, if a woodchuck could chuck wood?‘

coveredGames.name: Pass the Fear
coveredGames.title: Pass the Fear combines the build variety and chaos of Enter the Gungeon and Gunfire Reborn, focusing on skill-based gameplay and really putting the "hell" in bullet hell when it comes to boss fights.

coveredGames.name: Voidling Bound: Creature Evolution Shooter
coveredGames.title: I went into Voidling Bound expecting a creature collector, but what I found was a mutagen splicing experience that feels like a mash up of Spore, Spyro, Skylanders, and Pokemon.

coveredGames.name: NITRO GEN OMEGA
coveredGames.title: I want to love Nitro Gen Omega (NGO), I truly do. The art style and music fit the gameplay perfectly, and it has everything I’d normally want from a game like this. So why don’t I like it?

coveredGames.name: Everything is Crab: The Animal Evolution Roguelite
coveredGames.title: Everything is, in fact, not Crab. Like crabs? Eat crabs? Had crabs? Congratulations, this game is for you! Easy enough to understand as a casual, offers enough depth for theory crafters. A must play!

coveredGames.name: Grind Survivors
coveredGames.title: A good bullet hell created for min-maxers who love loot crafting, held back by a massive BUT. If you play for build optimisation, you’ll enjoy it. If you play for variety, you won’t.

coveredGames.name: Timberborn
coveredGames.title: As a beaver in real life, I must say this game depicts beavers very accurately.

coveredGames.name: Aliosso
coveredGames.title: Heavily inspired by Balatro, and for the most part, it's fun. Don't expect the same staying power, however.

coveredGames.name: I Hate This Place
coveredGames.title: A survival horror based on a comic book series by the same name, absolutely nailing the look and feel. If you enjoy games with a strong atmosphere and freedom of exploration, this one’s for you.

coveredGames.name: Winnie's Hole
coveredGames.title: The makers of Ring of Pain let you feel the warmth of Winnie’s intestines as you fill his hole. If you’re a roguelike deck builder enjoyer, this game is a must play.

coveredGames.name: ODDCORE
coveredGames.title: Backrooms Ultrakill Roguelike on LSD, delivered direct to your veins. Imagine Ultrakill & Risk of Rain 2 hooking up and birthing an ADHD child that lives in the backrooms and survives purely on drugs.

coveredGames.name: Night Swarm
coveredGames.title: This plays like a Hades-lite with VS elements. Beware, however, the developers abandoned their prior title ‘Rogue Loops’ - A good game, but it certainly needed more time in the oven before 1.0

coveredGames.name: WUCHANG: Fallen Feathers
coveredGames.title: This receives my ‘Gooner Seal of Approval’. Jiggle physics, revealing outfits, and a protagonist with desirable proportions – This is definitely a door locked, lights off, tissues ready experience.

coveredGames.name: Ruffy and the Riverside
coveredGames.title: Ruffy and the Riverside takes me back to the days of Banjo Kazooie, Crash Bandicoot, and Donkey Kong – This game is an ode to my childhood.

coveredGames.name: RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army
coveredGames.title: Thank you, Atlus, keep remastering. Give us the 2nd, give us the 3rd, give us everything! We’ll hand over our wallets, just please, no censorship, no Denuvo, and no $100 'Ultimate Edition'.

coveredGames.name: Zombie Graveyard Simulator
coveredGames.title: What do zombie bodybuilders crave? Gains. Ever dreamt about owning your own morgue and cracking open a cold one with the boys? Dream no longer!

coveredGames.name: Monster Girls Survival & Craft 2040
coveredGames.title: a surprisingly involved minecraft-like full of half naked and big breasted monster girls. i've played games similar but none that i felt i could sink a good bit of time into. this one is great so far.

coveredGames.name: Beautiful Mystic Survivors
coveredGames.title: minor fan service with some good jiggles but the project is an abandoned early access game so just know that it is unfinished and will remain that way as per the devs.

coveredGames.name: Elven Huntress: Sunveil
coveredGames.title: what an improvement over breath of life! it's a first person dungeon crawler, hot protagonist with clothing toggle and customizable body, tons of loot to get, lots of game to play. really impressed.

coveredGames.name: GloveUp!

coveredGames.name: Combolands: Roguelike Citybuilder

coveredGames.name: Paper Animal Adventure
coveredGames.title: I've been waiting three years for this game, and it does not disappoint.

coveredGames.name: Merge Maestro
coveredGames.title: Very special bite sized roguelike, $3 is ridiculous value for this gem.

coveredGames.name: He is Coming

coveredGames.name: A Solitaire Mystery
coveredGames.title: What's better than freakishly hard solitaire?

coveredGames.name: Dog And Goblin
coveredGames.title: I seriously love this game. Uses the Luck be a Landlord-style slot machine roguelike formula, but adds a brand new mechanic that completely changes the way the game is played.

coveredGames.name: Cats & Dice
coveredGames.title: A Balatro inspired dicebuilding roguelike that ramps up the decision-making of Balatro to 100. This is a complex game but is filled with interesting ideas and mechanics!

coveredGames.name: Blasted Dice
coveredGames.title: Funky roguelike dicebuilder that meshes the regular dungeon crawling formula with Balatro!

coveredGames.name: Become the Moon
coveredGames.title: Autobattler Roguelike Deckbuilder with some really fun mechanics. Needs a bit of balance and maybe a tiny bit more content, but it's off to the races.

coveredGames.name: Auto Rogue
coveredGames.title: A brilliant think-y programming style roguelike with a plentiful amount of jank

coveredGames.name: APICO
coveredGames.title: I seriously love this game. For such a seemingly cutesy calm game, it's an incredibly complex game with a ton of different mechanics. It's easy to get overwhelmed but that's a good thing.

coveredGames.name: Cairn
coveredGames.title: Narrative survival climbing game where you play as Aava through her most daring ascent. She also happens to be in a romantic relationship with another woman, Naomi.

coveredGames.name: SpiritVale
coveredGames.title: A love letter to Ragnarok Online, this sandbox grindfest MMORPG features completely genderless character creation. So far in EA, you're also able to edit your existing characters at will.

coveredGames.name: Squeakross: Home Squeak Home
coveredGames.title: A wholesome (and rather polished) mix of nonogram, decorating, character customisation, and idle game. The lil' rodent you get to customise is genderless and you can unlock a myriad of pride flags.

coveredGames.name: The Big Suck
coveredGames.title: A surprisingly addictive coffee-break incremental suck-'em-up with an increasingly chaotic tornado mechanic. Destroy and suck up everything in your path, then spend the resources on powerful upgrades.

coveredGames.name: Cataclyzm
coveredGames.title: Mesmerizing blossoms of bullets fan out of enemies forcing you to weave in and out of firing lines as metal music blares loud enough to grow a sick mullet on your head as you play. Yes, its that cool.

coveredGames.name: Duat: Beyond Light & Shadow
coveredGames.title: A creative usage of light mechanics and a theme of ancient Egyptian lore set this Metroidvania platformer apart from the usual bunch. Precision platforming done right, and with a clever twist.

coveredGames.name: Salmon Samurai
coveredGames.title: Incremental Fruit Ninja-esque fishing in a chill and ambient natural setting. Be a bear, catch the fish, strategically choose your cards each day to maximize your fishing output and your daily stamina

coveredGames.name: Voxotron
coveredGames.title: What an absolute adrenaline rush Voxotron is, this is a pleasant surprise of the year. A totally hectic and addictive high-speed dodge-'em-up that also serves as a mesmerizing audiovisual treat.

coveredGames.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
coveredGames.title: Belmont's Curse is a very different experience from the core entries in the series and that may tick some die-hards off, but it's also very good as a metroidvania of its own. Recommended.

coveredGames.name: Hypnostasis
coveredGames.title: A very dark, offbeat survival horror. Hypnostasis is an unnervingly beautiful horror game that achieves an almost Lynchian style of storytelling that only a certain crowd can really appreciate.

coveredGames.name: Thunder Hoop Collection (QUByte Classics)
coveredGames.title: This collection of hidden beat-em-up gems is mandatory for any co-op arcade collection. Clever level designs, badass BGM and challenging boss battles make this a nostalgic cult classic. Emulated well

coveredGames.name: CHOMP CHOMP Carnage
coveredGames.title: Vibrant, colorful chomp-em-up with a unique yarn sort of theme in an ocean of increasingly exotic fish. Start out a defenseless little fish and eat your way to the top. A chill casual coffeebreak run.

coveredGames.name: LURRUNA - The Island of Towering Automatons
coveredGames.title: Another memorable and authentically nostalgic retro platformer from the passionate mind behind SomnaBuster. Fast paced combat and stylish 90s visuals bring the player back to a Treasure-era experience

coveredGames.name: Odd's Job
coveredGames.title: A simple yet fairly challenging coffee-break platformer with some extremely memorable creature designs. This collect-a-thon platformer will push you with each death to retry for faster speeds.

coveredGames.name: Truxton Extreme
coveredGames.title: Tatsujin Extreme feels like an authentic arcade shoot’emup from the heart of a group of veterans who know exactly what they’re doing and do it for the art not the notoriety. Must play.

coveredGames.name: Tale of the Bullet Knight
coveredGames.title: A totally surreal DIY fever-dream of a boomer shooter. Take on increasingly chaotic waves of baddies in a hand-crafted world of trippy visuals, infectious jams, and hypnotizing level designs. Awesome.

coveredGames.name: Linkshift
coveredGames.title: A mesmerizing action-puzzler with the spirit and unique soul of Lumines; Come for the stylish visuals and beats, stay for the addictively fast-paced chains and combos. Simple yet beautifully chaotic.

coveredGames.name: Dragon Dragon Fire Fire Deluxe
coveredGames.title: Authentic arcade platformer that feels natural alongside legends like Bubble Bobble and Rainbow Islands. Tight and competitive scoring with clever, snappy stage design make this a couch co-op must!

coveredGames.name: Caromble!
coveredGames.title: Incredible quality representing the age-old brick breaking formula. Massively creative stages, satisfying destruction, and impressive visuals make this a must-play for those who grew up with Arkanoid.

coveredGames.name: Super Night Riders S1
coveredGames.title: Fast bikes, cute girls; SNR is a must for golden age arcade racers. An impressive leap in visual fidelity while retaining the slick arcade handling that made the first resonate with Hang On players.

coveredGames.name: Wanderling
coveredGames.title: A palm-sweating speed-run roguelite with whimsical fantasy visuals; Guide a brave mouse through maze-like biomes. Collect keys while memorizing your path to complete each run within limited days.

coveredGames.name: POROTO
coveredGames.title: Engaging and casual pachinko platform shooter, a perfect arcade time waster. Take control of an honor bound robot and place your shots to carefully pop the right pinball-style pegs with limited shots.

coveredGames.name: Berry Bury Berry
coveredGames.title: What starts out a cute, simple and effective incremental berry clicker ends up being a satisfying scene of colorful fruit chaos. Grow your berries into diverse fruits and control your hole to profit.

coveredGames.name: Arcadium - Space Odyssey
coveredGames.title: Offers a familiar arcade shooter take on the constantly evolving survivor formula complete with a very addictive gameplay loop, incremental unlocks, and a cosmically retro style unique to the genre.

coveredGames.name: Blood & Money
coveredGames.title: A nostalgic top-down arcade fantasy akin to Gauntlet - Blood & Money is dripping with its own DIY punk rock aesthetic. A humorous cast of heroes and unique character attacks make this a co-op must.

coveredGames.name: 閃攻機人アスラ - ASURA THE STRIKER -
coveredGames.title: Exhilarating and fast paced rail-shooter ASURA THE STRIKER proudly wears its arcade influences on its sleeve. A slick and modern throwback to the on-rails Sega classics; namely Space Harrier.

coveredGames.name: SKYSAVIOR Helicopter Services
coveredGames.title: This attractive SimCopter-like features a passionately handcrafted voxel sandbox city with a slew of interesting objectives to tackle - From simple transportation to harrowing rescue and TV news arcs.

coveredGames.name: Zaxtron EXPLUS
coveredGames.title: Buried underneath the light-hearted theme of childhood imagination is a competent and fairly challenging bullet hell shooter. Chock full of retro references and familiar arcade style. Recommended!

coveredGames.name: Circuit Overload
coveredGames.title: Another addictive arcade survivor-like. Seemingly simple DIY dodge-'em-up with creative upgrades and chaotic boss battles. Neon colors and heavy beats keep you in the fight for the Global Leaderboards

coveredGames.name: Astrolite
coveredGames.title: An Asteroids-influenced survivor-like and roguelite. Astrolite is a neon-drenched survivor style game that speaks to the arcade game enthusiast with its bullet hell reflexes. Addictive, bright & loud.

coveredGames.name: Super Pinball Adventure
coveredGames.title: Chill Pinball action, a perfectly zen-ful coffee break game with vibrant visuals and lo-fi beats that lull you into serious relaxation. Casual Pinball with a variety of levels, upgrades, and bosses.

coveredGames.name: Evil Egg
coveredGames.title: Lean. Gritty. Crunchy. Evil Egg is the beefiest Robotron-like to date, dripping with quality and ambition. Slick controls, addictive score-chasing, and wild audiovisuals that suck you into every run.

coveredGames.name: Sektori
coveredGames.title: Mindblowing evolution in twin-stick action that you need to feel to believe. Sektori smashes through the "Geometry Wars" ceiling and soars into the cosmos, raising the bar for the genre in every way.

coveredGames.name: One Rotten Oath
coveredGames.title: A very unique blend of horror FMV and old school shooter with classic tank-y controls. The shooting sections are nostalgic and clunky, while the highlight is the dark and eerie live-action narrative.

coveredGames.name: Slipstream

coveredGames.name: Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster
coveredGames.title: Control Skaven assassin Vihneek and explore the Skavendom in a mission to become the ultimate Deathmaster. Use devious strategies, unlock new abilities/secret tools and upgrade your gear.

coveredGames.name: 1BITDRAGON
coveredGames.title: Fun and intuitive DAW alternative with a huge variety of samples and customization tools out of the box. Create your own royalty-free tunes for fun or for commercial use.

coveredGames.name: Tempus Vitae
coveredGames.title: Explore a war-torn space station and find your lost brother by jumping in time between 2185 and 2385. A metroidvania FPS striving to be the ultimate time travel game.

coveredGames.name: Bye Bye Bonnie
coveredGames.title: Co-op platformer about operating a rolling skull with up to four players as you unlock new upgrades before heading to “The Tower”. Travel through a dystopian wasteland seen through children’s eyes.

coveredGames.name: METRO 2039
coveredGames.title: The Metro saga continues, this time in the dark heart of a harrowing conflict against a fanatical leader and a dark, terrifying enemy. Explore, survive and make it through combat or stealth.

coveredGames.name: EXODUS
coveredGames.title: Sci-fi action RPG set in the ruins of forgotten worlds. Assemble a crew, build bonds and make choices that may lead you to save them or lose them. An Exodus to save the world.

coveredGames.name: Mega Man: Dual Override
coveredGames.title: Dr. Wily strikes again and so does the Blue Bomber. Explore new futuristic frontiers as Mega Man and Proto Man override their limits using Custom Chips to restore peace to the city.

coveredGames.name: Showa American Story
coveredGames.title: Comedy action RPG set in a 1980s America colonized by Japan. Step into the unique culture of “Showa America” in search of answers to what caused the world to turn post-apocalyptic.

coveredGames.name: Lofsöng
coveredGames.title: Journey and Cocoon collide in a puzzle adventure about a hidden language “buried in stone and sound”. Explore a dead planet Earth with brutalist landscapes and dive into the cosmic unknown.

coveredGames.name: STAGE TOUR
coveredGames.title: Guitar Hero spiritual successor featuring over 90 licensed tracks and real guitars from Gibson, Epiphone and more. Rock your own way with a variety of controllers and five game modes.

coveredGames.name: Age Twisters
coveredGames.title: A grandfather and granddaughter receive age twisting bracelets and embark on a journey to find her mother. Twist your age in real time and use unique skills to overcome hazards in a co-op adventure.

coveredGames.name: Elta: Defy All Gods
coveredGames.title: Search for your lost god as a titan and its dragon-god companion. Slam in explosive group fights, explore three worlds full of hidden paths and unlock new moves to bring down the opponent gods.

coveredGames.name: Diggy Diggy Mole
coveredGames.title: Explore four different environments, unlock new abilities, and assist Mole in repaying his debts by finding the lost dwarven treasure. A brand-new NES Metroidvania that comes with a portable ROM file.

coveredGames.name: Keyboard Warrior
coveredGames.title: Slash across your keyboard and through enemies by typing from one key to another. Master your keyboard and take on enemies in different ways with unique items and techniques.

coveredGames.name: Veritas Tales: Witch of the Dark Castle
coveredGames.title: Choose your own adventure RPG handcrafted by Vanillaware’s artist Yoshio Nishimura and FF12’s composer Hitoshi Sakimoto. Make choices, roll the dice and experience a branching story.

coveredGames.name: Oh, My Doug!
coveredGames.title: Crazy hand-drawn metroidvania set inside the body of a middle-aged man who decides to get in shape. Traverse interconnected organs, wield cartoon-logic-powered weapons, and cooperate with yourself.

coveredGames.name: Penguin Colony
coveredGames.title: Experience cosmic horror through the eyes of curious Antarctic penguins as two opposing groups of humans dive deep into frozen landscapes in search of a Lovecraftian ancient being.

coveredGames.name: Lou's Lagoon
coveredGames.title: Collect resources across tropical islands and restore storm-damaged communities as you explore, fly your own customizable seaplane, and take on master ring challenges.

coveredGames.name: Hyper Bun Buster: Rocket Hammer Action
coveredGames.title: Move around and use a huge hammer to smash enemies as quickly as possible without getting damaged! A vibrant action arcade with co-op and an adventure mode featuring unlockable abilities.

coveredGames.name: Bunderkin: The Ocular Eclipse
coveredGames.title: Wind Waker and Majora’s Mask-inspired 3D platformer where you must save the very town that despises you from impending doom. Memorize villager routines, outmaneuver enemies and stop the apocalypse.

coveredGames.name: Flame Hunter: Zhong Kui
coveredGames.title: Zhong Kui passes away and becomes a demon hunter with legendary powers and shapeshifting abilities that lets him turn into the demons he beats. Set out and discover the secrets of the Underworld.

coveredGames.name: After All Is Abraded: A Study on Disappearing Completely
coveredGames.title: A short game, designed to be played in a single session, in which we explore surreal dreams and uncover fragments of the character's memory. A beautiful experience and wonderful abstract visuals.

coveredGames.name: FAT HOBO: Hobocop Saves Christmas
coveredGames.title: Jogo de exploração estranho, em uma cidade pós-soviética, com alguns elementos de combate por turnos, personagens com estética Photo Collage, humor ácido e um caso de assassinato para solucionar.

coveredGames.name: Lenrual
coveredGames.title: A small exploration game set in a strange, abstract world, where we communicate not through words, but through sensory interactions. The atmosphere is beautiful, encouraging one to make discoveries.

coveredGames.name: OKUREK
coveredGames.title: Someone, in a hurry, leaves a note asking you to look after a lovely farm in Switzerland. A cozy game to play in a single run, featuring an incredible atmosphere, yet with some nuances of horror.

coveredGames.name: Yuha's Nightmares. Episode One: Catastrophe
coveredGames.title: A surreal walking simulator that plays with the player's visual and auditory senses. Inspired by the personal stories of developer Yuliya, which reveal the fears and longings of her alter ego.

coveredGames.name: Good Children Say Grace
coveredGames.title: A psychological horror game that borders on the absurd, with its abstract aesthetic and surreal atmosphere. Deep themes are explored, such as grief, an oppressive family, and emotional manipulation.

coveredGames.name: Virus Brain
coveredGames.title: A walking simulator featuring puzzles and the exploration of a surreal, depressing Japanese city. The atmosphere, combined with an incredible soundtrack, is terrifying, yet free of cheap jumpscares.

coveredGames.name: Glitch
coveredGames.title: A horror game drawn entirely by hand, in which we wake up in our room to find the world in a chaotic and strange state. With over 20 different endings, it’s a good choice for a 30mi to 1h play session

coveredGames.name: Hypnostasis
coveredGames.title: A survival horror game set within a claustrophobic fever dream, surrounded by bizarre creatures and an almost omnipresent darkness. Explore unique, interconnected maps with an immersive aesthetic.

coveredGames.name: The House Before
coveredGames.title: Here, you don’t take on the role of an ordinary character; you are a house, tormented by strange beings within your own depths. A dark puzzle game with a surreal atmosphere and an intriguing story.

coveredGames.name: Giants
coveredGames.title: Your job is to investigate completely strange and bizarre apartments for an insurance company. Equipped with your camera, you explore these morbid areas and their surreal inhabitants.

coveredGames.name: Where are the Fish?
coveredGames.title: Driving a pickup truck through an arid desert while carrying a mysterious briefcase, and fishing in completely inhospitable places. An abstract walking simulator with an interesting melancholy.

coveredGames.name: Last Round at the End of the World
coveredGames.title: A peculiar exploration and puzzle game in which you traverse an island with a surrealist aesthetic, following a bizarre ritualistic tradition that demands the sacrifice of one person every year.

coveredGames.name: My Beautiful Faraway, Please Don't Be Cruel To Me
coveredGames.title: A puzzle game with a beautiful, morbid, and dark atmosphere. In a surreal dream, we meet odd characters and immerse ourselves in a story laden with profound themes of the human psyche.

coveredGames.name: Penguin Lifter
coveredGames.title: A short psychological thriller game that blends a tense mood with a tranquil atmosphere. Your task is to help the penguins, improve your base, and stay warm in this mysterious place.

coveredGames.name: RADIOSOL
coveredGames.title: Like a dark version of WALL-E, we take control of a robot in a world where humanity has been decimated by a cataclysm and a simple sunbath can be destructive. A gem for exploration enthusiasts.

coveredGames.name: Please Duology
coveredGames.title: Two cosmic horror short games where we take on different perspectives within the same universe. A machine technician in a strange factory and a soldier exploring the trenches of a war.

coveredGames.name: Serra de Deus
coveredGames.title: You move back to the village of your childhood and mysteriously discover that a series of murders is taking place. Set in Rio de Janeiro, packed with local references and a fun hot dog stand mini-game

coveredGames.name: Project Looking Glass
coveredGames.title: A horror game based on an internet conspiracy theory about a secret military experiment that promised to transport people's consciousness to a future astral plane. Crazy enough to be here.

coveredGames.name: The Hollowing
coveredGames.title: A curious blend of psychological horror and aviation, featuring an incredible atmosphere and interesting gameplay. From the creators of Lorn's Lure.

coveredGames.name: [Bober Bros] The Hole
coveredGames.title: An incredible psychological thriller in which we spy on our strange neighbor's life through a hole in the wall. The dev did an excellent job with the horror atmosphere, avoiding cheap jump scares

coveredGames.name: Brno Transit
coveredGames.title: An absurdly strange subway station, with strange people, and you are just a metro driver.

coveredGames.name: Wittengrad is no more
coveredGames.title: A short, surreal game with an incredible atmosphere. Wittengrad is a city that no longer exists, and you meet its peculiar inhabitants in search of answers.

coveredGames.name: Overstimulacrum
coveredGames.title: An abstract FMV-style experience lasting about 15 minutes. A piece of Gorgonzola cheese (my favorite), donuts, and a bottle of hand sanitizer... perhaps because of COVID.

coveredGames.name: Orderly Havoc
coveredGames.title: Everyone knows that person who is obsessed with cleanliness, but just how far can that go? In this game, we race against time to complete various daily tasks, or things could take a turn for the worse

coveredGames.name: Crabmeat
coveredGames.title: A fishing game that blends elements of horror, point'n'click, and exploration. Work to pay off your debt to the feudal state; otherwise, you and your family will be exiled from the country.

coveredGames.name: CHWÆST: A Creeping Parasite Horror
coveredGames.title: You are an unfortunate explorer who falls into a tunnel inhabited by a bizarre creature. A 20–30min game where the goal is to feed the creature until you find the exit. It’s worth checking out.

coveredGames.name: Dread Fields
coveredGames.title: If you are looking for a relaxing farming game, this isn't the one for you. Here, you must cultivate dark lands with a macabre past and fish in a strange lake. What will your harvest be?

coveredGames.name: OFFERING APP
coveredGames.title: This "game" might be hard to stomach, even for the most enthusiastic Lynchian in this community. We explored a bizarre world with surreal visuals and disturbing mini-games.

coveredGames.name: Beat, Heart, Beat
coveredGames.title: It’s like the lovechild of Geometry Dash and ENA: Dream BBQ. An incredible rhythm game featuring excellent music, stunning visuals, weird characters, and a surrealist aesthetic.

coveredGames.name: Tormentum II
coveredGames.title: David is a committed scientist and technologist who dedicates his life to creating a universe where organic life is unnecessary, yet he becomes a hostage to his own creation. Amazing point and click!

coveredGames.name: Out Of Hands
coveredGames.title: A card battle game with a fantastic art style, featuring extensive use of photo collages and motion. A profound story about losing someone we loved and exploring a world of nightmares and memories.

coveredGames.name: Sonar Shock
coveredGames.title: A dungeon crawler heavily inspired by old-school games like System Shock. With horror elements and resource management mechanics, it offers a challenging experience.

coveredGames.name: TAKE CARE OF THE DOG
coveredGames.title: A hilarious game that I would classify as a horror-comedy. You lovingly care for your Golden Retriever, and gradually, things take a different turn.

coveredGames.name: BRAVO
coveredGames.title: It appears to be a silly 20-minute game, but it ends up surprising us by intelligently presenting a social critique capable of transporting us to interesting perspectives.

coveredGames.name: Mik - Legacy
coveredGames.title: A 15-minute prototype of the upcoming game Mik. Explore a steampunk atmosphere featuring Brutalist environments and parkour-based gameplay.

coveredGames.name: Mama's Sleeping Angels
coveredGames.title: A strange cooperative exploration game set in procedurally generated, psychedelic worlds. The goal is to collect items, use weapons to survive, and feed a grotesque entity named Mama.

coveredGames.name: Creature Kitchen
coveredGames.title: A short game about cooking for strange creatures from a mysterious forest in your secluded cabin. Despite its dark aesthetic, it is a relaxing and cute game.

coveredGames.name: Geamana Village
coveredGames.title: Inspired by the true story of the village of Geamăna, Romania. You are a former investigative journalist seeking professional redemption while exploring the valley and its ecological disaster.

coveredGames.name: The Repairing Mantis
coveredGames.title: A short psychological horror adventure, extremely violent and set in a surrealist world. Don't be fooled by the visuals; this game tackles psychological and existential themes in an intelligent way.

coveredGames.name: ODD HAUL
coveredGames.title: A chaotic co-op trucking game for 1–4 players! Load absurd cargo, strap it down properly, and haul it across a hostile desert without losing the lot. Proximity chat chaos!

coveredGames.name: Last Spin: Survive
coveredGames.title: A roguelite where the slot machine is your lifeline! Spin for resources, weapons, and perks while endless waves close in. Short, chaotic, and endlessly replayable.

coveredGames.name: Aether Soul
coveredGames.title: A striking 2D soulslite with meter-based parries and heavy, deliberate attacks. Dodge, deflect, and punish bosses whose patterns you must learn - not brute force.

coveredGames.name: Arcane Dash - A Pixel Adventure
coveredGames.title: A charming pixel platformer! Dash and double-jump through handcrafted levels, hunt collectibles, and master tight, responsive controls. Nostalgic and satisfying.

coveredGames.name: Off Axis
coveredGames.title: A brutal 3D precision platformer where gravity is your only rule - shifting the world to walk walls and launch across the void. 45 stages, five bosses, and a level editor with Workshop.

coveredGames.name: Night Chain
coveredGames.title: By day you split up to gather and build; by night a chain binds you all around one unlucky player. Keep the sacred fire lit, revive fallen friends, survive endless waves. 1–4 co-op!

coveredGames.name: Sudoku Unlimited
coveredGames.title: Infinite sudoku done right—no DLC, no ads. Classic plus irregular, killer, arrow and thermometer variants, a growing 140-puzzle set, daily puzzles, and two-player online co-op.

coveredGames.name: KICKDOWN: Highway Traffic Racing
coveredGames.title: Pure highway adrenaline! Chain near misses into combos, escape police across 7 regions in 9 modes, and upgrade your ride from street coupe to S-class supercar. 43 achievements.

coveredGames.name: Drawbacks: Draw, Guess, Sabotage
coveredGames.title: The draw-and-guess party game where friends fight dirty! They spend ink on cards that shake, flip, mirror and splatter your doodle while you sketch. 2–16 players online.

coveredGames.name: Ember & Tide
coveredGames.title: Fire meets water and fuses into steam! Share one keyboard as Ember and Tide, solve 30 handcrafted levels across three worlds, then build your own in the editor.

coveredGames.name: Purrtopia: Desktop Cat
coveredGames.title: An adorable pixel-art desktop companion! Your cat strolls above your windows, naps by the cursor, and develops quirky habits. Outfits, toys, and online cat visits.

coveredGames.name: Frontier Tale
coveredGames.title: A surprisingly polished indie gem blending extraction runs with farming and territory building. 60+ bosses, 90+ weapons, comfy music, and a satisfying loot loop.

coveredGames.name: Boing Fight
coveredGames.title: Fast, springy party brawler for 2–4 players on one screen! 150 trap-filled arenas and 18 absurd weapons with glorious physics. Rounds last seconds - perfect couch chaos.

coveredGames.name: Have You Herd?
coveredGames.title: Free-to-play co-op herding chaos for up to 4 players! Bark and howl as Cowboy Maloy's pups, round up stubborn critters, and chase better ranks. Silly, tactical fun.

coveredGames.name: spec
coveredGames.title: A love letter to classic arcade gaming! 66 levels across 11 game modes, plus hidden secrets and bonus modes. A tiny package absolutely packed with skill-testing fun.

coveredGames.name: Timmy’s Dungeon Dive
coveredGames.title: A silly retro roguelite dungeon diver! Time your attacks, blocks and heals against disco zombies and candy demons across five ridiculous dungeons. Funky and charming.

coveredGames.name: Quarantine Zombies - Prologue 2
coveredGames.title: A tense free prologue blending inspection sim with zombie FPS action! Scan refugees for infection, run your own checkpoint, and survive eight days in Chicago.

coveredGames.name: Project SJHG
coveredGames.title: A Korean Souls-like action RPG with a tiger mountain spirit! Restore distorted time and space, regain lost powers, and battle through portals. Gorgeous and ambitious.

coveredGames.name: YoYo Blade
coveredGames.title: A brilliant mouse-only incremental action game! Throw your tethered blade, master its physics, catch it and relaunch faster. Chain kills and hold back the corruption.

coveredGames.name: Gods of the Grid
coveredGames.title: A Greek-myth match-3 roguelite with one life per run! Match runes to strike and heal, uncover each foe's hidden weakness, and draft boons and relics. 60 battles, 9 realms, pure tactical fun.

coveredGames.name: Ironholm: Reign of the Isles
coveredGames.title: A solo-dev medieval RTS where you command whole armies, not individual soldiers. Expand across islands, reinforce key positions, and strike at the right moment. Early Access with huge promise!

coveredGames.name: Lucky Hell
coveredGames.title: A dice roguelite scored on Yahtzee-style hands! Twist the odds with charms and engravings, build poker combos, and survive 36 escalating casino nights. The House is always smiling.

coveredGames.name: Speed Card Eatery
coveredGames.title: A brilliantly frantic card-based restaurant sim! Merge ingredient cards to fill endless beach-stall orders before customers lose patience. Fast hands, faster brain, pure addictive chaos!

coveredGames.name: Dungeoneers Idle
coveredGames.title: An endless idle RPG with no level cap! Build a party from 12 classes, hand them gear, and let them farm procedural dungeons—even offline. Months of progress, not one evening.

coveredGames.name: Space Travelers
coveredGames.title: A wonderfully chill 2D space sim! Mine asteroids, trade minerals, and chart a procedural galaxy—then pin it to your desktop as a live wallpaper. Pure calm.

coveredGames.name: We Are Rebellion
coveredGames.title: Command a rebel warship in a capitalist-ravaged future! Tactical ship combat, crew management, and hard risk-versus-reward calls. A grim, gripping strategy sim.

coveredGames.name: The Ghost and The Phoenix
coveredGames.title: A supernatural neo-classical top-down shooter! Fly as GHOST with the spirit Phoenix, blast possessed war machines, and chase relics across a roguelite loop. Ethereal and addictive!

coveredGames.name: Little St. Files Mayhem
coveredGames.title: A clever first-person filing game! Decipher damaged labels, learn the archive rules, and restore order alone or with up to 3 friends online. Memory-driven co-op fun!

coveredGames.name: The Red Bells Lament
coveredGames.title: A dark fantasy otome VN about a revenge-driven vampire huntress. Volunteer hunters, royal knights, and a ruthless war against the vampire world Nyx. Gorgeous and story-rich!

coveredGames.name: Spin Ball 3D Puzzle
coveredGames.title: A relaxing 3D logic puzzler! Slide blocks, ramps, and tunnels to guide each coloured ball to its matching flag across 400 handcrafted levels. Calm and clever!

coveredGames.name: Blindfold Bash
coveredGames.title: Brilliant hide-and-seek party game for 2–20 players! The seeker is blindfolded and hunts purely by ear. Creaky floors, decoys, and betrayals. Hilarious tension!

coveredGames.name: Bankshot!
coveredGames.title: Real 8-ball pool physics meets roguelike progression! Every shot matters, builds evolve rack by rack, and charming opponents keep you hustling. Pure pool bliss!

coveredGames.name: Kamiyo
coveredGames.title: A dystopian VN about Gods and Godkillers! Live2D sprites, LGBT romance, turn-based deckbuilding combat, and 100k+ words across multiple endings. Deeply immersive!

coveredGames.name: System Arrival
coveredGames.title: A top-down co-op survival RPG for 1–4 players! Fight zombies with weapons and psychic powers, then build and defend your underground bunker. Tense and addictive!

coveredGames.name: Blade Dodger
coveredGames.title: Fast, frantic 2D arena survival! Dodge deadly blades, fight back with abilities, and pick from four specializations. Solo or 2–4 player local and online co-op. Pure arcade chaos!

coveredGames.name: Corridor 13
