coveredGames.name: Strange Antiquities
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 2/10 - extremely relaxing. An amazing follow up to Strange Horticulture, with even more puzzles and things to identify. No timer, so you can take your time. Very immersive.

coveredGames.name: Strange Horticulture
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 2/10 - extremely relaxing. An amazing puzzle game where you solve riddles, identify plants, and change the story based on which plant you've chosen for the customer. Very immersive.

coveredGames.name: Assemble with Care
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 2/10 - extremely relaxing. Very short, but very sweet game with a great story. It feels very pleasant to fix stuff, it feels tactile even though it's done with mouse. Great art & music

coveredGames.name: Charm Studies
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 2/10 - extremely relaxing. A short nonogram game with an adorable story! The timer can be turned off, so you can relax and solve the puzzles at your own pace.

coveredGames.name: blockia
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 2/10 - extremely relaxing. A cute sandbox for building lego blocks. There are recipes, free play, and also a way to play with friends!

coveredGames.name: Selkie's Salvage&Co.
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 3/10 - very relaxing. Just a cozy fishing incremental, you are a robot made by a cute mouse, and your job is to clean the ocean. Feels good to clean, and the progress feels rewarding!

coveredGames.name: A Place for Every Potion
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 2/10 - extremely relaxing. Cool sorter combined with that silly vial game where you pour colors until they're sorted! There's no time pressure, and there is a cat!

coveredGames.name: Dressmaker
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 2/10 - extremely relaxing. Very satisfying and realistic sewing, good for anyone, you don't even have to like dresses, or sewing! There's no timer and a lot of creative freedom <3

coveredGames.name: Deleted Wiki: Clean Up the Lost Files
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 2/10 - extremely relaxing. Another amazing sorting game! Nostalgic vibes, great sorting upgrades and mechanics, and I loved the story! The updates on the forum were very funny.

coveredGames.name: Wands & Whiskers
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 2/10 - extremely relaxing. Cute watching all the cats, collecting all the different ones, even shiny versions. Play with the wand to speed the process, or turn off and come back later.

coveredGames.name: The Zachtronics Solitaire Collection
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 4/10 - relaxing. A great collection of solitaires from zachtronics games, plus one extra that isn't in any of the games! Can get pretty challenging, but you can take your time~

coveredGames.name: PawMart Tiny Market
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 3/10 - very relaxing. Cute little bottom-of-your-screen idler. Something to do when you don't have the energy for a full-screen game, but still want to be gaming ^.^

coveredGames.name: Bento Blocks
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 3/10 - very relaxing. Thinky game that reminds me of inbento. Very clever puzzles! There's 7 chapters, and each adds some new interesting mechanic.

coveredGames.name: Cozy Cleaner
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 2/10 - extremely relaxing. Very true to its name, it is cozy, and you clean~ It's simple and relaxing, and there's a cat!

coveredGames.name: The Planet Crafter
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 3/10 - very relaxing. Despite a not very cozy setting where you are a prisoner forced to terraform a planet, The grinding and exploring in this game feels relaxing and satisfying.

coveredGames.name: Lil Gator Game
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 1/10 - completely stress-free. An extremely cute game about a relationship between siblings, reminiscing the past fun they had before one had to go to college, and making new friends!

coveredGames.name: Big Walk
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 2/10 - extremely relaxing. What a nice way to spend time with friends! We explore and keep running into fun challenges. And it works great even if you use text instead of voice chat.

coveredGames.name: Put Back Stuff
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 3/10 - very relaxing. Another cool sorting game! No time pressure, good accessibility options, art & vibe is very nice. AND the dev listens to feedback!

coveredGames.name: We Are Gum
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 3/10 - very relaxing. Adorable thinky sokoban with handcrafted puzzles and art, and great hints that don't spoil the entire solution, but nudge you in the right direction <3

coveredGames.name: Puppergeist
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 2/10 - extremely relaxing. An adorable and emotional short story with easy and very fun rhythm minigames <3

coveredGames.name: Cleaning Up The Puzzle Gallery
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 2/10 - extremely relaxing. A very cool puzzle sorting game, another one of these where you unlock more skills and go faster and faster! Can also upload your own files for puzzles!

coveredGames.name: Leaf it Alone
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 2/10 - extremely relaxing. Cleaning up leaf by leaf, and getting more tools to do it faster and faster, unlocking new abilities and perks :3 Very fun!

coveredGames.name: Shelves and Sorcery: Tidy Up the Enchanted Shop
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 2/10 - extremely relaxing. Another sorting game with lots of various items! Very fun and colorful. Can pick the casual mode if you don't like time pressure!

coveredGames.name: Purr in Bloom
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 2/10 - extremely relaxing. A cute game featuring a sudoku-like logic game known as "two not touch", but with cats. There's no time pressure.

coveredGames.name: Cat Isle
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 3/10 - very relaxing. Similar to Minami Lane, but original enough to be a separate game :) You manage the restaurants for kitties, and you can take it slow of make time go faster.

coveredGames.name: The Mermaid Mask
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 3/10 - very relaxing. A cozy and interesting point&click detective game, where the puzzles make you feel smart, there is no time pressure, and there are hints in case you get stuck!

coveredGames.name: Tangle Tower
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 3/10 - very relaxing. A cozy and interesting point&click detective game, where the puzzles make you feel smart, there is no time pressure, and there are hints in case you get stuck!

coveredGames.name: Hexzen
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 3/10 - very relaxing. A simple hexagon minesweeper. Sadly, just like in minesweeper, guessing is unavoidable sometimes - but there are no bombs, you don't fail when you make a mistake.

coveredGames.name: Many Nights a Whisper
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 3/10 - very relaxing. You've been training for years, landing that single shot at the ritual night is everything. There is definitely pressure, but the game feels slow and meditative.

coveredGames.name: FIND KITTENS 2: Crafts
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 1/10 - completely stress-free. Just a cozy hidden cats game, very cute! I especially like the drawing getting colored in once I find all of the cats in that specific area.

coveredGames.name: FIND KITTENS: The last of cats
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 1/10 - completely stress-free. Just a cozy hidden cats game, very cute! I especially like the drawing getting colored in once I find all of the cats in that specific area.

coveredGames.name: FIND KITTENS 4: Aetherpunk
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 1/10 - completely stress-free. Just a cozy hidden cats game, very cute! I especially like the drawing getting colored in once I find all of the cats in that specific area.

coveredGames.name: FIND KITTENS 7: Cookie Town
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 1/10 - completely stress-free. Just a cozy hidden cats game, very cute! I especially like the drawing getting colored in once I find all of the cats in that specific area.

coveredGames.name: FIND KITTENS 6: After us
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 1/10 - completely stress-free. Just a cozy hidden cats game, very cute! I especially like the drawing getting colored in once I find all of the cats in that specific area.

coveredGames.name: Discounty
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 4/10 - relaxing. There is some time pressure during the selling part, but overall it's a relaxing experience and has a satisfying game loop.

coveredGames.name: SUMMERHOUSE
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 2/10 - extremely relaxing. It's a simple building game that is mostly 2D, and yet you are able to create 3d-looking pixel buildings that look cozy~ There's no goal other than fun!

coveredGames.name: It's Kooky - Land of Aotearoa
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 2/10 - extremely relaxing. Simple hidden object game. I specifically like this series because everything you find is different and weird. You look for stuff that looks out of place : D

coveredGames.name: 100 Hidden Kooky & Hiking Boots
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 2/10 - extremely relaxing. Simple hidden object game. I specifically like this series because everything you find is different and weird. You look for stuff that looks out of place : D

coveredGames.name: 100 Hidden Kooky - Sand & Sun
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 2/10 - extremely relaxing. Simple hidden object game. I specifically like this series because everything you find is different and weird. You look for stuff that looks out of place : D

coveredGames.name: It's Kooky
coveredGames.title: Cortisol Level: 2/10 - extremely relaxing. Simple hidden object game. I specifically like this series because everything you find is different and weird. You look for stuff that looks out of place : D

coveredGames.name: Dark Scrolls
coveredGames.title: With Gato Roboto, Demon Throttle (a Switch physical exclusive), and Gunbrella under their belts, doinksoft ply their skills to a roguelite bullethell platformer. Published by Devolver Digital.

coveredGames.name: BOXROOM
coveredGames.title: A swing at making your Steam library feel more tangible, where this room designing game pulls your games onto digitized boxes and posters. Published by Pantaloon.

coveredGames.name: Deer & Boy
coveredGames.title: A beautiful and tender cinematic platformer where you play as a kid and his newfound fawn friend. Aims to be poetic and emotional, a playable animated film. Published by Dear Villagers.

coveredGames.name: HUNTDOWN: OVERTIME
coveredGames.title: The original Huntdown is one of the tightest run and gun games of recent memory, so it getting a roguelite prequel is hella hype. Crazy good pixel art too. Published by Coffee Stain.

coveredGames.name: KIBORG
coveredGames.title: An action roguelite where the clock's ticking. The Redeemer devs' newest sci-fi game tackles procedurally-generated missions where you play how you like! Demo available.

coveredGames.name: Inspector Waffles Early Days
coveredGames.title: Inspector Waffles is quite the underrated point & click adventure, so it's cool to see this cat returning in this top-down prequel inspired by the Gameboy era.

coveredGames.name: Drova - Forsaken Kin
coveredGames.title: An action RPG drawing inspiration from grimdark fantasy and Celtic mythos in a handcrafted open world setting. Two joinable factions, combat with an emphasis on flow. Published by Deck13.

coveredGames.name: Sol Cesto
coveredGames.title: Roguelite tactical dungeon crawling across five biomes, with 10 playable characters. Nice hand-drawn art to capture its dark fantasy world. Co-published by Goblinz and Maple Whispering.

coveredGames.name: Everdeep Aurora
coveredGames.title: With its utterly awe-inspiring pixel art and palettes, rich atmosphere, and drilling gameplay, Everdeep Aurora is one helluva promising explorative platformer. Published by Ysbryd.

coveredGames.name: Sintopia
coveredGames.title: You become Hell's preliminary bureaucrat in this melding of a god game on the surface, with a city builder below, each feeding into the other half. Published by Team17.

coveredGames.name: Arashi Gaiden
coveredGames.title: Spinning off of 2023's Pocket Bravery, Arashi Gaiden here is a frenetic turn-based actioner with glorious pixel art. Demo available. By the Red Ronin and Cardboard Town devs. Published by Statera.

coveredGames.name: Forestrike
coveredGames.title: Brought to you by the Olija dev, Forestrike is a tactical roguelite kung fu title where you can practice fights through visualizing them beforehand. Published by Devolver Digital.

coveredGames.name: New Arc Line
coveredGames.title: Steampunk and fantasy magic converge in New Arc Line, a party-based RPG where your character customization will be more narratively impactful. Published by Fulqrum.

coveredGames.name: Tormenture
coveredGames.title: Retro horror drawing upon 80's computer games, with an interconnected world to explore and uncover the mysteries of. Published by Billete Cohete (the Blasphemous devs' publishing front).

coveredGames.name: Seafrog
coveredGames.title: A side-scrolling, skateboarding action/platformer with an outstanding, vibrant art style and an exhilarating sense of speed. Now published by Grumpyface.

coveredGames.name: Moves Of The Diamond Hand
coveredGames.title: A first-person narrative RPG follow-up to Betrayal at Club Low. As ever with an Off-Peak City entry, it's bizarre and surreal and probably hilarious. Demo available.

coveredGames.name: Gunboat God
coveredGames.title: At last, a new entry into the subgenre of blistering shmups in the vein of Luftrausers—though this reminds me more of SUBS, it looks like it'll stand on its own. Published by Fireshine.

coveredGames.name: Merp in Merpworld
coveredGames.title: With its delightful vibes and tranquil tunes, Merp in Merpworld is quite the departure from maybell's magnificent twinstick, satryn deluxe. However, the cuteness and vibrancy remain.

coveredGames.name: Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks
coveredGames.title: Vehicular combat from the team behind the banger GRIP: Combat Racing, but with Warhammer 40K orks? Hell yeah! Plus it's no longer free-to-play. Now published by Wired.

coveredGames.name: Reavers of New Rome
coveredGames.title: A dope 3D action/adventure across a sci-fi Roman world. Great low-poly art. By Renegade Sector (the Thunder Kid and Space Captain McCallery dev).

coveredGames.name: Monomyth
coveredGames.title: A first-person dungeon crawler inspired by Ultima: Underworld, Arx Fatalis, and King's Field with superb visuals.

coveredGames.name: Penguin Colony
coveredGames.title: A magnificent and unorthodox walking simulator inspired by H.P. Lovecraft's At the Mountains of Madness. Go through 7 penguin forms, exploring deep lore and a vast unsettling frozen world. Love it.

coveredGames.name: No Murders in Grimwick
coveredGames.title: A 45-min cozy mystery with some creepiness sprinkled on top. Investigate the Grimwick harvest festival's “accidents” through cute art & witty lines, but careful not to end up on the village's bad side

coveredGames.name: Where Pandas 熊猫在哪里
coveredGames.title: 10 min HOG including 100 pandas and a couple side tiems. More challenging than Where Foxes from the same company, but not quite as polished. Fun if you enjoy smaller items to find with a limited zoom.

coveredGames.name: Where Foxes 狐狸在哪里
coveredGames.title: 100 adorable hidden foxes that are quick, but fun to find. Extremely short, but very well QoL-equipped and with bonus side elements to search for!

coveredGames.name: MyDear.exe
coveredGames.title: A fully voiced, adorable love story between two septuagenarians told through an old PC full of mini-games. ~1h30 of gaming references and heartwarming, human moments. Prefect for a cozy evening 🤍

coveredGames.name: Case Solved: The London Files
coveredGames.title: Solid deduction game offering around 65 levels and 6h of content. It's light on story and sometimes awkwardly worded, but a good time for puzzle lovers.

coveredGames.name: Replay Value: Second Hand Games
coveredGames.title: A bright game shop sim full of nerd references and great humor. Perfect to scratch that repetitive, grindy itch, but still in need of a lot of balancing at launch. Keep a close look on future patches.

coveredGames.name: Hidden Gnomes
coveredGames.title: Great replayability and a fun twist on the regular HOG system, but keep in mind it's VERY repetitive and not completionist-friendly at all. Worth a look for casual players though.

coveredGames.name: Where is My Pet?
coveredGames.title: Rescue pets, manage a shelter and try to finally reach home ownership in this repetitive, but adorable sim! Cute & accessible, but only so enjoyable if you overlook some little details.

coveredGames.name: Hidden Raccoons in Winter
coveredGames.title: 90 cute trash pandas to find across 4 cute pixelated levels! A fun winter HOG, but its 6-minute runtime and underwhelming magnifying glass (zoom) make a big sale your best bet.

coveredGames.name: 101 Dogs Hidden in Shenzhen
coveredGames.title: A good HOG for those enjoying microscopic elements to find. It's quick, affordable and great for achievement hunters, but it's a squinting fest and kinda limited otherwise, so be warned.

coveredGames.name: Hidden Raccoons in Asia
coveredGames.title: 90 little pixel raccoons hidden in 4 short levels. It's very cute and fun, but wait for a sale unless you don't mind a 10min-only hidden object game (HOG).

coveredGames.name: Tidy Backpack: In the Faraway Lands
coveredGames.title: 100 calm little puzzles for around 4h of gameplay. It's not as funny as the first game, but just as fun puzzle-wise. Worth a look if you want something chill and easy to pick up from time to time.

coveredGames.name: Squirrel Stapler
coveredGames.title: Stapling squirrels to your beloved is a totally normal behavior. This is totally not an unhinged, surreal horror game full of secrets and making you question your sanity (/s). Worth a shot on sale 🐿️

coveredGames.name: 20 More, Somehow Even Smaller, Mazes
coveredGames.title: FREE 20 tiny, interesting and creative puzzles spread throughout an hour of gameplay with strong accessibility options and intuitive options. What more can you ask for?

coveredGames.name: KARMA: The Dark World
coveredGames.title: A surreal Orwell sci-fi thriller blending psychological horror, dystopian mind-diving and interactive-movie vibes. Gorgeous, atmospheric and best experienced knowing absolutely nothing beforehand.

coveredGames.name: The Bird of the North
coveredGames.title: A cozy supernatural mystery set in 1921! Use a magic crystal to investigate a missing spirit, sort timelines, and expose the Empire's lies in this short detective adventure. Not very unique, but fun!

coveredGames.name: Dyping Escape
coveredGames.title: A 2h, fourth-wall breaking, meta-horror game where a sentient being invades your PC & you have to type (or not) to survive. Great vibe and the cat helper is adorable, but it's very short for its price

coveredGames.name: Shelve the Potions!
coveredGames.title: Sort nearly 2000 flasks across 28 puzzles while cats judge your organizational skills. Great for those enjoying mindless sorting, but not it for the puzzles. Worth a look especially if you avoid AI 🤍

coveredGames.name: 100 Goblin Cats
coveredGames.title: 5 minutes of cat hunting for the low, low price of your wallet's dignity. Not even cute art or forgiving hints are worth that much. Not bad but wildly too expensive compared to similar games out there

coveredGames.name: Curious Paws: hidden objects
coveredGames.title: A colorful, cozy HOG with 7 bite-sized levels, clever themes, great zoom and tons of bugs to find. Perfect for both HOG regulars and newcomers looking for a relaxing little hunt. 100% worth it 🤍

coveredGames.name: The Forgotten City
coveredGames.title: A phenomenal time-loop mystery with deep storytelling, unforgettable characters, historical details & 4 endings. Think outside the box, question EVERYTHING and prepare to lose your sanity XD

coveredGames.name: This Is Fine: Maximum Cope
coveredGames.title: [Pre-100%] Funny meme vibes with approachable platforming & a great little dog we all know, but repetitive objectives, many technical issues & a steep price-to-playtime ratio make it so underwhelming.

coveredGames.name: Cozy Game Restoration
coveredGames.title: [PLAYTEST] Restore grimy game cartridges at your own pace with satisfying cleaning tools and fun side elements. Cozy and promising, though it could really use a tutorial and clearer cleaning progress.

coveredGames.name: Dark Pals: The 1st Floor
coveredGames.title: Great ambiance, polished assets & compelling lore, but the multiple progression-breaking bugs stopped my playthrough entirely. Worth watching for the fun puzzles & the cute doggie, but not buying yet.

coveredGames.name: 100 Marshmallow Cats
coveredGames.title: It's colorful and fun to finish, but only lasts 4 minutes. Very expensive for the amount of content, though it's better than other games from the same studio. Make an informed purchse if interested.

coveredGames.name: Hidden Dogs
coveredGames.title: A 60 min dog HOG where the canines finally steal the spotlight. The instant hint system is original, there's a funny ambiance and lots of small, easy & accessible levels. Worth a look on sale!

coveredGames.name: Tinkering Is Enough
coveredGames.title: Super easy cozy repair puzzler with funny ideas and quirky customer letters. Short and rough around the edges, but with enough potential to keep an eye on future updates.

coveredGames.name: Creature Kitchen
coveredGames.title: A cozy, eerie cooking game! Feed adorable cryptids, explore a spooky house and fully relax with 0 jumpscares. Also, yes, you can scare the raccoon. Perfect for the creepy but calm game lover!

coveredGames.name: Hidden Cats in Barcelona
coveredGames.title: Cute maps and solid QoL options, but far easier and shorter than past entries. Add the ongoing “Hidden Cats” copyright controversy, and this becomes a very hard game to recommend.

coveredGames.name: Save My Scrap
coveredGames.title: A short but impactful VN where you repair androids and get hit with an existential heartbreak. Great writing, meaningful choices, and enough emotional damage to justify every minute.

coveredGames.name: Call of the Elder Gods
coveredGames.title: Fantastic late-game puzzles trapped in an average story / characters. Great for escape room fans and puzzlers, but don’t come expecting real Lovecraft horror. Wait for a bigger discount or less bugs.

coveredGames.name: 100 Tiki Cats
coveredGames.title: Completely forgettable HOG. It's not that bad, just pricy. The QoL options are good as usual, but it's short, with a loopy OST and burried under the usual mountain of achievements.

coveredGames.name: 100 Archeology Cats
coveredGames.title: A brighter and more interesting hidden cat hunt than usual, but still painfully short for the price. Great QoL, decent placements, suspiciously cat-shaped cats. Okay game as long as you're informed.

coveredGames.name: Witch You Want
coveredGames.title: FREE, cozy potion brewing with cutesy vibes and a short story. Super easy, super soft, and 100%ed in under an hour. Come for the cauldron, stay for the adorable pastel witch yuri boss.

coveredGames.name: Briefcase
coveredGames.title: [Pre-100%] Resident Evil item management without the zombies (literally). Starts super easy, then hits hard near the end. Satisfying, a bit chaotic, and without meaningful hints so bring in patience.

coveredGames.name: Forbidden Solitaire
coveredGames.title: Creepy retro solitaire with grotesque monsters, but a very casual gameplay. It's more vibes and zero challenge, but if eerie aesthetics are your thing, this one’s hard to pass for a short, good time.

coveredGames.name: Rumbral
coveredGames.title: It's so eerie & creepy! A good time if you enjoyed A Little Nightmare, with interesting box and lever puzzles. It's short and slightly buggy tho, so maybe wait for a discount, but 100% worth the vibe!

coveredGames.name: Hidden Tomatoes
coveredGames.title: FREE, fast tomato hunt with clever placements and fun achievements. It's centered around angles and playful zoom usage so be prepared to squint! A very engaging and interesting hunts for all HOG fans!

coveredGames.name: Hidden Tails
coveredGames.title: Challenging 360° mouse hunt with cozy story mode and mini-games. Great content and clever hiding spots, but the camera will test your stomach. Not for motion-sensitive players or pure cozy game lovers

coveredGames.name: Pidgeon Pocket
coveredGames.title: Lianes8 Studio - Seville, Spain. A point-and-click game where strategy and choosing your upgrades matter. The Kairosoft aesthetic and the music is really good. Solo developer, low price, give it a try

coveredGames.name: Thronefall
coveredGames.title: GrizzlyGames - Germany (A minimalist game about building and defending a little kingdom. Thronefall is a classic strategy game without unnecessary complexity)

coveredGames.name: REFLECT89
coveredGames.title: EiSee Games - Seville, Spain. Demo available check it out!!

coveredGames.name: The Zibbo Show
coveredGames.title: Tessera Games - Spain. To me, it's like Balatro and Gwent had a baby with its own distinctive identity. It's a really fun game, and after finishing the demo, I wanted more. Give this game a go!

coveredGames.title: Kerzoven - Switzerland

coveredGames.name: Reshine
coveredGames.title: Quite OK games - Poland

coveredGames.title: Wispfire - Netherlands

coveredGames.name: MR. RECORDS
coveredGames.title: Glee-Cheese Studio - France. (Demo) The original soundtrack is nice, the gameplay in the musical part seems a little basic in the demo, but the part of the shop I really liked that. Try it. A

coveredGames.name: Tropico 7
coveredGames.title: Gaming Minds Studios - Germany (Demo) The 3D characters and beautifully crafted buildings look great, but I need more playtime to see any major improvements over Tropico 6. Need to see more.

coveredGames.name: Inkblood
coveredGames.title: Hey Bird! - Czechia (Demo) As a lover of case solving this game has so many mechanics and feels so good while playing it. The art style is superb and I need to know how the story unfolds, incredible A

coveredGames.name: Chrono

coveredGames.name: Dadi Kingdom
coveredGames.title: Dadi Entertainment - Würzburg, Germany (Demo Available)

coveredGames.name: Nivalis Nights
coveredGames.title: ION LANDS - Germany

coveredGames.name: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival
coveredGames.title: Mad Head Games - Serbia

coveredGames.name: runz
coveredGames.title: Sardin Ventures - France. I love the Brotato/Balatro feel. You have different characters, bosses, synergies, and bullets (so much content and possibilities!) And the devs are all in on this. Try it!

coveredGames.name: Planet Zoo 2
coveredGames.title: Frontier - UK

coveredGames.name: Noita
coveredGames.title: Nolla Games - Finland. I have a friend who loves it so much, and they hyped me up to try it. I haven't had the time to do so yet, but the unique mechanics it has are incredible.

coveredGames.name: Hunting Simulator 3
coveredGames.title: Nacon Studio Ghent - Belgium

coveredGames.name: SULFUR
coveredGames.title: Perfect Random - Sweden

coveredGames.name: Moadra

coveredGames.title: Memel Games - Lithuania. Having the world at your reach to connect is pretty neat, more so when you can do it by rail, sea, road, sky. Little complexity managing, economy only goes up but entertaining

coveredGames.name: DmC: Devil May Cry
coveredGames.title: Ninja Theory - UK. I love the hack-and-slash games made by this developer. I haven't played the other DMC games, but this one is really good. The combat feels dynamic and it's fun to play.

coveredGames.name: Battletoads
coveredGames.title: Dlala Studios - UK. I LOVED the animation and art direction. The combat is fine and has enough changes of pace to keep you glued to your seat until you finish it. It's a great compact game to enjoy.

creators.name: Puzzles Are A Very Satisfactory Diversion

coveredGames.name: He Who Watches
coveredGames.title: Some of the best use of 3D space in any puzzle game. You need to be good at visualising 3D spaces, but if you can you'll be rewarded with some really interesting mechanics to ponder.

coveredGames.name: Elementalist
coveredGames.title: Can't remember the last time I was so immediately hooked by a game as the first 10 minutes of Elementalist. Has some realtime execution, but really evil platforming is kept to the optional 'S' levels.

coveredGames.name: where's my egg?
coveredGames.title: Mechanically this game is not especially innovative, but top tier level design elevates it to the status of an unmissable classic.

coveredGames.name: MotionRec
coveredGames.title: A playful little puzzle platformer about creating custom moves from your own recorded path. No hard dexterity challenges. All tricky puzzles are optional.

coveredGames.name: Glowkeeper
coveredGames.title: A nice mix of high quality standalone puzzles and connected world exploration-based puzzles.

coveredGames.name: Denshattack!
coveredGames.title: Wonderful take on Tony Hawk games but with trains! It's got all kinds of mechanics and the story is interesting as well. You gotta check this out if you like doing tricks. 8/10

coveredGames.name: GeoDepths
coveredGames.title: Lonely with no combat but exciting world! Consider GeoDepths for the pure exploration. Pick it up on sale and don't rush. Really fun little game. 6-7/10

coveredGames.name: Shelldiver
coveredGames.title: Cute incremental game. Very well done skill tree which has a great pay off. The loop gets a little boring by the end but it's one of those games that gets crazy. As far as this genre goes it's an 8/10

coveredGames.name: All Hail the Orb
coveredGames.title: Incremental game with some style! Assigning cultist to a station is unique and it has great art. I had a lot of fun seeing where the game would go next. 7/10

coveredGames.name: Blood Dungeon
coveredGames.title: Hard to put down! Frantic and challenging though. You should pick this up if you're a fan of difficult games with a progression system. You must get unlocks to go on deep runs. 7/10 but maybe 8/10?

coveredGames.name: Drill Bird
coveredGames.title: Like Steamworld dig but very short and casual. This let me chill for an hour and I liked it. Could see replaying to get all the achievements for more. 7/10

coveredGames.name: I Am Your Beast
coveredGames.title: Really smart and funny! I had an absolute blast playing this FPS. Great style and it makes you feel good dunking on the poor saps sent after you.

coveredGames.name: BALL x PIT
coveredGames.title: Really solid game that puts its own spin on the auto-shooter genre. It stands out artistically and mechanically from a lot of other games I've played. Definitely worth checking out.

coveredGames.name: Wheel World
coveredGames.title: Open world racing game. Good visuals and bike mechanics are great. Not perfect though. Drags at end and sometimes weird physics. Bike parts are kinda meaningless. Still fun, light 7/10

coveredGames.name: South of Midnight
coveredGames.title: Incredible audio! Neat animation and a compelling story. Has it's flaws. Combat is meh, exploration is fine. Got a bit boring by end. Can see plot twists a mile away. Had fun, good game. 7 or 8/10

coveredGames.name: Crypt Custodian
coveredGames.title: Really enjoyed this one! Solid story as well. I made a lot of friends and they were all pretty cool to hang out with. I enjoyed doing crime with them. 8/10

coveredGames.name: Eternal Strands
coveredGames.title: Climbing big bosses is fantastic! Enjoyed the art style, writing, and combat. The character movement is solid. Enjoyed everything about it. This is easily and 8/10 but maybe a 9.

coveredGames.name: Crime Scene Cleaner
coveredGames.title: Meditative and a bit ridiculous at times. If you like power wash sim then you'll like this. Basic but interesting story, some rough edges. Strong 7/10

coveredGames.name: Deck of Haunts
coveredGames.title: One of those hidden gems that will make outwards melt away effortlessly. See my full review for more.

coveredGames.name: Project manager SIM
coveredGames.title: A very well done management game, lots of fun. See full review for more.

coveredGames.name: Stolen Realm
coveredGames.title: Good game with friends or solo. See full review for more.

coveredGames.name: Returns Outlet Simulator
coveredGames.title: Underrated game, lost 12 hours without trying, it is quite fun. See full review for more.

coveredGames.name: STAR WARS Zero Company™
coveredGames.title: Very good game, well worth the full rpice I paid for it, which is rare. See full review for more details.

coveredGames.name: WE ARE FOOTBALL 2024
coveredGames.title: It's good but far from great yet. See full review for more.

coveredGames.name: Gargadusa's Tower
coveredGames.title: One of the best and most immersive text based simulation/management games I have ever played. Highly recommend.

coveredGames.name: The Riftbreaker
coveredGames.title: Not bad, better with friends.

coveredGames.name: Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors
coveredGames.title: Very good game, and great idea from an already great game before it.

coveredGames.name: Be My Horde
coveredGames.title: Another in a long line of this type of game lately but this one stands out as one of the better ones.

coveredGames.name: Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord
coveredGames.title: It's pretty good, not great. See full review for more.

coveredGames.name: TerraTech Legion
coveredGames.title: Great fun, pleasantly surprised at how well done this one is. See full review for more details.

coveredGames.title: Finally a game worthy of being called as good as Xcom 2. See full review for more.

coveredGames.name: The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria™
coveredGames.title: Fun game with friends.

coveredGames.name: Dwarves: Glory, Death and Loot
coveredGames.title: Extremely fun and addictive. See full review for more details.

coveredGames.name: Tales & Tactics
coveredGames.title: A quick growing new favorite genre for me is single player Auto Battelrs, so finding good ones is my goal, and this is a good one.

coveredGames.name: Out of the Park Baseball 27
coveredGames.title: Great as always! See full review for more.

coveredGames.name: Slay the Spire 2
coveredGames.title: A nice upgrade from the original, especially since it now has multiplayer! Co-op with up to 4 players is a lot of fun and well done.

coveredGames.name: Imaginytes
coveredGames.title: A good TD game that takes a little getting used to.

coveredGames.name: Cosmoteer: Starship Architect & Commander
coveredGames.title: Good game, not great, just good. See full review for more.

coveredGames.title: Very good remaster. Great game to play multi-player.

coveredGames.name: Age of Wonders 4
coveredGames.title: Great game with friends.

coveredGames.title: Relaxing and well done game. A great way to chill to a game you do not need to think too much about.

coveredGames.name: Escape Simulator 2

coveredGames.name: Emberward
coveredGames.title: Very good TD game, must play in my opinion. See full review for details.

coveredGames.title: Everyone knows I love a good TD game and this is a very good TD game. See full review for more details.

coveredGames.name: BALL x PIT
coveredGames.title: One of the most addictive games I have ever come across.

coveredGames.name: The Alters: Original Soundtrack
coveredGames.title: Verdict: play. The Alters: Original Soundtrack is a varied and distinctive soundtrack with some lovely compositions and interesting instrumentation. 8/10.

coveredGames.name: The Rise of the Golden Idol Soundtrack
coveredGames.title: Verdict: play. The Rise of the Golden Idol Soundtrack is an eclectic, atmospheric soundtrack that may not stand out on its own, but does wonders for the game's mysterious and unsettling mood. 8/10.

coveredGames.name: The Rise of the Golden Idol
coveredGames.title: Verdict: play. The Rise of the Golden Idol is a bigger sequel with more to offer, but not quite the same magic, complexity, or sinister charm as the original. 8/10.

coveredGames.name: Atomfall
coveredGames.title: Verdict: mixed. Fantastic exploration, atmosphere, and quest design, held back by clunky combat, pointless stealth, restrictive inventory management, and a few frustrating design choices. 7/10.

coveredGames.name: Social Services of the Doomed
coveredGames.title: Verdict: play. SSotD has great writing, clever worldbuilding, and thoughtful social commentary, but it's slightly held back by underdeveloped romances, wonky portraits, and a rushed ending. 8/10.

coveredGames.name: The Passenger
coveredGames.title: Verdict: mixed. A promising eldritch horror with some lovely character moments, but its linear storytelling and increasingly convoluted second half kept me from fully embracing the experience. 7/10.

coveredGames.name: Bootlegger: Moonshine Empire
coveredGames.title: Verdict: play. A surprisingly rich Prohibition-era crime drama with excellent writing, meaningful choices, and plenty of branching, even if it occasionally tries to do a little too much at once. 8/10.

coveredGames.name: 007 First Light
coveredGames.title: Verdict: EASY play. 007 First Light is a terrific Bond origin story that proves the world’s most famous spy had to learn how to be more than just a man who could save himself. 10/10.

coveredGames.name: Paradox Factor
coveredGames.title: Verdict: play. Paradox Factor is a clever little time-travel puzzle with a surprisingly thoughtful message, held back by clunky navigation and uninspired prose. 7/10.

coveredGames.name: Frostpunk 2
coveredGames.title: Verdict: EASY play. A gorgeous, engaging society simulator that makes governing a city as compelling as building one, and reminds you that survival means nothing without hope for the future. 10/10.

coveredGames.name: The Last Wizard
coveredGames.title: Verdict: mixed. A fun power fantasy with satisfying choices and magic, held back by rushed pacing, bland prose, and romances that make saving the world feel easier than getting a date. 6/10.

coveredGames.name: Frostpunk 2: Original Soundtrack
coveredGames.title: Verdict: play. Another banger by a genius composer! 8/10.

coveredGames.name: Project Zomboid
coveredGames.title: Verdict: easy play. A brutally unforgiving survival sandbox where every little victory feels earned, and every death makes you want to try just one more time. 9/10.

coveredGames.name: Chicken Police - Paint it RED!
coveredGames.title: Verdict: play. A surprisingly well-written noir mystery with great characters, a killer jazz soundtrack, and more heart than you'd expect from a game about a rooster detective. 8/10.

coveredGames.name: Frostpunk Expansions Original Soundtrack
coveredGames.title: Verdict: play. A somber, beautifully composed extension of Frostpunk 1’s soundtrack, even if it doesn’t offer quite enough music to leave a lasting impression. 7/10.

coveredGames.name: The Incident at Galley House
coveredGames.title: Verdict: EASY play. Galley House is a brilliant, spooky, mind-bending detective game that trusts you to put the pieces together yourself—and might just be my 2026 mystery GOTY. 10/10.

coveredGames.name: Hunter: The Reckoning — Day For Night
coveredGames.title: Verdict: EASY play. Day for Night is a mechanically rich, choice-packed Hunter experience with visceral combat and a fantastic setting. Just don't go in expecting the same for prose or romance. 9/10.

coveredGames.name: Sniper Elite 5
coveredGames.title: Verdict: easy play. Sniper Elite 5 is a gorgeous, wonderfully open-ended sniper sandbox where every map feels like a puzzle you get to solve your own way. 9/10.

coveredGames.name: Dungeons & Degenerate Gamblers
coveredGames.title: Verdict: play. Such an underrated gem of a roguelike. RNG is everywhere, but so are ways to manipulate it, mitigate it, and occasionally weaponize it. 9/10.

coveredGames.name: Resident Evil 6
coveredGames.title: Verdict: mixed. A bloated, ridiculous mess of a game that's fun with a friend, but absolutely miserable when it isn't. 6/10.

coveredGames.name: Aviary Attorney
coveredGames.title: Verdict: play. A four-hour bird lawyer game has absolutely no business hitting this hard. 9/10.

coveredGames.name: An Unexpectedly Green Journey
coveredGames.title: Verdict: EASY play. If you’ve never played IF before, play this. Green is an absurdly deep, replayable sandbox that lets you play as an ORC and do whatever the hell you want. 10/10.

coveredGames.name: Monster Train 2
coveredGames.title: Verdict: EASY play. One of the greatest, deepest deckbuilding roguelites ever. 10/10.

coveredGames.name: Shadow Gambit: The Cursed Crew
coveredGames.title: Verdict: easy play. Mimimi lets you loose with a crew of supernatural pirates, and the result is an chaotic, creative stealth sandbox that has permanently ruined other RTS games for me. 10/10.

coveredGames.name: Dead Space™ 2
coveredGames.title: Verdict: play. A terrifying, atmospheric sequel with excellent gunplay and psychological horror, occasionally undermined by predictable jump scares that feel more cheap than scary. 8/10.

coveredGames.name: Agatha Christie - Murder on the Orient Express
coveredGames.title: Verdict: play. A faithful, character-driven Christie mystery with a great atmosphere, though the slow pace and endless back-and-forth across the train can test your patience. 8/10.

coveredGames.name: The Mysteries of Baroque
coveredGames.title: Verdict: play. A gorgeous, weird gothic nightmare with phenomenal worldbuilding that absolutely needed another 100,000 words. 8/10.

coveredGames.name: Life of a Mercenary
coveredGames.title: Verdict: mixed. Life of a Mercenary has good ideas, satisfying management, and a rough execution. It's fun enough to finish, but too unpolished to wholeheartedly recommend. 6/10.

coveredGames.name: Werewolf: The Apocalypse — The Book of Hungry Names
coveredGames.title: Verdict: easy play. The Book of Hungry Names is one of Choice of Games' strongest titles, with brilliant mechanics and writing, though its ambition sometimes overwhelms its nuance. 9/10.

coveredGames.name: Life of a Wizard
coveredGames.title: Verdict: cautious play. Life of a Wizard is a mechanically rich wizard simulator with outstanding replay value that sacrifices memorable characters and prose in favor of player choice. 6/10.

coveredGames.name: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream
coveredGames.title: Verdict: play. Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream isn't the tactical stealth masterpiece I was hoping for, but it's still a beautiful and worthwhile adventure. 8/10.

coveredGames.name: The Fielder's Choice
coveredGames.title: Verdict: mixed. The Fielder's Choice is a love letter to baseball that deserved extra innings: great writing and ideas cut short by rushed pacing and thin characters. 6/10.

coveredGames.name: Agatha Christie - Death on the Nile
coveredGames.title: Verdict: play. Agatha Christie - Death on the Nile is a brilliant detective adventure whose excellent mysteries outweigh its painfully slow pacing. 9/10.

coveredGames.name: Mecha Ace
coveredGames.title: Verdict: play. An excellent introduction to military interactive fiction, even if its characters never quite match the strength of its mechanics. 8/10.

coveredGames.name: The Eagle's Heir
coveredGames.title: Verdict: mixed. The Eagle's Heir is overflowing with brilliant ideas, but its rushed pacing leaves too little room for any of them to truly take flight. 6/10.

coveredGames.name: Back to the Dawn
coveredGames.title: Verdict: a must-play. Equal parts prison escape, RPG, and immersive sim, Back to the Dawn is one of the most memorable RPGs I've played. 10/10.

coveredGames.name: Moses & Plato - Last Train to Clawville
coveredGames.title: Verdict: play. Moses & Plato - Last Train to Clawville is a delightful detective adventure with heart, even if its mysteries aren't always as clever as its world. 7/10.

coveredGames.name: Marvel’s Spider-Man Remastered
coveredGames.title: Verdict: play. Marvel's Spider-Man is ne of the most enjoyable superhero games ever made, even if its open world eventually becomes a checklist. 8/10.

coveredGames.name: Fallout 4
coveredGames.title: Verdict: mixed. Fallout 4 is a fantastic sandbox held back by shallow role-playing and an underwhelming story. If you like systems, you'll probably love it. If you need stories, you won't. 7/10.

coveredGames.name: ROUTINE
coveredGames.title: Verdict: play. Despite its narrative shortcomings, ROUTINE delivers one of the most immersive and visually striking sci-fi horror experiences in recent years. 9/10.

coveredGames.name: COP BASTARD
coveredGames.title: Short but excellent shooter with a focus on intense gunfights reminiscent of John Woo movie shootouts. Clouds of dust, splatters of blood, objects flying around; beautifully chaotic firefights!

coveredGames.name: Queen's Domain
coveredGames.title: Incredible game, some of the best level design I've seen in my life. More interconnected than Dark Souls 1, secrets within secrets that lead to entire new dungeons. If you like exploration, PLAY THIS!

coveredGames.name: Eschalon: Book III
coveredGames.title: Decent final entry into a decent RPG trilogy. Some good level design improvements, but a disappointing ending for the story. Recommended if you liked the first two games, it's simply more of the same.

coveredGames.name: Pinball Spire
coveredGames.title: This is a solid puzzle platformer with pinball mechanics. It is, however, NOT a "pinballvania" as the store description claims. Good for what it is, but beware of false advertising!

coveredGames.name: BioMenace Remastered
coveredGames.title: The new Episode 4 makes this feel more like a full-fledged sequel than mere remaster. Highly recommended to everyone who liked the original, this is how you remake & enhance a classic!

coveredGames.name: Metal Garden
coveredGames.title: FPS set in a concrete megastructure. Good exploration, amazing atmosphere, but mediocre combat. Recommended for the vibe, but flaccid guns & simplistic enemy AI makes for underwhelming shootouts.

coveredGames.name: Void Sols
coveredGames.title: 2D top-down soulslike where you play a triangle fighting other abstract shape people. Great level design, unique approach to consumables and rewarding exploration make this a top-tier game. Recommend!

coveredGames.name: The Crimson Diamond
coveredGames.title: Excellent mystery adventure game with text parser input. Solve several mysteries, including a murder, in an isolated lodge in the Canadian wilderness! Highly recommended.

coveredGames.name: Dead Ink
coveredGames.title: Top-down soulslike set in an extremely vertical tower. It has some interesting mechanics, janky but solid combat and excellent level design. Fully recommended for those who play Souls for exploration!

coveredGames.name: Eschalon: Book II
coveredGames.title: A clear improvement upon its predecessor in every way. Bigger map, more quests, more skills & weapons, slightly faster movement, optional hunger mechanic, higher resolution graphics. Recommended!

coveredGames.name: Eschalon: Book I
coveredGames.title: Solid solo dev RPG with a focus on exploration and dungeon crawling, with some interesting mechanics (cartography skill!), but its slow walking speed makes travel a chore. Barely recommended!

coveredGames.name: The Dark Rites of Arkham
coveredGames.title: Point & click adventure where you play a cop investigating an occult murder in 1930s Arkham. Some unique interpretations of classic Lovecraftian themes and a solid story, but puzzles are very easy.

coveredGames.name: The Legend of Skye
coveredGames.title: Classic 90s style point & click heavily inspired by Monkey Island. Beautiful art and good puzzle design with multi-step puzzles that require some thinking, set in a zany medieval druid setting.

coveredGames.name: Heroes of the Seven Islands
coveredGames.title: Might & Magic style RPG meets point & click adventure in this hand-drawn treat made by a solo dev. Charming artstyle, hand-made dungeons & encounters, and plenty of secrets to discover. Recommended!

coveredGames.name: DinoSystem
coveredGames.title: Solo dev survival game with a very impressive ecosystem simulation. Nothing is random, everything has cause and effect. Four seasons with changing weather, complex dinosaur behavior. Highly recommend!

coveredGames.name: Hypogea
coveredGames.title: Very atmospheric 3D platformer/action-adventure set in a vast underground facility of steel and concrete. You play a robot trying to get to the surface. Excellent game, highly recommended!

coveredGames.name: Primal Planet
coveredGames.title: Excellent metroidvania with a living world where predator and prey animals dynamically interact with each other. Explore jungles while hunting dinosaurs and save your family from space aliens! Great!

coveredGames.name: Hollowdeep
coveredGames.title: Great little solo dev King's Field clone, janky but fun. Heavy focus on exploration with plenty of secrets, optional areas, and rewarding treasure chests to find. Recommended!

coveredGames.name: Knights of the Chalice
coveredGames.title: Excellent combat-focused RPG with challenging encounters and great spell-slinging wizard duels. Has a super hard optional post-game fight that's incredibly satisfying to beat. Recommended!

coveredGames.name: The Will of Arthur Flabbington
coveredGames.title: Classic point & click adventure with challenging puzzles, a complete ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ of a protagonist, and lots of humor. Feels very Lucas Arts like. A bit short though. Recommended for the humor & puzzles!

coveredGames.name: The Drifter
coveredGames.title: Point & click sci-fi thriller with great visuals & atmosphere, but very easy on the puzzle side. Interesting story & great vibes are its strengths, tho the writing isn't always tonally consistent.

coveredGames.name: The Citadel
coveredGames.title: Oldschool FPS with satisfying gunplay, anime girls who explode into disturbingly erotic gore, and a couple of bizarre design decisions. Really weird and different from your average FPS. Recommended!

coveredGames.name: Paper Sorcerer
coveredGames.title: Excellent dungeon crawler with unique premise and great combat system. Summon minions with different abilities that level up alongside you and escape a magical prison made of paper!

coveredGames.name: Legends of Amberland II: The Song of Trees
coveredGames.title: Might&Magic style open world RPG with a party of 7. Feels very similar to the first game, down to reusing 90% of assets. Bigger and better than its predecessor but mostly just more of the same.

coveredGames.name: SKALD: Against the Black Priory
coveredGames.title: Classic CRPG with grid-based tactical combat, Ultima-like exploration, a plot of Lovecraftian horror in a medieval fantasy world, and the best writing I've seen in a game in a long time. Recommended!

coveredGames.name: Little Kitty, Big City
coveredGames.title: Excellent exploration-focused "cozy game" where you play as a cat who has to find its way back home. A decently-sized map to explore, lots of verticality, many side quests. Very enjoyable little game!

coveredGames.name: Drova - Forsaken Kin
coveredGames.title: Excellent Gothic-style RPG with great exploration, lots of secrets to discover, solid combat and satisfying character progression. Highly recommended, especially for fans of Piranha Bytes!

coveredGames.title: [FR] "In summary, I liked the game at first, but came away kind of hating it." Watch Yahtz' review to find out why.

coveredGames.name: MONOMOON
coveredGames.title: [YT] "I wanted to see more 'a-ha!' moments, and Monomoon is mostly just 'oh.' moments, if you see what I mean. Still, I have some basic respect for a game that does the job."

coveredGames.name: WendyQuest: Legend of the Four Corner Stones
coveredGames.title: [YT] Neat for what it is. "Don't think I'll bother playing more of it. But for what it's worth, Wendy's seems to be meeting retro RPG gamers at their own level."

coveredGames.name: Queen's Domain
coveredGames.title: [YT][FR] This one kept pulling Yahtzee back. "It's that kind of janky-but-functional charm that hits a very specific nostalgic nerve, like one of those handheld water-filled ring toss games."

coveredGames.name: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival
coveredGames.title: [FR] Abridged, Yahtz couldn't recall how it played on writing this episode. "Once you get past the freaky sex cult stuff, the gameplay oscillates between silly and dull in a generally functional way."

coveredGames.name: Truckful
coveredGames.title: [YT] Yahtz didn't gel with this one, though he did enjoy the cargo stacking part of this game.

coveredGames.name: Thank You Bus Driver
coveredGames.title: [YT] "But I think there's some issues in execution." As Yahtz got into the rhythm, he realized that there wasn't much of any punishment for playing this game badly, among other things.

coveredGames.name: Normal Golf Game
coveredGames.title: [YT] Yahtz might need a bit more time, but spent the last portion ranting about struggle physics games.

coveredGames.name: RetroSpace
coveredGames.title: [YT] Yahtz didn't get enough time with this one. He liked what he saw, but wishes that "Retro indie style immersive sims [would] show a bit more ambition."

coveredGames.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
coveredGames.title: [FR] "Yeah, I liked this game. And I wanna tell you why I liked it. I wanna spread some positivity in the world- through ample use of profanity. Suck my ♥♥♥♥."

coveredGames.name: SILENT HILL: Townfall
coveredGames.title: [FR] Yahtz started off not sure how he wanted to feel, then stared at the box art for 30 seconds. Watch his review to find out more.

coveredGames.name: Nivalis Nights
coveredGames.title: [YT] "I need to reserve judgment on this one, because I don't think I had enough of an exposure to everything this one has to offer." Yahtz then admits it introduced a lot of things overwhelmingly.

coveredGames.name: Driving Rogue
coveredGames.title: [YT] Abridged. "It... Kind of works?"

coveredGames.name: Knuckle Jet
coveredGames.title: [YT] Abridged, "Everything about this game felt like it was trying to keep a high energy vibe, but it was flagging at times. Movement frictionless and a little too free. Still, funky music!"

coveredGames.name: CONTROL Resonant
coveredGames.title: [FR] Abridged: "Inscrutible plot, the combat is a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ chore. Eventually I gave myself double damage, gave the final boss a token attempt, and yelled 'OH SOD IT!' and watched the ending on YT."

coveredGames.name: DragonSword : Awakening
coveredGames.title: [HME] KC thought this was really fun. To him, it takes the best parts of combat in Genshin Impact and Zenless Zone Zero, and combines it in a harmonious way. A hidden gem!

coveredGames.name: Graveyard Keeper 2
coveredGames.title: [BZ] Abridged, Jess Hoops says that with a bit of work and getting familiar with the map and crafting elements of the game, it's easy to "get into a flow state" and spend hours with this one.

coveredGames.name: Welcome to Elderfield
coveredGames.title: [BZ] Jess Hoops has "Always been delighted by the idea of a horror RPG farming sim hybrid," and admits she's going to be playing more. Solid recommendation.

coveredGames.name: SPRAWL zero
coveredGames.title: [YT][BZ] Yahtz and Nick both agree that it needs more visual identity, but Yahtz didn't like this as much as Nick did, the latter achieving flow state in his time with the game.

coveredGames.name: He Who Watches
coveredGames.title: [YT] A little cynical, but more positive, Yahtz compared this as an opposite to The Talos Principle and Portal in how a puzzle game is designed. Nonetheless, he likes these puzzles.

coveredGames.name: Worming from Home
coveredGames.title: [YT] Abridged, "There's a lot more effort on display than you'd see in other work simulators. Writing's good, and there's something inherently funny about being a worm struggling with human tasks."

coveredGames.name: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
coveredGames.title: [FR] This one's worth watching the whole review, with the first half being relatively fun, and the last half being "Like if Tomb Raider (2013)'s second half was a jigsaw trap."

coveredGames.name: VHOLUME
coveredGames.title: [YT] Yahtz liked this one. "For what it's worth, the game handles very smoothly with a wonderful sense of flow. You can disconnect mentally and appreciate the art of it all."

coveredGames.name: STAR WARS Zero Company™
coveredGames.title: [ES][FR] Issues aside, Yahtz came around because of his love of XCOM. Meanwhile, Marty Sliva expressed his love of Star Wars "when it's done right." And to him, this game accomplishes exactly that.

coveredGames.name: The Sinking City 2
coveredGames.title: [FR] Abridged: "Summarized, it's a blatantly derivative survival horror format, with an interesting setting, a not interesting story, and gameplay that's solidly put together but uncreative."

coveredGames.name: Sovereign Tower
coveredGames.title: [HME][BZ] A hidden gem! Jess brought this one to the round table; she, KC, and Jesse all found this one enjoyable, talking excitedly back and forth about everything happening in this run.

coveredGames.name: Tidy Up Together
coveredGames.title: [YT] This came recommended to Yahtz by other Second Wind staff members, though he says this game lacks an important part of other contemporaries of the genre; Background story, intrigue.

coveredGames.name: Rubinite
coveredGames.title: [YT] Remarking that the game “won him over eventually,” Yahtz enjoys the balance of this game’s unique focus system.

coveredGames.name: The Message from Deep Space
coveredGames.title: [YT] “I hadn’t heard of this one ‘til someone on the Discord said it was something I’d like. And guess what? They were ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ right!!!”

coveredGames.name: Mortal Shell II
coveredGames.title: [FR+ES] Both Yahtzee and Nick enjoyed this on. Quoth the former: "Goes to show inventiveness is worth a lot, and not just in scrabble."

coveredGames.name: Halo: Campaign Evolved
coveredGames.title: [FR] "Don't you see? We never left the corridors. There is no escaping the corridors. WE ARE IN A CORRIDOR OF THE SOUL." Yahtz had a lot more to say about both the game and fan reception.

coveredGames.name: Foghorns Drown
coveredGames.title: [HME] Jesse Galena is intrigued. Compared to previous titles they played, this one has a hook that they may come back to. "It's very weird!" Jess Hoops concurs, but KC Nwosu doesn't really care for it

coveredGames.name: MOLE
coveredGames.title: [BZ] Nick gave this a good run over the course of a weekend and loved it so much, he revived Bytesized.

coveredGames.name: Feed The Pit
coveredGames.title: [YT] Abridged, "The game plants enough seeds of intrigue to draw me in, and it's a cathartic game and political commentary. I think I'll come back to this one!"

coveredGames.name: An Eggstremely Hard Game
coveredGames.title: [YT] Yahtz and JM8 played this one together. Definitely more or less of a "streamer bait" title. Yahtz praises the visual design as consistent, but the level design itself was a bit lopsided.

coveredGames.name: Rock Bottom
coveredGames.title: [YT] Drawing parallels to Shelldivers, Yahtz concludes that it's a perfectly fine game. "I feel the need to keep playing, so I guess all the individual pieces fit well enough." Just a bit hollow.

coveredGames.name: D-topia
coveredGames.title: [YT] This one left Yahtzee confused. "I might play more of it, but in the way I'd use a stick to poke a mysterious entity that washed up on the beach."

coveredGames.name: REKA

coveredGames.name: CryptidCam
coveredGames.title: An adorable little game about taking pictures of cryptids & figuring out how to get the best unique shots, would recommend for a chill time ♥ - Iggy

coveredGames.name: Queen's Domain
coveredGames.title: Amazing modernised take on King's Field, one of my faves of the year! Packed to the brim with secrets & synergies across gear, it often feels like you're breaking the game but it's by design - Greb

coveredGames.name: Dragon's Dogma 2
coveredGames.title: This has come a very long way since launch, performance issues fixed, gameplay rebalanced, etc. A lot of love & effort has been poured into this and it shows. Still has issues but it's a fave - Iggy

coveredGames.name: Desktop Explorer
coveredGames.title: A puzzle/horror game with a Windows NT/95 vibe, fun & satisfying to work out the puzzles! Some can be a challenge but I never felt stuck for too long, it has good difficulty balance & design - Greb

coveredGames.name: Wielders of the Essence
coveredGames.title: A bullet heaven with satisfying progression and town building, also cool frogs & meteor spells so what's not to like? I think it's great! - Greb

coveredGames.name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE
coveredGames.title: Enjoyable RPG that pushes stagger mechanics so battles can get a bit samey, characters speak at every opportunity which is tiresome but past that it's a decent game but not groundbreaking - Iggy

coveredGames.name: Forbidden Solitaire
coveredGames.title: Great puzzle card game! Fun "early 3d" graphics style & presentation. Gameplay is solid if a bit rng at times, nature of card games innit. But it's a great meta-horror "game's haunted" game! - Greb

coveredGames.name: The House Dreams Along With Them
coveredGames.title: A game featuring lots of closed off puzzle rooms to solve, quite satisfying though does take a dive toward some horror themes throughout. Has an arachnophobia mode if needed - Iggy

coveredGames.name: Selkie's Salvage&Co.
coveredGames.title: Incremental game with cute mouse & cool music, upgrades are satisfying & it's fun to get so absurdly powerful you destroy the framerate with how much loot you can pull up - Greb

coveredGames.name: Pixel Washer
coveredGames.title: A game that doesn't meaningfully evolve mechanically or have any plot beyond "wash stuff" if that's enough to hold you then it can be relaxing but lacks what other cleaning games provide - Iggy

coveredGames.name: Legion Breaker
coveredGames.title: Fun number go up tower defence style game, upgrades at times feel small but others are game changing, rate of progression can slow across stages but overall a good time! - Greb

coveredGames.name: ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE
coveredGames.title: Amazing campaign, great music, fantastic gameplay, one of the top Ace Combat games out there! RAILGUN WARNING RAILGUN WARNING - Greb

coveredGames.name: Resident Evil Requiem
coveredGames.title: It's not often a game has me coming back to complete it 3 times in a row, this is one of them. Fantastic game start to finish & an excellent entry to the series as a whole - Iggy

coveredGames.name: The Last Caretaker
coveredGames.title: A struggle to start & learn mechanics but if you give it time, effort, & some websearching then this can be a fun albeit very slow survival game but expect lots of gathering & backtracking - Iggy

coveredGames.name: Slash-Out: Fantasy Dueling
coveredGames.title: visually striking 1v1 boss fights that require quick reflexes & on the fly thinking to figure out each bosses moveset with blocks/bashes/attacks, short game but very very fun! Highly recommend - Iggy

coveredGames.name: Normal Golf Game
coveredGames.title: This is a game about suffering. You will miss a lot, the wind plots against you & your club shakes like it's in a neverending earthquake but if you land a good shot the relief is life changing - Greb

coveredGames.name: Video Game Menu: The Game
coveredGames.title: Very silly game about navigating obtuse menus and fiddling with crazy options, ultimately only roughly half an hour in length but good for a quick laugh - Greb

coveredGames.name: Crow Country
coveredGames.title: Ps1 style horror game with great vibes and gameplay, similar in vibe to classic resident evil/silent hill, definitely highly recommended - Iggy

coveredGames.name: Slay the Princess — The Pristine Cut
coveredGames.title: A choose your own adventure horror game with so many potential routes it boggles the mind & all of them are sublime. This is another game you're better off going into knowing less about it - Iggy

coveredGames.name: Spilled!
coveredGames.title: Cute but very short game about cleaning pollution from rivers & lakes, you'll be done in less than an hour most likely but it's still a very pleasant experience - Iggy

coveredGames.name: MOTORSLICE
coveredGames.title: Was a lot more platforming than expected but the bosses are a spectacle to behold when you reach them & traversal is quite fun, especially across the giant bosses themselves - Iggy

coveredGames.name: Contradiction: Spot The Liar
coveredGames.title: A very "B-movie esque" FMV point & click game, but I say that with the highest praise, the campy acting is memorable and fun from start to finish & it has a good hint system if you get stuck - Iggy

coveredGames.name: Mouthwashing
coveredGames.title: A very intense roughly 2 hour horror game, very gripping narrative, it would be a disservice to the game to talk about it other than say it's truly unforgettable - Iggy

coveredGames.title: Very VERY fast paced vampire parkour game, if you like speed tech this game's up your alley! - Greb

coveredGames.name: Parking Garage Rally Circuit
coveredGames.title: Some of the best ska music in games that I've heard in YEARS, oh and the driving's fun too. Not that many tracks though but still a good afternoon worth of fun here - Greb

coveredGames.name: Windrose
coveredGames.title: Finally, a pirate game that's not open pvp how'd it take this long? Resource gathering can be a bit of a grind & you're off the ship more often than on, but I still had a great time with it - Iggy

coveredGames.name: Return of the Obra Dinn
coveredGames.title: immaculate vibes start to finish, I loved solving the mystery of the Obra Dinn & have nothing bad to say about the game whatsoever! - Iggy

coveredGames.name: SIGNALIS
coveredGames.title: This too is yuri. Classic survival horror, among the best in its genre, if you're after a game with these vibes this could be a new favourite for you - Iggy

coveredGames.name: The Hayseed Knight
coveredGames.title: Criminally underrated visual novel, very well written, very well voice acted, overall hugely recommended! - Iggy

coveredGames.name: Deliver At All Costs
coveredGames.title: Silly driving game about making deliveries, except tons of stuff in the map is destructible! Get from A to B by any means necessary! Had great fun with this one - Greb

coveredGames.name: The Planet Crafter
coveredGames.title: Lovely chill game about terraforming planets & moons, was astounded at how many updates this game got over time & it's a fun time with friends if you want to bring life to planets together - Iggy

coveredGames.name: Look Outside
coveredGames.title: One of the best indie horror experiences out there, the less said about it the better. I could hardly believe this was an RPG maker game, they've done such amazing things with the engine! - Iggy

coveredGames.name: Aviassembly
coveredGames.title: Building your own planes from scratch in a cool editor to do missions! It's a lot of fun coming up with designs to fit multiple roles depending on what's needed - Greb

coveredGames.name: Blue Prince
coveredGames.title: very fun & satisfying at first, but the further in you get the more reliant you are on RNG to solve puzzles as you can't solve certain parts until the layout & items line up right - Iggy

coveredGames.name: Mars First Logistics
coveredGames.title: Build your own rovers brick by brick to fulfill different jobs! Great vehicle editor, but missions can get a little repetitive toward the mid-late game - Greb

coveredGames.name: Coral Island
coveredGames.title: Some games I'd call "Stardew-like" but this is Stardews 3d twin separated at birth with identical mechanics. Some things it does do better, but it's difficult to not make constant comparisons - Iggy

coveredGames.name: Kiosk
coveredGames.title: Short horror game, good vibes though a little reliant on jumpscares when I'm trying to make burgers here! - Greb

coveredGames.name: Draft of Darkness
coveredGames.title: Pretty cool & unique mix of Survival Horror/Darkest Dungeon/Mystery Dungeon/Deckbuilder. Works perfectly out of the box on the Deck.

coveredGames.name: Desecrators
coveredGames.title: Another cool Descent-like that also happens to be a pretty challenging rogue-like with procedurally generated levels. Works perfectly out of the box.

coveredGames.name: Flesh Made Fear
coveredGames.title: Kind of boring at the beginning (too much running in big empty spaces) but becomes better once you reach the police station. Works out of the box but stays at 40 FPS once you leave the sewer.

coveredGames.name: WORLD HEROES PERFECT
coveredGames.title: Classic. Would be cool to have the rest of the series if only for the death match mode that is absent from this episode. Works perfectly out of the box.

coveredGames.name: Dimension Drive
coveredGames.title: Cool shoot 'em up that takes a little while to get accustomed to with its splitscreen switching mechanic. Has online leaderboards for each stage. Works perfectly out of the box.

coveredGames.name: GladMort
coveredGames.title: Cool NEO GEO action platformer in the vein of Ghosts 'n Goblins with the double jump from the Super Nintendo game. Works perfectly out of the box.

coveredGames.name: DEATHRUN TV
coveredGames.title: Frantic roguelite twin-stick shooter with dual-wielding & good enemy variety that also has a survival mode with different difficulties. Some rare slowdowns but nothing too bad.

coveredGames.name: Don't Die, Collect Loot
coveredGames.title: It's still in early access so it still has room for improvement but it's already kind of fun if you're into Vampire Survivors etc... Works perfectly out of the box.

coveredGames.name: Cleanup on Aisle 3
coveredGames.title: Cool casual game but lacking some challenge in singleplayer until you get to the 6th day of V by ValuCo where things start spilling out of thin air while your coworkers do nothing. Works perfectly.

coveredGames.name: Alien Zombie Megadeath
coveredGames.title: Simple but pretty fun game with good enemy and stage variety. Works out of the box and fits the Deck perfectly for short sessions with its bite sized stages.

coveredGames.name: Transcripted
coveredGames.title: Cool mix of twin-stick shooter and Puzz Loop with a small skill tree that lets you unlock new weapons etc... Works perfectly out of the box.

coveredGames.name: Diadra Empty
coveredGames.title: Excellent Defenders-like that lets you chose a weapon loadout, a level up system & a dash mechanic that lets you fly through bullets & enemies. Great OST. Has online leaderboards. Works perfectly.

coveredGames.name: PainFighting
coveredGames.title: Another beat them up that could have been much better with some polish. Not a very good game but kind of worth it for the English translation. Works perfectly out of the box.

coveredGames.name: Flynn: Son of Crimson
coveredGames.title: Pretty good action-platformer/metroidvania with some cool pixel art and music. Combat is pretty fun once you start unlocking new abilities. Works perfectly out of the box.

coveredGames.name: Valdis Story: Abyssal City
coveredGames.title: Great metroidvania with fun combat and multiple playable characters. Works perfectly out of the box.

coveredGames.name: One Step From Eden
coveredGames.title: Great roguelike deckbuilder with Mega Man Battle Network gameplay. Has both coop and versus modes + workshop support. Works perfectly out of the box.

coveredGames.name: STURMWIND EX
coveredGames.title: Pretty good shmup if you can get past the visibility issues. It's marked as unplayable but works perfectly out of the box. I didn't experience the crash after level 4 which must have been patched.

coveredGames.name: MULLET MADJACK
coveredGames.title: Well, it's Mullet Madjack. Better with a keyboard and a mouse but it plays well on the Deck. There are some slowdowns (i'm playing at 60 FPS) but nothing too bad.

coveredGames.name: Tormentum - Dark Sorrow
coveredGames.title: Cool point & click with excellent art, no obtuse puzzles & some choices to make. Works perfectly out of the box and is entirely playable with the touch screen or the right trackpad.

coveredGames.name: Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc
coveredGames.title: Well, it's Danganronpa and it works perfectly out of the box on the Deck.

coveredGames.name: Soda Girls
coveredGames.title: Pretty cool beat them with combo customization & lots of unlockables. Lacks a lot of polish (like the UI) but has some neat ideas. Works out of the box & fits the deck perfectly for short sessions.

coveredGames.name: EMPTY SHELL
coveredGames.title: Great roguelike with multiple difficulties to chose from. Obviously inspired by Teleglitch but slower paced which makes it more manageable to play with a gamepad. Works perfectly out of the box.

coveredGames.name: Bud Spencer & Terence Hill - Slaps And Beans
coveredGames.title: Pretty fun if you can get behind the gameplay, even more so if you like or have some nostalgia for their movies. Works perfectly out of the box.

coveredGames.name: Mega Man X Legacy Collection
coveredGames.title: Well, it's Megaman X 1 through 4 (the best). This collection and the second one were marked as unplayable until recently but are now verified and work perfectly out of the box.

coveredGames.name: Bullet Candy
coveredGames.title: Fun Twin-stick shooter with online leaderboards that's been on Steam for 20 years. The game got updated at the start of the month with new modes and Steam Deck support. Works perfectly out of the box.

coveredGames.name: Asterix & Obelix: Slap them All!
coveredGames.title: Good moveset and great graphics but the stages (& the game) are too long & enemies are kind of boring to fight (especially the bosses). Still, I've played worse beat 'em ups. Works perfectly.

coveredGames.name: Rum & Gun
coveredGames.title: Pretty cool linear action rpg with some twin stick shooting action thrown in. Has workshop support but there's nothing there. Works perfectly out of the box but only has keyboard & mouse prompts.

coveredGames.name: FINAL FANTASY VII
coveredGames.title: Well, it's Final Fantasy VII and it works perfectly out of the box, just like the previous version that got delisted.

coveredGames.name: Grapple Dog
coveredGames.title: Very nice 2D platformer with lots of collectibles etc... Also contains a simplistic minigame that plays like a shmup with a boomerang and a pistol. Works perfectly out of the box.

coveredGames.name: NINJA GAIDEN Σ [NINJA GAIDEN: Master Collection]
coveredGames.title: Well, it's Ninja Gaiden Sigma and it works perfectly out of the box.

coveredGames.name: F.E.A.R. 3
coveredGames.title: Yeah it's no F.E.A.R. but it's a pretty fun game in its own right. Works perfectly out of the box.

coveredGames.name: Descenders
coveredGames.title: Very cool game. You'll need to play offline if you wanna reach 60 FPS. There's an option in the game to play offline. Works perfectly outside of that.

coveredGames.name: House of Necrosis
coveredGames.title: Cool Shiren/Mystery Dungeon clone with Resident Evil 1 aestethics + some rooms in which you move your character with tank controls around pre-rendered backgrounds. Works perfectly out of the box.

coveredGames.name: Death Ray Manta SE
coveredGames.title: No real scoring (64 is the maximum high score), not a single option, always the same music, zero randomness. Not bad but there are countless better twin stick shooters on steam. Works out of the box.

coveredGames.name: Gestalt: Steam & Cinder
coveredGames.title: Great pixeIart but I played for 45 minutes until I reached the 2nd boss and I was already bored by the combat & that green bar mechanic. Works perfectly out of the box though.

coveredGames.name: CARRION
coveredGames.title: What a cool game even if it lacks any kind of challenge (especially compared to Butcher which Phobia Game Studio worked on too). Has workshop support. Works perfectly out of the box.

coveredGames.name: Mega Man Legacy Collection 2
coveredGames.title: Well, it's Megaman 7 through 10. It used to be marked as unsupported but it's now verified and works perfectly out of the box.

coveredGames.name: Killing Time: Resurrected
coveredGames.title: Not a very good game in my opinion...gets boring pretty fast. It works perfectly out of the box though.

coveredGames.name: Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite
coveredGames.title: Well, it's Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite and its status was changed to playable for some weeks/months. Works perfectly out of the box.

coveredGames.name: Mortal Kombat X
coveredGames.title: Well, it's Mortal Kombat X and it works perfectly out of the box.

coveredGames.name: Shard Squad
coveredGames.title: "A Fun, Cute Vampire-Survivors-like Game" - Review by Sean on GF

coveredGames.name: NO LAW
coveredGames.title: SMASH!!! KILL!!

coveredGames.name: Guns of Eschaton
coveredGames.title: SMESH

coveredGames.title: very salam alaikum

coveredGames.name: MOOSA: Dirty Fate
coveredGames.title: Smesh

coveredGames.title: Smesh

coveredGames.title: If you want to show respect, respectfully touch somebody

coveredGames.name: Skate Story
coveredGames.title: smesh

coveredGames.name: Terminator 2D: NO FATE
coveredGames.title: One day, he has only one day left. So he's Dead Tomorrow!

coveredGames.name: Fatekeeper
coveredGames.title: SMESH!

coveredGames.title: Smesh
