coveredGames.name: Sorry We're Closed
coveredGames.title: Explores queer relationships, emphasis on sexual needs.

coveredGames.name: Date Everything!
coveredGames.title: Contains everything.

coveredGames.name: Pronoun Palace
coveredGames.title: Contains pronouns.

coveredGames.name: Money for Girls: Amortized
coveredGames.title: Written by solo trans-non-binary developer, heavily explore themes and aesthetics of queer and marginalised people.

coveredGames.name: The Blood of Dawnwalker
coveredGames.title: Contains option for player same-sex romance.

coveredGames.name: Six Bullets
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay. Upcoming CRPG with a spaghetti western setting. The resemblance is a bit too shameless in this one, to be honest.

coveredGames.name: 13 Germinal
coveredGames.title: Disco through themes, gameplay? Upcoming VN with RPG elements, where you play as a miner trying to organize a strike. Concept art in the game's gallery is dev for "don't expect this anytime soon"

coveredGames.name: A Night at Moka Efti: A Babylon Berlin Story
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay, vibes? This free noir adventure where you play as a journalist in Weimar-era Berlin is clearly Disco-inspired in its presentation, though the story's a bit all over the place.

coveredGames.name: Clam Man 2: Open Mic
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay. Comedy game about a clam looking for material for his stand-up routine.

coveredGames.name: Revolution's Eternal Debt
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay, themes. Upcoming CRPG set in 1917 Petrograd with a paranormal twist (some similarity to the Nighwatch series?)

coveredGames.name: ROSETIA: A First Contact RPG
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay. Upcoming dialog-based adventure with an upbeat tone where you contact an alien civilization. Will you score a diplomatic victory or blunder for humanity? Seems to be on hiatus.

coveredGames.name: Betrayal At Club Low
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay. Bizarre, charming and janky dice-based point-and-click adventure where you're a spy infiltrating a dance club. Just as in DE, you can craft custom pizza die.

coveredGames.name: Ithaca
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay, themes. Upcoming narrative game where you're an enviromental lawyer caught in an ecoterrorism plot. I'd like to see where the story goes, but I'm not feeling the characters.

coveredGames.name: A Line Held Tight
coveredGames.title: Disco through themes. An upcoming visual novel where a labor dispute in an off-world mining outpost is about to reach a boiling point.

coveredGames.name: Signet City
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay, themes. Upcoming "fungalpunk RPG" by the dev of Citizen Sleeper, where you'll control a parasite and its hosts in a setting inspired by the grime of industial cities in 80s UK.

coveredGames.name: Vampire: The Masquerade — ETERNAL WHISPERS
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay. Upcoming narrative CRPG set in the Vampire: the Masquerade universe.

coveredGames.name: Imago Season
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay. A whimsical first-person CRPG with a sci-fi setting where you find yourself in a city of mutated bug people.

coveredGames.name: Who's Lila?
coveredGames.title: Disco through vibes. The lore at the bottom of this game's rabbit hole might be of interest to DE players who had their brains melted by advanced entroponetics.

coveredGames.name: The Crane Rider's Tale
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay. Torn between tagging this as "disco with folk chinese characteristics" or as "CONFUCIUS DOESN'T ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ CARE", but this upcoming VN looks charming and intriguing.

coveredGames.name: Stiff Neck
coveredGames.title: Disco through themes, vibes. A VN where you play as a detective investigating a bizarre case of vandalism. Demo hints at an introspective, psychological tone that could appeal to DE fans.

coveredGames.name: Headspace Division
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay. Upcoming point-and-click CRPG with a sci-fi setting where you'll have to manage your thoughts to explore a derelict spaceship without going insane.

coveredGames.name: Where the Water Tastes Like Wine
coveredGames.title: Disco through themes. Collect stories across the US and watch them grow into folk tales. Can't fully recommend due to some jank and uneven writing, but I'd like to see another go at this concept.

coveredGames.name: Paradigm Island
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay. Dialog-focused CRPG where you play as a young mercenary. Haven't played.

coveredGames.name: Scarlet Hollow
coveredGames.title: Disco through themes, gameplay. From the devs of "Slay the Princess", this multi-episode horror visual novel set in a decaying mining town boasts an extremely reactive dialog system. Haven't played.

coveredGames.name: Parasensor
coveredGames.title: Disco through themes, vibes? Not much is known of this upcoming narrative game with body horror elements, but it's giving Mouthwashing vibes.

coveredGames.name: INDIKA
coveredGames.title: Disco through themes, vibes. This surreal, genre-blending narrative adventure starring a nun in late 19th century Russia is a good match for DE's weirdness and introspective tone. Haven't played.

coveredGames.name: Where Birds Sleep
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay, themes. Upcoming CRPG/choices-matter game where you play as (or against) a convict charting a mysterious island. Focus on the character's inner world should appeal to DE fans.

coveredGames.name: Neoproxima
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay. A sci-fi adventure set in an alternate history where the Cold War takes to the stars, the demo suggests time-loop related mishaps. Some similarities to Citizen Sleeper.

coveredGames.name: Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay, themes. This sequel keeps the Disco-adjacent themes and dice-based gameplay. The biggest changes are the addition of party members and the chance to go on off-station sorties.

coveredGames.name: Pathologic 3
coveredGames.title: Disco through themes, vibes. Probably the best vibe match for DE. Also applies to previous games in the series but this one is less likely to give you an aneurysm.

coveredGames.name: Aether & Iron
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay. A CRPG with noir and... decopunk(???) elements. Tried the demo - art was lovely, story didn't wow me, gameplay seemed what you'd expect for the genre.

coveredGames.name: Duskpunk
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay, themes. A text-based CRPG with a steampunk setting and political themes. Haven't played.

coveredGames.name: Savior Syndrome
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay, themes. Upcoming CRPG with noir and occult themes, and a psychology angle.

coveredGames.name: Sandara: City of a Thousand Eclipses
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay. Upcoming text-based CRPG with deckbuilding elements, set in a fantasy land. Closest resemblance gameplay-wise appears to be Citizen Sleeper.

coveredGames.name: Gerda: A Flame in Winter
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay. Dialog-based adventure set in occupied Denmark at the end of WWII, where you try to rescue your husband from the Gestapo. DE-like approach to speech challenges. Haven't played.

coveredGames.name: Freedom Tower
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay. Upcoming CRPG where you play as a freedom fighter in an occupied land.

coveredGames.name: Lovely Lady RPG
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay, themes. Described as "Trans Furry Disco Elysium", it seems more of a VN than an RPG, but the influence is undeniable. Haven't played yet.

coveredGames.name: Thousand Hells: The Underworld Heists
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay. This upcoming text-based fantasy RPG has you form a party to undertake a daring heist in hell.

coveredGames.name: NORCO
coveredGames.title: Disco through themes. This point-and-click adventure set in a dilapidated near-future Southern US covers topics that might appeal to DE fans.

coveredGames.name: The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante
coveredGames.title: Disco through themes. This text-based choices game deals with issues such as spirituality and class conflict in a way that might appeal to DE fans. Largely devoid of humor, though.

coveredGames.name: Mouthwashing
coveredGames.title: Disco through themes. This linear psychological horror game covers topics such as addiction, redemption, identity and alienation of labor in a way that might appeal to DE fans.

coveredGames.name: Travelling At Night
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay, themes. Upcoming dialog-driven CRPG with occult elements, set in an alternate Europe.

coveredGames.name: Shore of Jord
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay, themes. Upcoming DE-inspired CRPG set in an alternate Europe. No updates for a while.

coveredGames.name: Give up the Ghost
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay, themes. This upcoming story-based mystery game, where you investigate the plague ravaging a city, cites DE as an inspiration. Gorgeous art. No news of a demo just yet.

coveredGames.name: Glasshouse
coveredGames.title: Disco through gameplay, themes. Demo for this upcoming CRPG shows an interesting setting and premise, though the dense lore is dumped on you unceremoniously, and I'm not too sold on the characters.

coveredGames.name: Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town!
coveredGames.title: There's a weird joy in turning messy piles into proper buildings. Sorting colours, hauling bricks and watching the streets come together kept me busy. A little more variety would help. 7/10

coveredGames.name: A Game About Digging A Hole™
coveredGames.title: Surprisingly addictive! Digging for treasures and upgrading your gear is oddly satisfying. Relaxing and fun, though a bit short and repetitive. A neat little experience overall, and worth a shot! 7/10

coveredGames.name: Probably Stolen - Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim
coveredGames.title: Addictive shop sim with a great cyberpunk vibe. Packed with surprises! Buying, crafting, upgrading and selling always gives you something to work toward. Relaxing at first, then hard to put down. 9/10

coveredGames.name: Deskrawl: Idle ARPG
coveredGames.title: A great mix of idle progression and satisfying ARPG combat. Builds matter, upgrades feel rewarding, and there’s always something to chase. If you love Diablo and AFK gameplay, this one’s for you. 8/10

coveredGames.name: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered
coveredGames.title: A majestic journey reborn with vivid sights and smooth combat. Exploring its vast lands feels fresh again, and the renewed atmosphere makes every quest a joy to rediscover. Stong nostalgia. 9/10

coveredGames.name: Valheim
coveredGames.title: A beautiful blend of exploration, survival, and building. Every journey feels like an epic saga, with stunning landscapes and rewarding discoveries around every corner. 10/10

coveredGames.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor
coveredGames.title: Endless swarms, constant tension, and satisfying upgrades keep every run fresh. The chaotic mix of action and strategy makes it impossible to stop playing once you start. 9/10

coveredGames.title: A satisfying, deep bullet hell roguelike with a clever progression system and a loop that holds up over time. Minor visual issues aside, this is a strong entry in the genre.

coveredGames.name: Heretical
coveredGames.title: Heretical is a charming isometric roguelike with solid combat, strong progression, and great atmosphere. Repetitive for some, but rewarding if you enjoy HADES-style challenge with structure.

coveredGames.name: Assassin’s Creed Shadows
coveredGames.title: AC Shadows builds on the modern AC RPG formula with dual protagonists, a beautiful open world, and flexible playstyles. While progression can feel slow, the core gameplay and atmosphere are engaging.

coveredGames.name: StarRupture
coveredGames.title: StarRupture is a deceptively simple survival loop of mining, base building, and defense. It looks stunning, runs well, and is far better in co-op, where its complexity truly shines.

coveredGames.name: Megabonk
coveredGames.title: MEGABONK is a third-person survivors-style roguelike with a tight loop of killing, levelling, and build crafting. Solid variety, strong performance, good music, and a unique third-person twist.

coveredGames.name: Night Swarm
coveredGames.title: Night Swarm blends Vampire Survivors with Hades into a fast roguelike with short runs, great music and deep upgrades. Busy visuals and rare crashes hold it back, but the value proposition is strong.

coveredGames.name: The Scouring
coveredGames.title: A fresh RTS with Classic and Hero modes, strong mod support, co-op, and solid audio. Only two factions and limited settings, but great potential. Worth it for RTS fans, maybe wait for a sale if casual

coveredGames.name: The Outer Worlds 2
coveredGames.title: Outer Worlds 2 improves on the first with better writing, exploration, and combat. Performance lags behind, but it’s still a fun, choice-driven FPS RPG worth playing. Verdict: Safe bet.

coveredGames.name: Becastled
coveredGames.title: A unique city builder in which you acquire oddly shaped hexagonal territories, build up your economy. army, walls and strength, to overcome the enemy waves and take down the enemy bases.

coveredGames.name: DYNASTY WARRIORS: ORIGINS
coveredGames.title: A hack and slash veteran in the genre has returned with a banger. Although the silent protagonist trope is overused, I personally play these games for the gameplay. And the gameplay delivers!

coveredGames.name: Atomic Heart
coveredGames.title: Atomic Heart is a stunning shooter with rich visuals, great music, and flexible upgrades, but suffers from clunky puzzles, slow map navigation, relentless robot repairs, and unskippable cutscenes.

coveredGames.name: Star Birds
coveredGames.title: A cosy resource manager set in space. Mine resources, refine them, combine them, and transfer them between comets in order to craft the required end product to move on to the next section.

coveredGames.name: IXION
coveredGames.title: After earth was destroyed, a small space station is set off on a space adventure to preserve humanity in this unique city builder. Maintain your peoples trust, and find a new home for everyone.

coveredGames.name: Hordelord
coveredGames.title: Hordelord pits you in a high octane arena shooter where you rush around zipping through waves of enemies, unleash brutal weapons, upgrade with tarot cards, and chase leaderboard glory!

coveredGames.name: Ready or Not
coveredGames.title: A SWAT FPS in which you take control of your SWAT team and lead them to victory by breaching, peeking, flashing, kicking, busting, shooting, zip tying, rescuing, and clearing a variety of maps.

coveredGames.name: Revival: Recolonization
coveredGames.title: Resembling Civ in the visual style and in some ways gameplay, it is a moderately strong entry in the genre but not without its flaws. Focusing on terraforming the map to gain advantage and access.

coveredGames.name: Let Them Trade
coveredGames.title: Build settlements, get them producing unique resources, and watch them trade with each other while you profit from the trade tax. It is a micro economy management game, forgiving, but not hand holdy.

coveredGames.name: The Wandering Village
coveredGames.title: A city built at the back of a giant beast that is constantly moving through various environments. Each environment brings a unique challenge to overcome. One of the most creative city builders yet!

coveredGames.name: The Planet Crafter
coveredGames.title: A game in which you must terraform a barren planet in exchange for serving your prison sentence. Survive, terraform, explore, reveal secrets of the past, and ultimately find a way out.

coveredGames.name: Dawn of Man
coveredGames.title: A slow burn city builder. Watch your village progress through the various ages by completing milestones that earn them tech points. Hunt, gather, defend and become self efficient.

coveredGames.name: Gatekeeper
coveredGames.title: Fast paced top down view Risk of Rain 2 roguelite. 4 Player co-op, but online MP has not been very active lately. Smooth, stable gameplay, great visuals and audio and lots of fun otherwise!

coveredGames.name: Life Below
coveredGames.title: As far as builders go it is pretty standard with a bit of an exceptional setting and some interesting if not engaging mechanics. Lacks a bit of an improved pacing, at least from looking at the Demo.

coveredGames.name: Fatekeeper
coveredGames.title: Pretty early in development the baseline is visible, but the game needs a lot more time before it can really hit the mark. Very fairly priced for an EA title though.

coveredGames.name: Ignitement
coveredGames.title: Gfx are very experimental, skills and progression seem to need the most work. Different for sure. If better? We have to wait.

coveredGames.name: Into the Crypt
coveredGames.title: A pretty decent Deckbuilder that tries a mechanic that did not get to shine in the demo, but might provide a unique addon to the very saturated genre. Remains to be seen if it can pull it off with the

coveredGames.name: Driving Rogue
coveredGames.title: Very promising Demo that shows a slightly outdated version, which promises a very decent release of a fun take on mixing deckbuilder progression with arcade racing and a smashing soundtrack

coveredGames.name: Tiny Fortress
coveredGames.title: A cute little Tower Defense game that gets most things right. It is not really innovative, but the gfx might convince players to fill that gap of a decent, short(ish) tower defense game.

coveredGames.name: Queen's Domain
coveredGames.title: From the Demo: This looks like a very promising title that offers some light rpg mechanics, pixel graphics and a lot of atmosphere and exploration.

coveredGames.name: StarRupture
coveredGames.title: Enjoyed the automation and seemless building very much! Exploration was good and the shooting seemed decent. A very promising title to do solo or co-op automation/combat sessions - Keep an eye on this

coveredGames.name: Drop Duchy
coveredGames.title: Very neatly presented Tetris like with more depth than it lets on in the beginning. Challenging, Fun, Chill.

coveredGames.name: Hollowbody
coveredGames.title: First impression: Retrofied spooky game with a unique setting and presentation. That also is only for fans of the gfx and the patient player.

coveredGames.name: Silly Polly Beast
coveredGames.title: The Demo: Story driven adventure that mixes exploration with combat. Quite intense combat at that. Surprisingly dynamic storytelling won me over quickly.

coveredGames.name: Void Martyrs
coveredGames.title: The Demo: Very early in development with some issues and glitches. Setting is weird and unique. The rest needs to cook some more.

coveredGames.name: VEIN
coveredGames.title: The Demo: Very much like Project Zomboid in terms of interaction detail and atmosphere. Also very early in development with much promise.

coveredGames.name: Xenopurge
coveredGames.title: The Demo: Very stylised top-down tactics game set in spaceships with alien incursions. Interesting because of the indirect control of your units. The Xenomorph beckons! For fans of the gfx only.

coveredGames.name: R.I.P. - Reincarnation Insurance Program
coveredGames.title: Update: The release has much improved on many aspects, especially the gfx and smooth gameplay convince as well as the neat itemisation. Fun!

coveredGames.name: Curse of Pirates
coveredGames.title: Demo: Challenging at first, this cannon ball hell is very decent fun! Lots of things to combine and zooming about with your magic pirate ship is just as fun as it sounds

coveredGames.name: EARTH DEFENSE FORCE 5
coveredGames.title: EDF!, EDF!, EDF! - Honestly one of the most fun co-op shooters out there. The game mechanics are motivating and the 'story' is hilariously nonsensical and silly fun

coveredGames.name: Dice Legends
coveredGames.title: The Demo: Dice manipulation did not jump at me screaming: I AM FUN! But that might be sth. to unlock later. Competent and pretty deckbuilder at first glance

coveredGames.name: Wild Bastards
coveredGames.title: This is not like Void Bastards, but by the same developers. It is challenging as well and unique in presentation and gameplay. Loved the voice acting and the shooting

coveredGames.name: Witchfire
coveredGames.title: I love everything about this game. This is not a review, this is me being a fan. IF you like shooters with a soulsy touch, this is it

coveredGames.name: Wizordum
coveredGames.title: For Fans of pixel shooters, this is a very well done variant of those. Secrets, Fantasy World, Bad Baddies and cool weapons are included

coveredGames.name: Widget Inc.
coveredGames.title: An idle game with some more active parts in between. A tad shallow for experts, but still provides a chill puzzle experience for a small price

coveredGames.name: Sands of Aura
coveredGames.title: Challenging but fun top-down action rpg with lovely world building, loads of story bits and bobs that work well. Gameplay is fun for sure and rewarding.

coveredGames.name: TerraScape
coveredGames.title: Beautiful, relaxing, rewarding puzzle game that slowly, but steadily increases its challenge level. And increase it, it does - Real brainwrecker.

coveredGames.name: VICE Undercover
coveredGames.title: Demo: Detective game with a funky presentation focused on the 80's using an Amiga Computer. It is like going to a little museum with a game and fun soundtrack.

coveredGames.name: Wall World
coveredGames.title: Enjoyable game that combines mining, progression and presentation in a very neat bundle. The dynamic changes between mines and wall crawling aka. defending is perfect!

coveredGames.name: Zero Orders Tactics
coveredGames.title: Demo: 'Indirect' tactics battle with behaviour controlled units versus the AI, which is a puzzle because of the behaviour of the units. Plus good progression. Fun!

coveredGames.name: ZERO PROTOCOL
coveredGames.title: Demo: Very atmospheric, slightly spooky detective game that has minor amounts of combat. Puzzles were fun, setting is cool and the atmosphere works very well!

coveredGames.name: Ziggurat 2
coveredGames.title: This seems an improvement over its predecessor in most regards. So you get more of the same, maybe even faster?! and more variety for sure.

coveredGames.name: RACCOIN: Coin Pusher Roguelike
coveredGames.title: Demo: Funny how the theme of a game can become absolutely secondary if the mechanics are fun and engaging like in this silly game. Still not the best option in the genre - See Full Review for Gameplay

coveredGames.name: No Such Place
coveredGames.title: Playtest: Too early to tell. It improved a lot since the last Demo I tried. Shooting is powerful and precise, combat is fine and the crafting seems okay. Story is odd - See Full Review for Gameplay

coveredGames.name: No Players Online
coveredGames.title: Demo: Original mystery game with hardcore 90s presentation. Can be good or bad. I enjoyed it a lot for its creativity and trying sth different - See Full Review for Gameplay

coveredGames.name: Nightingale
coveredGames.title: Sure, it has some issues, but as soon as I got the graphics set up correctly it did at least look amazing. Building can be wonky, combat seems fine, if a tad clunky - See Full Review for Gameplay

coveredGames.name: Morbid Metal
coveredGames.title: Demo: Super Engaging fighting game with different characters, challenging enemies and a neat, straight forward and linear level design.

coveredGames.name: Monsters are Coming!
coveredGames.title: Demo: Very fun little mix of tower defence and an arcady loot collecting game with a rewarding progression system. I had more fun than expected at first - See Full Review for Gameplay

coveredGames.name: Monomyth
coveredGames.title: Demo: Very interesting take on the dungeon crawling genre with a long way ahead in development, but quite some promise for those looking for immersion + oldschool vibe- See Full Review for Gameplay

coveredGames.name: Megabonk
coveredGames.title: Demo: Tried this and had a lot of fun. Presentation is simple, progression is interesting. 3D adds enough for me, to set it apart from other survivor games - See Full Review for Gameplay

coveredGames.name: Jump Space
coveredGames.title: Demo: Impressive Demo with seamless transition from inside your space ship to outside and other ships. Felt like the potential for co-op was massive here - See Full Review for Gameplay

coveredGames.name: ITER-8
coveredGames.title: Demo: Way more fun than expected. Straight forward mining turns into interesting upgrades, light puzzles and motivating exploration. Gfx are a bit odd, but work well - See Full Review for Gameplay

coveredGames.name: I Hate This Place
coveredGames.title: Demo: Interesting presentation mixed with okayish level design and shooting. Lacking some depth and It was missing some intensity to its atmosphere sadly - See Full Review for Gameplay

coveredGames.name: SILENT HILL f
coveredGames.title: In a culture saturated by nostalgia, we have to take a step forward to break the impasse. The next best creative configuration for Silent Hill is not a remake. A great original story.

coveredGames.name: Terminal 81
coveredGames.title: The city of Terminal 81 feels more real than fictional. It will draw you in with its free roam and charm you with its people.

coveredGames.name: Solipsistic
coveredGames.title: The fun here is the same behind the experience of how modding a game can feel more rewarding than playing it vanilla.

coveredGames.name: GAME.exe 2 - Phantom Strike
coveredGames.title: A videogame creepypasta that explores its own unique trolley problem. Will you pull the lever?

coveredGames.name: FATAL FRAME II: Crimson Butterfly REMAKE
coveredGames.title: This was a tough game to finish. There is significant backtracking in the later chapters and there is an awful boss fight near the end. It also doesn't help that the ending felt rushed and abrupt.

coveredGames.name: Restless Dreams
coveredGames.title: Dreams eventually turn into a benediction. Uncertainty transforms into purpose, enveloping your heart. There is always hope.

coveredGames.name: Resident Evil
coveredGames.title: The tank controls and the fixed-camera angles enshrine its masterclass status. Unfortunately, the same cannot be said about its writing. Jill's characterization leaves much to be desired.

coveredGames.name: Fallout: New Vegas
coveredGames.title: One of the best games of all time. A wonderful adventure filled with so much fun and lots of meaning.

coveredGames.name: Solitary in the Library
coveredGames.title: An immersive and localized ghost story told in a few different ways. If you pay attention, then you'll enjoy the novelty.

coveredGames.name: Cronos: The New Dawn
coveredGames.title: An unforgiving story supplemented with an equally ruthless resource management system.

coveredGames.name: Urayama
coveredGames.title: Urayama focuses on a day in the life of a student whose summer vacation is interrupted by the mountain behind his house.

coveredGames.name: Planet Munchers
coveredGames.title: Very fun experience and creative gamedesign. Modern voxel and low poly art style graphics. Relaxing roguelike gameplay where you can watch tiny creatures eating whole planets. Good replayability. ✨

coveredGames.name: Blender
coveredGames.title: Powerful tool if you want to create various 3D assets, for example low poly artstyle. It is hard to learn but it also fun to use if you feel creative.

coveredGames.name: VoxelForge
coveredGames.title: Turn your 3D meshes with its textures and animations into voxel style assets.

coveredGames.name: Lenrual
coveredGames.title: An experimental 3D puzzle game with artistic visuals and animations. A small open world, starry night and neon lights combined with low poly artstyle offer an unique gaming experience.

coveredGames.name: Deep Rock Galactic
coveredGames.title: Excellent FPS, can be played solo or coop. Explore with dwarven space miners: exotic alien caves and fight against insectoid creatures. Awesome modern low poly art style graphics. Highly recommended.

coveredGames.name: Impossible Pizza Delivery
coveredGames.title: 🍕Amazing soundtrack and wonderful detailed modern low poly art style. A lot of eastereggs and wow an emotional support wizard. Hopefully more levels in future, what a lovely game. Highly Recommended.

coveredGames.name: Merchant 64
coveredGames.title: Perfected low poly art style and very good technical performance. A charming retro like game with a great nostalgic atmosphere. It has fair achievements. Highly recommended for game collections.

coveredGames.name: Little Wings Deliveries
coveredGames.title: A lot of eastereggs and references. Great soundtrack, funny characters, cute and cozy adventure. Modern low poly art style. Game can be completed within one gaming session and it has fair achievements

coveredGames.name: Nightclub Empire
coveredGames.title: If you ever wanted to manage your own nightclub, this simulation game might be for you. Easy to learn and fast progression for fun sessions. Great low poly artstyle and good technical performance. 🌃

coveredGames.name: AltusPixel
coveredGames.title: Excellent tool to create assets for your own game from pixel art to cartoon and much more. Animations can be made quickly. Ui is easy to learn and the tool itself with its many features is fun to use.

coveredGames.name: Autonauts vs Piratebots
coveredGames.title: Excellent and lovely low poly artstyle game. It is similar to the first title of this series, but Piratebots are your enemy now. Build, command and program your little robots to conquer and rescue.

coveredGames.name: Marooners
coveredGames.title: Very good multiplayer game with cartoony low poly artstyle. Good variety of levels offer fun for nice gaming sessions with your friends. Family friendly. Recommended.

coveredGames.name: Hope Harrison
coveredGames.title: Indie survival horror game. Creepy creatures and monsters with low poly retrolike graphics. Good to play at stormy halloween nights.

coveredGames.name: Lumberhill
coveredGames.title: Very nice and cute graphics. A solid arcade multiplayer game with a lot of content: good variety of levels, characters and good atmosphere. Easy to learn and play. Family friendly.

coveredGames.name: Lara Croft GO
coveredGames.title: Enjoy Lara Croft's isometric 2.5D adventure with awesome and appealing low poly artstyle graphics. It has fair to get achievements. Very good for casual and relaxing gaming sessions.

coveredGames.name: Hitman GO: Definitive Edition
coveredGames.title: Hitman, but in form of a board game with beautiful low poly artstyle graphics. Tricky levels with puzzle elements offer entertainment for hours. A really nice addition for every game collection.

coveredGames.name: Rogues Like Us
coveredGames.title: Appealing low poly artstyle graphics. This game can be played with a friend via local co-op. A fun and beginner friendly rogue like game with cool explorable dungeons and customizable heroes.

coveredGames.name: Gripless: Drift Valley
coveredGames.title: Good looking cars. Very nice modern low poly artstyle game. Well made levels / streets and modes to drive arround. Plus Free Roam mode offers relaxed driving sessions. The journey is the reward. 🚗

coveredGames.name: Eschaton
coveredGames.title: Eschaton impressed me with its surreal atmosphere and great animated low poly visuals. A story about a doomsday cult, mysticism or just a dream? The encounter in the finale might give you the answer.

coveredGames.name: Bizarre Mushroom Cycle Simulator
coveredGames.title: Cute little mushrooms with a low poly artstyle can be grown in highly detailed environments for a relaxed experience. Hidden eastereggs with a charming design. A very nice screensaver alternative. 🍄

coveredGames.name: project_Structure_01
coveredGames.title: Awesome visuals and atompshere. The maze like level design reminds me of Escherian Stairwell illusions. A game which wants to be played on a big screen. An unique interactive art / gaming experience.

coveredGames.name: Bochi Collection
coveredGames.title: Four minigames, very sad stories: each designed with a different artistical approach and artstyle. I think this title is more for an adult / mature audience because its psycho-horror content.

coveredGames.name: CHWÆST: A Creeping Parasite Horror
coveredGames.title: Horror with a great concept: Retro low poly artstyle graphics helps the atmosphere for a more creepier and unsettling look. Perfect title for fun halloween nights. Don't forget to feed the core... 👻

coveredGames.name: Little Racers STREET
coveredGames.title: Huge variety of well modelled cars, tracks and cities: ton of content. Qualitative low poly artstyle racer with good atmopsheric setting. Highly recommended for racing enthusiasts and collectors.

coveredGames.name: Nauts
coveredGames.title: Very good rogue spaceshooter with low poly artstyle. I really like the concept about a planet which is a spacecraft. Nauts offers good gameplay variety, fun and a cool story. High replayability.

coveredGames.name: Crocotile 3D
coveredGames.title: Highly recommended, if you want to create your own low poly games / art: Crocotile 3D is easy to learn and use. A cool tool to create your own 3D models (levels, characters, animations and more).

coveredGames.name: Cult of the Lamb
coveredGames.title: Top Tier 2.5D cartoon artstyle mixed with 3D poly like effects. Interesting story and a huge amount of catchy gameplay variety. Highly recommendeded for game collectors who value art in games.

coveredGames.name: Down in Bermuda
coveredGames.title: Cute characters and a lovely level design. I enjoyed the creative riddles, some of them were tricky to solve. All in all a great modern low poly art style game which offers a good cozy experience.

coveredGames.name: Urbek City Builder
coveredGames.title: It's real fun to see your city grow with some strategy - even smaller cities are a nice eye catcher. Amazing city builder game with qualitative modern low poly / voxel visuals. Highly Recommended.

coveredGames.name: Tomato Jones
coveredGames.title: A treasure hunting tomato with a hat? Fun comedy casual 3d platfomer with some tricky levels. This low poly artstyle game is really for tomato connoisseurs recommended but also for game collectors. :)

coveredGames.name: Pixel Combat: Zombie Shooter
coveredGames.title: Brilliant modern low poly artstyle and many eastereggs. Story, Suvivalmode and challenges offer fun for many hours. Gameplay progress is motivating and it has fair achievements. Highly Recommended.

coveredGames.name: WHATEVER
coveredGames.title: I like the well made eastereggs to discover in this low poly art style game. Each level has its own unique atmosphere and challenge. The game might be difficult but beating a level feels rewarding.

coveredGames.name: Toree Saturn
coveredGames.title: One can see the love in this work of art. Its colorful low poly arstyle is well made and the characters are realy cute. Platformer game with motivating music. Fun, easy to learn but hard to master.

coveredGames.name: Poly Skies
coveredGames.title: Relaxing, easy to learn + family friendly city building gameplay with adorable villagers. I hope for a sequel to learn more about the lore. Atmospheric music + wonderful modern low poly artstyle.

coveredGames.name: Conquero : Rise or Kneel
coveredGames.title: Made with colorful qualitative modern low poly art style. Easy to learn. Overall a good gaming experience. An Indie strategy game that will entertain the player for hours. High replayablility.

coveredGames.name: Gothic II: Gold Edition

coveredGames.name: Gothic 1 Classic

coveredGames.name: Tidy Up Mall

coveredGames.title: Hits the right balance between tidy up game and narrative puzzle game. Super gorgeous, immersive and addictive!

coveredGames.name: Tidy Farm

coveredGames.name: Tidy Up the Town
coveredGames.title: Tidy Up the Town is simply perfect. You can pet and befriend a cat and a dog. 11/10. Masterpiece.

coveredGames.name: Satisfactory

coveredGames.title: Probably the most "horror" game I will ever play. Super nerve-racking yet fun exploration, crafting, combat, building, and survival... all the way up to the first boss fight and then I'm done for.

coveredGames.name: Witchspire
coveredGames.title: Creature collector meets witchy game. There's definitely room for improvement, but the concept is there and I'm loving it!

coveredGames.title: This game is big and overwhelming, in a very good way. You put together exhibits piece by piece, which takes super long as many of them have dozens of pieces to put together. Slow-burn tidying.

coveredGames.name: A Place for Every Potion

coveredGames.name: Deleted Wiki: Clean Up the Lost Files

coveredGames.name: Black Friday Janitor: Clean the Whole Mall
coveredGames.title: SO. MANY. ITEMS. Leveling is slower but well-balanced and upgrades kept throughout the entire mall, making this the biggest, most satisfying tidy up loop I've played.

coveredGames.name: Wand & Order: Tidy up the magic shop!
coveredGames.title: I didn’t think I would love it as much as I did, on behalf of the “everything looks very similar” thing - but something about it was deeply calming and addictive, and now it’s one of my favourites.

coveredGames.name: Too Many Toys!
coveredGames.title: The only toy store tidy up game that did it right. The atmosphere of the game transports me back to my 6 year old self with my mum screaming at me to get off the train tracks and not touch the robot.

coveredGames.title: I'm struggling to get into this game enough to judge it fairly by fun factor. It has bot support through a dedicated playlist and private lobbies, both require an internet connection.

coveredGames.name: Splitgate
coveredGames.title: The original Splitgate remains available and with all the microtransactions and unlocks granted to you. Servers were replaced with community lobbies. You can play with bots but internet is required.

coveredGames.name: World War Legion
coveredGames.title: It's a WW2 Reskin of Combat Master with the bulk of new content consisting of 3 new maps at this stage. Not terrible, but if it's ever worth going out of your way for, it's not now.

coveredGames.name: Chivalry: Medieval Warfare
coveredGames.title: A medieval big team game that supports offline play via bot support. Heard the sequel also has bots, but is online-only. So this one may at least still be playable for quite a while.

coveredGames.name: Backroom Warfare II
coveredGames.title: A CoD deathmatch clone set in the backrooms with killstreaks spawning in iconic backrooms monsters that target your enemies as well as you. It's nothing super special and only has 3 maps. Bots allowed

coveredGames.name: Half-Life Arena
coveredGames.title: A modded version of Half-life Deathmatch. Honestly I was sold the moment I heard you could play against bot opponents.

coveredGames.name: Basket Bots
coveredGames.title: An arcadey 1v1 2.5D physics-based basketball game? Cool idea. It's kinda like a simple and cool mishmash of Rocket league and NBA 2k Playgrounds. Who needs a shoot button? Decent Bot Support too.

coveredGames.name: Incursion Red River
coveredGames.title: This may be a stretch for bot support, but this is a singleplayer and coop only extraction shooter. It's actually pretty dang fun if you can get it working. IDK if it's fair to count this or not...

coveredGames.name: Exploding Judo Federation
coveredGames.title: From the creator(s) of Schwarzerblitz comes a fighting game where you win by making enemies explode from throws. Rounds can end in seconds after a proper combo. Supports botmatches in Free Match.

coveredGames.name: Slasher
coveredGames.title: A lowpoly low budget indie PVP horror game that has bot support, but only lets you play as the Slasher in singleplayer. It's a bit buggy too and could use some more TLC, but can be fun.

coveredGames.name: Marvel Rivals
coveredGames.title: The best hero shooter on the market in 2025 does support botmatches, both through a playlist and custom games. You can expect it to be online-only, and it requires an SSD to play.

coveredGames.name: Passant: A Chess Roguelike
coveredGames.title: A roguelike chess game with mechanics and ideas similar to balatro. However, unlike Balatro, you actually have a bot opponent to fight and even the option to make a custom match against it.

coveredGames.name: The Karters 2: Turbo Charged
coveredGames.title: A heavily moddable kart racing game that takes heavy inspiration from Crash Team Racing. I had to get used to some new mechanics, but it's pretty good and also fully supports bots offline.

coveredGames.name: Toaster Arena
coveredGames.title: This unnecessarily fun free FPS starring protogens is mechanically really fun, like a cross between multiple popular shooters. At some point bot support was added so you can play MP modes solo.

coveredGames.name: Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl 2
coveredGames.title: Another great platform fighter with Nickelodeon characters. Some from the first game are missing, but there are some other fan favorites and a roguelite story mode. Obvious offline bot support is yes.

coveredGames.name: Crimson Desert Enhanced
coveredGames.title: RED: Major spider boss in the area Arboria Castle, as well as ambient small spiders throughout the game.

coveredGames.name: Rhythm Doctor

coveredGames.name: Soulmask

coveredGames.name: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon

coveredGames.name: Mittelland AD
coveredGames.title: BLUE: The only spidery thing here is going to be your web of informants spying on your rivals.

coveredGames.name: Magic: The Gathering Arena

coveredGames.name: The RPG

coveredGames.name: Dog in the Machine
coveredGames.title: Dog in the Machine offers a pretty stellar roguelike puzzle experience, but its focus on the cerebral over action might be a turn-off for some.

coveredGames.name: Dupery: A Game of Solo Deduction
coveredGames.title: Dupery: A Game of Solo Deduction is a fun novelty with some great ideas, but it lacks in certain other areas that might turn some people away.

coveredGames.name: From Beyond: Arcade Edition

coveredGames.name: Outcast Tales

coveredGames.name: Warhammer Survivors

coveredGames.name: God of War Ragnarök
coveredGames.title: A fantastic title, building from its predecessor's already phenomenal combat, though the story wasn't everything that I hoped it would be.

coveredGames.name: Fallen Tear: The Ascension

coveredGames.name: Into the Crypt

coveredGames.name: Dino Time Raiders

coveredGames.name: The WereCleaner

coveredGames.name: Fischer's Fishing Journey

coveredGames.name: Egg Squeeze
coveredGames.title: 🥚 Easy to pick up, impossible to put down. Sleepless nights and egg-puns guaranteed.

coveredGames.name: Bongo Cat

coveredGames.name: Cozy Organizer
coveredGames.title: 🌸 A colourful, relaxing puzzle game full of organizing & decorating fun. Thoughtful accessibility touches, soothing sounds, and cozy vibes perfect for chill gamers!

coveredGames.name: Whimside

coveredGames.name: Catto's Post Office

coveredGames.name: Lakeside Bar

coveredGames.name: Find My Frogs

coveredGames.name: Village Tale

coveredGames.name: Idle Waters
coveredGames.title: Idle Waters is a cozy idle game where you play as a red panda on a fishing adventure! Cute fish, fun upgrades, and quests make it engaging and relaxing. A must-play for idle game lovers! 🎣🌊

coveredGames.name: Wavetale

coveredGames.name: Tabletop Tavern
coveredGames.title: First Impressions: A Strategy RTS Roguelike. Essentially "Total War Roguelike". Engaging gameplay. Fun!

coveredGames.name: Mirklurk: Every Step Matters

coveredGames.name: Arise Dark Lord

coveredGames.name: Warhammer Survivors

coveredGames.name: Arcane Eats

coveredGames.name: Don't Let It Starve

coveredGames.name: Rogue Blight

coveredGames.name: The King is Watching

coveredGames.name: Lootbound

coveredGames.name: Underkeep

coveredGames.name: Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors

coveredGames.name: Lootbane

coveredGames.title: Short horror game. Complete the game, view the credits, click on gift option in menu and complete the game again. ~1 minute to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Everyday Devil
coveredGames.title: Free guided VN/walking sim. Chapter select unlocks after finishing the game. In XI, complete the FPS sequence without getting hit. In XIII, check the tools on the stage's right side. ~1 hour to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Double Trip
coveredGames.title: Sokoban puzzle game. Complete all levels and extra levels, then bring the statue to the goal at the center of the map. Some puzzles can be tricky. ~2 hours to 100%.

coveredGames.name: 100 Cats Lost in China 2 Find & Color
coveredGames.title: Hybrid hidden object/paint by number game. Type 'mesela' in main menu, click one cat/paint one square and press 'v' to auto complete all levels. ~1 minute to 100%.

coveredGames.name: 100 Cats Lost in Canada 2 Find & Color
coveredGames.title: Hybrid hidden object/paint by number game. Type 'mesela' in main menu, click one cat/paint one square and press 'v' to auto complete all levels. ~1 minute to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Banana 3D
coveredGames.title: Free clicker. Click 10 million times and complete a few misc settings tasks for all achievements. There is a click cap. ~300 hours to 100%.

coveredGames.name: The Da Vinci Cryptex 6
coveredGames.title: Fully guided puzzle game. Restart the game if first level doesn't work. ~20 minutes to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Aquarium Anomaly
coveredGames.title: Anomaly loop game. Finish the game with 10 correct guesses and find all 42 anomalies; to farm anomalies go back in loop 1 until you fail, repeat until done. ~40 minutes to 100%, slightly based on RNG.

coveredGames.name: FAST FOOD FUNKIN'
coveredGames.title: Free simple rhythm game. Finish the 3 orders, get 50 combo, hit all green notes (easy by holding down keys), dress up only mask (top left, use Hide Extras). Cheevos unlock at end. ~5+ minutes to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Cartomancy Anthology
coveredGames.title: Free collection of digital experiences. Play all subgames for all achievements. Use the 3 card option to be quicker. Skipping does not work. ~10 minutes to 100%.

coveredGames.name: Coffee Mania
coveredGames.title: First-person horror game. Its single achievement unlocks upon starting the game. ~1 minute to 100%.

coveredGames.name: The Entropy Centre
coveredGames.title: [Thought] A first-person puzzle game with a time manipulation mechanic & theme. The premise of this game is so interesting to think about, the story trips at the end, but the concept is fantastic.

coveredGames.name: The Spectrum Retreat
coveredGames.title: [Philosophy] Although not a clear theme, this 'walking sim meets first-person puzzle game' raises some moral questions as part of its unfolding mystery. It's not perfect, but it's an enjoyable game.

coveredGames.name: Room Zero
coveredGames.title: [Psychology] A short 'liminal spaces' game, that will rope in the innately curious way past completion. I found the puzzles intriguing, and I really enjoyed the unnerving atmosphere in this game.

coveredGames.name: Control, I'm Not Coming Back
coveredGames.title: [Philosophy] A short, free & incredibly enjoyable walking simulator that raises questions on human nature, human relationships and the strength of the human spirit. What a beautiful game.

coveredGames.name: The Vanishing of Ethan Carter
coveredGames.title: [Thought] A unique and fun to explore walking simulator with novel detective elements, and an interesting story that only really left an impact and got me thinking after I had finished the game.

coveredGames.name: THE CORRIDOR
coveredGames.title: [Psychology] A Stanley-esque mind-game walking sim that suffers from the inevitable comparison but does have a bit of creativity. It's quite amateur, but it's cheap. Overall, an apathetic thumbs-up.

coveredGames.name: Ether One
coveredGames.title: [Psychology|Thought] An emotional & thought-provoking game about dementia, that can be played as a walking sim but is better completed along with all optional puzzles. (see the full review as to why)

coveredGames.name: Hypnogenesis
coveredGames.title: Hypnogenesis

coveredGames.name: Database Detective: Minor Crimes Division
coveredGames.title: Database Detective is a very unique game that more than likely has no equal - a must play if you like detective games. SQL knowledge not required, but no doubt helps!

coveredGames.name: Bloodthief
coveredGames.title: 2nd best first person movement game I've ever played next to Neon White. The movement (& tech) is comically fast, I've never seen a game that allows you to go quite this fast. High recommend.

coveredGames.name: Vault of the Void
coveredGames.title: VotV is a tremendously deep and customizable deckbuilding roguelite, and my favorite of all time. Filled with content and challenges, it will keep you having fun for a long while.

coveredGames.name: KILL KNIGHT
coveredGames.title: An excellent twin stick shooter filled with style, gore, intense music and challenge. While it may feel short to some, the experience is filled with challenge and excitement. Well worth it.

coveredGames.name: Kabuto Park
coveredGames.title: An extremely cozy and cute bug catching & fighting game (well, pushing.) Very quick, but very charming.

coveredGames.name: Mortal Sin
coveredGames.title: Easily the best first person melee combat I've ever experienced in a video game, Mortal Sin offers a truly strong 'Berserk'-inspired experience where you can feel insanely strong.

coveredGames.name: Eyelord Returns
coveredGames.title: Eyelord Returns is a straightforward, heavy metal-themed match-3 arcade game that stands out for its neat visuals and custom-made soundtrack. It also features leaderboards and a co-op mode.

coveredGames.name: Burger Patrol
coveredGames.title: Nearly 5 years after its release, this not-so-small puzzle game about dogs making burgers has received a MASSIVE update, featuring revamped leaderboards, online PvP, Story Mode, and more. 1000/10 <3

coveredGames.name: Gourmet Zombie
coveredGames.title: The latest game from the devs of Mothmen 1966, is a survival horror game with PSX aesthetics, where you have to cook humans for your master, who is turning into a zombie. Amazing that it's free.

coveredGames.name: Milki Delivery
coveredGames.title: From makers of other cozy games like Minami Lane, and with more content than that one, this is a lovely, ultra-relaxing title where you do exactly what the title clearly suggests. Give it a chance!

coveredGames.name: Blackjack Roulette
coveredGames.title: The name speaks for itself: it’s a sort of “survival Blackjack”, with insurance cards that act like the jokers in Balatro. Simple, but not bad at all, especially on sale. There is a demo available.

coveredGames.name: When The Past Was Around
coveredGames.title: This is a sweet yet sad story of loss and moving on, which stands out for its lovely, remarkable artwork. Its puzzle gameplay is quite relaxing, and lasts around 2 hours. Check the available demo!

coveredGames.name: A Most Extraordinary Gnome
coveredGames.title: A 2D indie game, lovingly handcrafted with paper-cut elements. Its levels are a kind of boss battles, challenging, but with adjustable difficulty. Like the gnome, it's short, but extraordinary <3

coveredGames.name: Cats in Time
coveredGames.title: From the creators of the hugely popular Escape Simulator, this one, with a smol scope, is about finding kittens by solving easy puzzles in small dioramas. Smaller, yes, yet way more relaxing.

coveredGames.name: Mini Mini Golf Golf
coveredGames.title: Mini Mini Golf Golf is a sort of "avant-garde" narrative game, with a glitchy aesthetic, futuristic sci-fi story about climate change, and even a short live-action TV show inside. Try the demo first.

coveredGames.name: The House Before
coveredGames.title: A short, unsettling psychological horror adventure in which we have the dreadful experience of “being” a house. With neat visuals as bizarre as its premise, it's well worth a look.

coveredGames.name: Slay the Princess — The Pristine Cut
coveredGames.title: A visual novel that’s quite easy to get into, thanks to the quality of its hand-drawn artwork and its addictive narrative loop. It lives up to all the praise it has received. Go for it.

coveredGames.name: Fishing at the Lake Full of Cats
coveredGames.title: Wonderful, a meme game about fishing cats! There’s not much more to say, they’ve put a lot of love into it, and the price is a bargain.

coveredGames.name: 6 Feet Behind
coveredGames.title: 6 Feet Behind is roughly the distance you’ll need to keep from the enemies chasing you in this sort of 2.5D puzzle-horror game, where each pursuer has a different gameplay twist.

coveredGames.name: Pumpkin Jack
coveredGames.title: The name “Jack” fits the phrase “Jack of all trades, master of none”, as the game sadly lacks a bit depth in every aspect. Still, it looks good, it’s fun to play, and also cheap on sale.

coveredGames.name: Girl & Scarecrow
coveredGames.title: Girl & Scarecrow is a delightful visual novel, not only because of its claymation visuals, but also due to its captivating, branching story. Give it a go, there’s a demo available.

coveredGames.name: Tenebris Somnia
coveredGames.title: The long-awaited Tenebris Somnia has finally arrived, after years of anticipation. It beautifully blends 2D pixel-art survival horror with unique, superb live-action cutscenes. A demo is available.

coveredGames.name: Funnel Runners
coveredGames.title: An intense and atmospheric, up to 8 players co-op game, where you have to loot the evacuated city in search of parts to repair the van before the massive tornado hits. Cool AF :D

coveredGames.name: METAL GEAR SOLID 4: Guns of the Patriots - Master Collection Version
coveredGames.title: Locked away on the PS3 for so long, MGS4 is finally on PC. Nearly half the game consists of absurdly long cutscenes. Still, it delivers a fitting conclusion to the legendary saga, so it's a must.

coveredGames.name: Blades of Time
coveredGames.title: Blades of Time is an intense DMC-style hack-and-slash game from 2012. The gameplay is cool, and the story is just okay. Sadly, the ending is a bit shallow, as if a sequel were planned.

coveredGames.name: Burn With Me
coveredGames.title: This one is perfect for the spooky month! An accessible deckbuilder that grows in complexity without neglecting narrative power, with a story about anthropomorphic characters who perform dark rituals.

coveredGames.name: Honked: a clown noir
coveredGames.title: The lack of a save system and some occasional crashes sadly undermines the silliness and charm of this short jam game. Get it on sale, and pass it on a single session if you're still up for it.

coveredGames.name: Frog Detective 3: Corruption at Cowboy County
coveredGames.title: The final chapter of the series, and, without a doubt, the best one, wrapping up the saga on a high note. I'm going to miss the detective's adventures ;(

coveredGames.name: Pony Island
coveredGames.title: Pony Island is a minimalist and unconventional indie puzzle game. The gameplay is intense, and breaks the fourth wall in a brilliant way. Worth playing, and it's currently available for free.

coveredGames.name: Frog Detective 2: The Case of the Invisible Wizard
coveredGames.title: It's impossible not to love the Frog Detective :3

coveredGames.name: CARROT: Pancakes and Waffles
coveredGames.title: This is a complementary game to its predecessor, Carrot. With no dialogue or objectives, it's all about exploring its charming town and appreciating its vibrant, distinctive art and imaginative world.

coveredGames.name: Frog Detective 1: The Haunted Island
coveredGames.title: Frog Detective is a first-person narrative series with a very silly and wholesome sense of humour. They are quite short, around an hour long, so it's best to get the trilogy as a bundle.

coveredGames.name: Streets of Fury EX
coveredGames.title: Cool beat 'em up with digitized sprite graphics, like those used in the classic Mortal Kombat games. It has a huge number of characters and move sets. Best suited for local / remote play, multiplayer.

coveredGames.name: Strange Brigade
coveredGames.title: It's a co-op focused horde game with some extras like puzzles and hidden objects. However, the campaign is mediocre, some of the enemies are repetitive, and despite being from 2018, STILL has Denuvo.

coveredGames.name: Miniatures
coveredGames.title: 4 micro-stories with open interpretation, beautifully illustrated and animated. They involve just clicking and take less than an hour to play through.

coveredGames.name: Rustler (Grand Theft Horse)
coveredGames.title: Solid top-down GTA medieval parody. The story is funny, full of memes, but there's not much to do in its open world. Also, the publisher launcher feels unnecessary. Only get it when on sale.

coveredGames.name: Toska
coveredGames.title: A unusual side-scroller in which we have complete freedom to explore and collect items, whilst searching for a present for our mom. It takes some getting used to, but there’s lots to discover.

coveredGames.name: Slash-Out: Fantasy Dueling
coveredGames.title: Slash-Out brings challenging multi-stage duels, where memorising, anticipating and reacting to enemy attacks will be crucial. Featuring a sleek 3D wireframe style, without textures. Demo available.

coveredGames.name: Virginia
coveredGames.title: Despite its colourful, cinematic style, Virginia didn’t win me over. Its lack of gameplay, and its speechless narrative, aren’t compensated with a story that’s strong enough.

coveredGames.name: METAL GEAR SOLID 2: Sons of Liberty - Master Collection Version
coveredGames.title: A game ahead of its time, perhaps not the best in the series, but one that remains scary relevant. It’s a shame the port isn’t perfect, and requires mods for some fixes.

coveredGames.name: Tunnet
coveredGames.title: Digging and installing network cables proved to be quite addictive, plus there is an intriguing plot and spooky atmosphere. Amazing that it weighs less than 100 MB. You should try the demo NOW!

coveredGames.name: Dream Tactics
coveredGames.title: Dream Tactics brilliantly combines several cool elements, such as turn-based tactics, deck-building, a minimalist pixel art style, and a storyline full of lovely, silly characters. Go for it.

coveredGames.name: Flibbius McDoogle and the Mysterious Flying Machine
coveredGames.title: Short, sweet and cheap, in Flibbius McDoogle, we play a turtle that goes on an adventure, exploring an island and crafting items. A sequel has been announced and it's ready to wishlist.

coveredGames.name: Shoe it All!
coveredGames.title: Besides its cool visuals, the gameplay is simple and fun: swing, let go of your shoes, and smash whatever’s in front of you. Also, the nearly non existent transition between levels keeps you hooked.

coveredGames.name: Bounty Trail
coveredGames.title: A little game where you play as a bounty-hunting cowboy, with Oregon Trail vibes. Looks nice and offers a bit of a challenge, although it has some wasted potential. The Dev's other games are nice too.

coveredGames.name: Dicetris
coveredGames.title: Dicetris is a relaxing and particularly elegant puzzle game, thanks to its neat minimalism. You have to add up dice, and some of its rules leave plenty of scope for ingenious moves. Demo available.

coveredGames.title: Ok if you are a GK fan and want to own some great bonus content, but this 2014 remake already feels more dated than the original and features a lesser voice cast. If new, play the original first.

coveredGames.name: Alien: Isolation
coveredGames.title: A modern classic, Alien: Isolation surpasses most Alien film sequels and still holds up 11 years on due to a no-gimmicks design philosophy and excellent (and accurate) visual direction.

coveredGames.name: Hole io
coveredGames.title: An addicting and satisfying battle royale game where you devour the map to grow bigger and bigger. Hole io is a quirky and simple game that's easy to pick up. No DLC is required for the 100%.

coveredGames.name: Pumpkin Jack
coveredGames.title: A super fun, silly and simple platformer that won’t take you too long to hundo. It’s surprisingly well written and a perfect gem for spooky season.s

coveredGames.name: Unforgiving - A Northern Hymn
coveredGames.title: Unforgiving: A Northern Hymn delivers a chilling Scandinavian atmosphere, creepy folklore, and tense exploration. The haunting environments and encounters make it a memorable horror experience.

coveredGames.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
coveredGames.title: Steel, demons, and stylish swordplay! Onimusha: Way of the Sword delivers brutal fights, flashy parries, and a badass journey through demon-infested Kyoto. Slice through every demon in your path.

coveredGames.name: STUFFED
coveredGames.title: Had a really good time with this game. Fun gameplay, loads of charm, and it’s just an easy game to jump on and enjoy. Would definitely recommend!

coveredGames.name: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Reloaded Edition
coveredGames.title: Incredible parkour mechanics and brutal melee combat make leaping across towering rooftops thrilling. Tense night chases, fluid traversal, and satisfying skill upgrades create an addictive loop.

coveredGames.name: Bright Memory: Infinite
coveredGames.title: Guns? Check. Sword? Check. Superpowers? Check. Plot? Uh... probably. Bright Memory: Infinite is what happens when someone puts an anime, a fever dream, and a rocket launcher in a blender.

coveredGames.name: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion
coveredGames.title: Delightful throwback to a era of nostalgia. You wouldnt be able to guess this was a modern title because it replicates the old school beat em up days to perfection without overstaying its welcome.

coveredGames.name: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide
coveredGames.title: L4D2 meets 40k. Super entertaining co-op FPS. There’s no wrong choice between classes and they keep adding new content regularly. There is no lack of 40k content but this one is unique and wicked fun.

coveredGames.name: Magic: The Gathering Arena
coveredGames.title: Excellent place to learn the ins and outs of Magic: The Gathering without going broke before you realize if you limit or not. The best part is it’s free.

coveredGames.name: Moonlight Peaks
coveredGames.title: An addicting game that'll keep you engaged day after day. Raise creepy creatures, grow odd crops, and get to know interesting townsfolk. Moonlight Peaks is a farming sim that stands out from the rest.

coveredGames.name: Portal with RTX
coveredGames.title: This remaster transforms a beloved classic with breathtaking path tracing, gorgeous volumetric lighting, and crisp 4K textures. The test chambers feel entirely brand new, atmospheric, and mesmerizing.

coveredGames.name: Duskfade
coveredGames.title: Duskfade is a colorful and charming adventure full of secrets to uncover. Jump, dash, grapple and slash your way through beautiful worlds and enjoy a wonderfully cozy journey.

coveredGames.name: Shenmue I & II
coveredGames.title: Shenmue is the perfect mix of revenge, martial arts, awkward conversations, and somehow spending way too much time caring about forklift driving. An absolute classic that still oozes atmosphere.

coveredGames.name: Brotato
coveredGames.title: The game has various accessibility features for various people. If you need something tweaked, it's likely there. They help make the game fun for everyone, and allows for a lot more people to 100% it.

coveredGames.name: Hyperdimension Neptunia Re;Birth1
coveredGames.title: Full of references and addicting gameplay. The animations are cool and the characters are interesting. It's a very grindy game, with some unlocks requiring multiple playthroughs. Overall a great time.

coveredGames.name: Artifact Seeker: Resurrection
coveredGames.title: Great little survivor roguelike with lots of room to experiment. Unlocking new upgrades and trying different builds keeps every run feeling fresh and worthwhile

coveredGames.name: Steam Controller
coveredGames.title: A great controller for PC gamers who want to customize and optimize their controller. It's lightweight, comfortable, and works with my PC flawlessly. Being able to turn off the LED is great. 10/10

coveredGames.name: Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate
coveredGames.title: Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate is a blast! Fast-paced combat, charming pixel art, smooth co-op, and fun character variety make every run enjoyable. Easy to recommend!

coveredGames.name: Ship Graveyard Simulator
coveredGames.title: Simple, satisfying, and easy to switch your brain off with. Watching a massive ship slowly disappear piece by piece never really gets old. Definitely worth picking up if you like relaxing games

coveredGames.name: Mewgenics
coveredGames.title: From the creators of The Binding of Isaac and The End is Nigh, comes another great long grind of a game. Between the music and the unique cats you can breed, there is always something new to find

coveredGames.name: Halo: Campaign Evolved
coveredGames.title: What a masterclass of a remake. The game runs so smooth with zero issues. Guns feel amazing. The ability to run is a game changer and adds nice pace. Remix mode is terrifying but I dig it. Overall A++

coveredGames.name: Old Market Simulator
coveredGames.title: Old Market Simulator turns stocking shelves and serving customers into a surprisingly addictive loop. Relax, expand your business, optimize every shelf, and watch your profits grow.

coveredGames.name: Red Dead Redemption
coveredGames.title: A timeless Western adventure with unforgettable characters, a gripping story, and a beautiful open world. Every ride, duel, and quiet moment feels meaningful from start to finish.

coveredGames.name: Discounty
coveredGames.title: Discounty is an addicting shop sim that stands out from the rest of the genre! Restock shelves, get the inside scoop on gossip, and make decisions that impact your small town in this gem of a game!

coveredGames.name: Arrow a Row
coveredGames.title: A highly addictive, free-to-play casual auto-runner that delivers exactly what fake mobile game advertisements promise. No ads. No microtransactions. Simple “time waster” that’s pretty fun.

coveredGames.name: LiEat
coveredGames.title: If you’re looking for a short, charming, and beautifully illustrated narrative this is short and sweet. It falls flat for anyone seeking deep combat mechanics or vast exploration.

coveredGames.name: Little Noah: Scion of Paradise
coveredGames.title: Short runs, fun combos, and enough variety to keep things fresh. A charming little roguelite that's well worth playing

coveredGames.name: Gamble With Your Friends
coveredGames.title: By far the most fun I have had in a while, from the "stake" like gambling games to selling your friends body parts for more money. Its a blast to play, both whimsical and tense betting it all on red

coveredGames.name: World War Z VR
coveredGames.title: An intense VR shooter packed with massive swarms, satisfying gunplay, and nonstop action. The immersive perspective makes every close call thrilling and every victory feel earned.

coveredGames.title: Shakespeare, magical girls, and chaos? Sign me up. Came for curiosity, stayed for the laughs and fun battles. Wonderfully ridiculous. The Bard would probably approve of this madness. Pure silliness.

coveredGames.name: Life is Strange Remastered
coveredGames.title: A great remaster of a beautiful story. This game is a must play for anyone who likes story driven games where your choices matter. You definitely “will remember that.”

coveredGames.name: Forza Horizon 6

coveredGames.name: VRChat
coveredGames.title: VRChat runs on the Steam Frame at 36 FPS reprojected to 72, depending on the room. It works despite the devs saying anti-cheat would block it and that they won't support it. Informational only.

coveredGames.name: Synth Riders
coveredGames.title: Synth Riders runs standalone on the Steam Frame at a full 72 FPS with 0% reprojection, and battery lasts close to 1 hour 30 minutes. Great performance and an easy recommendation if you own a Frame.

coveredGames.name: Arizona Sunshine® VR 2
coveredGames.title: Arizona Sunshine 2 standalone on the Steam Frame: 36 FPS reprojected to 72 on max settings with AA at 8, and it feels quite smooth. Battery lasts about 1 hour 20 minutes. Great on the headset.

coveredGames.name: Arizona Sunshine® VR Remake
coveredGames.title: Arizona Sunshine Remake runs standalone on the Steam Frame at 36 FPS reprojected to 72, and it's quite smooth on max settings with AA at 8. Battery lasts about 1 hour 20 minutes. Easy recommendation.

coveredGames.name: Beat Saber
coveredGames.title: Beat Saber runs great standalone on the Steam Frame, even maxed out. I had no slowdowns and no controller tracking issues. If you have a Frame, this is one to grab right away.

coveredGames.name: SUPERHOT VR
coveredGames.title: SUPERHOT is a pretty great experience running standalone on the Steam Frame. No hitches, great performance, and it looks really good. If you have a Frame, this is one to grab.

coveredGames.name: Cubism
coveredGames.title: Cubism is great on the Steam Frame, but you do need the color camera to play it. If you're set up for that, it's an easy recommendation. Without the camera the game isn't playable.

coveredGames.name: Half-Life: Alyx
coveredGames.title: Alyx standalone on the Steam Frame uses eye tracking and foveated rendering. Distant outdoor objects look clearly lower res, but otherwise it runs fairly well for what it is. Worth playing on a Frame.

coveredGames.name: The Demon Lord's Maid Cafe
coveredGames.title: This game was hilariously stupid-chaotic. I found myself spamming my keyboard yet the gameplay and short levels never got boring. Peak enjoyment for a short/cheap snack.

coveredGames.name: SANAE's Sylphid Breeze
coveredGames.title: A cute action platformer with some shmup gameplay; it's an ode to Kirby games, even down to the celebration dances. Just like other touhou-related games, you can expect some bullet hell gaming.

coveredGames.name: Gawr Gura: Quest for Bread
coveredGames.title: A fairly comical 3D platformer that was a perfect length and quality for a snack. Entertaining throughout, felt natural to memorize everything for the speedrun, achievements were challenging enough.

coveredGames.name: Garden of Witches
coveredGames.title: An absolute snack of an action roguelite with cute art. It's not too difficult however, but progression feels great and there's enough builds and tiered upgrades to experiment with.

coveredGames.name: Touhou Russian Roulette
coveredGames.title: Pretty fun buckshot roulette clone. Just with cute Touhou characters. It's pretty forgiving with the lives system and the items available. A short snack.

coveredGames.name: Class of '09: Puzzle Showdown
coveredGames.title: This game is horribly offensive. But it plays well as an arcade puzzler because it's pretty much a copy of Pokemon Puzzle League. A bit overpriced but I enjoyed it throughout.

coveredGames.name: Shattered Divinities
coveredGames.title: It's interesting because this metroidvania isn't spectacular in any one aspect, but gets the job done, is a nice length, and does everything well enough that I have no complaints.

coveredGames.name: Sun Halo
coveredGames.title: Can trust this developer to have nice art and implement roguelike into their deckbuilder for a fun snack experience. There's different speeds to go along with how fast you'd like to play.

coveredGames.name: Narin: The Orange Room
coveredGames.title: Somewhat jank and linear horror game with cheap jump scares, puzzles, and stealth sections. It's a bit overpriced, cutscenes are somewhat long and unskippable, but the game is a solid snack.

coveredGames.name: Perfect Hand of Nostalpix [REMASTER]
coveredGames.title: A pretty straightforward card battler. Surprised it was a remake of an older classic as there's a few mechanics with card upgrades that keeps the game enjoyable for its' short playthrough.

coveredGames.name: White Night Dream
coveredGames.title: At a glance this game doesn't look as enticing and story doesn't interest me, but the developer consistently implements roguelike gameplay in a creative manner to dish out these fun snack-sized games.

coveredGames.name: Sunset Routes
coveredGames.title: Pretty neat take on the grid-placement resource management with a touch of roguelike. The gameplay was simple and addictive enough for its length, and the game has some nice artwork and chill music.

coveredGames.name: Z-GYUBAAN!
coveredGames.title: Neat little arcade-twin stick with some rapid-fire levels (and two that are needlessly long). Fun to kite, maneuver, but probably not as great needing to wait for enemies to be over squares. Good OST.

coveredGames.name: One Turn Kill
coveredGames.title: Fairly short but an incredible roguelike deckbuilder with a good amount of charm. If you're a fan of Yugioh decks, infinites, and general looping shenanigans, a pretty fun game to get into.

coveredGames.name: FANTASY LIFE i: The Girl Who Steals Time
coveredGames.title: This game is almost perfect with the amount of content and variety it offers. It's pretty much a single-player MMO with co-op dungeons that never get stale with a ton of QoL. My 2025 GOTY.

coveredGames.name: MAID MOVING BOXES
coveredGames.title: A very simple idea but a relaxing and fun experience you can share with friends. Best part is that it's free, and a pretty solid quality for something free. Short enough to not overstay its welcome.

coveredGames.name: Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels
coveredGames.title: There's not much depth in the gameplay but it's got a range of difficulty and some nice art. Boobie tennis. This is also the censored version, and completion isn't too bad. Also skipped all the story.

coveredGames.name: Hayo and the Emporium
coveredGames.title: Roguelike deckbuilder but make it a slot machine. This was actually a pretty neat idea and I had fun running it back on runs to see what builds were consistent enough for a win.

coveredGames.name: Star Soraight Fantasy: Magic to reach the sky
coveredGames.title: Yet another small metroidvania. Movement and combat is almost nonexistent and some animations are pretty mediocre, but cleaning up and exploring is as fun as always.

coveredGames.name: Marisa!ReturnTheBook!
coveredGames.title: A charming clicker that might require a few retries in testing what things give the most DPS, as well as perks that can absolutely magnify and set builds. Solid art and features well-hidden secrets.

coveredGames.name: Witchroid Vania: A Magical Girl’s Fantastical Adventures
coveredGames.title: I'm always a fan of pocket-sized metroidvanias. The game lacks a bit of depth but it's a good example of the genre as a whole being consistent and appealing to exploration and puzzles.

coveredGames.name: YGGDRA REFRAIN
coveredGames.title: This is kinda want I want in a gacha game, no money needed, single player, enough to look at and do. Some combat mechanics and boss fights to maneuver through. A solid buy for the time invested.

coveredGames.name: TouHou Makuka Sai ~ Fantastic Danmaku Festival Part III
coveredGames.title: The production value is unbelievably crisp. Audio's amazing, the mechanics and boss gimmicks are fun to learn, the game is just overall beautiful. A large range of difficulty, so accessible to all.

coveredGames.name: SignaNota
coveredGames.title: The game didn't have the best roguelike aspects regarding depth but the combat was satisfying, the cast was charming, and the game didn't overstay its welcome.

coveredGames.name: Hello Kitty Island Adventure
coveredGames.title: This game is quite literally the best of its subgenre. You're not gonna find a cozy island adventure with as much quality of life and content as this. A fantastic time with friends.
