coveredGames.name: Project Silverfish
coveredGames.title: A Stalker-Like that actually stands on its own two feet! It combines Stalker with immersive sim elements, and is really well made. Don't let the graphics and furry stuff put you off!

coveredGames.name: A Merchant's Promise
coveredGames.title: This is a physics based medieval trading simulator! You have to transport and sell goods, all with real time physics, think Death Stranding but medieval and with a cart!

coveredGames.name: Dandelion Void
coveredGames.title: Imagine Project Zomboid but set in space, and you get this game! It's made by a team of Project Zomboid modders, hence the inspiration, and looks incredibly cool. Worth keeping an eye on!

coveredGames.name: Palworld
coveredGames.title: Palworld surprised me! I admittedly missed a lot of the initial hype, and wrote off the Pals as being a gimmick, but actually trying it, I realised it's an incredibly fun and in-depth survival game!

coveredGames.name: Elevator
coveredGames.title: The successor to the popular source mod "Elevator: Source" by the original developers! The demo is great fun, and is already super promising, capturing the original feel of the mod perfectly!

coveredGames.name: Highland Keep
coveredGames.title: An incredibly ambitious medieval survival game set in Scotland! The world is simulated, with factions rising and falling, you can even build your own castle piece by piece! Worth keeping an eye on!

coveredGames.name: Approximately Up
coveredGames.title: Build spaceships with your friends in this chaotic Co-op game! Imagine Space Engineers meets Stormworks, you have to carry out jobs and build the spaceship to do them!

coveredGames.name: Darkwater
coveredGames.title: This is a 4 player co-op horror game where you and your friends are a submarine crew isolated in the icy depths of an alien moon. Imagine Barotrauma, but first person and 3D!

coveredGames.name: Loya
coveredGames.title: This survival game is inspired by Howl’s Moving Castle, where your base isn’t just a house, it’s a walking fortress. It's a solo dev passion project and looks great, can't wait to play it!

coveredGames.name: Storage Hunter Simulator
coveredGames.title: A really fun simulator game, has a lot of content and an addictive gameplay loop! You can even play with friends!

coveredGames.name: Saleblazers
coveredGames.title: Saleblazers is a game that massively surprised me! It's addictive, well polished and a unique blend of genres that I don't think has ever been done before (shop management + survival!). Great game!

coveredGames.name: ORMOD: Directive
coveredGames.title: One of my most anticipated 2026 games! ORMOD is a survival game that seems to have something for everybody, with PVP or PVE options, infinite procedural worlds to explore and in-depth automation!

coveredGames.name: Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business
coveredGames.title: Rad turn-based tactics with autobattler-ish segments.

coveredGames.name: Towers of Babble
coveredGames.title: Just one more First Clear...

coveredGames.name: Rift of the NecroDancer
coveredGames.title: It's a rhythm game! It's rad! It has Undertale and Mystery Skulls! the harder stuff is incredibly hard!

coveredGames.name: The Last Faith
coveredGames.title: I backed this! It's not terrible but it's not great either.

coveredGames.name: Mina the Hollower
coveredGames.title: Extremely rad, amazing music, great character design, makes good use of the DualSense light bar, only let down by having lots of silly modifiers you can use to make the game incredibly easy.

coveredGames.name: LIMBO
coveredGames.title: Absolute classic puzzle platformer from the Xbox Live Indie days.

coveredGames.name: Titanium Court
coveredGames.title: It's a game of some kind! Grab it! Don't read anything about it! Play the demo if you're unsure.

coveredGames.name: SteamWorld Dig
coveredGames.title: I am a robot and I'm digging a hole!

coveredGames.name: ChainStaff
coveredGames.title: Absolutely rocking Run 'N Gun that's a bit Bionic Commando and a bit Shadow of the Beast. Great soundtrack, lovely visuals, fun gameplay and Amiga vibes.

coveredGames.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® V
coveredGames.title: I prefer Civ IV overall but this one is pretty different to IV and is still a good one.

coveredGames.name: Xenosensory
coveredGames.title: Short, addictive and fun little thing. You can set the speed of progression at the start to choose if it takes about 1, 2 or 3 hours to complete (I suggest setting it to 3.)

coveredGames.name: ENDLESS Space™ 2
coveredGames.title: A great 4X with incredible vibes and one of the best soundtracks ever made. The AI was very broken but it just got an update to fix that.

coveredGames.name: NEO Scavenger
coveredGames.title: Amazing game with oldschool vibes in that you have to work things out for yourself. One of the best inventory systems around.

coveredGames.name: Demonschool
coveredGames.title: Rad tactical battles very much on the puzzly end of the spectrum, good visuals, good music, funny dialogue, though so far very easy.

coveredGames.name: Morsels
coveredGames.title: Incredible visuals, great vibes, gameplay is good fun though very oldschool in that it doesn't tell you what pretty much anything does and you have to work it out yourself.

coveredGames.name: Deep Space Exploitation
coveredGames.title: Short but sweet space mining with 2D physics.

coveredGames.name: Evil Egg
coveredGames.title: Rad Robotron-like.

coveredGames.name: Splice
coveredGames.title: Rad puzzle game with an excellent soundtrack.

coveredGames.name: BALL x PIT
coveredGames.title: I love playing with my balls!

coveredGames.name: Kill the Brickman
coveredGames.title: This game has the JUICE!

coveredGames.name: Plants vs. Zombies GOTY Edition
coveredGames.title: There's a zombie on your lawn!

coveredGames.name: Pseudoregalia
coveredGames.title: Short but sweet 3D platforming Metroidvania with great movement and excellent vibes.

coveredGames.name: Greed Corp
coveredGames.title: Fun board game!

coveredGames.name: NTE: Neverness to Everness
coveredGames.title: Good as a side game, playing it seriously is just a joke. It is a gacha game with no 50/50 and "ok" pull income, not that the endgame requires anything over 4*. Core gameplay and Minigames very mid.

coveredGames.name: WRC 7 FIA World Rally Championship
coveredGames.title: It's an arcade rally game with every basic functions you would need for casual play, one of the better entries in the WRC series. It's an overall flawed game but it's worth its asking price.

coveredGames.name: Silly Linguine Cat Simulator Deluxe Online
coveredGames.title: Silly Cat Clicker, no drops but has achievements & gambling minigames.

coveredGames.name: Fox Hime
coveredGames.title: Nice little kinetic VN, it has no VO but it doesn't really matter since it's pretty short. It's the first localised title in the Fox Hime series and the first game from Asicxart on Steam.

coveredGames.name: TBH: Task Bar Hero
coveredGames.title: Collects data in shady ways and barely works as a game

coveredGames.name: Touch Some Grass
coveredGames.title: It's a "gimmick game", it's more of a minigame where you move your hand and dodge stuff for a couple of minutes.

coveredGames.name: Assassin’s Creed® IV Black Flag™
coveredGames.title: One of the best entry in the series, it's Pirate of the Caribbean but with a Assassin's Creed twist. Get the OG before the "remaster" come out.

coveredGames.name: Bongo Cat
coveredGames.title: It's a nice desktop companion that counts your clicks, it has very grindy achievements and some item drops

coveredGames.name: DiRT Rally 2.0
coveredGames.title: The Dark Souls of Rally games. It's in between a pure simulator and sim-cade rally game, way more realistic than WRC but not to a fault. It's fun.

coveredGames.name: Forza Horizon 5
coveredGames.title: A fun big open-world sim-cade racing game set in Mexico, definitely a good casual game, stay away from anything PvP though

coveredGames.name: Duet Night Abyss
coveredGames.title: It can be fun and the gacha-less game design is innovative but the steam release took a while and updates are lackluster

coveredGames.name: Aseprite
coveredGames.title: The classic Sprite-making tool. There's a free version if you're broke (LibreSprite).

coveredGames.name: The Crew Motorfest
coveredGames.title: The main competitor to Forza Horizon and overall a quite fun game to play. Updates are frequent and community features are a main part of the game, variety is slimmer than previous entries.

coveredGames.name: The Crew™ 2
coveredGames.title: Actually a pretty fun racing game, very arcadey with lots of options to choose from. Beware possible End of Service and other shenanigans by Ubisoft.

coveredGames.name: Wuthering Waves
coveredGames.title: One of the nicer gacha games out at the moment. It has it's own problems but it's overall playable and decent, much better than the competition anyway.

coveredGames.name: Pixel Puzzles 2: Anime
coveredGames.title: Decent puzzle game. The artworks tend to be nostalgic and basic but still nice to see. The pieces in this entry can rotate and have various shapes so keep that in mind.

coveredGames.name: FISH
coveredGames.title: Simply and descriptively named, FISH is a fast-paced platformer run and gun shooter where you play as the titular Killer Fish From San Diego. You battle levels of enemies using a plethora of firearms.

coveredGames.name: MAGE: Mega Awesome Gregarious Encounters
coveredGames.title: M.A.G.E is a unique arena fighter about using spells and moving using attacks. The game has promise and has a fun art direction, but the requirement of Remote Play for online battles hinders it.

coveredGames.name: Grapple Gunners
coveredGames.title: Grapple Gunners is a fast-paced, stylistic player-verse-player party game that revolves around quick thinking and precise aiming and movement. It's a very fun game to come back to every now and then.

coveredGames.name: White Knuckle
coveredGames.title: White Knuckle is a roguelite climbing game about scaling brutalist superstructures in the ruins of a futuristic containment lab. Dynamic movement mechanics create a difficult yet fun gameplay loop.

coveredGames.name: Reus 2
coveredGames.title: Reus 2 is a puzzle god-sim game where you control elemental giants to aid humanity. Colonies have complex interpersonal relations and wants and, added with the fun art style, everything feels alive.

coveredGames.name: Vampy's Big Day
coveredGames.title: Vampy's Big Day is an adventure puzzle story game with a quirky art style where you play as Vampy, a young vampire, trying to (or deliberately failing to) right your ways with the blessing of the sun.

coveredGames.name: Bopl Battle
coveredGames.title: Bopl Battle is a 2D platformer fighting game revolving around synergizing move-sets and physics-based maps. Nearly every victory feels satisfying with its unique take on a tried-and-true formula.

coveredGames.name: WOIM
coveredGames.title: WOIM is a puzzle game with a distinctly gleepy art style where you play as a worm, cutting and looping yourself to create for unique, balanced and entertaining gameplay.

coveredGames.name: CardBoard
coveredGames.title: CardBoard is a multiplayer party card-based roguelike with surprisingly in-depth mechanics, centered around going around the board while upgrading your cards and competing against your friends.

coveredGames.name: Radiotext
coveredGames.title: Radiotext is a mysterious, story-based game that has you decode puzzles, talk with team members, and type various commands. The high pressure situations make it really interesting and fun to navigate.

coveredGames.name: Maze Creep!!
coveredGames.title: Maze Creep!! is a surprisingly entertaining Co-op roguelike escape room game that has you delving deeper through the levels to discover new enemies and obstacles. A great play-with-the-friends game.

coveredGames.name: REANIMAL
coveredGames.title: REANIMAL is a delightfully atmospheric co-op horror puzzle-platformer game that manages to keep you on edge from start to finish. Its demo gives you just enough content to experience and get hooked.

coveredGames.name: Love Craft
coveredGames.title: Brings a whole new definition to "Lovecraftian horrors." Art style is appealing and between characters interactions are interesting. Achievements and 30 unique endings bring a lot of replayability.

coveredGames.name: CloverPit
coveredGames.title: Cloverpit is a roguelite "gambling" strategy game where you earn as much money as possible in a hellish prison by using insane item synergies, all conveyed through a unique grimey pixel art style.

coveredGames.name: Cleared Hot
coveredGames.title: Cleared Hot is a top-down story-based physics helicopter fighter. What we thought was going to be a senseless destruction simulator ended up being a surprisingly funny senseless destruction simulator.

coveredGames.name: TAMASHIKA
coveredGames.title: TAMASHIKA is a chaotic roguelike-esque LSD trip of a game where you fight through rooms of enemies utilizing satisfying parrying and quick thinking.

coveredGames.name: BALL x PIT
coveredGames.title: Ball x Pit is a roguelite take on the classic breakout where you upgrade your character during the round and permanently through a buildable town, all conveyed through a beautiful pixel art aesthetic.

coveredGames.name: The Trolley Solution
coveredGames.title: The trolley solution is a hilarious take on the trolley problem, turned up to a thousand. One moment you're a schoolgirl fighting through middle school and the next you've killed your parents.

coveredGames.name: Hexologic
coveredGames.title: A short and charming puzzle game. Stays pretty relaxed throughout, has a really nice minimalist art style that's nice to look at, and introduces new gimmicks at a really comfortable pace. Good stuff.

coveredGames.name: Roadside Research
coveredGames.title: Silly rural gas station simulator with the fun twist of you being an alien with ulterior alien motives. Very solid depth of content and gameplay loop, that remained engaging but never too intense.

coveredGames.name: Waterpark Simulator
coveredGames.title: An endlessly fun, addicting, and stupid gem that manages to stand out amongst the sea of Steam simulator games. Has a fast-paced Overcooked-style gameplay loop that pushes you to your limits at times.

coveredGames.name: Paralives
coveredGames.title: Still in very early access, but regardless a fantastic Life Sim not published by EA. Tons of gameplay freedom and mod support, and a really pretty comic art style, all at a rather fair price point.

coveredGames.name: Subnautica 2
coveredGames.title: While still in very early access, Subnautica 2 is already in a great spot. I would say it's still worth 30 dollars even though we only have a fraction of the content and quality of life planned.

coveredGames.name: House Flipper
coveredGames.title: Although the sequel is out, there's still merit in playing the original. It remains an immensely satisfying game with a lot of customization potential and a healthy amount of content without the DLCs.

coveredGames.name: Bunny Guys!
coveredGames.title: A rather strange Only Up!-style obstacle course platformer, with full-fledged multiplayer and leaderboards. While extremely fun with friends, inconsistent game mechanics and movement are INFURIATING.

coveredGames.name: Planet Coaster
coveredGames.title: While a sequel does exist, Planet Coaster still holds up remarkably well and remains an excellent start to Frontier's Planet franchise, with a huge amount of content and freedom at a low cost.

coveredGames.name: 8AM
coveredGames.title: Incredibly simple, straight-forward anomaly hunting game, where you search through cameras, look for spooky things, rinse and repeat. Has a jumpscare toggle for those sensitive to startling imagery.

coveredGames.name: Planet Zoo
coveredGames.title: With the near arrival of the sequel, I returned to and still adore Planet Zoo. Though DLC is extremely mean-spirited, as with most Frontier games, this is still one of the best tycoons of all time.

coveredGames.name: Dead Island 2
coveredGames.title: My favorite zombie game. Mostly retcons the 2011 classic, in a fantastic new Los Angeles setting and with some fun gameplay additions. Incredibly strong combat, cast of characters, and replayability.

coveredGames.name: PRAGMATA
coveredGames.title: A staggeringly good Capcom original, with a unique and deep take on puzzle shooters. The story is just okay, but the heavily diverse gameplay loop and the chemistry between the leads are unrivaled.

coveredGames.name: Resident Evil Requiem
coveredGames.title: An incredibly solid and reflective love letter to the RE franchise, in both story aesthetics and gameplay elements. Derives gameplay influences from RE1R, RE2R, RE4R, RE0, RE7, and RE4R.

coveredGames.name: Tomb Raider Game of the Year
coveredGames.title: A revolutionary third-person shooter narrative, that holds up remarkably well. Smooth controls, deep exploration, addicting combat, a great story, and arguably the best take on Lara in the franchise.

coveredGames.name: A Little to the Left
coveredGames.title: Straight-forward, satisfying organizational puzzle game, with an incredibly pleasing art style and good variability in puzzle type and ways in which you can solve some puzzles.

coveredGames.name: Catherine Classic
coveredGames.title: Despite being one of the hardest games I've ever played, Catherine is a forgotten drama/puzzle masterpiece with a lot to say about commitment and infidelity that I adore. Best ATLUS game, don't @ me.

coveredGames.name: Megabonk
coveredGames.title: Stupidly fun roguelite built on speed, humor, and build variety. Controls feel great, the old fantasy game visual style was nailed, and the developer has a ton of integrity and deserves the support.

coveredGames.name: Dispatch
coveredGames.title: Unbelievably good for a debut title. Interactive superhero narrative, akin to the licensed Telltale games, sporting shockingly fun logic/puzzle gameplay, with a fantastic story and cast of characters.

coveredGames.name: Puzzle Chambers
coveredGames.title: A simple but fun logic-based puzzle game, with 67 levels that get pretty challenging, and a charming artstyle and story to give it some much-needed character. Snag it for free while you still can.

coveredGames.name: LOLLIPOP CHAINSAW RePOP
coveredGames.title: Despite being pricey at base cost, RePOP is a fun, funny, creative remaster of an underrated PS3/360 zombie slasher. The censorship discussion is stupid, the game is just fun, leave it at that.

coveredGames.name: Crash Bandicoot™ N. Sane Trilogy
coveredGames.title: The first three entries of a revolutionary and classic platformer, remade from the ground up with revamped physics. N-Sane Trilogy is addicting, fun, stylistic, and an absurdly good value on sale.

coveredGames.name: Stardew Valley
coveredGames.title: My favorite farm game of all time, and an absolute must-play for fans of more casual games. Incredibly open-ended and loaded with hundreds of hours of content, with fantastic day-to-day progression.

coveredGames.name: Slime Rancher
coveredGames.title: Nearly a decade and still a joy to play. A sprawling, unique take on farm games with tons of fun slime variants and a satisfying progression system that rewards every little thing you find and do.

coveredGames.name: Stellar Blade™
coveredGames.title: Fantastic port. Sex appeal stuff aside, Stellar Blade is a relatively short, but great sword-fighting RPG in a fun sci-fi universe with strong combat, characters, and world-building. No PSN required!

coveredGames.name: Scribblenauts Unlimited
coveredGames.title: Still a certified banger almost 15 years later. Relatively short, but insanely open-ended adventure sandbox that, despite being a game for children, actually has a few pretty challenging puzzles.

coveredGames.name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE
coveredGames.title: Final Fantasy Resonance is a return to the series’ turn-based roots. Using the skeleton and assets from a mobile game, Square Enix has transformed this into a complete, classic experience.

coveredGames.name: Braid, Anniversary Edition
coveredGames.title: "They got this game right, for people who smoke, for people who drink... It ain't got no point to the game, it's like Mario in the future and it is Mario in a suit with a tie on."

coveredGames.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
coveredGames.title: Play as Trevor Belmont's daughter Rose in this new entry by the developers of Dead Cells. The art is a departure from all other Castlevania games and that might turn some away.

coveredGames.name: Order of the Sinking Star
coveredGames.title: Puzzle master "Jonathan Blows expectations out of the water" has done it again.

coveredGames.name: Silver Pines
coveredGames.title: Silver Pines is the 2D metroidvania - Alan Wake game that I didn't know I needed. Survival horror meets limited resources, and exploration. October was the perfect release window for this game.

coveredGames.name: Palworld
coveredGames.title: Palworld combines survival gameplay with Pokemon Legends and guns. So, anyway I started blasting....... and catching.

coveredGames.name: Mixtape
coveredGames.title: Mixtape is an interactive story much like a walking simulator that tells the story of 3 burnout type high school kids based in the 90s. Beat in 3 hours.

coveredGames.name: Sea of Stars: Sunset Edition
coveredGames.title: Sea of Stars is a turn-based RPG with timed button press mechanics similar to Mario RPG. Gorgeous art and a heartfelt story.

coveredGames.name: Chained Echoes
coveredGames.title: Chained Echoes is a small team developed turn-based RPG inspired by Chrono Trigger and Xenogears. A-tier combat and political intrigue.

coveredGames.name: Retro Rewind - Video Store Simulator
coveredGames.title: Retro Rewind is like my first job at Blockbuster Video in the mid 90s. Great job and great game.

coveredGames.name: Slay the Spire 2
coveredGames.title: Slay the Spire 2 is a deck building roguelike. It's like the first game but with much more content.

coveredGames.name: MOUSE: P.I. For Hire
coveredGames.title: Mouse: P.I. for Hire is a boomer shooter inspired by early 1920s animation. It doesn't do anything innovative with gameplay but the atmosphere more than makes up for it.

coveredGames.name: Saint Slayer: Spear of Sacrilege
coveredGames.title: Saint Slayer is an NES Castlevania inspired 2D side scroller, action-adventure game. Not for the faint of heart or people who hate Knockback (tm).

coveredGames.name: Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors
coveredGames.title: Slay the Spire 2, eat your heart out.

coveredGames.name: Megabonk
coveredGames.title: Megabonk is Vampire Survivors with sliding and in 3D.

coveredGames.name: CloverPit
coveredGames.title: CloverPit is a slot machine rogue-like that is sort of a mix between Balatro, Inscryption and the Saw franchise. If you fail to meet the winning thresholds, fall to your death. 666 pick up sticks.

coveredGames.name: BALL x PIT
coveredGames.title: BALL x PIT is a brick breaker, a bullet hell, city mgmt, RPG; It fuses together into an addiction. Your power is your special balls and your baby balls. Perfect game for ball lovers.

coveredGames.name: Cult of the Lamb
coveredGames.title: Cult of the Lamb is a roguelike, dungeon crawler but also a morbidly adorable village building, cult management sim. Jump on in, the Kool-Aid tastes great!

coveredGames.name: Journey
coveredGames.title: Journey is a must play, heartfelt experience that can be enjoyed completely in a single play session. It is a light platformer, exploration and experimental multiplayer game with jaw-dropping art.

coveredGames.name: Mina the Hollower
coveredGames.title: Mina the Hollower is brought to you by the developers of Shovel Knight. Part Zelda, part Dark Souls with graphics reminiscent of the GBC era, you'll fight, explore and burrow like never before!

coveredGames.name: Balatro
coveredGames.title: Balatro is a roguelike card game based on the rules of poker. Experience different decks, game-altering joker cards and huge multipliers. This game is as addictive and pick up and play as Tetris is.

coveredGames.name: Hollow Knight
coveredGames.title: Hollow Knight is the critically acclaimed game that revitalized the Metroidvania genre that features Dark Souls like elements and cutesy insect characters. Exploration and challenging bosses await!

coveredGames.name: COCOON
coveredGames.title: Cocoon is a puzzle solving game with light platforming where you play as an insect that has the ability to travel between worlds in an instant. The game should take approximately 5 hours to complete.

coveredGames.name: Sword of the Sea
coveredGames.title: Sword of the Sea is a combination of Journey, The Pathless, and Tony Hawk's Pro Skater and it takes place in a desert with mystical elements of ocean and sea life; not unlike Sea World - San Antonio.

coveredGames.name: Hollow Knight: Silksong
coveredGames.title: Hollow Knight Silksong is the long awaited Metroidvania game that sees you take control of Hornet from the first game. Experience a fully realized sequel with new combat and a new map to explore!

coveredGames.name: Nobody Saves the World
coveredGames.title: Nobody Saves the World is an action-adventure and dungeon crawling game with a variety of classes to play that is the perfect companion to listening to your favorite podcast or audio book.

coveredGames.name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
coveredGames.title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 is a turn-based action RPG with addictive game play, an engaging story and charming characters. If you like JRPGs or anything French, this one is for you.

coveredGames.name: The Bazaar
coveredGames.title: The Bazaar is a drafting auto-battler roguelike where every run is a unique puzzle. You'll manage resources and put your builds against other player's using an asynchronous multiplayer system.

coveredGames.name: NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound
coveredGames.title: Ninja Gaiden Ragebound is a side-scrolling action game by the developers of the Blasphemous series. Experience fast, kinetic game play with challenging boss fights, collectibles and a ranking system.

coveredGames.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator
coveredGames.title: TCG Simulator lets you live out your dreams of owning a card shop complete with dealing with inventory, expansion and sometimes smelly customers.

coveredGames.name: Minishoot' Adventures
coveredGames.title: Minishoot Adventures is a cross between an old school Zelda game and a twin-stick shooter. The map is full of secrets and power ups to find and the gameplay is exactly what you'd want out of a shooter

coveredGames.name: Inscryption
coveredGames.title: Inscryption is part card game, part board game, part rogue like, part horror game. If you enjoy any of the aforementioned genres, you'll adore Inscryption. One of the most unique games in years.

coveredGames.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate
coveredGames.title: TMNT Splintered Fate is a Hades inspired rogue-like for fans of the series. Game play feels like an exact Hades copy but that's not a bad thing. Fans of the series will enjoy all the East eggs.

coveredGames.name: Cuphead
coveredGames.title: Cuphead is a hard as nails action platformer with a focus on boss battles inspired by 1930s cartoons. As long as you play games better than a games journalist, you shouldn't have too much difficulty.

coveredGames.name: No Rest for the Wicked
coveredGames.title: No Rest for the Wicked is an ARPG who is a cross between Diablo 4 and Dark Souls from Moon Studios (Ori). Combat feels calculated and satisfying and the graphics are dripping with style.

coveredGames.name: TUNIC
coveredGames.title: TUNIC is a charming isometric action/puzzle game that takes inspiration from the Zelda series but also incorporates elements from Souls games. Combat feels deliberate with its blocking and dodging.

coveredGames.name: Blasphemous
coveredGames.title: Blasphemous is a Spanish, Castlevania inspired Metroidvania with souls elements. The art is at times grotesque but always beautiful. The combat is fun and visceral with lots of upgrades to find.

coveredGames.name: Shovel Knight: Treasure Trove
coveredGames.title: Shovel Knight is a value packed ode to 8 bit classics such as Mario Bros, Megaman and old Disney games. The game play and level design are expertly crafted and the art style is oozing with character.

coveredGames.name: PEAK
coveredGames.title: PEAK is a joy to play with friends despite some connectivity bugs that need to be fixed. The game play is similar to BOTW climbing with an energy meter and lunging, but with an emphasis on teamwork.

coveredGames.name: Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo
coveredGames.title: Pipstrello and the Cursed Yoyo is a fantastic throwback to Zelda games or other top-down dungeon puzzle platformers. The platforming is fun, the puzzles are intuitive and never get frustrating.

coveredGames.name: Peglin
coveredGames.title: A pretty fun and addicting roguelike~ They managed to turn Peg into something awesome and unique 卅(•‿•)卅

coveredGames.name: DREDGE
coveredGames.title: This is exactly the kind of horror I like. Stressful and mysterious~ Kinda like the first season of "The Promising Neverland". A very good game 卅(^‿^)卅 !

coveredGames.name: ReStory: Chill Electronics Repairs
coveredGames.title: The demo was fun :3 I'm excited to see the full release !

coveredGames.name: My Friend Pedro
coveredGames.title: This is one of my favorite action/platformer game. The combat is very satisfying~ 卅(•‿•)卅

coveredGames.name: Metal: Hellsinger
coveredGames.title: The combat feels good when you get used to it and the music is a banger. The gameplay is similar to Doom (2016) but with rythm 卅(^‿^)卅 Also that final song, chef kiss.

coveredGames.name: Moonlighter
coveredGames.title: The concept of exploring dungeons and being a shopkeeper is pretty cool and fun. I enjoyed seeing my shop grow as the story progressed 卅(•‿•)卅

coveredGames.name: Cassette Beasts 2002
coveredGames.title: Wooper is hyped about this game :3

coveredGames.name: V Rising
coveredGames.title: A very fun Survival Craft with a cool vampire theme~ Building a castle is very fun and satisfying. The bosses are unique and fun to fight :3 It's a perfect game to play with a friend or two 卅(^‿^)卅

coveredGames.name: Forza Horizon 6
coveredGames.title: A fun casual racing game with a LOT of cars! The game is pretty and the region is fun to explore ^^ But, the AI can be frustrating and the game is pricy >,<; It's overall a good game tho 卅(•‿•)卅

coveredGames.name: TUNIC

coveredGames.title: Shaving milliseconds off a run never felt so good. If you liked the fast-paced time trial boomer shooter mechanics of Ultrakill, Neon White is a more polished and visually stunning upgrade.

coveredGames.name: Killer Frequency
coveredGames.title: A unique horror setup of trying to help people survive a slasher as a radio DJ by taking calls from the killers' victims. It's a stylish execution on something you can't get anywhere else.

coveredGames.name: October Panic
coveredGames.title: A halloween-themed Metroidvania with a bunch of musical stings from classic horror movies? Yes please! The short length of the game is a buzzkill, but I'm happy with what I got.

coveredGames.name: Peglin
coveredGames.title: Don't talk to me if you rate this any less than 10/10. Peglin is the best in its genre, mashing dungeon crawls with addicting peggle-style pachinko gameplay and adorable visuals sprinkled on top.

coveredGames.name: Black Book
coveredGames.title: A complex, addicting deckbuilding game with eerie storybook visuals that slaps you in the face with splendid slavic folk horror. Highly recommended for halloween play.

coveredGames.name: Autumn Park Mini Golf
coveredGames.title: Nothing revolutionary gameplay-wise, but this game set out to give you an idyllic environment you want to spend time in, and on that front they succeeded. If you miss October, this has you covered.

coveredGames.name: Crow Country
coveredGames.title: Definitive survival horror experience. Engaging puzzles interspersed with combat that keeps you on your toes all wrapped up in a cute and unsettling defunct theme park package.

coveredGames.name: Demon Turf: Queens Edition
coveredGames.title: A good quality collectathon platformer that somehow manages to make 2d sprites work in a 3d world. Worlds are vibrant, movement is engaging, and there's enough side objectives to keep you coming back.

coveredGames.name: Night in the Woods
coveredGames.title: All games are art, but this one is ART. It conveys a beautiful, moving, at times eerie story with a quirky and quaint charm that eschews dopamine highs for a bittersweet melancholy tone.

coveredGames.name: Corn Kidz 64
coveredGames.title: Nails the 1998 feel of old school n64 platforms warts and all. Platforming isn't as slick as I would like, but it is relentless in that y2k scene kid cringe that's oddly charming in retrospect

coveredGames.name: Pseudoregalia
coveredGames.title: Some of the best precision platforming ever. Love the style, love the movement, and I love the view running around as a pixellated goat lady with legs for days traversing the world in a tight leotard.

coveredGames.name: Nubby's Number Factory
coveredGames.title: Gas. Absolute gas. This game goes all in on one thing: Making Big Numbers that tickle your dopamine receptors in the best way possible. I couldn't stop until I beat every challenge mode.

coveredGames.name: Haste
coveredGames.title: What the mach speed levels in Sonic 06 wish they could be. It's an indescribable dopamine high hitting a ramp just right and building huge bursts of momentum. Pick this up if you like TF2 Surf.

coveredGames.name: SUMMERHOUSE
coveredGames.title: A little building game where you can mix and match different blocks and decorations to create cozy cottages, colorful seaside towns, and peaceful little villages. The game is super cozy and relaxing!

coveredGames.name: Finding Cats
coveredGames.title: A cute hidden-object game with lovely storybook artwork, kind of like Snow White but with adorable cats! The gameplay is simple and easy, with a hint button if you get stuck.

coveredGames.name: Weirdo
coveredGames.title: A black-and-white manga-style visual novel about a student caught up in mysterious events at his new school. Make choices to unlock multiple endings and creepy surprises!

coveredGames.name: The Bear - A Story from the World of Gra
coveredGames.title: A super cozy little game about a tiny character who helps a lonely bear discover the wonders of the world. It has five chapters, beautiful artwork, and a dreamy starry night atmosphere!

coveredGames.name: Snow of Penglai
coveredGames.title: A short visual novel set in ancient China, following Xuanhua, a wooden puppet brought to life by a mysterious witch and physician named Hanchuan. Beautiful illustrations and four chapters to explore.

coveredGames.name: 6-Sided Stories
coveredGames.title: A cute and relaxing puzzle game where you flip and recolor pieces to reveal adorable animal illustrations across four seasons. A good game to relax with after a long day.

coveredGames.name: Milk outside a bag of milk outside a bag of milk
coveredGames.title: A visual novel with surreal pixel art and 5 different endings, following a young girl struggling with mental health and painful memories. Recommended for anyone who enjoys emotional stories.

coveredGames.name: Vlare
coveredGames.title: A free point-and-click adventure with cozy nighttime scenery and simple puzzles! Help Eli find the missing telescope pieces while exploring a lovely little city!
A free visual novel about June, a college student who meets a mysterious girl named Tai. As story unfolds, you'll make choices, uncover secrets, and discover more about their relationship.

coveredGames.name: That's not my Neighbor
coveredGames.title: An addictive horror game where you inspect visitors, verify their identities, and catch doppelgangers pretending to be your neighbors. Multiple modes and tricky impostors test your observation skills!

coveredGames.name: Wolfskin's Curse
coveredGames.title: A free visual novel about a former nun trying to prove her werewolf companion's innocence after he's accused of murder. Features beautiful hand-painted artwork, full voice acting, and a short.

coveredGames.name: halfmoon
coveredGames.title: A pixel art visual novel with simple point-and-click minigames about processing souls in the afterlife. A bit slow at times, but 100% achievements are easy to get!

coveredGames.name: Cat Over Here!
coveredGames.title: A cozy 3D hidden-object game where you explore a black-and-white factory, look around machines, pipes, and platforms, and search for 100 adorable hidden cats.

coveredGames.name: Into the Waves
coveredGames.title: A short visual novel about a cursed bartender who sees everyone as shadows until a mysterious woman enters his tavern. Mix cocktails, uncover his past, and discover four different endings!

coveredGames.name: blockia
coveredGames.title: A cute and relaxing LEGO-style building game where you can create both 2D and 3D designs using tons of different blocks! Highly recommended!

coveredGames.name: Hibernation Day
coveredGames.title: A short story about a possum family trying to get along before their long winter hibernation!

coveredGames.name: Later
coveredGames.title: A short hidden-object game where you play hide-and-seek with a cat as the atmosphere gradually changes. Explore escape-room puzzles, arcade mini-games, and hidden secrets in a fun 30-minute adventure!

coveredGames.name: Alex's Hope & Alex's Solitude
coveredGames.title: A short, emotional visual novel featuring two separate stories about a boy searching for hope and a girl struggling with loneliness and rejection.

coveredGames.name: Finding Ruby: Hidden Object Adventure
coveredGames.title: A relaxing hidden-object adventure where you follow Ruby and her friends as they search for her missing parents. Explore 15 beautiful, detailed maps in this charming little adventure!

coveredGames.name: Lost Connections
coveredGames.title: A short visual novel about overcoming social anxiety and finding the courage to ask a girl for her number before she leaves. Your choices lead to different endings in this heartfelt story!

coveredGames.name: ISOLAND4: The Anchor of Memory
coveredGames.title: An adventure puzzle game where you explore mysterious places and uncover secrets about a strange experiment and the island's past. The story explores memory, loneliness, and life.

coveredGames.name: Virtual Cottage
coveredGames.title: A little virtual cottage that creates a peaceful atmosphere with cozy visuals, relaxing music, and gentle background sounds. A lovely companion for studying, working, or relaxing.

coveredGames.name: Velvet 89
coveredGames.title: A historical hidden-object game about the Velvet Revolution of 1989. Search through crowds to find people and discover their stories while learning about this historical event.

coveredGames.name: Colorizing
coveredGames.title: A relaxing pixel art coloring game where you fill in numbered pixels to complete various pictures. It features 100 easy achievements and customizable background colors.

coveredGames.name: Witch You Want
coveredGames.title: A free visual novel where you take a job as an assistant to a struggling witch who needs help saving her potion shop. Help brew potions and save the shop, with a touch of romance along the way!

coveredGames.name: Tukoni: Forest Keepers
coveredGames.title: A point-and-click adventure set in a beautifully forest, where you help adorable woodland creatures prepare for winter, solve puzzles, and brew tea. A cozy autumn fairy tale I wish would never end!

coveredGames.name: Margo
coveredGames.title: A short point-and-click game that follows Margo as she goes about her evening after waking up from a nap. Help her complete small tasks and discover amusing details around her apartment.

coveredGames.name: one night, hot springs
coveredGames.title: A visual novel about a birthday trip to a hot spring, where even a simple getaway can come with unexpected challenges. A thoughtful story with multiple endings and meaningful choices.

coveredGames.name: Tidy Till Dawn
coveredGames.title: Spend your night restoring order to a convenience store after a group of troublemakers leaves it in chaos. A laid-back game with useful upgrades to make your shift easier.

coveredGames.name: //TODO: today
coveredGames.title: A free visual novel about a struggling artist navigating life with the help of a mysterious AI. Lovely pastel artwork, romance options, and multiple endings.

coveredGames.name: Hidden Arcade: Hundreds of Ghosts!
coveredGames.title: A cute little free hidden-object game where you search for hundreds of ghosts hidden throughout the arcade.

coveredGames.name: Chinese Street Food Legend
coveredGames.title: A casual Chinese street food simulation game where you run a kaolengmian stall and later unlock a tanghulu stall. Prepare snacks, serve customers, and upgrade your equipment for faster cooking!

coveredGames.name: 100 Cats Lost In Canada Find & Color
coveredGames.title: Find 100 hidden cats across hand-drawn Canadian scenes, then bring the illustrations to life with color!

coveredGames.name: Under Leaves
coveredGames.title: A cute little hidden-object game where you help animals find what they need across colourful nature-themed maps. I love how the animals stay in the scene once you've helped them!

coveredGames.name: Damn Exam
coveredGames.title: Play teacher and catch sneaky students cheating on exams using classroom cameras and clues about their suspicious behaviors! (ಠ‿ಠ) Really interesting game!

coveredGames.name: The Ice Cream Culprit
coveredGames.title: A missing ice cream leads to an awkward dilemma: should you tell your girlfriend who ate it, or keep the culprit a secret? Your choices affect her reactions and determine!

coveredGames.name: Goblet of Mercy
coveredGames.title: A strange Halloween party turns into a dangerous encounter with a powerful vampire who controls her own twisted world. Different choices lead to multiple endings.

coveredGames.name: Four Rendezvous
coveredGames.title: A short visual novel about a young writer who meets a mysterious girl in a park while struggling with strange, lifelike dreams.

coveredGames.name: Tukoni: Prologue
coveredGames.title: Join Tukoni on a peaceful journey through an autumn forest, helping the woodland animals and solving little puzzles along the way. A cozy adventure full of mushrooms, tea, and forest charm! 🍄

coveredGames.name: Mushroom Cats 2
coveredGames.title: Help the adorable Mushroom Cats find their missing hats in magical settings. A lovely hidden-object game that’s more challenging than the first Mushroom Cats game.

coveredGames.name: PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS

coveredGames.name: Hunt: Showdown 1896

coveredGames.name: Unpacking

coveredGames.name: Tiny Glade
coveredGames.title: Visually beautiful and relaxing, but the gameplay loop is incredibly niche. If you aren't deeply into pure sandbox building, you might find yourself getting bored rather quickly.

coveredGames.name: Assetto Corsa
coveredGames.title: Amazing racing simulator with a massive car and track roster! Playing with a steering wheel and Content Manager mods elevates the realism completely. A must own for driving enthusiasts.

coveredGames.name: Wreckfest 2

coveredGames.name: My Garage
coveredGames.title: Incredible car work mechanics, but the dead world, low-budget textures, and janky co-op hold it back. Recommended purely as a single-player mechanic sim, but it lacks outside detail.

coveredGames.name: Palia
coveredGames.title: An absolute favorite with 360+ hours! Deeply relaxing and cozy, with fantastic collection mechanics to build up over time. Perfect to sink hours into if you love social simulators.

coveredGames.name: Stardew Valley
coveredGames.title: Clapped 140+ hours into this gold standard cozy sim. It is deeply relaxing, beautiful, and the PC modding support makes the replayability endless. A masterpiece for cozy gaming fans.

coveredGames.name: Satisfactory
coveredGames.title: Playing on a map with my partner and absolutely loving the exploration! Figuring out mining setups and building transport lines to the main base is incredibly rewarding. Highly satisfying.

coveredGames.name: House Flipper
coveredGames.title: Absolutely loving it! Snagged all the DLCs, hunting down achievements, and completely hooked on the flipping loop. It’s an essential, incredibly satisfying staple for any simulation fan.

coveredGames.name: Cyberpunk Store Simulator

coveredGames.name: Tales of Fear - Episode Zero
coveredGames.title: Engaging horror concept with great jump scares and smooth PC performance. Love hunting for the achievement collectibles! Looking forward to seeing more episodic stories added in the future.

coveredGames.name: Crime Scene Cleaner
coveredGames.title: Incredible, smooth, and oddly relaxing cleaning sim. Better mechanics than its rivals, fun tool skins, and great puzzle solving. Nightmare mode adds an awesome supernatural twist to maps!

coveredGames.name: Camper Van: Make it Home
coveredGames.title: Short, beautiful, and incredibly relaxing cozy game. The art style is gorgeous and the audio is deeply calming. Perfect game choice if you just need to wind down and clear your mind.

coveredGames.name: Bongo Cat
coveredGames.title: Super cute, smooth collection game for cat skins, hats, and emojis. It's a blast to have your friends' cats on screen to virtually hang out! Occasional lobby connection issues, but manageable.

coveredGames.name: Boba Cafe Simulator
coveredGames.title: Extends far beyond basic cafe management with hidden locations, recipes, and a cool drink collectible room. It's smooth, well optimized, and incredibly easy to lose hours playing.

coveredGames.name: Lost & Found: A This Bed We Made Story
coveredGames.title: A short but absolutely amazing story extension. It features highly engaging plot twists and a wild cliffhanger ending that left me begging for another episode. Highly recommended!

coveredGames.name: This Bed We Made
coveredGames.title: I don't usually like story games, but the demo hooked me! The mystery, puzzle solving, and branching outcomes made the full game completely worth it. A fantastic narrative experience.

coveredGames.name: ShantyTown
coveredGames.title: Cozy, peaceful, and full of cool hidden details, like bicycles forming a rack when placed together! The pet bed cat is a must have for creative builds. Perfect for a relaxing gaming night.

coveredGames.name: Supermarket Simulator
coveredGames.title: So much fun! I love organizing shelves, running the register, and driving vehicles to buy stock. It runs smoothly on PC with only a few minor, typical bugs. A top-tier management simulator.

coveredGames.name: inZOI
coveredGames.title: Incredible life sim! Endlessly customizable, gorgeous even on low settings. Remember it’s Early Access, so don't bring a potato PC and expect to run it perfectly!

coveredGames.name: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions
coveredGames.title: A lovely, ultra-cozy game that is great for tracking your real-life day-to-day tasks. Collecting the various spirits is a wonderful bonus. Highly recommended for focus and relaxation!

coveredGames.name: Ranch Simulator: Build, Hunt, Farm
coveredGames.title: I love this game so much! It is an amazing experience to play with a partner and build up your ranch setup together. There is always room for improvement, but it's incredibly fun.

coveredGames.name: CarX Drift Racing Online
coveredGames.title: Excellent, highly satisfying drift mechanics! It is incredibly fun to slide around the tracks and deeply customize the bodywork of your vehicles. A must-have for racing and tuning fans.

coveredGames.name: Counter-Strike 2
coveredGames.title: A classic, highly competitive shooter. You will occasionally run into hackers like any multiplayer game, but it's an awesome experience to play with friends when climbing the ranks!

coveredGames.name: Rust
coveredGames.title: Highly recommended if you love survival and intense PvP. The graphics are excellent, it runs incredibly smoothly with minimal bugs, and most importantly, it is just a ton of fun to play.

coveredGames.name: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™
coveredGames.title: Controller support works well. This game is truly designed for gamepads. Recommend using accessibility options to set boost button to a toggle.

coveredGames.name: Nova Swarm
coveredGames.title: Decent retro vertical shooter. It won't be your next big game, but it is a decent "in between" game. Controller support works well, except for some of the menus.

coveredGames.name: Fallout 76
coveredGames.title: Controller support works okay for this game. Would be better if there were more options for dead zones and look/ADS sensitivity, rather than just one slider. Works well enough though.

coveredGames.name: Fallout 4
coveredGames.title: Controller support works well with this game. I haven't finished it yet, but it seems to be a good entry in the series. I just wish we could play at higher frame rates without mods.

coveredGames.name: Fallout 3: Game of the Year Edition
coveredGames.title: Game feels a bit dated, but the controller support still works natively. Definitely play this one if you haven't ever played it. Nostalgic game for me because it was my first game to play in series.

coveredGames.name: Schedule I

coveredGames.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator

coveredGames.name: Slay the Spire

coveredGames.name: Marathon

coveredGames.name: Restore Your Island

coveredGames.name: Destiny 2

coveredGames.name: Cloudpunk

coveredGames.title: don't miss the shrimp guy in the tell grass or you're gonna get stuck later on (I just feel like I shouldn't be able to skip him) also be ready to fight a final... final... final... final boss.

coveredGames.name: Cave Story+

coveredGames.name: Katana ZERO

coveredGames.name: Hollow Knight: Silksong

coveredGames.name: Slots & Daggers

coveredGames.name: Alan Wake's American Nightmare
coveredGames.title: Short spin-off of the original Alan Wake with similar gameplay and a decent story addition. Lacks content, but stays fun and is an easy buy - especially when on sale.

coveredGames.name: DREDGE

coveredGames.name: BALL x PIT

coveredGames.name: Double Knight
coveredGames.title: i was quite surprised how complex this game could be, keeping an eye on all of your knights is a fun challenge with all the upgrades you get during your run. i think ive found a hidden gem. 7/10

coveredGames.name: Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library!
coveredGames.title: It's a chill cleaning game with fun references and lots of charm. i really enjoyed my multiple playthroughs (including grinding for the no magic achievement) 8/10 great concept and well executed!

coveredGames.name: Sensory Overload
coveredGames.title: This is a very fun game that really makes your brain work! Being able to lock in and play out of your mind is very fun and the controls are VERY simple. 7/10 a solid game.

coveredGames.name: God of War Ragnarök
coveredGames.title: this game is incredible and made me tear up multiple times. the graphics are great the gameplay is SMOOTH and the storytelling is impeccable 10/10

coveredGames.name: Borderlands 2
coveredGames.title: incredible game with TONS of replayability. the story is great, the characters are even better! and the guns are VERY fun 10/10 MUST BUY

coveredGames.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
coveredGames.title: Not only a love letter to the Castlevania franchise, but also to the metroidvania genre. With addicting exploration, platforming, stacking of mechanics, and challenges to overcome. Loved every second.

coveredGames.name: Mortal Shell II
coveredGames.title: It's like they took all the good ideas of the first, refined them, and shoved them into a much better video game. Biggest glow up I've seen and one of the best soulslikes as of recently.

coveredGames.name: Well Dweller
coveredGames.title: Not a long metroidvania, but certainly one worth checking out. Nice mixture of cutesy art with horror, exploration more focused survival, nice navigation abilities, and design choices to remove tedium

coveredGames.name: Lost and Found Co.
coveredGames.title: Not the kind of game I expected to play, but now that I did I'm incredibly grateful. Simplistic idea executed well as you search scenes, find the little detail you want, and feel rewarded finding it.

coveredGames.name: SPRAWL zero
coveredGames.title: Sometimes ascending to cybernetic goodhood is a good thing. Very fun combat loop that pushes your petal to the medal. The core mechanics are well executed, and I can forgive story taking a backseat.

coveredGames.name: REPLACED
coveredGames.title: The controls are clunky and may make it difficult the otherwise pretty well executed gameplay. Story is splendid though and is to me one of the best cyberpunk narratives ever written in a video game.

coveredGames.name: Sovereign Tower
coveredGames.title: For a game whose limitations are clear it's amazing how much thought was plugged in. Great management game with impactful choices and a colorful cast to bond with. One of the best of it's kind. 10/10

coveredGames.name: Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree
coveredGames.title: Sad this game isn't getting more love. A fantastic successor to Salt and Sanctuary that I'd go as far to say is a better experience. Great build craft, exploration and art direction.

coveredGames.name: Esoteric Ebb
coveredGames.title: It nails what what Disco Elysium great, forming an identity of it's own, and in some ways also being a better video game. Superb writing, mystery, and choices to make. 10/10

coveredGames.name: Assassin's Creed® Odyssey
coveredGames.title: I know it's the most divisive entry. If you told me you hate it I'd completely understand you. I still loved it though. Love the setting, running around the world, and going on many mini adventures.

coveredGames.name: Assassin's Creed® Syndicate
coveredGames.title: One of those games people hate but I really enjoyed. They took the improvements Unity made and shoved them into a functional video game. One that's not afraid to actually be fun to play through.

coveredGames.name: Assassin's Creed® III Remastered
coveredGames.title: Great story about race and learning to stand for your beliefs despite the discrimination you continuously face. Sadly buried beneath a game with bad pacing and poor usage of it's mechanics.

coveredGames.name: Rhythm Doctor
coveredGames.title: Really cemented my love for rhythm games with a simplistic core gimmick. Constantly finding ways to add challenge, and tells a neat story of hospital workers and their personal struggles.

coveredGames.name: The Rogue Prince of Persia
coveredGames.title: I always wondered what a platformer roguelike would look like. This game proves how to make it work even if it doesn’t have an extensive amount of replay-ability. Ends just when it gets too repetitive

coveredGames.name: GRIME II
coveredGames.title: Improves every single aspect and contains a map I adored exploring the ins and outs of. All while asking if it’s possible to separate art from the artist. A new high point among metroidvanias.

coveredGames.name: DEATH STRANDING 2: ON THE BEACH
coveredGames.title: A splendid sequel that expands on the first both in world building and gameplay. Love venturing through and being rewarded for taking my time. How unafraid the story is to get crazy. 10/10.

coveredGames.name: Cairn
coveredGames.title: This game made me sad. It's one of the most realistic and engaging climbing games I've played, but it's also about a woman trying to find peace with herself even if it means destroying her life. 10/10

coveredGames.name: South of Midnight
coveredGames.title: Gameplay is certainly it's biggest weakness, but the other aspects shine like the sun during a solar flare. Fun art direction, music, and story about people forced to grow up in a life of hurt.

coveredGames.name: Mina the Hollower
coveredGames.title: It's as good as everyone says it is. Some of the bosses are relentless later on, but almost every aspect of this game is expertly or thoughtfully designed. It's good to be a good hunter mate.

coveredGames.name: MIO: Memories in Orbit
coveredGames.title: A couple of the design choices are bad and even I can't defend them. However, it nails what it means to be a metroidvania. With solid e, platforming challenges, and discoveries to be made.

coveredGames.name: Planet of Lana II
coveredGames.title: It's an excellent sequel to a game I really loved, but part of me wonders how it's legacy is going to hold up when they eventually make the third one. It's what I call the "Spiderverse 2" of games.

coveredGames.name: Big Hops Together
coveredGames.title: If you like 3D platformers then please play this game. It's one of the best in recent memory and I think more stories aimed towards children need to teach them how to stand up for themselves.

coveredGames.name: UNBEATABLE
coveredGames.title: The story has some pacing issues and for a game that spent six years in the work there's quite a few bugs. The core gameplay loop is fun and I haven't stopped thinking about it's ending message.

coveredGames.name: Steelrising
coveredGames.title: There's some cool mechanics here, but ultimately it falls a bit flat by the end. With a story that's really forgettable, which is a shame considering the unique historical setting they were going for.

coveredGames.name: TRIANGLE STRATEGY
coveredGames.title: One of my favorite tactics games to date. With fun combat mechanics, decent challenge, different units to experiment with, and an entertaining story where you attempt to maintain political balance.

coveredGames.name: Jackal
coveredGames.title: What if you combined Hotline Miami with Pulp Fiction? You get this game. A fun chaotic top down action game. While frustrating at times it still manages to be an addicting joyride.

coveredGames.name: Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced
coveredGames.title: Plowed through this within a weekend, so it was obviously doing something right. The greatest spiritual successor to the Mega Man X series I've ever seen. Even if the storyline is c as hell.

coveredGames.name: Wargroove
coveredGames.title: I personally suck at this game, but it's a confidentially made tactics game by people who obviously love this style of turn based battles. Story isn't much, but it gets the jobs done.

coveredGames.name: Turbo Overkill
coveredGames.title: Didn't know if I liked this as first, but upon playing more of it I kind of succumbed to the mindlessness. Pretty fun combat loop where you jet around crazily and message about the dangers of AI.

coveredGames.name: Bye Sweet Carole
coveredGames.title: I think this game would've benefitted more from being a click and point rather than a run & hide horror game. There's some very nice animation here and story discussing womanhood & choice. It's art.

coveredGames.name: Cronos: The New Dawn
coveredGames.title: A shame it didn't review well at launch, because this is one of the best survival horror games I played. Rock solid action, balance of player power and resources, and story about love and moving on.

coveredGames.name: Hardspace: Shipbreaker
coveredGames.title: I love this game despite it not being something I can easily recommend to people. An experience you can lose hours to and story who political message can resonate with anyone who worked a job before.

coveredGames.name: Ghostrunner 2
coveredGames.title: Ended up enjoying this one unlike the first. Refined mechanics and systems alongside stuff to help break up the repetition. A less consistent game, but appreciate what they were trying to mess with.

coveredGames.name: Dead Space™ 2
coveredGames.title: A fantastic action packed sequel that somehow still manages to scare you. Fun combat, set pieces, and story that builds upon the groundwork the first set up. Still holds up all these years later.

coveredGames.name: Skate Story
coveredGames.title: Enjoyed this one way more than I was expecting. Don't like skateboarding games but this one is surrounded by a cool artstyle, vibes, killer soundtrack. Hits you right in the feels when it needs to.

coveredGames.name: Cult of the Lamb
coveredGames.title: It feels too basic for it's going for. Not a compelling roguelike due to lack of variety, and not a good base manager as everyone's needs are the same and keeping them happy is easy. Shallow overall.

coveredGames.name: BALL x PIT
coveredGames.title: A very addicitng roguelike that strikes a nice balance between skill and RNG. Letting every run be desperate struggles for survival or chaotic joyrides. Base building is surprisingly good too.

coveredGames.name: Bō: Path of the Teal Lotus
coveredGames.title: A pretty well made metroidvania that I kind of wish wowed me a bit more. Nice artstyle, but nothing mechanically interesting nor does it push itself enough to make the endgame harder than the start.

coveredGames.name: SANABI
coveredGames.title: A very fun 2D platformer with an emphasis on physics and momentum. The real kicker for me though was the narrative, and oh boy you know it's special if it almost made me cry. It's worth a play. 10/10.

coveredGames.name: Wanderstop
coveredGames.title: A cozy management game that chooses to end and for a good reason. Contains a very nicely told story about burnout and self worth alongside nice game design. It made me feel something. 10/10.

coveredGames.name: Deeper...
